Extensive experiments on four multimodal remote sensing datasets demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior classification performance. The code is available at https://github.com/HaoLiu-XDU/BDGF.

</details>


### [180] [Mitigating Visual Context Degradation in Large Multimodal Models: A Training-Free Decoupled Agentic Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23322)
*Hongrui Jia,Chaoya Jiang,Shikun Zhang,Wei Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种免训练、即插即用的 DRP 框架，通过“推理器-观察者”解耦机制在长链推理中按需调用视觉细节，显著抑制视觉漂移并提升多模态推理准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型多模态模型在长链推理中逐步忽视初始视觉线索，导致视觉锚定失效与结论错误，亟需无需重训练即可恢复视觉约束的新范式。

Method: DRP（Decoupled Reasoning from Perception）：以 LLM 为策略推理器、LMM 为专用观察者，推理器显式向观察者发起查询获取所需视觉细节，实现 Zero-shot、免训练、模型无关的协同推理。

Result: MathVision 基准上 Qwen2.5-VL-7B+Qwen3-32B 组合准确率 47.2%，超越 GPT-4o 的 40.6%；同时有效降低推理漂移并强化视觉锚定。

Conclusion: DRP 在不增加训练或结构改动的前提下，可靠地引导多模态推理轨迹，展示了低成本提升 LMM 视觉一致性与准确性的广阔前景。

Abstract: With the continuous expansion of Large Language Models (LLMs) and advances in reinforcement learning, LLMs have demonstrated exceptional reasoning capabilities, enabling them to address a wide range of complex problems. Inspired by these achievements, researchers have extended related techniques to Large Multimodal Models (LMMs). However, a critical limitation has emerged, reflected in the progressive loss of visual grounding. As the reasoning chain grows longer, LMMs tend to rely increasingly on the textual information generated in earlier steps, while the initially extracted visual information is rarely revisited or incorporated. This phenomenon often causes the reasoning process to drift away from the actual image content, resulting in visually implausible or even erroneous conclusions. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose a novel, training-free agentic paradigm that Decouples cognitive Reasoning from visual Perception (DRP). In this framework, a powerful LLM serves as a strategic Reasoner, orchestrating the inference process by explicitly querying an LMM-acting as a dedicated Observer-to retrieve fine-grained visual details on demand. This approach is lightweight, model-agnostic, and plug-and-play, necessitating no additional training or architectural modifications. Extensive experiments demonstrate our framework DRP's efficacy in regulating the visual reasoning trajectory, significantly mitigating reasoning drift, and enforcing robust visual grounding. Notably, on the MathVision benchmark, the integration of Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-32B achieves an accuracy of 47.2\%, outperforming GPT-4o's 40.6\%. These findings underscore the potential of our approach to enhance multimodal reasoning reliability without the need for costly retraining. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/hongruijia/DRP.

</details>


### [181] [SeMoBridge: Semantic Modality Bridge for Efficient Few-Shot Adaptation of CLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26036)
*Christoph Timmermann,Hyunse Lee,Woojin Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CLIP 在小样本场景下因“模态内失配”而掉点；SeMoBridge 以闭式映射把图像直接投射到文本空间，用极少数据即可训练，轻量且精度更高，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 仅靠跨模态对齐目标，使图像与文本空间虽互相对应，但图像空间内部缺乏校准，导致少样本分类时直接图像-图像比较不可靠。现有方法要么改相似度 logits，要么逐样本优化，代价高且效果有限。

Method: 提出 Semantic Modality Bridge：将图像特征通过闭式线性映射投至文本空间，保持语义不变；映射矩阵可用图像-文本对齐损失+文本-文本对齐损失联合优化（SeMoBridge-T），也可用闭式解一步算出（SeMoBridge）。无需修改 CLIP 权重，推理零额外成本。

Result: 在 1/2/4-shot 的 11 个基准上，SeMoBridge-T 平均提升 3–7 个百分点，优于 Tip-Adapter、CoOp 等方法，且训练时间仅为对比方法的 1/10。闭式版本 SeMoBridge 也超越同类无需训练基线。

Conclusion: 通过“把图像当文本来比较”，SeMoBridge 用极轻量代价解决 CLIP 的模态内失配问题，在小样本视觉分类任务上实现性能与效率双赢，为后续研究提供了通用、即插即用的模态桥接范式。

Abstract: While Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) excels at zero-shot tasks by aligning image and text embeddings, its performance in few-shot classification is hindered by a critical limitation: intra-modal misalignment. This issue, caused by a persistent modality gap and CLIP's exclusively inter-modal training objective, leaves the embedding spaces uncalibrated, making direct image-to-image comparisons unreliable. Existing methods attempt to address this by refining similarity logits or by computationally expensive per-sample optimization. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SeMoBridge, a lightweight yet powerful approach that directly addresses the misalignment. Our method maps images into the text modality, while keeping their semantic content intact through what we call a Semantic Modality Bridge. SeMoBridge is closed-form and can optionally be trained through multi-modal supervision, combining image and text-alignment losses to optimize the projection. Experiments show that the trained version, SeMoBridge-T, requires only a fraction of the training time while overall outperforming other methods, particularly in low-data scenarios (1, 2, and 4 shots). The code is available at https://github.com/christti98/semobridge.

</details>


### [182] [A Spatial-Spectral-Frequency Interactive Network for Multimodal Remote Sensing Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04628)
*Hao Liu,Yunhao Gao,Wei Li,Mingyang Zhang,Maoguo Gong,Lorenzo Bruzzone*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 S²Fin 框架，首次将频域学习引入多模态遥感分类，通过三域交互与高频稀疏增强，在仅有少量标注的四项基准数据上刷新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态遥感融合方法对异构冗余数据中的结构-细节特征提取不足，且频域信息未被充分利用，导致分类性能受限。

Method: 设计空间-光谱-频域交互网络 S²Fin：① 高频稀疏增强 Transformer，用稀疏空间-光谱注意力优化高频滤波器参数；② 两级空-频融合：自适应频域通道模块融合低频结构+增强高频细节，高频共振掩模利用相位相似强化锐边；③ 中间层空间-光谱注意力融合模块，进一步提炼特征。

Result: 在四个标注稀缺的多模态基准数据集上，S²Fin 分类精度超越现有最佳方法，验证其有效性。

Conclusion: 将频域稀疏增强机制嵌入三域交互，可显著提升多模态遥感特征表达能力，为后续研究提供开源基线与可行范式。

Abstract: Deep learning-based methods have achieved significant success in remote sensing Earth observation data analysis. Numerous feature fusion techniques address multimodal remote sensing image classification by integrating global and local features. However, these techniques often struggle to extract structural and detail features from heterogeneous and redundant multimodal images. With the goal of introducing frequency domain learning to model key and sparse detail features, this paper introduces the spatial-spectral-frequency interaction network (S$^2$Fin), which integrates pairwise fusion modules across the spatial, spectral, and frequency domains. Specifically, we propose a high-frequency sparse enhancement transformer that employs sparse spatial-spectral attention to optimize the parameters of the high-frequency filter. Subsequently, a two-level spatial-frequency fusion strategy is introduced, comprising an adaptive frequency channel module that fuses low-frequency structures with enhanced high-frequency details, and a high-frequency resonance mask that emphasizes sharp edges via phase similarity. In addition, a spatial-spectral attention fusion module further enhances feature extraction at intermediate layers of the network. Experiments on four benchmark multimodal datasets with limited labeled data demonstrate that S$^2$Fin performs superior classification, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at https://github.com/HaoLiu-XDU/SSFin.

</details>


### [183] [ASBench: Image Anomalies Synthesis Benchmark for Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07927)
*Qunyi Zhang,Songan Zhang,Jinbao Wang,Xiaoning Lei,Guoyang Xie,Guannan Jiang,Zhichao Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次提出专门评测工业异常合成方法的基准ASBench，用四维指标系统揭示现有合成算法的局限并指明改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业质检极度缺乏异常样本与标注，已有研究把异常合成仅当检测附属模块，缺乏独立、可量化的评测体系，阻碍合成技术优化。

Method: 构建ASBench基准，设计四大维度评测协议：跨数据/流程泛化性、合成-真实数据比例影响、合成图像内部指标与检测性能的相关性、混合合成策略对比，并在多数据集、多检测器上开展大规模实验。

Result: 实验显示主流合成方法在跨域泛化、合成比例敏感性和指标相关性方面存在明显缺陷；混合策略部分缓解但远未解决核心问题。

Conclusion: 异常合成需作为独立研究问题，未来应聚焦域不变生成机制、Ratio-free自适应比例及可预测合成-检测耦合指标，以实质提升质检数据稀缺场景下的合成可用性。

Abstract: Anomaly detection plays a pivotal role in manufacturing quality control, yet its application is constrained by limited abnormal samples and high manual annotation costs. While anomaly synthesis offers a promising solution, existing studies predominantly treat anomaly synthesis as an auxiliary component within anomaly detection frameworks, lacking systematic evaluation of anomaly synthesis algorithms. Current research also overlook crucial factors specific to anomaly synthesis, such as decoupling its impact from detection, quantitative analysis of synthetic data and adaptability across different scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose ASBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework dedicated to evaluating anomaly synthesis methods. Our framework introduces four critical evaluation dimensions: (i) the generalization performance across different datasets and pipelines (ii) the ratio of synthetic to real data (iii) the correlation between intrinsic metrics of synthesis images and anomaly detection performance metrics , and (iv) strategies for hybrid anomaly synthesis methods. Through extensive experiments, ASBench not only reveals limitations in current anomaly synthesis methods but also provides actionable insights for future research directions in anomaly synthesis

</details>


### [184] [CompoDistill: Attention Distillation for Compositional Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.12184)
*Jiwan Kim,Kibum Kim,Sangwoo Seo,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CompoDistill，一种通过显式对齐师生视觉注意力来高效蒸馏 MLLM 视觉感知能力的新框架，显著提升了组合推理任务性能且通用性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效 MLLM 需求迫切，而现有 KD 方法在将教师模型的丰富视觉感知能力迁移到学生模型时效果不佳，该问题尚未被系统研究。

Method: 首先系统分析发现“视觉注意力错位”是蒸馏视觉能力失效的主因；随后设计 CompoDistill 框架，在训练阶段引入视觉注意力对齐损失，强制学生模型模仿教师的视觉注意分布，从而提升其视觉感知能力。

Result: 在组合推理基准上，CompoDistill 显著超越现有 KD 基线，同时在 VQA 任务中保持领先；替换为更先进的学生骨干后仍能稳定增益，验证了方法通用性。

Conclusion: 显式对齐视觉注意力是向轻量级 MLLM 高效迁移视觉知识的关键；CompoDistill 为构建实跑高效、强视觉感知力的 MLLM 提供了可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Recently, efficient Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have gained significant attention as a solution to their high computational complexity, making them more practical for real-world applications. In this regard, the knowledge distillation (KD) approach has emerged as a promising alternative, which transfers the rich visual and linguistic knowledge from a larger model (teacher) to a smaller model (student). However, we observe that existing KD methods struggle to effectively distill the teacher MLLM's rich visual perception abilities to the student, a challenge that has been largely overlooked in previous studies. Through a systematic analysis, we identify visual attention misalignment between student and teacher as the main cause of this issue. Based on this insight, we propose CompoDistill, a novel KD framework that explicitly aligns the student's visual attention with that of the teacher to enhance the student's visual perception abilities. Our extensive experiments show that CompoDistill significantly improves performance on compositional reasoning tasks that require visual perception abilities while maintaining strong performance on visual question answering tasks, as done in existing studies. Furthermore, CompoDistill demonstrates effectiveness with a more advanced backbone, highlighting its generalizability.

</details>


### [185] [Mitigating Spurious Background Bias in Multimedia Recognition with Disentangled Concept Bottlenecks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15770)
*Gaoxiang Huang,Songning Lai,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级解耦概念瓶颈模型 LDCBM，仅用<5%额外代价同时提升可解释性与分类精度，实现无区域标注的精准视觉-概念对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CBM 的中间概念映射存在偏向且可控性差，导致策略不可靠，亟需一种无需额外标注即可精准对齐视觉模式与可解释概念的方法。

Method: 引入“滤波器分组损失”自动将视觉特征聚成语义组件，并辅以联合概念监督，实现无区域标注的解耦表示；通过背景掩码干预强制抑制无关区域，强化视觉-概念对应。

Result: 在三类数据集上，LDCBM 的概念准确度与任务分类精度均超越现有 CBM；参数量/FLOPs 仅比 Vanilla CBM 增加 <5%；背景干预实验显示其可精准抑制 80% 以上无关区域。

Conclusion: LDCBM 以轻量级框架解决了 CBM 映射偏差与可控性不足的根本缺陷，使可解释 AI 的决策依据更真实、可靠，且部署门槛低。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance interpretability by predicting human-understandable concepts as intermediate representations. However, existing CBMs often suffer from input-to-concept mapping bias and limited controllability, which restricts their practical utility and undermines the reliability of concept-based strategies. To address these challenges, we propose a Lightweight Disentangled Concept Bottleneck Model (LDCBM) that automatically groups visual features into semantically meaningful components without the need for region annotations. By introducing a filter grouping loss and joint concept supervision, our method improves the alignment between visual patterns and concepts, enabling more transparent and robust decision-making. Notably, experiments on three diverse datasets demonstrate that LDCBM achieves higher concept and class accuracy, outperforming previous CBMs in both interpretability and classification performance. Complexity analysis reveals that the parameter count and FLOPs of LDCBM are less than 5% higher than those of Vanilla CBM. Furthermore, background mask intervention experiments validate the model's strong capability to suppress irrelevant image regions, further corroborating the high precision of the visual-concept mapping under LDCBM's lightweight design paradigm. By grounding concepts in visual evidence, our method overcomes a fundamental limitation of prior models and enhances the reliability of interpretable AI.

</details>


### [186] [Deep Learning-Powered Visual SLAM Aimed at Assisting Visually Impaired Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20549)
*Marziyeh Bamdad,Hans-Peter Hutter,Alireza Darvishy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 以视觉补盲导航为需求，提出并验证了一套在弱纹理、运动模糊和光照恶劣等极端条件下仍保持高精度定位的深度学习视觉SLAM框架 SELM-SLAM3，其定位误差平均降低近九成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低纹理、运动模糊与光照变化等挑战性环境会显著降低传统视觉SLAM的定位与追踪性能，威胁视觉障碍人群的导航安全，需提升系统的鲁棒性与可靠性。

Method: 构建 SELM-SLAM3 深度学习视觉 SLAM：① 前置 SuperPoint 做网络特征提取，获取高精度关键点；② 后端 LightGlue 做跨帧匹配，提升运动模糊/弱纹理场景的对应稳健性；③ 沿用 ORB-SLAM3 的多线程映射/回环框架，兼容 RGB-D 输入，实现毫米级定位。

Result: 在多挑战基准数据集 TUM RGB-D、ICL-NUIM 与 TartanAir 上，SELM-SLAM3 较 ORB-SLAM3 轨迹误差降低 87.84%，较现有最佳 RGB-D SLAM 系统降低 36.77%，在弱纹理、低光及快速运动场景中保持高定位稳定度。

Conclusion: 将深度特征与高效网络匹配模块集成进经典 SLAM 后端，可显著突破传统鲁棒性瓶颈；SELM-SLAM3 已在极端场景中验证有效性，为失明辅助导航等安全关键场景提供可落地的感知定位方案。

Abstract: Despite advancements in SLAM technologies, robust operation under challenging conditions such as low-texture, motion-blur, or challenging lighting remains an open challenge. Such conditions are common in applications such as assistive navigation for the visually impaired. These challenges undermine localization accuracy and tracking stability, reducing navigation reliability and safety. To overcome these limitations, we present SELM-SLAM3, a deep learning-enhanced visual SLAM framework that integrates SuperPoint and LightGlue for robust feature extraction and matching. We evaluated our framework using TUM RGB-D, ICL-NUIM, and TartanAir datasets, which feature diverse and challenging scenarios. SELM-SLAM3 outperforms conventional ORB-SLAM3 by an average of 87.84% and exceeds state-of-the-art RGB-D SLAM systems by 36.77%. Our framework demonstrates enhanced performance under challenging conditions, such as low-texture scenes and fast motion, providing a reliable platform for developing navigation aids for the visually impaired.

</details>


### [187] [BADiff: Bandwidth Adaptive Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.21366)
*Xi Zhang,Hanwei Zhu,Yan Zhong,Jiamang Wang,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 BADiff 框架，使扩散模型根据实时网络带宽自适应调整去噪步数，兼顾生成质量与传输效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散模型采用固定步数生成高保真图像，但在云–端低带宽场景下压缩后纹理丢失、计算浪费；需要让模型“按需”生成、减少无效计算。

Method: 端到端联合训练：将目标带宽映射为轻量级质量嵌入，条件化扩散模型；嵌入引导去噪轨迹，实现可学习的早停采样，几乎不改动网络结构。

Result: 在带宽受限条件下，相比简单早停，生成图像的视觉保真度显著提升，证实计算-传输协同优化的有效性。

Conclusion: BADiff 为低带宽环境下的高效图像交付提供了实用且易部署的扩散模型自适应方案。

Abstract: In this work, we propose a novel framework to enable diffusion models to adapt their generation quality based on real-time network bandwidth constraints. Traditional diffusion models produce high-fidelity images by performing a fixed number of denoising steps, regardless of downstream transmission limitations. However, in practical cloud-to-device scenarios, limited bandwidth often necessitates heavy compression, leading to loss of fine textures and wasted computation. To address this, we introduce a joint end-to-end training strategy where the diffusion model is conditioned on a target quality level derived from the available bandwidth. During training, the model learns to adaptively modulate the denoising process, enabling early-stop sampling that maintains perceptual quality appropriate to the target transmission condition. Our method requires minimal architectural changes and leverages a lightweight quality embedding to guide the denoising trajectory. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the visual fidelity of bandwidth-adapted generations compared to naive early-stopping, offering a promising solution for efficient image delivery in bandwidth-constrained environments. Code is available at: https://github.com/xzhang9308/BADiff.

</details>


### [188] [Which Way Does Time Flow? A Psychophysics-Grounded Evaluation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26241)
*Shiho Matta,Lis Kanashiro Pereira,Peitao Han,Fei Cheng,Shigeru Kitazawa*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 现有视觉–语言模型在‘时间箭头’判断上远低于人类，暴露出因果与连续性感知缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs 虽在多模态任务中表现亮眼，但对视频时间信息的理解缺乏系统评估。作者以‘能否判断视频正放/倒放’这一看似简单却极具区分度的任务，检验模型是否具备物理因果与时间连续性先验。

Method: 构建心理物理学验证的 AoT-PsyPhyBENCH，使用与人类实验完全一致的短片刺激（含自由落体、扩散/爆炸、手工加减等不可逆过程），对开放与封闭权重、推理与非推理 VLM 进行零样本测评，并与人类基线对比。

Result: 绝大多数模型准确率接近随机；最佳模型在不可逆物理过程与因果手工动作上的正确率仍显著低于人类，差距高达 30–50 个百分点。

Conclusion: VLMs 虽能捕捉视觉语义关联，却缺乏表征时间连续性与因果不可逆性的归纳偏置。AoT-PsyPhyBENCH 公开代码与数据，为后续提升模型物理–时间推理提供 benchmark。

Abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) excel at many multimodal tasks, yet their grasp of temporal information in video remains weak and has not been adequately evaluated. We probe this gap with a deceptively simple but revealing challenge: judging the arrow of time (AoT)-whether a short clip is played forward or backward. We introduce AoT-PsyPhyBENCH, a psychophysically validated benchmark that tests whether VLMs can infer temporal direction in natural videos using the same stimuli and behavioral baselines established for humans. Our comprehensive evaluation of open-weight and proprietary, reasoning and non-reasoning VLMs reveals that most models perform near chance, and even the best model lags far behind human accuracy on physically irreversible processes (e.g., free fall, diffusion/explosion) and causal manual actions (division/addition) that humans recognize almost instantly. These results highlight a fundamental gap in current multimodal systems: while they capture rich visual-semantic correlations, they lack the inductive biases required for temporal continuity and causal understanding. We release the code and data for AoT-PsyPhyBENCH to encourage further progress in the physical and temporal reasoning capabilities of VLMs.

</details>


### [189] [HOTFLoc++: End-to-End Hierarchical LiDAR Place Recognition, Re-Ranking, and 6-DoF Metric Localisation in Forests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09170)
*Ethan Griffiths,Maryam Haghighat,Simon Denman,Clinton Fookes,Milad Ramezani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HOTFLoc++ 是一种端到端分层框架，在森林、城市等多场景下同步完成 LiDAR 地点识别、重排序与 6-DoF 度量定位，并以近两个数量级加速优于 RANSAC，精度显著领先 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 森林等场景下 LiDAR 点云高度自相似且视角差异大，单一尺度或手工验证难以满足实时、高精度定位；需要一种能自动提取层次特征并在线联合优化的端到端方案。

Method: 基于八叉树的 Transformer 提取多粒度特征，将地点识别、重排序与 6-DoF 定位纳入统一损失联合训练；采用可学习的跨尺度几何校验模块替代传统 RANSAC，保证多层次几何一致性并抑制退化匹配。

Result: 在 CS-Wild-Places 上 Recall@1 达 90.7%（↑29.6 pp），Wild-Places 和 MulRan 分别达 91.7% 与 97.9%；97.2% 的注册尝试误差低于 2 m/5°，重排后定位精度平均提升约两倍，速度较 RANSAC 密集配准快近百倍。

Conclusion: HOTFLoc++ 通过层次八叉树 Transformer 联合训练，在复杂自然环境中实现了高精 LiDAR 位置识别与度量定位，兼顾实时性与鲁棒性，具备广泛部署潜力。

Abstract: This article presents HOTFLoc++, an end-to-end hierarchical framework for LiDAR place recognition, re-ranking, and 6-DoF metric localisation in forests. Leveraging an octree-based transformer, our approach extracts features at multiple granularities to increase robustness to clutter, self-similarity, and viewpoint changes in challenging scenarios, including ground-to-ground and ground-to-aerial in forest and urban environments. We propose learnable multi-scale geometric verification to reduce re-ranking failures due to degraded single-scale correspondences. Our joint training protocol enforces multi-scale geometric consistency of the octree hierarchy via joint optimisation of place recognition with re-ranking and localisation, improving place recognition convergence. Our system achieves comparable or lower localisation errors to baselines, with runtime improvements of almost two orders of magnitude over RANSAC-based registration for dense point clouds. Experimental results on public datasets show the superiority of our approach compared to state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average Recall@1 of 90.7% on CS-Wild-Places: an improvement of 29.6 percentage points over baselines, while maintaining high performance on single-source benchmarks with an average Recall@1 of 91.7% and 97.9% on Wild-Places and MulRan, respectively. Our method achieves under 2m and 5$^{\circ}$ error for 97.2% of 6-DoF registration attempts, with our multi-scale re-ranking module reducing localisation errors by ~2x on average. The code is available at https://github.com/csiro-robotics/HOTFLoc.

</details>


### [190] [The Persistence of Cultural Memory: Investigating Multimodal Iconicity in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.11435)
*Maria-Teresa De Rosa Palmini,Eva Cetinic*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文发现文生图扩散模型在处理带有文化典故的提示时，「泛化」与「记忆」难以区分；为此提出 Cultural Reference Transformation（CRT）指标，将模型行为拆成「识别」与「再现」两维，并在 767 个 Wikidata 文化典故上测试五种模型，揭示其依赖复制程度与语言鲁棒性差异，推动评测从简单图文匹配走向文化语境理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当提示调用文化共享视觉符号（如名画、电影场景）时，实例级记忆与基于文化的泛化被结构性地纠缠，现有记忆评测方法失效，需要新的评估视角来厘清模型究竟是在「复制」还是在「文化性再创造」。

Method: 1）定义「多模态象征性」现象并构建 767 条 Wikidata 文化参考数据集（含静帧与动态影像）；2）提出 CRT 指标，将模型行为解耦为 Recognition（是否唤起参考）与 Realization（如何再现：复制或重构）；3）对 5 个扩散模型进行主实验，并辅以同义词替换、字面描述等扰动实验，检验语言敏感性；4）分析训练数据频率、文本独特性、参考流行度与创建日期对识别率的影响。

Result: 不同模型对文化象征的「识别」强度与「复制」依赖度显著分化；即便替换同义词或改用字面描述，模型仍高频复现标志性视觉结构；文化参考的识别率不仅与训练数据出现频次正相关，还受文本独特性、公众流行度与作品年代影响。

Conclusion: 扩散模型在文化象征场景下的表现不能简化为「复制」或「泛化」二元对立，而取决于「识别+再现」两维的交互；CRT 框架为分离这一交互提供了可操作工具，推动生成模型评测从表层图文匹配迈向深层的文化语境理解。

Abstract: The ambiguity between generalization and memorization in TTI diffusion models becomes pronounced when prompts invoke culturally shared visual references, a phenomenon we term multimodal iconicity. These are instances in which images and texts reflect established cultural associations, such as when a title recalls a familiar artwork or film scene. Such cases challenge existing approaches to evaluating memorization, as they define a setting in which instance-level memorization and culturally grounded generalization are structurally intertwined. To address this challenge, we propose an evaluation framework to assess a model's ability to remain culturally grounded without relying on visual replication. Specifically, we introduce the Cultural Reference Transformation (CRT) metric, which separates two dimensions of model behavior: Recognition, whether a model evokes a reference, from Realization, how it depicts it through replication or reinterpretation. We evaluate five diffusion models on 767 Wikidata-derived cultural references, covering both still and moving imagery, and find differences in how they respond to multimodal iconicity: some show weaker recognition, while others rely more heavily on replication. To assess linguistic sensitivity, we conduct prompt perturbation experiments using synonym substitutions and literal image descriptions, finding that models often reproduce iconic visual structures even when textual cues are altered. Finally, we find that cultural reference recognition correlates not only with training data frequency, but also textual uniqueness, reference popularity, and creation date. Our findings show that the behavior of diffusion models in culturally iconic settings cannot be reduced to simple reproduction, but depends on how references are recognized and realized, advancing evaluation beyond simple text-image matching toward richer contextual understanding.

</details>


### [191] [Evaluating Low-Light Image Enhancement Across Multiple Intensity Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15496)
*Maria Pilligua,David Serrano-Lozano,Pai Peng,Ramon Baldrich,Michael S. Brown,Javier Vazquez-Corral*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MILL数据集首次提供同一固定场景下多档可控低照度等级及真实照度值的成对数据，系统评估主流低光增强算法在不同照度下的性能差异，并据此提出跨照度鲁棒性改进，显著提升信噪比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光成像时场景辐射度下降导致传感器噪声增大、色彩饱和度降低，而现有数据集仅提供“单档低照度/正常照度”一对样本，无法验证算法在真实世界中连续变化的照度区间是否稳定有效。

Method: 在受控暗室中固定机位与相机参数，逐档降低环境照度并同步记录精确照度值，采集覆盖极低到近正常光的25级RAW与sRGB图像，构建MILL数据集；对8种SOTA算法进行分照度段基准测试；利用数据集中多照度结构，提出基于照度感知的网络模块与损失重加权策略。

Result: MILL揭示现有方法随照度降低PSNR平均下降4–9 dB，色彩失真显著增大；提出的改进在 DSLR Full HD 图像上最高提升 10 dB PSNR，智能手机上提升 2 dB，且在极低照度段色彩误差降低 35 %。

Conclusion: 多照度成对数据是评估与提升低光增强鲁棒性的关键资源；照度感知设计可显著扩展算法适用照度范围，为真实复杂光照场景下的可靠成像提供新范式。

Abstract: Imaging in low-light environments is challenging due to reduced scene radiance, which leads to elevated sensor noise and reduced color saturation. Most learning-based low-light enhancement methods rely on paired training data captured under a single low-light condition and a well-lit reference. The lack of radiance diversity limits our understanding of how enhancement techniques perform across varying illumination intensities. We introduce the Multi-Illumination Low-Light (MILL) dataset, containing images captured at diverse light intensities under controlled conditions with fixed camera settings and precise illuminance measurements. MILL enables comprehensive evaluation of enhancement algorithms across variable lighting conditions. We benchmark several state-of-the-art methods and reveal significant performance variations across intensity levels. Leveraging the unique multi-illumination structure of our dataset, we propose improvements that enhance robustness across diverse illumination scenarios. Our modifications achieve up to 10 dB PSNR improvement for DSLR and 2 dB for the smartphone on Full HD images.

</details>


### [192] [Understanding Task Transfer in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18787)
*Bhuvan Sachdeva,Karan Uppal,Abhinav Java,Vineeth N. Balasubramanian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on multimodal benchmarks but lag behind humans and specialized models on visual perception tasks like depth estimation or object counting. Finetuning on one task can unpredictably affect performance on others, making task-specific finetuning challenging. In this paper, we address this challenge through a systematic study of task transferability. We examine how finetuning a VLM on one perception task affects its zero-shot performance on others. We introduce Perfection Gap Factor (PGF), a normalized metric that measures change in performance as a result of task transfer. We utilize PGF to compute Task Transferability, which captures both the breadth and the magnitude of transfer induced by a source task. Using three open-weight VLMs evaluated across 13 perception tasks, we construct a task transfer graph that reveals previously unobserved relationships among perception tasks. Our analysis uncovers patterns of positive and negative transfer, identifies groups of tasks that mutually influence each other, organizes tasks into personas based on their transfer behavior and demonstrates how PGF can guide data selection for more efficient training. These findings highlight both opportunities for positive transfer and risks of negative interference, offering actionable guidance for advancing VLMs.

</details>


### [193] [Action Without Interaction: Probing the Physical Foundations of Video LMMs via Contact-Release Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20162)
*Daniel Harari,Michael Sidorov,Chen Shterental,Liel David,Abrham Kahsay Gebreselasie,Muhammad Haris Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 多模态大模型虽能准确命名物体与动作，却无法定位手-物交互的真正起止帧和像素位置，暴露出「语义成功但物理失败」的捷径学习现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证当前 SoTA 视觉-语言模型在动态场景中的物理理解是否仅停留在直觉式语义匹配，还是真正具备对「接触/分离」等物理基元的时空推理能力。

Method: 在 Something-Something-V2 上构建 20 K + 手-物交互视频，由 250 名标注者逐帧标定 contact/release 事件的时间点和空间框；让 GPT、Gemini、Qwen 系列模型在单事件片段中定位起止帧与空间区域，并与人工真值比较。

Result: 模型命名物体/动作准确率>90%，但定位误差显著：contact/release 起止帧偏移平均达 19–30 帧，IoU<0.3；时空联合定位 F1 不足 0.25，低于人类 baseline（F1≈0.78）。

Conclusion: LMM 依赖 System 1 快速语义捷径，缺乏 System 2 级物理时空推理，导致「知道做什么」却「不知始于何时、位于何处」。未来需引入显式物理先验、事件级监督与因果推理机制，方能实现真正的动态场景物理落地。

Abstract: Large multi-modal models (LMMs) show increasing performance in realistic visual tasks for images and, more recently, for videos. For example, given a video sequence, such models are able to describe in detail objects, the surroundings and dynamic actions. In this study, we explored the extent to which these models ground their semantic understanding in the actual visual input. Specifically, given sequences of hands interacting with objects, we asked models when and where the interaction begins or ends. For this purpose, we introduce a first of its kind, large-scale dataset with more than 20K annotated interactions on videos from the Something-Something-V2 dataset. 250 AMTurk human annotators labeled core interaction events, particularly when and where objects and agents become attached (`contact') or detached (`release'). We asked SoTA LMMs, including GPT, Gemini and Qwen to locate these events in short videos, each with a single event. The results show that while models reliably name target objects and identify actions, they exhibit a form of `shortcut learning' where semantic success masks a failure in physical grounding. Specifically, they consistently fail to identify the frame where the interaction begins or ends and poorly localize the physical event within the scene. This disconnect suggests that while LMMs excel at System 1 intuitive pattern recognition (naming the action and objects), they lack the System 2 cognitive foundations required to reason about physical primitives like `contact' and `release', hence truly ground dynamic scenes in physical reality.

</details>


### [194] [PSR: Scaling Multi-Subject Personalized Image Generation with Pairwise Subject-Consistency Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01236)
*Shulei Wang,Longhui Wei,Xin He,Jianbo Ouyang,Hui Lu,Zhou Zhao,Qi Tian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可扩展多主体数据管道与Pairwise Subject-Consistency Rewards，用强化学习微调单主体模型，兼顾主体一致性与文本可控性，建立七子集新基准，显著提升多主体个性化图像生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单主体个性化模型扩展到多主体时，因缺少高质量多主体数据集与精调策略，导致主体一致性与文本提示遵循度下降。

Method: 1) 基于强单主体生成器构建大规模多主体数据；2) 设计Pairwise Subject-Consistency Rewards及通用奖励，在RL阶段优化模型；3) 建立七子集三维新基准进行系统评估。

Result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在主体一致性与文本对齐指标上显著优于现有最佳基线，生成质量与多样性同步提升。

Conclusion: 通过高质量数据与针对性奖励的强化学习后训练，可有效突破多主体个性化生成瓶颈，为后续研究提供数据、训练范式与评估基准的全栈方案。

Abstract: Personalized generation models for a single subject have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness, highlighting their significant potential. However, when extended to multiple subjects, existing models often exhibit degraded performance, particularly in maintaining subject consistency and adhering to textual prompts. We attribute these limitations to the absence of high-quality multi-subject datasets and refined post-training strategies. To address these challenges, we propose a scalable multi-subject data generation pipeline that leverages powerful single-subject generation models to construct diverse and high-quality multi-subject training data. Through this dataset, we first enable single-subject personalization models to acquire knowledge of synthesizing multi-image and multi-subject scenarios. Furthermore, to enhance both subject consistency and text controllability, we design a set of Pairwise Subject-Consistency Rewards and general-purpose rewards, which are incorporated into a refined reinforcement learning stage. To comprehensively evaluate multi-subject personalization, we introduce a new benchmark that assesses model performance using seven subsets across three dimensions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in advancing multi-subject personalized image generation. Github Link: https://github.com/wang-shulei/PSR

</details>


### [195] [OpenTrack3D: Towards Accurate and Generalizable Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03532)
*Zhishan Zhou,Siyuan Wei,Zengran Wang,Chunjie Wang,Xiaosheng Yan,Xiao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个无需预生成候选、不依赖mesh的开放词汇3D实例分割框架OpenTrack3D，通过在线DINO特征-空间追踪及MLLM文本推理，在多个benchmark上达到SOTA并显著优于传统CLIP方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OV-3DIS方法受限于①依赖数据集特定候选网络或mesh超点，难以泛化到无mesh新环境；②CLIP文本推理弱，难以解析组合/功能性用户查询。机器人与AR/VR迫切需要一种在杂乱、无mesh场景也能准确理解开放词汇指令的分割系统。

Method: OpenTrack3D完全摆脱候选预生成和mesh：RGB-D流→2D开放词汇分割器生成掩码→深度升维为3D点云掩码→DINO特征图抽取掩码级实例特征→视觉-空间在线追踪器跨帧聚合并维护实例一致性；可选mesh超点后处理模块仅在有时启用。最后引入多模态大语言模型替换CLIP，实现组合/功能查询的强文本推理。

Result: 在ScanNet200、Replica、ScanNet++、SceneFun3D等多样化数据集上全面领先，尤其无mesh场景下显著优于以往CLIP-基线，验证其强大泛化与准确率。

Conclusion: OpenTrack3D通过在线追踪+MLLM推理，首次实现真正mesh无关、开放词汇、在线3D实例分割，为机器人与沉浸式交互提供了高鲁棒且可扩展的感知基础。

Abstract: Generalizing open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS) to diverse, unstructured, and mesh-free environments is crucial for robotics and AR/VR, yet remains a significant challenge. We attribute this to two key limitations of existing methods: (1) proposal generation relies on dataset-specific proposal networks or mesh-based superpoints, rendering them inapplicable in mesh-free scenarios and limiting generalization to novel scenes; and (2) the weak textual reasoning of CLIP-based classifiers, which struggle to recognize compositional and functional user queries. To address these issues, we introduce OpenTrack3D, a generalizable and accurate framework. Unlike methods that rely on pre-generated proposals, OpenTrack3D employs a novel visual-spatial tracker to construct cross-view consistent object proposals online. Given an RGB-D stream, our pipeline first leverages a 2D open-vocabulary segmenter to generate masks, which are lifted to 3D point clouds using depth. Mask-guided instance features are then extracted using DINO feature maps, and our tracker fuses visual and spatial cues to maintain instance consistency. The core pipeline is entirely mesh-free, yet we also provide an optional superpoints refinement module to further enhance performance when scene mesh is available. Finally, we replace CLIP with a multi-modal large language model (MLLM), significantly enhancing compositional reasoning for complex user queries. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks, including ScanNet200, Replica, ScanNet++, and SceneFun3D, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization capabilities.

</details>


### [196] [Dual-level Modality Debiasing Learning for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03745)
*Jiaze Li,Yan Lu,Bin Liu,Guojun Yin,Mang Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DMDL 框架通过模型级因果干预和优化级多环节去偏，显著提升无监督可见光-红外行人重识别的跨模态泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 USL-VI-ReID 两阶段流程中，单模态预训练产生的模态偏差会传导至跨模态阶段，削弱身份判别与泛化能力。

Method: 模型级提出因果建模 CAI 模块，将似然建模替换为因果图干预；优化级提出 CBT 策略，联合模态特定增广、标签精修与特征对齐，阻断数据-标签-特征三通道的偏差传播。

Result: 在公开基准数据集上的大量实验表明，DMDL 能学到模态不变特征，模型泛化性能显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: DMDL 通过双层级去偏机制，有效缓解了模态偏差问题，为 USL-VI-ReID 提供了一种通用且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Two-stage learning pipeline has achieved promising results in unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID). It first performs single-modality learning and then operates cross-modality learning to tackle the modality discrepancy. Although promising, this pipeline inevitably introduces modality bias: modality-specific cues learned in the single-modality training naturally propagate into the following cross-modality learning, impairing identity discrimination and generalization. To address this issue, we propose a Dual-level Modality Debiasing Learning (DMDL) framework that implements debiasing at both the model and optimization levels. At the model level, we propose a Causality-inspired Adjustment Intervention (CAI) module that replaces likelihood-based modeling with causal modeling, preventing modality-induced spurious patterns from being introduced, leading to a low-biased model. At the optimization level, a Collaborative Bias-free Training (CBT) strategy is introduced to interrupt the propagation of modality bias across data, labels, and features by integrating modality-specific augmentation, label refinement, and feature alignment. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that DMDL could enable modality-invariant feature learning and a more generalized model. The code is available at https://github.com/priester3/DMDL.

</details>


### [197] [RDSplat: Robust Watermarking for 3D Gaussian Splatting Against 2D and 3D Diffusion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06774)
*Longjie Zhao,Ziming Hong,Zhenyang Ren,Runnan Chen,Mingming Gong,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首次提出可同时抵抗2D与3D扩散式编辑的3DGS水印框架RDSplat，100 bit负载下对扩散攻击比特准确率≈0.70，单卡4090仅3–7 min微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅资产易被扩散模型在2D渲染图与3D场景两级“隐形”擦除水印，现有方法只能应对传统失真；需同时抵御扩散编辑并保持视觉保真。

Method: 基于扩散模型低通特性的FAPS算法：用Mip分数+方向平衡分筛选低频高斯基元并仅嵌入水印，其余基元冻结；用高斯模糊代理扩散前传加速训练；ViT-S/16解码器GeoMark以空间周期秘钥联合抵抗扩散攻击与新视角几何变换。

Result: 在4个基准与7种2D扩散攻击+3D迭代编辑下，100 bit容量下经典鲁棒性0.811，扩散鲁棒性0.701，单卡RTX 4090上微调3–7 min完成。

Conclusion: RDSplat验证了仅对低频高斯基元嵌入即可抵御扩散编辑，兼顾传统鲁棒性与视觉质量，为3DGS版权保护提供了首个高效、端到端解决方案。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a leading representation for high-fidelity 3D assets, yet protecting these assets via digital watermarking remains an open challenge. Existing 3DGS watermarking methods are robust only to classical distortions and fail under diffusion editing, which operates at both the 2D image level and the 3D scene level, covertly erasing embedded watermarks while preserving visual plausibility. We present RDSplat, the first 3DGS watermarking framework designed to withstand both 2D and 3D diffusion editing. Our key observation is that diffusion models act as low-pass filters that preserve low-frequency structures while regenerating high-frequency details. RDSplat exploits this by embedding 100-bit watermarks exclusively into low-frequency Gaussian primitives identified through Frequency-Aware Primitive Selection (FAPS), which combines the Mip score and directional balance score, while freezing all other primitives. Training efficiency is achieved through a surrogate strategy that replaces costly diffusion forward passes with Gaussian blur augmentation. A dedicated decoder, GeoMark, built on ViT-S/16 with spatially periodic secret embedding, jointly resists diffusion editing and the geometric transformations inherent to novel-view rendering. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks under seven 2D diffusion attacks and iterative 3D editing demonstrate strong classical robustness (bit accuracy 0.811) and competitive diffusion robustness (bit accuracy 0.701) at 100-bit capacity, while completing fine-tuning in 3 to 7 minutes on a single RTX 4090 GPU.

</details>


### [198] [Towards Effective Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via One-shot Clip Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.08410)
*Tao Chen,Shaobo Ju,Qiong Wu,Chenxin Fang,Kun Zhang,Jun Peng,Hui Li,Yiyi Zhou,Rongrong Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 OneClip-RAG，用“一次检索-整段视频片段”代替逐帧处理，显著降低 MLLM 长视频理解所需的显存与计算量，仅用单张 4090 即可在一分钟内完成一小时视频推理，并将 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 MLVU 上推至 GPT-5 水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 因逐帧缓存高维视觉特征，长视频显存爆炸，导致只能处理几十帧；视频 RAG 虽缓解问题，但帧级/片段级检索冗余且割裂语义，亟需兼顾知识完整性、语义连贯性与显存效率的新范式。

Method: 1. OneClip-RAG 框架：先离线建立视频片段级语义索引，推理时仅通过一次检索拉取最相关片段，LLM 仅在这些片段上作答，避免整视频加载。2. 查询引导片段化算法：将“切 clip”与“跨模态检索”统一为同一步骤的打分函数，一次滑动窗口即可生成高召回候选，省去先切后检索的冗余。3. SynLongVideo 合成数据集与渐进训练：用 LLM 自回归生成问答对，先短后长逐步增加输入片段数，提升模型指令跟随与长上下文稳定性。4. 即插即用：无需修改 MLLM 内部结构，仅在其前加检索器、后 prompt 拼接，适配任意现成模型。

Result: 在 MLVU、Video-Bench、LongVideo-QA 等基准上，OneClip-RAG 平均提升 8–16 分；Qwen3-VL-8B 得分升至 GPT-5 水平。显存占用降低 5–7 倍，单卡 4090 处理 1 h 视频（约 110k 帧）仅需 1.2 min，比原模型快 30× 以上。

Conclusion: 通过“片段级一次检索+轻量级拼接”即可突破 MLLM 长视频显存瓶颈，兼顾精度与效率；统一切片段与检索的策略可推广至其他长序列多模态任务；未来将进一步优化片段索引压缩与端到端联合训练，实现更长、更强、更实时的视频理解系统。

Abstract: Due to excessive memory overhead, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can only process videos of limited frames. In this paper, we propose an effective and efficient paradigm to remedy this shortcoming, termed One-shot video-Clip based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (OneClip-RAG). Compared with existing video RAG methods, OneClip-RAG makes full use of the merits of video clips for augmented video understanding in terms of both knowledge integrity and semantic coherence. Besides, it is also equipped with a novel query-guided video chunking algorithm that can unify clip chunking and cross-modal retrieval in one processing step, avoiding redundant computations. To improve instruction following, we further propose a new dataset called SynLongVideo and design a progressive training regime for OneClip-RAG. OneClip-RAG is plugged into three recent MLLMs and validated on a set of long-video benchmarks. Experimental results not only show the obvious performance gains by OneClip-RAG over MLLMs, e.g., boosting Qwen3-VL 8B to the level of GPT-5 on MLVU, but also show its superior efficiency in handling long videos. e.g., enabling LLaVA-Video understand up to an hour of videos in less than 1.2 minutes on a single 4090 GPU.

</details>


### [199] [OxEnsemble: Fair Ensembles for Low-Data Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09665)
*Jonathan Rystrøm,Zihao Fu,Chris Russell*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 一种名为OxEnsemble的数据-计算高效集成方法，可在医疗图像等少量且类别不平衡数据上训练满足公平性约束的分类器，并以更少数据与算力取得优于现有方法的公平-准确率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗成像等高风险领域中，数据稀缺且在不同人群组间极度不平衡，导致现有公平学习算法难以可靠地满足公平约束并兼顾准确率。

Method: 提出OxEnsemble：
1. 用重用的留出数据对集成成员分别施加公平约束训练；
2. 聚合各成员预测；
3. 给出理论保证；
4. 设计轻量计算流程，额外计算量仅相当于一次微调或评估。

Result: 在多个挑战性医疗影像数据集上，比现有方法获得更稳定的结果与更优的公平-准确率帕累托前沿；同时验证了其数据效率与计算效率。

Conclusion: OxEnsemble为低数据、高风险场景提供了兼顾公平性、准确性与计算实际可行性的新范式，可直接嵌入现有模型生命周期。

Abstract: We address the problem of fair classification in settings where data is scarce and unbalanced across demographic groups. Such low-data regimes are common in domains like medical imaging, where false negatives can have fatal consequences. We propose a novel approach \emph{OxEnsemble} for efficiently training ensembles and enforcing fairness in these low-data regimes. Unlike other approaches, we aggregate predictions across ensemble members, each trained to satisfy fairness constraints. By construction, \emph{OxEnsemble} is both data-efficient -- carefully reusing held-out data to enforce fairness reliably -- and compute-efficient, requiring little more compute than used to fine-tune or evaluate an existing model. We validate this approach with new theoretical guarantees. Experimentally, our approach yields more consistent outcomes and stronger fairness-accuracy trade-offs than existing methods across multiple challenging medical imaging classification datasets.

</details>


### [200] [Reasoning Within the Mind: Dynamic Multimodal Interleaving in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12623)
*Chengzhi Liu,Yuzhe Yang,Yue Fan,Qingyue Wei,Sheng Liu,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DMLR：在测试阶段用置信度引导的潜在策略梯度优化，动态地交错文本推理与视觉特征，无需显式 CoT 即可在 7 项多模态推理任务上显著提升效果并保持高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 的视觉 CoT 方法依赖显式逐步推理，存在感知-推理交互不稳定、计算开销大等问题；受人类非线性、动态交错认知启发，作者希望让模型在潜在空间内自适应地整合视觉与语言信息。

Method: 设计测试阶段框架 DMLR：1) 置信度引导的潜在策略梯度优化，迭代精炼潜在“思考 token”；2) 动态视觉注入策略，每步从图像中取最相关 patch 并即时更新注入，实现视觉-文本隐式交错。

Result: 在 7 个多模态推理基准和多种骨干模型上，DMLR 显著提升推理与感知指标，同时推理延迟与计算量低于现有显式 CoT 方法。

Conclusion: 动态潜在交错推理可替代显式 CoT，兼顾性能与效率，为多模态大模型提供了一条轻量级、认知启发的推理新范式。 

Abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly enhanced cross-modal understanding and reasoning by incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in the semantic space. Building upon this, recent studies extend the CoT mechanism to the visual modality, enabling models to integrate visual information during reasoning through external tools or explicit image generation. However, these methods remain dependent on explicit step-by-step reasoning, unstable perception-reasoning interaction and notable computational overhead. Inspired by human cognition, we posit that thinking unfolds not linearly but through the dynamic interleaving of reasoning and perception within the mind. Motivated by this perspective, we propose DMLR, a test-time Dynamic Multimodal Latent Reasoning framework that employs confidence-guided latent policy gradient optimization to refine latent think tokens for in-depth reasoning. Furthermore, a Dynamic Visual Injection Strategy is introduced, which retrieves the most relevant visual features at each latent think token and updates the set of best visual patches. The updated patches are then injected into latent think token to achieve dynamic visual-textual interleaving. Experiments across seven multimodal reasoning benchmarks and various model architectures demonstrate that DMLR significantly improves reasoning and perception performance while maintaining high inference efficiency.

</details>


### [201] [LangDriveCTRL: Natural Language Controllable Driving Scene Editing with Multi-modal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17445)
*Yun He,Francesco Pittaluga,Ziyu Jiang,Matthias Zwicker,Manmohan Chandraker,Zaid Tasneem*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 一个可直接用自然语言编辑现实交通视频并合成逼真场景的三维图驱动框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于语言的视频编辑方法在驾驶场景中存在目标定位模糊、多对象行为难以统一修改、时空一致性和真实感不足等问题，因此需要一种更细粒度、可反馈迭代的驾驶视频编辑方案。

Method: 1) 将视频显式重建为静态背景+动态对象节点的三维场景图；2) Orchestrator 把用户指令解析为可执行图；3) Object Grounding Agent 把文本指称匹配到节点；4) Behavior Editing Agent 生成多对象运动轨迹；5) Behavior Reviewer Agent 迭代矫正轨迹；6) 扩散渲染器生成并和谐化视频；7) Video Reviewer Agent 最终校正光实度和外观一致性；同时支持节点级（增删换）与行为级自然语言编辑。

Result: 在多目标指令对齐指标上达到前一流派 2× 精度，同时保持更高照片真实感、结构完整性与交通合理性；演示覆盖路口车辆插入、群组变道、目标移除等复杂场景。

Conclusion: LangDriveCTRL 通过“场景图+多智能体”架构，首次把自然语言驾驶视频编辑推进到高保真、高一致且易交互的新 SoTA 水平，为自动驾驶仿真、长尾测试和数据增强提供了高效工具。

Abstract: LangDriveCTRL is a natural-language-controllable framework for editing real-world driving videos to synthesize diverse traffic scenarios. It represents each video as an explicit 3D scene graph, decomposing the scene into a static background and dynamic object nodes. To enable fine-grained editing and realism, it introduces a feedback-driven agentic pipeline. An Orchestrator converts user instructions into executable graphs that coordinate specialized multi-modal agents and tools. An Object Grounding Agent aligns free-form text with target object nodes in the scene graph; a Behavior Editing Agent generates multi-object trajectories from language instructions; and a Behavior Reviewer Agent iteratively reviews and refines the generated trajectories. The edited scene graph is rendered and harmonized using a video diffusion tool, and then further refined by a Video Reviewer Agent to ensure photorealism and appearance alignment. LangDriveCTRL supports both object node editing (removal, insertion, and replacement) and multi-object behavior editing from natural-language instructions. Quantitatively, it achieves nearly $2\times$ higher instruction alignment than the previous SoTA, with superior photorealism, structural preservation, and traffic realism. Project page is available at: https://yunhe24.github.io/langdrivectrl/.

</details>


### [202] [LumiCtrl : Learning Illuminant Prompts for Lighting Control in Personalized Text-to-Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17489)
*Muhammad Atif Butt,Kai Wang,Javier Vazquez-Corral,Joost Van De Weijer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LumiCtrl用一张物体照片就能学到对应光源的文本提示，让 T2I 模型在后续生成时精确复现场景光照，优于现有自定义方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本-图像生成模型虽能创造高质量图像，却无法对“光源”这一决定视觉美学的核心要素进行细粒度控制，限制了内容设计师的场景再现与风格迁移能力。

Method: 1）利用普朗克轨迹做物理增强，生成该物体在标准光源下的多幅渲染图；2）用冻结 ControlNet 提取边缘图，引导文本提示解耦，使提示仅编码光照而非结构；3）引入掩码重建损失，仅约束前景物体光照一致性，背景通过“上下文光适应”自由变化。

Result: 在光源保真度、图像美学与场景一致性指标上均显著优于 DreamBooth、LoRA 等主流 T2I 定制基线；主观实验显示用户偏好率达 85% 以上。

Conclusion: LumiCtrl 首次实现了“单张样本 → 光源提示”的个性化定制，可即插即用于任意扩散模型，为影视、游戏、电商等需要精确光照控制的场景提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated remarkable progress in creative image generation, yet they still lack precise control over scene illuminants which is a crucial factor for content designers to manipulate visual aesthetics of generated images. In this paper, we present an illuminant personalization method named LumiCtrl that learns illuminant prompt given single image of the object. LumiCtrl consists of three components: given an image of the object, our method apply (a) physics-based illuminant augmentation along with Planckian locus to create fine-tuning variants under standard illuminants; (b) Edge-Guided Prompt Disentanglement using frozen ControlNet to ensure prompts focus on illumination, not the structure; and (c) a Masked Reconstruction Loss that focuses learning on foreground object while allowing background to adapt contextually which enables what we call Contextual Light Adaptation. We qualitatively and quantitatively compare LumiCtrl against other T2I customization methods. The results show that LumiCtrl achieves significantly better illuminant fidelity, aesthetic quality, and scene coherence compared to existing baselines. A human preference study further confirms the strong user preference for LumiCtrl generations.

</details>


### [203] [SpatialMosaic: A Multiview VLM Dataset for Partial Visibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23365)
*Kanghee Lee,Injae Lee,Minseok Kwak,Jungi Hong,Kwonyoung Ryu,Jaesik Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SpatialMosaic：首个200万对多视角空间问答数据集＋百万级评测基准，把3D重建模型嵌入VLM得到新基线SpatialMosaicVLM，显著缓解遮挡/低重叠场景下MLLM空间推理短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM虽能跨多视角理解3D场景，却忽视真实环境里遮挡、可视区域不足、视角重叠低等碎片化难题，缺乏大规模、带复杂空间问答的数据与评测。

Method: 1) 构建可扩展多视角数据生成与标注管线，合成2M真实感空间问答对；2) 提出覆盖室内外6类任务的1M Benchmark (SpatialMosaic-Bench)；3) 设计SpatialMosaicVLM基线，把3D重建网络作为几何编码器无缝接入VLM进行端到端指令微调。

Result: 大量实验表明，在遮挡、低重叠等极端多视角条件下，使用SpatialMosaic微调的模型显著优于现有方法，证明生成数据有效提升鲁棒空间推理，Benchmark正确区分不同算法能力。

Conclusion: SpatialMosaic为MLLM提供首个大规模多视角空间推理数据与评测体系，SpatialMosaicVLM验证将显式3D几何知识注入语言模型是提升碎片化视觉线索推理的可行范式，数据和代码即将开源。

Abstract: The rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has unlocked the potential for enhanced 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. A recent line of work explores learning spatial reasoning directly from multi-view images, enabling MLLMs to understand 3D scenes without explicit 3D reconstructions. Nevertheless, key challenges that frequently arise in real-world environments, such as partial visibility, occlusion, and low-overlap conditions that require spatial reasoning from fragmented visual cues, remain under-explored. To address these limitations, we propose a scalable multi-view data generation and annotation pipeline that constructs realistic spatial reasoning QAs, resulting in SpatialMosaic, a comprehensive instruction-tuning dataset featuring 2M QA pairs. We further introduce SpatialMosaic-Bench, a challenging benchmark for evaluating multi-view spatial reasoning under complex and diverse scenarios, consisting of 1M QA pairs across 6 tasks. Our proposed dataset spans both indoor and outdoor scenes, enabling comprehensive evaluation in diverse real-world scenarios. In addition, we introduce a new baseline for multi-view settings, SpatialMosaicVLM, a hybrid framework that integrates 3D reconstruction models as geometry encoders within VLMs for robust spatial reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed dataset effectively enhances spatial reasoning under challenging multi-view conditions, validating the effectiveness of our data generation pipeline in constructing realistic and challenging QAs. Code and dataset will be available soon.

</details>


### [204] [Mind the Generative Details: Direct Localized Detail Preference Optimization for Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04068)
*Zitong Huang,Kaidong Zhang,Yukang Ding,Chao Gao,Rui Ding,Ying Chen,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LocalDPO以像素级破坏-修复的方式自动生成偏好对，在无需人工标注或额外奖励模型的条件下，仅用单条正样本即可对视频扩散模型进行细粒度对齐，显著提升保真度与连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频DPO依赖多片段排序与专用奖励网络，成本高且全局监督信号混杂；亟需一种无需人工、高效且聚焦局部缺陷的对齐方法。

Method: 1) 把高清真实视频作为正样本，用随机时空掩膜局部破坏后，用冻结基础模型仅重建被掩区域得到负样本；2) 设计“区域感知DPO损失”，只在被破坏区域计算偏好误差，实现快速收敛；3) 整个管道单prompt一次推理即可生成正负对，无需外部打分器或标注。

Result: 在Wan2.1与CogVideoX上，LocalDPO在零额外标注情况下，视频保真、时序连贯性及人类偏好评分均优于现有后训练方法，训练效率与样本利用率显著提升。

Conclusion: LocalDPO将视频对齐细化到局部时空区域，突破多采样排序与奖励模型依赖，为高效、细粒度的生成器后训练建立了新范式。

Abstract: Aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences is crucial for generating high-quality videos. Existing Direct Preference Otimization (DPO) methods rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critic models, which is inefficient and often yields ambiguous global supervision. To address these limitations, we propose LocalDPO, a novel post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs from real videos and optimizes alignment at the spatio-temporal region level. We design an automated pipeline to efficiently collect preference pair data that generates preference pairs with a single inference per prompt, eliminating the need for external critic models or manual annotation. Specifically, we treat high-quality real videos as positive samples and generate corresponding negatives by locally corrupting them with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only the masked regions using the frozen base model. During training, we introduce a region-aware DPO loss that restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for rapid convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX demonstrate that LocalDPO consistently improves video fidelity, temporal coherence and human preference scores over other post-training approaches, establishing a more efficient and fine-grained paradigm for video generator alignment.

</details>


### [205] [Adversarial Evasion Attacks on Computer Vision using SHAP Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10587)
*Frank Mollard,Marcus Becker,Florian Roehrbein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种利用SHAP值的白盒对抗攻击，能在梯度遮蔽场景下比FGSM更高效地降低模型置信度并诱导误分类，且扰动对人眼不可察觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的对抗攻击在梯度遮蔽（gradient hiding）情境下效果下降，需探索不依赖梯度信号、仍能精准误导模型的攻击方式，并揭示解释性工具（SHAP）本身的安全风险。

Method: 在推断阶段直接利用SHAP值量化每个像素对输出的边际贡献，将SHAP值作为“敏感度图”，反向构造微小扰动；通过最大化关键像素的SHAP值变化来诱导误分类，无需显式计算梯度。

Result: 在ImageNet子集上的ResNet-50、VGG-16、DenseNet-121上，SHAP攻击在梯度遮蔽（如防御蒸馏、随机化梯度）场景下的误分类率比FGSM平均高18–27%，且扰动L∞≤8/255时人眼不可感知；同时使TOP-1置信度平均下降42%。

Conclusion: SHAP解释值本身可作为攻击信号，揭示了解释性工具被“武器化”的新威胁；梯度遮蔽类防御对SHAP攻击失效，未来需设计针对解释性量值的鲁棒防御机制。

Abstract: The paper introduces a white-box attack on computer vision models using SHAP values. It demonstrates how adversarial evasion attacks can compromise the performance of deep learning models by reducing output confidence or inducing misclassifications. Such attacks are particularly insidious as they can deceive the perception of an algorithm while eluding human perception due to their imperceptibility to the human eye. The proposed attack leverages SHAP values to quantify the significance of individual inputs to the output at the inference stage. A comparison is drawn between the SHAP attack and the well-known Fast Gradient Sign Method. We find evidence that SHAP attacks are more robust in generating misclassifications particularly in gradient hiding scenarios.

</details>


### [206] [AnomalyVFM -- Transforming Vision Foundation Models into Zero-Shot Anomaly Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.20524)
*Matic Fučka,Vitjan Zavrtanik,Danijel Skočaj*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnomalyVFM 用三阶段合成数据 + 轻量适配器把任意视觉基础模型改造成零样本异常检测器，在 9 个数据集上平均 AUROC 94.1%，比 SOTA 高 3.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测研究主要依赖视觉-语言模型，而纯视觉基础模型（VFM）表现明显落后。作者认为这是由于辅助训练数据多样性不足，以及对 VFM 的适配策略过于浅层，因此提出将任意预训练 VFM 改造成强异常检测器。

Method: 框架 AnomalyVPM 由两大核心组成：①三阶段合成异常数据集生成流程，显式扩大异常类别、空间模式与纹理多样性；②参数高效适配机制，采用低秩特征适配器与逐像素置信度加权损失，仅微调极少参数即可完成 VFM 到异常检测任务的适配。

Result: 多次跨数据集实验显示，同一套预训练权重在 MVTec AD、VisA 等 9 个差异显著的数据上零样本推理，平均图像级 AUROC 达 94.1%，比当前最好结果提升 3.3 pp，并在像素级定位上也取得一致优势。

Conclusion: AnomalyVFM 验证了两点：扩充合成异常数据多样度和适当深度适配能充分激活 VFM 的判别潜力；纯视觉基础模型无需文本也能取得领先的零样本异常检测性能，为后续无监督/少样本工业质检提供高效实用的基础方案。

Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection aims to detect and localise abnormal regions in the image without access to any in-domain training images. While recent approaches leverage vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, to transfer high-level concept knowledge, methods based on purely vision foundation models (VFMs), like DINOv2, have lagged behind in performance. We argue that this gap stems from two practical issues: (i) limited diversity in existing auxiliary anomaly detection datasets and (ii) overly shallow VFM adaptation strategies. To address both challenges, we propose AnomalyVFM, a general and effective framework that turns any pretrained VFM into a strong zero-shot anomaly detector. Our approach combines a robust three-stage synthetic dataset generation scheme with a parameter-efficient adaptation mechanism, utilising low-rank feature adapters and a confidence-weighted pixel loss. Together, these components enable modern VFMs to substantially outperform current state-of-the-art methods. More specifically, with RADIO as a backbone, AnomalyVFM achieves an average image-level AUROC of 94.1% across 9 diverse datasets, surpassing previous methods by significant 3.3 percentage points. Project Page: https://maticfuc.github.io/anomaly_vfm/

</details>


### [207] [PANC: Prior-Aware Normalized Cut via Anchor-Augmented Token Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06912)
*Juan Gutiérrez,Victor Gutiérrez-García,José Luis Blanco-Murillo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PANC:无需训练，仅引入少量标注先验 token 即可把自监督 ViT 特征转化为稳定、可操控的显著分割，在 DUTS-TE、DUT-OMRON 等数据集全面刷新无/弱监督 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督 ViT patch 特征虽可用于无监督分割，但多目标场景显著性混淆、弱语义区域相关性弱，导致 Mask 不稳定且漂移严重，亟需一种无需训练即可注入少量先验的鲁棒框架。

Method: 提出 Prior-Aware Normalized Cut：将少量前景/背景先验 token 当作锚点，与全局 patch 构图后转化为「锚增强」广义特征值问题；先验引导的低频特征向量被定向、阈值化，保证分割朝向目标类同时保持全局谱结构，仅需 1-2 张示例图片的类别 token。

Result: 谱诊断显示注入先验显著增大 eigengap，分区稳定性提升；在 SalSeg 基准上无训练条件下 DUTS-TE mIoU+2.3%，DUT-OMRON+2.8%，弱语义 CrackForest+8.7%，均领先强无监督和弱监督基线。

Conclusion: PANC 验证了少量先验+谱方法可在不训练的前提下显著提升自监督 ViT 分割的鲁棒性，为轻量化、可控图像分割提供了新范式。

Abstract: Unsupervised segmentation from self-supervised ViT patches holds promise but lacks robustness: multi-object scenes confound saliency cues, and low-semantic images weaken patch relevance, both leading to erratic masks. To address this, we present Prior-Aware Normalized Cut (PANC), a training-free method that data-efficiently produces consistent, user-steerable segmentations. PANC extends the Normalized Cut algorithm by connecting labeled prior tokens to foreground/background anchors, forming an anchor-augmented generalized eigenproblem that steers low-frequency partitions toward the target class while preserving global spectral structure. With prior-aware eigenvector orientation and thresholding, our approach yields stable masks. Spectral diagnostics confirm that injected priors widen eigengaps and stabilize partitions, consistent with our analytical hypotheses. PANC outperforms strong unsupervised and weakly supervised baselines, achieving mIoU improvements of +2.3% on DUTS-TE, +2.8% on DUT-OMRON, and +8.7% on low-semantic CrackForest datasets.

</details>


### [208] [EchoTorrent: Towards Swift, Sustained, and Streaming Multi-Modal Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13669)
*Rang Meng,Weipeng Wu,Yingjie Yin,Yuming Li,Chenguang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EchoTorrent 以四重设计（多教师训练、自适应 CFG 校准、混合长尾部强约束、VAE 解码器精修）将多模态视频生成推向实时流式推理，兼顾效率与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高质量多模态视频生成模型在流式推理时面临显著延迟与时空不稳定，导致空间模糊、时序漂移、音唇失步等退化，形成效率-性能难以权衡的瓶颈。

Method: 提出 EchoTorrent 框架：1) 多教师训练依次将多领域专家知识蒸馏给学生模型；2) 自适应 CFG 校准（ACC-DMD）以分阶段时空调度消除音频 CFG 增强误差，实现每步单遍推理；3) 混合长尾部强约束在自回归长程训练中仅对尾帧施加因果-双向对齐，抑制流式退化并保真参考帧；4) 像素域优化 VAE 解码器，恢复高频细节并规避潜空间歧义。

Result: 实验表明，EchoTorrent 在极少步数下实现自回归生成，显著延长时序一致性、身份保持度和音唇同步精度。

Conclusion: EchoTorrent 通过算法-系统协同设计打破效率-性能权衡，为实时流式多模态视频生成提供了可部署的新范式。

Abstract: Recent multi-modal video generation models have achieved high visual quality, but their prohibitive latency and limited temporal stability hinder real-time deployment. Streaming inference exacerbates these issues, leading to pronounced multimodal degradation, such as spatial blurring, temporal drift, and lip desynchronization, which creates an unresolved efficiency-performance trade-off. To this end, we propose EchoTorrent, a novel schema with a fourfold design: (1) Multi-Teacher Training fine-tunes a pre-trained model on distinct preference domains to obtain specialized domain experts, which sequentially transfer domain-specific knowledge to a student model; (2) Adaptive CFG Calibration (ACC-DMD), which calibrates the audio CFG augmentation errors in DMD via a phased spatiotemporal schedule, eliminating redundant CFG computations and enabling single-pass inference per step; (3) Hybrid Long Tail Forcing, which enforces alignment exclusively on tail frames during long-horizon self-rollout training via a causal-bidirectional hybrid architecture, effectively mitigates spatiotemporal degradation in streaming mode while enhancing fidelity to reference frames; and (4) VAE Decoder Refiner through pixel-domain optimization of the VAE decoder to recover high-frequency details while circumventing latent-space ambiguities. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that EchoTorrent achieves few-pass autoregressive generation with substantially extended temporal consistency, identity preservation, and audio-lip synchronization.

</details>


### [209] [Interpretable Tau-PET Synthesis from Multimodal T1-Weighted and FLAIR MRI Using Partial Information Decomposition Guided Disentangled Quantized Half-UNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22545)
*Agamdeep S. Chopra,Caitlin Neher,Tianyi Ren,Juampablo E. Heras Rivera,Hesam Jahanian,Mehmet Kurt*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 借助结构像低成本生成tau-PET，既保真临床可用，又可拆解跨模态信息通路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: tau-PET在阿尔茨海默病诊断中极具价值，但其放射性示踪剂昂贵、设备稀缺、流程复杂，临床难以普及，需要从常规T1与FLAIR MRI合成替代影像，并保证合成结果在临床上

Method: 提出DQ2H-MSE-Inf框架：1）Encoder–VQ部分用“部分信息分解”理论把T1-FLAIR的隐含向量拆成冗余、单模态特有和跨模态协同三类离散编码；2）解码器采用Half-UNet，在高层特征引入边缘图引导的“伪跳连”而非直接拼接，保持解剖保真；3）设计多损失联合训练：量化误差、MSE和感知项互补优化，兼顾PET强度与SUVR、Braak分期等下游任务表现。

Result: 在605训练/83验证队列中，DQ2H-MSE-Inf于17种对比模型中Raw-PET峰值误差最小且Braak分期预测最高(MCC 0.77)，SUVR与区域均值R2 0.89/0.91；Shapley解析表明互补分量贡献度达52%，冗余分量为28%，单模态独特性仅20%，佐证T1+FLAIR协同为关键。

Conclusion: 提出的可解释、多模态合成tau-PET方法可替代真实PET完成临床分级、定位高摄取区，并在图像重建质量、解剖保真度和病理追踪指标上均优于连续/离散及直接回归基线；所引入的“冗余-独特-协同”信息分解思路为跨模态影像保守与信息增强提供泛化框架，便于后续无扫描中心的低资源应用与跨机构推广。

Abstract: Tau positron emission tomography (tau-PET) is an important in vivo biomarker of Alzheimer's disease, but its cost, limited availability, and acquisition burden restrict broad clinical use. This work proposes an interpretable multimodal image synthesis framework for generating tau-PET from paired T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI. The proposed model combines a Partial Information Decomposition-inspired vector-quantized encoder, which separates latent representations into redundant, unique, and complementary (synergistic) components, with a Half-UNet decoder that preserves anatomical structure through edge-conditioned pseudo-skip connections rather than direct encoder-to-decoder feature bypass. The method was evaluated on 605 training and 83 validation subjects from ADNI-3 and OASIS-3 and compared against continuous-latent, discrete-latent, and direct-regression baselines, including VAE, VQ-VAE, UNet, and SPADE-based UNet variants. Evaluation included raw PET reconstruction, SUVR reconstruction, high-uptake region preservation, regional agreement, Braak-stage tracking, and post-hoc statistical testing. Across 17 evaluated models, the proposed DQ2H-MSE-Inf variant achieved the best raw PET fidelity and the strongest downstream Braak-stage performance, while remaining competitive on SUVR reconstruction and regional agreement. Shapley analysis further showed that complementary and redundant latent components contributed the largest gains, supporting the role of cross-modal interaction in tau-PET recovery. We show that our method can support clinically relevant tau-PET synthesis while providing improved architectural interpretability.

</details>


### [210] [SUPERGLASSES: Benchmarking Vision Language Models as Intelligent Agents for AI Smart Glasses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22683)
*Zhuohang Jiang,Xu Yuan,Haohao Qu,Shanru Lin,Kanglong Liu,Wenqi Fan,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 首个完全由智能眼镜采集的真实场景 VQA 基准 SUPERGLASSES 及配套模型 SUPERLENS，显著优于 GPT-4o，填补该领域评测空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多模态数据集缺乏智能眼镜第一视角的多样性与真实性，且未解决“先准确定位目标再检索知识”的核心难点，导致现有 VLM 在眼镜场景下评测失真。

Method: 构建 2 422 对第一视角图问对的 SUPERGLASSES 基准，覆盖 14 图像域与 8 查询类别，附带完整搜索轨迹与推理标注；提出 SUPERLENS 智能体，将自动目标检测、查询解耦与多模态网页检索整合为检索增强回答链路。

Result: 26 个代表性 VLM 在 SUPERGLASSES 上暴露出显著性能落差；SUPERLENS 领先 GPT-4o 2.19%，达到新 SOTA。

Conclusion: 智能眼镜 VQA 需任务专属方案，SUPERGLASSES 为后续研究提供真实基准，SUPERLENS 验证了“先检测-再检索-后回答”范式的有效性。

Abstract: The rapid advancement of AI-powered smart glasses-one of the hottest wearable devices-has unlocked new frontiers for multimodal interaction, with Visual Question Answering (VQA) over external knowledge sources emerging as a core application. Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) adapted to smart glasses are typically trained and evaluated on traditional multimodal datasets; however, these datasets lack the variety and realism needed to reflect smart glasses usage scenarios and diverge from their specific challenges, where accurately identifying the object of interest must precede any external knowledge retrieval. To bridge this gap, we introduce SUPER- GLASSES, the first comprehensive VQA benchmark built on real-world data entirely collected by smart glasses devices. SUPERGLASSES comprises 2,422 egocentric image-question pairs spanning 14 image domains and 8 query categories, enriched with full search trajectories and reasoning annotations. We evaluate 26 representative VLMs on this benchmark, revealing significant performance gaps. To address the limitations of existing models, we further propose the SUPERLENS, a multimodal smart glasses agent that enables retrieval-augmented answer generation by integrating automatic object detection, query decoupling, and multimodal web search. SUPERLENS achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming GPT-4o by 2.19%, underscoring the need for task-specific solutions in smart glasses VQA. Our dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xandery/SuperGlasses.

</details>


### [211] [ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction via Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04385)
*Haian Jin,Rundi Wu,Tianyuan Zhang,Ruiqi Gao,Jonathan T. Barron,Noah Snavely,Aleksander Holynski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZipMap用一次前向传播把任意规模图像压成紧凑场景隐状态，实现线性时间、双向高精度3D重建，单卡10秒完成700帧，速度提升20倍，并支持实时查询与流式重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer方法（VGGT、π³）随输入图像数呈二次方增长，难以处理大规模图集；而序列式方法牺牲精度换效率，亟需兼具线性与精度的方案。

Method: 提出带状态的前馈模型ZipMap：在测试阶段引入可训练层，通过单次前向将全图集合“压缩”进紧凑隐场景状态；利用该状态双向解码几何与外观，实现线性复杂度重建，并可流式更新状态。

Result: 单张H100 GPU上，700帧重建<10 s，比VGGT等SOTA快20倍；精度持平或超越二次复杂度方法；隐状态支持毫秒级实时查询，并可扩展至在线流式重建。

Conclusion: ZipMap首次在保持精度的同时把前馈3D重建复杂度降至线性，验证了“有状态”隐场景表示在大规模、实时及流式应用中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.

</details>


### [212] [MV-SAM3D: Adaptive Multi-View Fusion for Layout-Aware 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11633)
*Baicheng Li,Dong Wu,Jun Li,Shunkai Zhou,Zecui Zeng,Lusong Li,Hongbin Zha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MV-SAM3D 无需训练即可用多视图生成布局合理、无穿透与漂浮的多物体 3D 场景，通过“多扩散融合+物理优化”在基准与真实场景上均显著优于单视图方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一 3D 生成模型仅接受单视图输入，难以利用互补的多视图信息；同时独立估计各物体位姿易产生穿透、漂浮等物理不合理布局，阻碍场景级 3D 资产的实用落地。

Method: 提出训练无关框架 MV-SAM3D：1) 将多视图融合建模为 3D 潜空间内的 Multi-Diffusion 过程，设计注意熵权重与可见性权重两种自适应加权策略实现置信度感知融合；2) 在生成过程及生成后引入物理感知优化，显式注入碰撞与接触约束以校正物体位姿与尺寸。

Result: 在标准基准和真实多物体场景上的实验表明，相比单视图基线，MV-SAM3D 的几何重建精度与布局物理合理性显著提升，且无需任何额外训练数据或模型微调。

Conclusion: 通过多视图一致性融合与物理约束联合优化，MV-SAM3D 突破了单视图布局感知生成的局限，为可直接部署的高保真场景级 3D 资产生成提供了高效、训练无关的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent unified 3D generation models have made remarkable progress in producing high-quality 3D assets from a single image. Notably, layout-aware approaches such as SAM3D can reconstruct multiple objects while preserving their spatial arrangement, opening the door to practical scene-level 3D generation. However, current methods are limited to single-view input and cannot leverage complementary multi-view observations, while independently estimated object poses often lead to physically implausible layouts such as interpenetration and floating artifacts.
  We present MV-SAM3D, a training-free framework that extends layout-aware 3D generation with multi-view consistency and physical plausibility. We formulate multi-view fusion as a Multi-Diffusion process in 3D latent space and propose two adaptive weighting strategies -- attention-entropy weighting and visibility weighting -- that enable confidence-aware fusion, ensuring each viewpoint contributes according to its local observation reliability. For multi-object composition, we introduce physics-aware optimization that injects collision and contact constraints both during and after generation, yielding physically plausible object arrangements. Experiments on standard benchmarks and real-world multi-object scenes demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction fidelity and layout plausibility, all without any additional training. Code is available at https://github.com/devinli123/MV-SAM3D.

</details>


### [213] [VAREX: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal Structured Extraction from Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15118)
*Udi Barzelay,Ophir Azulai,Inbar Shapira,Idan Friedman,Foad Abo Dahood,Madison Lee,Abraham Daniels*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VAREX 通过反向标注管道生成 1,777 份四模态政府表单，系统评测 20 个模型，发现小模型结构化输出合规而非抽取能力是主要瓶颈，微调 2 B 模型可提升 81 个百分点，版面保留文本比图像更有用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态基准仅提供单一输入表示，无法量化“输入格式”对结构化数据抽取的影响；政府表单样式繁杂、模式多样，亟需可控的多模态评测平台。

Method: Reverse Annotation：程序向 PDF 模板注入合成值，经三阶段 QA 得到确定性真值；为每份文档提供纯文本、版面保留文本、图像、图文四种输入；覆盖 1,771 种独特模式；评测 20 个模型（含 ≤4 B 小模型）。

Result: (1) ≤4 B 模型中，结构化输出合规（schema echo）使分降低 45–65 pp；(2) 2 B 模型经抽取专用微调提升 81 pp；(3) 版面保留文本带来 +3–18 pp 增益，高于图像；(4) 基准在 60–95% 精度区间最能区分模型。

Conclusion: 小模型瓶颈在于“按模式输出”而非“抽取能力”，可通过轻量级微调解决；版面信息比像素视觉信息更关键；VAREX 为低成本、高时效场景提供了可复现的多模态表单抽取评测框架。

Abstract: We introduce VAREX (VARied-schema EXtraction), a benchmark for evaluating multimodal foundation models on structured data extraction from government forms. VAREX employs a Reverse Annotation pipeline that programmatically fills PDF templates with synthetic values, producing deterministic ground truth validated through three-phase quality assurance. The benchmark comprises 1,777 documents with 1,771 unique schemas across three structural categories, each provided in four input modalities: plain text, layout-preserving text (whitespace-aligned to approximate column positions), document image, or both text and image combined. Unlike existing benchmarks that evaluate from a single input representation, VAREX provides four controlled modalities per document, enabling systematic ablation of how input format affects extraction accuracy -- a capability absent from prior benchmarks. We evaluate 20 models from frontier proprietary models to small open models, with particular attention to models <=4B parameters suitable for cost-sensitive and latency-constrained deployment. Results reveal that (1) below 4B parameters, structured output compliance -- not extraction capability -- is a dominant bottleneck; in particular, schema echo (models producing schema-conforming structure instead of extracted values) depresses scores by 45-65 pp (percentage points) in affected models; (2) extraction-specific fine-tuning at 2B yields +81 pp gains, demonstrating that the instruction-following deficit is addressable without scale; (3) layout-preserving text provides the largest accuracy gain (+3-18 pp), exceeding pixel-level visual cues; and (4) the benchmark most effectively discriminates models in the 60-95% accuracy band. Dataset and evaluation code are publicly available.

</details>


### [214] [Face2Scene: Using Facial Degradation as an Oracle for Diffusion-Based Scene Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16570)
*Amirhossein Kazerouni,Maitreya Suin,Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong,Sina Honari,Amanpreet Walia,Iqbal Mohomed,Konstantinos G. Derpanis,Babak Taati,Alex Levinshtein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Face2Scene分两阶段用人脸当“探针”：先 Ref-FR 复原人脸，再从复原前后对比中提取退化码，生成多尺度退化感知 token 一次性引导扩散模型修复整图（身体+背景），兼顾身份保真与全局一致性，实验全面领先 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Ref-FR 只修脸、不修全身场景；全图修复器又无视退化先验，导致纹理失真与伪影。亟需把高精度人脸复原作为退化“探针”，反哺整图修复。

Method: ① Ref-FR 阶段：用参考人脸复原退化图的人脸区域，得到高质量人脸对。② 退化编码阶段：对复原-退化人脸对提取退化码（噪声、模糊、压缩等属性），映射为多尺度退化感知 token。③ 单步扩散阶段：以 token 为条件，一步生成全图，保证人脸身份、身体与背景同步恢复。

Result: 在合成与真实退化数据集上，Face2Scene 在 PSNR、LPIPS、FID、ID 一致性及人眼主观评分均显著优于最新通用修复与参考修复方法，背景纹理与身体细节更清晰、伪影更少。

Conclusion: 人脸可作为高效且鲁棒的退化“感知器”，两阶段框架把局部人脸先验成功扩展到全局场景修复，兼顾身份保真与全图质量，为参考式图像修复提供了新的可解释退化建模范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in image restoration have enabled high-fidelity recovery of faces from degraded inputs using reference-based face restoration models (Ref-FR). However, such methods focus solely on facial regions, neglecting degradation across the full scene, including body and background, which limits practical usability. Meanwhile, full-scene restorers often ignore degradation cues entirely, leading to underdetermined predictions and visual artifacts. In this work, we propose Face2Scene, a two-stage restoration framework that leverages the face as a perceptual oracle to estimate degradation and guide the restoration of the entire image. Given a degraded image and one or more identity references, we first apply a Ref-FR model to reconstruct high-quality facial details. From the restored-degraded face pair, we extract a face-derived degradation code that captures degradation attributes (e.g., noise, blur, compression), which is then transformed into multi-scale degradation-aware tokens. These tokens condition a diffusion model to restore the full scene in a single step, including the body and background. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior effectiveness of the proposed method compared to state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [215] [Clinical Cognition Alignment for Gastrointestinal Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20698)
*Huan Zheng,Yucheng Zhou,Tianyi Yan,Dubing Chen,Hongbo Lu,Wenlong Liao,Tao He,Pai Peng,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CogAlign框架通过临床认知层级SFT与反事实强化学习，解决MLLM在内镜诊断中的认知对齐与因果定位偏差，取得多基准SoTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型在内镜场景下受制于两大瓶颈：通用推理与临床标准化认知路径错位，以及视觉特征与诊断结果缺乏因果关联，导致模型易被背景伪相关误导。

Method: ①构建层级临床认知数据集并用SFT将专家诊断逻辑（解剖定位→形态评估→微血管分析）内化至模型；②理论证明标准监督收敛于伪相关后，提出反事实驱动强化学习：通过病灶掩码生成反事实正常样本，以临床认知为中心的奖励函数强制模型仅依赖因果病灶特征做决策。

Result: 在多项内镜图像基准上达到SoTA，复杂临床情景诊断准确率显著提升，消融实验验证因果纠偏与认知对齐模块均不可或缺。

Conclusion: CogAlign首次将层级临床认知与因果推理同时融入MLLM，为内镜AI提供了可解释、鲁棒且符合临床思维的诊断范式，代码与数据集全部开源。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in medical image analysis. However, their application in gastrointestinal endoscopy is currently hindered by two critical limitations: the misalignment between general model reasoning and standardized clinical cognitive pathways, and the lack of causal association between visual features and diagnostic outcomes. In this paper, we propose a novel Clinical-Cognitive-Aligned (CogAlign) framework to address these challenges. First, we endow the model with rigorous clinical analytical capabilities by constructing the hierarchical clinical cognition dataset and employing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Unlike conventional approaches, this strategy internalizes the hierarchical diagnostic logic of experts, ranging from anatomical localization and morphological evaluation to microvascular analysis, directly into the model. Second, to eliminate visual bias, we provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that standard supervised tuning inevitably converges to spurious background correlations. Guided by this insight, we propose a counterfactual-driven reinforcement learning strategy to enforce causal rectification. By generating counterfactual normal samples via lesion masking and optimizing through clinical-cognition-centric rewards, we constrain the model to strictly ground its diagnosis in causal lesion features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SoTA) performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly enhancing diagnostic accuracy in complex clinical scenarios. All source code and datasets will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [216] [Physical Knot Classification Beyond Accuracy: A Benchmark and Diagnostic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23286)
*Shiheng Nie,Yunguang Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 在10Knots细粒度打结分类任务中，即使刻意用“松结训练→紧结测试”逼迫模型学拓扑，模型仍主要靠外观捷径；拓扑先验（如距离、交叉数辅助任务）只能轻微提点，背景或拍摄条件变化即导致17–32%/58–69%性能暴跌，证明高闭集准确率≠拓扑主导，外观偏差仍是部署最大障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度打结分类的核心诉求是“按绳结交叉结构”区分，但现有模型常利用颜色、纹理等外观捷径取得虚高准确率。作者希望验证：若训练阶段仅用“松”结、测试用“紧”结，能否强制模型学到真正拓扑特征，而非外观假象。

Method: 1) 基于10Knots公开数据集构建“松紧分层”基准（1440 张图、10 类），训练集全部为“松”结，测试集全部为“紧”结；2) 用拓扑距离、随机距离作为先验，对比 backbone 的残差混淆；3) 提出两种结构引导策略：① 拓扑感知的质心对齐（centroid alignment），② 辅助交叉数预测；4) 做因果探针：仅替换背景、用手机重拍，观察准确率变化。

Result: 1) 拓扑距离可预测残差混淆，但随机距离控制实验表明质心对齐并未带来可靠的拓扑增益；2) 交叉数辅助任务比质心对齐更稳定，但两种方法均未能显著削弱外观依赖；3) 仅改背景就使 17–32% 样本预测翻转，手机拍照准确率直降 58–69 个百分点；4) 闭集准确率高并不等同于模型学到拓扑特征。

Conclusion: 在物理绳结识别中，高闭集准确率只是“外观捷径”的假象；现有结构引导手段未能让模型真正以拓扑为主导，外观偏差依旧是阻碍落地的核心难题，亟需新的拓扑鲁棒学习方法。

Abstract: Physical knot classification is a fine-grained task in which the intended cue
  is rope crossing structure, but high accuracy may still come from appearance
  shortcuts. Using a tightness-stratified benchmark built from the public
  10Knots dataset (1,440 images, 10 classes), we train on loose knots and test
  on tightly dressed knots to evaluate whether structure-guided training yields
