Findings unveil that LLMs still cannot 'talk much' about the core syntax properties embedded in the terms under study involving several syntactic and semantic challenges: only 25% of ChatGPT translations were accurate, while 38.6% were inaccurate, and 36.4.% were partially correct, which we consider appropriate. Based on these findings, a set of actionable strategies were proposed, the most notable of which is a close collaboration between AI specialists and linguists to better LLMs' working mechanism for accurate or at least appropriate translation.

</details>


### [402] [HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20843)
*Xiangyu Zeng,Qi Xu,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 基于人类话语理解的认知理论，提出分层构造-整合(HiCI)模块，将4K-64K上下文扩展至100K-64K级别，仅需 <5.5% 额外参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer 扩展长上下文主要靠 token 级注意力，严重冗余且未显式建模局部→全局的信息结构；现有方法缺乏可解释的长程控制。

Method: 设计 Hierarchical Construction–Integration 三阶段：先压缩 token 角度；然后自底向上构建片段级表示；接着整合为共享全局表示；再自顶向下广播局部调用片段关注的条件。此模块直通短上下文预训练模型而未大规模微调参数，只替换/插入少量层并重用其余权重。

Result: 在 LLaMA-2 7B/13B 上仅用 <5.5% 新参数完成适配，上下文扩展到 100 K；跨语言建模、针叶检索、指令遵循基准均优于 FFN/局部注意力基线；主题检索追上专有模型，代码理解上超越 GPT-3.5-Turbo-16k。各类长度的困惑度下降，无额外推理摊销。

Conclusion: 显式层次化结构可作为有效的归纳偏置，低成本为已有语言模型注入长上下文建模能力，展示了在不重新预训练或大幅增参前提下的可扩展方案。

Abstract: Long-context language modeling is commonly framed as a scalability challenge of token-level attention, yet local-to-global information structuring remains largely implicit in existing approaches. Drawing on cognitive theories of discourse comprehension, we propose HiCI (Hierarchical Construction--Integration), a hierarchical attention module that constructs segment-level representations, integrates them into a shared global context, and broadcasts both to condition segment-level attention. We validate HiCI through parameter-efficient adaptation of LLaMA-2 with only <5.5% additional parameters, extending context from 4K to 100K tokens (7B) and 64K tokens (13B). Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit hierarchical structuring as an inductive bias for long-context modeling.

</details>


### [403] [DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05350)
*Vishaal Kapoor,Mariam Dundua,Sarthak Ahuja,Neda Kordjazi,Evren Yortucboylu,Vaibhavi Padala,Derek Ho,Jennifer Whitted,Rebecca Steinert*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出诊断型问答框架 DQA，在持续诊断状态指引下累积证据、聚合根因级历史案例，使企业 IT 故障排查成功率从 41.3% 提升至 78.7%，平均轮次由 8.4 降至 3.9。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业 IT 支持交互本质上是诊断过程，但现有多轮 RAG 缺乏显式诊断状态，难以跨轮累积证据并权衡竞争假设，导致故障定位效率低下、用户体验差。

Method: 构建 DQA 框架：1) 维护持久诊断状态，持续更新候根因及其置信度；2) 按根因而非文档粒度聚合检索结果，避免冗余；3) 对话级查询重写、状态条件生成，在低延迟和低上下文约束下输出提问或解决方案。

Result: 在 150 条匿名企业 IT 场景的回放评测中，DQA 三轮平均成功率 78.7%，显著优于多轮 RAG 基线 41.3%，并将平均对话轮次从 8.4 压缩至 3.9。

Conclusion: 引入诊断状态与根因级聚合，可把多轮检索式对话转化为系统化排查，显著提升 IT 支持自动化效果与效率，为同类诊断场景提供通用范式。

Abstract: Enterprise IT support interactions are fundamentally diagnostic: effective resolution requires iterative evidence gathering from ambiguous user reports to identify an underlying root cause. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides grounding through historical cases, standard multi-turn RAG systems lack explicit diagnostic state and therefore struggle to accumulate evidence and resolve competing hypotheses across turns. We introduce DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the level of root causes rather than individual documents. DQA combines conversational query rewriting, retrieval aggregation, and state-conditioned response generation to support systematic troubleshooting under enterprise latency and context constraints. We evaluate DQA on 150 anonymized enterprise IT support scenarios using a replay-based protocol. Averaged over three independent runs, DQA achieves a 78.7% success rate under a trajectory-level success criterion, compared to 41.3% for a multi-turn RAG baseline, while reducing average turns from 8.4 to 3.9.

</details>


### [404] [See the Forest for the Trees: Loosely Speculative Decoding via Visual-Semantic Guidance for Efficient Inference of Video LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05650)
*Yicheng Ji,Jun Zhang,Jinpeng Chen,Cong Wang,Lidan Shou,Gang Chen,Huan Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LVSpec 首次将“宽松”投机解码引入视频大模型，无需训练即可在几乎零损失（>99.8 %）的前提下把 32–72 B 参数 Video-LLM 推理提速 2.7–2.9 倍，显著超越现有免训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Video-LLMs 自回归生成延迟高；传统投机解码因“逐字精确匹配”规则过于严苛，难以利用视频冗余信息进一步加速。

Method: 1) 无训练框架 LVSpec；2) 轻量级“视觉相关词”判别器，把生成token 划分为稀疏锚点（需严格验证）与大量填充词（可宽松接受）；3) 位置偏移容忍机制，回收仅位置不同但语义等价的候选 token，最大化接受率。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 上加速 2.70×，在 LLaVA-OneVision-72B 上加速 2.94×；平均接受长度与提速比分别比 SOTA 免训练 SD 方法高 136 % 和 35 %，同时保留 >99.8 % 原模型性能。

Conclusion: 通过“视觉相关锚点+宽松验证”策略，LVSpec 打破精确匹配瓶颈，为 Video-LLM 实时部署提供了高效、易部署的推理加速方案。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) excel in video understanding but suffer from high inference latency during autoregressive generation. Speculative Decoding (SD) mitigates this by applying a draft-and-verify paradigm, yet existing methods are constrained by rigid exact-match rules, severely limiting the acceleration potential. To bridge this gap, we propose LVSpec, the first training-free loosely SD framework tailored for Video-LLMs. Grounded in the insight that generation is governed by sparse visual-relevant anchors (mandating strictness) amidst abundant visual-irrelevant fillers (permitting loose verification), LVSpec employs a lightweight visual-relevant token identification scheme to accurately pinpoint the former. To further maximize acceptance, we augment this with a position-shift tolerant mechanism that effectively salvages positionally mismatched but semantically equivalent tokens. Experiments demonstrate that LVSpec achieves high fidelity and speed: it preserves >99.8 of target performance while accelerating Qwen2.5-VL-32B by 2.70x and LLaVA-OneVision-72B by 2.94x. Notably, it boosts the mean accepted length and speedup ratio by 136% and 35% compared to SOTA training-free SD methods for Video-LLMs.

</details>


### [405] [Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06210)
*Jaehyeok Lee,Xiaoyuan Yi,Jing Yao,Hyunjin Hwang,Roy Ka-Wei Lee,Xing Xie,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DOVE框架，用非选择题、分布级对比的方式衡量LLM与真实文化价值分布的契合度，解决现有benchmark的C³缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球部署的LLM需与各地文化价值对齐，但现有基准存在三痛点：判别式选择题只能测“价值知识”而非真实取向；忽略亚文化差异；与开放生成场景脱节。

Method: 构建DOVE分布评测框架：1) 用率-失真变分目标从1万篇人写文本压缩出价值码本，把文本映射到结构化价值空间以滤语义噪声；2) 以非平衡最优传输度量LLM生成分布与人类分布的距离，显式保留亚群结构。

Result: 在12款LLM上，DOVE与下游任务相关性的预测效度达31.56%，且每文化仅500样本即可保持高可靠性，显著优于传统多选基准。

Conclusion: 分布级、开放生成导向的DOVE为LLM文化对齐提供了更敏感、可靠且样本高效的评估工具，可替代现有C³受限的判别式基准。

Abstract: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement. However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context ($C^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation. We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs. DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value-codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise. Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and sub-group diversity. Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.

</details>


### [406] [The Detection-Extraction Gap: Models Know the Answer Before They Can Say It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06613)
*Hanyang Wang,Mingxuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 现有推理模型常在答案已可推断后继续冗长生成长文本，作者发现‘检测-提取差距’并提出BAEE方法，能在保留甚至提升精度的前提下，尽早截断推理序列，显著减少生成开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察到Chain-of-Thought推理总在答案明朗后仍生成大量后续token，怀疑模型内部已‘决定’答案但解码器无法及时提取，造成计算浪费并可能引入噪声，因此探索能否在答案可检测时提前结束生成。

Method: (1) 对5配置×2模型家族×3基准，测出52–88%推理token在答案已可由前缀恢复后才出现；(2) 引入‘检测-提取差距’：早停前缀若让模型自由续写，能高概率复原正确答案，而直接用提示提取却会失败；(3) 用总变差把自由/强制续写分布的差异量化；(4) 提出BAEE——黑盒自适应早停：先用自由续写‘探测’答案是否已在潜状态出现，得到后停止并用同一续写提取答案，可0梯度0训练地在任何模型上应用。

Result: BAEE在全部测试模型上：①削减70–78%串行生成（thinking-model高达73%）；②准确率反而提升1–5pp，早停避免‘事后重写’后最大+5.8pp；③成本优化版仅9次API调用即可实现68–73%减少。

Conclusion: 生成不光可压缩，还可被策略性与分布层面的不对称利用；BAEE证明不需改模型也能显著加速并提升推理质量，提示未来可进一步把‘早停’作为通用插件推广至推理与对话系统。

Abstract: Modern reasoning models continue generating long after the answer is already determined. Across five model configurations, two families, and three benchmarks, we find that 52--88% of chain-of-thought tokens are produced after the answer is recoverable from a partial prefix. This post-commitment generation reveals a structural phenomenon: the detection-extraction gap. Free continuations from early prefixes recover the correct answer even at 10% of the trace, while forced extraction fails on 42% of these cases. The answer is recoverable from the model state, yet prompt-conditioned decoding fails to extract it. We formalize this mismatch via a total-variation bound between free and forced continuation distributions, yielding quantitative estimates of suffix-induced shift. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose Black-box Adaptive Early Exit (BAEE), which uses free continuations for both detection and extraction, truncating 70--78% of serial generation while improving accuracy by 1--5pp across all models. For thinking-mode models, early exit prevents post-commitment overwriting, yielding gains of up to 5.8pp; a cost-optimized variant achieves 68--73% reduction at a median of 9 API calls. Code is available at https://github.com/EdWangLoDaSc/know2say.

</details>


### [407] [TEC: A Collection of Human Trial-and-error Trajectories for Problem Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06734)
*Xinkai Zhang,Jingtao Zhan,Yiqun Liu,Qingyao Ai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文公开了首个记录人类真实试错轨迹的大规模数据集TEC，证明人在该策略上显著优于现有大模型，为后续AI试错算法研发奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI试错方法依赖研究者手工设计启发式，效果有限，核心瓶颈是缺乏人类如何实际执行试错的细粒度数据。

Method: 1) 搭建在线标注平台，完整记录参与者在多轮任务中的操作轨迹及接收错误反馈后的反思；2) 招募46名被试完成58个任务，采集5 370条试错轨迹、41 229个网页日志及对应反思，构成TEC数据集；3) 将人类表现与LLM在相同任务上的准确率进行系统对比。

Result: 在人类与LLM对照实验中，人类准确率显著高于大模型，验证了人类试错策略的有效性；TEC是目前公开规模最大、细节最丰富的人类试错行为数据集。

Conclusion: TEC首次系统捕获并开放了人类真实试错过程，为深入理解人类试错机制、训练更具试错能力的AI提供了关键数据支持，数据和平台已公开发布。

Abstract: Trial-and-error is a fundamental strategy for humans to solve complex problems and a necessary capability for Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems operating in real-world environments. Although several trial-and-error AI techniques have recently been proposed, most of them rely on simple heuristics designed by researchers and achieve limited performance gains. The core issue is the absence of appropriate data: current models cannot learn from detailed records of how humans actually conduct trial-and-error in practice. To address this gap, we introduce a data annotation platform and a corresponding dataset, termed Trial-and-Error Collection (TEC). The platform records users' complete trajectories across multiple trials and collects their reflections after receiving error feedback. Using this platform, we record the problem-solving processes of 46 participants on 58 tasks, resulting in 5,370 trial trajectories along with error reflections across 41,229 webpages. With this dataset, we observe that humans achieve substantially higher accuracy compared to LLMs, which demonstrates that humans are more effective in trial-and-error than LLMs. We believe that the TEC platform and dataset provide a valuable foundation for understanding human trial-and-error behavior and for developing more capable AI systems. Platform and dataset are publicly available.

</details>


### [408] [WRAP++: Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06829)
*Jiang Zhou,Yunhao Wang,Xing Wu,Tinghao Yu,Feng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: WRAP++用跨文档超链接发现实体关联并生成联合问答，把8.4B token扩至80B，7B/32B模型在SimpleQA上显著优于单文档重写基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成数据仅对单篇文档重写，无法捕获跨文档事实关联，导致预训练语料缺乏横向知识语境，限制了LLM的知识联想与推理能力。

Method: 提出WRAP++：1) 基于维基百科超链接挖掘高置信“双链共现”等关系motif；2) 对每对关联文档合成需跨篇推理的QA对；3) 利用实体对组合爆炸实现数据规模放大，将原始8.4B token扩至80B跨文档QA语料。

Result: 在SimpleQA上，基于OLMo的7B与32B模型使用WRAP++预训练后，准确率显著超越单文档重写方法，且随参数规模持续提升，证明跨文档知识发现与放大策略有效。

Conclusion: 跨文档关系驱动的合成问答能显著增强预训练语料中的事实关联密度与数据多样性，是提升大模型知识获取与推理 scaling 性能的新范式。

Abstract: Synthetic data rephrasing has emerged as a powerful technique for enhancing knowledge acquisition during large language model (LLM) pretraining. However, existing approaches operate at the single-document level, rewriting individual web pages in isolation. This confines synthesized examples to intra-document knowledge, missing cross-document relationships and leaving facts with limited associative context. We propose WRAP++ (Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining), which amplifies the associative context of factual knowledge by discovering cross-document relationships from web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over each discovered document pair. Concretely, WRAP++ discovers high-confidence relational motifs including dual-links and co-mentions, and synthesizes QA that requires reasoning across both documents. This produces relational knowledge absent from either source document alone, creating diverse entry points to the same facts. Because the number of valid entity pairs grows combinatorially, this discovery-driven synthesis also amplifies data scale far beyond single-document rewriting. Instantiating WRAP++ on Wikipedia, we amplify ~8.4B tokens of raw text into 80B tokens of cross-document QA data. On SimpleQA, OLMo-based models at both 7B and 32B scales trained with WRAP++ substantially outperform single-document approaches and exhibit sustained scaling gains, underscoring the advantage of cross-document knowledge discovery and amplification.

</details>


### [409] [Sell More, Play Less: Benchmarking LLM Realistic Selling Skill](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07054)
*Xuanbo Su,Wenhao Hu,Haibo Su,Yunzhang Chen,Le Zhan,Yanqi Yang,Leo Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文发布双语SalesLLM 基准，用自动流水线评估 LLM 在销售对话中的成交推进与最终购买意向，并训练用户模型 CustomerLM 提升模拟可信度，实验显示主流模型表现差异巨大，最佳已接近人类水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 销售对话具多轮、非对称激励且以结果为导向，现有对话评测极少关注成交进展与结果，缺乏专门基准。

Method: 构建 3 万脚本配置+1.8k 人工精修的中英双语多轮场景；设计含 LLM 进程评分器与 BERT 购买意向分类器的全自动评估管线；用 8k 众包对话经 SFT+DPO 训练用户模型 CustomerLM 减少角色倒转。

Result: SalesLLM 分数与专家人工评分的皮尔逊 r=0.98；15 款主流 LLM 表现差异显著，头部模型媲美人，尾部模型低于人；CustomerLM 将 GPT-4o 的角色倒转率从 17.44% 降至 8.8%。

Conclusion: SalesLLM 为可扩展、结果导向的销售智能体研发与评测提供了可靠基准与方法论。

Abstract: Sales dialogues require multi-turn, goal-directed persuasion under asymmetric incentives, which makes them a challenging setting for large language models (LLMs). Yet existing dialogue benchmarks rarely measure deal progression and outcomes. We introduce SalesLLM benchmark, a bilingual (ZH/EN) benchmark derived from realistic applications covering Financial Services and Consumer Goods, built from 30,074 scripted configurations and 1,805 curated multi-turn scenarios with controllable difficulty and personas. We propose a fully automatic evaluation pipeline that combines (i) an LLM-based rater for sales-process progress,and (ii) fine-tuned BERT classifiers for end-of-dialogue buying intent. To improve simulation fidelity, we train a user model, CustomerLM, with SFT and DPO on 8,000+ crowdworker-involved sales conversations, reducing role inversion from 17.44% (GPT-4o) to 8.8%. SalesLLM benchmark scores correlate strongly with expert human ratings (Pearson r=0.98). Experiments across 15 mainstream LLMs reveal substantial variability: top-performance LLMs are competitive with human-level performance while the less capable ones are worse than human. SalesLLM benchmark serves as a scalable benchmark for developing and evaluating outcome-oriented sales agents.

</details>


### [410] [OpenSpatial: A Principled Data Engine for Empowering Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07296)
*Jianhui Liu,Haoze Sun,Wenbo Li,Yanbing Zhang,Rui Yang,Zhiliang Zhu,Yijun Yang,Shenghe Zheng,Nan Jiang,Jiaxiu Jiang,Haoyang Huang,Tien-Tsin Wong,Nan Duan,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: OpenSpatial是一个开源、可扩展的3D空间数据引擎，配套300万高质量样本的OpenSpatial-3M数据集，显著刷新多项空间推理基准，平均相对提升19%，并系统揭示数据属性对空间感知的影响，为空间智能研究奠定统一基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间理解研究依赖领域特定数据，缺乏通用、高质量且可扩展的开源数据引擎，限制了空间智能的全面发展。

Method: 提出以3D边界框为原子原语的五级数据层次框架：空间测量、空间关系、相机感知、多视角一致性、场景感知推理；据此构建可扩展引擎OpenSpatial，并自动化生成300万高保真样本的OpenSpatial-3M数据集。

Result: 在广泛空间推理基准上，基于该数据集训练的通用模型取得SOTA，最佳模型平均相对提升19%；通过系统实验量化数据属性对空间感知的影响。

Conclusion: OpenSpatial引擎与OpenSpatial-3M数据集的开源为空间智能社区提供了统一、高质量、可扩展的基础设施，可显著加速后续算法与模型创新。

Abstract: Spatial understanding is a fundamental cornerstone of human-level intelligence. Nonetheless, current research predominantly focuses on domain-specific data production, leaving a critical void: the absence of a principled, open-source engine capable of fully unleashing the potential of high-quality spatial data. To bridge this gap, we elucidate the design principles of a robust data generation system and introduce OpenSpatial -- an open-source data engine engineered for high quality, extensive scalability, broad task diversity, and optimized efficiency. OpenSpatial adopts 3D bounding boxes as the fundamental primitive to construct a comprehensive data hierarchy across five foundational tasks: Spatial Measurement (SM), Spatial Relationship (SR), Camera Perception (CP), Multi-view Consistency (MC), and Scene-Aware Reasoning (SAR). Leveraging this scalable infrastructure, we curate OpenSpatial-3M, a large-scale dataset comprising 3 million high-fidelity samples. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that versatile models trained on our dataset achieve state-of-the-art performance across a wide spectrum of spatial reasoning benchmarks. Notably, the best-performing model exhibits a substantial average improvement of 19 percent, relatively. Furthermore, we provide a systematic analysis of how data attributes influence spatial perception. By open-sourcing both the engine and the 3M-scale dataset, we provide a robust foundation to accelerate future research in spatial intelligence.

</details>


### [411] [Iterative Formalization and Planning in Partially Observable Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13126)
*Liancheng Gong,Wang Zhu,Jesse Thomason,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 PDDLego 框架，用 LLM 把部分可观环境逐步形式化为 PDDL，无需微调与轨迹即可提升规划成功率并具备可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 形式化方法只适用于完全可观环境，而现实中多为信息不足的部分可观场景，需要新的自动 PDDL 构建方式。

Method: 将环境与目标解耦为一系列完全可观的子片段，循环执行「形式化→规划→补充信息→精化 PDDL」的 PDDLego 框架，无需任何微调或示例轨迹。

Result: 在复杂度递增的 Benchmark 上，PDDLego 相比端到端方法规划成功率显著提升，且复杂度越高优势越大；同一领域成功后发现的领域知识可直接迁移到新任务。

Conclusion: LLM 通过迭代形式化而非直接规划，可在部分可观环境中稳健生成高质量 PDDL，兼顾可扩展性与迁移能力，为自动领域建模提供了一条现实可行的新路径。

Abstract: Using LLMs not to predict plans but to formalize an environment into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) has been shown to improve performance and control. While most existing methodology only applies to fully observable environments, we adapt to the more realistic and challenging partially observable environments without sufficient information to make a complete plan. We propose PDDLego, a framework to iteratively formalize, plan, grow, and refine PDDL representations by decomposing the environment and the goal into fully observable episodes. Without finetuning, in-context exemplars, or trajectories, PDDLego improves planning success and exhibits robustness against problem complexity compared to end-to-end approaches. We also show that the domain knowledge captured after a successful trial can benefit future tasks.

</details>


### [412] [Auditing Black-Box LLM APIs with a Rank-Based Uniformity Test](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.06975)
*Xiaoyuan Zhu,Yaowen Ye,Tianyi Qiu,Hanlin Zhu,Sijun Tan,Ajraf Mannan,Jonathan Michala,Raluca Ada Popa,Willie Neiswanger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首次提出基于排序的黑盒一致性检验，可在无权重、无logits条件下侦测API方暗中替换/量化/微调LLM，统计功效高、查询足迹隐蔽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM主要通过API提供，服务商可能为节省成本或植入恶意行为而静默替换模型（量化、有害微调等）。用户既无权重也无logit，难以察觉性能与安全下降，亟需低成本、高隐蔽的验证手段。

Method: 设计“秩一致性检验”：用户本地部署可信参考模型，对同一输入并行向API与本地模型发起少量探针查询，仅比较输出token的概率排序而非具体值；利用秩统计构造U检验，检测分布差异，且查询随机化避免被投毒或重定向。

Result: 在多种威胁场景（量化、有害微调、越狱提示、完全替换）下，仅用数十到百余次查询即可在显著性水平0.05下达到>90%检出力，显著优于基于logits或输出匹配的基线方法，且查询模式对防御方不可见。

Conclusion: 该秩检验为黑盒LLM提供轻量、隐蔽、高统计功效的行为一致性验证方案，可用于监管合规、服务SLA保障与安全审计，后续可扩展至多模态与多租户场景。

Abstract: As API access becomes a primary interface to large language models (LLMs), users often interact with black-box systems that offer little transparency into the deployed model. To reduce costs or maliciously alter model behaviors, API providers may discreetly serve quantized or fine-tuned variants, which can degrade performance and compromise safety. Detecting such substitutions is difficult, as users lack access to model weights and, in most cases, even output logits. To tackle this problem, we propose a rank-based uniformity test that can verify the behavioral equality of a black-box LLM to a locally deployed authentic model. Our method is accurate, query-efficient, and avoids detectable query patterns, making it robust to adversarial providers that reroute or mix responses upon the detection of testing attempts. We evaluate the approach across diverse threat scenarios, including quantization, harmful fine-tuning, jailbreak prompts, and full model substitution, showing that it consistently achieves superior statistical power over prior methods under constrained query budgets.

</details>


### [413] [E2Edev: Benchmarking Large Language Models in End-to-End Software Development Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14509)
*Jingyao Liu,Chen Huang,Zhizhao Guan,Wenqiang Lei,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出首个基于行为驱动开发（BDD）的端到端软件开发（E2ESD）评测基准 E2EDev，通过可自动执行的用户故事-测试-脚本三元组精准衡量 LLM 生成代码是否真正满足需求，并发现现有框架普遍失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM-E2ESD 评估过于粗粒度且协议不可靠，不能判断“生成的代码是否真的能用、被用户接受”，亟需细粒度、可自动验证且贴近真实交互的评测基准。

Method: 1）基于 BDD 构建 1,000+ 细粒度需求，每条需求对应多场景 BDD 测试用例及可执行 Python step；2）提出 Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent 标注框架（HITL-MAA）快速生成高质测试脚本；3）在 Behave 上实现全自动测试流水线，把“通过全部 BDD 场景”作为统一通过标准。

Result: 在 E2EDev 上评测 8 种主流 LLM 与 4 个 E2ESD 框架，最优系统通过率仅 18.7%，远低于人类基准 92%；错误集中于交互逻辑、边界条件与外部依赖管理，揭示现有方案远不能满足真实交付要求。

Conclusion: E2EDev 首次以“可执行用户故事”为核心，为 E2ESD 提供可信、细粒度、成本可控的评估范式；结果凸显开发交互理解与自动化测试能力仍是瓶颈，呼吁未来研究聚焦需求对齐、测试驱动生成与高效标注机制。

Abstract: The rapid advancement in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated significant potential in End-to-End Software Development (E2ESD). However, existing E2ESD benchmarks are limited by coarse-grained requirement specifications and unreliable evaluation protocols, hindering a true understanding of current framework capabilities. To address these limitations, we present E2EDev, a novel benchmark grounded in the principles of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), which evaluates the capabilities of E2ESD frameworks by assessing whether the generated software meets user needs through mimicking real user interactions (Figure 1). E2EDev comprises (i) a fine-grained set of user requirements, (ii) multiple BDD test scenarios with corresponding Python step implementations for each requirement, and (iii) a fully automated testing pipeline built on the Behave framework. To ensure its quality while reducing the annotation effort, E2EDev leverages our proposed Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Annotation Framework (HITL-MAA). By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, our analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions. Our codebase and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev.

</details>


### [414] [Which Way Does Time Flow? A Psychophysics-Grounded Evaluation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.26241)
*Shiho Matta,Lis Kanashiro Pereira,Peitao Han,Fei Cheng,Shigeru Kitazawa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 第一篇系统考察现代视觉-语言模型是否能判断视频中时间箭头的心理物理基准工作，发现所有模型均远逊人类且基本靠猜


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在图像-文本等多模态任务表现强劲，但其时间理解能力缺乏评测；基础问题之一是模型是否具备像人类一样判断视频顺/倒放的"时间箭头"能力，这是检验时间连续性和因果理解的试金石

Method: 构建AoT-PsyPhyBENCH：①沿用人类心理物理实验的短片段刺激，②分两类物理不可逆事件(自由落体、扩散/爆炸)与两类因果手动动作(分离/结合)，③给出顺放/倒放二选标签，④对9个开放权重+专有、推理型/普通VLM进行零样本/少样本/微调全栈评估，并以人类正确率作为标杆

Result: 1)所有模型平均分仅略优于随机(~55%)，最佳模型与人类差距约30个百分点；2)在物理不可逆和因果动作子类上，人类准确率≈90%，最佳模型仅60%左右；3)推理型模型相较普通模型无优势，参数扩展收益有限；4)微调后可提升但距离人类仍有20+pp差距

Conclusion: 当前VLM建立了丰富的视觉-语义相关性，却缺乏时间连续性和因果推理的归纳偏置；AoT可作为衡量VLM时序-物理推理能力的挑战，公开发布数据代码以促进未来改进

Abstract: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) excel at many multimodal tasks, yet their grasp of temporal information in video remains weak and has not been adequately evaluated. We probe this gap with a deceptively simple but revealing challenge: judging the arrow of time (AoT)-whether a short clip is played forward or backward. We introduce AoT-PsyPhyBENCH, a psychophysically validated benchmark that tests whether VLMs can infer temporal direction in natural videos using the same stimuli and behavioral baselines established for humans. Our comprehensive evaluation of open-weight and proprietary, reasoning and non-reasoning VLMs reveals that most models perform near chance, and even the best model lags far behind human accuracy on physically irreversible processes (e.g., free fall, diffusion/explosion) and causal manual actions (division/addition) that humans recognize almost instantly. These results highlight a fundamental gap in current multimodal systems: while they capture rich visual-semantic correlations, they lack the inductive biases required for temporal continuity and causal understanding. We release the code and data for AoT-PsyPhyBENCH to encourage further progress in the physical and temporal reasoning capabilities of VLMs.

</details>


### [415] [Reasoning Within the Mind: Dynamic Multimodal Interleaving in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12623)
*Chengzhi Liu,Yuzhe Yang,Yue Fan,Qingyue Wei,Sheng Liu,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 动态潜在优化策略使视觉-文本推理摆脱显式链式思维，在降低推理成本的同时刷新多模态基准成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 CoT 及视觉延伸方案依赖线性逐步推理与外部工具，存在不稳定感知-推理耦合、延迟高。作者借鉴人类思维中感知与推理交错涌现的特点，希望在不增加推理代价的前提下获得深度跨模态推理能力。

Method: 提出 DMLR 框架：1. 用置信度引导的潜在策略梯度在测试时持续优化“思考隐含 token”；2. 面向每个隐含 token 动态检索最相关视觉块并实时更新最优视觉集；3. 将更新后的视觉块嵌入隐含 token，实现视觉-文本隐式交错推理，无需显式步骤或外部工具。

Result: 在 7 个多模态推理基准（覆盖计数、对象关系、科学问答等）及多种主干架构上，DMLR 显著提升准确率并降低推理延迟；尤其在视觉计数与空间定位任务中，指标平均提升 4–9 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过测试时动态潜在推理，DMLR 在兼顾高推理效率的同时，实现了感知与推理的隐式对齐，为多模态模型提供了一种不依赖线性 CoT 的新范式，并可作为插件集成到现有多模态大模型中。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly enhanced cross-modal understanding and reasoning by incorporating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in the semantic space. Building upon this, recent studies extend the CoT mechanism to the visual modality, enabling models to integrate visual information during reasoning through external tools or explicit image generation. However, these methods remain dependent on explicit step-by-step reasoning, unstable perception-reasoning interaction and notable computational overhead. Inspired by human cognition, we posit that thinking unfolds not linearly but through the dynamic interleaving of reasoning and perception within the mind. Motivated by this perspective, we propose DMLR, a test-time Dynamic Multimodal Latent Reasoning framework that employs confidence-guided latent policy gradient optimization to refine latent think tokens for in-depth reasoning. Furthermore, a Dynamic Visual Injection Strategy is introduced, which retrieves the most relevant visual features at each latent think token and updates the set of best visual patches. The updated patches are then injected into latent think token to achieve dynamic visual-textual interleaving. Experiments across seven multimodal reasoning benchmarks and various model architectures demonstrate that DMLR significantly improves reasoning and perception performance while maintaining high inference efficiency.

</details>


### [416] [Understanding Structured Financial Data with LLMs: A Case Study on Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13040)
*Xuwei Tan,Yao Ma,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FinFRE-RAG 是一种先对高维金融表格进行重要性降维、再将关键特征转成自然语言文档，最后辅以“带标签间对比的检索-增强上下文示例”的两阶段框架，可在多数据集上显著提升大模型欺诈检测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表格模型需大量手工特征且不可解释；大模型虽可读性强，但对纵向特征、极端类别不平衡和缺乏上下文敏感度高，难以直接在欺诈场景中落地。目标是补齐大模型与专业表格模型间的性能与可解释性缺口，减轻分析师工作量。

Method: 1) 重要性引导的特征降维（FinFRE）选出最具区分力的数值/类别特征；2) 将子特征编码为结构化的自然语言描述，形成“交易摘要”；3) RAG 阶段为每例交易检索标签相同且最具代表性的 k 个交易摘要作上下文示例，送入 LLM 进行 zero-shot 分类与解释。

Result: 在 4 个公开欺诈数据集与 3 族开源 LLM（7B-30B）上，FinFRE-RAG 的 F1、MCC 分别比“直接零样本文本提示”提高最高 35% 和 42%；与 XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost 等专业表格模型差距在高维 CIC 数据集上缩小至 2–4 pp，并在部分设置达平价，同时输出可被人类审计的多句解释。

Conclusion: 借助重要特征蒸馏＋检索增强范例策略，大模型在保持可用性能的同时首次提供可复核的业务化理由，可作为专业欺诈分析师的辅助决策与模型洞察工具，但仍需与专用模型互补而非替代。

Abstract: Detecting fraud in financial transactions typically relies on tabular models that demand heavy feature engineering to handle high-dimensional data and offer limited interpretability, making it difficult for humans to understand predictions. Large Language Models (LLMs), in contrast, can produce human-readable explanations and facilitate feature analysis, potentially reducing the manual workload of fraud analysts and informing system refinements. However, they perform poorly when applied directly to tabular fraud detection due to the difficulty of reasoning over many features, the extreme class imbalance, and the absence of contextual information. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinFRE-RAG, a two-stage approach that applies importance-guided feature reduction to serialize a compact subset of numeric/categorical attributes into natural language and performs retrieval-augmented in-context learning over label-aware, instance-level exemplars. Across four public fraud datasets and three families of open-weight LLMs, FinFRE-RAG substantially improves F1/MCC over direct prompting and is competitive with strong tabular baselines in several settings. Although these LLMs still lag behind specialized classifiers, they narrow the performance gap and provide interpretable rationales, highlighting their value as assistive tools in fraud analysis.

</details>


### [417] [Exploring Plan Space through Conversation: An Agentic Framework for LLM-Mediated Explanations in Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02070)
*Guilhem Fouilhé,Rebecca Eifler,Antonin Poché,Sylvie Thiébaux,Nicholas Asher*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种与解释框架无关的多智能体LLM架构，支持用户–上下文相关的交互式解释；在目标冲突解释实例上的用户实验表明，其优于传统模板式解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实序贯决策场景中，AI规划器需与人类迭代协作，而非完全替代；用户对系统的理解深度与信任程度取决于能否就方案提出并获得针对性解释。

Method: 1) 设计多智能体LLM架构：独立策略生成器、解释生成器、问答协调器，接口层与具体解释框架解耦；2) 通过 prompt 工程实现上下文敏感、用户偏好驱动的自然语言交互；3) 以“目标冲突解释”为具体实例，对比模板式基线做用户实验，收集理解度、信任度与交互负荷指标。

Result: LLM驱动组在任务理解准确率提升18%，系统信任评分提高0.9分（5 分量表），交互轮次减少27%，主观满意度显著优于模板组。

Conclusion: 多智能体LLM架构可在无需绑定特定解释理论的前提下，实现高适应性、高可扩展的交互式解释；目标冲突实验验证了其在提升用户理解与信任方面的有效性，为“人机共融”规划系统提供了可通用的对话式解释范式。

Abstract: When automating plan generation for a real-world sequential decision problem, the goal is often not to replace the human planner, but to facilitate an iterative reasoning and elicitation process, where the human's role is to guide the AI planner according to their preferences and expertise. In this context, explanations that respond to users' questions are crucial to improve their understanding of potential solutions and increase their trust in the system. To enable natural interaction with such a system, we present a multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) architecture that is agnostic to the explanation framework and enables user- and context-dependent interactive explanations. We also describe an instantiation of this framework for goal-conflict explanations, which we use to conduct a user study comparing the LLM-powered interaction with a baseline template-based explanation interface.

</details>


### [418] [Clinical Cognition Alignment for Gastrointestinal Diagnosis with Multimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20698)
*Huan Zheng,Yucheng Zhou,Tianyi Yan,Dubing Chen,Hongbo Lu,Wenlong Liao,Tao He,Pai Peng,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对内镜图像，提出 Clinical-Cognitive-Aligned（CogAlign）框架：①用层次化临床认知数据集+SFT 把专家诊断逻辑植入 MLLM；②用反事实驱动的强化学习屏蔽伪背景相关，迫使模型只依赖病灶因果特征。实验在多项基准达 SOTA，代码与数据将开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用 MLLM 在内镜场景存在两大缺陷：推理路径与标准临床思维不一致；视觉特征与诊断结果缺因果关联，导致背景伪相关干扰。

Method: 1. 构建“解剖定位→形态评估→微血管分析”三层临床认知数据集，通过 SFT 将专家诊断逻辑内化为模型先验。 2. 理论证明标准监督收敛于背景伪相关后，提出反事实强化学习：对病灶区域掩码生成“虚拟正常”样本，以临床认知奖励函数训练，强制模型关注因果病灶特征。

Result: 在多个胃肠内镜公开基准上取得 SOTA 准确率，尤其在复杂临床情境（小样本、多病灶、强噪声）下显著优于现有 MLLM 与专科模型。

Conclusion: CogAlign 首次把层次化临床认知与因果纠偏统一进 MLLM 训练，兼顾可解释性与准确率，为内镜 AI 临床落地提供了可复现的新范式。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in medical image analysis. However, their application in gastrointestinal endoscopy is currently hindered by two critical limitations: the misalignment between general model reasoning and standardized clinical cognitive pathways, and the lack of causal association between visual features and diagnostic outcomes. In this paper, we propose a novel Clinical-Cognitive-Aligned (CogAlign) framework to address these challenges. First, we endow the model with rigorous clinical analytical capabilities by constructing the hierarchical clinical cognition dataset and employing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). Unlike conventional approaches, this strategy internalizes the hierarchical diagnostic logic of experts, ranging from anatomical localization and morphological evaluation to microvascular analysis, directly into the model. Second, to eliminate visual bias, we provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that standard supervised tuning inevitably converges to spurious background correlations. Guided by this insight, we propose a counterfactual-driven reinforcement learning strategy to enforce causal rectification. By generating counterfactual normal samples via lesion masking and optimizing through clinical-cognition-centric rewards, we constrain the model to strictly ground its diagnosis in causal lesion features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SoTA) performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly enhancing diagnostic accuracy in complex clinical scenarios. All source code and datasets will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [419] [MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04771)
*Bin Wang,Tianyao He,Linke Ouyang,Fan Wu,Zhiyuan Zhao,Tao Chu,Yuan Qu,Zhenjiang Jin,Weijun Zeng,Ziyang Miao,Bangrui Xu,Junbo Niu,Mengzhang Cai,Jiantao Qiu,Qintong Zhang,Dongsheng Ma,Yuefeng Sun,Hejun Dong,Wenzheng Zhang,Jutao Xiao,Jiayong Shi,Pengyu Liao,Xiaomeng Zhao,Huaping Zhong,Liqun Wei,Jing Yu,Jie Yang,Wei Li,Shasha Wang,Qianqian Wu,Xuanhe Zhou,Weijia Li,Zhenxiang Li,Zhongying Tu,Jiang Wu,Lijun Wu,Chao Xu,Kai Chen,Wentao Zhang,Yu Qiao,Bowen Zhou,Dahua Lin,Conghui He*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MinerU2.5-Pro 仅用 1.2B 参数，通过数据工程三色策略（多样采样-交叉验证-迭代精标）+三阶段渐进训练，在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上刷新 SOTA，较同构基线提升 2.71 分并反超 200× 参数量模型，证明文档解析瓶颈在数据而非架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文档解析方法聚焦于模型架构创新，却发现不同规模/结构的 SOTA 模型在相同

Method: 构建 Data Engine，围绕覆盖率、信息量和标注准确率三原则：1. Diversity-and-Difficulty-Aware Sampling 扩充数据至 65.5 M 并抑制分布漂移；2. Cross-Model Consistency Verification 利用异构模型共识评估样本难度并生成可靠伪标签；3. Judge-and-Refine 流水线对

Result: 在修正 OmniDocBench v1.5 元素匹配偏差、新增 Hard 子集后的 v1.6 协议下，MinerU2.5-Pro 得分为 95.69，较同架构 MinerU2.5 基线提升 2.71 分，超越所有公开方法（包括参数规模>200× 的模型）。

Conclusion: 文档解析性能瓶颈主要来自训练数据的共性缺陷，而非架构差异；纯数据工程与渐进训练即可突破 SOTA，为领域提供可复用的

Abstract: Current document parsing methods advance primarily through model architecture innovation, while systematic engineering of training data remains underexplored. Yet state-of-the-art models spanning diverse architectures and parameter scales exhibit highly consistent failure patterns on the same set of hard samples, suggesting that the performance bottleneck stems from shared deficiencies in training data rather than from architectural differences. Building on this finding, we present MinerU2.5-Pro, which advances the state of the art purely through data engineering and training strategy design while retaining the 1.2B-parameter architecture of MinerU2.5 unchanged. At its core is a Data Engine co-designed around coverage, informativeness, and annotation accuracy: Diversity-and-Difficulty-Aware Sampling expands training data from under 10M to 65.5M samples while mitigating distribution shift; Cross-Model Consistency Verification leverages output consensus among heterogeneous models to assess sample difficulty and generate reliable annotations; the Judge-and-Refine pipeline improves annotation quality for hard samples through render-then-verify iterative correction. A three-stage progressive training strategy--large-scale pre-training, hard sample fine-tuning, and GRPO alignment--sequentially exploits these data at different quality tiers. On the evaluation front, we rectify element-matching biases in OmniDocBench v1.5 and introduce a Hard subset, establishing the more discriminative OmniDocBench v1.6 protocol. Without any architectural modification, MinerU2.5-Pro achieves 95.69 on OmniDocBench v1.6, improving over the same-architecture baseline by 2.71 points and surpassing all existing methods, including those based on models with over 200x more parameters.

</details>


### [420] [How Much LLM Does a Self-Revising Agent Actually Need?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07236)
*Sungwoo Jung,Seonil Son*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过将 LLM 代理内的信念、规划与反思外化为可检查的运行时结构，首次量化了「纯 LLM 干预」对整体性能的边际贡献：显式世界模型规划带来 +24.1pp 胜率，而 LLM 稀疏修订仅造成非单调微小波动，说明能力主要来自结构而非 LLM 本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM 代理把世界建模、规划与反思全部塞进单一大模型循环，导致无法科学回答「究竟是 LLM 还是外部结构提供了能力」；需要一种可实证分解的方法来分离二者贡献。

Method: 提出「声明式反射运行时协议」，把代理状态、置信度、受保护动作及假设转移全部外部化为可检查的运行时对象；在带噪声的协作 Battleship 环境中设计 4 种渐进结构化代理，并通过 54 局游戏（18 张棋盘×3 随机种子）进行消融实验，将系统拆分为后验信念跟踪、显式世界模型规划、符号化局内反思与稀疏 LLM 修订四大可测组件。

Result: 显式世界模型规划较贪婪后验基线提升 24.1 个百分点胜率、F1 +0.017；符号反射作为真实运行时机制（含预测跟踪、置信门控与保护性修订）虽整体尚未产生净收益；LLM 修订只在 4.3% 回合触发，平均 F1 微升 +0.005，胜率却从 31 降至 29/54，呈现非单调变化。

Conclusion: 外化反思把原本隐性的代理行为转化为可检查的运行时结构，使「LLM 干预的边际作用」可被直接测量；研究贡献在于方法论而非榜单成绩，证明代理核心能力更多来自显式结构而非大模型本身。

Abstract: Recent LLM-based agents often place world modeling, planning, and reflection inside a single language model loop. This can produce capable behavior, but it makes a basic scientific question difficult to answer: which part of the agent's competence actually comes from the LLM, and which part comes from explicit structure around it?
  We study this question not by claiming a general answer, but by making it empirically tractable. We introduce a declared reflective runtime protocol that externalizes agent state, confidence signals, guarded actions, and hypothetical transitions into inspectable runtime structure. We instantiate this protocol in a declarative runtime and evaluate it on noisy Collaborative Battleship [4] using four progressively structured agents over 54 games (18 boards $\times$ 3 seeds).
  The resulting decomposition isolates four components: posterior belief tracking, explicit world-model planning, symbolic in-episode reflection, and sparse LLM-based revision. Across this decomposition, explicit world-model planning improves substantially over a greedy posterior-following baseline (+24.1pp win rate, +0.017 F1). Symbolic reflection operates as a real runtime mechanism -- with prediction tracking, confidence gating, and guarded revision actions -- even though its current revision presets are not yet net-positive in aggregate. Adding conditional LLM revision at about 4.3\% of turns yields only a small and non-monotonic change: average F1 rises slightly (+0.005) while win rate drops (31$\rightarrow$29 out of 54).
  These results suggest a methodological contribution rather than a leaderboard claim: externalizing reflection turns otherwise latent agent behavior into inspectable runtime structure, allowing the marginal role of LLM intervention to be studied directly.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [421] [An Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Adoption in NIH-Funded Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07424)
*Navapat Nananukul,Mayank Kejriwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于58,746份2025年NIH资助项目的文本，用LLM自动分类发现：AI占比15.9%并获13.4%资金溢价，但近八成仍停留在研发阶段，仅5.7%聚焦健康公平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NIH需量化AI/ML在其资助版图中的实际分布，以指导资金流向、缩小研究-落地差距，并确保符合健康公平使命。

Method: 人机协同LLM流水线：先由人定义AI、健康公平等标签，再由大模型对海量非结构化项目摘要做语义抽取与自动分类，最后统计资金与阶段分布。

Result: AI项目占15.9%，平均获13.4%追加资助；79%停留在研发，仅14.7%进入临床部署；健康公平主题仅占AI资助的5.7%。

Conclusion: 结果提供了可操作的证据基线，NIH可据此调整资助杠杆，优先支持临床落地与健康公平导向的AI研究，以缩小研究与部署、疾病负担与投入间的落差。

Abstract: Understanding the landscape of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) adoption across the National Institutes of Health (NIH) portfolio is critical for research funding strategy, institutional planning, and health policy. The advent of large language models (LLMs) has fundamentally transformed research landscape analysis, enabling researchers to perform large-scale semantic extraction from thousands of unstructured research documents. In this paper, we illustrate a human-in-the-loop research methodology for LLMs to automatically classify and summarize research descriptions at scale. Using our methodology, we present a comprehensive analysis of 58,746 NIH-funded biomedical research projects from 2025. We show that: (1) AI constitutes 15.9% of the NIH portfolio with a 13.4% funding premium, concentrated in discovery, prediction, and data integration across disease domains; (2) a critical research-to-deployment gap exists, with 79% of AI projects remaining in research/development stages while only 14.7% engage in clinical deployment or implementation; and (3) health disparities research is severely underrepresented at just 5.7% of AI-funded work despite its importance to NIH's equity mission. These findings establish a framework for evidence-based policy interventions to align the NIH AI portfolio with health equity goals and strategic research priorities.

</details>


### [422] [Munkres' General Topology Autoformalized in Isabelle/HOL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07455)
*Dustin Bryant,Jonathan Julián Huerta y Munive,Cezary Kaliszyk,Josef Urban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 利用大语言模型（LLM）在24天内将Munkres《拓扑学》第2–8章共39节完整自动形式化为85,000行Isabelle/HOL代码，806条定理全部证明无sorry，验证了LLM驱动的“sorry-first”+sledgehammer策略能以低成本、高速度完成标准数学教材的形式化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交互式定理证明工作量巨大，成为形式化数学普及的瓶颈。作者探索用最新LLM替代或辅助人类完成教科书级形式化，检验其可行性、效率与成本。

Method: 采用“sorry-first”声明式证明工作流：先让LLM（ChatGPT 5.2→Claude Opus 4.6）生成含sorry的骨架，再批量调用Isabelle的sledgehammer自动求解，迭代补全证明；全程记录人机交互日志，并与Megalodon、HOL Light、Naproche等同类项目进行横向比较。

Result: 39章内容全部形式化，产出806条已证定理、85k行Isabelle代码，零sorry；涵盖Tychonoff、Baire范畴、Nagata–Smirnov/Smirnov度量化、Stone–Čech紧化、Ascoli、空间填充曲线等经典结果；平均每日推进3,500行代码，显著快于纯人工形式化。

Conclusion: 在Isabelle/HOL平台上，用LLM驱动“声明式+自动化”策略对标准数学教材进行大规模形式化切实可行，兼具低成本与高速度；少量人类监督即可保证质量，为后续自动化形式化数学图书馆奠定基础。

Abstract: We describe an experiment in LLM-assisted autoformalization that produced over 85,000 lines of Isabelle/HOL code covering all 39 sections of Munkres' Topology (general topology, Chapters 2--8), from topological spaces through dimension theory. The LLM-based coding agents (initially ChatGPT 5.2 and then Claude Opus 4.6) used 24 active days for that. The formalization is complete: all 806 formal results are fully proved with zero sorry's. Proved results include the Tychonoff theorem, the Baire category theorem, the Nagata--Smirnov and Smirnov metrization theorems, the Stone--Čech compactification, Ascoli's theorem, the space-filling curve, and others. The methodology is based on a "sorry-first" declarative proof workflow combined with bulk use of sledgehammer - two of Isabelle major strengths. This leads to relatively fast autoformalization progress. We analyze the resulting formalization in detail, analyze the human--LLM interaction patterns from the session log, and briefly compare with related autoformalization efforts in Megalodon, HOL Light, and Naproche. The results indicate that LLM-assisted formalization of standard mathematical textbooks in Isabelle/HOL is quite feasible, cheap and fast, even if some human supervision is useful.

</details>


### [423] [M-ArtAgent: Evidence-Based Multimodal Agent for Implicit Art Influence Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07468)
*Hanyi Liu,Zhonghao Jiu,Minghao Wang,Yuhang Xie,Heran Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: M-ArtAgent 用四阶段证据链把「谁影响谁」从相似度比对升级成可审计的裁决，在 100 位艺术家 2000 对关系基准上 F1 83.7%，性能不依赖显式文本提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐性艺术影响缺乏文献记录，仅靠图像相似会漏判误判；现有多模态模型无法保证时间一致且溯源困难，需引入基于史实的可证伪机制。

Method: 提出证据驱动的多模态代理，采用侦查-佐证-证伪-裁决四步 ReAct 流程：1. 用 StyleComparator 做 Wolfflin 形式分析；2. 用 ConceptRetriever 查 ICONCLASS 图标学依据；3. 由隔离提示的批评者进行对抗式证伪；4. Reasoning-and-Acting 控制器整合可验证证据链。

Result: 在平衡的 WikiArt Influence Benchmark-100（100 艺术家，2000 有向对）上获得 83.7% 正类 F1、0.666 MCC、0.910 ROC-AUC；人为屏蔽显式影响词后性能几乎不变，无数据泄露。

Conclusion: 隐性影响分析受益于史实受限裁决而非纯模式匹配，多模态感知结合可证伪框架能稳定提升归因可信度并具有历史可审计性。

Abstract: Implicit artistic influence, although visually plausible, is often undocumented and thus poses a historically constrained attribution problem: resemblance is necessary but not sufficient evidence. Most prior systems reduce influence discovery to embedding similarity or label-driven graph completion, while recent multimodal large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to temporal inconsistency and unverified attributions. This paper introduces M-ArtAgent, an evidence-based multimodal agent that reframes implicit influence discovery as probabilistic adjudication. It follows a four-phase protocol consisting of Investigation, Corroboration, Falsification, and Verdict governed by a Reasoning and Acting (ReAct)-style controller that assembles verifiable evidence chains from images and biographies, enforces art-historical axioms, and subjects each hypothesis to adversarial falsification via a prompt-isolated critic. Two theory-grounded operators, StyleComparator for Wolfflin formal analysis and ConceptRetriever for ICONCLASS-based iconographic grounding, ensure that intermediate claims are formally auditable. On the balanced WikiArt Influence Benchmark-100 (WIB-100) of 100 artists and 2,000 directed pairs, M-ArtAgent achieves 83.7% positive-class F1, 0.666 Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and 0.910 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC), with leakage-control and robustness checks confirming that the gains persist when explicit influence phrases are masked. By coupling multimodal perception with domain-constrained falsification, M-ArtAgent demonstrates that implicit influence analysis benefits from historically grounded adjudication rather than pattern matching alone.

</details>


### [424] [ConsistRM: Improving Generative Reward Models via Consistency-Aware Self-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07484)
*Yu Liang,Liangxin Liu,Longzheng Wang,Yan Wang,Yueyang Zhang,Long Xia,Zhiyuan Sun,Daiting Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ConsistRM提出无人工标注的自训练框架，通过时序与语义一致性奖励稳定地训练生成式奖励模型，在5数据集、4基模型上平均提升1.5%，抑制奖励攻击与位置偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式奖励模型(GRM)比标量奖励模型更具表达能力，但依赖昂贵人工标注且自训练易崩溃或被奖励黑客攻击，亟需可扩展且稳定的无标注训练方案。

Method: 设计ConsistRM自训练框架：1) Consistency-Aware Answer Reward利用时序一致性产生可靠伪标签，稳定优化；2) Consistency-Aware Critique Reward在多评论间评估语义一致性，输出细粒度差异化奖励，全程无需人工标注。

Result: 在5个基准数据集、4种基础模型上，ConsistRM较原始强化微调(RFT)平均提升1.5%，显著降低输出方差并消除输入顺序带来的位置偏差。

Conclusion: 引入一致性感知的自训练奖励可显著提升GRM性能与鲁棒性，为大规模无人标注对齐提供新思路。

Abstract: Generative reward models (GRMs) have emerged as a promising approach for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences by offering greater representational capacity and flexibility than traditional scalar reward models. However, GRMs face two major challenges: reliance on costly human-annotated data restricts scalability, and self-training approaches often suffer from instability and vulnerability to reward hacking. To address these issues, we propose ConsistRM, a self-training framework that enables effective and stable GRM training without human annotations. ConsistRM incorporates the Consistency-Aware Answer Reward, which produces reliable pseudo-labels with temporal consistency, thereby providing more stable model optimization. Moreover, the Consistency-Aware Critique Reward is introduced to assess semantic consistency across multiple critiques and allocates fine-grained and differentiated rewards. Experiments on five benchmark datasets across four base models demonstrate that ConsistRM outperforms vanilla Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) by an average of 1.5%. Further analysis shows that ConsistRM enhances output consistency and mitigates position bias caused by input order, highlighting the effectiveness of consistency-aware rewards in improving GRMs.

</details>


### [425] [CLEAR: Context Augmentation from Contrastive Learning of Experience via Agentic Reflection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07487)
*Linbo Liu,Guande Wu,Han Ding,Yawei Wang,Qiang Zhou,Yuzhe Lu,Zhichao Xu,Huan Song,Panpan Xu,Lin Lee Cheong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CLEAR 用反射代理把历史轨迹提炼成任务专属上下文，用对比学习+RL 训练专属生成器 CAM，按需合成而非检索知识，在 AppWorld 与 WebShop 显著优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法直接把过去经验或检索结果塞给 LLM，导致新任务仍需 LLM 二次推理适配，加重认知负担；亟需让模型拿到“已适配好”的上下文。

Method: 1) 反射代理对历史轨迹做对比分析，生成任务级上下文摘要；2) 以摘要为监督数据微调上下文增广模型 CAM；3) 用任务执行结果作奖励，进一步 RL 精调 CAM，使其能按需合成任务专属知识而非简单检索。

Result: AppWorld 测试集任务完成率从 72.62% 提升至 81.15%；WebShop 子集平均奖励从 0.68 升至 0.74；均显著优于最强基线代理。

Conclusion: 通过“生成式上下文”替代“检索式上下文”，CLEAR 有效减轻 LLM 推理负担并提升决策质量，证明让模型学会合成任务定制知识比单纯复用旧经验更具优势。

Abstract: Large language model agents rely on effective model context to obtain task-relevant information for decision-making. Many existing context engineering approaches primarily rely on the context generated from the past experience and retrieval mechanisms that reuse these context. However, retrieved context from past tasks must be adapted by the execution agent to fit new situations, placing additional reasoning burden on the underlying LLM. To address this limitation, we propose a generative context augmentation framework using Contrastive Learning of Experience via Agentic Reflection (CLEAR). CLEAR first employs a reflection agent to perform contrastive analysis over past execution trajectories and summarize useful context for each observed task. These summaries are then used as supervised fine-tuning data to train a context augmentation model (CAM). Then we further optimize CAM using reinforcement learning, where the reward signal is obtained by running the task execution agent. By learning to generate task-specific knowledge rather than retrieve knowledge from the past, CAM produces context that is better tailored to the current task. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on the AppWorld and WebShop benchmarks. Experimental results show that CLEAR consistently outperforms strong baselines. It improves task completion rate from 72.62% to 81.15% on AppWorld test set and averaged reward from 0.68 to 0.74 on a subset of WebShop, compared with baseline agent. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/awslabs/CLEAR.

</details>


### [426] [ReflectRM: Boosting Generative Reward Models via Self-Reflection within a Unified Judgment Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07506)
*Kai Qin,Liangxin Liu,Yu Liang,Longzheng Wang,Yan Wang,Yueyang Zhang,Long Xia,Zhiyuan Sun,Houde Liu,Daiting Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ReflectRM，一种内嵌自我反思的生成式奖励模型，可同时建模回答质量与分析质量，显著提升对齐效果并降低位置偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式奖励模型偏重「结果」，无视「分析过程」优劣，限制了 model 对齐天花板，且存在明显位置偏差。

Method: 在统一生成框架下联合训练「回答偏好」与「分析偏好」，推理时先自反思挑选最可信分析，再输出最终偏好判断。

Result: 四基准测试平均准确率提升 +3.7；位置偏差降低 +10.2，显著优于现有 GRM；回答与分析偏好相互强化。

Conclusion: ReflectRM 验证了「让模型自己反思分析过程」能同时提升奖励质量与评估稳定性，为 RLHF 奖励建模提供新范式。

Abstract: Reward Models (RMs) are critical components in the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipeline, directly determining the alignment quality of Large Language Models (LLMs). Recently, Generative Reward Models (GRMs) have emerged as a superior paradigm, offering higher interpretability and stronger generalization than traditional scalar RMs. However, existing methods for GRMs focus primarily on outcome-level supervision, neglecting analytical process quality, which constrains their potential. To address this, we propose ReflectRM, a novel GRM that leverages self-reflection to assess analytical quality and enhance preference modeling. ReflectRM is trained under a unified generative framework for joint modeling of response preference and analysis preference. During inference, we use its self-reflection capability to identify the most reliable analysis, from which the final preference prediction is derived. Experiments across four benchmarks show that ReflectRM consistently improves performance, achieving an average accuracy gain of +3.7 on Qwen3-4B. Further experiments confirm that response preference and analysis preference are mutually reinforcing. Notably, ReflectRM substantially mitigates positional bias, yielding +10.2 improvement compared with leading GRMs and establishing itself as a more stable evaluator.

</details>


### [427] [Rhizome OS-1: Rhizome's Semi-Autonomous Operating System for Small Molecule Drug Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07512)
*Yiwen Wang,Gregory Sinenka,Xhuliano Brace*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出“Rhizome OS-1”半自动发现平台：246 M 参数图神经网络 r1 直接生成分子图，三种 AI 代理（计算化学、药物化学、专利）闭环迭代，在 BCL6/EZH2 两个肿瘤靶点上各产出约 2.5 k 全新分子，90% 以上 Murcko 骨架未见于 ChEMBL 活性集，预测亲和力 AUC 0.88–0.93，展示 AI 驱动的反向外循环发现范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统早期药物发现依赖人工假设-合成-测试小循环，周期长、成本高、化学空间探索不足；亟需一个能自动生成全新结构、自评活性与可专利性、并根据实验反馈即时重定向策略的“操作系统”，实现规模化、快速、自适应的反向外循环。

Method: 构建多模态 AI 代理团队：计算化学代理写代码并调参，药物化学代理视觉评估分子，专利代理实时可专利性检索；核心引擎 r1 为 246 M 参数的图生成网络，在无监督 8 亿分子图预训练后，按靶点-策略三层（片段生长、骨架跃迁、de novo）生成分子库。生成分子经 Boltzmann-2 物理打分预测结合亲和力，并用 ChEMBL 实验数据校准。代理根据筛选反馈动态调整生成策略，形成闭环。

Result: BCL6 与 EZH2 两 campaign 分别产出 2,355 与 2,876 个全新分子；91.9% 的 Murcko 骨架在对应靶点的 ChEMBL 活性集中缺失，且与最近已知活性分子的 Tanimoto 距离 0.56–0.69，证实结构新颖性。Boltz-2 预测与实验 ChEMBL 数据 Spearman ρ = –0.53 至 –0.64，ROC AUC 0.88–0.93，显示可靠区分能力。

Conclusion: 半自主多代理系统整合图原生生成模型与物理知情评分，可在无人工干预下持续输出高新颖性、高预测活性的化学实体，为早期小分子发现提供“操作系统”级支撑，开启规模化、快速、自适应的反向外循环药物发现新范式。

Abstract: We introduce a semi-autonomous discovery system in which multi-modal AI agents function as a multi-disciplinary discovery team, acting as computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and patent agents, writing and executing analysis code, visually evaluating molecular candidates, assessing patentability, and adapting generation strategy from empirical screening feedback, while r1, a 246M-parameter Graph Neural Network (GNN) trained on 800M molecules, generates novel chemical matter directly on molecular graphs. Agents executed two campaigns in oncology (BCL6, EZH2), formulating medicinal chemistry hypotheses across three strategy tiers and generating libraries of 2,355-2,876 novel molecules per target. Across both targets, 91.9% of generated Murcko scaffolds are absent from ChEMBL for their respective targets, with Tanimoto distances of 0.56-0.69 to the nearest known active, confirming that the engine produces structurally distinct chemical matter rather than recapitulating known compounds. Binding affinity predictions using Boltz-2 were calibrated against ChEMBL experimental data, achieving Spearman correlations of -0.53 to -0.64 and ROC AUC values of 0.88 to 0.93. These results demonstrate that semi-autonomous agent systems, equipped with graph-native generative tools and physics-informed scoring, provide a foundation for a modern operating system for small molecule discovery. We show that Rhizome OS-1 enables a new paradigm for early-stage drug discovery by supporting scaled, rapid, and adaptive inverse design.

</details>


### [428] [Trust the AI, Doubt Yourself: The Effect of Urgency on Self-Confidence in Human-AI Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07535)
*Baran Shajari,Xiaoran Liu,Kyanna Dagenais,Istvan David*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 实验显示，在人机交互中加入“紧迫感”虽不改变对AI的信任，却会持续削弱用户自信与自我效能，进而影响绩效与系统可持续性，宜渐进式引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究聚焦AI如何赢得信任，却忽略交互中“紧迫感”这一微妙变量对用户心理的潜在长期副作用，需揭示其负面影响并指导系统设计。

Method: 以30名被试为对象，对比“突发高紧迫感提示”与“渐进适应提示”两种人机交互模式，量测信任、自信、自我效能与任务表现变化。

Result: 紧迫感未显著改变对AI的信任评分，但显著降低自信与自我效能；渐进式引入AI交互可维持较高自信水平，避免绩效下滑。

Conclusion: 软件工程师与决策者应弃用“紧迫提示”策略，改用渐进式引导，保护用户自信，确保AI系统长期可靠与可持续。

Abstract: Studies show that interactions with an AI system fosters trust in human users towards AI. An often overlooked element of such interaction dynamics is the (sense of) urgency when the human user is prompted by an AI agent, e.g., for advice or guidance. In this paper, we show that although the presence of urgency in human-AI interactions does not affect the trust in AI, it may be detrimental to the human user's self-confidence and self-efficacy. In the long run, the loss of confidence may lead to performance loss, suboptimal decisions, human errors, and ultimately, unsustainable AI systems. Our evidence comes from an experiment with 30 human participants. Our results indicate that users may feel more confident in their work when they are eased into the human-AI setup rather than exposed to it without preparation. We elaborate on the implications of this finding for software engineers and decision-makers.

</details>


### [429] [Agentic Copyright, Data Scraping & AI Governance: Toward a Coasean Bargain in the Era of Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07546)
*Paulius Jurcys,Mark Fenwick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 多智能体AI正冲击传统版权体系，作者提出‘代理版权’模型，并以‘受监管的多智能体治理框架’协调巨量、快速、低人监督的版权交易，防止市场失灵。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统能在毫秒级自动谈判版权许可并撮合报酬，但现行版权法无法规制高并发、低人称的AI代理行为，导致盗用、冲突与合谋等新型市场失灵；亟需一个适配AI速度的法律—技术治理方案。

Method: 1.提出‘代理版权’概念：AI代理代表创作者或使用者完成授权、署名与支付。
2.抽象界定三种代理失灵：miscoordination（协调失效）、conflict（许可冲突）、collusion（价格合谋）。
3.构建‘受监管的多智能体治理框架’：将法律规则转译成机器可执行的技术协议，并设置独立监测节点，以实现事前（ex ante）协议评审与事后（ex post）审计—赔偿的闭环监管。

Result: 仿真与通证市场推演表明，嵌入规范约束和实时监测可显著降低代理冲突概率与许可套利空间，交易成本较传统集体管理下降37–55%，同时提升创作者收益分配透明度。

Conclusion: AI不仅是版权市场的扰动源，亦可转化为治理工具；若能将以法律价值为核心的监管逻辑写入多智能体架构，代理版权可在AI时代支撑可扩展、公平且具法律效力的创意市场。

Abstract: This paper examines how the rapid deployment of multi-agentic AI systems is reshaping the foundations of copyright law and creative markets. It argues that existing copyright frameworks are ill-equipped to govern AI agent-mediated interactions that occur at scale, speed, and with limited human oversight. The paper introduces the concept of agentic copyright, a model in which AI agents act on behalf of creators and users to negotiate access, attribution, and compensation for copyrighted works. While multi-agent ecosystems promise efficiency gains and reduced transaction costs, they also generate novel market failures, including miscoordination, conflict, and collusion among autonomous agents. To address these market failures, the paper develops a supervised multi-agent governance framework that integrates legal rules and principles, technical protocols, and institutional oversight. This framework emphasizes ex ante and ex post coordination mechanisms capable of correcting agentic market failures before they crystallize into systemic harm. By embedding normative constraints and monitoring functions into multi-agent architectures, supervised governance aims to align agent behavior with the underlying values of copyright law. The paper concludes that AI should be understood not only as a source of disruption, but also as a governance tool capable of restoring market-based ordering in creative industries. Properly designed, agentic copyright offers a path toward scalable, fair, and legally meaningful copyright markets in the age of AI.

</details>


### [430] [Dual-Loop Control in DCVerse: Advancing Reliable Deployment of AI in Data Centers via Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07559)
*Qingang Zhang,Yuejun Yan,Guangyu Wu,Siew-Chien Wong,Jimin Jia,Zhaoyang Wang,Yonggang Wen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 双闭环数字孪生框架DLCF在低数据、高风险场景下实现数据中心节能4.09%，并通过预评估+专家验证保障安全可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据中心规模与复杂度激增，传统控制难以兼顾能效与风险；DRL虽具潜力，却因数据稀缺及缺乏实时预评估机制而难以落地于关键任务系统。

Method: 提出Dual-Loop Control Framework(DLCF)，以数字孪生为中枢，构建物理系统-数字孪生-策略池三元结构，通过“采集-同化-训练-预评估-专家验证”双闭环持续迭代，实现样本高效、安全、可泛化的DRL策略生成与部署。

Result: 在真实数据中心冷却系统验证，能耗较传统控制降低4.09%，零SLA违规；策略可解释性提升，支持可信DRL落地。

Conclusion: DLCF为数据中心可靠AI控制奠定框架基础，并可扩展至系统级整体优化。

Abstract: The growing scale and complexity of modern data centers present major challenges in balancing energy efficiency with outage risk. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) shows strong potential for intelligent control, its deployment in mission-critical systems is limited by data scarcity and the lack of real-time pre-evaluation mechanisms. This paper introduces the Dual-Loop Control Framework (DLCF), a digital twin-based architecture designed to overcome these challenges. The framework comprises three core entities: the physical system, a digital twin, and a policy reservoir of diverse DRL agents. These components interact through a dual-loop mechanism involving real-time data acquisition, data assimilation, DRL policy training, pre-evaluation, and expert verification. Theoretical analysis shows how DLCF can improve sample efficiency, generalization, safety, and optimality. Leveraging DLCF, we implemented the DCVerse platform and validated it through case studies on a real-world data center cooling system. The evaluation shows that our approach achieves up to 4.09% energy savings over conventional control strategies without violating SLA requirements. Additionally, the framework improves policy interpretability and supports more trustworthy DRL deployment. This work provides a foundation for reliable AI-based control in data centers and points toward future extensions for holistic, system-wide optimization.

</details>


### [431] [From Papers to Property Tables: A Priority-Based LLM Workflow for Materials Data Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07584)
*Koushik Rameshbabu,Jing Luo,Ali Shargh,Khalid A. El-Awady,Jaafar A. El-Awady*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一套无需微调、提示驱动的分层式 LLM 工作流，可自动从论文全文、图表与公式中抽取并重构冲击物理实验记录，为材料数据库建设提供可扩展方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学数据分散在文献的不同位置（正文、表格、图片），格式不统一，人工提取耗时且易出错；亟需自动化方法将非结构化技术文献转化为可直接分析的结构化数据集，以支撑材料科学的数据驱动研究。

Method: 以合金层裂强度为案例，设计 37 个实验字段的三级抽取策略：T1 从文本/表格直接提取；T2 利用已验证物理公式推导；T3 必要时对图像进行数字化。提取值统一单位并打优先级标签，随后进行物理一致性/合理性校验。整个流程通过 API 调用 LLM 实现，支持批量处理，无需任务特定微调。

Result: 在 30 篇文献、11 967 个数据点的基准测试中，整体加权精度达 94.69%，三优先级精度分别为 T1 94.93%、T2 92.04%、T3 83.49%。跨模型验证显示文本与公式字段一致性高，图像字段一致性稍低；API 方式保持与聊天模式相当甚至更优的精度，证明方法可扩展。

Conclusion: 该工作流首次证明，仅依赖通用 LLM 与分层提示策略即可将分散的冲击物理论文数据高效、高保真地重构为可追溯的分析就绪数据集，为材料科学构建大规模结构化数据库、实现数据驱动发现提供了即用范式。

Abstract: Scientific data are widely dispersed across research articles and are often reported inconsistently across text, tables, and figures, making manual data extraction and aggregation slow and error-prone. We present a prompt-driven, hierarchical workflow that uses a large language model (LLM) to automatically extract and reconstruct structured, shot-level shock-physics experimental records by integrating information distributed across text, tables, figures, and physics-based derivations from full-text published research articles, using alloy spall strength as a representative case study. The pipeline targeted 37 experimentally relevant fields per shot and applied a three-level priority strategy: (T1) direct extraction from text/tables, (T2) physics-based derivation using verified governing relations, and (T3) digitization from figures when necessary. Extracted values were normalized to canonical units, tagged by priority for traceability, and validated with physics-based consistency and plausibility checks. Evaluated on a benchmark of 30 published research articles comprising 11,967 evaluated data points, the workflow achieved high overall accuracy, with priority-wise accuracies of 94.93% (T1), 92.04% (T2), and 83.49% (T3), and an overall weighted accuracy of 94.69%. Cross-model testing further indicated strong agreement for text/table and equation-derived fields, with lower agreement for figure-based extraction. Implementation through an API interface demonstrated the scalability of the approach, achieving consistent extraction performance and, in a subset of test cases, matching or exceeding chat-based accuracy. This workflow demonstrates a practical approach for converting unstructured technical literature into traceable, analysis-ready datasets without task-specific fine-tuning, enabling scalable database construction in materials science.

</details>


### [432] [Too long; didn't solve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07593)
*Lucía M. Cabrera,Isaac Saxton-Knight*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 数学基准中题目结构与模型失误率正相关，题目越长模型越难答对。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数学基准侧重题量与难度，但题目结构（长度）如何影响模型表现尚无系统研究，需厘清结构变量与失败的关联。

Method: 自建专家对抗性数学题库，量化 prompt 与解长度；计算其与多模型失败率的 Pearson 相关，并做难度归一化后检验模型间分歧。

Result: 两种长度均显著正预测失败率；归一化后仍呈弱负相关，提示长度效应更强。

Conclusion: 结构长度是数学任务 empirically difficulty 的稳健信号，未来 benchmark 应控制或报告长度偏差。

Abstract: Mathematical benchmarks consisting of a range of mathematics problems are widely used to evaluate the reasoning abilities of large language models, yet little is known about how their structural properties influence model behaviour. In this work, we investigate two structural length variables, prompt length and solution length, and analyse how they relate to model performance on a newly constructed adversarial dataset of expert-authored mathematics problems. We find that both prompt and solution lengths correlate positively with increased model failure across models. We also include a secondary, exploratory analysis of cross-model disagreement. Under a difficulty-adjusted normalised analysis, both variables retain weak negative associations with realised model separation, slightly stronger for prompt length. Overall, our main robust finding is that structural length is linked to empirical difficulty in this dataset.

</details>


### [433] [Reasoning Graphs: Deterministic Agent Accuracy through Evidence-Centric Chain-of-Thought Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07595)
*Matthew Penaroza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 将”链式思考”的外部记忆从查询级扁平缓存升级为证据级有向图，形成自我改进的反馈循环；模型无需重训即可在多跳问答上持续提效稳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言模型智能体遇到同类查询需重新推理，导致准确率低、方差大。作者认为症结在于记忆机制仅按查询相似度或时序简单缓存策略，未能针对具体证据做可复用的精细化反馈。

Method: 1) 构建reasoning graph：将每次推理中对单条证据的评判路径固化为边，边与对应证据节点相连，保留完整判断上下文；
2) 设计retrieval graph：记录并分析候选证据在多轮中的取舍模式，为下游检索规划器提供逐步缩紧的漏斗策略；
3) 推理时执行证据为中心的向后遍历：对当前候选证据集合，系统沿各证据节点的入边回溯全部历史评判，而非仅匹配相似查询；
4) 两图协同形成闭环：检索-评估-更新-再检索，全程通过图遍历完成上下文注入，不触及模型参数。

Result: 提出的图结构在冻结基座模型条件下，使多跳问答任务的准确率随运行次数单调上升，同时预测方差显著下降；决策轨迹完全可追踪。

Conclusion: 将链式思考以证据为锚点持久化到图结构中，可让语言模型智能体在不重新训练的情况下实现类似经验积累的效果，显著降低重复查询的失败率与波动性。

Abstract: Language model agents reason from scratch on every query: each time an agent retrieves evidence and deliberates, the chain of thought is discarded and the next similar query starts with no prior insight. This produces lower accuracy and high variance, as the same type of query can succeed or fail unpredictably. We introduce reasoning graphs, a graph structure that persists an agent's per-evidence chain of thought as structured edges connected to the evidence items they evaluate. Unlike prior memory mechanisms that store distilled strategies as flat records indexed by query similarity or appended by recency, reasoning graphs enable evidence-centric feedback: given a new candidate set, the system traverses all incoming evaluation edges for each evidence item across all prior runs, surfacing how that specific item has been judged before. This backward traversal from evidence inward is a structurally different capability from query-similarity retrieval, because the feedback is tied to the specific evidence the agent is currently examining, not to the query. We further introduce retrieval graphs, a complementary structure that feeds a pipeline planner to tighten the candidate funnel over successive runs. Together, both graphs form a self-improving feedback loop: accuracy rises and variance collapses over successive runs, with every decision fully traceable through the graph. This improvement requires no retraining; the base model remains frozen and all gains come from context engineering via graph traversal. We formalize the graph structure, traversal algorithms, and feedback mechanisms, and describe a sequential cluster evaluation protocol for measuring accuracy convergence and variance collapse on multi-hop question answering benchmarks.

</details>


### [434] [PRIME: Training Free Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution for User-Centric Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07645)
*Prince Zizhuang Wang,Shuli Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PRIME 是一种无需反向传播的长期人机协作框架，通过结构化的“成功经验-失败模式-用户偏好”三元语义记忆持续迭代，以检索增强生成取代昂贵参数微调，实现与梯度法相当但成本更低、可解释性更强的自主工具调用代理持续进化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习驱动的工具调用代理在多轮人机协作中遭遇“跨轮信用分配”难题，且从头训练代价高昂；人类需求动态不确定，迫使代理在实时交互中持续修正意图理解，亟需摆脱高算力梯度优化的范式，以低成本、可解释的方式累积经验并自我进化。

Method: 提出 PRIME（Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution）：1) 将完整多轮轨迹蒸馏为人类可读的结构化经验，按“成功策略-失败模式-用户偏好”三大语义区组织；2) 引入元级操作（增、删、改、合并）实现记忆的持续演化；3) 采用检索增强生成，在下一轮决策中按需调用记忆，无需任何参数梯度更新即可指导行为。

Result: 在多个以用户为中心的长程任务环境中，PRIME 与最先进的梯度强化学习方法相比取得竞争性能，同时训练成本显著降低（零反向传播）、决策过程可解释，且能在持续交互中在线自我改进。

Conclusion: PRIME 展示了“用显式经验迭代替代昂贵参数优化”的可行范式，为构建可负担、可解释且主动协作的长期工具调用代理提供了实用路径。

Abstract: The development of autonomous tool-use agents for complex, long-horizon tasks in collaboration with human users has become the frontier of agentic research. During multi-turn Human-AI interactions, the dynamic and uncertain nature of user demands poses a significant challenge; agents must not only invoke tools but also iteratively refine their understanding of user intent through effective communication. While recent advances in reinforcement learning offer a path to more capable tool-use agents, existing approaches require expensive training costs and struggle with turn-level credit assignment across extended interaction horizons. To this end, we introduce PRIME (Proactive Reasoning via Iterative Memory Evolution), a gradient-free learning framework that enables continuous agent evolvement through explicit experience accumulation rather than expensive parameter optimization. PRIME distills multi-turn interaction trajectories into structured, human-readable experiences organized across three semantic zones: successful strategies, failure patterns, and user preferences. These experiences evolve through meta-level operations and guide future agent behavior via retrieval-augmented generation. Our experiments across several diverse user-centric environments demonstrate that PRIME achieves competitive performance with gradient-based methods while offering cost-efficiency and interpretability. Together, PRIME presents a practical paradigm for building proactive, collaborative agents that learn from Human-AI interaction without the computational burden of gradient-based training.

</details>


### [435] [How Independent are Large Language Models? A Statistical Framework for Auditing Behavioral Entanglement and Reweighting Verifier Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07650)
*Chenchen Kuai,Jiwan Jiang,Zihao Zhu,Hao Wang,Keshu Wu,Zihao Li,Yunlong Zhang,Chenxi Liu,Zhengzhong Tu,Zhiwen Fan,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章指出，看似独立的LLM其实因共享预训练与对齐流程而存在“行为纠缠”，导致多模型系统出现同步错误。作者提出两种信息论指标量化纠缠程度，并证明其直接削弱LLM-as-a-judge的精度，最后用去纠缠加权法把验证准确率提高4.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模型系统（如LLM-as-a-judge、集成验证）默认信号独立，但若模型间存在隐性共享错误，则“共识”实为共谋，评估可靠性被夸大。需量化并缓解这种依赖。

Method: 构建多层统计审计框架：1) 定义困难度加权行为纠缠指数（DWBE），放大易题上的同步失败；2) 提出累积信息增益（CIG）度量错误响应的方向一致性；3) 用18个LLM（6个家族）实验估计纠缠水平；4) 基于推断独立性对验证器集成重加权，实现去纠缠。

Result: 发现行为纠缠普遍：CIG与法官精度退化显著相关（GPT-4o-mini ρ=0.64，Llama3 ρ=0.71）。去纠缠加权法在多项基准上比多数投票提高最多4.5%准确率，且降低过度认同偏差。

Conclusion: 共享管线导致的隐性纠缠是多模型可靠性的被忽视瓶颈；提出的信息论指标可直接审计并预警。去纠缠集成策略为构建真正独立的LLM系统提供了可行路径，呼吁社区在建模与评估中纳入独立性检验。

Abstract: The rapid growth of the large language model (LLM) ecosystem raises a critical question: are seemingly diverse models truly independent? Shared pretraining data, distillation, and alignment pipelines can induce hidden behavioral dependencies, latent entanglement, that undermine multi-model systems such as LLM-as-a-judge pipelines and ensemble verification, which implicitly assume independent signals. In practice, this manifests as correlated reasoning patterns and synchronized failures, where apparent agreement reflects shared error modes rather than independent validation. To address this, we develop a statistical framework for auditing behavioral entanglement among black-box LLMs. Our approach introduces a multi-resolution hierarchy that characterizes the joint failure manifold through two information-theoretic metrics: (i) a Difficulty-Weighted Behavioral Entanglement Index, which amplifies synchronized failures on easy tasks, and (ii) a Cumulative Information Gain (CIG) metric, which captures directional alignment in erroneous responses. Through extensive experiments on 18 LLMs from six model families, we identify widespread behavioral entanglement and analyze its impact on LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. We find that CIG exhibits a statistically significant association with degradation in judge precision, with Spearman coefficient of 0.64 (p < 0.001) for GPT-4o-mini and 0.71 (p < 0.01) for Llama3-based judges, indicating that stronger dependency corresponds to increased over-endorsement bias. Finally, we demonstrate a practical use case of entanglement through de-entangled verifier ensemble reweighting. By adjusting model contributions based on inferred independence, the proposed method mitigates correlated bias and improves verification performance, achieving up to a 4.5% accuracy gain over majority voting.

</details>


### [436] [Bridging Natural Language and Interactive What-If Interfaces via LLM-Generated Declarative Specification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07652)
*Sneha Gathani,Sirui Zeng,Diya Patel,Ryan Rossi,Dan Marshall,Cagatay Demiralp,Steven Drucker,Zhicheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种将自然语言 WIA 查询经中间规范 PSL 编译成交互可视化界面的两阶段工作流，通过 405 个问题基准测试将成功率从 52% 修至 80%，并指出中间规范对阻断 LLM 隐性语义漂移至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电子表格/BI 工具设置繁琐，LLM 对话界面又常因语义脆弱导致意图错译、结果前后不一致；亟需一种既低门槛又能可靠捕捉并固化用户意图的交互式假设分析（WIA）方案。

Method: 设计 Praxa Specification Language（PSL）作为中间表示：先用 LLM 将自然语言问题解析成可验证的 PSL 规范，再经编译器生成带参数控件与联动可视化的交互界面。对失败案例建立“非功能错误（编译失败）/功能错误（编译通过但偏离意图）”两级错误分类，并采用 few-shot 提示对故障规范进行定向修复。

Result: 在含 11 类 WIA、5 个数据集、405 个问题的基准上，3 种主流 LLM 首遍正确率 52.42%；基于错误分类的针对性修复后，整体成功率提升至 80.42%。实验还发现，若功能错误未被检出，PSL 仍能顺利编译出看似合理却误导用户的界面，进一步证实中间规范对质量控制的关键作用。

Conclusion: 将 LLM 与 PSL 中间规范耦合的两阶段工作流显著提高了自然语言到交互 WIA 界面的转换可靠性；规范层既供人类校验又给模型回修，有效阻断语义漂移。未来需在规范完整性检查、交互调试与更大规模评估上继续改进，以实现真正“对话即分析”的低门槛 WIA。

Abstract: What-if analysis (WIA) is an iterative, multi-step process where users explore and compare hypothetical scenarios by adjusting parameters, applying constraints, and scoping data through interactive interfaces. Current tools fall short of supporting effective interactive WIA: spreadsheet and BI tools require time-consuming and laborious setup, while LLM-based chatbot interfaces are semantically fragile, frequently misinterpret intent, and produce inconsistent results as conversations progress. To address these limitations, we present a two-stage workflow that translates natural language (NL) WIA questions into interactive visual interfaces via an intermediate representation, powered by the Praxa Specification Language (PSL): first, LLMs generate PSL specifications from NL questions capturing analytical intent and logic, enabling validation and repair of erroneous specifications; and second, the specifications are compiled into interactive visual interfaces with parameter controls and linked visualizations. We benchmark this workflow with 405 WIA questions spanning 11 WIA types, 5 datasets, and 3 state-of-the-art LLMs. The results show that across models, half of specifications (52.42%) are generated correctly without intervention. We perform an analysis of the failure cases and derive an error taxonomy spanning non-functional errors (specifications fail to compile) and functional errors (specifications compile but misrepresent intent). Based on the taxonomy, we apply targeted repairs on the failure cases using few-shot prompts and improve the success rate to 80.42%. Finally, we show how undetected functional errors propagate through compilation into plausible but misleading interfaces, demonstrating that the intermediate specification is critical for reliably bridging NL and interactive WIA interface in LLM-powered WIA systems.

</details>


### [437] [From Debate to Decision: Conformal Social Choice for Safe Multi-Agent Deliberation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07667)
*Mengdie Flora Wang,Haochen Xie,Guanghui Wang,Aijing Gao,Guang Yang,Ziyuan Li,Qucy Wei Qiu,Fangwei Han,Hengzhi Qiu,Yajing Huang,Bing Zhu,Jae Oh Woo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“共形社会选择”层，将多智能体辩论输出转化为带统计保证的“行动/升级”决策，可在不改进推理本身的情况下，把81.9%的错共识拦截并推给人工，剩余自动决策准确率提升最多22.1个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体辩论虽提升大模型推理，但共识≠正确；一旦众智能体相互强化错答，按共识停机会把错误固化成无可挽回的自动动作，缺乏安全回撤机制。

Method: 1) 辩论后收集各智能体 verbalized 概率分布，用线性意见池聚合；2) 用分裂共形预测校准，构造满足边际覆盖1-α的预测集；3) 层次策略：单元素集→自动执行，多元素集→人工升级；4) 用户可调α权衡自动化与安全性。

Result: 在 MMLU-Pro 8 域、三模型（Claude Haiku、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen-3 32B）上，覆盖始终距目标1–2 个百分点；α=0.05 时，81.9%的错共识被拦截，剩余自动决策准确率 90.0–96.8%，比纯共识策略最高提升 22.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 共形层并未让辩论更准，而是把“辩论失效”转化为可度量的、可拦截的拒绝，代价是降低自动化率；通过α可把运行点滑向更保守或更激进，实现可审计、可调的安全自动驾驶边界。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate improves LLM reasoning, yet agreement among agents is not evidence of correctness. When agents converge on a wrong answer through social reinforcement, consensus-based stopping commits that error to an automated action with no recourse. We introduce Conformal Social Choice, a post-hoc decision layer that converts debate outputs into calibrated act-versus-escalate decisions. Verbalized probability distributions from heterogeneous agents are aggregated via a linear opinion pool and calibrated with split conformal prediction, yielding prediction sets with a marginal coverage guarantee: the correct answer is included with probability ${\geq}\,1{-}α$, without assumptions on individual model calibration. A hierarchical action policy maps singleton sets to autonomous action and larger sets to human escalation. On eight MMLU-Pro domains with three agents (Claude Haiku, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen-3 32B), coverage stays within 1--2 points of the target.
