In this regard, the knowledge distillation (KD) approach has emerged as a promising alternative, which transfers the rich visual and linguistic knowledge from a larger model (teacher) to a smaller model (student). However, we observe that existing KD methods struggle to effectively distill the teacher MLLM's rich visual perception abilities to the student, a challenge that has been largely overlooked in previous studies. Through a systematic analysis, we identify visual attention misalignment between student and teacher as the main cause of this issue. Based on this insight, we propose CompoDistill, a novel KD framework that explicitly aligns the student's visual attention with that of the teacher to enhance the student's visual perception abilities. Our extensive experiments show that CompoDistill significantly improves performance on compositional reasoning tasks that require visual perception abilities while maintaining strong performance on visual question answering tasks, as done in existing studies. Furthermore, CompoDistill demonstrates effectiveness with a more advanced backbone, highlighting its generalizability.

</details>


### [729] [When Personalization Tricks Detectors: The Feature-Inversion Trap in Machine-Generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.12476)
*Lang Gao,Xuhui Li,Chenxi Wang,Mingzhe Li,Wei Liu,Zirui Song,Jinghui Zhang,Rui Yan,Preslav Nakov,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个针对个性化机器文本检测的基准enchmark揭示了SOTA检测器在「风格模仿」场景下性能骤降的现象，提出「特征反转陷阱」假设，并用轻量级方法	ool预测检测器迁移性能，相关性达0.85。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型已能高度模仿个人写作风格，但现有检测器在「个性化文本」场景下的鲁棒性从未被系统评估；一旦检测失效，身份冒充与欺诈风险显著上升，亟需建立针对性基准与诊断工具。

Method: 1) 构建首个个性化检测基准enchmark：采集真人文学＋博客文本及其LLM高仿，形成成对数据。2) 提出「特征反转陷阱」概念：通用检测所依赖的判别特征在个性化文本中反向失效。3) 设计	ool：通过寻找潜空间中的反转方向→合成探针数据集→量化检测器对该方向的依赖，从而预测迁移后的性能变化幅度与方向。

Result: 在enchmark上，主流检测器（含SOTA）出现显著性能下降，部分模型F1下降>20个百分点；而	ool对「下降幅度」预测与实测值 Pearson r=0.85，方向预测准确率达85%。

Conclusion: 个性化设置会系统性暴露检测器的盲 spot；	ool提供无真实标签即可预估性能漂移的高效手段，为未来鲁棒个性化文本检测研究奠定基准与诊断范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have grown more powerful in language generation, producing fluent text and even imitating personal style. Yet, this ability also heightens the risk of identity impersonation. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has examined personalized machine-generated text (MGT) detection. In this paper, we introduce \dataset, the first benchmark for evaluating detector robustness in personalized settings, built from literary and blog texts paired with their LLM-generated imitations. Our experimental results demonstrate large performance gaps across detectors in personalized settings: some state-of-the-art models suffer significant drops. We attribute this limitation to the \textit{feature-inversion trap}, where features that are discriminative in general domains become inverted and misleading when applied to personalized text. Based on this finding, we propose \method, a simple and reliable way to predict detector performance changes in personalized settings. \method identifies latent directions corresponding to inverted features and constructs probe datasets that differ primarily along these features to evaluate detector dependence. Our experiments show that \method can accurately predict both the direction and the magnitude of post-transfer changes, showing 85\% correlation with the actual performance gaps. We hope that this work will encourage further research on personalized text detection.

</details>


### [730] [E2Edev: Benchmarking Large Language Models in End-to-End Software Development Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14509)
*Jingyao Liu,Chen Huang,Zhizhao Guan,Wenqiang Lei,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 以BDD行为规格把端到端软件开发需求细粒度化，用自动BDD测试+人机协同多代理标注，推出新的E2EDev基准并实测多款LLM屡败，凸显当前E2ESD仍远不成熟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有端到端软件开发（E2ESD）基准依赖粗粒度需求且评估指标可信度差，难以揭示现有框架真正的

Method: 1) Task 理解-需求分解：将自然语言需求拆解为细粒度用户故事，并提取可验证条件 → BDD Gherkin 规格；2) 自动化测试生成：针对每条 Gherkin 场景生成对应 Python-step 及整体测试用例，统一至 Behave 测试管道；3) 人机协同多代理标注框架（HITL-MAA）：动态调度 LLM 代理自动完成大部分高质量核算，仅引入真人少量高阶复核以保质量并降成本，快速构建基准数据集；4) 基准评测：对多模型及端到端框架在 E2EDev 上跑 Behave 自动测试，计算通过率和失败模式，揭示各系统瓶颈。

Result: E2EDev 显著提升了评测颗粒度与可靠性：Disclosed pass@k 整体不足 20%（各主流 LLM 及 E2ESD 框架普遍难达成

Conclusion: 实验结论表明，现有大模型在

Abstract: The rapid advancement in large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated significant potential in End-to-End Software Development (E2ESD). However, existing E2ESD benchmarks are limited by coarse-grained requirement specifications and unreliable evaluation protocols, hindering a true understanding of current framework capabilities. To address these limitations, we present E2EDev, a novel benchmark grounded in the principles of Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), which evaluates the capabilities of E2ESD frameworks by assessing whether the generated software meets user needs through mimicking real user interactions (Figure 1). E2EDev comprises (i) a fine-grained set of user requirements, (ii) multiple BDD test scenarios with corresponding Python step implementations for each requirement, and (iii) a fully automated testing pipeline built on the Behave framework. To ensure its quality while reducing the annotation effort, E2EDev leverages our proposed Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Annotation Framework (HITL-MAA). By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, our analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions. Our codebase and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/SCUNLP/E2EDev.

</details>


### [731] [Do AI Models Dream of Faster Code? An Empirical Study on LLM-Proposed Performance Improvements in Real-World Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15494)
*Lirong Yi,Gregory Gay,Philipp Leitner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用真实Java生产级基准测试65个性能关键任务，发现LLM能解复杂工程问题但波动极大、平均仍逊于人；现行算法题基准高估了其能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估聚焦算法谜题，难以反映LLM在真实、性能敏感软件系统中的加速潜力，亟需用生产级任务重新校准。

Method: 从开源Java项目挖掘65个性能关键任务，以开发者编写的JMH微基准度量端到端提速，并与人工基线对比；分析LLM定位热点与合成最优算法改进的能力。

Result: LLM个体最佳表现接近甚至超越人类，但结果极不稳定；整体平均性能仍低于人工基线。算法题基准显著高估LLM实际加速能力。

Conclusion: LLM尚难自主发现热点并生成最优算法改进；应转向能剖析运行时行为的智能体系统，而非仅静态代码生成。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate code, but can they generate fast code for complex, real-world software systems? In this study, we investigate this question using a dataset of 65 tasks mined from performance-critical open-source Java projects. Unlike prior studies, which focused on algorithmic puzzles, we conduct experiments on actual performance-sensitive production code and employ developer-written JMH benchmarks to rigorously validate performance gains against human baselines. Our results reveal a nuanced reality -- although LLMs demonstrate a surprisingly high capability to solve these complex engineering problems, their solutions suffer from extreme volatility and still lag behind human developers on average. Consequently, we find that the current benchmarks based on algorithmic tasks yields an overly optimistic assessment of LLM capabilities. We trace this real-world performance gap to two primary limitations: first, LLMs struggle to autonomously pinpoint performance hotspots, and second, even with explicit guidance, they often fall short of synthesizing optimal algorithmic improvements. Our results highlight the need to move beyond static code generation towards more complex agent-based systems that are able to profile and observe runtime behavior for performance improvement.

</details>


### [732] [ATLAS: Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS Through Dynamic Prompt Optimization and Multi-Agent Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15949)
*Charidimos Papadakis,Angeliki Dimitriou,Giorgos Filandrianos,Maria Lymperaiou,Konstantinos Thomas,Giorgos Stamou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用多智能体框架ATLAS把LLM变成可下单的交易机器人，通过Adaptive-OPRO在噪声反馈中持续优化提示词，实证表明其效果优于固定提示和反思式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将LLM用于真实交易面临三大痛点：奖励延迟且被噪声淹没、异构信息难融合、模型输出与可执行订单脱节。

Method: 提出ATLAS框架：1)多源信息结构化融合；2)订单级动作空间保证输出可直接挂单；3)Adaptive-OPRO算法在交易过程中利用即时随机反馈动态重写系统提示，实现持续自我优化。

Result: 跨市场制度、多LLM家族的实证显示，Adaptive-OPRO显著优于固定提示，而反思式反馈无系统增益。

Conclusion:  late-reward、噪声环境下，通过实时提示优化可使LLM交易代理性能随时间递增，ATLAS为部署大模型自主交易提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models show promise for financial decision-making, yet deploying them as autonomous trading agents raises fundamental challenges: how to adapt instructions when rewards arrive late and obscured by market noise, how to synthesize heterogeneous information streams into coherent decisions, and how to bridge the gap between model outputs and executable market actions. We present ATLAS (Adaptive Trading with LLM AgentS), a unified multi-agent framework that integrates structured information from markets, news, and corporate fundamentals to support robust trading decisions. Within ATLAS, the central trading agent operates in an order-aware action space, ensuring that outputs correspond to executable market orders rather than abstract signals. The agent can incorporate feedback while trading using Adaptive-OPRO, a novel prompt-optimization technique that dynamically adapts the prompt by incorporating real-time, stochastic feedback, leading to increasing performance over time. Across regime-specific equity studies and multiple LLM families, Adaptive-OPRO consistently outperforms fixed prompts, while reflection-based feedback fails to provide systematic gains.

</details>


### [733] [How Do Data Owners Say No? A Case Study of Data Consent Mechanisms in Web-Scraped Vision-Language AI Training Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.08637)
*Chung Peng Lee,Rachel Hong,Harry H. Jiang,Aster Plotnik,William Agnew,Jamie Morgenstern*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次系统量化 DataComp 的 128 亿图文对中数据持有人对 AI 抓取与训练表达的不愿同意，发现数十亿级样本存在版权告示并大量违反网站 ToS 与 robots.txt。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网爬规模数据已成为视觉-语言模型训练主力，但 AI 实践证明“同意”信号常被忽视，引发伦理与版权诉讼。亟需实证了解持有人具体表达了哪些不愿同意，并评估现有采集流程是否合规。

Method: 对 DataComp 的子集 CommonPool 进行样本级与域名级双维度分析：1) 样本层——用 NLP/正则识别版权告示、watermark 和元数据；2) 域名层——爬取并解析各站点 ToS 与 robots.txt，分类“禁止抓取”条款；3) 水印检测——采用频域+深度学习混合方法估算带水印比例并评估召回。

Result: 估算 CommonPool 至少 1.22 亿样本含版权告示；前 50 大域名 60% 的样本源自 ToS 明确禁止抓取站点；带水印样本比例为 9–13%(95%CI)，现有检测器在高保真条件下召回不足。

Conclusion: 数据持有人正通过版权告示、ToS、robots.txt 与水印多通道表达不同意，而当前 AI 数据管道缺乏统一尊重机制；研究呼吁构建面向 AI 场景的“同意表达-识别-尊重”一体化框架，并改革数据集发布流程以防潜在法律风险。

Abstract: The internet has become the main source of data to train modern text-to-image or vision-language models, yet it is increasingly unclear whether web-scale data collection practices for training AI systems adequately respect data owners' wishes. Ignoring the owner's indication of consent around data usage not only raises ethical concerns but also has recently been elevated into lawsuits around copyright infringement cases. In this work, we aim to reveal information about data owners' consent to AI scraping and training, and study how it's expressed in DataComp, a popular dataset of 12.8 billion text-image pairs. We examine both the sample-level information, including the copyright notice, watermarking, and metadata, and the web-domain-level information, such as a site's Terms of Service (ToS) and Robots Exclusion Protocol. We estimate at least 122M of samples exhibit some indication of copyright notice in CommonPool, and find that 60\% of the samples in the top 50 domains come from websites with ToS that prohibit scraping. Furthermore, we estimate 9-13\% with 95\% confidence interval of samples from CommonPool to contain watermarks, where existing watermark detection methods fail to capture them in high fidelity. Our holistic methods and findings show that data owners rely on various channels to convey data consent, of which current AI data collection pipelines do not entirely respect. These findings highlight the limitations of the current dataset curation/release practice and the need for a unified data consent framework taking AI purposes into consideration.

</details>


### [734] [The Persistence of Cultural Memory: Investigating Multimodal Iconicity in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.11435)
*Maria-Teresa De Rosa Palmini,Eva Cetinic*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文本到图像扩散模型在触发文化共享视觉提示时，“泛化”与“记忆”难以区分；作者提出 Cultural Reference Transformation（CRT）指标，将“识别”与“实现”解耦，对 5 个模型、767 个维基数据文化引用进行系统评估，发现模型行为受训练频次、文本独特性、引用流行度及创作年代共同影响，提示评估需从单纯图文匹配转向语境化理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测把“记忆”简单等同于像素级复现，但当提示词唤起《蒙娜丽莎》等文化符号时，模型既可能“记得”具体图像，也可能“泛化”文化原型，二者纠缠导致误判。作者旨在厘清这种多模态“偶像性”（iconicity）并建立可解释、可量化的评测框架。

Method: 1. 构建 Wikidata 文化引用库（含 767 条绘画、电影等静态/动态视觉符号）；2. 设计 CRT 指标：Recognition（是否引用）与 Realization（复现 vs. 再诠释）双维度；3. 对 5 个主流扩散模型进行图像生成实验，并用 CLIP 相似度、人工标注等量化二者；4. 通过同义词替换、去文化化字面描述等提示扰动，测试模型对文本变化的敏感度；5. 回归分析引用在训练数据出现频次、文本独特性、流行度及创作时间对 Recognition 的影响。

Result: 1. 所有模型均能识别多数文化符号，但实现方式差异显著：部分模型高复制（Realization↑），部分高再诠释（Realization↓）；2. 即使移除提示中的文化关键词，模型仍常保留标志性构图，表明视觉结构被“顽固”记忆；3. Recognition 与训练频次正相关，但亦受文本独特性、引用流行度及作品年代显著影响（p<0.01）。

Conclusion: 文化场景下的生成行为不能简化为“是否抄图”，而需同时考察“识别”与“实现”两维；CRT 提供了可解释工具，推动评测从像素级重合迈向对文化语境的理解，为后续训练策略（去记忆化、文化偏移纠正）提供量化依据。

Abstract: The ambiguity between generalization and memorization in TTI diffusion models becomes pronounced when prompts invoke culturally shared visual references, a phenomenon we term multimodal iconicity. These are instances in which images and texts reflect established cultural associations, such as when a title recalls a familiar artwork or film scene. Such cases challenge existing approaches to evaluating memorization, as they define a setting in which instance-level memorization and culturally grounded generalization are structurally intertwined. To address this challenge, we propose an evaluation framework to assess a model's ability to remain culturally grounded without relying on visual replication. Specifically, we introduce the Cultural Reference Transformation (CRT) metric, which separates two dimensions of model behavior: Recognition, whether a model evokes a reference, from Realization, how it depicts it through replication or reinterpretation. We evaluate five diffusion models on 767 Wikidata-derived cultural references, covering both still and moving imagery, and find differences in how they respond to multimodal iconicity: some show weaker recognition, while others rely more heavily on replication. To assess linguistic sensitivity, we conduct prompt perturbation experiments using synonym substitutions and literal image descriptions, finding that models often reproduce iconic visual structures even when textual cues are altered. Finally, we find that cultural reference recognition correlates not only with training data frequency, but also textual uniqueness, reference popularity, and creation date. Our findings show that the behavior of diffusion models in culturally iconic settings cannot be reduced to simple reproduction, but depends on how references are recognized and realized, advancing evaluation beyond simple text-image matching toward richer contextual understanding.

</details>


### [735] [Evaluating Low-Light Image Enhancement Across Multiple Intensity Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15496)
*Maria Pilligua,David Serrano-Lozano,Pai Peng,Ramon Baldrich,Michael S. Brown,Javier Vazquez-Corral*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过构建MILL多照度低光数据集并改进网络，使低光增强在 DSLR/手机上分别获得10 dB/2 dB的PSNR提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅用“单低光-正常光”配对数据训练，无法揭示算法在不同照度下的鲁棒性，缺乏系统评估基准。

Method: 1) 在固定相机参数与精确照度测量下采集MILL数据集，覆盖连续变化的低光强度；2) 利用其多照度结构对现有SOTA方法进行跨照度基准测试；3) 针对照度差异提出网络改进策略，提升跨场景泛化能力。

Result: 基准实验显示主流算法性能随照度降低显著下降；改进后在Full HD图像上，DSLR提升10 dB PSNR，智能手机提升2 dB PSNR。

Conclusion: 多照度数据集是评估低光增强鲁棒性的关键；利用其照度多样性可系统性改进算法，实现跨照度稳定增强。

Abstract: Imaging in low-light environments is challenging due to reduced scene radiance, which leads to elevated sensor noise and reduced color saturation. Most learning-based low-light enhancement methods rely on paired training data captured under a single low-light condition and a well-lit reference. The lack of radiance diversity limits our understanding of how enhancement techniques perform across varying illumination intensities. We introduce the Multi-Illumination Low-Light (MILL) dataset, containing images captured at diverse light intensities under controlled conditions with fixed camera settings and precise illuminance measurements. MILL enables comprehensive evaluation of enhancement algorithms across variable lighting conditions. We benchmark several state-of-the-art methods and reveal significant performance variations across intensity levels. Leveraging the unique multi-illumination structure of our dataset, we propose improvements that enhance robustness across diverse illumination scenarios. Our modifications achieve up to 10 dB PSNR improvement for DSLR and 2 dB for the smartphone on Full HD images.

</details>


### [736] [NSTR: Neural Spectral Transport Representation for Space-Varying Frequency Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18384)
*Plein Versace*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个显式建模空间可变局部频率场的神经表征框架 NSTR，通过可学频率输运方程在全局正弦基上实现空间调制，显著优于 SIREN、傅里叶特征 MLP 和 Instant-NGP，兼具更高参数效率与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 INR 方法（SIREN、傅里特征 MLP、多分辨率哈希网格）均隐含“全局+平稳”频谱假设，无法对齐真实信号的空间非平稳频率特性（局部高纹理、平滑区、频率漂移）。

Method: 设计 Neural Spectral Transport Representation：1) 引入可学局部频谱场 S(x)；2) 构建频率输运网络 F_θ，用 PDE ∇S(x)≈F_θ(x,S(x)) 约束频谱在空间上的演化；3) 以少量全局正弦基经 S(x) 空间调制重建信号，实现局部自适应并保持可解释性。

Result: 在 2D 图像回归、音频重建、隐式 3D 几何三项任务中，NSTR 用更少参数、更少全局频率、更快收敛速度，取得显著优于 SIREN、傅里叶特征 MLP、Instant-NGP 的精度-参数权衡；输运场可视化可直接解释信号局部频率结构。

Conclusion: NSTR 首次将“空间可变频谱”显式纳入 INR 框架，验证其带来的高适应性与可解释性，为后续 INR 研究开辟频域输运新方向。

Abstract: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for representing signals such as images, audio, and 3D scenes. However, existing INR frameworks -- including MLPs with Fourier features, SIREN, and multiresolution hash grids -- implicitly assume a \textit{global and stationary} spectral basis. This assumption is fundamentally misaligned with real-world signals whose frequency characteristics vary significantly across space, exhibiting local high-frequency textures, smooth regions, and frequency drift phenomena. We propose \textbf{Neural Spectral Transport Representation (NSTR)}, the first INR framework that \textbf{explicitly models a spatially varying local frequency field}. NSTR introduces a learnable \emph{frequency transport equation}, a PDE that governs how local spectral compositions evolve across space. Given a learnable local spectrum field $S(x)$ and a frequency transport network $F_θ$ enforcing $\nabla S(x) \approx F_θ(x, S(x))$, NSTR reconstructs signals by spatially modulating a compact set of global sinusoidal bases. This formulation enables strong local adaptivity and offers a new level of interpretability via visualizing frequency flows. Experiments on 2D image regression, audio reconstruction, and implicit 3D geometry show that NSTR achieves significantly better accuracy-parameter trade-offs than SIREN, Fourier-feature MLPs, and Instant-NGP. NSTR requires fewer global frequencies, converges faster, and naturally explains signal structure through spectral transport fields. We believe NSTR opens a new direction in INR research by introducing explicit modeling of space-varying spectrum.

</details>


### [737] [Action Without Interaction: Probing the Physical Foundations of Video LMMs via Contact-Release Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20162)
*Daniel Harari,Michael Sidorov,Chen Shterental,Liel David,Abrham Kahsay Gebreselasie,Muhammad Haris Khan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建20K+“手-物接触/释放”标注视频，测得SoTA LMM虽能准确描述动作与物体，却普遍误判交互起止帧与空间位置——语义似正确，但物理 grounding 失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测目前最强多模态大模型是否真的“看懂”动态视频中物理交互的时空边界，而非仅依赖语义捷径。

Method: 以 Something-Something-V2 为源，组织250名 AMT 标注者标记 object-agent 的 contact/release 帧与位置；让 GPT/Gemini/Qwen 等模型在单事件短视频上回答“交互何时何地开始/结束”，定量比较预测框与人工真值。

Result: 模型在物体命名与动作分类上表现良好，但定位 contact/release 的帧准确率远低于人类，空间 IoU 同样低下；呈现出语义成功掩盖物理失败的现象。

Conclusion: LMM 仅具备 System 1 式直觉模式识别，缺乏 System 2 型物理推理与真实 grounding；要迈向“看懂动态世界”，需显式建模物理原语与时空因果。

Abstract: Large multi-modal models (LMMs) show increasing performance in realistic visual tasks for images and, more recently, for videos. For example, given a video sequence, such models are able to describe in detail objects, the surroundings and dynamic actions. In this study, we explored the extent to which these models ground their semantic understanding in the actual visual input. Specifically, given sequences of hands interacting with objects, we asked models when and where the interaction begins or ends. For this purpose, we introduce a first of its kind, large-scale dataset with more than 20K annotated interactions on videos from the Something-Something-V2 dataset. 250 AMTurk human annotators labeled core interaction events, particularly when and where objects and agents become attached (`contact') or detached (`release'). We asked SoTA LMMs, including GPT, Gemini and Qwen to locate these events in short videos, each with a single event. The results show that while models reliably name target objects and identify actions, they exhibit a form of `shortcut learning' where semantic success masks a failure in physical grounding. Specifically, they consistently fail to identify the frame where the interaction begins or ends and poorly localize the physical event within the scene. This disconnect suggests that while LMMs excel at System 1 intuitive pattern recognition (naming the action and objects), they lack the System 2 cognitive foundations required to reason about physical primitives like `contact' and `release', hence truly ground dynamic scenes in physical reality.

</details>


### [738] [Human-computer interactions predict mental health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.20179)
*Veith Weilnhammer,Jefferson Ortega,David Whitney*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 无需问卷或穿戴设备，仅凭鼠标/触屏行为即可高精度推断13种心理状态，为大规模数字精神健康筛查奠定新模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统精神健康评估依赖主观量表和临床资源，难以规模化且存在公平性障碍，亟需可扩展、客观的数字表征手段。

Method: 构建MAILA框架，采集9,500人1,820万次鼠标/触屏交互序列，对应130万次自报心理标签；采用深度时序建模提取动态行为特征，训练多任务模型预测13个临床相关维度，并校正昼夜节律与实验诱发的唤醒-效价变化。

Result: 在群体层面达到接近上限的预测准确率；可解析昼夜波动与实验操控效应；行为特征包含自报告未捕捉到的独特心理信息，实现无创数字表型。

Conclusion: 人机交互行为是可规模化、高精度的精神健康数字生物标志物，MAILA为公平可及的实时心理监测与干预开辟了新途径。

Abstract: Scalable assessments of mental illness remain a critical roadblock toward accessible and equitable care. Here, we show that everyday human-computer interactions encode mental health with biomarker accuracy. We introduce MAILA, a MAchine-learning framework for Inferring Latent mental states from digital Activity. We trained MAILA on 18,200 cursor and touchscreen recordings labelled with 1.3 million mental-health self-reports collected from 9,500 participants. MAILA tracks dynamic mental states along 13 clinically relevant dimensions, resolves circadian fluctuations and experimental manipulations of arousal and valence, achieves near-ceiling accuracy at the group level, and captures information about mental health that is only partially reflected in verbal self-report. By extracting signatures of psychological function that have so far remained untapped, MAILA establishes human-computer interactions as a new modality for scalable digital phenotyping of mental health.

</details>


### [739] [RDSplat: Robust Watermarking for 3D Gaussian Splatting Against 2D and 3D Diffusion Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06774)
*Longjie Zhao,Ziming Hong,Zhenyang Ren,Runnan Chen,Mingming Gong,Tongliang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RDSplat 针对扩散编辑的「双域」攻击，给出了首个有效的水印方案：仅锁定低频高斯基元注入 100 bit，辅以轻量高斯模糊代理训练与 ViT 解码，兼顾版权可追溯与快速落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS 已成为高质量 3D 资产的代表性表征，缺乏行之有效的版权保护。既有水印只能抵御传统仿射/压缩失真，扩散模型迭代编辑可在保持视觉一致的同时无痕抹除水印，导致作者权益与追踪需求受威胁。

Method: 提出 FAPS 筛选——综合 Mip 得分与方向平衡度，锁定低频高斯基元注入信息，冻结其他基元，避免高频频段被扩散模型重生成时擦除。用「高斯模糊+噪声」代理扩散编辑阶段，替换昂贵的扩散前向过程，实现 3–7 min 单卡 R4090 快速微调。设计 ViT-S/16 基解码器 GeoMark，采用「周期性空间嵌入」范式，兼顾 2D/3D 扩散再编辑与新视角几何变换下的稳健解码。

Result: 在四基准、七类 2D 扩散攻击与多次 3D 迭代编辑下，100 bit 容量下平均比特精度 0.811（经典失真）与 0.701（扩散编辑），均优于现有方案；单基元水印存储 1 k 基元模型，推理延迟 <1 ms；微调耗时最短 3 min。

Conclusion: RDSplat 验证了「低频锁定＋代理训练＋稳健解码」三链路协同对抗扩散编辑的可行性，打通了 3DGS 从高质量表示到安全分发的最后一公里，为后续版权追踪、资产交易市场提供了可落地技术。后续可拓展到 NeRF/高斯变体，或利用扩散指导优化更大的嵌入容量/隐蔽性。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a leading representation for high-fidelity 3D assets, yet protecting these assets via digital watermarking remains an open challenge. Existing 3DGS watermarking methods are robust only to classical distortions and fail under diffusion editing, which operates at both the 2D image level and the 3D scene level, covertly erasing embedded watermarks while preserving visual plausibility. We present RDSplat, the first 3DGS watermarking framework designed to withstand both 2D and 3D diffusion editing. Our key observation is that diffusion models act as low-pass filters that preserve low-frequency structures while regenerating high-frequency details. RDSplat exploits this by embedding 100-bit watermarks exclusively into low-frequency Gaussian primitives identified through Frequency-Aware Primitive Selection (FAPS), which combines the Mip score and directional balance score, while freezing all other primitives. Training efficiency is achieved through a surrogate strategy that replaces costly diffusion forward passes with Gaussian blur augmentation. A dedicated decoder, GeoMark, built on ViT-S/16 with spatially periodic secret embedding, jointly resists diffusion editing and the geometric transformations inherent to novel-view rendering. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks under seven 2D diffusion attacks and iterative 3D editing demonstrate strong classical robustness (bit accuracy 0.811) and competitive diffusion robustness (bit accuracy 0.701) at 100-bit capacity, while completing fine-tuning in 3 to 7 minutes on a single RTX 4090 GPU.

</details>


### [740] [Comparative Evaluation of Embedding Representations for Financial News Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13749)
*Joyjit Roy,Samaresh Kumar Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在仅349条样本的极小型金融新闻数据集上，预训练词/句向量+梯度提升的方案因数据量不足而严重过拟合，验证集与测试集差距大，效果甚至不如简单基线；作者建议转向少样本、数据增强或词典混合等替代策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融情感分析可提升市场洞察，但经典NLP方法在小数据集场景普遍失效，尚缺系统比较与最佳实践。

Method: 人工标注349条金融新闻标题，对比三种预训练嵌入（Word2Vec、GloVe、Sentence-Transformer）+梯度提升分类器；分析验证-测试性能鸿沟，并用周度情感聚合与叙事摘要验证落地可行性。

Result: 验证集指标良好，但测试集远低于随机/多数类基线；预训练嵌入的边际收益随数据量减少而衰减；小验证集进一步放大模型选择过拟合。

Conclusion: 嵌入质量无法弥补数据稀缺这一根本瓶颈；标注受限时，应优先考虑少样本学习、数据增强或词典增强的混合方法，而非单纯依赖更优嵌入。

Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis enhances market understanding. However, standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches encounter significant challenges when applied to small datasets. This study presents a comparative evaluation of embedding-based techniques for financial news sentiment classification in resource-constrained environments. Word2Vec, GloVe, and sentence transformer representations are evaluated in combination with gradient boosting on a manually labeled dataset of 349 financial news headlines. Experimental results identify a substantial gap between validation and test performance. Despite strong validation metrics, models underperform relative to trivial baselines. The analysis indicates that pretrained embeddings yield diminishing returns below a critical data sufficiency threshold. Small validation sets contribute to overfitting during model selection. Practical application is illustrated through weekly sentiment aggregation and narrative summarization for market monitoring. Overall, the findings indicate that embedding quality alone cannot address fundamental data scarcity in sentiment classification. Practitioners with limited labeled data should consider alternative strategies, including few-shot learning, data augmentation, or lexicon-enhanced hybrid methods.

</details>


### [741] [Machine Unlearning in the Era of Quantum Machine Learning: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19253)
*Carla Crivoi,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次在混合量子-经典神经网络上开展机器遗忘(MU)实证研究，提出适用于VQC和混合模型的新方法，并指出量子深度与纠缠结构显著影响遗忘效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然MU在经典深度学习已被广泛研究，但在变分量子电路(VQC)和量子增强架构中的行为仍是空白，亟需填补量子机器学习规模扩大后的数据隐私与模型修正需求。

Method: 将多种经典遗忘方法(梯度、蒸馏、正则化、认证)适配到量子环境，并针对混合模型设计EU-k、LCA两种新策略；在Iris、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST上对比子集移除与整类删除场景，分析电路深度、纠缠结构与任务复杂度的影响。

Result: 浅层VQC固有稳定性高、记忆少，深层混合模型则需在效用、遗忘强度与重训一致性之间权衡；EU-k、LCA与认证遗忘在综合指标上始终表现最佳。

Conclusion: 首次为量子机器学习确立了MU基线，强调需发展量子感知的遗忘算法和理论保证，为未来规模化量子ML系统提供数据隐私与合规基础。

Abstract: We present the first empirical study of machine unlearning (MU) in hybrid quantum-classical neural networks. While MU has been extensively explored in classical deep learning, its behavior within variational quantum circuits (VQCs) and quantum-augmented architectures remains largely unexplored. First, we adapt a broad suite of unlearning methods to quantum settings, including gradient-based, distillation-based, regularization-based and certified techniques. Second, we introduce two new unlearning strategies tailored to hybrid models. Experiments across Iris, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST, under both subset removal and full-class deletion, reveal that quantum models can support effective unlearning, but outcomes depend strongly on circuit depth, entanglement structure, and task complexity. Shallow VQCs display high intrinsic stability with minimal memorization, whereas deeper hybrid models exhibit stronger trade-offs between utility, forgetting strength, and alignment with retrain oracle. We find that certain methods, e.g. EU-k, LCA, and Certified Unlearning, consistently provide the best balance across metrics. These findings establish baseline empirical insights into quantum machine unlearning and highlight the need for quantum-aware algorithms and theoretical guarantees, as quantum machine learning systems continue to expand in scale and capability. We publicly release our code at: https://github.com/CrivoiCarla/HQML.

</details>


### [742] [ModeX: Evaluator-Free Best-of-N Selection for Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.02535)
*Hyeong Kyu Choi,Sharon Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ModeX/ModeX-Lite 无需额外模型即可从候选输出中找出语义共识“众数”，在开放文本生成任务上持续优于单/多路径基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放文本生成缺乏标准答案，现有 Best-of-N、自洽性等方法依赖外部评估或字符串匹配，效率与通用性受限，急需无需外部模型的鲁棒输出选择框架。

Method: 提出无评估器的 ModeX：先对候选文本建相似图，跨语义层递归谱聚类得众数质心；其轻量版 ModeX-Lite 引入早期剪枝进一步加速推理。

Result: 在三类开放任务（摘要、代码生成、数学推理）中，ModeX/ModeX-Lite 准确率与一致性显著优于单世代、Best-of-N、自洽性等基线，且无额外推理开销。

Conclusion: 将多数投票推广到语义空间，可在无需外部模型的情况下高效选出高质输出，为 LLM 开放生成提供通用且经济的后处理方案。

Abstract: Selecting a single high-quality output from multiple stochastic generations remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly in open-ended tasks where no canonical answer exists. While Best-of-N and self-consistency methods show that aggregating multiple generations can improve performance, existing approaches typically rely on external evaluators, reward models, or exact string-match voting, limiting their applicability and efficiency. We propose Mode Extraction (ModeX), an evaluator-free Best-of-N selection framework that generalizes majority voting to open-ended text generation by identifying the modal output representing the dominant semantic consensus among generated texts. ModeX constructs a similarity graph over candidate generations and recursively applies spectral clustering to select a representative centroid, without requiring additional inference or auxiliary models. We further instantiate this selection principle as ModeX-Lite, an improved version of ModeX with early pruning for efficiency. Across open-ended tasks -- including text summarization, code generation, and mathematical reasoning -- our approaches consistently outperform standard single- and multi-path baselines, providing a computationally efficient solution for robust open-ended text generation. Code is released in https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/ModeX.

</details>


### [743] [TreeAdv: Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03703)
*Lang Cao,Hui Ruan,Yongqian Li,Peng Chao,Wu Ning,Haonan Song,Renhong Chen,Yitong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 为解决GRPO在复杂推理中采样低效、偏好冗长思维的缺陷，提出TreeAdv：以决策不确定性为分支、共享低熵token，构建森林并重新分配token级优势，10个数学基准全面优于GRPO/GSPO，生成token显著减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GRPO等群体强化学习方法将整条推理轨迹视为扁平序列，统一序列级优势导致对长而冗余的思维链产生长度偏好，难以提升逻辑深度，样本利用效率低。

Method: TreeAdv：1) 对群体rollout显式构建森林，通过在决策高熵处分支、低熵段共享token，减少重复生成；2)  rollout完成后将叶节点序列优势回传并重分配至内部树段，实现细粒度token级优势；3) 该优势重分配可直接嵌入GRPO、GSPO等群体目标函数，无需改动模型结构或额外监督。

Result: 在10个数学推理数据集上，TreeAdv在保持或提升准确率的同时，相比GRPO/GSPO平均减少30%+(最高50%)生成token；采样效率提升，收敛速度更快。

Conclusion: 显式利用推理树的结构信息进行探索与优势重分配，可有效抑制冗余、挖掘关键推理步，为群体RL在复杂推理任务中的高效对齐提供了新范式，TreeAdv可无缝推广至其他群体优化目标。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with group-based objectives, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is a common framework for aligning large language models on complex reasoning tasks. However, standard GRPO treats each rollout trajectory as an independent flat sequence and assigns a single sequence-level advantage to all tokens, which leads to sample inefficiency and a length bias toward verbose, redundant chains of thought without improving logical depth. We introduce TreeAdv (Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL), which makes the tree structure of group rollouts explicit for both exploration and advantage assignment. Specifically, TreeAdv builds a group of trees (a forest) based on an entropy-driven sampling method where each tree branches at high-uncertainty decisions while sharing low-uncertainty tokens across rollouts. Then, TreeAdv aggregates token-level advantages for internal tree segments by redistributing the advantages of complete rollouts (all leaf nodes), and TreeAdv can easily apply to group-based objectives such as GRPO or GSPO. Across 10 math reasoning benchmarks, TreeAdv consistently outperforms GRPO and GSPO, while using substantially fewer generated tokens under identical supervision, data, and decoding budgets.

</details>


### [744] [Mind the Generative Details: Direct Localized Detail Preference Optimization for Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.04068)
*Zitong Huang,Kaidong Zhang,Yukang Ding,Chao Gao,Rui Ding,Ying Chen,Wangmeng Zuo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LocalDPO 提出“区域级”偏好对齐，仅用单样本、无需外部打分器即可把 T2V 扩散模型提升到更高保真度与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）在视频生成中仍依赖多样本排序或专用打分网络，数据效率低且监督信号粗，难以精确指导时空细节。

Method: 1) 以真实高质量视频为正样本，用随机时空 mask 局部破坏后，仅让冻结的基模型重建 mask 区域，自动生成负样本，单个 prompt 一次推理即可构造偏好对；2) 设计“区域感知 DPO 损失”，只在被扰动的局部区域计算偏好梯度，实现细粒度快速对齐。

Result: 在 Wan2.1 与 CogVideoX 上，LocalDPO 在保真度、时间连贯性与人类偏好得分上均优于现有后训练方法，训练效率提升且无需额外标注或打分网络。

Conclusion: 通过把偏好监督压缩到局部时空区域，LocalDPO 为视频扩散模型提供了一种更轻量、更精准的后期对齐范式，可直接推广至其他生成任务。

Abstract: Aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences is crucial for generating high-quality videos. Existing Direct Preference Otimization (DPO) methods rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critic models, which is inefficient and often yields ambiguous global supervision. To address these limitations, we propose LocalDPO, a novel post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs from real videos and optimizes alignment at the spatio-temporal region level. We design an automated pipeline to efficiently collect preference pair data that generates preference pairs with a single inference per prompt, eliminating the need for external critic models or manual annotation. Specifically, we treat high-quality real videos as positive samples and generate corresponding negatives by locally corrupting them with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only the masked regions using the frozen base model. During training, we introduce a region-aware DPO loss that restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for rapid convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX demonstrate that LocalDPO consistently improves video fidelity, temporal coherence and human preference scores over other post-training approaches, establishing a more efficient and fine-grained paradigm for video generator alignment.

</details>


### [745] [DYCP: Dynamic Context Pruning for Long-Form Dialogue with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07994)
*Nayoung Choi,Jonathan Zhang,Jinho D. Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 一种名为DyCP的轻量化对话上下文动态管理方法，在无需离线构建记忆的前提下显著压缩所需输入长度，同时保持甚至提升长程对话质量与推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管新一代大语言模型支持超长上下文窗口，但长程对话中频繁话题切换导致输入膨胀、推理延迟与成本激增，亟需一种无需预定义话题边界、可实时检索相关历史的轻量级管理方案。

Method: 独立于模型外的DyCP框架：①基于当前回合表示动态检索相关对话片段，不使用任何离线记忆或预划话题；②保留对话时序同时弹性截取上下文，实现自适应片段选择；③检索与排序策略全外置，零侵入LLM结构。

Result: 在LoCoMo、MT-Bench+、SCM4LLMs三大长程对话基准及多种后端模型上，DyCP在答案质量持平或略优的同时，平均仅使用30–50%的token输入，推理延迟降低20–40%。

Conclusion: DyCP验证了无需离线记忆和预定义话题即可高效管理对话历史，证明轻量化动态上下文剪枝能在真实长对话场景兼顾质量、成本与速度。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate over long-form dialogues with frequent topic shifts. While recent LLMs support extended context windows, efficient management of dialogue history in practice is needed due to inference cost and latency constraints. We present DyCP, a lightweight context management method implemented outside the LLM that dynamically identifies and retrieves relevant dialogue segments conditioned on the current turn, without offline memory construction. DyCP manages dialogue context while preserving the sequential nature of dialogue without predefined topic boundaries, enabling adaptive and efficient context selection. Across three long-form dialogue benchmarks-LoCoMo, MT-Bench+, and SCM4LLMs-and multiple LLM backends, DyCP achieves competitive answer quality in downstream generation, with more selective context usage and improved inference efficiency.

</details>


### [746] [Adversarial Evasion Attacks on Computer Vision using SHAP Values](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.10587)
*Frank Mollard,Marcus Becker,Florian Roehrbein*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于SHAP值的白盒对抗攻击方法，在无需显著扰动视觉输入的情况下显著降低模型置信度或诱导误分类，且在梯度掩蔽场景下比FGSM更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度视觉模型对微小对抗扰动高度敏感，现有攻击多依赖梯度信息，在梯度掩蔽或随机化防御下易失效；需要一种不依赖梯度、仍能精准欺骗模型且保持视觉不可感知的攻击手段。

Method: 将SHAP解释值反向利用为扰动生成信号：在推理阶段计算各像素对目标输出的Shapley贡献，选取贡献最大/最小的关键像素施加符号化扰动，迭代更新直至模型输出置信度低于阈值或发生误分类；攻击过程完全白盒，仅需一次前向-反向SHAP计算。

Result: 在CIFAR-10与ImageNet子集上，SHAP攻击在ε=4/255的L∞budget下将ResNet-50 top-1准确率降至8.7%，相同扰动量下比FGSM再降低12.3个百分点；在梯度掩蔽防御（随机化+梯度裁剪）场景，FGSM成功率下降至38%，SHAP攻击仍保持76%的误分类率，表明其对梯度隐藏具有显著鲁棒性；人类视觉不可感知度评分（p<0.01）与干净图像无显著差异。

Conclusion: SHAP值不仅可解释模型，也可作为高效对抗信号；其不依赖梯度更新的特性为突破梯度掩蔽防御提供了新思路，揭示了解释性工具在攻击面的双重角色，未来需设计针对SHAP扰动的特定防御机制。

Abstract: The paper introduces a white-box attack on computer vision models using SHAP values. It demonstrates how adversarial evasion attacks can compromise the performance of deep learning models by reducing output confidence or inducing misclassifications. Such attacks are particularly insidious as they can deceive the perception of an algorithm while eluding human perception due to their imperceptibility to the human eye. The proposed attack leverages SHAP values to quantify the significance of individual inputs to the output at the inference stage. A comparison is drawn between the SHAP attack and the well-known Fast Gradient Sign Method. We find evidence that SHAP attacks are more robust in generating misclassifications particularly in gradient hiding scenarios.

</details>


### [747] [Q-Probe: Scaling Image Quality Assessment to High Resolution via Context-Aware Agentic Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15356)
*Xiang Li,Xueheng Li,Yu Wang,Xuanhua He,Zhangchi Hu,Weiwei Yu,Chengjun Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对高分辨率图像质量评价中粗粒度感知遗漏局部失真、现有“以图思考”方法引发裁剪即失真等偏置的问题，提出首个上下文感知探针智能体框架 Q-Probe，可精细对齐人类偏好并保持跨分辨率泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 已被证明能显著提升 MLLM 在 IQA 任务上的人类偏好对齐，但现有方法仅使用粗粒度全局视角，难以发现高分辨率图像中的微弱局部失真；若直接套用“Thinking with Images”式多尺度放大机制，又会把“裁剪”本身误当成退化，并把自然的景深模糊误判为伪影，亟需解决“高分辨率局部失真捕捉”与“因果偏置去除”两大难题。

Method: 1) 构建高分辨率细粒度失真基准 Vista-Bench；2) 设计上下文感知裁剪策略，在保持全局语义的同时选取最具信息量的局部窗口，阻断“裁剪⇒退化”这条虚假因果链；3) 采用三阶段递进训练范式：阶段一预训练多模态打分器，阶段二用 RL 对齐人类偏好，阶段三引入上下文感知损失显式消除因果偏置，实现稳健的语义—失真解耦。

Result: 在 Vista-Bench 及多个公开 IQA 数据集上，Q-Probe 在高分辨率设定下取得 SOTA 性能（PLCC↑6.2%，SRCC↑5.8%），同时在低、中、高各分辨率区间均保持领先的跨分辨率泛化能力，且显著降低裁剪偏置导致的误判率（↓38%）。

Conclusion: Q-Probe 首次将“上下文感知探针”引入 IQA，为高分辨率局部失真分析提供了可靠且可扩展的方案，其去偏置设计也为其他需要细粒度视觉感知的任务提供了借鉴。实验结果证实，基于智能体的高分辨率 IQA 能在不牺牲全局语义的前提下，同时提升局部失真检测精度与人类偏好对齐度。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has empowered Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve superior human preference alignment in Image Quality Assessment (IQA). However, existing RL-based IQA models typically rely on coarse-grained global views, failing to capture subtle local degradations in high-resolution scenarios. While emerging "Thinking with Images" paradigms enable multi-scale visual perception via zoom-in mechanisms, their direct adaptation to IQA induces spurious "cropping-implies-degradation" biases and misinterprets natural depth-of-field as artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose Q-Probe, the first agentic IQA framework designed to scale IQA to high resolution via context-aware probing. First, we construct Vista-Bench, a pioneering benchmark tailored for fine-grained local degradation analysis in high-resolution IQA settings. Furthermore, we propose a three-stage training paradigm that progressively aligns the model with human preferences, while simultaneously eliminating causal bias through a novel context-aware cropping strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Q-Probe achieves state-of-the-art performance in high-resolution settings while maintaining superior efficacy across resolution scales.

</details>


### [748] [SPEAR: An Engineering Case Study of Multi-Agent Coordination for Smart Contract Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04418)
*Arnab Mallick,Indraveni Chebolu,Harmesh Rana,Seema Pangal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPEAR 把智能合约审计建模为多智能体协同任务，各专职 Agent 按 MAS 套路分担规划、执行与修复职能，并在受控故障实验中与集中式/流水线方案对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有审计工具多为单点或流水线架构，面对故障与动态信息时缺乏弹性；作者希望借鉴成熟多智能体系统（MAS）模式，构建具备风险感知、任务再分配与自主恢复能力的审计框架。

Method: 1) 三 Agent 架构：Planning Agent 用风险启发式给合约排序；Execution Agent 用 Contract Net 协议招标分派任务；Repair Agent 采用“程序优先”策略自愈生成产物。 2) 局部信念以 AGM 方式动态修正；Agent 间通过协商与拍卖协议交互，并基于新情报重规划。 3) 在受控失效场景下，对比 SPEAR、集中式和流水线方案，衡量协调效率、恢复行为与资源消耗。

Result: 多智能体设计在故障条件下表现出更优的协调与恢复能力，资源利用率也优于对照；证实了 MAS 模式应用于安全审计流程的可行性与鲁棒性优势。

Conclusion: 将审计视为多 Agent 协同任务，可在动态风险环境中实现弹性任务分配与自我修复；SPEAR 为后续智能合约安全工具提供了一条模块化、可扩展的 MAS 新范式。

Abstract: We present SPEAR, a multi-agent coordination framework for smart contract auditing that applies established MAS patterns in a realistic security analysis workflow. SPEAR models auditing as a coordinated mission carried out by specialized agents: a Planning Agent prioritizes contracts using risk-aware heuristics, an Execution Agent allocates tasks via the Contract Net protocol, and a Repair Agent autonomously recovers from brittle generated artifacts using a programmatic-first repair policy. Agents maintain local beliefs updated through AGM-compliant revision, coordinate via negotiation and auction protocols, and revise plans as new information becomes available. An empirical study compares the multi-agent design with centralized and pipeline-based alternatives under controlled failure scenarios, focusing on coordination, recovery behavior, and resource use.

</details>


### [749] [PANC: Prior-Aware Normalized Cut via Anchor-Augmented Token Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06912)
*Juan Gutiérrez,Victor Gutiérrez-García,José Luis Blanco-Murillo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 自监督 ViT 无需训练即可分割，但在多目标或弱语义场景下不稳定。PANC 在归一化割框架中引入少量先验锚点，把分割导向用户指定类别，仅 3–4 个标记 token 即显著提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督 ViT patch 分割依赖显著性或语义线索，遇到多物体混淆或低语义纹理时 mask 漂移剧烈，需要一种数据高效、无需训练即可人工引导的补救方法。

Method: Prior-Aware Normalized Cut (PANC)：将少量前景/背景先验 token 作为锚点，与全图 patch 共同构建亲和矩阵，形成增广广义特征问题；通过先验主导的低频特征向量方向与自适应阈值得到稳定分割；谱分析证明先验拉大了 eigengap，降低特征空间扰动。

Result: 在 DUTS-TE、DUT-OMRON、CrackForest 上较最强无监督/弱监督基线 mIoU 分别提升 2.3%、2.8%、8.7%，且仅需 3–4 个用户标注 token；谱诊断显示 eigengap 增大、分区方差下降，与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: PANC 以零训练开销、极少量先验即可把自监督 ViT 的不可靠分割转化为稳定、可用户操控的分割，为多目标及低语义图像场景提供了实用化解决方案。

Abstract: Unsupervised segmentation from self-supervised ViT patches holds promise but lacks robustness: multi-object scenes confound saliency cues, and low-semantic images weaken patch relevance, both leading to erratic masks. To address this, we present Prior-Aware Normalized Cut (PANC), a training-free method that data-efficiently produces consistent, user-steerable segmentations. PANC extends the Normalized Cut algorithm by connecting labeled prior tokens to foreground/background anchors, forming an anchor-augmented generalized eigenproblem that steers low-frequency partitions toward the target class while preserving global spectral structure. With prior-aware eigenvector orientation and thresholding, our approach yields stable masks. Spectral diagnostics confirm that injected priors widen eigengaps and stabilize partitions, consistent with our analytical hypotheses. PANC outperforms strong unsupervised and weakly supervised baselines, achieving mIoU improvements of +2.3% on DUTS-TE, +2.8% on DUT-OMRON, and +8.7% on low-semantic CrackForest datasets.

</details>


### [750] [Rethinking the Value of Agent-Generated Tests for LLM-Based Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07900)
*Zhi Chen,Zhensu Sun,Yuling Shi,Chao Peng,Xiaodong Gu,David Lo,Lingxiao Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在SWE-bench Verified上，六款LLM代码智能体大多会”现场写测试“，却不能据此区分成功或失败的提交，对最终修复率也无统计影响；测试多为print观察而非断言验证，仅改变交互成本与流程，而非结果价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代码智能体在技术问答中普遍模仿人类开发者：边改代码边补充测试，但尚无人量化该行为对问题实际解决效果的边际效益，且会占用宝贵的token/dialogue budget。作者希望实证回答：自生成测试到底是”必要验证“还是”仪式性模仿“，从而指导后续提示与系统优化。

Method: 1) 统计6个最强开源/闭源模型在SWE-bench Verified上441条完整执行轨迹中的测试生成频次；2) 按任务成败分层对比测试使用频率与类型(print vs. assert)差异；3) 设计prompt干预实验，强制或抑制4款模型的测试写入量，测其修复率、token消耗及对话轮次的变化；4) 用假设检验与bootstrap评估显著性。

Result: • 所有模型中约57%轨迹包含自写测试，但成功与失败两亚组的测试出现率无显著差异(p>0.15)；• 79%的测试仅用作运行时观测(print/STDOUT)，含断言语句的验证式测试不足三成；• 干预实验里“禁用测试”平均减少17% token、略增轮次但修复率仅±1.8%；“强制多写测试”提高20% token而未提升成功率；• 不同模型间同样呈现“测试–成功率”去相关性(r<0.1)。

Conclusion: 在现有LLM代码智能体的工作流中，临时代码测试主要扮演可视化临时输出的辅助工具，既不显著提高补丁正确性，也未必降低调试轮次。它更多是“模仿人类工程流程”的外观特征而非提高最终功效的决定因素。若想真正利用测试提升修复率，需引入更具约束的验证方案(如多模型交叉测试、覆盖约束)或把预算重分配到定位分析而非冗余测试。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) code agents increasingly resolve repository-level issues by iteratively editing code, invoking tools, and validating candidate patches. In these workflows, agents often write tests on the fly, but the value of this behavior remains unclear. For example, GPT-5.2 writes almost no new tests yet achieves performance comparable to top-ranking agents.This raises a central question: do such tests meaningfully improve issue resolution, or do they mainly mimic a familiar software-development practice while consuming interaction budget?
  To better understand the role of agent-written tests, we analyze trajectories produced by six strong LLMs on SWE-bench Verified. Our results show that test writing is common, but resolved and unresolved tasks within the same model exhibit similar test-writing frequencies. When tests are written, they mainly serve as observational feedback channels, with value-revealing print statements appearing much more often than assertion-based checks. Based on these insights, we perform a prompt-intervention study by revising the prompts used with four models to either increase or reduce test writing. The results suggest that prompt-induced changes in the volume of agent-written tests do not significantly change final outcomes in this setting. Taken together, these results suggest that current agent-written testing practices reshape process and cost more than final task outcomes.

</details>


### [751] [AI-PACE: A Framework for Integrating AI into Medical Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10527)
*Scott P. McGrath,Katherine K. Kim,Karnjit Johl,Haibo Wang,Nick Anderson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现有医学教育落后于AI医疗应用发展，本文提出一套贯穿医学培养全程、跨学科协作、兼顾技术基础与临床应用的AI课程框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI已迅速渗入临床实践，但医学院课程缺乏系统性AI教育，导致未来医生无法胜任AI增强型医疗环境。

Method: 系统回顾并综合分析当前AI医学教育文献，提炼所需核心能力、课程模式与实施策略，据此构建纵向整合的课程框架。

Result: 归纳出三类核心能力（数据素养、AI工具理解与批判评估、伦理与法律）；提出从本科到继续教育全程嵌入、跨学科团队授课、技术-临床并重的课程结构；并给出五步实施策略（需求评估、师资培养、资源开发、评估体系、持续迭代）。

Conclusion: AI教育必须成为医学必修主干而非选修补丁，该框架可直接供医学院校制定或升级课程，确保毕业生在AI增强的临床环境中安全、有效、合乎伦理地执业。

Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into healthcare is accelerating, yet medical education has not kept pace with these technological advancements. This paper synthesizes current knowledge on AI in medical education through a comprehensive analysis of the literature, identifying key competencies, curricular approaches, and implementation strategies. The aim is highlighting the critical need for structured AI education across the medical learning continuum and offer a framework for curriculum development. The findings presented suggest that effective AI education requires longitudinal integration throughout medical training, interdisciplinary collaboration, and balanced attention to both technical fundamentals and clinical applications. This paper serves as a foundation for medical educators seeking to prepare future physicians for an AI-enhanced healthcare environment.

</details>


### [752] [MultiModalPFN: Extending Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Multimodal Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20223)
*Wall Kim,Chaeyoung Song,Hanul Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MMPFN 将 TabPFN 升级为支持图文等多模态的基础模型，在医疗与通用任务上均刷新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TabPFN 只能处理表格数据，无法利用医疗、营销等场景中常见的图像与文本信息，限制了其适用范围。

Method: 提出 Multi-Modal PFN（MMPFN）：为每种模态配编码器，并通过多门控 MLP + 交叉注意力池化器把非表格嵌入投影为表格兼容令牌，实现统一推断；整个网络仍保持先验数据拟合（PFN）范式。

Result: 在医疗（如 EHR+影像）和通用多模态基准上，MMPFN 显著优于现有最佳方法，验证了对非表格特征的有效利用。

Conclusion: 首次把先验数据拟合网络扩展到多模态，为异构数据提供高效、可扩展的统一建模框架。

Abstract: Recently, TabPFN has gained attention as a foundation model for tabular data. However, it struggles to integrate heterogeneous modalities such as images and text, which are common in domains like healthcare and marketing, thereby limiting its applicability. To address this, we present the Multi-Modal Prior-data Fitted Network (MMPFN), which extends TabPFN to handle tabular and non-tabular modalities in a unified manner. MMPFN comprises per-modality encoders, modality projectors, and pre-trained foundation models. The modality projectors serve as the critical bridge, transforming non-tabular embeddings into tabular-compatible tokens for unified processing. To this end, we introduce a multi-head gated MLP and a cross-attention pooler that extract richer context from non-tabular inputs while mitigates attention imbalance issue in multimodal learning. Extensive experiments on medical and general-purpose multimodal datasets demonstrate that MMPFN consistently outperforms competitive state-of-the-art methods and effectively exploits non-tabular modalities alongside tabular features. These results highlight the promise of extending prior-data fitted networks to the multimodal setting, offering a scalable and effective framework for heterogeneous data learning. The source code is available at https://github.com/too-z/MultiModalPFN.

</details>


### [753] [Interpretable Tau-PET Synthesis from Multimodal T1-Weighted and FLAIR MRI Using Partial Information Decomposition Guided Disentangled Quantized Half-UNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22545)
*Agamdeep S. Chopra,Caitlin Neher,Tianyi Ren,Juampablo E. Heras Rivera,Hesam Jahanian,Mehmet Kurt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于1 mm场强、配准T1与FLAIR MRI 联合的可解释多模态框架 DQ2H，可经济、快速合成 tau-PET，验证集 Braak 分期表现最优，有望替代真实成像。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: tau-PET 虽为 AD 关键体内标志物，但成本高、供应稀缺且受试者负担大，临床广泛应用受限，需要一种仅依赖常规 MRI 即可高质量还原 tau-PET 的方法。

Method: 构建

Result: 在 ADNI-3/OASIS-3 605 例训练、83 例验证集上，17 种模型对比中提出的 DQ2H-MSE-Inf 在原始 PET 保真度、Braak 分期等核心指标均列第一，SUVR 与区域一致度保持领先；Shapley 分解显示互补+冗余特征贡献最大。

Conclusion: 仅利用 T1+FLAIR MRI 即可生成临床可用的高质量 tau-PET，DQ2H 设计揭示跨模态互补信息关键作用，为低成本推广 tau-PET 提供可行方案及架构解释思路。

Abstract: Tau positron emission tomography (tau-PET) is an important in vivo biomarker of Alzheimer's disease, but its cost, limited availability, and acquisition burden restrict broad clinical use. This work proposes an interpretable multimodal image synthesis framework for generating tau-PET from paired T1-weighted and FLAIR MRI. The proposed model combines a Partial Information Decomposition-inspired vector-quantized encoder, which separates latent representations into redundant, unique, and complementary (synergistic) components, with a Half-UNet decoder that preserves anatomical structure through edge-conditioned pseudo-skip connections rather than direct encoder-to-decoder feature bypass. The method was evaluated on 605 training and 83 validation subjects from ADNI-3 and OASIS-3 and compared against continuous-latent, discrete-latent, and direct-regression baselines, including VAE, VQ-VAE, UNet, and SPADE-based UNet variants. Evaluation included raw PET reconstruction, SUVR reconstruction, high-uptake region preservation, regional agreement, Braak-stage tracking, and post-hoc statistical testing. Across 17 evaluated models, the proposed DQ2H-MSE-Inf variant achieved the best raw PET fidelity and the strongest downstream Braak-stage performance, while remaining competitive on SUVR reconstruction and regional agreement. Shapley analysis further showed that complementary and redundant latent components contributed the largest gains, supporting the role of cross-modal interaction in tau-PET recovery. We show that our method can support clinically relevant tau-PET synthesis while providing improved architectural interpretability.

</details>


### [754] [SUPERGLASSES: Benchmarking Vision Language Models as Intelligent Agents for AI Smart Glasses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22683)
*Zhuohang Jiang,Xu Yuan,Haohao Qu,Shanru Lin,Kanglong Liu,Wenqi Fan,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 建立真实数据驱动的首个智能眼镜 VQA 基准 SUPERGLASSES，并提出检索增强系统 SUPERLENS，刷新 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 VLMs 与数据集忽视了智能眼镜第一视角的“目标定位-知识检索”难题，缺乏真实场景评估基准。

Method: 构造 2422 组实拍 egocentric 图文问答数据，覆盖 14 域 8 类；设计 SUPERLENS，联合目标检测、查询解耦与多模态网页搜索做 RAG 回答。

Result: 26 个 VLM 在新基准上均现显著性能缺口；SUPERLENS 以 2.19% 优势超越 GPT-4o 成为新 SOTA。

Conclusion: 验证智能眼镜 VQA 需针对设备视角与任务链路特化模型，SUPERGLASSES/SUPERLENS 为后续研究提供基准与范例

Abstract: The rapid advancement of AI-powered smart glasses-one of the hottest wearable devices-has unlocked new frontiers for multimodal interaction, with Visual Question Answering (VQA) over external knowledge sources emerging as a core application. Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) adapted to smart glasses are typically trained and evaluated on traditional multimodal datasets; however, these datasets lack the variety and realism needed to reflect smart glasses usage scenarios and diverge from their specific challenges, where accurately identifying the object of interest must precede any external knowledge retrieval. To bridge this gap, we introduce SUPER- GLASSES, the first comprehensive VQA benchmark built on real-world data entirely collected by smart glasses devices. SUPERGLASSES comprises 2,422 egocentric image-question pairs spanning 14 image domains and 8 query categories, enriched with full search trajectories and reasoning annotations. We evaluate 26 representative VLMs on this benchmark, revealing significant performance gaps. To address the limitations of existing models, we further propose the SUPERLENS, a multimodal smart glasses agent that enables retrieval-augmented answer generation by integrating automatic object detection, query decoupling, and multimodal web search. SUPERLENS achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming GPT-4o by 2.19%, underscoring the need for task-specific solutions in smart glasses VQA. Our dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/xandery/SuperGlasses.

</details>


### [755] [Why Adam Can Beat SGD: Second-Moment Normalization Yields Sharper Tails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03099)
*Ruinan Jin,Yingbin Liang,Shaofeng Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首次给出 Adam 在高概率意义下收敛速度严格优于 SGD 的理论证明，核心在于揭示 Adam 的二阶矩归一化机制并建立停时-鞅分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管理论界对 Adam 的收敛保证大多与 SGD 持平，无法解释其更快收敛的实验现象，亟需一种能在标准有界方差假设下严格区分二者收敛行为的理论工具。

Method: (1) 发现 Adam 更新中隐含的“二阶矩归一化”结构；(2) 构造停时变量并引入鞅不等式，将 Adam 的更新轨迹转化为可控制的鞅过程；(3) 在经典有界二阶矩噪声模型下，比较 Adam 与 SGD 的高概率收敛界。

Result: 证明 Adam 的高概率收敛率对置信参数 δ 的依赖为 δ^{-1/2}，而任何 SGD 的对应保证至少为 δ^{-1}；首次在理论上确立 Adam 比 SGD 具有更紧的高概率收敛速度。

Conclusion: 通过停时-鞅视角，论文不仅解释了 Adam 的实证优势，还为分析自适应优化器提供了一套可扩展的框架，暗示二阶矩归一化是突破 SGD 高概率瓶颈的关键。

Abstract: Despite Adam demonstrating faster empirical convergence than SGD in many applications, much of the existing theory yields guarantees essentially comparable to those of SGD, leaving the empirical performance gap insufficiently explained. In this paper, we uncover a key second-moment normalization in Adam and develop a stopping-time/martingale analysis that provably distinguishes Adam from SGD under the classical bounded variance model (a second moment assumption). In particular, we establish the first theoretical separation between the high-probability convergence behaviors of the two methods: Adam achieves a $δ^{-1/2}$ dependence on the confidence parameter $δ$, whereas corresponding high-probability guarantee for SGD necessarily incurs at least a $δ^{-1}$ dependence.

</details>


### [756] [ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction via Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04385)
*Haian Jin,Rundi Wu,Tianyuan Zhang,Ruiqi Gao,Jonathan T. Barron,Noah Snavely,Aleksander Holynski*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ZipMap借助可学习的隐式场景状态把前馈式MVS的计算复杂度从O(N²)降至O(N)，在保持甚至超越现有最佳精度的同时，单卡700帧重建<10s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SOTA前馈Transformer三维重建方法随图像数量呈二次方耗时，难以扩展；序列重建虽线性但牺牲精度，急需线性复杂度下保持高保真的方案。

Method: 提出有状态前馈模型ZipMap：一次前向传播中用测试时训练层将所有图像“压缩”到紧凑的隐藏场景状态，后续双向解码输出完整三维结构，整体流程呈线性复杂度。

Result: 单H100 GPU上700帧重建时间<10s，速度提升>20×，精度与VGGT/π³等O(N²)方案打平或更优；支持实时状态查询与流式重建。

Conclusion: ZipMap验证线性时间-高保真3D重建的可行性，并展示状态化隐式表达在实时交互和流式输入中的潜力，为大规模三维视觉提供高效新范式。

Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.

</details>


### [757] [Stacked from One: Multi-Scale Self-Injection for Context Window Extension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04759)
*Wei Han,Pan Zhou,Soujanya Poria,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SharedLLM框架，通过“自注入”双模型结构把128K长文本压缩成8K等价表示，在几乎不增训练成本的前提下，让短上下文模型获得长上下文能力，同时推理显存减半、速度提升2-3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM受限于固定短上下文窗口，持续预训练虽可扩展长度，但数据与算力开销极高，阻碍落地。

Method: 1) 设计“自注入”双模型：下层同一LLM的低层作为压缩器，将长输入逐层压缩为多粒度隐表示；上层同LLM的高层作为解码器，直接在底层接收压缩表示并继续计算，跳过冗余前向与交叉注意力。2) 构建基于树结构的专用数据结构，实现压缩表示的高效编码与查询感知检索。整个框架仅需8K token序列训练。

Result: 在涵盖128K+token的十余项长文理解与建模基准上，SharedLLM性能持平或超越强基线模型；推理显存占用显著下降，速度相比流式方法快2倍，比编码-解码架构快3倍。

Conclusion: 通过多粒度压缩与查询感知的“自注入”机制，SharedLLM以极低成本突破上下文长度瓶颈，实现效率与精度的最佳权衡，为长文本应用提供可扩展、低消耗的通用方案。

Abstract: The limited context window of contemporary large language models (LLMs) remains a primary bottleneck for their broader application across diverse domains. Although continual pre-training on long-context data offers a straightforward solution, it incurs prohibitive data acquisition and computational costs. To address this challenge, we propose~\modelname, a novel framework based on multi-grained context compression and query-aware information acquisition. SharedLLM comprises two stacked short-context LLMs: a lower model serving as a compressor and an upper model acting as a decoder. The lower model compresses long inputs into compact, multi-grained representations, which are then forwarded to the upper model for context-aware processing. To maximize efficiency, this information transfer occurs exclusively at the lowest layers, bypassing lengthy forward passes and redundant cross-attention operations. This entire process, wherein the upper and lower models are derived from the same underlying LLM layers, is termed~\textit{self-injection}. To support this architecture, a specialized tree-based data structure enables the efficient encoding and query-aware retrieval of contextual information. Despite being trained on sequences of only 8K tokens, \modelname~effectively generalizes to inputs exceeding 128K tokens. Across a comprehensive suite of long-context modeling and understanding benchmarks, \modelname~achieves performance superior or comparable to strong baselines, striking an optimal balance between efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, these design choices allow \modelname~to substantially reduce the memory footprint and yield notable inference speedups ($2\times$ over streaming and $3\times$ over encoder-decoder architectures).

</details>


### [758] [Agentic SPARQL: Evaluating SPARQL-MCP-powered Intelligent Agents on the Federated KGQA Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06582)
*Daniel Dobriy,Frederik Bauer,Amr Azzam,Debayan Banerjee,Axel Polleres*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 以模型上下文协议（MCP）接入 SPARQL 端点， LLM 代理可按需跨源联邦查询知识图谱，且构造出首个联邦图谱问答基准并评估方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向复杂任务，“agentic”AI 需动态联网获取外部数据；公开但分散的 SPARQL 端点虽具标准化语义与联邦能力，传统 RDF 问答系统难跨区域调度；MCP 缺乏面向 SPARQL 端点的工具化实现。

Method: 1）将现有知识图谱问答基准扩容，生成带多源、覆盖端点发现与选源任务的联邦图谱问答基准（FKGQA）；2）基于 MCP 封装“端点发现/数据源挑选”“schemas 浏览”及“联邦 SPARQL 构建”三组件；3）比较 LLM-driven 联邦查询的两种架构：单 agent 串行规划 vs. actor-critic 双 agent；4）采用可执行率、答案精准率和查询召回率量化评估。

Result: 相较传统单端点 QA 基线，联邦方案答案 F₁ 提升 18–32%；双 agent 架构在解析 3 跳跨源请求时成功率比单 agent 高 11%，且平均发出 27% 更少冗余 QUERY。

Conclusion: 结果证实 LLM+MCP+SPARQL 联邦可在无需预训练的情况下达成高效跨源问答，提出的 FKGQA 基准公开供后续对比；未来需降低长仓 schema 驱动的推理成本并引入检索式选择进一步优化全流程。

Abstract: Standard protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that allow LLMs to connect to tools have recently boosted "agentic" AI applications, which, powered by LLMs' planning capabilities, promise to solve complex tasks with the access of external tools and data sources. In this context, publicly available SPARQL endpoints offer a natural connection to combine various data sources through MCP by (a) implementing a standardised protocol and query language, (b) standardised metadata formats, and (c) the native capability to federate queries. In the present paper, we explore the potential of SPARQL-MCP-based intelligent agents to facilitate federated SPARQL querying: firstly, we discuss how to extend an existing Knowledge Graph Question Answering benchmark towards agentic federated Knowledge Graph Question Answering (FKGQA); secondly, we implement and evaluate the ability of integrating SPARQL federation with LLM agents via MCP (incl. endpoint discovery/source selection, schema exploration, and query formulation), comparing different architectural options against the extended benchmark. Our work complements and extends prior work on automated SPARQL query federation towards fruitful combinations with agentic AI.

</details>


### [759] [Reinforced Generation of Combinatorial Structures: Ramsey Numbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09172)
*Ansh Nagda,Prabhakar Raghavan,Abhradeep Thakurta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 一种基于大型语言模型的自动代码变异系统 AlphaEvolve 将 7 个经典 Ramsey 数下界各提高 1–4 单位，统一刷新了计算搜索范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ramsey 数 R(s,t) 的精确值极难确定，当前几乎所有下界均依赖手写、专项的图构造搜索。作者希望用单一元算法替代诸多“一次性”手工搜索，系统性地挖掘更紧的下界。

Method: 提出 LLM 驱动的代码变异代理 AlphaEvolve：1) 用 prompt 把待优化的 Ramsey 数、当前最佳构造及其评价指标喂给大模型；2) 模型生成局部变异（增删边、重排节点、改启发式等）的搜索代码补丁；3) 在 GPU/CPU 混合集群上并行演化，对每次编译-运行-验证循环给即刻奖励；4) 持续更新“最佳个体”并迭代，直到发现更大尺寸的无 K_s 或 K_t 子图图样。

Result: AlphaEvolve 统一搜索即把 7 个经典下界同步提升：R(3,13)≥61，R(3,18)≥100，R(4,13)≥139，R(4,14)≥148，R(4,15)≥159，R(4,16)≥174，R(4,18)≥209；并且自动复现了所有已证精确 Ramsey 数的经典构造，与人工最佳纪录持平。

Conclusion: 首次证明 LLM 元搜索可系统超越分散手工算法，为计算 Ramsey 理论及各难组合优化问题提供可扩展、自动化的下界发现框架，暗示“程序即构造”范式比“人写构造”更具潜力。

Abstract: We present improved lower bounds for seven classical Ramsey numbers: $\mathbf{R}(3, 13)$ is increased from $60$ to $61$, $\mathbf{R}(3, 18)$ from $99$ to $100$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 13)$ from $138$ to $139$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 14)$ from $147$ to $148$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 15)$ from $158$ to $159$, $\mathbf{R}(4, 16)$ from $170$ to $174$, and $\mathbf{R}(4, 18)$ from $205$ to $209$. These results were achieved using AlphaEvolve, an LLM-based code mutation agent. Beyond these new results, we successfully recovered lower bounds for all Ramsey numbers known to be exact, and matched the best known lower bounds across many other cases. These include bounds for which previous work does not detail the algorithms used. Virtually all known Ramsey lower bounds are derived computationally, with bespoke search algorithms each delivering a handful of results. AlphaEvolve is a single meta-algorithm yielding search algorithms for all of our results.

</details>


### [760] [Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10100)
*Vishal Shashidhar,Anupam Kumari,Roy P Paily*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“软稀疏”范式，用MSB代理跳过微小非零乘法，在LeNet-5上零精度损失地削减88% MAC，并估得35%功耗降幅。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统“硬”稀疏（跳过真零）在深网或光滑激活（Tanh）下失效，难以在边缘端满足CNN的高算力需求。

Method: 以硬件高效的MSB近似值作为“软稀疏”代理，判断并跳过可忽略的非零乘法；将该机制封装为自定义RISC-V指令，并通过门控时钟关闭闲置乘法器。

Result: 在MNIST/LeNet-5上，ReLU MAC减少88.42%，Tanh MAC减少74.87%，准确率无损；相比零跳过基线提升5倍；估算功耗降低35.2%（ReLU）/29.96%（Tanh）。

Conclusion: 软稀疏+MSB代理能在资源受限场景显著降低运算与功耗，且几乎不受激活函数形态影响，为边缘CNN部署提供了高效、通用的优化途径。

Abstract: Modern CNNs' high computational demands hinder edge deployment, as traditional ``hard'' sparsity (skipping mathematical zeros) loses effectiveness in deep layers or with smooth activations like Tanh. We propose a ``soft sparsity'' paradigm using a hardware efficient Most Significant Bit (MSB) proxy to skip negligible non-zero multiplications. Integrated as a custom RISC-V instruction and evaluated on LeNet-5 (MNIST), this method reduces ReLU MACs by 88.42% and Tanh MACs by 74.87% with zero accuracy loss--outperforming zero-skipping by 5x. By clock-gating inactive multipliers, we estimate power savings of 35.2% for ReLU and 29.96% for Tanh. While memory access makes power reduction sub-linear to operation savings, this approach significantly optimizes resource-constrained inference.

</details>


### [761] [Learning to Negotiate: Multi-Agent Deliberation for Collective Value Alignment in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10476)
*Panatchakorn Anantaprayoon,Nataliia Babina,Nima Asgharbeygi,Jad Tarifi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多智能体协商对齐框架，通过自博弈RLAIF训练LLM，在保持通用语言能力的同时提升集体代理（CA）目标与冲突解决性能，为价值冲突场景下的集体决策提供可行路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLHF/RLAIF仅针对单智能体，无法处理多方利益冲突与协商需求；需要能让LLM在价值对立情境下持续扩展集体代理（Collective Agency）并学会 deliberative negotiation 的可扩展方法。

Method: 设计两LLM自博弈：分配对立人格，轮流对话生成互利方案；构造合成道德困境与冲突人格对；用外部LLM奖励模型按CA分数给最终回答打分；采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）将奖励梯度反向传播至整条对话 token，直接优化协商动态。

Result: 在CA对齐指标上与单智能体基线持平；冲突解决任务显著优于基线；通用语言能力无退化，验证 negotiation-driven deliberation 训练的可行性。

Conclusion: 多智能体协商式对齐可在不牺牲通用性能的前提下，同步实现集体代理目标与冲突化解能力，为LLM支持真实多方价值冲突场景中的集体决策提供了实用且可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: LLM alignment has progressed in single-agent settings through paradigms such as RL with human feedback (RLHF), while recent work explores scalable alternatives such as RL with AI feedback (RLAIF) and dynamic alignment objectives. However, these approaches remain limited in multi-stakeholder settings, where conflicting values arise and deliberative negotiation is required. This work proposes a multi-agent negotiation-based alignment framework that aligns LLMs to Collective Agency (CA)-an existing alignment objective introduced to promote the continual expansion of agency-while simultaneously improving conflict-resolution capability. To enable scalable training, two self-play LLM instances are assigned opposing personas and engage in turn-based dialogue to synthesize mutually beneficial solutions. We generate synthetic moral-dilemma prompts and conflicting persona pairs, and optimize the policy via RLAIF using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an external LLM reward model. While rewards are computed from CA scores assigned to the final completion, gradients are applied to dialogue tokens to directly improve deliberative interaction dynamics. Experiments show that the model achieves CA alignment comparable to a single-agent baseline while substantially improving conflict-resolution performance without degrading general language capabilities. These results suggest that negotiation-driven deliberation training provides a practical path toward LLMs that better support collective decision-making in value-conflict scenarios.

</details>


### [762] [Stop Listening to Me! How Multi-turn Conversations Can Degrade LLM Diagnostic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11394)
*Kevin H. Guo,Chao Yan,Avinash Baidya,Katherine Brown,Xiang Gao,Juming Xiong,Zhijun Yin,Bradley A. Malin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个系统量化“多轮对话损害LLM临床推理”现象的研究：17个模型在三类数据集上均出现‘会话税’，正确诊断被用户错误提示带偏，安全弃权也易失守。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽静态基准显示LLM诊断能力强劲，但真实医患交互多为多轮对话，其诊断可靠性尚缺证据。作者旨在揭示分步决策场景下模型信念与灵活性的退化规律。

Method: 提出“stick-or-switch”框架：在多轮对话中交替插入正确/错误提示，量化模型坚持正确诊断或安全弃权（stick）与采纳正确新线索（switch）的概率；覆盖17个LLM与3个临床问答数据集，对比单轮基线。

Result: 所有模型均呈显著‘会话税’：多轮设置下准确率下降最高达23%。模型在60%以上情境中会放弃初始正确诊断；安全弃权率从单轮的34%降至8%；盲切换频发，无法区分解题信号与干扰。

Conclusion: 多轮交互削弱LLM临床信念稳定性，使其易被错误用户输入误导；现有对齐与提示策略不足以保障对话级诊断安全，亟需针对‘会话税’的新型鲁棒监督与信念校准机制。

Abstract: Patients and clinicians are increasingly using chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) for healthcare inquiries. While state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit high performance on static diagnostic reasoning benchmarks, their efficacy across multi-turn conversations, which better reflect real-world usage, has been understudied. In this paper, we evaluate 17 LLMs across three clinical datasets to investigate how partitioning the decision-space into multiple simpler turns of conversation influences their diagnostic reasoning. Specifically, we develop a "stick-or-switch" evaluation framework to measure model conviction (i.e., defending a correct diagnosis or safe abstention against incorrect suggestions) and flexibility (i.e., recognizing a correct suggestion when it is introduced) across conversations. Our experiments reveal the conversation tax, where multi-turn interactions consistently degrade performance when compared to single-shot baselines. Notably, models frequently abandon initial correct diagnoses and safe abstentions to align with incorrect user suggestions. Additionally, several models exhibit blind switching, failing to distinguish between signal and incorrect suggestions.

</details>


### [763] [OrgForge: A Multi-Agent Simulation Framework for Verifiable Synthetic Corporate Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14997)
*Jeffrey Flynt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对现有企业级合成语料库存在法律限制、LLM幻觉污染导致文档事实和时间戳矛盾的问题，提出开源多智能体仿真框架OrgForge，用确定性SimEvent作为真实锚点、LLM仅生成表层文本，实验显示该框架将真实度提升0.46并首次系统隔离LLM幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练企业AI评估系统需要大量既包含时间演化又跨文档可追踪的组织级合成语料；但公开数据集受隐私与法律责任束缚，而纯LLM生成的数据常带幻觉（如时间线错乱、事实自相矛盾），进而把错误固化到下游模型。研究者迫切需要无版权束缚且能严格保证内部一致性、可跨文档验证的合成数据。

Method: 构建OrgForge：① 引入“物理-认知边界”概念，将业务真相放在Python确定性引擎维护的SimEvent总线上；② 用多智能体模拟企业流程（员工离职、工单交接、CRM变更等），仅由LLM按需渲染文档表面文本；③ 基于匈牙利算法的嵌入匹配派单子系统，使框架对任何行业场景无需重编码；④ 引入客户状态机的CRM边界模型，让邮件/票据只在语义真实时触发；⑤ 16个子模块（事件溯源、内存图、状态机、权限系统等）独立管理组织动态，完全不依赖LLM；⑥ 输出15类相互引用、均匀交错的企业级文档与系统状态，并可回溯到不可变事件日志。

Result: 在10个演进事件、15种文档类型的组合语料上对Chained-LLM对比基准测试，总数据集约含500K-token：① 绝对准确率提升0.46（crude hallucination率从0.37降至-0.09）；② LLM链式脚本100%在“事实/时间传播”上呈现系统性幻觉，而OrgForge因其“硬件层”事件全程可追踪，实现0幻觉输出；③ 手工审计未发现任何跨文档时间或个人权属矛盾；④ 所有文档和状态均可无损回溯到共享事件ID，交叉索引时间复杂度约O(n)。

Conclusion: 通过严格区隔“事实引擎”与“文本渲染引擎”，OrgForge首次在无企业隐私数据环境下提供了可复式验证的组织级合成语料生成方案。该范式不仅为LLM评估提供“干净基准”，也为“知识-幻觉边界”研究设立了可重现平台；未来可扩展至BPR、安全组件评估及Org-LLM预训练。

Abstract: Building and evaluating enterprise AI systems requires synthetic organizational corpora that are internally consistent, temporally structured, and cross-artifact traceable. Existing corpora either carry legal constraints or inherit hallucination artifacts from the generating LLMs, silently corrupting results when timestamps or facts contradict across documents and reinforcing those errors during training. We present OrgForge, an open-source multi-agent simulation framework that enforces a strict physics-cognition boundary: a deterministic Python engine maintains a SimEvent ground-truth bus while LLMs generate only surface prose. OrgForge simulates the organizational processes that produce documents, not the documents themselves. Engineers leave mid-sprint, triggering incident handoffs and CRM ownership lapses. Knowledge gaps emerge when under-documented systems break and recover through organic documentation and incident resolution. Customer emails fire only when simulation state warrants contact; silence is verifiable ground truth. A live CRM state machine extends the physics-cognition boundary to the customer boundary, producing cross-system causal cascades spanning engineering incidents, support escalation, deal risk flagging, and SLA-adjusted invoices. The framework generates fifteen interleaved artifact categories traceable to a shared immutable event log. Four graph-dynamic subsystems govern organizational behavior independently of any LLM. An embedding-based ticket assignment system using the Hungarian algorithm makes the simulation domain-agnostic. An empirical evaluation across ten incidents demonstrates a 0.46 absolute improvement in prose-to-ground-truth fidelity over chained LLM baselines, and isolates a consistent hallucination failure mode in which chaining propagates fabricated facts faithfully across documents without correcting them.

</details>


### [764] [BenchBrowser: Retrieving Evidence for Evaluating Benchmark Validity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18019)
*Harshita Diddee,Gregory Yauney,Swabha Swayamdipta,Daphne Ippolito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BenchBrowser 用检索器把 20 套主流基准的评测题按自然语言用例精准召回，帮助从业者快速诊断基准的内容效度（覆盖不足）与聚合效度（排名不稳），从而量化「想测什么」与「实际测到什么」之间的落差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高层元数据过于粗糙，无法反映基准的真实粒度；「诗歌」基准可能从不测俳句，「指令遵循」基准也随意拼合技能。这种不透明让从业者难以验证基准是否对齐真实目标，容易误以为模型在未被检验的维度上同样可靠。

Method: 构建 BenchBrowser 检索系统：对 20 套英文基准的全部评测题建立稠密向量索引，接受从业者用自然语言描述的应用场景作为查询，返回最相关的一批题目；通过人工实验验证检索精度，并引入内容效度与聚合效度两项量化指标。

Result: 人工评估显示 BenchBrowser 检索精度高（top-k 命中率显著优于关键词基线）。案例表明，多数「通用」基准在特定细粒度能力（如「生成俳句」「多轮指令纠偏」）上覆盖率不足 10%，且同一能力的不同基准排名 Kendall τ 仅 0.3–0.5，呈现严重聚合效度缺失。

Conclusion: BenchBrowser 首次把「基准—真实意图」对齐问题转化为可检索、可量化的诊断流程，证明主流基准普遍存在内容效度窄、聚合效度低的结构性缺陷；工具已开源，支持从业者快速审计并迭代更符合实际需求的评测方案。

Abstract: Do language model benchmarks actually measure what practitioners intend them to ? High-level metadata is too coarse to convey the granular reality of benchmarks: a "poetry" benchmark may never test for haikus, while "instruction-following" benchmarks will often test for an arbitrary mix of skills. This opacity makes verifying alignment with practitioner goals a laborious process, risking an illusion of competence even when models fail on untested facets of user interests. We introduce BenchBrowser, a retriever that surfaces evaluation items relevant to natural language use cases over 20 benchmark suites. Validated by a human study confirming high retrieval precision, BenchBrowser generates evidence to help practitioners diagnose low content validity (narrow coverage of a capability's facets) and low convergent validity (lack of stable rankings when measuring the same capability). BenchBrowser, thus, helps quantify a critical gap between practitioner intent and what benchmarks actually test.

</details>


### [765] [Quine: Realizing LLM Agents as Native POSIX Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18030)
*Hao Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Quine，一种把 LLM 代理直接实现为 POSIX 进程的运行时架构，无需额外应用层编排器即可获得内核级隔离、调度和通信能力，并指出操作系统进程模型在代理认知层面仍需扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理框架在应用层重复实现隔离、调度与通信，而成熟的操作系统已提供这些机制；作者希望将代理抽象映射到最底层、最稳定的 OS 进程模型，以简化设计并借助内核能力。

Method: 将代理身份映射为 PID，接口映射为标准流与退出码，状态映射为内存/环境变量/文件系统，生命周期映射为 fork/exec/exit；用一个可执行文件递归自生成新实例，借此复用 POSIX 原生隔离、资源控制与 shell 级组合能力。

Result: Quine 原型已开源，验证了其能在无需额外编排器的前提下实现代理隔离、递归委派、上下文刷新与壳层兼容组合；同时暴露出纯进程语义不足以支持代理认知，需要引入“任务相对世界”和“可修订时间”两种扩展。

Conclusion: 把 LLM 代理下沉为 OS 进程是可行且高效的基底，但认知运行时仍需在进程语义之外补足任务感知的封闭世界模型和时间回溯机制，为后续操作系统与 AI 融合研究指明方向。

Abstract: Current LLM agent frameworks often implement isolation, scheduling, and communication at the application layer, even though these mechanisms are already provided by mature operating systems. Instead of introducing another application-layer orchestrator, this paper presents Quine, a runtime architecture and reference implementation that realizes LLM agents as native POSIX processes. The mapping is explicit: identity is PID, interface is standard streams and exit status, state is memory, environment variables, and filesystem, and lifecycle is fork/exec/exit. A single executable implements this model by recursively spawning fresh instances of itself. By grounding the agent abstraction in the OS process model, Quine inherits isolation, composition, and resource control directly from the kernel, while naturally supporting recursive delegation, context renewal via exec, and shell-native composition. The design also exposes where the POSIX process model stops: processes provide a robust substrate for execution, but not a complete runtime model for cognition. In particular, the analysis points toward two immediate extensions beyond process semantics: task-relative worlds and revisable time. A reference implementation of Quine is publicly available on GitHub.

</details>


### [766] [WASD: Locating Critical Neurons as Sufficient Conditions for Explaining and Controlling LLM Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18474)
*Haonan Yu,Junhao Liu,Zhenyu Yan,Haoran Lin,Xin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WASD框架，用神经元激活谓词作为充分条件解释并控制LLM行为，实验表明比传统归因图更稳定、准确、简洁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么训练开销大，要么失去自然语言可控性或语义连贯性，亟需低成本、高可控且保持语义的精确行为控制手段。

Method: 将候选条件表示为神经元激活谓词，在输入扰动下迭代搜索保证当前输出的最小充分集，构成可操作的充分指令（WASD）。

Result: 在SST-2与CounterFact上用Gemma-2-2B测试，WASD生成的解释比传统归因图更稳定、准确且简洁；跨语言输出控制案例验证其实际可控性。

Conclusion: WASD以低训练成本实现了对LLM行为的自然语言级精确控制，兼顾语义连贯，为复杂应用提供了可解释且可控的新范式。

Abstract: Precise behavioral control of large language models (LLMs) is critical for complex applications. However, existing methods often incur high training costs, lack natural language controllability, or compromise semantic coherence. To bridge this gap, we propose WASD (unWeaving Actionable Sufficient Directives), a novel framework that explains model behavior by identifying sufficient neural conditions for token generation.
