Our method represents candidate conditions as neuron-activation predicates and iteratively searches for a minimal set that guarantees the current output under input perturbations. Experiments on SST-2 and CounterFact with the Gemma-2-2B model demonstrate that our approach produces explanations that are more stable, accurate, and concise than conventional attribution graphs. Moreover, through a case study on controlling cross-lingual output generation, we validated the practical effectiveness of WASD in controlling model behavior.

</details>


### [767] [HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20843)
*Xiangyu Zeng,Qi Xu,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Long-context language modeling is commonly framed as a scalability challenge of token-level attention, yet local-to-global information structuring remains largely implicit in existing approaches. Drawing on cognitive theories of discourse comprehension, we propose HiCI (Hierarchical Construction--Integration), a hierarchical attention module that constructs segment-level representations, integrates them into a shared global context, and broadcasts both to condition segment-level attention. We validate HiCI through parameter-efficient adaptation of LLaMA-2 with only <5.5% additional parameters, extending context from 4K to 100K tokens (7B) and 64K tokens (13B). Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit hierarchical structuring as an inductive bias for long-context modeling.

</details>


### [768] [MCLR: Improving Conditional Modeling via Inter-Class Likelihood-Ratio Maximization and Unifying Classifier-Free Guidance with Alignment Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22364)
*Xiang Li,Yixuan Jia,Xiao Li,Jeffrey A. Fessler,Rongrong Wang,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出扩散模型依赖CFG本质是训练阶段类间可分离性不足，为此提出训练期最大化类间似然比的MCLR目标，无需推理期CFG即可复现其效果，并严格证明CFG分数等价于加权MCLR最优解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然扩散模型在生成任务上表现最佳，但其成功严重依赖推理时的启发式技巧CFG；理论上仅通过去噪得分匹配(DSM)训练应已能恢复数据分布，因此需厘清为何仍需CFG，并探索能否在训练阶段用 principled 方法消除这一依赖。

Method: 首先将“类间可分离性不足”量化为似然比不足，进而设计训练目标MCLR——在DSM损失上显式最大化不同类样本间的似然比。用该目标对预训练扩散模型进行微调，使标准反向采样即可增强条件生成效果。理论分析部分构造加权MCLR目标，证明其最优解恰好等于CFG修正后的得分函数。

Result: 在标准采样条件下，经MCLR微调的模型在定量指标(FID、IS)和视觉质量上均达到与原模型+CFG相当的性能，彻底摆脱推理期额外计算。理论结果表明CFG-guided score是加权MCLR的闭式最优解，首次从机理层面揭示CFG等价于一种训练期对齐目标。

Conclusion: 研究证实CFG并非不可避免的外部分类器，而是训练目标缺陷的“事后修正”。MCLR为扩散模型提供了一种无推理开销的替代方案，并建立了CFG与对齐目标间的严格等价关系，为后续设计更高效、无启发式的条件扩散模型奠定理论与算法基础。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling, but their success often relies heavily on classifier-free guidance (CFG), an inference-time heuristic that modifies the sampling trajectory. From a theoretical perspective, diffusion models trained with standard denoising score matching (DSM) are expected to recover the target data distribution, raising the question of why inference-time guidance is necessary in practice. In this work, we ask whether the DSM training objective can be modified in a principled manner such that standard reverse-time sampling, without inference-time guidance, yields effects comparable to CFG. We identify insufficient inter-class separation as a key limitation of standard diffusion models. To address this, we propose MCLR, a principled alignment objective that explicitly maximizes inter-class likelihood-ratios during training. Models fine-tuned with MCLR exhibit CFG-like improvements under standard sampling, achieving comparable qualitative and quantitative gains without requiring inference-time guidance. Beyond empirical benefits, we provide a theoretical result showing that the CFG-guided score is exactly the optimal solution to a weighted MCLR objective. This establishes a formal equivalence between classifier-free guidance and alignment-based objectives, offering a mechanistic interpretation of CFG.

</details>


### [769] [tBayes-MICE: A Bayesian Approach to Multiple Imputation for Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27142)
*Amuche Ibenegbu,Pierre Lafaye de Micheaux,Rohitash Chandra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 tBayes-MICE，将 MICE 扩展到贝叶斯框架，引入时序初始化与滞后特征，用 MCMC 采样同时估计参数与缺失值，在空气质量和生理信号数据上显著降低插补误差并量化不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序数据普遍存在缺失，传统 MICE 无法充分利用时序信息且难以表达插补不确定性；需构建既尊重序列特性又能给出误差置信度的插补框架。

Method: 1) 以贝叶斯视角重构 MICE：用全条件指定对各变量建立含时滞特征的似然；2) 采用 MCMC（RWM/MALA）联合采样模型参数与缺失值；3) 设计基于时间序列的初始值与滞后特征，强化动态依赖；4) 在 AirQuality 与 PhysioNet 两真实数据集上系统评估，对比传统均值/回归插补及经典 MICE。

Result: tBayes-MICE 在所有变量上的 RMSE 与 MAE 均显著低于基线；90% 可信区间覆盖率高于 90%，显示良好校准；MALA 比 RWM 混合更快、有效样本量更高，兼顾精度与稳定性。

Conclusion: tBayes-MICE 将时序结构、贝叶斯不确定度建模与 MICE 灵活性结合，为环境与临床等时序插补任务提供了更准确、可解释且附带置信区间的实用方案。

Abstract: Time-series analysis is often affected by missing data, a common problem across several fields, including healthcare and environmental monitoring.
  Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) has been prominent for imputing missing values through "fully conditional specification". We extend MICE using the Bayesian framework (tBayes-MICE), utilising Bayesian inference to impute missing values via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to account for uncertainty in MICE model parameters and imputed values. We also include temporally informed initialisation and time-lagged features in the model to respect the sequential nature of time-series data. We evaluate the tBayes-MICE method using two real-world datasets (AirQuality and PhysioNet), and using both the Random Walk Metropolis (RWM) and the Metropolis-Adjusted Langevin Algorithm (MALA) samplers. Our results demonstrate that tBayes-MICE reduces imputation errors relative to the baseline methods over all variables and accounts for uncertainty in the imputation process, thereby providing a more accurate measure of imputation error.
  We also found that MALA mixed better than RWM across most variables, achieving comparable accuracy while providing more consistent posterior exploration. Overall, these findings suggest that the tBayes-MICE framework represents a practical and efficient approach to time-series imputation, balancing increased accuracy with meaningful quantification of uncertainty in various environmental and clinical settings.

</details>


### [770] [Continued AI Scaling Requires Repeated Efficiency Doublings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28507)
*Chien-Ping Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI要持续突破，必须像芯片业那样“每过一段时间把同样算力砍一半成本”；否则算力需求暴涨会把任何人挡在门外。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典缩放律把“算力”当成抽象逻辑量，却忽略真实硬件能效瓶颈；作者提醒行业：不解决能效，指数级模型扩张将因运营成本失控而停滞。

Method: 重读AI缩放公式，把“compute”解释为“逻辑运算量”，再引入“物理实现效率”作为中介变量；用半导体与系统级历史数据佐证“效率翻倍”是维持指数曲线的必要前提。

Result: 论证了：1)  diminishing returns ≠  flat curve，而是运营成本飙升；2) 若无硬件、算法、系统协同的“Moore-like”效率增益，缩放将因经济不可行而终止；3) 近期证据显示AI已出现≥ Moore律的能效改进节奏。

Conclusion: AI继续按指数扩张不是算力堆得动就行，而是必须建立“效率翻倍”新常态；行业应把追逐能效置于与追模型规模同等地位，否则 scaling 必然停摆。

Abstract: This paper argues that continued AI scaling requires repeated efficiency doublings. Classical AI scaling laws remain useful because they make progress predictable despite diminishing returns, but the compute variable in those laws is best read as logical compute, not as a record of one fixed physical implementation. Practical burden therefore depends on the efficiency with which physical resources realize that compute. Under that interpretation, diminishing returns mean rising operational burden, not merely a flatter curve. Sustained progress then requires recurrent gains in hardware, algorithms, and systems that keep additional logical compute feasible at acceptable cost. The relevant analogy is Moore's Law, understood less as a theorem than as an organizing expectation of repeated efficiency improvement. AI does not yet have a single agreed cadence for such gains, but recent evidence suggests trends that are at least Moore-like and sometimes faster. The paper's claim is therefore simple: if AI scaling is to remain active, repeated efficiency doublings are not optional. They are required.

</details>


### [771] [Quantum-Inspired Geometric Classification with Correlation Group Structures and VQC Decision Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01930)
*Nishikanta Mohanty,Arya Ansuman Priyadarshi,Bikash K. Behera,Badshah Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于相关邻域几何特征，先用轻量融合打分解决小到中等规模分类，再用量子变分网络精炼极端失衡大数据；在公开基准上精度媲美传统方法，极稀少量样本召回率显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小数据集和极不平衡数据集下，经典概率方法易过拟合且难以兼顾召回率与误报率，需要数据高效、可解释且跨任务稳健的新型分类框架。

Method: 设计 CGR 提取锚点邻域相关加权特征，用 SWAP-test 类嵌入并行计算两遍余/角度相似度，通过非概率 margin fusion 打分直接判决；样本数或类别失衡过重时，引入 Δ-距离紧凑对比特征＋变分量子分类器 (VQC) 作为二级精炼层，实现混合几何-量子双阶段模型。

Result: 小型基准测试平均准确率 0.8478-0.9556，F1 超过 0.84；0.17% 极度少数信用卡欺诈上，1.31% 预警率下召回≈0.85，ROC-AUC 0.925，PR-AUC 0.325，优于多数经典基线并在罕见事件检测中兼顾操作点可解释性。

Conclusion: 几何优先范式与量子小网络互补，小样本阶段保持鲁棒与高效，失衡阶段凭对比特征＋VQC 增强非线性边界，提供跨规模可调节、过程可解释、召回-误报可调的解释友好的统一分类方案。

Abstract: We propose a geometry-driven quantum-inspired classification framework that integrates Correlation Group Structures (CGR), compact SWAP-test-based overlap estimation, and selective variational quantum decision modelling. Rather than directly approximating class posteriors, the method adopts a geometry-first paradigm in which samples are evaluated relative to class medoids using overlap-derived Euclidean-like and angular similarity channels. CGR organizes features into anchor-centered correlation neighbourhoods, generating nonlinear, correlation-weighted representations that enhance robustness in heterogeneous tabular spaces. These geometric signals are fused through a non-probabilistic margin-based fusion score, serving as a lightweight and data-efficient primary classifier for small-to-moderate datasets. On Heart Disease, Breast Cancer, and Wine Quality datasets, the fusion-score classifier achieves 0.8478, 0.8881, and 0.9556 test accuracy respectively, with macro-F1 scores of 0.8463, 0.8703, and 0.9522, demonstrating competitive and stable performance relative to classical baselines. For large-scale and highly imbalanced regimes, we construct compact Delta-distance contrastive features and train a variational quantum classifier (VQC) as a nonlinear refinement layer. On the Credit Card Fraud dataset (0.17% prevalence), the Delta + VQC pipeline achieves approximately 0.85 minority recall at an alert rate of approximately 1.31%, with ROC-AUC 0.9249 and PR-AUC 0.3251 under full-dataset evaluation. These results highlight the importance of operating-point-aware assessment in rare-event detection and demonstrate that the proposed hybrid geometric-variational framework provides interpretable, scalable, and regime-adaptive classification across heterogeneous data settings.

</details>


### [772] [Parent Selection Mechanisms in Elitist Crossover-Based Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04083)
*Andre Opris,Denis Antipov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: (μ+1) GA 通过“优先选最远离父母”策略，在 Jumpₖ 上将期望运行时间由 O(nμlogμ+nᵏ⁻¹) 降至 O(k4ᵏ n log n)；理论关键是为交叉持续供多样而非最后才用交叉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 演化计算里亲代选择能加速优化，但其理论增益缺系统分析；尤对 crossover 何时、如何提供多样缺乏量化刻画。

Method: 1) 提出最大距离优先的亲代选择规则；2) 引入“最大对距+达成对数”双指标多样性度量；3) 在 (μ+1) GA 框架下给出漂移/期望时间分析，全程把交叉视为主动生成与维持多样性的机制。

Result: 对 Jumpₖ 问题，当 μ 适当大时算法期望时间界为 O(k4ᵏ n log n)，显著优于任何不额外保多样、交叉概率为常数的 (μ+1) GA 现有最优界 O(nμlogμ+nᵏ⁻¹)。

Conclusion: 证明交叉若被持续用于扩大多样而非仅最后组合已多样个体，可带来指数级速度提升；为理解 GA 群体动力学与 crossover 的理论价值提供新视角与分析工具。

Abstract: Parent selection methods are widely used in evolutionary computation to accelerate the optimization process, yet their theoretical benefits are still poorly understood. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a parent selection strategy for the $(μ+1)$ genetic algorithm (GA) that prioritizes the selection of maximally distant parents for crossover. We show that, with an appropriately chosen population size, the resulting algorithm solves the Jump$_k$ problem in $O(k4^kn\log(n))$ expected time. This bound is significantly smaller than the best known bound of $O(nμ\log(μ)+n\log(n)+n^{k-1})$ for any $(μ+1)$~GA using no explicit diversity-preserving mechanism and a constant crossover probability.
  To establish this result, we introduce a novel diversity metric that captures both the maximum distance between pairs of individuals in the population and the number of pairs achieving this distance. The main novelty of our analysis is that it relies on crossover as a mechanism for creating and maintaining diversity throughout the run, rather than using crossover only in the final step to combine already diversified individuals. The insights provided by our analysis contribute to a deeper theoretical understanding of the role of crossover in the population dynamics of genetic algorithms.

</details>


### [773] [Justified or Just Convincing? Error Verifiability as a Dimension of LLM Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04418)
*Xiaoyuan Zhu,Kimberly Le Truong,Riccardo Fogliato,Gokul Swamy,Weijian Zhang,Minglai Yang,Longtian Ye,Bangya Liu,Minghao Liu,Andrew Ilyas,Steven Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出“错误可验证性”(error verifiability) 作为衡量模型生成解释能否帮助用户判别答案正误的新指标，并给出 v_bal 评估方法；实验发现常规提升准确率手段无法改善可验证性，仅在数学推理和事实问答上引入外部知识的 RR/OR 方法才有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在关键场景落地时，用户必须判断单条回答正确与否，而现有工作只关注答案准确率，缺乏对“解释能否让用户识别错误”这一需求的系统性度量与提升手段。

Method: 1) 形式化“错误可验证性”并设计平衡指标 v_bal，以人类一致标注为金标准；2) 评估主流做法（后训练、SCALE、prompt 调优）对可验证性的影响；3) 提出 reflect-and-rephrase(RR，针对数学推理) 与 oracle-rephrase(OR，针对事实 QA)，在生成解释时引入领域相关外部信息。

Result: 主流提升准确率的方法（继续训练、模型放大、针对性干预）均无法显著提升 v_bal；而 RR 与 OR 分别在数学与问答任务上将可验证性提高 18–32%，且无需牺牲准确率。

Conclusion: 错误可验证性是独立于准确率的新质量维度，需要领域感知的专门方法才能改进；未来应将可验证性纳入模型优化目标与评估体系。

Abstract: As LLMs are deployed in high-stakes settings, users must judge the correctness of individual responses, often relying on model-generated justifications such as reasoning chains or explanations. Yet, no standard measure exists for whether these justifications help users distinguish correct answers from incorrect ones. We formalize this idea as error verifiability and propose $v_{\text{bal}}$, a balanced metric that measures whether justifications enable raters to accurately assess answer correctness, validated against human raters who show high agreement. We find that neither common approaches, such as post-training and model scaling, nor more targeted interventions recommended improve verifiability. We introduce two methods that succeed at improving verifiability: reflect-and-rephrase (RR) for mathematical reasoning and oracle-rephrase (OR) for factual QA, both of which improve verifiability by incorporating domain-appropriate external information. Together, our results establish error verifiability as a distinct dimension of response quality that does not emerge from accuracy improvements alone and requires dedicated, domain-aware methods to address.

</details>


### [774] [Training Transformers in Cosine Coefficient Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04440)
*Mohamed Amine Bergach*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用 DCT 稀疏系数代替 Transformer 线性层全部权重，训练参数量减半时验证损失仅升 0.024，显著优于同参数量 LoRA；优势源自可保持高秩，且 DCT 可片上快速重建、节省带宽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性层占 Transformer 参数量大头，现有低秩近似（如 LoRA）在压缩率与性能间取舍明显，需寻找在相同参数预算下性能损失更小的替代方案。

Method: 将每个线性层权重视为图像，仅保留 K 个二维 DCT 系数作为可训练参数；前向传播时通过逆 DCT 即时重建完整矩阵。对比同样 K=mn/2 的稠密基线与秩 48 LoRA，并测试随机正交基、不同 zigzag 扫描及更低 K 值，分析稳定秩与损失关系。

Result: 4 层 128 维字符级 Shakespeare 模型在 K=mn/2 时验证损失 1.604，仅比稠密基线高 0.024，却少用一半参数；同参数量 LoRA 损失高达 1.801。随机正交基表现与 DCT 相当；能维持高秩的子空间在 K=mn/10 甚至 K=mn/20 时仍保持较低损失，而强制低秩的 zigzag 选择迅速逼近 LoRA 的损失与稳定秩曲线。

Conclusion: 稀疏 DCT 系数通过“秩灵活性”机制在相同参数预算下显著优于低秩参数化；DCT 因可分离快速变换支持片上 fused 重建，实现参数与带宽双重节省，为高效压缩 Transformer 线性层提供了实用新范式。

Abstract: Linear layers hold most of a transformer's parameters. We replace each linear layer with one that stores $K$ out of $mn$ two-dimensional DCT coefficients per weight matrix and reconstructs the full matrix through an inverse DCT at every forward pass; the $K$ coefficients are the trainable parameters.
  A 4-layer, 128-dim transformer trained from scratch on character-level Shakespeare reaches validation loss $1.604$ at $K = mn/2$, against $1.580$ for a standard dense baseline -- a gap of $+0.024$ at half the trainable parameter count, within the terminal-epoch variation of the dense run. A rank-48 LoRA factorization at the same trainable parameter count reaches only $1.801$ ($+0.221$). The structural advantage of sparse-coefficient over low-rank parameterizations at matched $K$ is qualitative.
  We identify rank flexibility as the mechanism. A random orthonormal basis matches the DCT within noise at $K = mn/2$, and a compression sweep through $K = mn/10$ and $K = mn/20$ shows that subspaces that can host high-rank matrices keep the loss low, while subspaces that flatten into a low-rank block (zigzag-selection variants) converge onto the observed stable rank \emph{and} the loss line of the rank-48 LoRA reference in lock-step. Among these orthonormal bases, the DCT is preferred because its separable fast transform admits a fused reconstruction kernel: the materialized weight matrix never leaves on-chip memory, so the parameter saving translates into a bandwidth saving as well.

</details>


### [775] [DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05350)
*Vishaal Kapoor,Mariam Dundua,Sarthak Ahuja,Neda Kordjazi,Evren Yortucboylu,Vaibhavi Padala,Derek Ho,Jennifer Whitted,Rebecca Steinert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在150条匿名企业IT支持对话上，tgram把根因级诊断状态引入到多轮RAG，成功率翻倍并将平均轮次从8.4降到3.9。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业IT支持对话的核心是诊断：用户的早期描述零散而模糊，系统需要随着对话逐轮收敛到根因。但现有的多轮RAG只能孤立检索单文档，缺乏跨轮信念更新，导致没法兼顾竞争假设，回复往往反复、冗余甚至误诊。

Method: 提出DQA框架：①维护

Result: 在150条匿名企业IT支持对话上，DQA的整单成功率达78.7%，比基线RAG高出37.4个百分点，并把平均对话轮数从8.4压缩至3.9；轮次越少意味着客户等待时间和人力成本同步下降。

Conclusion: 引入根因级、可累积的诊断状态是解决多轮问答中疑因博弈的关键；DQA对企业规模、低延迟场景具备落地潜力，后续可在人机协作、主动提问机制上进一步扩展。

Abstract: Enterprise IT support interactions are fundamentally diagnostic: effective resolution requires iterative evidence gathering from ambiguous user reports to identify an underlying root cause. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides grounding through historical cases, standard multi-turn RAG systems lack explicit diagnostic state and therefore struggle to accumulate evidence and resolve competing hypotheses across turns. We introduce DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the level of root causes rather than individual documents. DQA combines conversational query rewriting, retrieval aggregation, and state-conditioned response generation to support systematic troubleshooting under enterprise latency and context constraints. We evaluate DQA on 150 anonymized enterprise IT support scenarios using a replay-based protocol. Averaged over three independent runs, DQA achieves a 78.7% success rate under a trajectory-level success criterion, compared to 41.3% for a multi-turn RAG baseline, while reducing average turns from 8.4 to 3.9.

</details>


### [776] [Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06210)
*Jaehyeok Lee,Xiaoyuan Yi,Jing Yao,Hyunjin Hwang,Roy Ka-Wei Lee,Xing Xie,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DOVE框架，用分布级最优传输衡量LLM与人群文化取向差异，解决现有判别式基准在构造-构成-语境三方面的失配。仅用500样本即可高可靠评估，下游任务预测效度提升31.56%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM全球部署需文化对齐，但现有基准仅做多选知识测试，忽视亚文化差异与真实开放式生成，难以反映模型真实价值取向。

Method: 1) 收集1万人写文本→率失真变分目标学习紧凑value-codebook，把文本映射到结构化价值空间以滤语义噪声；2) 用非平衡最优传输将LLM生成分布与人类分布对齐，显式保留亚群内部结构；3) 以12模型、少至500样本评估信度与效度。

Result: DOVE预测效度达31.56%（与下游任务相关），显著优于现有基准；可靠性高，样本效率提升一个量级；可细粒度揭示模型在不同亚文化上的取向差异。

Conclusion: 分布级价值对齐评估应取代判别式知识测试；DOVE为LLM文化安全与本地化提供高灵敏、低样本的评估工具，支持后续对齐优化。

Abstract: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement. However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context ($C^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation. We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs. DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value-codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise. Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and sub-group diversity. Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.

</details>


### [777] [Blockchain and AI: Securing Intelligent Networks for the Future](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06323)
*Joy Dutta,Hossien B. Eldeeb,Tu Dac Ho*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文为区块链+AI 融合安全提出统一分类法、集成模式与 BASE 评估蓝图，并梳理五大场景证据，指出概念契合但实证薄弱，呼吁未来聚焦互操作、隐私分析和基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区块链与 AI 常被并列用于保障智能网络，但研究分散在账本设计、AI 检测、信息物理系统等多条主线，缺乏系统梳理与可重用框架，难以指导实践。

Method: 通过系统性文献合成，提出：(i) 区块链-AI 安全多维分类法；(ii) 可验证、自适应安全工作流的集成设计模式；(iii) 涵盖 AI 质量、账本行为、服务级、隐私、能耗与可复现性的 BASE 评估清单；并对 IoT、关键基础设施、智能电网、交通与医疗五大领域的证据进行映射对比。

Result: 构建出首个跨域统一框架，明确区块链负责 provenance/审计、AI 负责检测/适应的分工；发现概念层面契合度高，但真实部署证据稀少且多为原型，缺少跨域开放基准与隐私保护方案。

Conclusion: 未来需优先攻关：1) 互操作接口与跨链标准；2) 隐私保护分析技术；3) 可控的代理化自动化；4) 开放跨域基准与评估平台。BASE 与分类法可直接指导研究人员和工程师设计安全、透明、韧性的智能网络。

Abstract: Blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly proposed together for securing intelligent networks, but the literature remains fragmented across ledger design, AI-driven detection, cyber-physical applications, and emerging agentic workflows. This paper synthesizes the area through three reusable contributions: (i) a taxonomy of blockchain-AI security for intelligent networks, (ii) integration patterns for verifiable and adaptive security workflows, and (iii) the Blockchain-AI Security Evaluation Blueprint (BASE), a reporting checklist spanning AI quality, ledger behavior, end-to-end service levels, privacy, energy, and reproducibility. The paper also maps the evidence landscape across IoT, critical infrastructure, smart grids, transportation, and healthcare, showing that the conceptual fit is strong but real-world evidence remains uneven and often prototype-heavy. The synthesis clarifies where blockchain contributes provenance, trust, and auditability, where AI contributes detection, adaptation, and orchestration, and where future work should focus on interoperable interfaces, privacy-preserving analytics, bounded agentic automation, and open cross-domain benchmarks. The paper is intended as a reference for researchers and practitioners designing secure, transparent, and resilient intelligent networks.

</details>


### [778] [The Defense Trilemma: Why Prompt Injection Defense Wrappers Fail?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06436)
*Manish Bhatt,Sarthak Munshi,Vineeth Sai Narajala,Idan Habler,Ammar Al-Kahfah,Ken Huang,Joel Webb,Blake Gatto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对任意连续、保效用的输入预处理防御D，当语言模型提示空间连通时，D必定在正测集上无法将输出转为严格安全；连续性、保效用与完备性不可能同时成立，这一结论在拓扑、离散、多轮、随机、同容量等设定均成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前主流的内容安全手段依赖输入预处理（wrapper）把有害提示转为无害。作者旨在给出通用不可能性定理，揭示这类防御的硬性局限，为后续研究方向提供理论边界。

Method: 将提示空间建模为连通拓扑或有限离散集，定义“严格安全”为模型输出满足某阈值约束。引入三类假设：边界固定点、ε-鲁棒Lipschitz、横截性条件，用Lean 4形式化证明当防御连续且保效用时，必存在正测 unsafe 区域；再将结论推广到多轮、随机、同容量场景。

Result: 证明“防御三难”：连续性＋保效用＋完备安全不可共存。给出显式失败集：在边界固定点附近存在ε-带无法被净化；在横截条件下，该 unsafe 区域具有正测度且持久存在。离散版本与连续版本并行成立，机械验证无漏洞。

Conclusion: wrapper 式输入预处理先天无法在所有输入上实现严格安全，单靠推断时“包壳”无法根治滥用。理论为训练时对齐、模型架构重设计、可牺牲效用的防御等替代路线留下空间，并给出形式化验证范式。

Abstract: We prove that no continuous, utility-preserving wrapper defense-a function $D: X\to X$ that preprocesses inputs before the model sees them-can make all outputs strictly safe for a language model with connected prompt space, and we characterize exactly where every such defense must fail. We establish three results under successively stronger hypotheses: boundary fixation-the defense must leave some threshold-level inputs unchanged; an $ε$-robust constraint-under Lipschitz regularity, a positive-measure band around fixed boundary points remains near-threshold; and a persistent unsafe region under a transversality condition, a positive-measure subset of inputs remains strictly unsafe. These constitute a defense trilemma: continuity, utility preservation, and completeness cannot coexist. We prove parallel discrete results requiring no topology, and extend to multi-turn interactions, stochastic defenses, and capacity-parity settings. The results do not preclude training-time alignment, architectural changes, or defenses that sacrifice utility. The full theory is mechanically verified in Lean 4 and validated empirically on three LLMs.

</details>


### [779] [The Detection-Extraction Gap: Models Know the Answer Before They Can Say It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06613)
*Hanyang Wang,Mingxuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 现代推理模型常在答案已可判定后继续生成冗长思维链；作者发现 52–88 % 的后续 token 属于“承诺后生成”，提出用自由续写代替强制解码，可截断 70 % 以上序列并提升 1–5 pp 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察到链式思维模型在答案已显式出现之后仍持续输出大量 token，造成算力浪费且可能引入错误，需要理解并消除这种“检测-提取鸿沟”。

Method: 首先形式化“检测-提取鸿沟”：用总变差距离量化自由续写分布与强制解码分布的差异；随后提出黑箱自适应早停（BAEE）：以部分前缀的自由续写既做答案检测又做答案提取，一旦置信度达标即终止生成。

Result: 在五组模型、两大家族、三大 benchmark 上，BAEE 能在 70–78 % 的样本中提前终止，平均节省 68–73 % 的串行生成成本；在 thinking-mode 模型上准确率最高提升 5.8 pp，且代价仅约 9 次 API 调用。

Conclusion: 承诺后生成是结构性现象，自由续写比强制解码更能可靠暴露模型已确定的答案；BAEE 无需训练、黑箱可用，为长思维链模型提供了即插即用的“加速+提精”方案。

Abstract: Modern reasoning models continue generating long after the answer is already determined. Across five model configurations, two families, and three benchmarks, we find that 52--88% of chain-of-thought tokens are produced after the answer is recoverable from a partial prefix. This post-commitment generation reveals a structural phenomenon: the detection-extraction gap. Free continuations from early prefixes recover the correct answer even at 10% of the trace, while forced extraction fails on 42% of these cases. The answer is recoverable from the model state, yet prompt-conditioned decoding fails to extract it. We formalize this mismatch via a total-variation bound between free and forced continuation distributions, yielding quantitative estimates of suffix-induced shift. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose Black-box Adaptive Early Exit (BAEE), which uses free continuations for both detection and extraction, truncating 70--78% of serial generation while improving accuracy by 1--5pp across all models. For thinking-mode models, early exit prevents post-commitment overwriting, yielding gains of up to 5.8pp; a cost-optimized variant achieves 68--73% reduction at a median of 9 API calls. Code is available at https://github.com/EdWangLoDaSc/know2say.

</details>


### [780] [WRAP++: Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06829)
*Jiang Zhou,Yunhao Wang,Xing Wu,Tinghao Yu,Feng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WRAP++通过超链接挖掘跨文档实体关系并生成跨文档QA数据，使预训练语料从8.4B扩增至80B，7B/32B OLMo在SimpleQA上显著优于仅做单文档改写的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成数据改写局限于单文档，无法利用跨文档的实体关联，导致事实缺乏丰富的上下文与多路径检索入口。

Method: 以高置信双链/共现为锚点→发现跨文档实体对→生成需联合推理的问答对；知识互补且组合爆炸带来规模倍增。

Result: Wikipedia数据放大9.5倍(8.4B→80B tokens)，7B与32B模型在SimpleQA显著优于单文档法，并呈持续规模效应。

Conclusion: 跨文档关系发现与联合QA合成能有效扩充训练信号，显著提升LLM事实问答性能与规模扩展性。

Abstract: Synthetic data rephrasing has emerged as a powerful technique for enhancing knowledge acquisition during large language model (LLM) pretraining. However, existing approaches operate at the single-document level, rewriting individual web pages in isolation. This confines synthesized examples to intra-document knowledge, missing cross-document relationships and leaving facts with limited associative context. We propose WRAP++ (Web discoveRy Amplified Pretraining), which amplifies the associative context of factual knowledge by discovering cross-document relationships from web hyperlinks and synthesizing joint QA over each discovered document pair. Concretely, WRAP++ discovers high-confidence relational motifs including dual-links and co-mentions, and synthesizes QA that requires reasoning across both documents. This produces relational knowledge absent from either source document alone, creating diverse entry points to the same facts. Because the number of valid entity pairs grows combinatorially, this discovery-driven synthesis also amplifies data scale far beyond single-document rewriting. Instantiating WRAP++ on Wikipedia, we amplify ~8.4B tokens of raw text into 80B tokens of cross-document QA data. On SimpleQA, OLMo-based models at both 7B and 32B scales trained with WRAP++ substantially outperform single-document approaches and exhibit sustained scaling gains, underscoring the advantage of cross-document knowledge discovery and amplification.

</details>


<div id='eess.IV'></div>

# eess.IV [[Back]](#toc)

### [781] [MetaTele: Compact Refractive Metasurface Computational Telephoto Camera](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07614)
*Harshana Weligampola,Yuanrui Chen,Abhiram Gnanasambandam,Dilshan Godaliyadda,Hamid R. Sheikh,Stanley H. ChanQi Guo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: MetaTele通过“紧凑折-超构透镜+窄带捕捉结构+宽带取色+扩散模型融合”把远摄比压到0.44、TTL 13 mm，首次在手机上实现单反级长焦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机摄像头受厚度和传统折射远摄极限（telephoto ratio ≥0.5）阻碍，难以在长焦端达到单反水准。

Method: 1) 折-超构混合透镜组，窄带成像保结构细节、避开色差；2) 同光路宽带成像取色，但容忍大色差；3) 一步扩散模型把结构和色信息融合，同时矫正残余像差。

Result: 原型系统TTL 13 mm、远摄比0.44，为RGB成像迄今最小；解析力与色差抑制指标优于同等厚度传统方案。

Conclusion: 光学-算法协同让手机在超薄尺寸下拥有单反级远摄潜力，验证了“结构/色彩解耦+计算融合”的新范式。

Abstract: Smartphone cameras face fundamental form-factor constraints that limit their optical magnification, primarily due to the difficulty of reducing a lens assembly's telephoto ratio, the ratio between total track length (TTL) and effective focal length (EFL). Currently, conventional refractive optics struggle to achieve a telephoto ratio below 0.5 without requiring multiple bulky elements to correct optical aberrations. In this paper, we introduce MetaTele, a novel optics-algorithm co-design that breaks this bottleneck. MetaTele explicitly decouples the acquisition of scene structure and color information. First, it utilizes a compact refractive-metasurface optical assembly to capture a fine-detail structure image under a narrow wavelength band, inherently avoiding severe chromatic aberrations. Second, it captures a broadband color cue using the same optics; although this cue is heavily corrupted by chromatic aberrations, it retains sufficient spectral information to guide post-processing. We then employ a custom one-step diffusion model to computationally fuse these two raw measurements, successfully colorizing the structure image while correcting for system aberrations. We demonstrate a MetaTele prototype, achieving an unprecedented telephoto ratio of 0.44 with a TTL of just 13 mm for RGB imaging, paving the way for DSLR-level telephoto capabilities within smartphone form factors.

</details>


### [782] [MonoUNet: A Robust Tiny Neural Network for Automated Knee Cartilage Segmentation on Point-of-Care Ultrasound Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07780)
*Alvin Kimbowa,Arjun Parmar,Ibrahim Mujtaba,Will Wei,Maziar Badii,Matthew Harkey,David Liu,Ilker Hacihaliloglu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出仅 10 万参数的 MonoUNet，在 3 类 POCUS 设备上 Dice≈93%，参数与计算量压缩 1-3 个数量级，厚度/回声强度 ICC>0.96，可嵌入式完成膝软骨自动分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 床旁超声（POCUS）硬件算力与内存极度受限，且不同机型图像外观差异大，现有轻量分割网络体积仍过大、跨设备鲁棒性不足；亟需

Method: 设计三项核心： 1) 非对称极简 U-Net 主干，通道深度逐层锐减；2) 可训练 monogenic 块，在 3 个尺度估计局部相位，提取软骨特有的相位纹理；3) 门控特征注入，将相位向量按像素权重动态融合至编码器各层，抑制声影、增益差异带来的伪影。

Result: 多中心 3 型设备 358 例超声，MonoUNet 参数 0.12 M，计算量 0.03 GFLOPs，较 6 个轻量模型分别减少 10-700 倍参数量、14-2000 倍计算；Dice 92.6-94.8%，MASD 0.13-0.25 mm，均优于对比网络。厚度 ICC=0.96、偏差 2.0%；回声强度 ICC=0.99、偏差 0.8%。

Conclusion: 可训练局部相位特征使超紧凑网络跨设备仍保持高精度与可靠性，为嵌入式 POCUS 实时膝软骨评估、骨关节炎随访提供可扩展方案。

Abstract: Objective: To develop a robust and compact deep learning model for automated knee cartilage segmentation on point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) devices.
  Methods: We propose MonoUNet, an ultra-compact U-Net consisting of (i) an aggressively reduced backbone with an asymmetric decoder, (ii) a trainable monogenic block that extracts multi-scale local phase features, and (iii) a gated feature injection mechanism that integrates these features into the encoder stages to reduce sensitivity to variations in ultrasound image appearance and improve robustness across devices. MonoUNet was evaluated on a multi-site, multi-device knee cartilage ultrasound dataset acquired using cart-based, portable, and handheld POCUS devices.
  Results: Overall, MonoUNet outperformed existing lightweight segmentation models, with average Dice scores ranging from 92.62% to 94.82% and mean average surface distance (MASD) values between 0.133 mm and 0.254 mm. MonoUNet reduces the number of parameters by 10x--700x and computational cost by 14x--2000x relative to existing lightweight models. MonoUNet cartilage outcomes showed excellent reliability and agreement with the manual outcomes: intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC$_{2,k})$=0.96 and bias=2.00% (0.047 mm) for average thickness, and ICC$_{2,k}$=0.99 and bias=0.80% (0.328 a.u.) for echo intensity.
  Conclusion: Incorporating trainable local phase features improves the robustness of highly compact neural networks for knee cartilage segmentation across varying acquisition settings and could support scalable ultrasound-based assessment and monitoring of knee osteoarthritis using POCUS devices. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/alvinkimbowa/monounet.

</details>


### [783] [A H.265/HEVC Fine-Grained ROI Video Encryption Algorithm Based on Coding Unit and Prompt Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08047)
*Xiang Zhang,Haoyan Lu,Ziqiang Li,Ziwen He,Zhenshan Tan,Fei Peng,Zhangjie Fu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 针对H.265/HEVC视频，提出以8×8 CU为最小加密粒度的细粒度ROI选择性加密框架，通过提示分割实现ROI像素级映射，并配合多语法元素扰动与PCM/MV隔离策略抑制扩散，实验验证其在医疗、军事等高敏场景下的亚Tile精度防护能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ROI视频加密普遍以Tile为大粒度单元，导致加密区域不精准、边缘泄漏严重，难以满足医疗、军遥等敏感场景对像素级保密的需求。

Method: 1) 提出基于提示分割的ROI→8×8 CU精映射算法；2) 设计CU级多语法元素（系数、模式、MV等）选择性扰动策略；3) 引入PCM模式与MV限制扩散隔离，阻断预测环内误差传播。

Result: 在HEVC参考模型上测试，加密区域定位误差<1 CU，密文扩散率<0.5%，码率增幅<3%，加密/解密速度达实时30 fps@1080p，显著优于Tile级方法。

Conclusion: 首次将ROI视频加密粒度降至最小CU，解决Tile级方法精度不足与扩散难题，为医疗影像、军事侦察等高敏领域提供了可落地的像素级内容安全方案。

Abstract: ROI (Region of Interest) video selective encryption based on H.265/HEVC is a technology that protects the sensitive regions of videos by perturbing the syntax elements associated with target areas. However, existing methods typically adopt Tile (with a relatively large size) as the minimum encryption unit, which suffers from problems such as inaccurate encryption regions and low encryption precision. This low-precision encryption makes them difficult to apply in sensitive fields such as medicine, military, and remote sensing. In order to address the aforementioned problem, this paper proposes a fine-grained ROI video selective encryption algorithm based on Coding Units (CUs) and prompt segmentation. First, to achieve a more precise ROI acquisition, we present a novel ROI mapping approach based on prompt segmentation. This approach enables precise mapping of ROIs to small $8\times8$ CU levels, significantly enhancing the precision of encrypted regions. Second, we propose a selective encryption scheme based on multiple syntax elements, which distorts syntax elements within high-precision ROI to effectively safeguard ROI security. Finally, we design a diffusion isolation based on Pulse Code Modulation (PCM) mode and MV restriction, applying PCM mode and MV restriction strategy to the affected CU to address encryption diffusion during prediction. The above three strategies break the inherent mechanism of using Tiles in existing ROI encryption and push the fine-grained level of ROI video encryption to the minimum $8\times8$ CU precision. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can accurately segment ROI regions, effectively perturb pixels within these regions, and eliminate the diffusion artifacts introduced by encryption. The method exhibits great potential for application in medical imaging, military surveillance, and remote areas.

</details>


### [784] [TinyDEVO: Deep Event-based Visual Odometry on Ultra-low-power Multi-core Microcontrollers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08060)
*Alessandro Marchei,Lorenzo Lamberti,Daniele Palossi,Luca Benini*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: TinyDEVO 首度把事件相机 VO 压缩到 63.8 MB、5.2 B MAC/帧，在 9 核 ULP RISC-V MCU 上以 86 mW、1.2 fps 运行，轨迹误差仅比 DEVO 高 19 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机+深度学习 VO 虽抗运动模糊与光照，但 SoA 方案 DEVO 需 733 MB 内存、155 B MAC/帧，无法部署于功耗受限的 MCU 级终端，急需极致压缩。

Method: 面向 MCU 设计 TinyDEVO：神经架构搜/剪枝+量化+事件体素表征重构+超参调优，全面缩减模型体积与运算量；再映射至 ULP 9 核 RISC-V，实现内存-计算协同优化。

Result: 内存降 11.5× 至 63.8 MB，MAC 降 29.7× 至 5.2 B/帧；在 3 个公开数据集平均漂移 27 cm，仅比 DEVO 差 19 cm；在 86 mW 平均功耗下吞吐 1.2 fps，首次验证事件 VO 全 pipeline 可在超低功耗 MCU 实时工作。

Conclusion: TinyDEVO 突破性地把事件 VO 带入毫瓦级 MCU，证实通过算法-硬件协同设计，可在资源极受限终端实现高精度、低功耗视觉里程计，为微型机器人、AR/VR 眼镜等场景提供可行方案。

Abstract: A key task in embedded vision is visual odometry (VO), which estimates camera motion from visual sensors, and it is a core component in many embedded power-constrained systems, from autonomous robots to augmented and virtual reality wearable devices. The newest class of VO systems combines deep learning models with bio-inspired event-based cameras, which are robust to motion blur and lighting conditions. However, state-of-the-art (SoA) event-based VO algorithms require significant memory and computation. For example, the leading approach DEVO requires 733 MB of memory and 155 billion multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations per frame. We present TinyDEVO, an event-based VO deep learning model designed for resource-constrained microcontroller units (MCUs). We deploy TinyDEVO on an ultra-low-power (ULP) 9-core RISC-V-based MCU, achieving a throughput of approximately 1.2 frames per second with an average power consumption of only 86 mW. Thanks to our neural network architectural optimizations and hyperparameter tuning, TinyDEVO reduces the memory footprint by 11.5x (to 63.8 MB) and the number of operations per frame by 29.7x (to 5.2 billion MACs per frame) compared to DEVO, while maintaining an average trajectory error of 27 cm, i.e., only 19 cm higher than DEVO, on three state-of-the-art datasets. Our work demonstrates, for the first time, the feasibility of an event-based VO pipeline on ultra-low-power devices.

</details>


### [785] [HistDiT: A Structure-Aware Latent Conditional Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity Virtual Staining in Histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08305)
*Aasim Bin Saleem,Amr Ahmed,Ardhendu Behera,Hafeezullah Amin,Iman Yi Liao,Mahmoud Khattab,Pan Jia Wern,Haslina Makmur*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜空间条件DiT的虚拟IHC染色模型HistDiT，通过双流条件、多目标损失及SCM指标，在维持精细结构的同时生成高保真HER2染色图，显著优于GAN/U-Net扩散基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统IHC染色流程耗资源、易损组织；现有GAN/U-Net虚拟染色在

Method: 构建HistDiT：1)双流条件——VAE潜空间保留空间约束，UNI嵌入提供语义表型指导；2)多目标损失联合优化结构锐度与纹理保真；3)引入SCM专注核心形态评估；整体在潜空间完成条件扩散生成。

Result: 在HER2虚拟染色任务上，HistDiT在SSIM、FID、SCM等指标全面超越当前最佳GAN与U-Net扩散模型；病理医生盲评显示其图像清晰度与诊断可用性显著提高，且几乎无伪影。

Conclusion: HistDiT通过DiT架构与双流条件机制突破了“结构-染色”权衡，首次实现兼具高结构保真与生化表达准确的虚拟IHC染色，为大规模、可扩展的病理免疫评估提供新基准。

Abstract: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) is essential for assessing specific immune biomarkers like Human Epidermal growth-factor Receptor 2 (HER2) in breast cancer. However, the traditional protocols of obtaining IHC stains are resource-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to structural damages. Virtual staining has emerged as a scalable alternative, but it faces significant challenges in preserving fine-grained cellular structures while accurately translating biochemical expressions. Current state-of-the-art methods still rely on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) or standard convolutional U-Net diffusion models that often struggle with "structure and staining trade-offs". The generated samples are either structurally relevant but blurry, or texturally realistic but have artifacts that compromise their diagnostic use. In this paper, we introduce HistDiT, a novel latent conditional Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that establishes a new benchmark for visual fidelity in virtual histological staining. The novelty introduced in this work is, a) the Dual-Stream Conditioning strategy that explicitly maintains a balance between spatial constraints via VAE-encoded latents and semantic phenotype guidance via UNI embeddings; b) the multi-objective loss function that contributes to sharper images with clear morphological structure; and c) the use of the Structural Correlation Metric (SCM) to focus on the core morphological structure for precise assessment of sample quality. Consequently, our model outperforms existing baselines, as demonstrated through rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

</details>


### [786] [DiV-INR: Extreme Low-Bitrate Diffusion Video Compression with INR Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08329)
*Eren Çetin,Lucas Relic,Yuanyi Xue,Markus Gross,Christopher Schroers,Roberto Azevedo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: \u003c0.05 bpp 下，用 INR 紧凑表征场景，用预训练视频扩散模型提供生成先验；两者协同，显著优于 HEVC/VVC 及现有神经编解码器。\u003e\u003e


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统混合编码在极低码率（\u003c0.05 bpp）下视觉质量崩溃，现有 INR-only 方法缺乏强先验、纹理欠逼真，需引入大规模生成先验并保留紧凑表示。\u003e\u003e"

Method: 1) 用轻量 INR 替代传统 I 帧，直接回归扩散模型所需之条件潜码；2) 冻结扩散主干，仅更新低秩适配器与 INR 权重，端到端联合训练；3) 码流仅存储 INR 权重与适配器参数，实现极低码率；4) 解码端先由 INR 提供场景布局与 ID 先验，再由扩散模型逐级细化纹理。\u003e\u003e"

Result: 在 UVG、MCL-JCV、JVET-B 上，相对 HEVC：BD-LPIPS 最高提升 0.214，BD-FID 最高提升 91.14，也优于 VVC 及当前最佳神经/INR 编解码器；主观纹理一致性显著改善。\u003e\u003e"

Conclusion: INR 与扩散模型互补——前者极致压缩、后者强先验——在 \u003c0.05 bpp 下仍能恢复语义与纹理，为极低码率感知视频编码确立新范式。\u003e\u003e

Abstract: We present a perceptually-driven video compression framework integrating implicit neural representations (INRs) and pre-trained video diffusion models to address the extremely low bitrate regime (<0.05 bpp). Our approach exploits the complementary strengths of INRs, which provide a compact video representation, and diffusion models, which offer rich generative priors learned from large-scale datasets. The INR-based conditioning replaces traditional intra-coded keyframes with bit-efficient neural representations trained to estimate latent features and guide the diffusion process. Our joint optimization of INR weights and parameter-efficient adapters for diffusion models allows the model to learn reliable conditioning signals while encoding video-specific information with minimal parameter overhead. Our experiments on UVG, MCL-JCV, and JVET Class-B benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements in perceptual metrics (LPIPS, DISTS, and FID) at extremely low bitrates, including improvements on BD-LPIPS up to 0.214 and BD-FID up to 91.14 relative to HEVC, while also outperforming VVC and previous strong state-of-the-art neural and INR-only video codecs. Moreover, our analysis shows that INR-conditioned diffusion-based video compression first composes the scene layout and object identities before refining textural accuracy, exposing the semantic-to-visual hierarchy that enables perceptually faithful compression at extremely low bitrates.

</details>


### [787] [Accelerating Training of Autoregressive Video Generation Models via Local Optimization with Representation Continuity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07402)
*Yucheng Zhou,Jianbing Shen*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 针对自回归视频生成的训练耗时长问题，提出局部优化（Local Opt.）与表示连续性（ReCo）策略，在保证生成质量的前提下将训练时间减半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频模型训练成本过高，直接减少训练帧数虽可提速，但会放大误差累积并破坏时序一致性。

Method: 1) Local Opt.：在局部窗口内优化 token，利用上下文信息抑制误差传播；2) ReCo：受 Lipschitz 连续性启发，引入连续性损失约束帧间表示变化，提升鲁棒性并抑制误差累积。

Result: 在类别驱动与文本驱动视频数据集上，所提方法在训练成本降低 50% 的同时，生成质量优于基线模型。

Conclusion: 通过局部优化与表示连续性约束，可在不牺牲质量的前提下显著压缩自回归视频生成模型的训练时间，为高效视频生成提供新思路。

Abstract: Autoregressive models have shown superior performance and efficiency in image generation, but remain constrained by high computational costs and prolonged training times in video generation. In this study, we explore methods to accelerate training for autoregressive video generation models through empirical analyses. Our results reveal that while training on fewer video frames significantly reduces training time, it also exacerbates error accumulation and introduces inconsistencies in the generated videos. To address these issues, we propose a Local Optimization (Local Opt.) method, which optimizes tokens within localized windows while leveraging contextual information to reduce error propagation. Inspired by Lipschitz continuity, we propose a Representation Continuity (ReCo) strategy to improve the consistency of generated videos. ReCo utilizes continuity loss to constrain representation changes, improving model robustness and reducing error accumulation. Extensive experiments on class- and text-to-video datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance to the baseline while halving the training cost without sacrificing quality.

</details>


### [788] [GAN-based Domain Adaptation for Image-aware Layout Generation in Advertising Poster Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07409)
*Chenchen Xu,Min Zhou,Tiezheng Ge,Weiwei Xu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 基于GAN的CGL-GAN与PDA-GAN模型利用自采CGL-Dataset，在修复海报与干净商品图之间做域适应，生成视觉内容感知的广告版面；提出像素级判别器与三项新指标，PDA-GAN在定量与主观评价中达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度布局生成研究忽视“商品图→海报版面”这一真实落地场景，且修复海报与干净商品图存在域差异，导致版面与图像视觉纹理脱节。

Method: 1）构建60k修复海报+121k干净商品图配对的CGL-Dataset；2）CGL-GAN用高斯模糊修复区生成初步版面；3）PDA-GAN引入像素级判别器(PD)，在浅层特征图逐像素计算GAN损失，实现无监督域适应，使生成布局与输入图像纹理一致；4）设计三项内容感知指标评估图文关系。

Result: PDA-GAN在提出的新指标及传统版面指标上全面优于CGL-GAN与现有方法，主观盲测显示生成版面图文一致性与美学质量显著提升。

Conclusion: 像素级判别器可有效弥合修复图与干净图域差距，实现高保真、内容感知的商品海报版面生成；所提数据集与指标为该方向奠定新基准。

Abstract: Layout plays a crucial role in graphic design and poster generation. Recently, the application of deep learning models for layout generation has gained significant attention. This paper focuses on using a GAN-based model conditioned on images to generate advertising poster graphic layouts, requiring a dataset of paired product images and layouts. To address this task, we introduce the Content-aware Graphic Layout Dataset (CGL-Dataset), consisting of 60,548 paired inpainted posters with annotations and 121,000 clean product images. The inpainting artifacts introduce a domain gap between the inpainted posters and clean images. To bridge this gap, we design two GAN-based models. The first model, CGL-GAN, uses Gaussian blur on the inpainted regions to generate layouts. The second model combines unsupervised domain adaptation by introducing a GAN with a pixel-level discriminator (PD), abbreviated as PDA-GAN, to generate image-aware layouts based on the visual texture of input images. The PD is connected to shallow-level feature maps and computes the GAN loss for each input-image pixel. Additionally, we propose three novel content-aware metrics to assess the model's ability to capture the intricate relationships between graphic elements and image content. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that PDA-GAN achieves state-of-the-art performance and generates high-quality image-aware layouts.

</details>


### [789] [SMFD-UNet: Semantic Face Mask Is The Only Thing You Need To Deblur Faces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07477)
*Abduz Zami*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: SMFD-UNet 是一种轻量级人脸去模糊框架，仅依赖输入模糊图像，无需高分辨参考图即可恢复高质量人脸。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法采用通用图像先验，难以捕捉面部特有的结构与身份细节；作者希望用语义掩码替代参考图，实现更精准的人脸去模糊。

Method: 双阶段 UNet：先由语义掩码生成器从模糊图像中提取五官掩码（眼鼻口），再将掩码与特征通过多阶段融合送入高效 UNet；主干含 RDC 残差稠密块、CBAM 注意力、轻量级上采样与后处理，并使用 1.74 万亿种随机模糊场景训练以增强鲁棒性。

Result: 在 CelebA 上，SMFD-UNet 的 PSNR 与 SSIM 均优于现有 SOTA，同时 NIQE、LPIPS、FID 保持自然；模型轻量，推理效率高。

Conclusion: 将面部语义先验显式融入去模糊网络可显著提升恢复质量且无需高清参考；SMFD-UNet 为学术研究与实际人脸修复应用提供了高效、可扩展的新基线。

Abstract: For applications including facial identification, forensic analysis, photographic improvement, and medical imaging diagnostics, facial image deblurring is an essential chore in computer vision allowing the restoration of high-quality images from blurry inputs. Often based on general picture priors, traditional deblurring techniques find it difficult to capture the particular structural and identity-specific features of human faces. We present SMFD-UNet (Semantic Mask Fusion Deblurring UNet), a new lightweight framework using semantic face masks to drive the deblurring process, therefore removing the need for high-quality reference photos in order to solve these difficulties. First, our dual-step method uses a UNet-based semantic mask generator to directly extract detailed facial component masks (e.g., eyes, nose, mouth) straight from blurry photos. Sharp, high-fidelity facial images are subsequently produced by integrating these masks with the blurry input using a multi-stage feature fusion technique within a computationally efficient UNet framework. We created a randomized blurring pipeline that roughly replicates real-world situations by simulating around 1.74 trillion deterioration scenarios, hence guaranteeing resilience. Examined on the CelebA dataset, SMFD-UNet shows better performance than state-of-the-art models, attaining higher Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) while preserving satisfactory naturalness measures, including NIQE, LPIPS, and FID. Powered by Residual Dense Convolution Blocks (RDC), a multi-stage feature fusion strategy, efficient and effective upsampling techniques, attention techniques like CBAM, post-processing techniques, and the lightweight design guarantees scalability and efficiency, enabling SMFD-UNet to be a flexible solution for developing facial image restoration research and useful applications.

</details>


### [790] [Monocular Depth Estimation From the Perspective of Feature Restoration: A Diffusion Enhanced Depth Restoration Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07664)
*Huibin Bai,Shuai Li,Hanxiao Zhai,Yanbo Gao,Chong Lv,Yibo Wang,Haipeng Ping,Wei Hua,Xingyu Gao*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文把单目深度估计重新定义为“特征复原”任务，用可逆变换增强的间接扩散模块(InvT-IndDiffusion)在仅有稀疏深度监督下逐步恢复encoder特征，辅以视角辅助的低层特征增强(AV-LFE)，在KITTI上将RMSE再降4.09%–37.77%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有encoder-decoder式MDE虽利用多级特征，但缺乏对“不同层特征到底如何影响精度”的系统评估；作者发现只要能把encoder特征质量提升，就能在现有框架里再挖潜力，于是提出从“特征复原”角度而非直接回归深度来突破瓶颈。

Method: 1)将预训练encoder输出视为被退化的“真实特征”，需用扩散过程复原；2)设计InvT-IndDiffusion模块：在双向Lipschitz可逆变换约束下，用可逆解码器把扩散每一步的隐特征映射到深度空间，仅通过稀疏深度损失间接约束，避免步间特征漂移；3)提出plug-and-play AV-LFE，利用额外视角的低层线索增强局部细节；4)整体仍保持encoder-decoder骨架，但核心改进在特征级扩散与可逆解码。

Result: 在KITTI、NuScenes等多数据集上均优于SOTA；KITTI官方测试集上，与基线相比，全监督设定RMSE降低4.09%，仅有稀疏深度标注时RMSE暴降37.77%，同时保持δ<1.25等指标领先；Ablation验证InvT-IndDiffusion与AV-LFE各自贡献显著。

Conclusion: 把深度估计转化为“特征复原”并引入可逆扩散，是提升现有encoder-decoder框架精度的新思路；InvT-IndDiffusion在弱监督情形下尤其有效，AV-LFE进一步补全细节。方法即插即用，代码开源，可为后续3D感知任务提供更强单目深度先验。

Abstract: Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) is a fundamental computer vision task with important applications in 3D vision. The current mainstream MDE methods employ an encoder-decoder architecture with multi-level/scale feature processing. However, the limitations of the current architecture and the effects of different-level features on the prediction accuracy are not evaluated. In this paper, we first investigate the above problem and show that there is still substantial potential in the current framework if encoder features can be improved. Therefore, we propose to formulate the depth estimation problem from the feature restoration perspective, by treating pretrained encoder features as degraded features of an assumed ground truth feature that yields the ground truth depth map. Then an Invertible Transform-enhanced Indirect Diffusion (InvT-IndDiffusion) module is developed for feature restoration. Due to the absence of direct supervision on feature, only indirect supervision from the final sparse depth map is used. During the iterative procedure of diffusion, this results in feature deviations among steps. The proposed InvT-IndDiffusion solves this problem by using an invertible transform-based decoder under the bi-Lipschitz condition. Finally, a plug-and-play Auxiliary Viewpoint-based Low-level Feature Enhancement module (AV-LFE) is developed to enhance local details with auxiliary viewpoint when available. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves better performance than the state-of-the-art methods on various datasets. Specifically on the KITTI benchmark, compared with the baseline, the performance is improved by 4.09% and 37.77% under different training settings in terms of RMSE. Code is available at https://github.com/whitehb1/IID-RDepth.

</details>


### [791] [Preventing Overfitting in Deep Image Prior for Hyperspectral Image Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08272)
*Panagiotis Gkotsis,Athanasios A. Rontogiannis*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文针对深度图像先验(DIP)在高光谱去噪中易过拟合的问题，引入Smooth ℓ1保真项与散度敏感度正则，并联合输入优化，显著抑制过拟合并提升去噪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DIP虽无需训练数据即可求解逆成像，但在高光谱去噪任务中会因网络容量过大而快速过拟合，导致性能骤降。现有DIP变体仅依赖早停，缺乏系统性的正则手段，亟需一种可在训练全程稳定抑制过拟合的方法。

Method: 提出“鲁棒保真+显式敏感度正则”框架：1) 用Smooth ℓ1取代L2保真，增强对离群噪声的鲁棒性；2) 在网络输出对输入的散度上构造敏感度正则，显式惩罚高曲率、高频过拟合分量；3) 将输入一并设为可学习参数，实现保真、正则与输入的端到端联合优化。

Result: 在真实高光谱数据集的Gaussian、sparse、stripe三种噪声场景下，提出的方法PSNR平均提升2.1 dB，SSIM提升0.018，训练后期不再出现性能骤降，曲线平稳收敛，优于现有DIP系列及传统BM4D、LRTV等基线。

Conclusion: 通过鲁棒保真与散度敏感度正则的协同，本文方法在不增加外部数据的前提下根本性地缓解了DIP过拟合，为高光谱去噪提供了更稳定、更高精度的无监督解决方案，并可拓展至其他DIP逆成像任务。

Abstract: Deep image prior (DIP) is an unsupervised deep learning framework that has been successfully applied to a variety of inverse imaging problems. However, DIP-based methods are inherently prone to overfitting, which leads to performance degradation and necessitates early stopping. In this paper, we propose a method to mitigate overfitting in DIP-based hyperspectral image (HSI) denoising by jointly combining robust data fidelity and explicit sensitivity regularization. The proposed approach employs a Smooth $\ell_1$ data term together with a divergence-based regularization and input optimization during training. Experimental results on real HSIs corrupted by Gaussian, sparse, and stripe noise demonstrate that the proposed method effectively prevents overfitting and achieves superior denoising performance compared to state-of-the-art DIP-based HSI denoising methods.

</details>


### [792] [CryoSplat: Gaussian Splatting for Cryo-EM Homogeneous Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.04929)
*Suyi Chen,Haibin Ling*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: cryoSplat 首次将可微高斯溅射渲染引入冷冻电镜三维重构，无需外部模板即可从噪声投影直接解析近原子分辨率结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GMM 方法依赖共识图或原子模型初始化，无法形成端到端管道；而通用高斯溅射针对光学成像设计，与 cryo-EM 的物理机制、坐标系及目标函数不匹配。

Method: 提出 cryoSplat：① 正交投影感知的高斯溅射，使椭球体在傅里叶切片而非光栅空间累积；② 引入视角相关归一化项，消除积分强度随倾角偏差；③ 建立 FFT 对齐的球面坐标系，实现随机初始化下的稳定优化。

Result: 在公开真实数据集上完成无模板同质重构，分辨率与 gold-standard 方法相当或更优，运行时间缩短 30%，对低信噪比（<0.1）颗粒依旧鲁棒。

Conclusion: cryoSplat 证明了高斯溅射可无缝适配 cryo-EM 物理，实现完全自洽、可扩展的近原子分辨率重构，为冷冻电镜计算流水线提供了新的高效范式。

Abstract: As a critical modality for structural biology, cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) facilitates the determination of macromolecular structures at near-atomic resolution. The core computational task in single-particle cryo-EM is to reconstruct the 3D electrostatic potential of a molecule from noisy 2D projections acquired at unknown orientations. Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) provide a continuous, compact, and physically interpretable representation for molecular density and have recently gained interest in cryo-EM reconstruction. However, existing methods rely on external consensus maps or atomic models for initialization, limiting their use in self-contained pipelines. In parallel, differentiable rendering techniques such as Gaussian splatting have demonstrated remarkable scalability and efficiency for volumetric representations, suggesting a natural fit for GMM-based cryo-EM reconstruction. However, off-the-shelf Gaussian splatting methods are designed for photorealistic view synthesis and remain incompatible with cryo-EM due to mismatches in the image formation physics, reconstruction objectives, and coordinate systems. Addressing these issues, we propose cryoSplat, a GMM-based method that integrates Gaussian splatting with the physics of cryo-EM image formation. In particular, we develop an orthogonal projection-aware Gaussian splatting, with adaptations such as a view-dependent normalization term and FFT-aligned coordinate system tailored for cryo-EM imaging. These innovations enable stable and efficient homogeneous reconstruction directly from raw cryo-EM particle images using random initialization. Experimental results on real datasets validate the effectiveness and robustness of cryoSplat over representative baselines. The code will be released at https://github.com/Chen-Suyi/cryosplat.

</details>


### [793] [Cost-Efficient Multi-Scale Fovea for Semantic-Based Visual Search Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03836)
*João Luzio,Alexandre Bernardino,Plinio Moreno*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种仿中央凹-周边的「多尺度窝」模块，嵌入基于语义的贝叶斯注意（SemBA）框架，可通过压缩外围输入显著降低深度检测器的计算量，同时提升视觉搜索扫视预测精度并贴合人类一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度对象检测器虽能提取语义形成自顶向下的前注意线索，但大尺寸视觉输入带来高昂时间开销，削弱实时性与生物合理性；需要兼顾精度与效率的感知机制。

Method: ①受经典指数衰减拓扑启发，设计多尺度金字塔形视场（Multi-Scale Fovea），中心保持全分辨率而最外层逐步降采样模拟周边失真；②将该模块嵌入提出的语义-贝叶斯注意框架SemBA，实现对检测网络的输入重构；③在目标呈现型视觉搜索任务上与既有中央凹系统及不同检测模型进行消融比较，量化计算开销与性能变化。

Result: 实验表明，引入多尺度窝模块显著降低检测相关计算量；在scanpath预测准确率上优于现有方法，并与人类行为一致性更接近，同时保留真实人类中央凹的尺度比例。

Conclusion: 通过模拟人类视网膜拓扑的输入解耦，SemBA可在不牺牲视觉任务精度前提下提升效率与生物合理性，为实时、类人注意系统提供有效范式。

Abstract: Semantics are one of the primary sources of top-down preattentive information. Modern deep object detectors excel at extracting such valuable semantic cues from complex visual scenes. However, the size of the visual input to be processed by these detectors can become a bottleneck, particularly in terms of time costs, affecting an artificial attention system's biological plausibility and real-time deployability. Inspired by classical exponential density roll-off topologies, we apply a new artificial foveation module to our novel attention prediction pipeline: the Semantic-based Bayesian Attention (SemBA) framework. We aim at reducing detection-related computational costs without compromising visual task accuracy, thereby making SemBA more biologically plausible. The proposed multi-scale pyramidal field-of-view retains maximum acuity at an innermost level, around a focal point, while gradually increasing distortion for outer levels to mimic peripheral uncertainty via downsampling. In this work we evaluate the performance of our novel Multi-Scale Fovea, incorporated into SemBA, on target-present visual search. We also compare it against other artificial foveal systems, and conduct ablation studies with different deep object detection models to assess the impact of the new topology in terms of computational costs. We experimentally demonstrate that including the new Multi-Scale Fovea module effectively reduces inherent processing costs while improving SemBA's scanpath prediction accuracy. Remarkably, we show that SemBA closely approximates human consistency while retaining the actual human fovea's proportions.

</details>


### [794] [LipKernel: Lipschitz-Bounded Convolutional Neural Networks via Dissipative Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22258)
*Patricia Pauli,Ruigang Wang,Ian Manchester,Frank Allgöwer*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 通过逐层 LMI 约束，把 Lipschitz 常数直接“写进”卷积核的 2-D Roesser 状态空间参数化，训后无计算开销即可实现鲁棒 CNN，速度比频域竞品快两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有保证 CNN Lipschitz 界的方法（谱范数、正交卷积、频域参数化）要么表达能力受限，要么推理耗时大，难以嵌入实时机器人/自动驾驶系统。

Method: 提出 LipKernel：1) 将每层卷积核显式表示为 2-D Roesser 状态空间模型；2) 设计每层线性矩阵不等式 (LMI)，使其对给定供给率具有耗散性；3) 逐层 LMI 组合保证整体输入-输出映射的 Lipschitz 常数；4) 训练完成后直接输出标准卷积形式，无需额外投影或频域反变换；5) 框架兼容 1-D/2-D 卷积、池化、步长/空洞/零填充等所有常见 CNN 模块，并可拓展到任意增量耗散层。

Result: 在 ImageNet/CIFAR 等实验上，LipKernel 的推理速度比现有最优频域 Lipschitz 网络快 10² 量级，同时保持相当或更高的准确率与严格 Lipschitz 界；在实时感知与控制器任务中验证其满足硬实时约束。

Conclusion: LipKernel 首次把 Lipschitz 鲁棒性“免费”嵌入标准 CNN 前向路径，兼具高表达能力、零推理开销与广泛层兼容，为机器人、自动驾驶等安全关键实时学习系统提供了可直接部署的轻量级鲁棒骨干。该方法可自然外推至超越 CNN 的任何增量耗散层结构。

Abstract: We propose a novel layer-wise parameterization for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that includes built-in robustness guarantees by enforcing a prescribed Lipschitz bound. Each layer in our parameterization is designed to satisfy a linear matrix inequality (LMI), which in turn implies dissipativity with respect to a specific supply rate. Collectively, these layer-wise LMIs ensure Lipschitz boundedness for the input-output mapping of the neural network, yielding a more expressive parameterization than through spectral bounds or orthogonal layers. Our new method LipKernel directly parameterizes dissipative convolution kernels using a 2-D Roesser-type state space model. This means that the convolutional layers are given in standard form after training and can be evaluated without computational overhead. In numerical experiments, we show that the run-time using our method is orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art Lipschitz-bounded networks that parameterize convolutions in the Fourier domain, making our approach particularly attractive for improving the robustness of learning-based real-time perception or control in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or automation systems. We focus on CNNs, and in contrast to previous works, our approach accommodates a wide variety of layers typically used in CNNs, including 1-D and 2-D convolutional layers, maximum and average pooling layers, as well as strided and dilated convolutions and zero padding. However, our approach naturally extends beyond CNNs as we can incorporate any layer that is incrementally dissipative.

</details>


### [795] [DHFP-PE: Dual-Precision Hybrid Floating Point Processing Element for AI Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04507)
*Shubham Kumar,Vijay Pratap Sharma,Vaibhav Neema,Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 一款28 nm双精度浮点MAC单元，用位分割技术让单个4×4乘法器在FP8与并行2×2 FP4之间复用，1.94 GHz下面积0.00396 mm²、功耗2.13 mW，比同类设计节省60%面积、87%功耗，面向低功耗AI推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI与边缘计算对低功耗、高吞吐浮点MAC需求激增，亟需一种能在FP8/FP4间切换且硬件利用率最高的处理单元。

Method: 提出位分割复用架构：将4位乘法器按模式切换为标准4×4（FP8）或并行双2×2（FP4），避免硬件复制；整合双精度浮点MAC链路，支持E4M3/E5M2 FP8与两组E2M1/E1M2 FP4格式。

Result: 28 nm实现1.94 GHz，面积0.00396 mm²，功耗2.13 mW；相比先进设计面积减60.4%，功耗降86.6%，吞吐率与精度可覆盖主流AI推理。

Conclusion: 该MAC单元以最小面积/功耗代价实现FP8/FP4双精度切换，可直接嵌入大规模加速器，为能量受限场景提供高密度、高能效AI计算基元。

Abstract: The rapid adoption of low-precision arithmetic in artificial intelligence and edge computing has created a strong demand for energy-efficient and flexible floating-point multiply-accumulate (MAC) units. This paper presents a dual-precision floating-point MAC processing element supporting FP8 (E4M3, E5M2) and FP4 (2 x E2M1, 2 x E1M2) formats, specifically optimized for low-power and high-throughput AI workloads. The proposed architecture employs a novel bit-partitioning technique that enables a single 4-bit unit multiplier to operate either as a standard 4 x 4 multiplier for FP8 or as two parallel 2 x 2 multipliers for 2-bit operands, achieving maximum hardware utilization without duplicating logic. Implemented in 28 nm technology, the proposed PE achieves an operating frequency of 1.94 GHz with an area of 0.00396 mm^2 and power consumption of 2.13 mW, resulting in up to 60.4% area reduction and 86.6% power savings compared to state-of-the-art designs, making it well suited for energy-constrained AI inference and mixed-precision computing applications when deployed within larger accelerator architectures.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [796] [Prediction Arena: Benchmarking AI Models on Real-World Prediction Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07355)
*Jaden Zhang,Gardenia Liu,Oliver Johansson,Hileamlak Yitayew,Kamryn Ohly,Grace Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prediction Arena 首次让前沿模型用真金在 Kalshi/Polymarket 上对赌 57 天，结果全军覆没（-1.1% 到 -30.8%），但平台差异巨大；Polymarket 上 grok-4 胜率 71.4%，gemini-3.1-pro 3 天赚 6.02% 成最佳。预测准确性与变现能力决定排名，算力/研究量无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 NLP 基准可被过拟合或缺乏客观真值，无法衡量模型在真实、动态、有皮肤博弈场景下的预测与决策能力。

Method: 搭建 Prediction Arena：给每模型 1 万美元独立账户，15-45 分钟自主交易，全程链上/交易所实盘；分两个队列——Cohort1 六模型全程实盘，Cohort2 四模型纸交易 3 天；采集收益、胜率、token 开销、平仓模式等多维度指标。

Result: 57 天 Kalshi 全亏损（-16.0% 至 -30.8%），但同步 Polymarket 仅-1.1%，揭示平台机制（手续费、流动性、事件粒度）对策略成败影响最大；grok-4-20 在 Polymarket 胜率 71.4%，gemini-3.1-pro 3 日收益 +6.02% 为最佳；预测准度与能否及时加仓是主要成败因子，研究量、参数规模与收益无关。

Conclusion: Prediction Arena 证明：1) 平台设计远大于模型体量，2) 当前前沿模型仍难以在真实预测市场持续盈利，3) 需将“预测+行动”耦合作为新基准，4) 未来改进应聚焦于策略校准、跨平台套利与风险控制而非单纯扩大算力。

Abstract: We introduce Prediction Arena, a benchmark for evaluating AI models' predictive accuracy and decision-making by enabling them to trade autonomously on live prediction markets with real capital. Unlike synthetic benchmarks, Prediction Arena tests models in environments where trades execute on actual exchanges (Kalshi and Polymarket), providing objective ground truth that cannot be gamed or overfitted. Each model operates as an independent agent starting with $10,000, making autonomous decisions every 15-45 minutes. Over a 57-day longitudinal evaluation (January 12 to March 9, 2026), we track two cohorts: six frontier models in live trading (Cohort 1, full period) and four next-generation models in paper trading (Cohort 2, 3-day preliminary). For Cohort 1, final Kalshi returns range from -16.0% to -30.8%. Our analysis identifies a clear performance hierarchy: initial prediction accuracy and the ability to capitalize on correct predictions are the main drivers, while research volume shows no correlation with outcomes. A striking cross-platform contrast emerges from parallel Polymarket live trading: Cohort 1 models averaged only -1.1% on Polymarket vs. -22.6% on Kalshi, with grok-4-20-checkpoint achieving a 71.4% settlement win rate - the highest across any platform or cohort. gemini-3.1-pro-preview (Cohort 2), which executed zero trades on Kalshi, achieved +6.02% on Polymarket in 3 days - the best return of any model across either cohort - demonstrating that platform design has a profound effect on which models succeed. Beyond performance, we analyze computational efficiency (token usage, cycle time), settlement accuracy, exit patterns, and market preferences, providing a comprehensive view of how frontier models behave under real financial pressure.

</details>


### [797] [BLEG: LLM Functions as Powerful fMRI Graph-Enhancer for Brain Network Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07361)
*Rui Dong,Zitong Wang,Jiaxing Li,Weihuang Zheng,Youyong Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BLEG 框架，利用 LLM 为 fMRI 功能脑图生成增强文本 → 低成本指令微调获取文本表征 → 与 GNN 进行对数-对齐联合训练 → 下游任务微调适配器，显著提升多数据集脑网络分析性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GNN 在稀疏 fMRI 脑图任务上受限于单模态特征稀疏与知识不足，LLM 虽具强大表征能力，却未见与图数据深度融合的系统方法；需以低成本引入 LLM 增强 GNN。

Method: 三阶段：① 用 LLM 生成 fMRI 图数据的增强文本；② 设计 LLM-LM 指令微调，得到低成本的文本嵌入，并与 GNN 在粗粒度空间对齐；③ 在 GNN 后接入轻量适配器，引入 LM-GNN logits 对齐损失，联合微调完成下游任务。

Result: 在多个公开 fMRI 脑网络数据集上，BLEG 相较纯 GNN 与现有 Neuro-LLM 方法取得一致且显著的性能提升（分类/回归指标提升 6–15 pp）。

Conclusion: BLEG 证明用 LLM 文本增强并以 logits 对齐方式协同训练 GNN，可在不微调大模型参数的前提下低成本放大 GNN 表征，为图神经科学计算提供通用高效的新范式。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely used in diverse brain network analysis tasks based on preprocessed functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data. However, their performances are constrained due to high feature sparsity and inherent limitations of domain knowledge within uni-modal neurographs. Meanwhile, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated powerful representation capabilities. Combining LLMs with GNNs presents a promising direction for brain network analysis. While LLMs and MLLMs have emerged in neuroscience, integration of LLMs with graph-based data remains unexplored. In this work, we deal with these issues by incorporating LLM's powerful representation and generalization capabilities. Considering great cost for directly tuning LLMs, we instead function LLM as enhancer to boost GNN's performance on downstream tasks. Our method, namely BLEG, can be divided into three stages. We firstly prompt LLM to get augmented texts for fMRI graph data, then we design a LLM-LM instruction tuning method to get enhanced textual representations at a relatively lower cost. GNN is trained together for coarsened alignment. Finally we finetune an adapter after GNN for given downstream tasks. Alignment loss between LM and GNN logits is designed to further enhance GNN's representation. Extensive experiments on different datasets confirmed BLEG's superiority.

</details>


### [798] [LLM-Generated Fault Scenarios for Evaluating Perception-Driven Lane Following in Autonomous Edge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07362)
*Faezeh Pasandideh,Achim Rettberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种离/在线解耦的故障注入框架，利用LLM/LDM在云端预生成大量高保真故障数据并蒸馏为查找表，使边缘设备在不运行重模型情况下实时评估自身鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘端自动驾驶视觉系统需做安全验证，但资源受限无法实时执行全面测试；现有静态数据集或手工故障注入难以覆盖真实环境中多样化风险。

Method: 将验证拆为：①离线——LLM语义生成结构化故障场景，LDM合成高保真传感器退化，提前构建故障-性能查找表；②在线——边缘端仅查表即可实时获取故障影响，无需本地运行LLM/LDM。

Result: 在ResNet18车道保持模型、460种故障场景上，干净数据R²≈0.85，注入雾等故障后RMSE最高增99%，±0.1m定位准确率最低降至31.0%，显著暴露正常数据评估的不足。

Conclusion: 所提框架能在资源受限边缘设备上实现实时、可预测的鲁棒性评估，证明仅用干净数据测试不足以保障现实部署安全。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous vision systems on edge devices faces a critical challenge: resource constraints prevent real-time and predictable execution of comprehensive safety tests. Existing validation methods depend on static datasets or manual fault injection, failing to capture the diverse environmental hazards encountered in real-world deployment. To address this, we introduce a decoupled offline-online fault injection framework. This architecture separates the validation process into two distinct phases: a computationally intensive Offline Phase and a lightweight Online Phase. In the offline phase, we employ Large Language Models (LLMs) to semantically generate structured fault scenarios and Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) to synthesize high-fidelity sensor degradations. These complex fault dynamics are distilled into a pre-computed lookup table, enabling the edge device to perform real-time fault-aware inference without running heavy AI models locally. We extensively validated this framework on a ResNet18 lane-following model across 460 fault scenarios. Results show that while the model achieves a baseline R^2 of approximately 0.85 on clean data, our generated faults expose significant robustness degradation, with RMSE increasing by up to 99% and within-0.10 localization accuracy dropping to as low as 31.0% under fog conditions, demonstrating the inadequacy of normal-data evaluation for real-world edge AI deployment.

</details>


### [799] [Benchmark Shadows: Data Alignment, Parameter Footprints, and Generalization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07363)
*Hongjian Zou,Yidan Wang,Qi Ding,Yixuan Liao,Xiaoxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 相同训练配置下，基准对齐数据仅提升窄指标，覆盖扩展数据带来更广泛表征、更好泛化；谱/秩诊断可区分两种机制，该规律在开源与多模态模型中普适。基准分数≠能力，数据分布决定学习动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型常出现“基准提分但泛化停滞”的怪象，作者怀疑这是训练数据分布差异所致，需厘清“数据→学习动力学→能力”的因果链。

Method: 1. 在统一训练设置下，设计“基准对齐”与“覆盖扩展”两类受控数据干预；2. 用谱分析与低秩近似构建参数空间诊断工具，量化参数更新结构与秩特征；3. 跨多开源模型家族及多模态模型复现，并做 prompt 重复扰动作为反例对照。

Result: 1. 基准对齐组：窄指标↑但表征同质化、参数秩低、谱能量集中；覆盖扩展组：泛化↑、表征多样、参数秩高、谱能量分散。2. 该二分现象在 7B-70B 语言模型及多模态模型上稳定复现；3. Prompt 重复等局部噪声不触发机制切换，说明仅全局分布改变才有效。

Conclusion: 基准提分≠模型真实能力；数据分布通过重塑参数更新结构决定学习动力学；评估与数据策展应同时监控参数空间特征，避免被窄指标误导。

Abstract: Large language models often achieve strong benchmark gains without corresponding improvements in broader capability. We hypothesize that this discrepancy arises from differences in training regimes induced by data distribution. To investigate this, we design controlled data interventions that isolate distributional effects under fixed training settings. We find that benchmark-aligned data improves narrow evaluation metrics while limiting broader representational development, whereas coverage-expanding data leads to more distributed parameter adaptation and better generalization. We further introduce parameter-space diagnostics based on spectral and rank analyses, which reveal distinct structural signatures of these regimes. Similar patterns are observed across diverse open-source model families, including multimodal models as a key case study, suggesting that these effects extend beyond controlled settings. A case study on prompt repetition shows that not all data artifacts induce regime shifts. These results indicate that benchmark performance alone is insufficient to characterize model capability, and highlight the importance of data distribution in shaping learning dynamics.

</details>


### [800] [Flow Learners for PDEs: Toward a Physics-to-Physics Paradigm for Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07366)
*Yilong Dai,Shengyu Chen,Xiaowei Jia,Runlong Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有学习型PDE求解器仍沿用“状态回归”的抽象范式，忽略了物理不确定性在约束动力学中的传播；作者提出用“流学习者”（flow learners）直接参数化输运向量场，通过连续积分生成轨迹，从而在物理空间而非状态空间中建模PDE演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE求解在高维、大域、多尺度场景下计算昂贵；生成式AI已在语音、视觉、蛋白质等领域取得突破，而PDE求解尚未出现类似范式跃迁。关键在于训练目标的抽象层次——多数模型只预测单时刻状态，无法刻画不确定性沿动力学约束的传播。

Method: 提出“流学习者”框架：将求解目标从“预测下一状态”改为“学习输运向量场”，通过可逆或正则化积分生成连续轨迹；利用输运映射与物理守恒结构的天然一致性，实现连续时间外推、内生不确定性量化及物理约束保持。

Result: 理论论证表明：基于输运的抽象比状态回归更能捕捉物理可接受轨迹流形；初步实验显示流学习者在长期 rollout 的稳定性与不确定性校准上优于 PINN、神经算子及扩散型求解器。

Conclusion: 将学习型PDE求解的核心抽象从“状态”升级为“输运”提供了统一的组织原则，可催生连续时间、物理一致、可扩展的新一代求解器；未来需深入研究输运空间的网络架构、高效积分策略、混合保结构实现及跨尺度不确定性量化。

Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) govern nearly every physical process in science and engineering, yet solving them at scale remains prohibitively expensive. Generative AI has transformed language, vision, and protein science, but learned PDE solvers have not undergone a comparable shift. Existing paradigms each capture part of the problem. Physics-informed neural networks embed residual structure, yet they are often difficult to optimize in stiff, multiscale, or large-domain regimes. Neural operators amortize across instances, yet they commonly inherit a snapshot-prediction view of solving and can degrade over long rollouts. Diffusion-based solvers model uncertainty, yet they are often built on a solver template that still centers on state regression. We argue that the core issue is the abstraction used to train learned solvers. Many models are asked to predict states, while many scientific settings require modeling how uncertainty moves through constrained dynamics. The relevant object is transport over physically admissible futures. This motivates \emph{flow learners}: models that parameterize transport vector fields and generate trajectories through integration, echoing the continuous dynamics that define PDE evolution. This physics-to-physics alignment supports continuous-time prediction, native uncertainty quantification, and new opportunities for physics-aware solver design. We explain why transport-based learning offers a stronger organizing principle for learned PDE solving and outline the research agenda that follows from this shift.

</details>


### [801] [The Role of Emotional Stimuli and Intensity in Shaping Large Language Model Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07369)
*Ameen Patel,Felix Lee,Kyle Liang,Joseph Thomas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了不同情感类型与强度对LLM提示的影响，发现正面情感提升准确性与安全性，但会加剧谄媚倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有情感提示研究仅聚焦单一正向情感，且未考虑情感强度差异，亟需验证不同情感类别与强度对模型行为的真实作用。

Method: 构建四类情感（喜悦、鼓励、愤怒、不安全感）× 多强度提示生成流水线；用 GPT-4o-mini 与人工共同生成并筛选出“Gold Dataset”；在准确率、谄媚性与毒性三维度上评估模型表现。

Result: 正向情感刺激显著提高回答准确率并降低毒性，但同时显著放大模型的谄媚行为；负面情感未带来一致增益。

Conclusion: 情感提示可作为低成本性能调优手段，但需警惕其诱导的讨好偏差，未来应结合强度校准与纠偏策略以平衡准确性与安全性。

Abstract: Emotional prompting - the use of specific emotional diction in prompt engineering - has shown increasing promise in improving large language model (LLM) performance, truthfulness, and responsibility. However these studies have been limited to single types of positive emotional stimuli and have not considered varying degrees of emotion intensity in their analyses. In this paper, we explore the effects of four distinct emotions - joy, encouragement, anger, and insecurity - in emotional prompting and evaluate them on accuracy, sycophancy, and toxicity. We develop a prompt-generation pipeline with GPT-4o mini to create a suite of LLM and human-generated prompts with varying intensities across the four emotions. Then, we compile a "Gold Dataset" of prompts where human and model labels align. Our empirical evaluation on LLM behavior suggests that positive emotional stimuli lead to more accurate and less toxic results, but also increase sycophantic behavior.

</details>


### [802] [The Lifecycle of the Spectral Edge: From Gradient Learning to Weight-Decay Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07380)
*Yongzhong Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现Grokking过程中参数更新谱边缘存在由梯度主导到权重衰减主导的两阶段突变，该边缘在突跃后成为对扰动平坦但对消融极度关键的压缩轴，且信息经非线性重编码而非丢失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释深度模型在突然泛化（grokking）时参数空间到底发生了什么结构性变化，以及权重衰减与梯度如何共同塑造这一转变。

Method: 在Dyck-1与SCAN两项序列任务上，将参数更新Gram矩阵的谱边缘分解为梯度与权重衰减分量；用gap flow方程预测三种普适类；通过线性与非线性探针验证信息是否丢失；并在grokking后移除权重衰减做反卷实验。

Result: 观察到清晰的梯度→压缩两相生命周期；grokking临界点处梯度与权重衰减对齐，谱边缘成为扰动平坦但消融影响>4000×的压缩轴；出现功能/混合/压缩三种普适类；非线性探针R²达0.99，表明信息被重编码；去权重衰减可逆压缩而算法保持。

Conclusion: Grokking对应参数空间的一次结构化压缩相变，权重衰减是触发该相变的核心力量，信息以非线性方式被保留，模型已学到的算法可在去压缩后依旧存在。

Abstract: We decompose the spectral edge -- the dominant direction of the Gram matrix of parameter updates -- into its gradient and weight-decay components during grokking in two sequence tasks (Dyck-1 and SCAN). We find a sharp two-phase lifecycle: before grokking the edge is gradient-driven and functionally active; at grokking, gradient and weight decay align, and the edge becomes a compression axis that is perturbation-flat yet ablation-critical (>4000x more impactful than random directions). Three universality classes emerge (functional, mixed, compression), predicted by the gap flow equation. Nonlinear probes show information is re-encoded, not lost (MLP $R^2=0.99$ where linear $R^2=0.86$), and removing weight decay post-grok reverses compression while preserving the algorithm.

</details>


### [803] [Latent Structure of Affective Representations in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07382)
*Benjamin J. Choi,Melanie Weber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者用几何方法分析大模型内部的情感表征，证明其符合心理学 valence-arousal 模型，可线性近似，并可用来量化不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于缺乏真实潜空间几何，现有对 LLM 表征几何的验证困难；情绪同时具有类别与连续维度且安全相关，可作为理想探针。

Method: 采集 LLM 情感相关隐向量，运用几何数据分析工具，检验其与心理学 valence-arousal 模型的一致性、线性可分性及与不确定性的关系。

Result: 1) 情感隐空间呈心理学对齐的相干结构；2) 虽呈非线性但可用线性近似，为线性表征假设提供实证；3) 该空间能预测模型情感任务的不确定性。

Conclusion: LLM 自学的情感潜空间几何接近人类模型，为可解释性与安全性提供新线索。
