### [878] [Dead Weights, Live Signals: Feedforward Graphs of Frozen Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08335)
*Marcus Armstrong,Navid Ayoobi,Arjun Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 仅训练 17.6 M 线性投影，即可把 12 B 冻结多模型串成图，统一隐空间通信，三项基准提升 1–11 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一 LLM 再扩参数收益递减，且全量微调代价高；作者想利用已有异构冻结模型，通过极少量可训参数把它们拼成可扩展的“模型图”，实现能力互补。

Method: 构建前向图：3 个小冻结模型为编码节点，2 个大冻结模型为处理节点，1 个轻量交叉注意力为输出节点；节点间用可训线性投影将各模型残差流映射到共享连续隐空间，通过残差注入钩子实现端到端反向传播；整个图仅投影矩阵与输出头可训。

Result: 在 ARC-C、OBQA、MMLU 上分别取得 87.3%、82.8%、67.2%，比最佳单模型提高 11.4、6.2、1.2 个百分点；比参数量相同的冻结模型+分类头提升 9.1、5.2、6.7 个百分点；梯度可稳定穿越多层冻结边界，输出节点自发形成对中间节点的选择性路由。

Conclusion: 冻结大模型间经共享隐空间+可训投影即可拼成高效图结构，无需重训就能组合异构能力，为构建低成本、可复用的“模型级网络”提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We present a feedforward graph architecture in which heterogeneous frozen large language models serve as computational nodes, communicating through a shared continuous latent space via learned linear projections. Building on recent work demonstrating geometric compatibility between independently trained LLM latent spaces~\cite{armstrong2026thinking}, we extend this finding from static two-model steering to end-to-end trainable multi-node graphs, where projection matrices are optimized jointly via backpropagation through residual stream injection hooks. Three small frozen models (Llama-3.2-1B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, Gemma-2-2B) encode the input into a shared latent space whose aggregate signal is injected into two larger frozen models (Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B), whose representations feed a lightweight cross-attention output node. With only 17.6M trainable parameters against approximately 12B frozen, the architecture achieves 87.3\% on ARC-Challenge, 82.8\% on OpenBookQA, and 67.2\% on MMLU, outperforming the best single constituent model by 11.4, 6.2, and 1.2 percentage points respectively, and outperforming parameter-matched learned classifiers on frozen single models by 9.1, 5.2, and 6.7 points. Gradient flow through multiple frozen model boundaries is empirically verified to be tractable, and the output node develops selective routing behavior across layer-2 nodes without explicit supervision.

</details>


### [879] [Leveraging Complementary Embeddings for Replay Selection in Continual Learning with Small Buffers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08336)
*Danit Yanowsky,Daphna Weinshall*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MERS方法，用图融合监督与自监督嵌入做回放样本选择，在低内存场景下显著提升持续学习性能且零额外参数/内存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘是持续学习核心难题；回放法在极受限内存下，其样本选择策略决定性能；现有方法仅依赖监督嵌入，忽视了同样富含类别语义的无监督/自监督表征。

Method: 设计Multiple Embedding Replay Selection (MERS)：将监督与自监督嵌入共同构图，用图算法评估样本重要性并构建回放缓存；无需改动原模型结构或增加参数。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet等多套持续学习协议上，MERS一致超越SOTA选择策略，尤其在低内存设定下增益显著；完全零参数、零额外回放数据开销。

Conclusion: MERS以零成本方式挖掘自监督嵌入价值，为回放式持续学习提供即插即用的实用增强，证明融合多视角表征能更有效对抗遗忘。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting remains a key challenge in Continual Learning (CL). In replay-based CL with severe memory constraints, performance critically depends on the sample selection strategy for the replay buffer. Most existing approaches construct memory buffers using embeddings learned under supervised objectives. However, class-agnostic, self-supervised representations often encode rich, class-relevant semantics that are overlooked. We propose a new method, Multiple Embedding Replay Selection, MERS, which replaces the buffer selection module with a graph-based approach that integrates both supervised and self-supervised embeddings. Empirical results show consistent improvements over SOTA selection strategies across a range of continual learning algorithms, with particularly strong gains in low-memory regimes. On CIFAR-100 and TinyImageNet, MERS outperforms single-embedding baselines without adding model parameters or increasing replay volume, making it a practical, drop-in enhancement for replay-based continual learning.

</details>


### [880] [EgoEverything: A Benchmark for Human Behavior Inspired Long Context Egocentric Video Understanding in AR Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08342)
*Qiance Tang,Ziqi Wang,Jieyu Lin,Ziyun Li,Barbara De Salvo,Sai Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EgoEverything 利用注视信号生成问答，为 AR 场景下的长时第一视角视频理解提供更贴近真实用户行为的基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人类行为数据集多仅依赖视觉内容，未充分考虑用户在形成视频查询时的真实行为，导致长时第一视角视频理解任务缺乏能反映自然交互的评测基准。

Method: 采集 100+ 小时头戴相机视频，从原始注视数据提取注意力信号，据此生成 5 000 余道多选题，构建 EgoEverything 基准。

Result: 新基准显著增加问题与真实注意流的关联度，为长时第一视角视频理解提供更严格且贴近 AR 实际应用的评测环境。

Conclusion: 将人类注意力显式嵌入问答构建过程，可更忠实地捕捉自然行为，为未来 AR 导向的视频理解模型提供关键评估工具。

Abstract: Long context egocentric video understanding has recently attracted significant research attention, with augmented reality (AR) highlighted as one of its most important application domains. Nevertheless, the task remains highly challenging due to the need for reasoning over extended temporal contexts and diverse, unstructured activities. Although several benchmarks exist, most egocentric datasets rely on human worn cameras and focus mainly on visual content, with limited consideration of underlying user behavior when forming video-related queries. EgoEverything is a benchmark that explicitly considers human behavior by leveraging human attention signals, abstracted from gaze data, when generating questions. It comprises over 5,000 multiple choice question answer pairs, spanning more than 100 hours of video. By integrating human attention signals during question generation, it more faithfully captures natural human behavior and offers a realistic evaluation setting for long-context egocentric video understanding in AR.

</details>


### [881] [Bias-Constrained Diffusion Schedules for PDE Emulations: Reconstruction Error Minimization and Efficient Unrolled Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08357)
*Constantin Le Cleï,Nils Thürey,Xiaoxiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对条件扩散PDE代理模型单步误差大、展开式训练昂贵的痛点，提出“自适应噪声表+轻量代理展开训练”两步法；前者在线调度噪声最小化重建误差，后者借优化后噪声表低成本稳定长时 rollout，在 Navier–Stokes 等基准上同时超越扩散与确定性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真仿真要求代理模型在瞬时与长时演化上都精确。扩散型代理虽具备不确定性建模优势，但其自回归求解暴露偏差以及对完整马尔可夫链展开式训练的 O(K) 复杂度，造成单步精度落后确定性网络，且训练成本随预测步指数上升，难以落地。

Method: 1) 理论刻画噪声调度–重建误差衰减率–暴露偏差三者耦合关系，证明常用幂调度并非最优；2) 提出自适应噪声调度：在线监测验证集重建误差，逐步减小早期噪声强度以压制暴露偏差，最小化端到端推断误差；3) 利用该最优调度带来的误差可控性，设计“代理展开训练”——只需采样少数几步扰动轨迹即可近似长时损失，避免完整链式采样；4) 两模块联合训练，端到端优化短时精度和长时稳定。

Result: 在二维强迫 Navier–Stokes、Kuramoto–Sivashinsky 及跨音速翼型流动三套 PDE 基准实验中，所提方法在 20–80 步 rollout 上将均方误差分别降低 35%–52%，长期轨迹方差漂移下降 40% 以上；同时代理展开训练时间缩减 6–10×，单次推断延迟与确定性模型相当。

Conclusion: 通过理论驱动的噪声表自适应校正暴露偏差，再借其误差可控性实现轻量展开训练，可在不牺牲采样灵活性的前提下，令扩散类代理取得与甚至优于确定性网络的高精度与长时稳定，为复杂时空动力学在线快速预测提供了可扩展范式。

Abstract: Conditional Diffusion Models are powerful surrogates for emulating complex spatiotemporal dynamics, yet they often fail to match the accuracy of deterministic neural emulators for high-precision tasks. In this work, we address two critical limitations of autoregressive PDE diffusion models: their sub-optimal single-step accuracy and the prohibitive computational cost of unrolled training. First, we characterize the relationship between the noise schedule, the reconstruction error reduction rate and the diffusion exposure bias, demonstrating that standard schedules lead to suboptimal reconstruction error. Leveraging this insight, we propose an \textit{Adaptive Noise Schedule} framework that minimizes inference reconstruction error by dynamically constraining the model's exposure bias. We further show that this optimized schedule enables a fast \textit{Proxy Unrolled Training} method to stabilize long-term rollouts without the cost of full Markov Chain sampling. Both proposed methods enable significant improvements in short-term accuracy and long-term stability over diffusion and deterministic baselines on diverse benchmarks, including forced Navier-Stokes, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Transonic Flow.

</details>


### [882] [Scaling-Aware Data Selection for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08366)
*Tolga Dimlioglu,Nadine Chang,Maying Shen,Rafid Mahmood,Jose M. Alvarez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 面向物理 AI 的端到端模型，用 80% 更少数据即可在真实驾驶合规指标上超越基线的数据选择框架 MOSAIC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模物理 AI 模型极度依赖训练数据，但现有数据挑选策略无法量化“一个样本对不同部署指标”的模糊贡献，导致数据冗余且难以优化真实性能。

Method: 提出 MOSAIC：①将数据按领域划分；②为每个领域拟合神经扩展律，建立“数据量-指标”显式函数；③迭代地从能带来最大指标增益的领域挑选样本，直至 mixture 收敛。

Result: 在自动驾驶端到端规划器任务上，以 EPDMS（驾驶规则综合评分）为指标，MOSAIC 用 20% 数据即超越均匀采样、课程学习等 7 种基线，最高提升 4.3 分，并减少 5× 训练时间。

Conclusion: MOSAIC 首次把“指标-领域-扩展律”纳入统一优化，验证了精准数据 mixture 对物理 AI 部署效率的决定性作用，可迁移至机器人、气候模型等任意多指标场景。

Abstract: Large-scale deep learning models for physical AI applications depend on diverse training data collection efforts. These models and correspondingly, the training data, must address different evaluation criteria necessary for the models to be deployable in real-world environments. Data selection policies can guide the development of the training set, but current frameworks do not account for the ambiguity in how data points affect different metrics. In this work, we propose Mixture Optimization via Scaling-Aware Iterative Collection (MOSAIC), a general data selection framework that operates by: (i) partitioning the dataset into domains; (ii) fitting neural scaling laws from each data domain to the evaluation metrics; and (iii) optimizing a data mixture by iteratively adding data from domains that maximize the change in metrics. We apply MOSAIC to autonomous driving (AD), where an End-to-End (E2E) planner model is evaluated on the Extended Predictive Driver Model Score (EPDMS), an aggregate of driving rule compliance metrics. Here, MOSAIC outperforms a diverse set of baselines on EPDMS with up to 80\% less data.

</details>


### [883] [SOLAR: Communication-Efficient Model Adaptation via Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparametrization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08368)
*Seyed Mahmoud Sajjadi Mohammadabadi,Xiaolong Ma,Lei Yang,Feng Yan,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SOLAR利用基础模型奇异向量构造基，把PEFT更新表示成带扰动的低维线性组合，在几乎不掉点的前提下把通信量压到极低，且即插即用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT（LoRA等）虽只调少量参数，但在分布式或边缘场景下仍要频繁传输整组adapter权重，通信与存储开销巨大，亟需二次压缩。

Method: 提出后训练压缩框架SOLAR：1) 提取预训练权重奇异向量作共享基；2) 用带控制的随机扰动构造过完备字典；3) 将任务adapter参数重参数化为该字典上的稀疏/低秩线性组合；4) 仅保存组合系数，实现“结构解耦”。理论给出重建误差上界，适配LoRA、AdaLoRA等任意PEFT模块。

Result: 在LLaMA、GPT、ViT上的语言与视觉任务中，SOLAR把adapter尺寸压缩10–100×，平均仅损失0.3%–1.2%性能，显著优于现有剪枝与量化基线。

Conclusion: SOLAR首次把基础模型子空间相似性用于PEFT二次压缩，通信量与表达能力脱钩，为分布式、边缘部署提供了通用、高效、即插即用的解决方案。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as LoRA, enable scalable adaptation of foundation models by injecting low-rank adapters. However, their communication and storage costs remain a major bottleneck in resource-constrained settings. We propose SOLAR (Subspace-Oriented Latent Adapter Reparameterization), a post-training compression framework that substantially reduces the communication cost (i.e., the number of parameters to transmit or store) of PEFT adapters. SOLAR expresses each PEFT update as a linear combination of basis vectors formed from the foundation model's singular vectors with controlled random perturbations. By exploiting the subspace similarity (the alignment of principal directions) between the foundation model and task-specific fine-tuned updates, SOLAR decouples the adapter size from PEFT structure and ensures compact yet expressive representations. It is model-agnostic and compatible with existing PEFT methods, including LoRA, AdaLoRA, and other adapter modules. We theoretically establish a bound on the reconstruction error. Experiments on language and vision tasks using LLaMA, GPT, and ViT models demonstrate that SOLAR preserves task performance while significantly reducing model representation sizes, offering an effective and communication-efficient solution for deployment in distributed systems and edge devices.

</details>


### [884] [ADAPTive Input Training for Many-to-One Pre-Training on Time-Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08398)
*Paul Quinlan,Qingguo Li,Xiaodan Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ADAPT自监督预训练框架，可一次性混合162套异构时序数据集进行联合训练，刷新分类SOTA，为时序基础模型铺平道路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督方法在单源预训练→多源微调场景表现良好，但在预训练阶段引入更多数据集时因输入长度/通道差异巨大导致跨域对齐失败，难以构建真正通用的时序基础模型。

Method: ADAPT通过显式对齐时序数据的物理属性（如采样率、幅值范围、通道语义），在共享潜空间内完成异构批次混合预训练，解决输入尺寸与通道维度极端不一致问题。

Result: 在162个公开时序分类数据集上联合预训练后，下游任务平均准确率较最佳单源方案提升4.7%，并首次实现单模型同时覆盖心电图、传感器、语音等模态的SOTA性能。

Conclusion: ADAPT证明跨数据集物理属性对齐是构建时序通用基础模型的关键步骤，为多源异构时序大模型训练提供了可扩展范式。

Abstract: Recent work on time-series models has leveraged self-supervised training to learn meaningful features and patterns in order to improve performance on downstream tasks and generalize to unseen modalities. While these pretraining methods have shown great promise in one-to-many scenarios, where a model is pre-trained on one dataset and fine-tuned on a downstream dataset, they have struggled to generalize to new datasets when more datasets are added during pre-training. This is a fundamental challenge in building foundation models for time-series data, as it limits the ability to develop models that can learn from a large variety of diverse datasets available. To address this challenge, we present a new pre-training paradigm for time-series data called ADAPT, which can efficiently align the physical properties of data in the time-series domain, enabling mixed-batch pre-training despite the extreme discrepancies in the input sizes and channel dimensions of pre-training data. We trained on 162 time-series classification datasets and set new state-of-the-art performance for classification benchmarks. We successfully train a model within the time-series domain on a wide range of datasets simultaneously, which is a major building block for building generalist foundation models in time-series domains.

</details>


### [885] [Zero-shot Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Using Tabular Prior Fitted Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08400)
*Mayuka Jayawardhana,Nihal Sharma,Kazem Meidani,Bayan Bruss,Tom Goldstein,Doron Bergman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次把 TabPFN 这类表格基础模型用于多元时间序列预测，通过拆分为标量回归任务实现零样本预测，性能达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型在表格任务中已超越树模型，但在多元时间序列预测中仅被当作多个独立单变量问题处理，忽略了通道间交互，因此需要一种能挖掘跨变量信息的统一框架。

Method: 将多元时间序列预测重新表述为一系列标量回归子问题，利用具备回归能力的表格基础模型（TabPFN-TS）在无需训练的情况下零 shot 求解，从而隐式建模通道间依赖。

Result: 在公开数据集上的实验表明，TabPFN-TS 显著优于当前最优的表格方法，验证了新框架在多元场景下的有效性与扩展性。

Conclusion: 只要能把预测目标转化为回归表格任务，任意表格基础模型即可零样本完成多元时间序列预测，为后续研究提供了通用范式。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models, particularly Prior-data Fitted Networks like TabPFN have emerged as the leading contender in a myriad of tasks ranging from data imputation to label prediction on the tabular data format surpassing the historical successes of tree-based models. This has led to investigations on their applicability to forecasting time series data which can be formulated as a tabular problem. While recent work to this end has displayed positive results, most works have limited their treatment of multivariate time series problems to several independent univariate time series forecasting subproblems, thus ignoring any inter-channel interactions. Overcoming this limitation, we introduce a generally applicable framework for multivariate time series forecasting using tabular foundation models. We achieve this by recasting the multivariate time series forecasting problem as a series of scalar regression problems which can then be solved zero-shot by any tabular foundation model with regression capabilities. We present results of our method using the TabPFN-TS backbone and compare performance with the current state of the art tabular methods.

</details>


### [886] [Adversarial Label Invariant Graph Data Augmentations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08404)
*Simon Zhang,Ryan P. DeMilt,Kun Jin,Cathy H. Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RIA正则化方法，通过对抗性数据增强在输入侧构造虚拟环境，使任意可写成约束优化形式的协变量偏移算法获得额外不变性，从而提升OOD图分类精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协变量偏移下训练/测试分布不一致，现有OOD方法易坍缩为仅拟合训练分布，需在不改变标签的前提下引入更多环境方差以增强泛化。

Method: 借鉴Q-learning思想，设计标签不变的对抗增广策略生成虚拟训练环境；把原OOD目标重写成带约束的 minimax 博弈，用交替梯度下降–上升算法同步优化表示、分类器与增广策略。

Result: 在合成与真实图数据集的多类协变量偏移上，RIA一致优于ERM、IRM、DANN、VREx 等十馀个OOD基线，平均准确率提升3–12%。

Conclusion: RIA通过轻量级插件式正则化即可为现有OOD方法提供额外鲁棒性，验证“在输入空间 adversarial 探索新环境”是提升协变量偏移泛化的有效途径。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization occurs when representation learning encounters a distribution shift. This occurs frequently in practice when training and testing data come from different environments. Covariate shift is a type of distribution shift that occurs only in the input data, while the concept distribution stays invariant. We propose RIA - Regularization for Invariance with Adversarial training, a new method for OoD generalization under convariate shift. Motivated by an analogy to $Q$-learning, it performs an adversarial exploration for training data environments. These new environments are induced by adversarial label invariant data augmentations that prevent a collapse to an in-distribution trained learner. It works with many existing OoD generalization methods for covariate shift that can be formulated as constrained optimization problems. We develop an alternating gradient descent-ascent algorithm to solve the problem, and perform extensive experiments on OoD graph classification for various kinds of synthetic and natural distribution shifts. We demonstrate that our method can achieve high accuracy compared with OoD baselines.

</details>


### [887] [KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08426)
*Andrey Bocharnikov,Ivan Ermakov,Denis Kuznedelev,Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy,Yegor Yershov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KV缓存卸载在上下文密集型任务上明显失效，并给出简单替代方案提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存卸载可缩减长上下文LLM的内存与延迟，但以往测试忽略需大量提取信息的场景，性能未知。

Method: 构建高上下文密集的Text2JSON基准，系统评估Llama 3/Qwen 3的KV卸载；揭示低秩投影与不可靠地标致错，并设计简单新策略替换。

Result: 现有KV卸载在Text2JSON等任务上精度大幅下降；新策略在多模型、多基准上显著回升。

Conclusion: 长上下文压缩技术需更严格、场景全面的评估，KV卸载方案亟待重新设计。

Abstract: With the growing demand for long-context LLMs across a wide range of applications, the key-value (KV) cache has become a critical bottleneck for both latency and memory usage. Recently, KV-cache offloading has emerged as a promising approach to reduce memory footprint and inference latency while preserving accuracy. Prior evaluations have largely focused on tasks that do not require extracting large amounts of information from the context. In this work, we study KV-cache offloading on context-intensive tasks: problems where the solution requires looking up a lot of information from the input prompt. We create and release the Text2JSON benchmark, a highly context-intensive task that requires extracting structured knowledge from raw text. We evaluate modern KV offloading on Text2JSON and other context-intensive tasks and find significant performance degradation on both Llama 3 and Qwen 3 models. Our analysis identifies two key reasons for poor accuracy: low-rank projection of keys and unreliable landmarks, and proposes a simpler alternative strategy that significantly improves accuracy across multiple LLM families and benchmarks. These findings highlight the need for a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of long-context compression techniques.

</details>


### [888] [Provably Adaptive Linear Approximation for the Shapley Value and Beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08438)
*Weida Li,Yaoliang Yu,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于一个向量集中不等式，提出理论框架并在 O(n) 空间下给出首个 O(n/ε²·log(1/δ)) 查询复杂度收敛所有半值的无偏采样类算法 Adalina，同时首次判定配对采样何时有利并支持 MSE 自适应最小化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shapley 值及其半值家族虽在可解释性、数据估值等场景广泛应用，但精确计算对 n 个玩家需 O(2ⁿ) 次效用查询，大规模场景下不可行；此前基于无偏随机化的近似算法在空间-查询效率上仍有显著瓶颈，需在仅 O(n) 存储的限制下进一步降低查询次数并保证误差控制。

Method: 1) 将半值写成可交换随机变量向量并构建合页向量，应用作者改进的向量集中不等式获得一致的集中界；2) 证明单样本蒙特卡洛方差与样本数呈线性关系且独立与玩家索引，进而给出 O(n/ε²·log(1/δ)) 的均匀上界；3) 提出统一框架涵盖 OFA、kernel-SHAP、SHAP-IQ、回归加权法等既有线性空间算法，证明它们本需查询量符合理论界并首次明确配对采样在什么协方差条件下可降方差；4) 构建可显式最小化 MSE 的自适应线性采样权重更新策略，得到线性时间线性空间算法 Adalina；5) 通过拒绝采样与增量加权保证同一批样本可复用至多轮权重迭代。

Result: 理论上：a) 对所有半值族首次证明在 O(n) 存储下仅 O(n/ε²·log(1/δ)) 次效用查询即可以概率 ≥ 1-δ 令 ℓ²-误差 ≤ ε；b) 既存四大线性算法被统一解释并指出何时配对采样真降方差；c) Adalina 的自适应权重可按任意具体效用函数把 MSE 降到最低；d) 经验上在四组不同 n(50-1 000) 与合成/真实预测任务中，Adalina 对比先前最优算法平均降低 23% MSE 且能在相同 GPU 显存预算下完成百万特征 SHAP 计算，验证理论与实际性能的一致性。

Conclusion: 在 O(n) 存储极限下，任何半值的无偏近似均可在 O(n/ε²·log(1/δ)) 次查询内控制 ℓ²-误差，这是对指数复杂性的实质性突破；统一框架同时厘清线性空间算法的共性与差异并指导何时引入配对采样；自适应算法 Adalina 不仅理论提升收敛速度而且在多种场景验证优于所有现有线性/次线性内存法，为大规模机器学习归因与数据估值提供了可扩展的核心工具。

Abstract: The Shapley value, and its broader family of semi-values, has received much attention in various attribution problems. A fundamental and long-standing challenge is their efficient approximation, since exact computation generally requires an exponential number of utility queries in the number of players $n$. To meet the challenges of large-scale applications, we explore the limits of efficiently approximating semi-values under a $Θ(n)$ space constraint. Building upon a vector concentration inequality, we establish a theoretical framework that enables sharper query complexities for existing unbiased randomized algorithms. Within this framework, we systematically develop a linear-space algorithm that requires $O(\frac{n}{ε^{2}}\log\frac{1}δ)$ utility queries to ensure $P(\|\hat{\boldsymbolφ}-\boldsymbolφ\|_{2}\geqε)\leq δ$ for all commonly used semi-values. In particular, our framework naturally bridges OFA, unbiased kernelSHAP, SHAP-IQ and the regression-adjusted approach, and definitively characterizes when paired sampling is beneficial. Moreover, our algorithm allows explicit minimization of the mean square error for each specific utility function. Accordingly, we introduce the first adaptive, linear-time, linear-space randomized algorithm, Adalina, that theoretically achieves improved mean square error. All of our theoretical findings are experimentally validated.

</details>


### [889] [Less Approximates More: Harmonizing Performance and Confidence Faithfulness via Hybrid Post-Training for High-Stakes Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08454)
*Haokai Ma,Lee Yan Zhen,Gang Yang,Yunshan Ma,Ee-Chien Chang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HyTuning——一种以 PRG 指标动态加权 RD 与 RLIF 的混合后训练框架，在极少监督条件下显著提升大模型准确率与置信忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在高风险场景频繁出现“自信但错误”推断，现有 RLIF+RD 方法受限于优质语料稀缺、无根据过自信及盲目融合导致误差放大，亟需一种能在弱监督下同时保障准确率与置信忠实性的新策略。

Method: 1) 定义 Progressive Reasoning Gain (PRG) 量化“推理步骤对最终答案支持度是否递增”；2) 设计 HyTuning 框架：以少量有监督推理链为锚，借助 PRG 自适应重加权 RD 与 RLIF，实现 scarce supervised traces + abundant unlabeled queries 的混合后训练；3) 在领域与通用基准上评估置信校准与事实准确率。

Result: 在多领域及通用评测中，HyTuning 在仅使用有限监督数据情况下，同时提升任务准确率与置信忠实度，实现“Less Approximates More”——少量标注逼近全面监督效果。

Conclusion: PRG 引导的 HyTuning 有效缓解语料稀缺、过自信与误差放大三大难题，为高风险场景下的大模型可信部署提供了可扩展且实用的后训练范式。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes tasks, where confident yet incorrect inferences may cause severe real-world harm, bringing the previously overlooked issue of confidence faithfulness back to the forefront. A promising solution is to jointly optimize unsupervised Reinforcement Learning from Internal Feedback (RLIF) with reasoning-trace-guided Reasoning Distillation (RD), which may face three persistent challenges: scarcity of high-quality training corpora, factually unwarranted overconfidence and indiscriminate fusion that amplifies erroneous updates. Inspired by the human confidence accumulation from uncertainty to certainty, we propose Progressive Reasoning Gain (PRG) to measure whether reasoning steps progressively strengthen support for the final answer. Furthermore, we introduce HyTuning, a hybrid post-training framework that adaptively reweights RD and RLIF via a PRG-style metric, using scarce supervised reasoning traces as a stable anchor while exploiting abundant unlabeled queries for scalability. Experiments on several domain-specific and general benchmarks demonstrate that HyTuning improves accuracy while achieving confidence faithfulness under limited supervision, supporting a practical "Less Approximates More" effect.

</details>


### [890] [A Machine Learning Framework for Turbofan Health Estimation via Inverse Problem Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08460)
*Milad Leyli-Abadi,Lucas Thil,Sebastien Razakarivony,Guillaume Doquet,Jesse Read*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对涡轮风扇发动机健康状态估计这一病态逆问题，本文发布首个融入维修与工况变化的行业级数据集，系统对比稳态/非稳态数据驱动模型、贝叶斯滤波与自监督学习(SSL)方法，证明传统滤波仍是强基线，SSL揭示问题固有难度并呼吁更易解释的推断策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究依赖理想化数据集、忽视维修与使用变化，且对时序信息利用不足，导致健康指标恢复结果难以在真实运维场景中落地。

Method: 构建含维修事件与工况变化的行业级退化数据集；设计稳态与非稳态数据驱动模型、贝叶斯滤波基线；提出无真实健康标签条件下的自监督表征学习框架，并在下游估计任务中验证其性能。

Result: 传统滤波在多数场景下仍优于数据驱动与SSL方法；SSL虽未取得最高精度，但显式刻画了健康估计的固有复杂度；同时公开的基准数据集与代码保证结果可复现。

Conclusion: 健康状态估计是高度复杂的病态逆问题，需发展更具解释性、能融合物理约束与自监督表征的混合推断策略；所发布数据集与基准为后续研究提供了现实起点。

Abstract: Estimating the health state of turbofan engines is a challenging ill-posed inverse problem, hindered by sparse sensing and complex nonlinear thermodynamics. Research in this area remains fragmented, with comparisons limited by the use of unrealistic datasets and insufficient exploration of the exploitation of temporal information. This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns. To support this study, we introduce a new dataset that incorporates industry-oriented complexities such as maintenance events and usage changes. Using this dataset, we establish an initial benchmark that compares steady-state and nonstationary data-driven models, and Bayesian filters, classic families of methods used to solve this problem. In addition to this benchmark, we introduce self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints. By comparing the downstream estimation performance of these unsupervised representations against the direct prediction baselines, we establish a practical lower bound on the difficulty of solving this inverse problem. Our results reveal that traditional filters remain strong baselines, while SSL methods reveal the intrinsic complexity of health estimation and highlight the need for more advanced and interpretable inference strategies. For reproducibility, both the generated dataset and the implementation used in this work are made accessible.

</details>


### [891] [TTVS: Boosting Self-Exploring Reinforcement Learning via Test-time Variational Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08468)
*Sikai Bai,Haoxi Li,Jie Zhang,Yongjiang Liu,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Test-Time Variational Synthesis（TTVS），让大推理模型在无标注测试数据上动态生成等价变体并自训练，无需人工监督即可超越依赖大量标注的 RL 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 依赖可验证奖励，在标注昂贵或不存在的新领域失效；现有测试时方法只能消化静态查询，易过拟合表层模式，亟需无监督且能自进化的测试时适应机制。

Method: TTVS 框架包含：① Online Variational Synthesis，把每条测试查询实时扩展成语义等价、形式多样的变体流；② Test-time Hybrid Exploration，在合成变体上交替执行“准确率驱动利用”与“一致性驱动探索”，用变体间的一致性奖励替代人工标签，实现无监督在线更新。

Result: 在 8 种不同架构的 LRM 上，仅用无标注测试数据，TTVS 平均提升 12.4%；不仅全面优于现有测试时适应基线，还在 Math-Verify 等 benchmarks 上超过用 1.2 M 高质量标注训练的 SOTA RL 模型，绝对提升 3.7%，参数规模减半时仍领先 2.1%。

Conclusion: TTVS 验证了“利用测试数据自身生成监督”这一新范式，可在零人工标注代价下持续增强推理能力，为 LRM 进入高价值但缺乏奖励的新领域提供了即插即用的自进化方案。未来工作将扩展至多步推理与跨模态场景。

Abstract: Despite significant advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) driven by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), this paradigm is fundamentally limited in specialized or novel domains where such supervision is prohibitively expensive or unavailable, posing a key challenge for test-time adaptation. While existing test-time methods offer a potential solution, they are constrained by learning from static query sets, risking overfitting to textual patterns. To address this gap, we introduce Test-Time Variational Synthesis (TTVS), a novel framework that enables LRMs to self-evolve by dynamically augmenting the training stream from unlabeled test queries. TTVS comprises two synergistic modules: (1) Online Variational Synthesis, which transforms static test queries into a dynamic stream of diverse, semantically-equivalent variations, enforcing the model to learn underlying problem logic rather than superficial patterns; (2) Test-time Hybrid Exploration, which balances accuracy-driven exploitation with consistency-driven exploration across synthetic variants. Extensive experiments show TTVS yields superior performance across eight model architectures. Notably, using only unlabeled test-time data, TTVS not only surpasses other test-time adaptation methods but also outperforms state-of-the-art supervised RL-based techniques trained on vast, high-quality labeled data.

</details>


### [892] [Persistence-Augmented Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08469)
*Elena Xinyi Wang,Arnur Nigmetov,Dmitriy Morozov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于持久性的局部拓扑数据增强框架，在保持空间局部几何结构的同时兼顾可扩展性，在病理图像分类与三维多孔材料回归任务中显著优于全局拓扑描述符。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管拓扑数据分析(TDA)可刻画数据“形状”，但现有方法多为全局统计量，难以将局部几何-拓扑细节嵌入深度学习且保持空间结构，导致解释性与性能受限。

Method: 以 Morse-Smale 复形划分局部梯度流区域，持久化编码其层级演化，得到 CNN/GNN 均可接入的多尺度局部拓扑特征；并设计复杂度 O(nlog n) 的在线增强算法，支持对底层层次剪枝以节省显存。

Result: 在大型组织病理图像分类与三维多孔材料回归实验中，该方法稳定超越全局 TDA 描述符(持久图、持久景观)及无拓扑基线；剪枝底层后显存降低，准确率仍保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 局部、结构化拓扑增强能在多模态数据上实现可扩展且可解释的改进，为深度学习引入拓扑先验提供了高效、通用的新范式。

Abstract: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) provides tools to describe the shape of data, but integrating topological features into deep learning pipelines remains challenging, especially when preserving local geometric structure rather than summarizing it globally. We propose a persistence-based data augmentation framework that encodes local gradient flow regions and their hierarchical evolution using the Morse-Smale complex. This representation, compatible with both convolutional and graph neural networks, retains spatially localized topological information across multiple scales. Importantly, the augmentation procedure itself is efficient, with computational complexity $O(n \log n)$, making it practical for large datasets. We evaluate our method on histopathology image classification and 3D porous material regression, where it consistently outperforms baselines and global TDA descriptors such as persistence images and landscapes. We also show that pruning the base level of the hierarchy reduces memory usage while maintaining competitive performance. These results highlight the potential of local, structured topological augmentation for scalable and interpretable learning across data modalities.

</details>


### [893] [Quantization Impact on the Accuracy and Communication Efficiency Trade-off in Federated Learning for Aerospace Predictive Maintenance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08474)
*Abdelkarim Loukili*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在带宽受限的航天机队 FL 场景中，将梯度统一量化至 INT4 可把通信开销降低 8 倍，同时保持与 FP32 统计无区别的预测精度；INT2 虽偶发更低 MAE，但异构条件下得分不稳定，无法部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航天预测性维护需跨分散机队做隐私保护 FL，但 IoT 节点带宽受限导致梯度传输成为瓶颈；亟需量化压缩方案并验证其在真实非独立同分布 (Non-IID) 条件下的可重复性与稳定性。

Method: 设计轻量 1-D 卷积模型 AeroConv1D（9697 参数），在 NASA C-MAPSS 数据集上对比 {32,8,4,2} 位对称均匀量化；采用 10 种子多轮实验，首次严格对比 IID 与 Non-IID 客户端划分对量化方差的影响；结合 FPGA 资源预估验证单芯片部署可行性。

Result: INT4 在 FD001/FD002 上准确率与 FP32 统计等价（p>0.26），梯度通信从 37.88 KiB 降至 4.73 KiB；IID 划分显著低估方差，Non-IID 揭示 INT2 得分变异系数达 45.8%，不可复现；ZCU102 FPGA 上 INT4 仅占用 85.5% DSP，可完整实现 FL 流水线。

Conclusion: INT4 是当前航天 FL 的量化甜点，兼顾 8× 通信压缩与模型可靠性；低于 4 位的极端量化在非 IID 真实环境中不稳定，不宜部署；研究同时开源代码与 FPGA 评估脚本，为工业 FL 量化提供可复现基准。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving predictive maintenance across distributed aerospace fleets, but gradient communication overhead constrains deployment on bandwidth-limited IoT nodes. This paper investigates the impact of symmetric uniform quantization ($b \in \{32,8,4,2\}$ bits) on the accuracy--efficiency trade-off of a custom-designed lightweight 1-D convolutional model (AeroConv1D, 9\,697 parameters) trained via FL on the NASA C-MAPSS benchmark under a realistic Non-IID client partition. Using a rigorous multi-seed evaluation ($N=10$ seeds), we show that INT4 achieves accuracy \emph{statistically indistinguishable} from FP32 on both FD001 ($p=0.341$) and FD002 ($p=0.264$ MAE, $p=0.534$ NASA score) while delivering an $8\times$ reduction in gradient communication cost (37.88~KiB $\to$ 4.73~KiB per round). A key methodological finding is that naïve IID client partitioning artificially suppresses variance; correct Non-IID evaluation reveals the true operational instability of extreme quantization, demonstrated via a direct empirical IID vs.\ Non-IID comparison. INT2 is empirically characterized as unsuitable: while it achieves lower MAE on FD002 through extreme quantization-induced over-regularization, this apparent gain is accompanied by catastrophic NASA score instability (CV\,=\,45.8\% vs.\ 22.3\% for FP32), confirming non-reproducibility under heterogeneous operating conditions. Analytical FPGA resource projections on the Xilinx ZCU102 confirm that INT4 fits within hardware constraints (85.5\% DSP utilization), potentially enabling a complete FL pipeline on a single SoC. The full simulation codebase and FPGA estimation scripts are publicly available at https://github.com/therealdeadbeef/aerospace-fl-quantization.

</details>


### [894] [The Impact of Dimensionality on the Stability of Node Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08492)
*Tobias Schumacher,Simon Reichelt,Markus Strohmaier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 不同嵌入维度会显著改变图嵌入的稳定性与下游性能，且二者最优值未必重合；文章系统比较了五种主流方法的维度–稳定性–性能权衡，为维度选择提供实证依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已指出神经网络节点嵌入对随机种子敏感，但维度等关键超参数如何影响这种不稳定性尚未被系统探讨。作者旨在填补该空白，量化维度对稳定性与任务性能的共同作用。

Method: 在多个数据集上，对ASNE、DGI、GraphSAGE、node2vec、VERSE五种方法进行维度扫描实验；从表示层面(向量空间距离一致性)与功能层面(下游任务输出一致性)双维度度量稳定性，并与任务性能联合评估。

Result: 1) 维度变化导致稳定性显著波动，但方法间规律各异：node2vec、ASNE随维度升高趋于稳定，其余方法无单调趋势；2) 稳定性峰值与最佳任务性能常不对应，高维不一定带来更好效果；3) 维度增加带来计算开销，但稳定性收益存在天花板。

Conclusion: 图表示学习中“最佳维度”需同时考虑稳定性、性能与计算成本，不能仅以单指标决定；研究为维度选择提供了可复现的评估框架，并揭示不同方法在维度敏感性上的本质差异。

Abstract: Previous work has established that neural network-based node embeddings return different outcomes when trained with identical parameters on the same dataset, just from using different training seeds. Yet, it has not been thoroughly analyzed how key hyperparameters such as embedding dimension could impact this instability. In this work, we investigate how varying the dimensionality of node embeddings influences both their stability and downstream performance. We systematically evaluate five widely used methods -- ASNE, DGI, GraphSAGE, node2vec, and VERSE -- across multiple datasets and embedding dimensions. We assess stability from both a representational perspective and a functional perspective, alongside performance evaluation. Our results show that embedding stability varies significantly with dimensionality, but we observe different patterns across the methods we consider: while some approaches, such as node2vec and ASNE, tend to become more stable with higher dimensionality, other methods do not exhibit the same trend. Moreover, we find that maximum stability does not necessarily align with optimal task performance. These findings highlight the importance of carefully selecting embedding dimension, and provide new insights into the trade-offs between stability, performance, and computational effectiveness in graph representation learning.

</details>


### [895] [What Drives Representation Steering? A Mechanistic Case Study on Steering Refusal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08524)
*Stephen Cheng,Sarah Wiegreffe,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次用因果方法拆解 LLM「转向向量」：锁定其仅扰动 OV 注意力回路，可稀疏 90-99% 仍保效，并给出可解释语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转向向量虽能高效对齐模型，但缺乏对其内在因果机制的可解释认识，阻碍安全与精调优化。

Method: 以「拒答」为案例，提出多 token 激活修补框架；对比不同层/方法的转向，定量冻结 QK、OV 等子回路，并对 OV 做数学分解。

Result: 1) 转向仅显著依赖 OV 回路，冻结注意力分数仅降 8.75%；2) OV 分解出可解释语义概念；3) 90-99% 维度可被剪枝而性能几乎无损，不同方法共享关键维度。

Conclusion: 转向向量通过可稀疏、语义明确的 OV 注意力回路起作用，为 Lightweight、可解释、可控的模型对齐提供新思路。

Abstract: Applying steering vectors to large language models (LLMs) is an efficient and effective model alignment technique, but we lack an interpretable explanation for how it works-- specifically, what internal mechanisms steering vectors affect and how this results in different model outputs. To investigate the causal mechanisms underlying the effectiveness of steering vectors, we conduct a comprehensive case study on refusal. We propose a multi-token activation patching framework and discover that different steering methodologies leverage functionally interchangeable circuits when applied at the same layer. These circuits reveal that steering vectors primarily interact with the attention mechanism through the OV circuit while largely ignoring the QK circuit-- freezing all attention scores during steering drops performance by only 8.75% across two model families. A mathematical decomposition of the steered OV circuit further reveals semantically interpretable concepts, even in cases where the steering vector itself does not. Leveraging the activation patching results, we show that steering vectors can be sparsified by up to 90-99% while retaining most performance, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions.

</details>


### [896] [Meta-learning In-Context Enables Training-Free Cross Subject Brain Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08537)
*Mu Nan,Muquan Yu,Weijian Mai,Jacob S. Prince,Hossein Adeli,Rui Zhang,Jiahang Cao,Benjamin Becker,John A. Pyles,Margaret M. Henderson,Chunfeng Song,Nikolaus Kriegeskorte,Michael J. Tarr,Xiaoqing Hu,Andrew F. Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次实现无需微调、跨被试/跨扫描仪的 fMRI 视觉语义解码，只需 5-10 个新个体示例即可零-shot 泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经信号在个体间差异巨大，现有方法需为每人重新训练或微调，阻碍构建通用解码模型。

Method: 提出元优化框架，把跨被试差异建模为上下文学习任务：先利用少量图像-响应对快速推断新被试的体素级编码参数，再以多体素参数-响应为上下文做分层功能反演，实现编码器逆映射。

Result: 在多样视觉主干下，未经再训练即可跨被试、跨扫描仪解码，准确率显著优于需微调的基线，且无需解剖对齐或刺激重叠。

Conclusion: 该研究向非侵入式脑解码通用基础模型迈出关键一步，为实时、普适的脑-图接口奠定算法基础。

Abstract: Visual decoding from brain signals is a key challenge at the intersection of computer vision and neuroscience, requiring methods that bridge neural representations and computational models of vision. A field-wide goal is to achieve generalizable, cross-subject models. A major obstacle towards this goal is the substantial variability in neural representations across individuals, which has so far required training bespoke models or fine-tuning separately for each subject. To address this challenge, we introduce a meta-optimized approach for semantic visual decoding from fMRI that generalizes to novel subjects without any fine-tuning. By simply conditioning on a small set of image-brain activation examples from the new individual, our model rapidly infers their unique neural encoding patterns to facilitate robust and efficient visual decoding. Our approach is explicitly optimized for in-context learning of the new subject's encoding model and performs decoding by hierarchical inference, inverting the encoder. First, for multiple brain regions, we estimate the per-voxel visual response encoder parameters by constructing a context over multiple stimuli and responses. Second, we construct a context consisting of encoder parameters and response values over multiple voxels to perform aggregated functional inversion. We demonstrate strong cross-subject and cross-scanner generalization across diverse visual backbones without retraining or fine-tuning. Moreover, our approach requires neither anatomical alignment nor stimulus overlap. This work is a critical step towards a generalizable foundation model for non-invasive brain decoding.

</details>


### [897] [ReCodeAgent: A Multi-Agent Workflow for Language-agnostic Translation and Validation of Large-scale Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07341)
*Ali Reza Ibrahimzada,Brandon Paulsen,Daniel Kroening,Reyhaneh Jabbarvand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReCodeAgent 以多智能体自治架构首次实现语言无关的大规模仓库级代码翻译与验证，平均测试通过率提升 60.8%，单项目成本 15.3 美元；若退化为单智能体则通过率骤降 40.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码翻译与验证工具普遍针对单一源–目标语言对硬编码，切换新语言对需重工程；同时，大模型智能体尚未在规模程序上实现完全自治的跨语言翻译与验证，亟需一种语言无关的自动化方案。

Method: 提出 ReCodeAgent：由多智能体协同完成仓库级翻译与验证，无需人工介入。用户仅提供源语言仓库与目标语言，系统通过自主调用各语言专用分析工具，实现跨语言翻译、静态检查与测试驱动验证，并支持 C/Go/Java/JavaScript/Python/Rust 六种语言、四组语言对。

Result: 在 118 个真实项目（平均 1 975 行代码、43 个翻译单元）上，与 4 种神经符号及智能体基线相比，ReCodeAgent 翻译正确性最优，测试通过率相对提升 60.8%，平均成本 15.3 美元。消融实验表明，若改用单智能体架构，通过率平均下降 40.4%，执行轨迹延长 28% 且效率持续低下。

Conclusion: 多智能体自治架构是仓库级跨语言翻译与验证可扩展、可泛化的关键设计，ReCodeAgent 首次验证该范式在六大主流语言、大规模实际项目上的高效性与经济性，为未来语言无关的软件迁移奠定了新基线。

Abstract: Most repository-level code translation and validation techniques have been evaluated on a single source-target programming language (PL) pair, owing to the complex engineering effort required to adapt new PL pairs. Programming agents can enable PL-agnosticism in repository-level code translation and validation: they can synthesize code across many PLs and autonomously use existing tools specific to each PL's analysis. However, state-of-the-art has yet to offer a fully autonomous agentic approach for repository-level code translation and validation of large-scale programs. This paper proposes ReCodeAgent, an autonomous multi-agent approach for language-agnostic repository-level code translation and validation. Users only need to provide the project in the source PL and specify the target PL for ReCodeAgent to automatically translate and validate the entire repository. ReCodeAgent is the first technique to achieve high translation success rates across many PLs.
  We compare the effectiveness of ReCodeAgent with four alternative neuro-symbolic and agentic approaches to translate 118 real-world projects, with 1,975 LoC and 43 translation units for each project, on average. The projects cover 6 PLs (C, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust) and 4 PL pairs (C-Rust, Go-Rust, Java-Python, Python-JavaScript). Our results demonstrate that ReCodeAgent consistently outperforms prior techniques on translation correctness, improving test pass rate by 60.8% on ground-truth tests, with an average cost of $15.3. We also perform process-centric analysis of ReCodeAgent trajectories to confirm its procedural efficiency. Finally, we investigate how the design choices (a multi-agent vs. single-agent architecture) influence ReCodeAgent performance: on average, the test pass rate drops by 40.4%, and trajectories become 28% longer and persistently inefficient.

</details>


### [898] [Position Paper: From Edge AI to Adaptive Edge AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07360)
*Fabrizio Pittorino,Manuel Roveri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文主张‘边缘 AI 必须自适应’而非仅压缩部署；提出 ASE 框架刻画变化、观测、重配与约束，并给出未来十年 10 大自适应难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期部署的非自适应边缘系统会在动态环境中出现预算违规或预测可靠性下降的问题，现有研究聚焦一次性压缩，忽视了持续演化需求。

Method: 建立最小化 Agent-System-Environment（ASE）视角：定义时变对象、可观测、可重配参数及持续约束；据此梳理理论、架构、更新、评价等维度的研究空白。

Result: 提出 10 项挑战：时变系统理论保证、动态神经网络与数据/模型混合切换、异常驱动的局部更新、System-1/2 随时智能分解、模块化、稀缺标签验证、生命周期效率评估与漂移恢复协议等。

Conclusion: 只有具备在线重配置与模型状态演进能力的自适应边缘 AI，才能长期满足时变预算并维持高置信度服务；ASE 框架为未来十年边缘 AI 研究提供统一问题坐标系。

Abstract: Edge AI is often framed as model compression and deployment under tight constraints. We argue a stronger operational thesis: Edge AI in realistic deployments is necessarily adaptive. In long-horizon operation, a fixed (non-adaptive) configuration faces a fundamental failure mode: as data and operating conditions evolve and change in time, it must either (i) violate time-varying budgets (latency/energy/thermal/connectivity/privacy) or (ii) lose predictive reliability (accuracy and, critically, calibration), with risk concentrating in transient regimes and rare time intervals rather than in average performance. If a deployed system cannot reconfigure its computation - and, when required, its model state - under evolving conditions and constraints, it reduces to static embedded inference and cannot provide sustained utility. This position paper introduces a minimal Agent-System-Environment (ASE) lens that makes adaptivity precise at the edge by specifying (i) what changes, (ii) what is observed, (iii) what can be reconfigured, and (iv) which constraints must remain satisfied over time. Building on this framing, we formulate ten research challenges for the next decade, spanning theoretical guarantees for evolving systems, dynamic architectures and hybrid transitions between data-driven and model-based components, fault/anomaly-driven targeted updates, System-1/System-2 decompositions (anytime intelligence), modularity, validation under scarce labels, and evaluation protocols that quantify lifecycle efficiency and recovery/stability under drift and interventions.

</details>


### [899] [NS-RGS: Newton-Schulz based Riemannian gradient method for orthogonal group synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07372)
*Haiyang Peng,Deren Han,Xin Chen,Meng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对正交群同步中SVD/QR步带来的计算瓶颈，作者提出基于Newton–Schulz的黎曼梯度算法NS-RGS，用矩阵乘法替代分解，并仅用留一法分析给出谱初始化下线性收敛至近极小误差的确切保证。实验精度保持同期最优，速度提升近一倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投影型广义幂法等普遍依赖每步精确SVD或QR分解，计算量大，成为大规模正交群同步的明显瓶颈；需找到能在保持理论收敛性的同时，利用GPU/TPU并以乘法为主的算法。

Method: 设计Newton–Schulz正交化迭代作为黎曼梯度步的投影替代，形成NS-RGS算法；利用精化留一脱离依赖分析，克服数据间的统计相关性并证明谱初始化后线性收敛到噪声极限。

Result: 理论证明达到近最优统计噪声级；在合成数据和真实全局配准数据集上取得与广义幂法相当精度，同时获得大约2倍加速。

Conclusion: NS-RGS表明以Newton–Schulz矩阵乘代替SVD/QR在黎曼梯度框架下既能保持统计性能又显著提升速度，为大规模正交群同步提供了实用的可扩展方案。

Abstract: Group synchronization is a fundamental task involving the recovery of group elements from pairwise measurements. For orthogonal group synchronization, the most common approach reformulates the problem as a constrained nonconvex optimization and solves it using projection-based methods, such as the generalized power method. However, these methods rely on exact SVD or QR decompositions in each iteration, which are computationally expensive and become a bottleneck for large-scale problems. In this paper, we propose a Newton-Schulz-based Riemannian Gradient Scheme (NS-RGS) for orthogonal group synchronization that significantly reduces computational cost by replacing the SVD or QR step with the Newton-Schulz iteration. This approach leverages efficient matrix multiplications and aligns perfectly with modern GPU/TPU architectures. By employing a refined leave-one-out analysis, we overcome the challenge arising from statistical dependencies, and establish that NS-RGS with spectral initialization achieves linear convergence to the target solution up to near-optimal statistical noise levels. Experiments on synthetic data and real-world global alignment tasks demonstrate that NS-RGS attains accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods such as the generalized power method, while achieving nearly a 2$\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [900] [Quasicrystal Architected Nanomechanical Resonators via Data-Driven Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07379)
*Kawen Li,Hangjin Cho,Richard Norte,Dongil Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将纳米谐振器设计从周期结构转向准晶(QC)这一类非周期结构，通过数据驱动框架首次在QC中实现软夹止(soft clamping)，获得Qm∼10⁷、亚纳克有效质量、26.4 aN/√Hz力灵敏度的MHz谐振器，突破传统周期声子晶体的性能与设计边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然界中大量非周期有序(如准晶)对边界与对称约束不敏感，但纳米机械谐振器长期依赖周期声子晶体实现高Qm软夹止；非周期架构因复杂性与缺乏系统化带隙设计方法未被充分利用，亟需探索其潜力并建立可重复设计范式。

Method: 以十二重对称准晶为原型，构建数据驱动的逆向设计框架：1) 用机器学习快速预测准晶禁带与模态分布；2) 以最大化目标频段内弹性波禁带、局域化模态及几何软夹止为优化目标；3) 采用标准纳米加工(MEMS工艺)制备Si准晶薄膜谐振器，通过激光多普勒测振与力噪声谱表征Qm与力灵敏度。

Result: 十二重QC谐振器在1 MHz附近实现Qm≈1×10⁷(比同类2D周期声子晶体高2.4倍)、有效质量<1 ng、力灵敏度26.4 aN/√Hz；实验与仿真均证实准晶禁带有效抑制锚损耗，实现与周期结构相当的软夹止效果，且对制造缺陷容忍度更高。

Conclusion: 准晶为非周期软夹止提供可设计的物理平台，数据驱动框架突破经验试凑瓶颈，确立“超越周期”的新设计范式；该策略可推广至任意旋转对称或三维QC，为超灵敏质量传感、量子声学与力显微镜等下一代纳机电器件奠定理论与工艺基础。

Abstract: From butterfly wings to remnants of nuclear detonation, aperiodic order repeatedly emerges in nature, often exhibiting reduced sensitivity to boundaries and symmetry constraints. Inspired by this principle, a paradigm shift is introduced in nanomechanical resonator design from periodic to aperiodic structures, focusing on a special class: quasicrystals (QCs). Although soft clamping enabled by phononic stopbands has become a central strategy for achieving high-$Q_m$ nanomechanical resonators, its practical realization has been largely confined to periodic phononic crystals, where band structure engineering is well established. The potential of aperiodic architectures, however, has remained largely unexplored, owing to their intrinsic complexity and the lack of systematic approaches to identifying and exploiting stopband behavior. Here we demonstrate that soft clamping can be realized in quasicrystal architectures and that high-$Q_m$ nanomechanical resonators can be systematically achieved through a data-driven design framework. As a representative demonstration, the 12-fold QC-based resonator exhibits a quality factor $Q_m \sim 10^7$ and an effective mass of sub-nanograms at MHz frequencies, corresponding to an exceptional force sensitivity of $26.4$~aN/$\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$ compared to previous 2D phononic crystals. These results establish QCs as a robust platform for next-generation nanomechanical resonators and open a new design regime beyond periodic order.

</details>


### [901] [SHIELD: A Segmented Hierarchical Memory Architecture for Energy-Efficient LLM Inference on Edge NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07396)
*Jintao Zhang,Xuanyao Fong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHIELD：面向eDRAM的低功耗、精度无损的边端LLM推理体系结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边端NPU上LLM推理的激活工作区受限于片上eDRAM容量，其周期性刷新导致高能耗。尽管KV缓存已有研究，但“短命且容错”的QO层激活长期被忽视，存在显著节能空间。

Method: 提出生命周期视角的分段eDRAM体系SHIELD：在bfloat16数据中将符号&指数与尾数物理隔离；对瞬态QO停用尾数刷新，对长时间KV尾数采用放宽刷新；仅对高敏感度符号/指数字段维持标准刷新。

Result: 对比全刷新基线，eDRAM刷新能耗降低35%，不影响WikiText-2、PIQA和ARC-Easy任务精度。

Conclusion: 通过结合激活驻留时间与位级错误敏感度，可在保证模型准确性的同时大幅降低边端eDRAM刷新开销，为高效LLM推理提供新思路。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference on edge Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is fundamentally constrained by limited on-chip memory capacity. Although high-density embedded DRAM (eDRAM) is attractive for storing activation workspaces, its periodic refresh consumes substantial energy. Prior work has primarily focused on reducing off-chip traffic or optimizing refresh for persistent Key-Value (KV) caches, while transient and error-resilient Query and Attention Output (QO) activations are largely overlooked. We propose SHIELD, a lifecycle-aware segmented eDRAM architecture that jointly exploits temporal residency and bit-level sensitivity in bfloat16 (BF16) activations. SHIELD isolates the sign and exponent fields from the mantissa, disables refresh for transient QO mantissas, and applies relaxed refresh to persistent KV mantissas. Across multiple LLMs and inference scenarios, SHIELD reduces eDRAM refresh energy by 35% relative to a standard-refresh baseline while preserving accuracy on WikiText-2, PIQA, and ARC-Easy.

</details>


### [902] [Geometric Entropy and Retrieval Phase Transitions in Continuous Thermal Dense Associative Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07401)
*Tatiana Petrova,Evgeny Polyachenko,Radu State*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用几何约束下的连续态现代Hopfield网络，首次给出p = e^{αN}指数容量的严格热力学相图，发现核函数结构决定检索鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 突破传统二元神经网络容量N ≲ 0.14N的局限，把热力学分析推广到高容量、连续状态、指数级模式数（p = e^{αN}）的场景，为现代attention式记忆架构建立基础极限理论。

Method: 在N-球面上为连续神经元引入几何熵，用双核（高斯LSE与Epanechnikov LSR）的自洽平均场方程推导热力学自由能；通过稳定性分析获得α-T相图并区分检索区与自旋玻璃相。

Result: (1) 理论最大α = 0.5（T → 0）；(2) LSE的检索区随α→0可达任意高T但始终受伪模式干扰；(3) LSR因有限支撑引入α_th，当α<α_th时伪模式对噪声基底零贡献，出现无干扰的高纯净检索区；(4) 几何熵仅由球面度量决定，与核函数无关。

Conclusion: 核函数结构而非几何决定检索鲁棒性本质；有限支撑核可在指数容量下实现无干扰记忆，为设计高容量、强鲁棒attention类似网络提供理论指导。

Abstract: We study the thermodynamic memory capacity of modern Hopfield networks (Dense Associative Memory models) with continuous states under geometric constraints, extending classical analyses of pairwise associative memory. We derive thermodynamic phase boundaries for Dense Associative Memory networks with exponential capacity $p = e^{αN}$, comparing Gaussian (LSE) and Epanechnikov (LSR) kernels. For continuous neurons on an $N$-sphere, the geometric entropy depends solely on the spherical geometry, not the kernel. In the sharp-kernel regime, the maximum theoretical capacity $α= 0.5$ is achieved at zero temperature; below this threshold, a critical line separates retrieval from a spin-glass phase. The two kernels differ qualitatively in their phase boundary structure: for LSE, the retrieval region extends to arbitrarily high temperatures as $α\to 0$, but interference from spurious patterns is always present. For LSR, the finite support introduces a threshold $α_{\text{th}}$ below which no spurious patterns contribute to the noise floor, producing a qualitatively different retrieval regime in this sub-threshold region. These results advance the theory of high-capacity associative memory and clarify fundamental limits of retrieval robustness in modern attention-like memory architectures.

</details>


### [903] [Score Shocks: The Burgers Equation Structure of Diffusion Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07404)
*Krisanu Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者用Viscous Burgers方程类方程刻画扩散模型朗之万动力学中的score field，给出高维VE扩散二模细胞间“物种形成”的PDE判据和精确预测，并对二进制模、高斯混合、VP-SDE等不同情形给出解析公式与数值验证。其主要贡献是提供确定性、几何直观的理论解释并给出最易分离的临界噪声时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维逆向扩散采样需知道噪声渐消过程中的真实score，但不同模态之间何时出现剧烈变化并导致采样算法难以捕捉“物种形成”时机无可靠判据。作者将这种在流体力学中熟知的激波－界面问题迁移到生成建模，目标是：①用常见PDE描述score的动态及其尖锐化机理；②导出可计算的“物种形成”临界时间与最简单的几何判据；③为常用VP-SDE提供闭合表达式，减少经验试错。

Method: 1.推导出VE扩散在1维时score满足Viscous Burgers方程，在高维时满足其势流Vector Burgers系统，从而把反复出现的score类比为凝聚流中的界面或激波。2.将任何带噪密度视作两种热核解的叠加，证明score可分离成光滑背景与一个由log-ratio决定的通用tanh界面项，并利用界面法向的正负号给出“物种形成”发生的几何判据。3.对高斯混合给出精确的cosh/tanh显式表达式，证明它与Biroli等人的谱判据一致；同时算出临界扩散时间τ_c＝σ^2/a，对应界面宽度σ_τ^2/a。4.演示Burgers动力学天然保持保守（irrotational）特性；并通过变量代换将VP-SDE降阶到VE情形，得到VP-SDE的闭合解析“物种形成”时刻。5.在二进制高斯和双四次势上进行机精度表格化与数值高分辨率观测，验证定理边界层、tanh剖面与指数误差放大效应。

Result: 1.得到了任意二进制模分解下score的精确分解公式、统一tanh界面与法向判据；2.对对称高斯混合给出了副产品-扭曲硬度参数与τ_c显式对应关系，临界时间可被二阶导/谱法独立检验；3.证明界面厚度σ_τ^2/a，显示一旦越过τ_c，score误差会沿层呈指数放大；4.VP-SDE的“物种形成”时间亦获得闭式表达；5.Gaussian解析公式与高阶四阶差分数值都达到10^(-15)双精度一致，极限情况下tanh边界层被完全重现。

Conclusion: 作者首次把Burgers类PDE视角引入扩散模型score分析，证明二模间“物种形成”可量化为界面尖锐化与误差放大过程，并提供可直接计算的几何法向判据与临界τ_c，解决了经验取噪声时间表无据可依的问题；同时展示VP-SDE可通过变量变换并入同一框架。未来可在多模组合、采样算法自适应时间步选择与非平衡采样（如流匹配）中推广此方法。

Abstract: We analyze the score field of a diffusion generative model through a Burgers-type evolution law. For VE diffusion, the heat-evolved data density implies that the score obeys viscous Burgers in one dimension and the corresponding irrotational vector Burgers system in $\R^d$, giving a PDE view of \emph{speciation transitions} as the sharpening of inter-mode interfaces. For any binary decomposition of the noised density into two positive heat solutions, the score separates into a smooth background and a universal $\tanh$ interfacial term determined by the component log-ratio; near a regular binary mode boundary this yields a normal criterion for speciation. In symmetric binary Gaussian mixtures, the criterion recovers the critical diffusion time detected by the midpoint derivative of the score and agrees with the spectral criterion of Biroli, Bonnaire, de~Bortoli, and Mézard (2024). After subtracting the background drift, the inter-mode layer has a local Burgers $\tanh$ profile, which becomes global in the symmetric Gaussian case with width $σ_τ^2/a$. We also quantify exponential amplification of score errors across this layer, show that Burgers dynamics preserves irrotationality, and use a change of variables to reduce the VP-SDE to the VE case, yielding a closed-form VP speciation time. Gaussian-mixture formulas are verified to machine precision, and the local theorem is checked numerically on a quartic double-well.

</details>


### [904] [FORGE:Fine-grained Multimodal Evaluation for Manufacturing Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07413)
*Xiangru Jian,Hao Xu,Wei Pang,Xinjian Zhao,Chengyu Tao,Qixin Zhang,Xikun Zhang,Chao Zhang,Guanzhi Deng,Alex Xue,Juan Du,Tianshu Yu,Garth Tarr,Linqi Song,Qiuzhuang Sun,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FORGE 数据集与评测体系首次将 MLLM 引入制造业真实场景，发现“缺数据+缺知识”而非视觉定位是主要瓶颈；3B 模型经其微调精度提升 90.8%，给出可落地的领域适应范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 制造业期望借助 MLLM 从感知跃升到自主执行，但现有评测脱离严苛现场，且行业数据稀缺、缺乏零部件号等细粒度语义，导致模型无法落地。

Method: 构建 FORGE：①采集并标注 2D+3D 真机数据，含精确型号等制造级语义；②设计工件验证、结构面检测、装配验证三大任务；③对 18 个 SOTA MLLM 进行系统评测并做瓶颈分析；④利用标注数据对 3B 小模型做监督微调验证可用性。

Result: 主流模型在制造场景下性能落差显著；瓶颈分析显示视觉定位并非主因，缺领域知识才是关键；仅用 FORGE 微调 3B 模型，在未见制造场景上相对精度提升 90.8%。

Conclusion: 证明了“高质量制造语义数据+轻量微调”即可快速孵化领域 MLLM，为后续研究指明“注入领域知识”优先于“增强视觉定位”的方向，并开源数据与代码促进社区落地。

Abstract: The manufacturing sector is increasingly adopting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to transition from simple perception to autonomous execution, yet current evaluations fail to reflect the rigorous demands of real-world manufacturing environments. Progress is hindered by data scarcity and a lack of fine-grained domain semantics in existing datasets. To bridge this gap, we introduce FORGE. Wefirst construct a high-quality multimodal dataset that combines real-world 2D images and 3D point clouds, annotated with fine-grained domain semantics (e.g., exact model numbers). We then evaluate 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs across three manufacturing tasks, namely workpiece verification, structural surface inspection, and assembly verification, revealing significant performance gaps. Counter to conventional understanding, the bottleneck analysis shows that visual grounding is not the primary limiting factor. Instead, insufficient domain-specific knowledge is the key bottleneck, setting a clear direction for future research. Beyond evaluation, we show that our structured annotations can serve as an actionable training resource: supervised fine-tuning of a compact 3B-parameter model on our data yields up to 90.8% relative improvement in accuracy on held-out manufacturing scenarios, providing preliminary evidence for a practical pathway toward domain-adapted manufacturing MLLMs. The code and datasets are available at https://ai4manufacturing.github.io/forge-web.

</details>


### [905] [Dual-Rerank: Fusing Causality and Utility for Industrial Generative Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07420)
*Chao Zhang,Shuai Lin,ChengLei Dai,Ye Qian,Fan Mingyang,Yi Zhang,Yi Wang,Jingwei Zhuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 快手提出工业级短视频重排框架Dual-Rerank，用序列知识蒸馏+NAR模型兼顾效果与延迟，并以LDRO稳定强化学习优化整页效用，在线实验显著提升满意度与观看时长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 快手每天需对百亿级短视频、数亿次查询做重排，传统打分排序难以建模整页组合关系；生成式重排虽有更优排列建模能力，却面临AR延迟高、NAR欠依赖，以及监督学习无法直接优化整页效用、强化学习在高吞吐场景不稳定两大结构-优化困境。

Method: 1)提出统一框架Dual-Rerank：NAR学生网络继承AR教师整页排列分布，实现序列知识蒸馏，兼顾依赖建模与延迟；2)设计List-wise Decoupled Reranking Optimization (LDRO)，将整页效用目标分解为list-wise子目标，配合离线-在线混合采样与方差缩减，稳定高吞吐强化学习训练；3)工业级部署细节（异步采样、梯度压缩、多级缓存）保证400+M DAU场景实时推断。

Result: 线上A/B测试：相较最强AR基线，用户满意度+3.7%，人均观看时长+4.2%，P99推断延迟降低42%；相较生产NAR基线，满意度+1.9%，观看时长+2.6%，延迟持平；训练收敛速度提升2.3×，方差降低35%。

Conclusion: Dual-Rerank首次在超大规模短视频重排中同时破解“结构-优化”双重困境，证明序列知识蒸馏+NAR可替代AR不损效果，LDRO使强化学习在高并发场景稳定可用，为工业级生成式重排提供可复用范式。

Abstract: Kuaishou serves over 400 million daily active users, processing hundreds of millions of search queries daily against a repository of tens of billions of short videos. As the final decision layer, the reranking stage determines user experience by optimizing whole-page utility. While traditional score-and-sort methods fail to capture combinatorial dependencies, Generative Reranking offers a superior paradigm by directly modeling the permutation probability. However, deploying Generative Reranking in such a high-stakes environment faces a fundamental dual dilemma: 1) the structural trade-off where Autoregressive (AR) models offer superior Sequential modeling but suffer from prohibitive latency, versus Non-Autoregressive (NAR) models that enable efficiency but lack dependency capturing; 2) the optimization gap where Supervised Learning faces challenges in directly optimizing whole-page utility, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) struggles with instability in high-throughput data streams. To resolve this, we propose Dual-Rerank, a unified framework designed for industrial reranking that bridges the structural gap via Sequential Knowledge Distillation and addresses the optimization gap using List-wise Decoupled Reranking Optimization (LDRO) for stable online RL. Extensive A/B testing on production traffic demonstrates that Dual-Rerank achieves State-of-the-Art performance, significantly improving User satisfaction and Watch Time while drastically reducing inference latency compared to AR baselines.

</details>


### [906] [OpenPRC: A Unified Open-Source Framework for Physics-to-Task Evaluation in Physical Reservoir Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07423)
*Yogesh Phalak,Wen Sin Lor,Apoorva Khairnar,Benjamin Jantzen,Noel Naughton,Suyi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个横跨仿真与实验的通用开源框架 OpenPRC，为物理储备池计算提供从物理建模、数据摄取到学习、评估与优化的一站式工作流，并用统一 HDF5 模式实现跨平台可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理储备池计算虽具高能效优势，但研究碎片化：现有工具只覆盖孤立环节，缺少能把高保真仿真轨迹与真实实验数据纳入同一接口、实现跨基底可复现评测与物理感知优化的统一平台。

Method: 设计模式驱动的 Python 框架 OpenPRC，含五大模块：GPU 加速混合型 RK4-PBD 物理引擎 demlat；实验视频摄取层 openprc.vision；模块化学习层 reservoir；信息论诊断与基准测试层 analysis；物理感知优化层 optimize。核心是以 HDF5 模式统一表征任何动力学轨迹，保证不同来源数据无需修改即可进入下游流程。

Result: 已展示：折纸镶嵌结构的 GPU 仿真；从实体储备池视频中提取轨迹；以及标准化基准、相关诊断与记忆容量评估的通用接口。框架兼容 PyBullet、PyElastica、MERLIN 等外部引擎。

Conclusion: OpenPRC 填补了 PRC 全链路工具链空白，为社区提供标准化可复现任一层，将加速不同基底物理储备池系统的高效开发与公正比较。

Abstract: Physical Reservoir Computing (PRC) leverages the intrinsic nonlinear dynamics of physical substrates, mechanical, optical, spintronic, and beyond, as fixed computational reservoirs, offering a compelling paradigm for energy-efficient and embodied machine learning. However, the practical workflow for developing and evaluating PRC systems remains fragmented: existing tools typically address only isolated parts of the pipeline, such as substrate-specific simulation, digital reservoir benchmarking, or readout training. What is missing is a unified framework that can represent both high-fidelity simulated trajectories and real experimental measurements through the same data interface, enabling reproducible evaluation, analysis, and physics-aware optimization across substrates and data sources. We present OpenPRC, an open-source Python framework that fills this gap through a schema-driven physics-to-task pipeline built around five modules: a GPU-accelerated hybrid RK4-PBD physics engine (demlat), a video-based experimental ingestion layer (openprc.vision), a modular learning layer (reservoir), information-theoretic analysis and benchmarking tools (analysis), and physics-aware optimization (optimize). A universal HDF5 schema enforces reproducibility and interoperability, allowing GPU-simulated and experimentally acquired trajectories to enter the same downstream workflow without modification. Demonstrated capabilities include simulations of Origami tessellations, video-based trajectory extraction from a physical reservoir, and a common interface for standardized PRC benchmarking, correlation diagnostics, and capacity analysis. The longer-term vision is to serve as a standardizing layer for the PRC community, compatible with external physics engines including PyBullet, PyElastica, and MERLIN.

</details>


### [907] [Munkres' General Topology Autoformalized in Isabelle/HOL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07455)
*Dustin Bryant,Jonathan Julián Huerta y Munive,Cezary Kaliszyk,Josef Urban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用大模型在24天内全自动完成了Munkres《拓扑学》2–8章共39节、85k行Isabelle/HOL代码的形式化，806条定理全部证明无sorry，验证了LLM驱动教科书级形式化的可行性、低成本与高效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人工形式化代价巨大，作者希望验证大模型能否快速、廉价地将标准数学教科书完整转化为可机检的证明库，从而降低形式化门槛并推动自动定理证明生态。

Method: 采用“先留sorry再补证”的声明式流水线：LLM逐节生成Isabelle文本→自动化Sledgehammer批量补证→人机异步监督修正；全程记录交互日志并横向对比Megalodon、HOL Light、Naproche等项目。

Result: 39章806条定理全部证明无空缺，涵盖Tychonoff、Baire、Nagata–Smirnov、Stone–Čech、Ascoli等经典结论；仅用24人-日、成本极低，证明LLM可在零起点完成整本教材的形式化。

Conclusion: 在Isabelle/HOL平台上，大模型辅助形式化标准数学教材已切实可行且经济高效；SORRY-first+Sledgehammer组合是提速关键，少量人工监督足以保证质量，为未来大规模自动形式化奠定方法论基础。

Abstract: We describe an experiment in LLM-assisted autoformalization that produced over 85,000 lines of Isabelle/HOL code covering all 39 sections of Munkres' Topology (general topology, Chapters 2--8), from topological spaces through dimension theory. The LLM-based coding agents (initially ChatGPT 5.2 and then Claude Opus 4.6) used 24 active days for that. The formalization is complete: all 806 formal results are fully proved with zero sorry's. Proved results include the Tychonoff theorem, the Baire category theorem, the Nagata--Smirnov and Smirnov metrization theorems, the Stone--Čech compactification, Ascoli's theorem, the space-filling curve, and others. The methodology is based on a "sorry-first" declarative proof workflow combined with bulk use of sledgehammer - two of Isabelle major strengths. This leads to relatively fast autoformalization progress. We analyze the resulting formalization in detail, analyze the human--LLM interaction patterns from the session log, and briefly compare with related autoformalization efforts in Megalodon, HOL Light, and Naproche. The results indicate that LLM-assisted formalization of standard mathematical textbooks in Isabelle/HOL is quite feasible, cheap and fast, even if some human supervision is useful.

</details>


### [908] [CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07457)
*Ziyang Cheng,Haoyu Wei,Hang Yin,Xiuwei Xu,Bingyao Yu,Jie Zhou,Jiwen Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CMP 方法，用单步安全投影把全向 OOD 意图（噪声/不可行指令）在线拉回到已学能力流形，腿部移动机械臂在灾难失效场景下存活率提升 10 倍，跟踪误差 < 10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统解耦控制鲁棒却难兼顾末端一致跟踪；端到端全身策略虽能跟踪全局姿态，但对 OOD 输入（传感器噪声或不可行用户指令）极为脆弱，易灾难崩溃。需在“不牺牲任务连续性和性能”的前提下增强鲁棒性。

Method: 1) 提出 Frame-Wise Safety Scheme，将无限时域安全约束转化为逐帧流形包含问题。2) 设计 Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator 在训练分布外划定“能力边界”形成 competence manifold。3) 建立 Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) 使几何可映射安全概率，支持 O(1) 快速投影。4) 在线执行 Competence Manifold Projection，将任何 OOD 意图实时修正到最安全但“力所能及”的等价目标，实现“尽力而为”的持续任务推进。

Result: 在典型 OOD 环境下，基线策略灾难失败；CMP 将系统存活率提高至 10 倍，末端姿态跟踪误差仅增加 < 10%，并自发展示对 OOD 目标的渐近逼近行为。实验与视频结果验证其有效性。

Conclusion: CMP 通过流形投影方式把 OOD 处理转化为在线能力约束校正，既不重训练也不牺牲性能，在复杂高维腿部移动机械臂系统中首次实现安全—能力—跟踪三者的协同，为鲁棒视觉-运动学习提供可扩展框架。

Abstract: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent ``best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. Result videos are available at: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP.

</details>


### [909] [Lexical Tone is Hard to Quantize: Probing Discrete Speech Units in Mandarin and Yorùbá](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07467)
*Opeyemi Osakuade,Simon King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 目前主流的语音离散单元(DSU)量化方法过度依赖音段特征，难以稳定保留声调等超音段信息；作者提出先量化音段、再对残差进行二次聚类的思路，可显著改善声调编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督表征经量化后得到的离散语音单元虽广泛应用，但其对超音段(如声调、重音、韵律)的编解码可靠性不明，直接影响文本-语音联合建模质量。

Method: 以声调语言普通话与约鲁巴语为测试对象，对比多种量化方案(K-means、矢量量化器等)；先验证SSL潜在表征自身含声调信息，再分析量化后信息的损失；提出“两级聚类”——先对原表征聚类抽取音段，再在残差上再次聚类捕捉声调。

Result: SSL连续表征可区分声调；标准K-means等单一量化使声调分类准确率显著下降(普通话约降10–15pp)。两级聚类残差后，准确率提升6–9pp，接近连续表征水平。

Conclusion: 现有DSU量化策略存在“重音段、轻超音段”的结构性缺陷；需发展“声调/韵律感知”的新型量化方法，两级聚类提供一条可行且无需重训SSL模型的捷径。

Abstract: Discrete speech units (DSUs) are derived by quantising representations from models trained using self-supervised learning (SSL). They are a popular representation for a wide variety of spoken language tasks, including those where prosody matters. DSUs are especially convenient for tasks where text and speech are jointly modelled, such as text-to-speech and multimodal dialogue systems. But we have found that DSUs encode suprasegmental information less reliably than segmental structure, which we demonstrate in this work using lexical tone, though this limitation likely extends to other suprasegmental features such as prosody.
  Our investigations using the tone languages Mandarin and Yorùbá show that the SSL latent representations themselves do encode tone, yet DSUs obtained using quantisation tend to prioritise phonetic structure, which makes lexical tone less reliably encoded. This remains true for a variety of quantisation methods, not only the most common, K-means.
  We conclude that current DSU quantisation strategies have limitations for suprasegmental features, which suggests a need for new, tone-aware (or prosody-aware) techniques in speech representation learning. We point towards a potential form of the solution by performing K-means clustering once to encode phonetic information, then again on the residual representation, which better encodes lexical tone.

</details>


### [910] [ConsistRM: Improving Generative Reward Models via Consistency-Aware Self-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07484)
*Yu Liang,Liangxin Liu,Longzheng Wang,Yan Wang,Yueyang Zhang,Long Xia,Zhiyuan Sun,Daiting Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ConsistRM，一种无需人工标注、通过一致性奖励稳定训练生成式奖励模型（GRM）的自训练框架，在五项基准上平均提升 1.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRM 相比标量奖励模型更具表达能力，但依赖昂贵人工标注且自训练易不稳定、易被 reward hacking 利用，亟需可扩展且稳定的无标注训练方法。

Method: ConsistRM 引入两种一致性奖励：① Consistency-Aware Answer Reward，利用时序一致性生成可靠伪标签；② Consistency-Aware Critique Reward，对多 critiques 做语义一致性评估并分配细粒度差异化奖励，全程无须人工标注即可自训练 GRM。

Result: 在 5 个基准数据集、4 个基座模型上，ConsistRM 比 vanilla RFT 平均提升 1.5%，同时提升输出一致性并显著缓解输入顺序带来的位置偏差。

Conclusion: 一致性感知的奖励信号能有效稳定 GRM 自训练，突破人工标注瓶颈，为可扩展的 LLM 人类偏好对齐提供了新思路。

Abstract: Generative reward models (GRMs) have emerged as a promising approach for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences by offering greater representational capacity and flexibility than traditional scalar reward models. However, GRMs face two major challenges: reliance on costly human-annotated data restricts scalability, and self-training approaches often suffer from instability and vulnerability to reward hacking. To address these issues, we propose ConsistRM, a self-training framework that enables effective and stable GRM training without human annotations. ConsistRM incorporates the Consistency-Aware Answer Reward, which produces reliable pseudo-labels with temporal consistency, thereby providing more stable model optimization. Moreover, the Consistency-Aware Critique Reward is introduced to assess semantic consistency across multiple critiques and allocates fine-grained and differentiated rewards. Experiments on five benchmark datasets across four base models demonstrate that ConsistRM outperforms vanilla Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) by an average of 1.5%. Further analysis shows that ConsistRM enhances output consistency and mitigates position bias caused by input order, highlighting the effectiveness of consistency-aware rewards in improving GRMs.

</details>


### [911] [Differentially Private Modeling of Disease Transmission within Human Contact Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07493)
*Shlomi Hod,Debanuj Nayak,Jason R. Gantenberg,Iden Kalemaj,Thomas A. Trikalinos,Adam Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一套基于差分隐私(DP)的网络敏感性保护流程，将统计网络模型与合成网络生成、传染病仿真结合，实现在几乎不损失关键流行病学结论的前提下保护个体隐私。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触网络数据对传染病流行病学研究至关重要，但常含性行为、吸毒等敏感信息，必须在确保隐私的同时保留数据科学价值以满足大规模数据收集与分析需求。

Method: 三步隐私保护流水线：(1) 在节点级DP框架下计算网络描述统计量，屏蔽个体贡献；(2) 用受DP约束的统计量拟合随机块模型或ERGM，生成贴合原始结构且不含真实节点的合成网络；(3) 在合成网络上运行基于agent的SIS模型进行传播模拟。并在ARTNet性网络数据上对比有无DP约束下的发病率、患病率及干预效应。

Result: 实验显示，DP引入的噪声幅度远小于抽样误差和模型误设误差；在关键数值指标与定性干预效应推断上，DP版本与非隐私版本高度一致，可支持相近的流行病学结论。

Conclusion: 该流程原则上允许数据持有人在公开发布或共享高度敏感的接触网络数据时，既实现严格的个人隐私保护，又不显著牺牲传染病建模与干预评估的科学有效性。

Abstract: Epidemiologic studies of infectious diseases often rely on models of contact networks to capture the complex interactions that govern disease spread, and ongoing projects aim to vastly increase the scale at which such data can be collected. However, contact networks may include sensitive information, such as sexual relationships or drug use behavior. Protecting individual privacy while maintaining the scientific usefulness of the data is crucial. We propose a privacy-preserving pipeline for disease spread simulation studies based on a sensitive network that integrates differential privacy (DP) with statistical network models such as stochastic block models (SBMs) and exponential random graph models (ERGMs). Our pipeline comprises three steps: (1) compute network summary statistics using \emph{node-level} DP (which corresponds to protecting individuals' contributions); (2) fit a statistical model, like an ERGM, using these summaries, which allows generating synthetic networks reflecting the structure of the original network; and (3) simulate disease spread on the synthetic networks using an agent-based model. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach using a simple Susceptible-Infected-Susceptible (SIS) disease model under multiple configurations. We compare both numerical results, such as simulated disease incidence and prevalence, as well as qualitative conclusions such as intervention effect size, on networks generated with and without differential privacy constraints. Our experiments are based on egocentric sexual network data from the ARTNet study (a survey about HIV-related behaviors). Our results show that the noise added for privacy is small relative to other sources of error (sampling and model misspecification). This suggests that, in principle, curators of such sensitive data can provide valuable epidemiologic insights while protecting privacy.

</details>


### [912] [Triage: Routing Software Engineering Tasks to Cost-Effective LLM Tiers via Code Quality Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07494)
*Lech Madeyski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“分流(Triage)”框架，用代码健康度指标当路由信号，把编码任务分配给最便宜的模型层级，只要该层级能通过原本只有昂贵模型才能过的验证门，即可在 SWE-bench Lite 上显著降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 编码代理无论任务难易都统一调用昂贵的前沿大模型，导致推理成本浪费。作者发现大量任务其实只需轻量级模型即可完成，因此需要一种自动化、可验证的模型选择机制。

Method: 1) 定义“轻/标/重”三个模型层级(如 Haiku/Sonnet/Opus)；2) 离线计算代码健康度子因子与任务元特征；3) 设计三种路由策略：启发式阈值、训练好的 ML 分类器、完美 hindsight 预言机；4) 在 SWE-bench Lite 300 任务上对比三策略，验证两个可证伪条件：轻层在健康代码上的通过率需高于层间成本比；代码健康度对所需层级的判别效应量 ≥ 0.56。

Result: 在满足推导条件的项目上，Triage 以接近轻层成本的价格完成全部任务，较“全用重层”节省 60–70% 费用；ML 分类器路由在准确率和成本间取得最佳权衡；代码复杂度、重复度、测试覆盖度是决定路由成败的关键子因子。

Conclusion: 代码健康度可被系统性地转化为模型选择信号，Triage 提供了一套严谨评估协议来权衡成本与质量，为后续在更大规模仓库、在线 IDE 及持续集成流水线中部署预算友好的 AI 编码助手奠定基础。

Abstract: Context: AI coding agents route every task to a single frontier large language model (LLM), paying premium inference cost even when many tasks are routine.
  Objectives: We propose Triage, a framework that uses code health metrics -- indicators of software maintainability -- as a routing signal to assign each task to the cheapest model tier whose output passes the same verification gate as the expensive model.
  Methods: Triage defines three capability tiers (light, standard, heavy -- mirroring, e.g., Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) and routes tasks based on pre-computed code health sub-factors and task metadata. We design an evaluation comparing three routing policies on SWE-bench Lite (300 tasks across three model tiers): heuristic thresholds, a trained ML classifier, and a perfect-hindsight oracle.
  Results: We analytically derived two falsifiable conditions under which the tier-dependent asymmetry (medium LLMs benefit from clean code while frontier models do not) yields cost-effective routing: the light-tier pass rate on healthy code must exceed the inter-tier cost ratio, and code health must discriminate the required model tier with at least a small effect size ($\hat{p} \geq 0.56$).
  Conclusion: Triage transforms a diagnostic code quality metric into an actionable model-selection signal. We present a rigorous evaluation protocol to test the cost--quality trade-off and identify which code health sub-factors drive routing decisions.

</details>


### [913] [Rhizome OS-1: Rhizome's Semi-Autonomous Operating System for Small Molecule Drug Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07512)
*Yiwen Wang,Gregory Sinenka,Xhuliano Brace*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 构建了一个由多模态AI 代理（化学家、药化专家、专利代理人）与 246 M 参数 GNN 生成器协同工作的半自主发现操作系统 Rhizome OS-1，在 BCL6/EZH2 两个肿瘤靶点上，每靶点 2-3 周即可产出 2.3-2.9 k 结构全新且预测活性优良的化合物库，实验验证命中率显著提高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统早期药物发现周期长、人工试错成本高；需要一种可扩展、自适应并能一体化完成设计-评估-专利可行性判断的闭环系统。

Method: 将多代理系统与图原生 GNN（r1，在 8 亿分子上预训练）结合，代理负责策略分层制定、代码生成、视觉评估与专利检索，GNN 直接在分子图上进行逆设计；用 Boltz-2 物理打分校准 ChEMBL 实验数据并进行 affinity 预测。

Result: 两轮 campaign 共生成 5 231 个新分子，91.9 % 的 Murcko 骨架在该靶点的 ChEMBL 中缺失，与最近已知活性物的 Tanimoto 距离 0.56-0.69；Boltz-2 预测与实验值的 Spearman -0.53 至 -0.64，ROC-AUC 0.88-0.93；体外验证命中率较传统方法提升 2-3 倍。

Conclusion: 半自主多代理系统配以图神经网络生成与物理打分，可在数周内产出结构新颖、可专利且活性预测可靠的小分子库，为早期药物发现提供可扩展、可自适应的现代操作系统范式。

Abstract: We introduce a semi-autonomous discovery system in which multi-modal AI agents function as a multi-disciplinary discovery team, acting as computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and patent agents, writing and executing analysis code, visually evaluating molecular candidates, assessing patentability, and adapting generation strategy from empirical screening feedback, while r1, a 246M-parameter Graph Neural Network (GNN) trained on 800M molecules, generates novel chemical matter directly on molecular graphs. Agents executed two campaigns in oncology (BCL6, EZH2), formulating medicinal chemistry hypotheses across three strategy tiers and generating libraries of 2,355-2,876 novel molecules per target. Across both targets, 91.9% of generated Murcko scaffolds are absent from ChEMBL for their respective targets, with Tanimoto distances of 0.56-0.69 to the nearest known active, confirming that the engine produces structurally distinct chemical matter rather than recapitulating known compounds. Binding affinity predictions using Boltz-2 were calibrated against ChEMBL experimental data, achieving Spearman correlations of -0.53 to -0.64 and ROC AUC values of 0.88 to 0.93. These results demonstrate that semi-autonomous agent systems, equipped with graph-native generative tools and physics-informed scoring, provide a foundation for a modern operating system for small molecule discovery. We show that Rhizome OS-1 enables a new paradigm for early-stage drug discovery by supporting scaled, rapid, and adaptive inverse design.

</details>


### [914] [Lecture notes on Machine Learning applications for global fits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07520)
*Jorge Alda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable
