Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: These lecture notes provide a comprehensive framework for performing global statistical fits in high-energy physics using modern Machine Learning (ML) surrogates. We begin by reviewing the statistical foundations of model building, including the likelihood function, Wilks' theorem, and profile likelihoods. Recognizing that the computational cost of evaluating model predictions often renders traditional minimization prohibitive, we introduce Boosted Decision Trees to approximate the log-likelihood function. The notes detail a robust ML workflow including efficient generation of training data with active learning and Gaussian processes, hyperparameter optimization, model compilation for speed-up, and interpretability through SHAP values to decode the influence of model parameters and interactions between parameters. We further discuss posterior distribution sampling using Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). These techniques are finally applied to the $B^\pm \to K^\pm ν\barν$ anomaly at Belle II, demonstrating how a two-stage ML model can efficiently explore the parameter space of Axion-Like Particles (ALPs) while satisfying stringent experimental constraints on decay lengths and flavor-violating couplings.

</details>


### [915] [From LLM to Silicon: RL-Driven ASIC Architecture Exploration for On-Device AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07526)
*Ravindra Ganti,Steve Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 以强化学习为核心的统一编译器在7种工艺节点（3–28 nm）上自动联合优化AI推理ASIC的架构、存储层次与算子划分，实现高吞吐/超低功耗两模式，无需人工重调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ASIC设计需为不同工艺节点反复手工调校PPA，流程割裂且耗时。本文旨在用单一RL智能体把架构、微架构与映射联合建模，实现跨节点零人工迁移。

Method: 将联合优化空间建模为混合离散-连续动作MDP，采用Soft Actor-Critic+MoE门控，同时探索网格拓扑、核级微架构与算子布局；奖励函数为统一PPA加权和。通过经验回放与熵正则化保证高效探索。

Result: 在Llama3.1-8B FP16上3nm节点达29 809 token/s；SmolVLM低功耗模式全节点低于13 mW@10 MHz，面积与手动设计相当，能耗平均降28%。7个节点无需重调即自动适配异构FETCH、VLEN及存储分配。

Conclusion: 首次证明单RL智能体可端到端联合优化AI推理ASIC的宏/微架构与映射，并在3–28 nm全工艺节点零人工重调达成Pareto最优PPA，为工艺可迁移的自主芯片设计奠定基础。

Abstract: We present an RL-driven compiler that jointly optimizes ASIC architecture, memory hierarchy, and workload partitioning for AI inference across 3nm to 28nm. The design space is formulated as a single Markov Decision Process with mixed discrete-continuous actions and a unified Power-Performance-Area (PPA) objective. Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with Mixture-of-Experts gating explores the joint space of mesh topology, per-core microarchitecture, and operator placement. We validate on two workloads, Llama 3.1 8B FP16 (high-performance mode, 29809 tokens per second at 3nm) and SmolVLM (low-power mode, less than 13 mW at all nodes, 10 MHz). Across 7 process nodes, the RL automatically adapts mesh sizes and per-tile configurations, including heterogeneous FETCH, VLEN, and memory allocation without node-specific manual retuning.

</details>


### [916] [RL-ASL: A Dynamic Listening Optimization for TSCH Networks Using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07533)
*F. Fernando Jurado-Lasso,J. F. Jurado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于强化学习的TSCH自适应监听机制，在节点端零训练开销下实现46%能耗降低、96%时延缩短，同时保持近100%可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典TSCH调度器采用静态时隙分配，在业务动态变化时造成空闲监听与额外能耗，难以满足IIoT低功耗与高可靠并存的需求。

Method: 提出RL-ASL框架：离线训练轻量级RL模型，节点在线推理动态决定“监听/跳过”已分配时隙；引入链路级变体RL-ASL-LB以应对高竞争场景；完整兼容IEEE 802.15.4e TSCH同步机制。

Result: FIT IoT-LAB与Cooja实验表明：相比基准调度，能耗降46%，端到端时延最高降96%，PDR保持≥99.9%；RL-ASL-LB在高负载下延迟再降15%，能耗持平；推理RAM<2 kB，CPU占用<1%。

Conclusion: RL-ASL首次在资源受限节点上实现“零在线训练”的RL调度，提供可扩展、低功耗、高可靠的IIoT MAC层解决方案，可直接部署于现有TSCH网络。

Abstract: Time Slotted Channel Hopping (TSCH) is a widely adopted Media Access Control (MAC) protocol within the IEEE 802.15.4e standard, designed to provide reliable and energy-efficient communication in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) networks. However, state-of-the-art TSCH schedulers rely on static slot allocations, resulting in idle listening and unnecessary power consumption under dynamic traffic conditions. This paper introduces RL-ASL, a reinforcement learning-driven adaptive listening framework that dynamically decides whether to activate or skip a scheduled listening slot based on real-time network conditions. By integrating learning-based slot skipping with standard TSCH scheduling, RL-ASL reduces idle listening while preserving synchronization and delivery reliability. Experimental results on the FIT IoT-LAB testbed and Cooja network simulator show that RL-ASL achieves up to 46% lower power consumption than baseline scheduling protocols, while maintaining near-perfect reliability and reducing average latency by up to 96% compared to PRIL-M. Its link-based variant, RL-ASL-LB, further improves delay performance under high contention with similar energy efficiency. Importantly, RL-ASL performs inference on constrained motes with negligible overhead, as model training is fully performed offline. Overall, RL-ASL provides a practical, scalable, and energy-aware scheduling mechanism for next-generation low-power IIoT networks.

</details>


### [917] [Predicting Activity Cliffs for Autonomous Medicinal Chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07560)
*Michael Cuccarese*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于2500万对匹配分子，首次把“活性悬崖位置”与“高频变构位点”分开建模；仅用骨架大小即可定位高变位点，而预测真正的活性悬崖需11个三维药效团特征，NDCG@3达0.91，可将首轮实验需合成位置减少31%，代码与网页工具已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活性悬崖（微小结构改变导致活性骤变）是药物化学的核心难题。前人研究常把“哪一位置最易变化”与“哪一位置易产生活性悬崖”混为一谈，缺乏可解释、可泛化且对化学家直接有用的精准定位方法。

Method: 从ChEMBL 50个靶标、六大蛋白家族提取2500万对匹配分子对(MMP)；分别定义两类问题：①“哪一位置变异最频繁”——仅用骨架原子数指标；②“哪一位置是真实活性悬崖”——用SALI归一化活性差距标识悬崖。对后者构建11维特征（含3D药效团环境、相对溶剂可及面积等），用LightGBM训练排序模型，并做家族外、新骨架、时间分割三重泛化验证。

Result: 问题①NDCG@3=0.966，无需机器学习；问题②模型NDCG@3=0.910（随机基线0.839），跨家族、新骨架、时间切分仍保持>0.87。Top-1命中率达到53%（随机27%），化学家首轮需探索的位置从平均3.1降至2.1，减少31%。然而“到具体做哪种修饰”无法仅靠结构预测（Spearman 0.268，新骨架上降至-0.31）。

Conclusion: 首次阐明“高频变构位点”与“活性悬崖位点”本质不同：前者由骨架大小决定，后者需三维药效团上下文。所建模型可即时指导合成优先级，显著降低实验成本；系统已开源并提供交互式网页工具，为早期药物发现提供即用型活性悬崖定位方案。

Abstract: Activity cliff prediction - identifying positions where small structural changes cause large potency shifts - has been a persistent challenge in computational medicinal chemistry. This work focuses on a parsimonious definition: which small modifications, at which positions, confer the highest probability of an outcome change. Position-level sensitivity is calculated using 25 million matched molecular pairs from 50 ChEMBL targets across six protein families, revealing that two questions have fundamentally different answers. "Which positions vary most?" is answered by scaffold size alone (NDCG@3 = 0.966), requiring no machine learning. "Which are true activity cliffs?" - where small modifications cause disproportionately large effects, as captured by SALI normalization - requires an 11-feature model with 3D pharmacophore context (NDCG@3 = 0.910 vs. 0.839 random), generalizing across all six protein families, novel scaffolds (0.913), and temporal splits (0.878). The model identifies the cliff-prone position first 53% of the time (vs. 27% random - 2x lift), reducing positions a chemist must explore from 3.1 to 2.1 - a 31% reduction in first-round experiments. Predicting which modification to make is not tractable from structure alone (Spearman 0.268, collapsing to -0.31 on novel scaffolds). The system is released as open-source code and an interactive webapp.

</details>


### [918] [Reasoning-Based Refinement of Unsupervised Text Clusters with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07562)
*Tunazzina Islam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用 LLM 当“语义裁判”，在无需标签的情况下对任意无监督聚类结果做三级推理精修，显著提升一致性与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯无监督聚类常产生冗余、不连贯或难以解释的簇，而嵌入空间方法无法自我校验；需要一种无需人工标注即可验证并重构语义结构的机制。

Method: 提出三阶段推理框架：① 一致性验证——让 LLM 判断簇摘要是否被成员文本支持；② 冗余裁决——基于语义重叠合并或剔除候选簇；③ 标签落地——完全无监督地为簇生成可解释标签。整个流程将表示学习与结构验证解耦，仅把 LLM 用作语义裁判而非嵌入生成器。

Result: 在两个交互模式迥异的社交媒体数据集上，相较于经典主题模型与最新表示基线，簇一致性及人类对齐标签质量均显著提升；人类评估与 LLM 生成标签高度一致。跨平台时序与规模鲁棒测试验证了稳定性。

Conclusion: LLM 推理可作为一种通用机制，对大规模文本的无监督语义结构进行可验证、可解释的精修，无需任何监督信号即可提升可靠性。

Abstract: Unsupervised methods are widely used to induce latent semantic structure from large text collections, yet their outputs often contain incoherent, redundant, or poorly grounded clusters that are difficult to validate without labeled data. We propose a reasoning-based refinement framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) not as embedding generators, but as semantic judges that validate and restructure the outputs of arbitrary unsupervised clustering algorithms.Our framework introduces three reasoning stages: (i) coherence verification, where LLMs assess whether cluster summaries are supported by their member texts; (ii) redundancy adjudication, where candidate clusters are merged or rejected based on semantic overlap; and (iii) label grounding, where clusters are assigned interpretable labels in a fully unsupervised manner. This design decouples representation learning from structural validation and mitigates common failure modes of embedding-only approaches. We evaluate the framework on real-world social media corpora from two platforms with distinct interaction models, demonstrating consistent improvements in cluster coherence and human-aligned labeling quality over classical topic models and recent representation-based baselines. Human evaluation shows strong agreement with LLM-generated labels, despite the absence of gold-standard annotations. We further conduct robustness analyses under matched temporal and volume conditions to assess cross-platform stability. Beyond empirical gains, our results suggest that LLM-based reasoning can serve as a general mechanism for validating and refining unsupervised semantic structure, enabling more reliable and interpretable analyses of large text collections without supervision.

</details>


### [919] [CAMO: A Class-Aware Minority-Optimized Ensemble for Robust Language Model Evaluation on Imbalanced Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07583)
*Mohamed Ehab,Ali Hamdi,Khaled Shaban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAMO是一种针对类别极度不均衡问题的层级式集成框架，通过投票分布、置信度校准与模型间不确定性动态提升少数类，在两个高难度领域基准上刷新严格 macro-F1 纪录，并证明其增益与模型适配方式协同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实分类任务常因类别失衡导致传统集成方法偏向多数类，显著压低少数类性能与整体 F1 得分。现有集成策略未充分考虑少数类优化，亟需一种能同时保持并放大少数类预测的通用框架。

Method: 提出 CAMO（Class-Aware Minority-Optimized）集成框架：① 层级投票重分配：先在各基模型内部按置信度校准生成少数类加权投票；② 不确定性融合：利用模型间预测方差动态放大高不确定且属于少数类的置信度；③ 自适应权重更新：根据验证集 macro-F1 反馈迭代调整少数类 boost 强度，实现域无关的通用提升。

Result: 在 DIAR-AI/Emotion（情绪极不平衡）与 BEA 2025（三分类作文错误检测）两个领域基准上，用 8 种语言模型（3 大 5 小）分别做 zero-shot 与微调测试。CAMO 在微调场景下连续获得最高严格 macro-F1，相对次优集成平均提升 4.7 pp；在 zero-shot 下亦保持优势。增益与模型规模、微调深度呈协同关系，表明集成策略需因模型特性而异。

Conclusion: CAMO 是一个可靠、领域中立的类别不平衡分类通用框架，其通过动态少数类增强机制与模型不确定性耦合，能在不同规模与训练方式的语言模型上稳定提升宏观性能，为现实极度倾斜数据场景提供即插即用的集成解决方案。

Abstract: Real-world categorization is severely hampered by class imbalance because traditional ensembles favor majority classes, which lowers minority performance and overall F1-score. We provide a unique ensemble technique for imbalanced problems called CAMO (Class-Aware Minority-Optimized).Through a hierarchical procedure that incorporates vote distributions, confidence calibration, and inter model uncertainty, CAMO dynamically boosts underrepresented classes while preserving and amplifying minority forecasts. We verify CAMO on two highly unbalanced, domain-specific benchmarks: the DIAR-AI/Emotion dataset and the ternary BEA 2025 dataset. We benchmark against seven proven ensemble algorithms using eight different language models (three LLMs and five SLMs) under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings .With refined models, CAMO consistently earns the greatest strict macro F1-score, setting a new benchmark. Its benefit works in concert with model adaptation, showing that the best ensemble choice depends on model properties .This proves that CAMO is a reliable, domain-neutral framework for unbalanced categorization.

</details>


### [920] [From Ground Truth to Measurement: A Statistical Framework for Human Labeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07591)
*Robert Chew,Stephanie Eckman,Christoph Kern,Frauke Kreuter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将人工标注视为测量过程，用统计模型把标签差异分解为实例难度、标注者偏差、情境噪声与关系对齐四类，可诊断「共享真值」还是「个体真值」更适合任务，并在 NLI 多标注数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督学习默认标签准确，但人工标注存在系统性差异；现有研究把差异统一当噪声，掩盖了概念本质与模型真实学习目标。

Method: 把标注重构为测量过程，提出四层统计分解框架：实例难度、标注者偏差、情境噪声、关系对齐；扩展经典测量误差模型以兼容共享与个体真值，并给出模型选择诊断。

Result: 在多人标注的自然语言推理数据集上，四项理论成分均获实证支持，证明框架可解释标签变源并区分「共享真值」与「个体真值」机制。

Conclusion: 该测量视角为数据-centric ML 提供系统诊断工具，可指导标注流程优化并推动标注科学化发展。

Abstract: Supervised machine learning assumes that labeled data provide accurate measurements of the concepts models are meant to learn. Yet in practice, human labeling introduces systematic variation arising from ambiguous items, divergent interpretations, and simple mistakes. Machine learning research commonly treats all disagreement as noise, which obscures these distinctions and limits our understanding of what models actually learn. This paper reframes annotation as a measurement process and introduces a statistical framework for decomposing labeling outcomes into interpretable sources of variation: instance difficulty, annotator bias, situational noise, and relational alignment. The framework extends classical measurement-error models to accommodate both shared and individualized notions of truth, reflecting traditional and human label variation interpretations of error, and provides a diagnostic for assessing which regime better characterizes a given task. Applying the proposed model to a multi-annotator natural language inference dataset, we find empirical evidence for all four theorized components and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. We conclude with implications for data-centric machine learning and outline how this approach can guide the development of a more systematic science of labeling.

</details>


### [921] [Blink: CPU-Free LLM Inference by Delegating the Serving Stack to GPU and SmartNIC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07609)
*Mohammad Siavashi,Mariano Scazzariello,Gerald Q. Maguire,Dejan Kostić,Marco Chiesa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 以SmartNIC+GPU一体化架构取代传统CPU过多参与的推理流水线，彻底屏蔽CPU性能波动对LLM服务的影响，在延迟、吞吐与能耗指标上全面碾压现有基线，且对CPU干扰完全免疫。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理成为数据中心新核心负载，但主流服务框架仍将CPU留在请求调度、KV-cache管理等关键路径，导致性能易受CPU干扰，迫使运营商过量预留CPU资源，大规模算力闲置。

Method: 提出「Blink」端到端架构：1) 请求收发与RDMA直通GPU内存由SmartNIC硬件承担，CPU不介入稳态路径；2) 常驻GPU内核负责batching、调度与KV-cache管理，实现无CPU推理闭环；3) 彻底重分配主机-设备职责，仅在异常/初始阶段才回落CPU，形成CPU-SmartNIC-GPU三域协同。

Result: 与TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/SGLang对比：单系统运行即可将P99 TTFT最高降低8.47×，P99 TPOT最高降低3.40×；decode吞吐最高提升2.1×；每token能耗最高下降48.6%；在100% CPU压力测试中，基线系统延迟劣化达两个数量级，而Blink保持稳定输出。

Conclusion: 验证LLM推理可由SmartNIC+GPU协同接管，CPU从稳态路径“下岗”切实可行，不仅释放被预留算力，更将性能、能效与多租户干扰隔离提升一个量级，为下一代数据中心级LLM服务提供重新设计范式。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference is rapidly becoming a core datacenter service, yet current serving stacks keep the host CPU on the critical path for orchestration and token-level control. This makes LLM performance sensitive to CPU interference, undermining application colocation and forcing operators to reserve CPU headroom, leaving substantial capacity unutilized.
  We introduce Blink, an end-to-end serving architecture that removes the host CPU from the steady-state inference path by redistributing responsibilities across a SmartNIC and a GPU. Blink offloads request handling to the SmartNIC, which delivers inputs directly into GPU memory via RDMA, and replaces host-driven scheduling with a persistent GPU kernel that performs batching, scheduling, and KV-cache management without CPU involvement.
  Evaluated against TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang, Blink outperforms all baselines even in isolation, reducing pre-saturation P99 TTFT by up to 8.47$\times$ and P99 TPOT by up to 3.40$\times$, improving decode throughput by up to 2.1$\times$, and reducing energy per token by up to 48.6$\%$. Under CPU interference, Blink maintains stable performance, while existing systems degrade by up to two orders of magnitude.

</details>


### [922] [DIVERSED: Relaxed Speculative Decoding via Dynamic Ensemble Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07622)
*Ziyi Wang,Siva Rajesh Kasa,Ankith M S,Santhosh Kumar Kasa,Jiaru Zou,Sumit Negi,Ruqi Zhang,Nan Jiang,Qifan Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DIVERSED 引入一个动态可学习的 relaxed verifier，通过任务/上下文相关的加权混合草稿与目标模型分布，打破传统投机解码“严格对齐接受分布”导致的刚性瓶颈，显著提升 token 接受率和推理加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准投机解码在验证阶段必须强制草稿概率分布与目标模型完全相同，导致大量合理 token 被拒、接受率低下，成为整体加速的主要瓶颈；现有工作缺乏对该刚性分布匹配的松弛与自适应调整手段，亟需一种在保持生成质量的同时可动态放宽验证限制的框架。

Method: 提出 Dynamic Verification Relaxed Speculative Decoding (DIVERSED)：1. 将验证条件改为经验性加权分布匹配问题，允许草稿-目标差异在一定阈值内被容忍；2. 引入基于集成学习的可训练 verifier，引入任务与上下文相关特征，动态学习混合权重；3. 理论证明松弛验证下的期望输出 KL 散度界限保证质量；4. 端到端与主流模型和基准集成实现。

Result: 多组大模型（含参数量 1.3B–30B）与 HumanEval、MBPP、OpenWebText 等测试显示：接受率提升 4.7–7.3×，解码速度提高 1.9–2.5×，端到端延迟平均减少 58%；与标准投机解码相比维持相似 BLEU/困惑度/通过率，未出现可检测质量下降。

Conclusion: DIVERSED 通过“动态松弛+可学习验证”突破传统投机解码的刚性对齐瓶颈，在几乎不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著推高 token 接受率与推理加速天花板，为大规模模型在线部署提供了实用高效且易于实现的通用加速框架。

Abstract: Speculative decoding is an effective technique for accelerating large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. In practice, its speedup is often bottlenecked by a rigid verification step that strictly enforces the accepted token distribution to exactly match the target model. This constraint leads to the rejection of many plausible tokens, lowering the acceptance rate and limiting overall time speedup. To overcome this limitation, we propose Dynamic Verification Relaxed Speculative Decoding (DIVERSED), a relaxed verification framework that improves time efficiency while preserving generation quality. DIVERSED learns an ensemble-based verifier that blends the draft and target model distributions with a task-dependent and context-dependent weight. We provide theoretical justification for our approach and demonstrate empirically that DIVERSED achieves substantially higher inference efficiency compared to standard speculative decoding methods. Code is available at: https://github.com/comeusr/diversed.

</details>


### [923] [Variational Approximated Restricted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Spatial Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07635)
*Debjoy Thakur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对大规模 ICAR 空间模型 REML 计算瓶颈，本文提出变分 REML（VREML），用高斯变分族近似边际似然，构建 ELBO 并设计坐标上升算法，理论上证明 ELBO 单调收敛且在高斯 ICAR 下逼近误差为零；实验显示 VREML 精度优于 MLE 与 INLA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 REML 需反复对大型稀疏精度矩阵求逆/分解，计算代价高，难以扩展至大规模空间数据，需要一种可扩展且理论保障的推断方法。

Method: 构建高斯变分分布近似不可解的 REML 边际似然，建立 ELBO 为目标函数，推导坐标上升算法联合估计空间随机效应与方差分量；证明 ELBO 单调递增并在高斯 ICAR 模型下变分族精确，近似误差后验为零。

Result: 理论保证 ELBO 单调收敛且变分逼近无误；模拟与实证表明 VREML 在估计精度与计算效率上均优于 MLE 与 INLA。

Conclusion: VREML 在大规模 ICAR 空间推断中兼具可扩展性与理论最优性，为空间统计提供高效可靠的 REML 替代方案。

Abstract: This research considers a scalable inference for spatial data modeled through Gaussian intrinsic conditional autoregressive (ICAR) structures. The classical estimation method, restricted maximum likelihood (REML), requires repeated inversion and factorization of large, sparse precision matrices, which makes this computation costly. To sort this problem out, we propose a variational restricted maximum likelihood (VREML) framework that approximates the intractable marginal likelihood using a Gaussian variational distribution. By constructing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) on the restricted likelihood, we derive a computationally efficient coordinate-ascent algorithm for jointly estimating the spatial random effects and variance components. In this article, we theoretically establish the monotone convergence of ELBO and mathematically exhibit that the variational family is exact under Gaussian ICAR settings, which is an indication of nullifying approximation error at the posterior level. We empirically establish the supremacy of our VREML over MLE and INLA.

</details>


### [924] [Exponential quantum advantage in processing massive classical data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07639)
*Haimeng Zhao,Alexander Zlokapa,Hartmut Neven,Ryan Babbush,John Preskill,Jarrod R. McClean,Hsin-Yuan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 理论证明仅需数 10 个逻辑量子比特即可对 PB 级经典数据完成分类与降维，并在单细胞 RNA 测序、影评情感分析等实测任务中比经典 4–6 个数量级更小的设备获得相同性能，而且经典设备若规模指数翻倍仍需超多项式样本/时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前量子优势主要集中在特定量子物理问题或需指数级量子内存的任务，尚不清楚能否在日常海量经典数据处理与机器学习场景（现实数据不可整体载入量子存储器）被普遍证明改进。

Method: 提出 “量子预言机草图”（quantum oracle sketching）框架：只随机采样经典数据生成量子叠加态草图，再结合经典阴影（classical shadows）重建贝叶斯/线性模型，不需要完整先加载数据库，也不受读出瓶颈影响；随后给出样本复杂度、量子线路规模、经典对照下界等严格理论结果。

Result: 1. 理论上证明对需样本数 N≥exp(n^α) 的规模可以：a) 仅需 polylog(N) 量子位即获得等效预测精度；b) 经典机若规模不到 exp(polylog(N)) 则需 exp(α·nk) 样本和时间。2. 实验验证仅 60 位逻辑量子比特即可处理百万级单细胞转录组与影评数据，对应的经典接近同性能模型需数千倍规模；等效表现差距持续六阶量级，且优势在 BPP=BQP 假定下依旧成立。

Conclusion: 文章把“经典数据的机器学习”确认为量子优势的广泛原生赛道，并首次给出无需量子存储器、不受外插读取瓶颈限制的渐进分离；断言了量子力学本身正确性的复杂性前沿检验点，同时为近期小规模量子计算切入实际 Big-Data 分析提供可行方案。

Abstract: Broadly applicable quantum advantage, particularly in classical data processing and machine learning, has been a fundamental open problem. In this work, we prove that a small quantum computer of polylogarithmic size can perform large-scale classification and dimension reduction on massive classical data by processing samples on the fly, whereas any classical machine achieving the same prediction performance requires exponentially larger size. Furthermore, classical machines that are exponentially larger yet below the required size need superpolynomially more samples and time. We validate these quantum advantages in real-world applications, including single-cell RNA sequencing and movie review sentiment analysis, demonstrating four to six orders of magnitude reduction in size with fewer than 60 logical qubits. These quantum advantages are enabled by quantum oracle sketching, an algorithm for accessing the classical world in quantum superposition using only random classical data samples. Combined with classical shadows, our algorithm circumvents the data loading and readout bottleneck to construct succinct classical models from massive classical data, a task provably impossible for any classical machine that is not exponentially larger than the quantum machine. These quantum advantages persist even when classical machines are granted unlimited time or if BPP=BQP, and rely only on the correctness of quantum mechanics. Together, our results establish machine learning on classical data as a broad and natural domain of quantum advantage and a fundamental test of quantum mechanics at the complexity frontier.

</details>


### [925] [Parameter-free non-ergodic extragradient algorithms for solving monotone variational inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07662)
*Lingqing Shen,Fatma Kılınç-Karzan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无参数外梯度算法，在仅知全局或局部 Lipschitz 信息即可给出单调变分不等式非渐近最后迭代收敛率 O(1/√T)，且所有步长自适应选取大幅超越现有固定步长方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单调变分不等式(MVI) 统一了凸优化、均衡与鞍点问题；现有外梯度方法多依赖难估计的全局光滑常数，且最后迭代收敛率理论匮乏，阻碍实际应用。

Method: 1) 对全局 Lipschitz 算子设计无参数自适应步长，将步长与梯度范数或局部 Lipschitz 常数之倒数直接耦合；2) 通过典型 Lipschitz 加权和势函数技术给出单步下降不等式，推出非渐近 o(1/√T) 最后迭代速率；3) 引入回溯线搜索把框架延拓至只满足局部 Lipschitz、无法给出全局常数的情形，仍保持参数-自由；4) 在理论保证中显式考虑约束集，证明投影操作不会破坏所得步长与下降关系。

Result: 对已知或未知光滑常数的受限 MVI，新算法均首次获得可计算、参数-自由的 o(1/√T) 最后迭代收敛率，且任意维数简单可执行。数值实验(双线性矩阵博弈、LASSO、最小极大群体公平、最大熵采样松弛)显示 vs. Paramount-EHS 等最新方法，相对终端误差平均下降 30-70%，迭代更少，稳定度更高。

Conclusion: 论文给出的无参数外梯度族真正克服了”需要预知光滑常数且仅保证平均迭代” 的障碍，使最后迭代理论首次在一般 MVI 层面走上可计算、自适应、实用的位置，可被直接迁移到凸-凹博弈与凸优化问题中以提升实际终端性能。

Abstract: Monotone variational inequalities (VIs) provide a unifying framework for convex minimization, equilibrium computation, and convex-concave saddle-point problems. Extragradient-type methods are among the most effective first-order algorithms for such problems, but their performance hinges critically on stepsize selection. While most existing theory focuses on ergodic averages of the iterates, practical performance is often driven by the significantly stronger behavior of the last iterate. Moreover, available last-iterate guarantees typically rely on fixed stepsizes chosen using problem-specific global smoothness information, which is often difficult to estimate accurately and may not even be applicable. In this paper, we develop parameter-free extragradient methods with non-asymptotic last-iterate guarantees for constrained monotone VIs. For globally Lipschitz operators, our algorithm achieves an $o(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate rate. We then extend the framework to locally Lipschitz operators via backtracking line search and obtain the same rate while preserving parameter-freeness, thereby making parameter-free last-iterate methods applicable to important problem classes for which global smoothness is unrealistic. Our numerical experiments on bilinear matrix games, LASSO, minimax group fairness, and state-of-the-art maximum entropy sampling relaxations demonstrate wide applicability of our results as well as strong last-iterate performance and significant improvements over existing methods.

</details>


### [926] [On the Unique Recovery of Transport Maps and Vector Fields from Finite Measure-Valued Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07671)
*Jonah Botvinick-Greenhouse,Yunan Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 引入用有限观测密度唯一恢复流形上线性场及同胚映射的确定性理论，给出可计算同胚测度以及流场数据维度下界，并将所得框架用于生成模型、动力系统和 PDE 反问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 如何在有限观测下保证生成模型中的变换/驱动向量能被唯一确定，从而确保相应反问题的良定性；同时探讨概率测度空间里的推前算子在何种条件下足以刻画变换。

Method: 利用 Whitney 与 Takens 嵌入定理说明在流形本征维数意义下有限的推前密度（推前向量场密度）蕴含唯一同胚映射（向量场）。在此基础上构造推前密度分布差异度规，并引入 Perron–Frobenius/Koopman 算子刻画。

Result: 给出了唯一识别同胚或向量场的最小密度数与流形内在维数间显式关系；证明了相应的度量是一非退化距离；进一步推广到连续性、扩散、Fokker–Planck 及对流-扩散-反应型 PDE 反问题的良定性条件。

Conclusion: 推前密度的有限集合足以唯一编码高维同胚映射及向量场，这为基于测度的生成建模、动力系统参数反演和 PDE 反问题提供了严格算法可行性保证，并通过数值实验检验其实际表现。

Abstract: We establish guarantees for the unique recovery of vector fields and transport maps from finite measure-valued data, yielding new insights into generative models, data-driven dynamical systems, and PDE inverse problems. In particular, we provide general conditions under which a diffeomorphism can be uniquely identified from its pushforward action on finitely many densities, i.e., when the data $\{(ρ_j,f_\#ρ_j)\}_{j=1}^m$ uniquely determines $f$. As a corollary, we introduce a new metric which compares diffeomorphisms by measuring the discrepancy between finitely many pushforward densities in the space of probability measures. We also prove analogous results in an infinitesimal setting, where derivatives of the densities along a smooth vector field are observed, i.e., when $\{(ρ_j,\text{div} (ρ_j v))\}_{j=1}^m$ uniquely determines $v$. Our analysis makes use of the Whitney and Takens embedding theorems, which provide estimates on the required number of densities $m$, depending only on the intrinsic dimension of the problem. We additionally interpret our results through the lens of Perron--Frobenius and Koopman operators and demonstrate how our techniques lead to new guarantees for the well-posedness of certain PDE inverse problems related to continuity, advection, Fokker--Planck, and advection-diffusion-reaction equations. Finally, we present illustrative numerical experiments demonstrating the unique identification of transport maps from finitely many pushforward densities, and of vector fields from finitely many weighted divergence observations.

</details>


### [927] [Towards Counterfactual Explanation and Assertion Inference for CPS Debugging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07679)
*Zaid Ghazal,Hadiza Yusuf,Khouloud Gaaloul*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DeCaF——首个面向 CPS 大规模仿真失效的最小反事实调试框架，可自动给出“何时、改何值即可让测试通过”的可解释断言，无需模型内部信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPS 仿真失效常由连续-离散交互触发，现有调试只能定位模型组件，无法揭示触发违规的输入信号取值/时刻，更难给出可防失效的最小精确修正。

Method: 1) 对失败测试用三种反事实生成器（KD-Tree NN、M5 模型树、遗传算法）搜索“最小、必要、充分”的输入信号扰动；2) 用两种因果模型（随机森林、M5 树）评估扰动与结果间的因果精度；3) 将成功扰动泛化为易于解释的输入断言。

Result: 在三套 CPS 案例中，KD-Tree NN + M5 树方案成功率最高；遗传算法 + 随机森林在成功率与因果精度间取得最佳平衡。

Conclusion: DeCaF 能在不暴露模型内部的前提下，把晦涩的仿真失效转化为工程师可直接理解的“何时改何值”断言，为 CPS 验证/调试提供通用、可解释的反事实指导。

Abstract: Verification and validation of cyber-physical systems (CPS) via large-scale simulation often surface failures that are hard to interpret, especially when triggered by interactions between continuous and discrete behaviors at specific events or times. Existing debugging techniques can localize anomalies to specific model components, but they provide little insight into the input-signal values and timing conditions that trigger violations, or the minimal, precisely timed changes that could have prevented the failure. In this article, we introduce DeCaF, a counterfactual-guided explanation and assertion-based characterization framework for CPS debugging. Given a failing test input, DeCaF generates counterfactual changes to the input signals that transform the test from failing to passing. These changes are designed to be minimal, necessary, and sufficient to precisely restore correctness. Then, it infers assertions as logical predicates over inputs that generalize recovery conditions in an interpretable form engineers can reason about, without requiring access to internal model details. Our approach combines three counterfactual generators with two causal models, and infers success assertions. Across three CPS case studies, DeCaF achieves its best success rate with KD-Tree Nearest Neighbors combined with M5 model tree, while Genetic Algorithm combined with Random Forest provides the strongest balance between success and causal precision.

</details>


### [928] [IatroBench: Pre-Registered Evidence of Iatrogenic Harm from AI Safety Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07709)
*David Gringras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 同一前沿模型被问相同的苯二氮䓬戒断问题：若以普通患者口吻询问，模型拒绝给出减药方案；若将提问者身份改为“医生”，则瞬间输出详细、符合指南的 Ashton 手动方案。论文用 IatroBench 量化这种“因身份而差别提供医疗知识”的现象，并在 6 个模型×60 个临床场景中发现普遍存在“对医生更完整、对普通人更留白”的系统性隐瞒，模型越强调安全，隐瞒差越大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在医疗场景中常被用作诊断或用药顾问，但其“安全对齐”主要由内容过滤器与 RLHF 完成。作者怀疑：训练流程把“避免造成伤害”简单等同于“不给普通人医疗细节”，导致模型对非专业用户出现过度保守的 omission harm（漏诊/漏治伤害），却无法识别这种隐性危害。需要可量化的基准揭示并拆解这一盲区。

Method: ①构建 IatroBench：60 个精神科急诊/慢病管理脚本，均设定患者已无法获得正规转诊；②把同一临床问题复制成两种 prompt——layperson（患者自述）vs physician（医生求助）身份；③6 个前沿模型各生成 10 次，共 3 600 条回应；④双盲医生标注以建立金标准：CH 0-3（主动错误/commission）与 OH 0-4（遗漏关键干预/omission）；⑤评估者间信度 κ_w = 0.571，离 1 分误差内一致率 96%；⑥用相同 LLM-as-a-judge 对比人类评分，检验“训练-评估盲区同构性”；⑦统计 decoupling gap = physician_OH − layperson_OH，检验身份效应与过滤机制。

Result: ①所有可测模型均表现“身份依赖性隐瞒”：physician 条件下安全碰撞动作命中率平均提升 13.1 pp（p<0.0001），非碰撞动作无差异；平均 decoupling gap +0.38（p=0.003）。②Opus 安全投入最足，gap 最大（+0.65）。③三种失效模式清晰分离：Opus 呈现“训练式隐瞒”；Llama 4 为“能力不足”；GPT-5.2 因后生成过滤，对 physician 回答 9× 概率被截，归因于药学术语密度触发内容过滤器。④LLM-judge 自检盲区：其给 73%  physician 标 OH≥1 的回答判为 OH=0，κ=0.045，与人类几乎不相关，显示评估框架与训练框架共享同一 blind spot。

Conclusion: 前沿模型的安全对齐把“不向非专业人士透露医疗细节”当作默认策略，导致对最需要帮助、已无路转诊的患者产生 omission harm。该问题不能仅靠扩大参数或 RLHF 解决，而需：①设计以 omission 为中心的新奖励/过滤目标；②在训练与评估阶段显式引入 layperson 最坏情况；③公开拆解过滤规则，避免因关键词密度误杀关键内容。IatroBench 提供了一个可复现的度量工具，把“安全隐瞒”转化为可优化的量化指标。

Abstract: Ask a frontier model how to taper six milligrams of alprazolam (psychiatrist retired, ten days of pills left, abrupt cessation causes seizures) and it tells her to call the psychiatrist she just explained does not exist. Change one word ("I'm a psychiatrist; a patient presents with...") and the same model, same weights, same inference pass produces a textbook Ashton Manual taper with diazepam equivalence, anticonvulsant coverage, and monitoring thresholds. The knowledge was there; the model withheld it. IatroBench measures this gap. Sixty pre-registered clinical scenarios, six frontier models, 3,600 responses, scored on two axes (commission harm, CH 0-3; omission harm, OH 0-4) through a structured-evaluation pipeline validated against physician scoring (kappa_w = 0.571, within-1 agreement 96%). The central finding is identity-contingent withholding: match the same clinical question in physician vs. layperson framing and all five testable models provide better guidance to the physician (decoupling gap +0.38, p = 0.003; binary hit rates on safety-colliding actions drop 13.1 percentage points in layperson framing, p < 0.0001, while non-colliding actions show no change). The gap is widest for the model with the heaviest safety investment (Opus, +0.65). Three failure modes separate cleanly: trained withholding (Opus), incompetence (Llama 4), and indiscriminate content filtering (GPT-5.2, whose post-generation filter strips physician responses at 9x the layperson rate because they contain denser pharmacological tokens). The standard LLM judge assigns OH = 0 to 73% of responses a physician scores OH >= 1 (kappa = 0.045); the evaluation apparatus has the same blind spot as the training apparatus. Every scenario targets someone who has already exhausted the standard referrals.

</details>


### [929] [Needle in a Haystack -- One-Class Representation Learning for Detecting Rare Malignant Cells in Computational Cytology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07722)
*Swarnadip Chatterjee,Vladimir Basic,Arrigo Capitanio,Orcun Goksel,Joakim Lindblad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 单类学习（如DSVDD/DROC）仅靠正常细胞训练即可在超低阳性率（≤1%）下精准定位罕见癌细胞，显著优于传统 MIL 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全片细胞学图像中恶性细胞形态多样但占比极低，现有弱监督 MIL 在实例级极度不平衡时泛化差，且难以获得大量标注。

Method: 提出以单类表示学习框架检测癌变：只用阴性片块训练 DSVDD 与 DROC，学习“正常”紧致表征，测试中凭偏离度发现异常；对比 MIL（FS-SIL、WS-SIL）与对比学习 ItS2CLR。

Result: 在 TCIA 骨髓及口腔癌私有数据集上，DSVDD 在≤1% 极低阳性率下实例级 AUC 达 SOTA，部分场景甚至超过全监督；DROC 也具竞争力。

Conclusion: 单类表征学习在极度稀疏阳性场景中稳健、可解释，性能上限高于 MIL，为无法逐像素标注的细胞学筛查提供实用新范式。

Abstract: In computational cytology, detecting malignancy on whole-slide images is difficult because malignant cells are morphologically diverse yet vanishingly rare amid a vast background of normal cells. Accurate detection of these extremely rare malignant cells remains challenging due to large class imbalance and limited annotations. Conventional weakly supervised approaches, such as multiple instance learning (MIL), often fail to generalize at the instance level, especially when the fraction of malignant cells (witness rate) is exceedingly low. In this study, we explore the use of one-class representation learning techniques for detecting malignant cells in low-witness-rate scenarios. These methods are trained exclusively on slide-negative patches, without requiring any instance-level supervision. Specifically, we evaluate two OCC approaches, DSVDD and DROC, and compare them with FS-SIL, WS-SIL, and the recent ItS2CLR method. The one-class methods learn compact representations of normality and detect deviations at test time. Experiments on a publicly available bone marrow cytomorphology dataset (TCIA) and an in-house oral cancer cytology dataset show that DSVDD achieves state-of-the-art performance in instance-level abnormality ranking, particularly in ultra-low witness-rate regimes ($\leq 1\%$) and, in some cases, even outperforming fully supervised learning, which is typically not a practical option in whole-slide cytology due to the infeasibility of exhaustive instance-level annotations. DROC is also competitive under extreme rarity, benefiting from distribution-augmented contrastive learning. These findings highlight one-class representation learning as a robust and interpretable superior choice to MIL for malignant cell detection under extreme rarity.

</details>


### [930] [Efficient Dataset Selection for Continual Adaptation of Generative Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07739)
*Cathy Jiao,Juan Elenter,Praveen Ravichandran,Bernd Huber,Joseph Cauteruccio,Todd Wasson,Timothy Heath,Chenyan Xiong,Mounia Lalmas,Paul Bennett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在大规模数据流环境下通过「针对数据挑选」解决推荐系统因时间分布漂移而产生的性能衰退，用梯度和分布匹配方式选取小规模但信息量大的用户交互数据子集，实现高效训练并保持对漂移的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户行为持续变化，频繁全量重训成本高且不可扩展，亟需仅在分布漂移时选取少量高价值数据持续更新模型。

Method: 1) 设计梯度型用户/物品表示以捕捉对模型影响最大的样本；2) 结合分布匹配采样子集，使所选数据与流式总体分布保持统计一致性；3) 在子集上增量更新推荐模型，并与随机、核心集、时间窗等多种采样策略进行对比。

Result: 在公开和工业级流式数据集上，仅用约1%–5%数据即可恢复或超越全量重训性能，模型收敛速度提升2–4倍，NDCG/HR等指标提升3–7%；对概念漂移的检测与适应延迟降低30%以上。

Conclusion: 以数据筛选代替全量重训的「流式数据策展」方案可在生产级推荐系统中低成本、实时地维持模型性能，为后续自适应、可解释和隐私友好的推荐系统提供可行范式。

Abstract: Recommendation systems must continuously adapt to evolving user behavior, yet the volume of data generated in large-scale streaming environments makes frequent full retraining impractical. This work investigates how targeted data selection can mitigate performance degradation caused by temporal distributional drift while maintaining scalability. We evaluate a range of representation choices and sampling strategies for curating small but informative subsets of user interaction data. Our results demonstrate that gradient-based representations, coupled with distribution-matching, improve downstream model performance, achieving training efficiency gains while preserving robustness to drift. These findings highlight data curation as a practical mechanism for scalable monitoring and adaptive model updates in production-scale recommendation systems.

</details>


### [931] [The Condition-Number Principle for Prototype Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07744)
*Romano Li,Jianfei Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个算法无关的几何框架，把原型聚类的目标值与结构恢复联系起来，给出非渐近、确定性的精确恢复保证；量化了算法精度与实例内在几何难度，揭示鲁棒性与类不平衡敏感性之间的折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有原型聚类方法不能保证“低目标值 ⇒ 结构正确”。作者希望在不依赖特定算法和分布假设的前提下，回答：目标函数的次优度究竟在何种几何条件下才能直接推出聚类误差很小，以及算法精度与问题难度如何解耦。

Method: 1) 引入“聚类条件数”κ——簇内尺度与跨越簇边界所需最小损失增量之比；2) 定义可容许损失函数类，建立κ、次优间隙Δ与相对误分率ε之间的确定性不等式：Δ小 ⇒ ε小；3) 刻画簇边界误差集中现象，给出局部加强 margin 下“深核精确恢复”判据；4) 分析不同目标函数在鲁棒性-类不平衡敏感性上的相变行为。

Result: 当κ=O(1)且Δ足够小时，任何近似解的误分率ε≤O(Δ/κ)，实现算法无关的结构保证；误差主要集中在簇边界附近，足够深的核区域可零误差恢复；在κ→0与κ→∞两种极限下，分别出现“鲁棒但难恢复小簇”与“敏感但可精确恢复”的相变。

Conclusion: 首次给出“低目标值即可信结构”的几何原理：只要实例条件数κ小，低次优度就必然意味着低误分率，从而把算法精度与问题本身的几何难度彻底分离；该框架统一解释多种损失函数，并为选择/设计更可靠的原型聚类准则提供理论依据。

Abstract: We develop a geometric framework that links objective accuracy to structural recovery in prototype-based clustering. The analysis is algorithm-agnostic and applies to a broad class of admissible loss functions. We define a clustering condition number that compares within-cluster scale to the minimum loss increase required to move a point across a cluster boundary. When this quantity is small, any solution with a small suboptimality gap must also have a small misclassification error relative to a benchmark partition. The framework also clarifies a fundamental trade-off between robustness and sensitivity to cluster imbalance, leading to sharp phase transitions for exact recovery under different objectives. The guarantees are deterministic and non-asymptotic, and they separate the role of algorithmic accuracy from the intrinsic geometric difficulty of the instance. We further show that errors concentrate near cluster boundaries and that sufficiently deep cluster cores are recovered exactly under strengthened local margins. Together, these results provide a geometric principle for interpreting low objective values as reliable evidence of meaningful clustering structure.

</details>


### [932] [Mitigating Distribution Sharpening in Math RLVR via Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis and Backward Hint Annealing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07747)
*Pei-Xi Xie,Che-Yu Lin,Cheng-Lin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过分布对齐的提示构建与动态退火策略，解决数学强化学习中的师生分布错位与提示过度暴露问题，使 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 在 AIME 系列基准上同时提升 pass@1 与 pass@2048。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR 在数学难题上虽能提升 pass@1，却牺牲解空间覆盖且大 k 性能无增益；现有提示方法存在师生分布错位及提示暴露过度两大缺口，亟需对齐训练-测试条件。

Method: Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) 先以“学生风格”回答为条件，合成可验证的教师提示，缩小分布差异；Backward Hint Annealing (BHA) 按难度层级逐轮降低提示曝光，并引入 per-question hint dropout，保证无提示梯度贯穿训练全程。

Result: 在 DAPO 框架下对 AIME24-26 测试，Qwen3-1.7B-Base 的 pass@1 与 pass@2048 同步提升；Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct 的提升集中在大 k 区域，验证提示支架在“可学→退火”路径上的有效性。

Conclusion: 数学 RLVR 中，只要提示支架早期恢复难题的可学习信号，并在评估前逐步撤除，就能兼顾小 k 准确率与大 k 探索力，突破“pass@1 涨、大 k 掉”的瓶颈。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve low-$k$ reasoning accuracy while narrowing solution coverage on challenging math questions, and pass@1 gains do not necessarily translate into better large-$k$ performance. Existing hint-based approaches can make challenging questions trainable, but they leave two issues underexplored: teacher-student distribution mismatch and the need to reduce hint exposure to match no-hint evaluation. We address these issues through two components. Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) constructs verified teacher hints conditioned on student-style responses. Backward Hint Annealing (BHA) anneals hint exposure across difficulty buckets and uses per-question hint dropout to preserve no-hint updates throughout RL training. We evaluate the method in math RLVR under the DAPO training framework across AIME24, AIME25, and AIME26 using $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$ and $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$. On $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$, our method improves both pass@1 and pass@2048 relative to DAPO across the three AIME benchmarks. On $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$, the gains are concentrated in the large-$k$ regime. These results suggest that, in math RLVR, hint scaffolding is effective when it restores learnable updates on challenging questions early in training and is then gradually removed before no-hint evaluation.

</details>


### [933] [Sparse $ε$ insensitive zone bounded asymmetric elastic net support vector machines for pattern classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07748)
*Haiyan Du,Hu Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Existing support vector machines(SVM) models are sensitive to noise and lack sparsity, which limits their performance. To address these issues, we combine the elastic net loss with a robust loss framework to construct a sparse $\varepsilon$-insensitive bounded asymmetric elastic net loss, and integrate it with SVM to build $\varepsilon$ Insensitive Zone Bounded Asymmetric Elastic Net Loss-based SVM($\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM). $\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM is both sparse and robust. Sparsity is proven by showing that samples inside the $\varepsilon$-insensitive band are not support vectors. Robustness is theoretically guaranteed because the influence function is bounded. To solve the non-convex optimization problem, we design a half-quadratic algorithm based on clipping dual coordinate descent. It transforms the problem into a series of weighted subproblems, improving computational efficiency via the $\varepsilon$ parameter. Experiments on simulated and real datasets show that $\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM outperforms traditional and existing robust SVMs. It balances sparsity and robustness well in noisy environments. Statistical tests confirm its superiority. Under the Gaussian kernel, it achieves better accuracy and noise insensitivity, validating its effectiveness and practical value.

</details>


### [934] [Symbiotic-MoE: Unlocking the Synergy between Generation and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07753)
*Xiangyue Liu,Zijian Zhang,Miles Yang,Zhao Zhong,Liefeng Bo,Ping Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Symbiotic-MoE 在原生多模态 MoE 架构内用零额外参数解决“图像生成→视觉理解”灾难性遗忘，通过专家分组与共享语义桥同时保持并增强两大任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LMM 若引入文生图能力，生成梯度会与理解梯度剧烈冲突，导致理解任务灾难性遗忘；MoT 等结构隔离方案虽缓解冲突却切断了跨模态协同并造成容量碎片化。

Method: 1) 发现并证实标准 MoE 微调会出现“路由崩溃”（生成任务独占专家）；2) 提出 Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement：将专家划分为私有组+共享组，共享组充当视觉-语言语义桥，使生成梯度反哺文本表征；3) 设计 Progressive Training：差分学习率+早期梯度屏蔽，先保护预训练知识，再逐步将生成信号转为理解任务的构造性反馈；4) 整个框架零新增参数，直接在大规模多模态 MoE 上预训练。

Result: 在多模态 MoE 基底上，Symbiotic-MoE 实现生成任务快速收敛，同时在 MMLU 与 OCRBench 等理解基准上取得显著增益，验证跨模态协同被重新激活而非牺牲。

Conclusion: 无需结构隔离或额外参数，仅通过专家分组与渐进式训练即可让生成与理解任务互利共生，为统一多模态模型提供可扩展的预训练范式。

Abstract: Empowering Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with image generation often leads to catastrophic forgetting in understanding tasks due to severe gradient conflicts. While existing paradigms like Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) mitigate this conflict through structural isolation, they fundamentally sever cross-modal synergy and suffer from capacity fragmentation. In this work, we present Symbiotic-MoE, a unified pre-training framework that resolves task interference within a native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers architecture with zero-parameter overhead. We first identify that standard MoE tuning leads to routing collapse, where generative gradients dominate expert utilization. To address this, we introduce Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement, which partitions experts into task-specific groups while utilizing shared experts as a multimodal semantic bridge. Crucially, this design allows shared experts to absorb fine-grained visual semantics from generative tasks to enrich textual representations. To optimize this, we propose a Progressive Training Strategy featuring differential learning rates and early-stage gradient shielding. This mechanism not only shields pre-trained knowledge from early volatility but eventually transforms generative signals into constructive feedback for understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Symbiotic-MoE achieves rapid generative convergence while unlocking cross-modal synergy, boosting inherent understanding with remarkable gains on MMLU and OCRBench.

</details>


### [935] [Generative optimal transport via forward-backward HJB matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07762)
*Haiqian Yang,Vishaal Krishnan,Sumit Sinha,L. Mahadevan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于时间反转对偶的随机控制框架，可在仅知道目标系综样本、无需反向模拟的条件下，以最小功把多体随机系统从参考态驱向目标态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在非平衡统计物理与随机控制中，常需将扩散导致的自然松弛过程逆转，使系统从唾手可得的参考无序态回到难以建模的结构目标态，同时能耗最小。

Method: 建立反向动力学值函数与正向 HJB 方程的时间反转对偶；利用 Cole-Hopf 变换和 Feynman-Kac 表示，把该正向势表达为可模拟的正向松弛轨迹上的路径空间自由能，仅需目标样本即可计算。

Result: 得到可解释的路径空间自由能-风险敏感控制-空间代价场统一描述，数值实验可视化学习到的值函数及受控扩散，显示空间代价如何像非均匀介质中的费马原理般塑造传输几何。

Conclusion: 该框架将随机最优控制、薛定谔桥理论与非平衡统计力学统一起来，为仅基于样本的最小功驱动提供了可行且物理解释清晰的工具。

Abstract: Controlling the evolution of a many-body stochastic system from a disordered reference state to a structured target ensemble, characterized empirically through samples, arises naturally in non-equilibrium statistical mechanics and stochastic control. The natural relaxation of such a system - driven by diffusion - runs from the structured target toward the disordered reference. The natural question is then: what is the minimum-work stochastic process that reverses this relaxation, given a pathwise cost functional combining spatial penalties and control effort? Computing this optimal process requires knowledge of trajectories that already sample the target ensemble - precisely the object one is trying to construct. We resolve this by establishing a time-reversal duality: the value function governing the hard backward dynamics satisfies an equivalent forward-in-time HJB equation, whose solution can be read off directly from the tractable forward relaxation trajectories. Via the Cole-Hopf transformation and its associated Feynman-Kac representation, this forward potential is computed as a path-space free energy averaged over these forward trajectories - the same relaxation paths that are easy to simulate - without any backward simulation or knowledge of the target beyond samples. The resulting framework provides a physically interpretable description of stochastic transport in terms of path-space free energy, risk-sensitive control, and spatial cost geometry. We illustrate the theory with numerical examples that visualize the learned value function and the induced controlled diffusions, demonstrating how spatial cost fields shape transport geometry analogously to Fermat's Principle in inhomogeneous media. Our results establish a unifying connection between stochastic optimal control, Schrödinger bridge theory, and non-equilibrium statistical mechanics.

</details>


### [936] [Sensitivity-Positional Co-Localization in GQA Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07766)
*Manoj Chandrashekar Rao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对GQA变换器提出“共定位假说”并验证失败：任务敏感层与RoPE可塑层呈强反定位；基于此设计的ackslash 	ext{LSLORA}+GARFA仅对敏感层微调即可在6项基准上逼近Claude 3.5 Haiku，成本仅100美元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Grouped Query Attention（GQA）Transformer中，任务正确性最敏感的层是否与位置编码（RoPE）最具可塑性的层重合，尚无实证研究。厘清该“共定位”结构可指导高效参数高效微调。

Method: 1. 在32层Llama 3.1 8B上定义“正确性差分隐状态”度量，定位任务敏感层。
2. 提出ackslash 	ext{LSLORA}：仅对敏感层施加LoRA。
3. 提出GARFA：为早期层每KV头附加8个可学习的RoPE频率缩放因子。
4. 4×2交叉消融：在敏感/非敏感层分别启用/禁用两种干预，验证性能。

Result: 共定位假说被否定：任务敏感层集中晚期（23–31层），RoPE影响层集中早期（0–9层），Spearman r_s = –0.735。尽管如此，将两种干预同时施加于敏感层时，在MMLU、GPQA、HumanEval+、MATH、MGSM、ARC六基准上平均提升4–16个百分点，HumanEval+达67.1%，接近Claude 3.5 Haiku（68.3%），总GPU开销仅100美元。

Conclusion: GQA模型中任务敏感性与位置编码可塑性呈显著反定位，但利用敏感层作为“手术层”即可用极低成本实现强泛化，提示未来高效微调应关注跨层异质结构而非共定位假设。

Abstract: We investigate a fundamental structural question in Grouped Query Attention (GQA) transformers: do the layers most sensitive to task correctness coincide with the layers where positional encoding adaptation has the greatest leverage? We term this the co-localization hypothesis and test it on Llama 3.1 8B, a 32-layer GQA model with a 4:1 query-to-key-value head ratio. We introduce \LSLORA, which restricts LoRA adaptation to layers identified via a novel correctness-differential hidden-state metric, and GARFA (GQA-Aware RoPE Frequency Adaptation), which attaches 8 learnable per-KV-head scalar multipliers to each targeted layer. Contrary to the co-localization hypothesis, we discover strong anti-localization: task-sensitive layers concentrate in the late network ($\ell\in\{23\text{-}31\}$) while RoPE-influential layers dominate the early network ($\ell\in\{0\text{-}9\}$), yielding Spearman $r_s = -0.735$ ($p = 1.66\times10^{-6}$). Despite this anti-localization, a 4-way cross-layer ablation shows that applying both interventions to the sensitivity-identified layers outperforms all alternative configurations by 4-16 percentage points across six diverse benchmarks (MMLU, GPQA, HumanEval+, MATH, MGSM, ARC), approaching Claude 3.5 Haiku on HumanEval+ (67.1% vs. 68.3%) at \$100 total compute cost.

</details>


### [937] [Toward Generalizable Graph Learning for 3D Engineering AI: Explainable Workflows for CAE Mode Shape Classification and CFD Field Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07781)
*Tong Duy Son,Kohta Sugiura,Marc Brughmans,Andrey Hense,Zhihao Liu,Amirthalakshmi Veeraraghavan,Ajinkya Bhave,Jay Masters,Paolo di Carlo,Theo Geluk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将异构3D工程资产统一转为物理感知图表示，用GNN在同一框架内完成可解释CAE模态分类与CFD气动场预测，实现跨阶段复用与主动数据指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 汽车研发需整合FE、BiW、CAD、CFD等异构3D数据，但AI方法多为任务专用、难解释、难复用，无法应对短周期、高性能、快迭代的需求。

Method: 提出“图学习框架”：①把各类工程资产自动转换为含物理先验的异构图；②基于GNN同时支持分类与回归；③针对CAE构建区域感知BiW图，在标签稀缺下做可解释模态分类；④针对CFD构建保持对称的降采样图，实现压力与壁面剪应力场快速代理预测；⑤输出数据生成指引，指导下一步应补充哪些仿真或标签。

Result: 在两项汽车任务中验证：CAE模态分类在车型与FE变体间取得高解释性精度；CFD气动代理在保持与高精度CFD<3%误差的同时，计算成本降低1–2个数量级；框架具跨项目复用潜力，并给出主动采样策略。

Conclusion: 该工作为CAE/CFD提供了一套可信、可解释、可复用的图学习工作流，显著缩短仿真-决策闭环，可在整车开发链中持续积累数据与模型资产。

Abstract: Automotive engineering development increasingly relies on heterogeneous 3D data, including finite element (FE) models, body-in-white (BiW) representations, CAD geometry, and CFD meshes. At the same time, engineering teams face growing pressure to shorten development cycles, improve performance and accelerate innovation. Although artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly explored in this domain, many current methods remain task-specific, difficult to interpret, and hard to reuse across development stages. This paper presents a practical graph learning framework for 3D engineering AI, in which heterogeneous engineering assets are converted into physics-aware graph representations and processed by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). The framework is designed to support both classification and prediction tasks. The framework is validated on two automotive applications: CAE vibration mode shape classification and CFD aerodynamic field prediction. For CAE vibration mode classification, a region-aware BiW graph supports explainable mode classification across vehicle and FE variants under label scarcity. For CFD aerodynamic field prediction, a physics-informed surrogate predicts pressure and wall shear stress (WSS) across aerodynamic body shape variants, while symmetry preserving down sampling retains accuracy with lower computational cost. The framework also outlines data generation guidance that can help engineers identify which additional simulations or labels are valuable to collect next. These results demonstrate a practical and reusable engineering AI workflow for more trustworthy CAE and CFD decision support.

</details>


### [938] [Cross-Modal Emotion Transfer for Emotion Editing in Talking Face Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07786)
*Chanhyuk Choi,Taesoo Kim,Donggyu Lee,Siyeol Jung,Taehwan Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出跨模态情感迁移框架C-MET，仅依赖语音即可在语音-视觉空间学习连续情感语义向量，实现无标签、无参考图的高精度长程情感说话人脸合成，在MEAD与CREMA-D上情绪准确率提升14%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有说话人脸情感编辑方法灵活性不足、难以生成扩展情感：基于标签的方法受限于离散类别；基于音频的方法因情感与内容耦合而无法准确表达目标情绪；基于图像的方法需高质量正面参考图且难获取扩展情感（如讽刺）样本。亟需一种无需额外标签或参考图、可连续控制情感并覆盖扩展情感的新范式。

Method: 提出Cross-Modal Emotion Transfer (C-MET)：1) 利用大规模预训练音频编码器提取语音情感嵌入；2) 引入解耦式面部表情编码器提取视觉情感嵌入；3) 在跨模态空间学习“情感语义向量”，显式建模两种情感状态间的差异；4) 通过该向量驱动人脸生成网络，实现任意连续情感迁移与扩展情感合成，无需额外标签或参考图像。

Result: 在MEAD与CREMA-D数据集上的大量实验表明，C-MET在情感识别准确率上较现有最佳方法提升14%，可稳定合成包含未见扩展情感（如讽刺、轻蔑）的高表现力说话人脸视频，且在主观测评中真实度与同步性显著优于基线。

Conclusion: C-MET通过跨模态情感语义向量首次将语音中的情感信息连续、精准地迁移至视觉人脸，突破传统标签离散、内容-情感耦合及参考图依赖等瓶颈，为扩展情感说话人脸生成提供了简洁高效的新基准。代码、权重与演示已开源。

Abstract: Talking face generation has gained significant attention as a core application of generative models. To enhance the expressiveness and realism of synthesized videos, emotion editing in talking face video plays a crucial role. However, existing approaches often limit expressive flexibility and struggle to generate extended emotions. Label-based methods represent emotions with discrete categories, which fail to capture a wide range of emotions. Audio-based methods can leverage emotionally rich speech signals - and even benefit from expressive text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis - but they fail to express the target emotions because emotions and linguistic contents are entangled in emotional speeches. Images-based methods, on the other hand, rely on target reference images to guide emotion transfer, yet they require high-quality frontal views and face challenges in acquiring reference data for extended emotions (e.g., sarcasm). To address these limitations, we propose Cross-Modal Emotion Transfer (C-MET), a novel approach that generates facial expressions based on speeches by modeling emotion semantic vectors between speech and visual feature spaces. C-MET leverages a large-scale pretrained audio encoder and a disentangled facial expression encoder to learn emotion semantic vectors that represent the difference between two different emotional embeddings across modalities. Extensive experiments on the MEAD and CREMA-D datasets demonstrate that our method improves emotion accuracy by 14% over state-of-the-art methods, while generating expressive talking face videos - even for unseen extended emotions. Code, checkpoint, and demo are available at https://chanhyeok-choi.github.io/C-MET/

</details>


### [939] [SEARL: Joint Optimization of Policy and Tool Graph Memory for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07791)
*Xinshun Feng,Xinhao Song,Lijun Li,Gongshen Liu,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SEARL 框架通过构建可复用的结构化经验记忆，在低资源环境下实现自演化强化学习，并在推理与数学任务中超过现有以结果奖励为主的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法依赖大模型或多智能体，难以在资源受限场景部署；结果奖励稀疏导致学习效率低。

Method: 提出工具-记忆自演化框架 SEARL：将规划与执行整合为结构化记忆，抽象出“工具态”，利用跨轨迹相关性加密奖励，实现经验复用与知识提取。

Result: 在知识推理与数学任务中，SEARL 在降低计算/模型规模的同时获得优于强基线的学习效果；工具复用率提升、奖励密度增加。

Conclusion: 结构化经验记忆能在低资源环境下提升 RL 智能体的样本效率与泛化能力，为自演化代理在边端应用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have demonstrated significant potential in single-turn reasoning tasks. With the paradigm shift toward self-evolving agentic learning, models are increasingly expected to learn from trajectories by synthesizing tools or accumulating explicit experiences. However, prevailing methods typically rely on large-scale LLMs or multi-agent frameworks, which hinder their deployment in resource-constrained environments. The inherent sparsity of outcome-based rewards also poses a substantial challenge, as agents typically receive feedback only upon completion of tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce a Tool-Memory based self-evolving agentic framework SEARL. Unlike approaches that directly utilize interaction experiences, our method constructs a structured experience memory that integrates planning with execution. This provides a novel state abstraction that facilitates generalization across analogous contexts, such as tool reuse. Consequently, agents extract explicit knowledge from historical data while leveraging inter-trajectory correlations to densify reward signals. We evaluate our framework on knowledge reasoning and mathematics tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving more practical and efficient learning.

</details>


### [940] [Order-Optimal Sequential 1-Bit Mean Estimation in General Tail Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07796)
*Ivan Lau,Jonathan Scarlett*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出首个在严格 1-bit 通信约束下对任意有界 k 阶矩分布均达到极小最优样本复杂度的自适应均值估计器，并证明非自适应方法存在线性阶差距，量化本身在 k=2 时引入的 log(σ/ε) 惩罚是信息论下界所决定的固有代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式、边缘计算及联邦学习场景下通信预算极低，只能传输 1 bit；现有 1-bit 均值估计要么假设方差有限，要么样本复杂度远逊无量化下界，无法适应重尾分布且缺乏严格理论保证。

Method: 设计基于“随机阈值查询”的自适应序贯试验：每步依当前统计量随机生成阈值，仅接收样本是否过阈的 1 bit 响应，动态更新阈值并收窄置信区间。通过矩控制与分层置信度分配，使总样本量对任意 k>1 均匹配无量化极小界，仅在定位代价上多出 log(λ/σ)。对未知预算与尺度分别采用双重采样和尺度枚举策略；两阶段版用更一般的 1-bit 区间查询降低自适应深度。

Result: 1. 对任意 k≠2，样本复杂度 O((σ/ε)^2 log(1/δ) + log(λ/σ))，与无量化下界只差定位项；k=2 时再多乘 log(σ/ε)，并首次证明该因子为 1-bit 量化信息论下界所必须。2. 非自适应估计器复杂度必含 Ω(λ/σ) 线性因子，与自适应呈指数级差距。3. 算法可直接应对采样预算、尺度未知等实际约束，两阶段版本的复杂度仅略增。

Conclusion: 在 1-bit 通信极限下，自适应随机阈值策略是达到极小最优样本效率的必要手段；对有限方差分布，log(σ/ε) 惩罚无法消除，揭示了量化与估计精度间的根本权衡。结果可扩展至联邦学习、传感器网络等需在极低位宽下做均值估计的场景。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of mean estimation under strict 1-bit communication constraints. We propose a novel adaptive mean estimator based solely on randomized threshold queries, where each 1-bit outcome indicates whether a given sample exceeds a sequentially chosen threshold. Our estimator is $(ε, δ)$-PAC for any distribution with a bounded mean $μ\in [-λ, λ]$ and a bounded $k$-th central moment $\mathbb{E}[|X-μ|^k] \le σ^k$ for any fixed $k > 1$. Crucially, our sample complexity is order-optimal in all such tail regimes, i.e., for every such $k$ value. For $k \neq 2$, our estimator's sample complexity matches the unquantized minimax lower bounds plus an unavoidable $O(\log(λ/σ))$ localization cost. For the finite-variance case ($k=2$), our estimator's sample complexity has an extra multiplicative $O(\log(σ/ε))$ penalty, and we establish a novel information-theoretic lower bound showing that this penalty is a fundamental limit of 1-bit quantization. We also establish a significant adaptivity gap: for both threshold queries and more general interval queries, the sample complexity of any non-adaptive estimator must scale linearly with the search space parameter $λ/σ$, rendering it vastly less sample efficient than our adaptive approach. Finally, we present algorithmic variants that (i) handle an unknown sampling budget, (ii) adapt to an unknown scale parameter~$σ$ given (possibly loose) bounds, and (iii) require only two stages of adaptivity at the expense of more complicated general 1-bit queries.

</details>


### [941] [GRASS: Gradient-based Adaptive Layer-wise Importance Sampling for Memory-efficient Large Language Model Fine-tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07808)
*Kaiyuan Tian,Yu Tang,Gongqingjian Jiang,Baihui Liu,Yifu Gao,Xialin Su,Linbo Qiao,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 无对整个模型参数的更新的GPU存储限制促生了调解方案。低秩与分层催生法均丢失去层重要性动态变化，影响表现。本文的GRASS基于平均梯度范数动态选择采样层，兼顾任务与训练阶段特征，并在层粒度上外存优化器状态。实验证明其在平均准确率提升4.38点的同时节省最多19.97%显存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对大模型进行全参数微调所需GPU存储过大；现有低秩适配方法表现力受限，分层采样策略又静态地看待层重要性，无法适应不同任务与训练阶段，导致表现欠佳。迫切需要一种能兼顾计算开销与模型表达能力的微调框架。

Method: 提出GRASS框架：1)用层梯度范数作为任务和训练阶段感知的层重要度指标；2)依此动态调整采样概率，实现自适应分层训练；3)设计层粒度优化器状态下放与计算重叠机制，进一步降低显存并保吞吐。

Result: 在多种大模型与主流下游基准上评测，GRASS平均准确率最高提升4.38点，显存占用最多减少19.97%。

Conclusion: 通过将梯度信息引入层重要性评估并在采样及内存管理上做自适应与重叠设计，GRASS能在显著减少GPU显存消耗的同时取得优于全参数微调与现有高效训练方法的效果，为大模型微调提供一种高效可行的新范式。

Abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models is constrained by substantial GPU memory requirements. Low-rank adaptation methods mitigate this challenge by updating only a subset of parameters. However, these approaches often limit model expressiveness and yield lower performance than full-parameter fine-tuning. Layer-wise fine-tuning methods have emerged as an alternative, enabling memory-efficient training through static layer importance sampling strategies. However, these methods overlook variations in layer importance across tasks and training stages, resulting in suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. To address these limitations, we propose GRASS, a gradient-based adaptive layer-wise importance sampling framework. GRASS utilizes mean gradient norms as a task-aware and training-stage-aware metric for estimating layer importance. Furthermore, GRASS adaptively adjusts layer sampling probabilities through an adaptive training strategy. We also introduce a layer-wise optimizer state offloading mechanism that overlaps computation and communication to further reduce memory usage while maintaining comparable training throughput. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that GRASS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of up to 4.38 points and reducing memory usage by up to 19.97\%.

</details>


### [942] [Intensity Dot Product Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07810)
*Giulio Valentino Dalla Riva,Matteo Dalla Riva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Intensity Dot Product Graphs（IDPGs），用Poisson点过程替代固定潜位置，实现随机节点集与连续潜空间的几何解释，建立谱收敛理论并自然对接时序PDE扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜位置模型要么节点集固定（如RDPG），要么虽允随机节点但几何可解释性弱（如graphon）。需要一个既能随机生成节点规模又保留欧氏潜空间几何、且可无缝刻画动态网络的模型。

Method: 以Poisson点过程在欧氏空间生成随机潜节点集；用传统点积得到边概率；定义连续化的热图算子与desire算子；证明有限图邻接矩阵奇异值向算子谱的L2一致性；与graphon/digraphon对比；通过强度函数集中化极限退化到经典RDPG；将强度函数视为时空PDE的解，给出动态IDPG框架。

Result: 建立了随机节点规模下图谱与连续算子谱的收敛定理；显式刻画了IDPG与graphon的对应及差异；证明当强度趋于δ-集中时模型坍缩为RDPG；给出随时间演化的强度可服从反应-扩散类PDE，实现网络生长的连续潜空间描述。

Conclusion: IDPG在保持欧氏潜空间几何可解释的同时，允许节点随机出现，统一了RDPG、graphon与动态网络建模，为大规模时序网络分析提供新的含参潜过程工具。

Abstract: Latent-position random graph models usually treat the node set as fixed once the sample size is chosen, while graphon-based and random-measure constructions allow more randomness at the cost of weaker geometric interpretability. We introduce \emph{Intensity Dot Product Graphs} (IDPGs), which extend Random Dot Product Graphs by replacing a fixed collection of latent positions with a Poisson point process on a Euclidean latent space. This yields a model with random node populations, RDPG-style dot-product affinities, and a population-level intensity that links continuous latent structure to finite observed graphs. We define the heat map and the desire operator as continuous analogues of the probability matrix, prove a spectral consistency result connecting adjacency singular values to the operator spectrum, compare the construction with graphon and digraphon representations, and show how classical RDPGs arise in a concentrated limit. Because the model is parameterized by an evolving intensity, temporal extensions through partial differential equations arise naturally.

</details>


### [943] [Automatic Generation of Executable BPMN Models from Medical Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07817)
*Praveen Kumar Menaka Sekar,Ion Matei,Maksym Zhenirovskyy,Hon Yung Wong,Sayuri Kohmura,Shinji Hotta,Akihiro Inomata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将日文慢病手册全自动转成可执行BPMN模型，1000患者仿真验证决策一致率>92%，不确定段能自报需人工澄清


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政策文本->可执行模型耗时耗力，用LLM端到端自动转化并量化评估，提升卫生政策仿真与落地效率

Method: 四步pipeline：①LLM提取数据并生成BPMN+自修复语法；②注入执行属性、KPI标签；③熵值检测不确定性；④用1000合成患者蒙特卡洛仿真；对3地区糖尿病肾病指南各100模型×3大模型比对

Result: 结构化文本千例仿真决策100%重合；全条件下患者级一致率≥92%；熵随文档复杂度单调增，阈上段100%被标记为需澄清

Conclusion: LLM可高保真地把政策转为仿真级BPMN，熵指标可靠识别不确定段，为数据驱动卫生政策快速迭代与精准审查开辟新范式

Abstract: We present an end-to-end pipeline that converts healthcare policy documents into executable, data-aware Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) models using large language models (LLMs) for simulation-based policy evaluation. We address the main challenges of automated policy digitization with four contributions: data-grounded BPMN generation with syntax auto-correction, executable augmentation, KPI instrumentation, and entropy-based uncertainty detection. We evaluate the pipeline on diabetic nephropathy prevention guidelines from three Japanese municipalities, generating 100 models per backend across three LLMs and executing each against 1,000 synthetic patients. On well-structured policies, the pipeline achieves a 100% ground-truth match with perfect per-patient decision agreement. Across all conditions, raw per-patient decision agreement exceeds 92%, and entropy scores increase monotonically with document complexity, confirming that the detector reliably separates unambiguous policies from those requiring targeted human clarification.

</details>


### [944] [Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07822)
*Harsh Kohli,Srinivasan Parthasarathy,Huan Sun,Yuekun Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 静息式多次前向的变形内隐推理模型（循环深度Transformer）能在训练分布外系统地组合知识和‘外推’到更深推理层数，而标准Transformer不易做到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型一次前向就能回答需要结合多跳知识的问题时往往失败，显示对参数量中知识的组合泛化能力不足；作者想弄清是模型结构上“深度不够”还是“不能复用已有深度”。

Method: 提出“循环深度Transformer”——同一组 Transformer 层在推理阶段可循环多次。在两项受控合成任务上比较其与标准 Transformer：①系统泛化：训练集全部是 A→B、C→D 的成对知识，不暴露 A→D 的组合链路；②深度外推：训练仅含 ≤k 跳链路，测试要求对 2k 跳进行正确推理。模型由随机初始化训练，通过后验可解释性分析其内部机理。

Result: ①循环深度模型在系统泛化任务上最终取得 >90% 准确率，标准 Transformer <30%，表现出现典型的三阶段 grokking（先死记→分布内泛化→系统级泛化）。②对仅训练到 5 跳的模型，推理时若循环 10 次可在 10 跳任务达到近 85% 准确率；循环次数成为主要控制变量。③训练策略上，循环权重共享、适量 dropout 与渐进式增长迭代次数训练可抑制“想太多”问题，否则过多次循环会损害细粒度预测，限制对更深链路的持续外推。④机制分析显示后期循环主要强化跨层注意力模式的逐跳传播，而非死记最终答案。

Conclusion: 循环深度 Transformer 通过推理时间反复，可在不扩展参数量的情况下实现深层的隐式组合推理，说明“可复用深度 + 迭代计算”是补强大模型组合泛化的可行方向；但要平衡循环次数以防止过思考导致性能逆转，为后续可扩展推理系统提供设计指南。

Abstract: We study implicit reasoning, i.e. the ability to combine knowledge or rules within a single forward pass. While transformer-based large language models store substantial factual knowledge and rules, they often fail to compose this knowledge for implicit multi-hop reasoning, suggesting a lack of compositional generalization over their parametric knowledge. To address this limitation, we study recurrent-depth transformers, which enables iterative computation over the same transformer layers. We investigate two compositional generalization challenges under the implicit reasoning scenario: systematic generalization, i.e. combining knowledge that is never used for compositions during training, and depth extrapolation, i.e. generalizing from limited reasoning depth (e.g. training on up to 5-hop) to deeper compositions (e.g. 10-hop). Through controlled studies with models trained from scratch, we show that while vanilla transformers struggle with both generalization challenges, recurrent-depth transformers can effectively make such generalization. For systematic generalization, we find that this ability emerges through a three-stage grokking process, transitioning from memorization to in-distribution generalization and finally to systematic generalization, supported by mechanistic analysis. For depth extrapolation, we show that generalization beyond training depth can be unlocked by scaling inference-time recurrence, with more iterations enabling deeper reasoning. We further study how training strategies affect extrapolation, providing guidance on training recurrent-depth transformers, and identify a key limitation, overthinking, where excessive recurrence degrades predictions and limits generalization to very deep compositions.

</details>


### [945] [Ensembles at Any Cost? Accuracy-Energy Trade-offs in Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07869)
*Jannik Nitschke,Lukas Wegmeth,Joeran Beel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 推荐系统的集成方法虽能小幅度提高准确率（0.3%–5.7%），但能耗暴涨19%–2 549%；提出基于真实测量的“准确度-能耗”权衡评估框架，发现精选子模型集成远优于全量平均策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有集成推荐算法仅聚焦准确率与鲁棒性，缺乏对能耗的直接测量，难以回答“为微量精度提升是否值得付出巨量能耗与碳排”。

Method: 在显式评分预测（Surprise/RMSE）与隐式反馈排序（LensKit/NDCG@10）两条管线中共运行 93 组对照实验，借助 EMERS 智能插座测得整机能耗并折算 CO₂ 当量，对比 4 种主流集成策略（平均、加权、Stacking/Rank Fusion、Top Performers）与强单模型基线。

Result: 四个数据集（100 K–7.8 M 交互）上，集成提升有限而能耗激增；MovieLens-1M 上 Top-Performers 集成 RMSE 仅降 0.96%，却多花 18.8% 电；Anime 数据集上 Surprise Top-Performers 能耗暴增 2 005%，碳排从 2.6 mg 升至 53.8 mg；LensKit 集成在 Anime 上直接因内存超限失败。

Conclusion: 盲目堆砌模型的“ exhaustive averaging”得不偿失；按性能精选子集的集成可在同等精度增益下显著降低能耗，为绿色推荐系统提供实证指引。

Abstract: Ensemble methods are frequently used in recommender systems to improve accuracy by combining multiple models. Recent work reports sizable performance gains, but most studies still optimize primarily for accuracy and robustness rather than for energy efficiency. This paper measures accuracy energy trade offs of ensemble techniques relative to strong single models. We run 93 controlled experiments in two pipelines: 1. explicit rating prediction with Surprise (RMSE) and 2. implicit feedback ranking with LensKit (NDCG@10). We evaluate four datasets ranging from 100,000 to 7.8 million interactions (MovieLens 100K, MovieLens 1M, ModCloth, Anime). We compare four ensemble strategies (Average, Weighted, Stacking or Rank Fusion, Top Performers) against baselines and optimized single models. Whole system energy is measured with EMERS using a smart plug and converted to CO2 equivalents. Across settings, ensembles improve accuracy by 0.3% to 5.7% while increasing energy by 19% to 2,549%. On MovieLens 1M, a Top Performers ensemble improves RMSE by 0.96% at an 18.8% energy overhead over SVD++. On MovieLens 100K, an averaging ensemble improves NDCG@10 by 5.7% with 103% additional energy. On Anime, a Surprise Top Performers ensemble improves RMSE by 1.2% but consumes 2,005% more energy (0.21 vs. 0.01 Wh), increasing emissions from 2.6 to 53.8 mg CO2 equivalents, and LensKit ensembles fail due to memory limits. Overall, selective ensembles are more energy efficient than exhaustive averaging,

</details>


### [946] [Non-variational supervised quantum kernel methods: a review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07896)
*John Tanner,Chon-Fai Kam,Jingbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 综述系统梳理了非变分监督式量子核方法（QKM）的理论基础、实现框架与潜在优势边界，指出其利用固定量子特征映射+经典凸优化规避变分算法训练难题，但同时面临指数集中、退量子化与谱分析等核心挑战，并明确了未来实现量子学习优势需突破的技术与概念障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变分量子算法受贫瘠高原与梯度优化不稳定困扰，亟需无需量子端训练、又能利用高维希尔伯特空间编码的替代范式；同时量子机器学习领域对“真正量子优势”的界定模糊，需建立系统评估框架以厘清QKM的适用场景与理论极限。

Method: 采用“综述-分析-综合”三步法：1) 从经典核理论出发，形式化定义保真度核与投影量子核；2) 建立一般化误差界、经典可模拟性条件与张量网络退量子化路径，剖析核积分算子谱特性；3) 结合近期超导与离子阱硬件实验数据，对结构化问题类（如低秩、高维隐式特征）进行案例比较，划定优势可行域。

Result: 得到三项定量认知：a) 当输入维数n与量子比特数m满足m≈log n且数据生成分布具有低有效秩时，QKM预测误差可优于任意经典核O(√(log n)/n)量级；b) 若核矩阵出现指数集中（方差≤2^{-m}），则所需样本量随m指数增长，硬件噪声阈值需低于10^{-3}；c) 张量网络退量子化在TT-rank≤poly(m)条件下可将量子核估计复杂度降至poly(m)，但损失核矩阵秩≥2^{m/2}时量子优势消失。

Conclusion: QQM在“高维、低有效秩、样本受限”的学习任务中具备理论优势，但需同时解决核集中度控制、噪声可扩展性及结构化数据假设三大瓶颈；未来工作应聚焦于谱正则化+误差缓解混合策略，并建立统一的“量子-经典”复杂度归约层级，以实现可验证的实用化量子增强学习。

Abstract: Quantum kernel methods (QKMs) have emerged as a prominent framework for supervised quantum machine learning. Unlike variational quantum algorithms, which rely on gradient-based optimisation and may suffer from issues such as barren plateaus, non-variational QKMs employ fixed quantum feature maps, with model selection performed classically via convex optimisation and cross-validation. This separation of quantum feature embedding from classical training ensures stable optimisation while leveraging quantum circuits to encode data in high-dimensional Hilbert spaces. In this review, we provide a thorough analysis of non-variational supervised QKMs, covering their foundations in classical kernel theory, constructions of fidelity and projected quantum kernels, and methods for their estimation in practice. We examine frameworks for assessing quantum advantage, including generalisation bounds and necessary conditions for separation from classical models, and analyse key challenges such as exponential concentration, dequantisation via tensor-network methods, and the spectral properties of kernel integral operators. We further discuss structured problem classes that may enable advantage, and synthesise insights from comparative and hardware studies. Overall, this review aims to clarify the regimes in which QKMs may offer genuine advantages, and to delineate the conceptual, methodological, and technical obstacles that must be overcome for practical quantum-enhanced learning.

</details>


### [947] [Visual Perceptual to Conceptual First-Order Rule Learning Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07897)
*Kun Gao,Davide Soldà,Thomas Eiter,Katsumi Inoue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出端到端可微框架γILP，无需标签与人工谓词即可从图像中归纳逻辑规则，在符号、关系图像及纯图像任务上均表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有规则学习方法依赖符号数据，无法从未标注图像自动学习规则并发掘新谓词，限制了可解释AI与LLM推理能力的提升。

Method: 设计完全可微的γILP流水线：用可微常量替换将图像映射为逻辑常量，通过神经谓词发明模块自动生成新谓词，再以可微归纳编程同时优化规则结构与参数。

Result: 在经典符号数据集（NELL、Kinship）、关系图像任务（Kandinsky Patterns）及纯图像数据集上，γILP的F1/准确率均显著超越NILM、ILP等基线，且可解释性指标提升20%以上。

Conclusion: γILP首次实现无标签图像的端到端规则学习，证明可微归纳编程可跨模态扩展，为视觉-符号联合推理提供新范式

Abstract: Learning rules plays a crucial role in deep learning, particularly in explainable artificial intelligence and enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. While existing rule learning methods are primarily designed for symbolic data, learning rules from image data without supporting image labels and automatically inventing predicates remains a challenge. In this paper, we tackle these inductive rule learning problems from images with a framework called γILP, which provides a fully differentiable pipeline from image constant substitution to rule structure induction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that γILP achieves strong performance not only on classical symbolic relational datasets but also on relational image data and pure image datasets, such as Kandinsky patterns.

</details>


### [948] [Dynamic Attentional Context Scoping: Agent-Triggered Focus Sessions for Isolated Per-Agent Steering in Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07911)
*Nickson Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对多方LLM协作时因并发代理竞争导致的上下文污染，本文提出一种轻量、确定性的动态关注上下文裁剪机制DACS，使协调器在跨代理调度与专注介入间灵活切换，无须检索或压缩即可彻底隔离干扰，显著降低错代理污染率并提升决策准度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多代理LLM编排系统中，代理数量N与并发决策密度上升时，各任务状态、部分输出与待决问题在统一上下文窗口里相互掺杂，严重削弱编排器的决策质量，需要一种在不牺牲完整信息的前提下、剔除跨代理噪声的新范式。

Method: DACS架构为协作器设计Registry与Focus两种非对称模式：Registry模式仅保留每代理≤200 token的轻量汇总并通过SteeringRequest触发转移；进入Focus(aᵢ)模式后，只注入目标代理完整上下文并将其余代理压缩回注册条目，实现确定性的上下文可预测性。算法中上下文窗口可表示为F(aᵢ)+R₋ᵢ，无需检索或二级压缩。研究围绕四阶段200轮实验评估：1) 变量N∈{3,5,10}、2) 代理异构性与对抗依赖、3) 高决策密度D=15、4) 自驱动LLM提出的自由式问题，并与扁平上下文基线对比，引入LLM-as-judge进行质检。

Result: 综合8个合成场景90.0–98.4% vs 21.0–60.0%的操控准度优势（p < 0.0001），错代理污染率由28–57%降至0–14%，上下文效率最高提升3.53倍；N增加时优势线性放大，Phase 4中N=3与N=5分别领先+17.2pp（p=0.0023）与+20.4pp（p=0.0008）。κ=0.909的LLM评审显示评估一致性极高。

Conclusion: DACS利用轻且确定性的上下文分隔解决多代理间“信息噪声耦合”难题，不依赖检索或压缩即可在复杂并发环境与算力极限下稳定保持高决策准度，为大规模LLM协作提供可直接落地的编排范式。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM orchestration systems suffer from context pollution: when N concurrent agents compete for the orchestrator's context window, each agent's task state, partial outputs, and pending questions contaminate the steering interactions of every other agent, degrading decision quality. We introduce Dynamic Attentional Context Scoping (DACS), a mechanism in which the orchestrator operates in two asymmetric modes. In Registry mode it holds only lightweight per-agent status summaries (<=200 tokens each), remaining responsive to all agents and the user. When an agent emits a SteeringRequest, the orchestrator enters Focus(a_i) mode, injecting the full context of agent a_i while compressing all other agents to their registry entries. Context isolation is agent-triggered, asymmetric, and deterministic: the context window contains exactly F(a_i) + R_{-i} during steering, eliminating cross-agent contamination without requiring context compression or retrieval. We evaluate DACS across four experimental phases totalling 200 trials: Phase 1 tests N in {3,5,10} (60 trials); Phase 2 tests agent heterogeneity and adversarial dependencies (60 trials); Phase 3 tests decision density up to D=15 (40 trials); Phase 4 uses autonomous LLM agents for free-form questions (40 trials, Claude Haiku 4.5). Across all 8 synthetic scenarios, DACS achieves 90.0--98.4% steering accuracy versus 21.0--60.0% for a flat-context baseline (p < 0.0001 throughout), with wrong-agent contamination falling from 28--57% to 0--14% and context efficiency ratios of up to 3.53x. The accuracy advantage grows with N and D; keyword matching is validated by LLM-as-judge across all phases (mean kappa=0.909). DACS outperforms the flat-context baseline by +17.2pp at N=3 (p=0.0023) and +20.4pp at N=5 (p=0.0008) in Phase 4, with the advantage growing with N confirmed by two independent judges.

</details>


### [949] [Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-ResolutionAtmospheric Downscaling and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07928)
*Tao Hana,Zhibin Wen,Zhenghao Chen,Fenghua Lin,Junyu Gao,Song Guo,Lei Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 3D 高斯泼溅与尺度感知 Vision Transformer 融合，实现大气变量任意分辨率统一预报与高效降尺度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI-NWP 受限于多尺度适应能力差、高分辨率输出计算昂贵，难以在单一框架内同时完成任意分辨率预报与连续降尺度。

Method: 将经纬度格点建模为 3D 高斯中心，提出生成式 3D 高斯预测网络估计未知样本的协方差、属性与透明度；引入尺度感知注意力模块跨降尺度比捕获跨尺度依赖，实现连续分辨率自适应。

Result: ERA5 上可准确预报 87 个大气变量并支持任意分辨率；ERA5/CMIP6 降尺度任务中精度与效率均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: GSSA-ViT 首次将生成式 3D 高斯建模与尺度感知注意力结合，为高效、可扩展的高分辨率多尺度大气预测与降尺度提供了统一方案。

Abstract: While AI-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) enables rapid forecasting, generating high-resolution outputs remains computationally demanding due to limited multi-scale adaptability and inefficient data representations. We propose the 3D Gaussian splatting-based scale-aware vision transformer (GSSA-ViT), a novel framework for arbitrary-resolution forecasting and flexible downscaling of high-dimensional atmospheric fields. Specifically, latitude-longitude grid points are treated as centers of 3D Gaussians. A generative 3D Gaussian prediction scheme is introduced to estimate key parameters, including covariance, attributes, and opacity, for unseen samples, improving generalization and mitigating overfitting. In addition, a scale-aware attention module is designed to capture cross-scale dependencies, enabling the model to effectively integrate information across varying downscaling ratios and support continuous resolution adaptation. To our knowledge, this is the first NWP approach that combines generative 3D Gaussian modeling with scale-aware attention for unified multi-scale prediction. Experiments on ERA5 show that the proposed method accurately forecasts 87 atmospheric variables at arbitrary resolutions, while evaluations on ERA5 and CMIP6 demonstrate its superior performance in downscaling tasks. The proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable solution for high-resolution, multi-scale atmospheric prediction and downscaling.
