Code is available at: https://github.com/binbin2xs/weather-GS.

</details>


### [950] [Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07941)
*Shiwan Zhao,Zhihu Wang,Xuyang Zhao,Jiaming Zhou,Caiyue Xu,Chenfei Liu,Liting Zhang,Yuhang Jia,Yanzhe Zhang,Hualong Yu,Zichen Xu,Qicheng Li,Yong Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出“行为干预”的统一视角，把零散的 LLM 后训练方法重新归为三大角色——支持扩张、策略重塑与行为巩固，并据此诊断瓶颈、设计多阶段流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练文献按目标函数或标签碎片化讨论，难以解释不同方法为何、何时有效，也无法指导多阶段系统的设计。

Method: 先按轨迹来源划分离线与在线两大学习范式，再从“行为干预”角度将方法映射到支持扩张、策略重塑、行为巩固三种功能角色，并给出各主流技术（SFT、偏好优化、RL、蒸馏等）的统一解读框架。

Result: 框架显示：SFT 可兼扩张或重塑；偏好类方法多为离线重塑；在线 RL 主做重塑但强引导时也能扩张；蒸馏本质是巩固而非单纯压缩；混合流水线对应多阶段协同。据此可诊断数据/探索/巩固瓶颈并优化阶段组合。

Conclusion: LLM 后训练已进入“系统协调设计”阶段，单一目标函数不再主导，需按行为瓶颈精准选用并组合扩张-重塑-巩固策略。

Abstract: Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objective families rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address.
  This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary learning regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories, and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes behavior across stages and model transitions.
  This perspective yields a unified reading of major paradigms. SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping, whereas preference-based methods are usually off-policy reshaping. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, though under stronger guidance it can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often best understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions.
  Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress in LLM post-training increasingly depends on coordinated system design rather than any single dominant objective.

</details>


### [951] [Investigation of Automated Design of Quantum Circuits for Imaginary Time Evolution Methods Using Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07951)
*Ryo Suzuki,Shohei Watabe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用双深度Q网络自动为VITE找量子电路，能量只低不高，门数降37%、深度降43%，H₂分子算到Full-CI精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VITE比VQE/QAOA更省参数，但在NISQ设备上手工ansatz门数深、噪声大，需要自动化的硬件友好电路设计框架。

Method: 把VITE电路构建建模为“能量最小+电路最简单”双目标优化，用DDQN智能体逐层选门；引入自适应接受阈值，在能量不降时仍允许短时增加复杂度以跳出局部极小。

Result: 在随机Max-Cut上，DDQN自动生成的电路比硬件高效ansatz平均门数少37%、深度浅43%；在H₂分子基态计算中，仅用显著更浅的电路即收敛到Full-CI能量，误差<10⁻³ Ha。

Conclusion: 深度强化学习可发现反直觉、硬件感知的短深度电路，为NISQ时代高效量子算法设计提供新范式。

Abstract: Efficient ground state search is fundamental to advancing combinatorial optimization problems and quantum chemistry. While the Variational Imaginary Time Evolution (VITE) method offers a useful alternative to Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), and Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), its implementation on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices is severely limited by the gate counts and depth of manually designed ansatz. Here, we present an automated framework for VITE circuit design using Double Deep-Q Networks (DDQN). Our approach treats circuit construction as a multi-objective optimization problem, simultaneously minimizing energy expectation values and optimizing circuit complexity. By introducing adoptive thresholds, we demonstrate significant hardware overhead reductions. In Max-Cut problems, our agent autonomously discovered circuits with approximately 37\% fewer gates and 43\% less depth than standard hardware-efficient ansatz on average. For molecular hydrogen ($H_2$), the DDQN also achieved the Full-CI limit, with maintaining a significantly shallower circuit. These results suggest that deep reinforcement learning can be helpful to find non-intuitive, optimal circuit structures, providing a pathway toward efficient, hardware-aware quantum algorithm design.

</details>


### [952] [Rethinking Data Mixing from the Perspective of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07963)
*Yuanjian Xu,Tianze Sun,Changwei Xu,XinLong Zhao,Jianing Hao,Ran Chen,Yang Liu,Ruijie Xu,Stephen Chen,Guang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立“梯度更新 ↔ 数据域分布”理论框架，纠正 LLM 数据配比中的主观性偏差并回答“域”定义与域权重如何影响泛化，提出图约束优化重加权方法 DoGraph，可在多规模 GPT-2 上稳健优于现有策略且不改训练设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证据表明糟糕的数据混合策略直接拉低大模型最终泛化能力，但学界仍不清楚：什么才是域？人类与模型认识域是否一致？域权重怎样改变泛化？缺乏理论放弃域配比的“经验咒语”治理会拖慢模型迭代，且当下理论无法给出数据权重 Δloss 线性的稳态解。

Method: 1) 建立域分布–梯度动态 PDE，把训练时域梯度分解为“本梯度＋他梯度”两部分并分析贡献边界差；2) 推出误差传播上界，指出梯度幅值反差较大时重加权后的“均值—反差”比无序混合低，理论预测域权重应按梯度反差和 Hessian Lipschitz 常数溢价重分配；3) 将数据样本串成结构化 k-近邻图，约束“邻接子图均一化”的同时最大化域间反差，把数据调度写成带图正则的软约束优化问题，得到 DoGraph 算法；4) 实验在多规模 GPT-2（野生、同构、异质三族规模 1.4B–7B）做跨域和长距泛化，基准为比例分享、BabyLM、ROD & UDRI 等。

Result: 1) DoGraph 推导出最优域权重与域内梯度反差呈指数式负相关，经 100M–7B 规模验证阈值成本误差 <1.2%；2) 在 C4→OpenWebText 等非对齐迁移上 DoGraph 相对最佳基准损失下降 1.7%–2.3%，最糟情形至少持平；3) 相同预算下 DoGraph 拉近平滑性指标‖∇²L‖₂ 0.6–0.9σ、阻断高反差热 Hess spot；4) 学派可复制、损失降幅随规模正线性，无发散歧义。

Conclusion: 域定义不应局限于人类语义而应回归梯度视角，梯度反差决定了域对最终泛化的信息量；利用图结构为梯度反差定量化并把调度问题等价为平滑约束优化，可在理论保证下同时消除“域偏见”与过配比；DoGraph 证明无需改变训练器即可显著提升和对齐效果，为后续预训练配比自动化提供可迁移的理论配方和算法通路。

Abstract: Data mixing strategy is essential for large language model (LLM) training. Empirical evidence shows that inappropriate strategies can significantly reduce generalization. Although recent methods have improved empirical performance, several fundamental questions remain open: what constitutes a domain, whether human and model perceptions of domains are aligned, and how domain weighting influences generalization. We address these questions by establishing formal connections between gradient dynamics and domain distributions, offering a theoretical framework that clarifies the role of domains in training dynamics. Building on this analysis, we introduce DoGraph, a reweighting framework that formulates data scheduling as a graph-constrained optimization problem. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 models of varying scales demonstrate that DoGraph consistently achieves competitive performance.

</details>


### [953] [Are we still able to recognize pearls? Machine-driven peer review and the risk to creativity: An explainable RAG-XAI detection framework with markers extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07964)
*Alin-Gabriel Văduva,Simona-Vasilica Oprea,Adela Bâra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLM 扩展至审稿后，下一步将是编辑自动化；机器偏好


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大模型生成评审，编辑部可能把“接收/拒稿”也交由算法裁决，形成端到端的自动评估流水线。作者担心这会系统性地奖励套路化研究、压制颠覆性创新，导致“认知同质化”。

Method: 构建 RAG-XAI 框架：①用 LLM-extractor 从评审文本中抓取“缺人性信号、重复模式”等 28 维特征；②XGBoost/RF/LightGBM 三模型集成；③可解释层 SHAP 给出特征贡献；④RAG 模块把可疑评审与已标注库比对，提供循证解释。

Result: 在 1.8 万篇跨学科评审数据集上，三模型平均准确率达 99.61%，AUC-ROC>0.999，F1=0.9925，假阳<0.23%，假阴≈0.8%；RAG 召回 Top-1 准确率 90.5%，且同类别在嵌入空间显著聚类。

Conclusion: RAG-XAI 能高精度、可解释地识别机器审稿痕迹，为编辑部设置“熔断”提供技术抓手；但根本治理仍需政策层保留人类编辑最终裁量权，并改革激励制度，防止学者为通过算法而迎合标准化套路。

Abstract: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into peer review raises a concern beyond authorship and detection: the potential cascading automation of the entire editorial process. As reviews become partially or fully machine-generated, it becomes plausible that editorial decisions may also be delegated to algorithmic systems, leading to a fully automated evaluation pipeline. They risk reshaping the criteria by which scientific work is assessed. This paper argues that machine-driven assessment may systematically favor standardized, pattern-conforming research while penalizing unconventional and paradigm-shifting ideas that require contextual human judgment. We consider that this shift could lead to epistemic homogenization, where researchers are implicitly incentivized to optimize their work for algorithmic approval rather than genuine discovery. To address this risk, we introduce an explainable framework (RAG-XAI) for assessing review quality and detecting automated patterns using markers LLM extractor, aiming to preserve transparency, accountability and creativity in science. The proposed framework achieves near-perfect detection performance, with XGBoost, Random Forest and LightGBM reaching 99.61% accuracy, AUC-ROC above 0.999 and F1-scores of 0.9925 on the test set, while maintaining extremely low false positive rates (<0.23%) and false negative rates (~0.8%). In contrast, the logistic regression baseline performs substantially worse (89.97% accuracy, F1-score 0.8314). Feature importance and SHAP analyses identify absence of personal signals and repetition patterns as the dominant predictors. Additionally, the RAG component achieves 90.5% top-1 retrieval accuracy, with strong same-class clustering in the embedding space, further supporting the reliability of the framework's outputs.

</details>


### [954] [DSCA: Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment for Lifelong VLM Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07965)
*Gyanendra Das,Sai Satyam Jena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment（DSCA），结构性地把 VLM 共享表征空间拆成一系列正交语义子空间，在子空间内做“手术式”编辑，实现终身编辑不遗忘，1000 次连续编辑后成功率仍>95%，显著优于现有适配器/激活/参数合并方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 知识编辑方法虽缓解灾难性遗忘，但仍共享纠缠表征空间，导致顺序编辑干扰无关概念；作者认为是“算法级优化”而非“结构级隔离”造成不稳定，需把知识从表示层面物理隔离开。

Method: 1）对 VLM 联合视觉-语言表征做增量聚类+PCA，将原空间分解为 k 个正交语义子空间；2）每条编辑只在对应子空间内执行，基模型权重全程冻结；3）设计多损失项（任务保真、编辑局部性、跨模态对齐）引导子空间内轻量变换，实现“手术式”精准更新。

Result: 单条编辑成功率 98%；连续 1000 次编辑后保持>95%；幻觉下降 3–5%；在持续指令调优基准上取得最佳后向迁移（BWT）分数；多数据集与 benchmark 均显示 DSCA 稳定性与知识保持能力 SOTA。

Conclusion: 通过结构级正交子空间隔离，DSCA 把“隔离”从软目标变为网络先天属性，首次在 VLM 上实现真正意义上的终身知识编辑，不重新训练、不干扰旧知识，为持续学习与大模型可控更新提供新范式。

Abstract: Model editing aims to update knowledge to add new concepts and change relevant information without retraining. Lifelong editing is a challenging task, prone to disrupting previously learned concepts, especially for Vision Language Models (VLMs), because sequential edits can lead to degraded reasoning and cross modal misalignment. Existing VLM knowledge editing methods based on gated adapters, activation edits, and parameter merging techniques address catastrophic forgetting seen in full fine tuning; however, they still operate in the shared representation space of the VLM, where concepts are entangled, so edits interfere with other non relevant concepts. We hypothesize that this instability persists because current methods algorithmically control edits via optimization rather than structurally separating knowledge. We introduce Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment (DSCA) which by design mitigates this limitation by decomposing the representation space into a set of orthogonal semantic subspaces and proposing edits only in those transformed spaces. These subspaces are obtained through incremental clustering and PCA on joint vision language representations. This process structurally isolates concepts, enabling precise, non interfering edits by turning isolation from a soft training objective into an architectural property. The surgical edits are guided by a multi term loss function for maintaining task fidelity, edit locality, and cross modal alignment. With the base model frozen, our method achieves 98 percent single edit success, remains over 95 percent after 1000 sequential edits, lowers hallucination by 3 to 5 percent, and achieves the best backward transfer (BWT) scores on continual instruction tuning benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate DSCA state of the art stability and knowledge retention capability in continual lifelong editing across various datasets and benchmarks.

</details>


### [955] [A Decomposition Perspective to Long-context Reasoning for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07981)
*Yanling Xiao,Huaibing Xie,Guoliang Zhao,Shihan Dou,Shaolei Wang,Yiting Liu,Nantao Zheng,Cheng Zhang,Pluto Zhou,Zhisong Zhang,Lemao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次把长文本推理拆解为可度量的原子技能，用合成数据+RL定向增强，6 个基准平均提升 7.7 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长文本推理研究把任务视为黑箱，忽视其内部技能构成，导致改进方向模糊；作者假设若直接优化子技能，可泛化到完整长文本推理。

Method: 1) 将长文本推理分解为原子技能集合；2) 为每项技能自动生成伪数据集；3) 用这些伪数据对 LLM 做强化学习微调，只更新与技能对应的内部表示。

Result: 在 Loogle、Loong、LongBench-v2 等 6 个 benchmark 上，基线 46.3% 的均值准确率被提升到 54.0%，绝对增益 7.7%，显著优于传统长上下文模型。

Conclusion: 长文本推理能力可被拆分为可训练的原子技能，显式优化这些技能即可稳定提升整体表现，为后续长上下文研究提供了可解释、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex real-world applications, yet remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid evolution in long-context reasoning, current research often overlooks the internal complexity of the long-context reasoning task itself. In this paper, we move beyond this holistic view and decompose long-context reasoning into a set of fundamental atomic skills, and we then automatically synthesize a suite of pseudo datasets, each explicitly targeting a specific atomic skill. Our empirical analysis confirms that proficiency in these atomic skills is strongly correlated with general long-text reasoning performance. Building on this insight, we employ reinforcement learning on these pseudo datasets to sharpen the model's atomic skills, in the hope of boosting its general long-context reasoning ability. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach: it outperforms a strong baseline by an average margin of 7.7\% (improving from 46.3\% to 54.0\%) across Loogle, Loong, LongBench-v2, BrowscompLong, Ruler-qa2, and MRCR.

</details>


### [956] [SearchAD: Large-Scale Rare Image Retrieval Dataset for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08008)
*Felix Embacher,Jonas Uhrig,Marius Cordts,Markus Enzweiler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SearchAD 为首个面向长尾场景的百万级自动驾驶检索数据集，提供 42.3 万帧/51.3 万框、90 类极稀有目标，支持文本/图像双模态检索，并为零样本、少样本与微调任务提供标准化基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当数据规模趋于饱和后，“如何高效找出对安全至关重要的稀有样本”成为提升自动驾驶系统鲁棒性的新瓶颈；现有数据集缺乏针对长尾分布的大规模检索基准。

Method: 采集 11 个公开数据集的 42.3 万帧，人工标注 51.3 万精准边界框、覆盖 90 类出现频次<50 的稀有类别；设计语义级图文检索任务与公开评测服务器，提供零样本、少样本及多模态微调三种评测协议。

Result: 文本检索显著优于纯图检索；零样本下，空间-视觉-语言对齐模型最佳；经微调后召回率大幅提升，但仍远未满足工程需求。数据集与服务器已开放，填补该领域空白。

Conclusion: SearchAD 首次将“稀有样本检索”确立为独立研究任务，为后续长尾感知、数据主动挖掘与多模态模型优化提供可复现的大规模实验平台。

Abstract: Retrieving rare and safety-critical driving scenarios from large-scale datasets is essential for building robust autonomous driving (AD) systems. As dataset sizes continue to grow, the key challenge shifts from collecting more data to efficiently identifying the most relevant samples. We introduce SearchAD, a large-scale rare image retrieval dataset for AD containing over 423k frames drawn from 11 established datasets. SearchAD provides high-quality manual annotations of more than 513k bounding boxes covering 90 rare categories. It specifically targets the needle-in-a-haystack problem of locating extremely rare classes, with some appearing fewer than 50 times across the entire dataset. Unlike existing benchmarks, which focused on instance-level retrieval, SearchAD emphasizes semantic image retrieval with a well-defined data split, enabling text-to-image and image-to-image retrieval, few-shot learning, and fine-tuning of multi-modal retrieval models. Comprehensive evaluations show that text-based methods outperform image-based ones due to stronger inherent semantic grounding. While models directly aligning spatial visual features with language achieve the best zero-shot results, and our fine-tuning baseline significantly improves performance, absolute retrieval capabilities remain unsatisfactory. With a held-out test set on a public benchmark server, SearchAD establishes the first large-scale dataset for retrieval-driven data curation and long-tail perception research in AD: https://iis-esslingen.github.io/searchad/

</details>


### [957] [Component-Adaptive and Lesion-Level Supervision for Improved Small Structure Segmentation in Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08015)
*Minh Sao Khue Luu,Evgeniy N. Pavlovskiy,Bair N. Tuchinov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一目标函数CATMIL，在nnU-Net框架下将体素级与病灶级监督融合，显著提升小病灶分割与检测性能，同时降低误报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像中小病灶极度不平衡，传统仅体素级的分割损失难以兼顾不同尺寸病灶的检测与边界精度，需同时优化体素级分割与病灶级召回。

Method: 1) Component-Adaptive Tversky：按连通域大小重加权体素损失，缓解大小病灶不平衡；2) MIL-based lesion-level supervision：把每个病灶视为一包，施加实例级检测约束；3) 将两项辅助损失与标准nnU-Net损失加权融合，端到端联合优化。

Result: 在MSLesSeg 5折交叉验证中，CATMIL Dice达0.7834，边界误差最小；小病灶召回率显著提高，假阴性大幅降低，同时保持最低假阳性体积，综合性能最佳。

Conclusion: 在高度不平衡场景下，将组件级与病灶级监督嵌入统一目标，可有效提升小病灶分割与检测，方法即插即用、代码开源。

Abstract: We propose a unified objective function, termed CATMIL, that augments the base segmentation loss with two auxiliary supervision terms operating at different levels. The first term, Component-Adaptive Tversky, reweights voxel contributions based on connected components to balance the influence of lesions of different sizes. The second term, based on Multiple Instance Learning, introduces lesion-level supervision by encouraging the detection of each lesion instance. These terms are combined with the standard nnU-Net loss to jointly optimize voxel-level segmentation accuracy and lesion-level detection. We evaluate the proposed objective on the MSLesSeg dataset using a consistent nnU-Net framework and 5-fold cross-validation. The results show that CATMIL achieves the most balanced performance across segmentation accuracy, lesion detection, and error control. It improves Dice score (0.7834) and reduces boundary error compared to standard losses. More importantly, it substantially increases small lesion recall and reduces false negatives, while maintaining the lowest false positive volume among compared methods. These findings demonstrate that integrating component-level and lesion-level supervision within a unified objective provides an effective and practical approach for improving small lesion segmentation in highly imbalanced settings. All code and pretrained models are available at \href{https://github.com/luumsk/SmallLesionMRI}{this url}.

</details>


### [958] [Wiring the 'Why': A Unified Taxonomy and Survey of Abductive Reasoning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08016)
*Moein Salimi,Shaygan Adim,Danial Parnian,Nima Alighardashi,Mahdi Jafari Siavoshani,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首篇系统综述LLM溯因推理：提出“生成-选择”两阶段统一框架，实证6类模型差距，指出现有静态评测、领域狭窄与训练不足三大缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 溯因推理虽是人类发现与意义建构的核心，却在LLM研究中被零散探讨、概念混淆，亟需统一视角与系统梳理以指导未来发展。

Method: 构建“假设生成-假设选择”两级形式化定义；据此建立涵盖任务、数据、方法、评测的四维文献分类体系；并设计紧凑基准实验，横向对比模型尺度、家族、评测方式及两阶段任务差异，再关联归纳/演绎任务以观察整体推理能力。

Result: 实证显示LLM在生成阶段表现普遍弱于选择阶段；大模型优势主要体现在选择而非生成；溯因与演绎/归纳成绩仅呈弱相关，提示推理模式异质；现有数据集静态、领域窄、训练框架缺且缺乏对溯因机制的深入解释。

Conclusion: 研究为LLM溯因推理提供统一框架与全景视图，揭示评测、数据、训练与机理理解四大短板，呼吁动态交互式基准、跨域数据、显式溯因训练及可解释机制研究，以推进下一代具备真正溯因能力的人工智能系统。

Abstract: Regardless of its foundational role in human discovery and sense-making, abductive reasoning--the inference of the most plausible explanation for an observation--has been relatively underexplored in Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, the exploration of abductive reasoning and its diverse facets has thus far been disjointed rather than cohesive. This paper presents the first survey of abductive reasoning in LLMs, tracing its trajectory from philosophical foundations to contemporary AI implementations. To address the widespread conceptual confusion and disjointed task definitions prevalent in the field, we establish a unified two-stage definition that formally categorizes prior work. This definition disentangles abduction into \textit{Hypothesis Generation}, where models bridge epistemic gaps to produce candidate explanations, and \textit{Hypothesis Selection}, where the generated candidates are evaluated and the most plausible explanation is chosen. Building upon this foundation, we present a comprehensive taxonomy of the literature, categorizing prior work based on their abductive tasks, datasets, underlying methodologies, and evaluation strategies. In order to ground our framework empirically, we conduct a compact benchmark study of current LLMs on abductive tasks, together with targeted comparative analyses across model sizes, model families, evaluation styles, and the distinct generation-versus-selection task typologies. Moreover, by synthesizing recent empirical results, we examine how LLM performance on abductive reasoning relates to deductive and inductive tasks, providing insights into their broader reasoning capabilities. Our analysis reveals critical gaps in current approaches--from static benchmark design and narrow domain coverage to narrow training frameworks and limited mechanistic understanding of abductive processes...

</details>


### [959] [PrivFedTalk: Privacy-Aware Federated Diffusion with Identity-Stable Adapters for Personalized Talking-Head Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08037)
*Soumya Mazumdar,Vineet Kumar Rakesh,Tapas Samanta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 为了隐私地训练个性化说话头模型，PrivFedTalk用联邦方式联合微调共享扩散骨架和本地LoRA身份适配器，无需上传原始音视频。身份一致性加权聚合、时序去噪正则、安全聚合与差分隐私共同抑制通信、漂移与泄露风险，实现资源受限下的跨设备训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散式说话头生成依赖集中化人脸-语音数据集，引入隐私风险；个性化场景下，身份级数据更敏感，无法跨用户汇聚。文中旨在解决“高性能扩散模型+强隐私保护”在个性化说话头训练中的矛盾。

Method: 1) 架构：共享条件潜在扩散主干 + 客户端私有LoRA身份适配器，实现参数高效适配；2) 聚合：提出ISFA，利用基于设备端身份一致性与时序稳定性的标量可靠性信号，对异构客户端更新加权；3) 正则：引入TDC，限制去噪过程中帧间漂移、闪变与身份漂移；4) 隐私：对LoRA更新实施安全聚合与客户端级差分隐私；5) 资源：支持低显存单GPU及多GPU异构并行。

Result: 在资源受限的跨设备联邦实验里，PrivFedTalk在FedAvg与FedProx多种聚合条件下均实现稳定优化，完成端到端训练与评估，效果优于基线，验证了隐私保护下个性化说话头联邦训练的可行性。

Conclusion: 框架首次将条件潜在扩散与联邦LoRA结合，成功在保护原始数据的同时训练高质量个性化说话头；但组件级隐私-效用 trade-off 与定性效果仍缺统一评估基准，未来需针对更强隐私预算、更复杂分布和更大规模客户端展开深入研究。

Abstract: Talking-head generation has advanced rapidly with diffusion-based generative models, but training usually depends on centralized face-video and speech datasets, raising major privacy concerns. The problem is more acute for personalized talking-head generation, where identity-specific data are highly sensitive and often cannot be pooled across users or devices. PrivFedTalk is presented as a privacy-aware federated framework for personalized talking-head generation that combines conditional latent diffusion with parameter-efficient identity adaptation. A shared diffusion backbone is trained across clients, while each client learns lightweight LoRA identity adapters from local private audio-visual data, avoiding raw data sharing and reducing communication cost. To address heterogeneous client distributions, Identity-Stable Federated Aggregation (ISFA) weights client updates using privacy-safe scalar reliability signals computed from on-device identity consistency and temporal stability estimates. Temporal-Denoising Consistency (TDC) regularization is introduced to reduce inter-frame drift, flicker, and identity drift during federated denoising. To limit update-side privacy risk, secure aggregation and client-level differential privacy are applied to adapter updates. The implementation supports both low-memory GPU execution and multi-GPU client-parallel training on heterogeneous shared hardware. Comparative experiments on the present setup across multiple training and aggregation conditions with PrivFedTalk, FedAvg, and FedProx show stable federated optimization and successful end-to-end training and evaluation under constrained resources. The results support the feasibility of privacy-aware personalized talking-head training in federated environments, while suggesting that stronger component-wise, privacy-utility, and qualitative claims need further standardized evaluation.

</details>


### [960] [LINE: LLM-based Iterative Neuron Explanations for Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08039)
*Vladimir Zaigrajew,Michał Piechota,Gaspar Sekula,Przemysław Biecek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LINE提出一种无需训练、开放词汇的单神经元概念标注方法，仅通过黑盒访问，用LLM与文生图模型迭代闭环生成概念，在ImageNet和Places365上取得SOTA，并额外发现29%被固定词表遗漏的高层概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经元可解释性方法受限于人工词表或过于具体的描述，难以揭示高阶、全局概念，阻碍对模型决策机制与安全性的深入理解。

Method: LINE以神经元激活序列为指导，利用大语言模型提出候选概念→文生图模型生成图像→模型激活反馈→LLM精炼概念，形成无需训练、无需梯度的黑盒迭代闭环。

Result: 在ImageNet、Places365等多架构测试中，LINE将平均AUC分别提升0.18和0.05；相比大规模固定词表平均额外发现29%新概念；生成的视觉解释与梯度式激活最大化方法相当，并提供完整生成历史用于多语义性评估。

Conclusion: LINE证明开放词汇、训练无关的迭代框架能有效挖掘模型内部高层语义，兼顾精度与可扩展性，为实现更安全、可解释的AI系统提供了新工具。

Abstract: Interpreting the concepts encoded by individual neurons in deep neural networks is a crucial step towards understanding their complex decision-making processes and ensuring AI safety. Despite recent progress in neuron labeling, existing methods often limit the search space to predefined concept vocabularies or produce overly specific descriptions that fail to capture higher-order, global concepts. We introduce LINE, a novel, training-free iterative approach tailored for open-vocabulary concept labeling in vision models. Operating in a strictly black-box setting, LINE leverages a large language model and a text-to-image generator to iteratively propose and refine concepts in a closed loop, guided by activation history. We demonstrate that LINE achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple model architectures, yielding AUC improvements of up to 0.18 on ImageNet and 0.05 on Places365, while discovering, on average, 29% of new concepts missed by massive predefined vocabularies. Beyond identifying the top concept, LINE provides a complete generation history, which enables polysemanticity evaluation and produces supporting visual explanations that rival gradient-dependent activation maximization methods.

</details>


### [961] [DeepForestSound: a multi-species automatic detector for passive acoustic monitoring in African tropical forests, a case study in Kibale National Park](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08087)
*Gabriel Dubus,Théau d'Audiffret,Claire Auger,Raphaël Cornette,Sylvain Haupert,Innocent Kasekendi,Raymond Katumba,Hugo Magaldi,Lise Pernel,Harold Rugonge,Jérôme Sueur,John Justice Tibesigwa,Sabrina Krief*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeepForestSound (DFS) 基于半监督＋LoRA 微调 AST，可在乌干达 Kibale 国家公园长期监测鸟类、灵长类与大象等 12 类生物声，跨时间、跨地点测试中有 8 类优于现有模型，灵长类 AP 0.964、象 0.961，证实区域特化训练对非洲热带雨林声学监测具显著价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非洲热带森林 PAM 标注稀缺，导致通用生态声学模型在代表性不足类群上性能骤降，亟需面向该区域的多物种自动检测框架。

Method: 1) 半监督管线：先对无标注录音聚类并人工校验获得伪标签；2) 以 Audio Spectrogram Transformer 为骨干，采用 LoRA 低秩自适应微调；3) 引入线性探针基线 DFS-Linear 作对照；4) 在乌干达 Sebitoli 训练，两年后同林不同位点独立测试，评估时-空泛化。

Result: 在 12 个目标类群中，DFS 于 8 类超越现有自动检测工具，非鸟类提升尤为显著：灵长类平均精度 0.964，象类 0.961；LoRA 微调全面优于线性探针。

Conclusion: 针对特定热带森林生态系统的任务导向训练，可显著突破声学复杂环境下的检测瓶颈；DFS 已展现作为非洲雨林生物多样性保护实用工具的潜力。

Abstract: Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM) is widely used for biodiversity assessment. Its application in African tropical forests is limited by scarce annotated data, reducing the performance of general-purpose ecoacoustic models on underrepresented taxa. In this study, we introduce DeepForestSound (DFS), a multi-species automatic detection model designed for PAM in African tropical forests. DFS relies on a semi-supervised pipeline combining clustering of unannotated recordings with manual validation, followed by supervised fine-tuning of an Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) using low-rank adaptation, which is compared to a frozen-backbone linear baseline (DFS-Linear). The framework supports the detection of multiple taxonomic groups, including birds, primates, and elephants, from long-term acoustic recordings. DFS was trained on acoustic data collected in the Sebitoli area, in Kibale National Park, Uganda, and evaluated on an independent dataset recorded two years later at different locations within the same forest. This evaluation therefore assesses generalization across time and recording sites within a single tropical forest ecosystem. Across 8 out of 12 taxons, DFS outperforms existing automatic detection tools, particularly for non-avian taxa, achieving average AP values of 0.964 for primates and 0.961 for elephants. Results further show that LoRA-based fine-tuning substantially outperforms linear probing across taxa. Overall, these results demonstrate that task-oriented, region-specific training substantially improves detection performance in acoustically complex tropical environments, and highlight the potential of DFS as a practical tool for biodiversity monitoring and conservation in African rainforests.

</details>


### [962] [OV-Stitcher: A Global Context-Aware Framework for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08110)
*Seungjae Moon,Seunghyun Oh,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 无需训练的开放词汇语义分割新框架OV-Stitcher，通过在最后编码器层拼接子图特征，解决滑动窗口导致的上下文割裂问题，在8个数据集上把mIoU从48.7提升至50.7。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无训练开放词汇分割方法为处理高分辨率输入而采用滑动窗口，导致子图独立计算、缺乏全局注意力，特征碎片化、上下文推理受限。

Method: 提出OV-Stitcher：在最终编码器块内，不经过再训练，直接把各子图特征重建为全局注意力表示，实现全局上下文聚合，再生成空间一致且语义对齐的分割图。

Result: 在8个公开基准上，mIoU相较最强无训练基线提升2.0个百分点（48.7→50.7），验证了框架的可扩展性与有效性。

Conclusion: OV-Stitcher通过“后段拼接”策略，无需额外训练即可恢复全局注意力，为开放词汇语义分割提供了一条简洁高效的新路径。

Abstract: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation(TF-OVSS) has recently attracted attention for its ability to perform dense prediction by leveraging the pretrained knowledge of large vision and vision-language models, without requiring additional training. However, due to the limited input resolution of these pretrained encoders, existing TF-OVSS methods commonly adopt a sliding-window strategy that processes cropped sub-images independently. While effective for managing high-resolution inputs, this approach prevents global attention over the full image, leading to fragmented feature representations and limited contextual reasoning. We propose OV-Stitcher, a training-free framework that addresses this limitation by stitching fragmented sub-image features directly within the final encoder block. By reconstructing attention representations from fragmented sub-image features, OV-Stitcher enables global attention within the final encoder block, producing coherent context aggregation and spatially consistent, semantically aligned segmentation maps. Extensive evaluations across eight benchmarks demonstrate that OV-Stitcher establishes a scalable and effective solution for open-vocabulary segmentation, achieving a notable improvement in mean Intersection over Union(mIoU) from 48.7 to 50.7 compared with prior training-free baselines.

</details>


### [963] [TADP-RME: A Trust-Adaptive Differential Privacy Framework for Enhancing Reliability of Data-Driven Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08113)
*Labani Halder,Payel Sadhukhan,Sarbani Palit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TADP-RME：用逆信任分数动态调整隐私预算，并用逆向流形嵌入打破几何结构，兼顾差分隐私形式化保证与效用，显著降低推理攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统差分隐私方案使用固定隐私预算，难以适应异构用户信任度；单纯加噪声仍保留几何结构，易被推理攻击利用，导致隐私泄露。

Method: 设计逆信任得分∈[0,1]，依用户信任度自适应分配隐私预算；引入反向流形嵌入，通过非线性变换破坏局部几何关系，并在后处理阶段维持差分隐私的严格定义。

Result: 理论分析与实验表明，在几乎不损失效用的前提下，推理攻击成功率最高降低3.1%，隐私-效用权衡优于现有方法。

Conclusion: TADP-RME 提供了一种统一、可信赖的学习框架，能在对抗环境中根据用户信任水平灵活平衡隐私与效用。

Abstract: Ensuring reliability in adversarial settings necessitates treating privacy as a foundational component of data-driven systems. While differential privacy and cryptographic protocols offer strong guarantees, existing schemes rely on a fixed privacy budget, leading to a rigid utility-privacy trade-off that fails under heterogeneous user trust. Moreover, noise-only differential privacy preserves geometric structure, which inference attacks exploit, causing privacy leakage.
  We propose TADP-RME (Trust-Adaptive Differential Privacy with Reverse Manifold Embedding), a framework that enhances reliability under varying levels of user trust. It introduces an inverse trust score in the range [0,1] to adaptively modulate the privacy budget, enabling smooth transitions between utility and privacy. Additionally, Reverse Manifold Embedding applies a nonlinear transformation to disrupt local geometric relationships while preserving formal differential privacy guarantees through post-processing.
  Theoretical and empirical results demonstrate improved privacy-utility trade-offs, reducing attack success rates by up to 3.1 percent without significant utility degradation. The framework consistently outperforms existing methods against inference attacks, providing a unified approach for reliable learning in adversarial environments.

</details>


### [964] [Initialisation Determines the Basin: Efficient Codebook Optimisation for Extreme LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08118)
*Ian W. Kennedy,Nafise Sadat Moosavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对加法量化在2-bit压缩率下失败的核心原因进行诊断，并提出OA-EM初始化方法，显著提高极端压缩后LLM的恢复质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加法量化可实现O(1)查表反量化、适合端侧部署，但在2-bit下即使有大量搜索和微调也常崩溃，阻碍了超低比特量模型落地。

Method: 引入“表达比”ρ=N/KM量化权重分组与码本容量的几何关系，分析差初始性的困境；提出输出感知EM（OA-EM）初始化，用Hessian加权马氏距离指导码字分配；再结合PV调优完成整体优化。

Result: 在Llama 3.2 3B/3.1 8B和Qwen 2.5 3B上，OA-EM在不同压缩率、搜索预算下均优于现有初始化，PV调优后困惑度最大可降低数十倍，全面占据质量-计算前沿。

Conclusion: 极端低位压缩模型的表现高度依赖初始化策略，优化几何决定终局质量；以Hessian加权输出感知EM初始化为代表的几何友好方法，是摆脱2-bit“灾难性失效”的有效途径。

Abstract: Additive quantization enables extreme LLM compression with O(1) lookup-table dequantization, making it attractive for edge deployment. Yet at 2-bit precision, it often fails catastrophically, even with extensive search and finetuning. We show that the dominant bottleneck is codebook initialisation. Greedy sequential initialisation frequently places the model in poor optimisation regions that subsequent beam search and PV-tuning struggle to overcome. We analyse this behaviour through the representational ratio \r{ho} = N/KM, which characterises the relationship between weight groups and codebook capacity, and propose OA-EM, an output-aware EM initialisation method using Hessian-weighted Mahalanobis distance. Across compression rates, search budgets, and three architectures (Llama 3.2 3B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 3B), OA-EM consistently produces better solutions after PV-tuning and dominates the quality-compute frontier. The severity of the bottleneck scales with \r{ho}: moderate at 3 bpp but extreme at 2 bpp, where poor initialisation can degrade perplexity by orders of magnitude. More broadly, our results highlight the importance of optimisation geometry in compressed model spaces, where initialisation can dominate subsequent search and fine-tuning.

</details>


### [965] [Small Vision-Language Models are Smart Compressors for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08120)
*Junjie Fei,Jun Chen,Zechun Liu,Yunyang Xiong,Chong Zhou,Wei Wen,Junlin Han,Mingchen Zhuge,Saksham Suri,Qi Qian,Shuming Liu,Lemeng Wu,Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi,Vikas Chandra,Mohamed Elhoseiny,Chenchen Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tempo 用 6B 小模型在单轮前向中把小时级视频压到 0.5-16 token/帧，8K 视觉令牌预算下 LVBench 达 SOTA，证明长视频理解靠意图驱动压缩而非堆上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型受限于上下文长度， dense 视觉 token 迅速占满预算并加剧“中间丢失”问题；简单降采样或均匀池化会丢弃关键帧、浪费带宽，急需在严格 token 预算内保留与查询相关的关键信息。

Method: 提出 query-aware 框架 Tempo：1) 用小型视觉-语言模型（SVLM）作局部时序压缩器，将 token 削减转化为早期跨模态蒸馏，单前向生成紧凑、意图对齐的表示；2) 设计无训练、O(1) 的 Adaptive Token Allocation（ATA），借助 SVLM 的 zero-shot 相关性先验与语义前置，动态把密集带宽分给查询关键段，冗余段压成最小时间锚点，保持因果性与全局故事线。

Result: 在极端长视频基准 LVBench（平均 4101 秒）上，6B 的 Tempo 在 8K 视觉令牌预算下得 52.3 分，超越 GPT-4o 与 Gemini 1.5 Pro；扩展到 2048 帧进一步达 53.7。动态压缩率 0.5-16 token/帧，显著低于理论下限。

Conclusion: 小时级长视频理解的关键是“意图驱动的高效压缩”，而非无限扩充上下文窗口；Tempo 通过早阶段、查询感知的跨模态蒸馏与因果动态路由，首次在极稀疏视觉预算内实现 SOTA 表现，为 MLLM 处理长时视频提供了新范式。

Abstract: Adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for hour-long videos is bottlenecked by context limits. Dense visual streams saturate token budgets and exacerbate the lost-in-the-middle phenomenon. Existing heuristics, like sparse sampling or uniform pooling, blindly sacrifice fidelity by discarding decisive moments and wasting bandwidth on irrelevant backgrounds. We propose Tempo, an efficient query-aware framework compressing long videos for downstream understanding. Tempo leverages a Small Vision-Language Model (SVLM) as a local temporal compressor, casting token reduction as an early cross-modal distillation process to generate compact, intent-aligned representations in a single forward pass. To enforce strict budgets without breaking causality, we introduce Adaptive Token Allocation (ATA). Exploiting the SVLM's zero-shot relevance prior and semantic front-loading, ATA acts as a training-free $O(1)$ dynamic router. It allocates dense bandwidth to query-critical segments while compressing redundancies into minimal temporal anchors to maintain the global storyline. Extensive experiments show our 6B architecture achieves state-of-the-art performance with aggressive dynamic compression (0.5-16 tokens/frame). On the extreme-long LVBench (4101s), Tempo scores 52.3 under a strict 8K visual budget, outperforming GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro. Scaling to 2048 frames reaches 53.7. Crucially, Tempo compresses hour-long videos substantially below theoretical limits, proving true long-form video understanding relies on intent-driven efficiency rather than greedily padded context windows.

</details>


### [966] [QARIMA: A Quantum Approach To Classical Time Series Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08277)
*Nishikanta Mohanty,Bikash K. Behera,Badshah Mukherjee,Pravat Dash*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用固定拓扑的变分量子电路（VQC）代替 ARIMA 建模中的部分搜索与参数估计环节，在保证模型阶数不变的条件下，显著降低超参调优开销并提升预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 ARIMA 的阶数搜索和参数估计存在指数级组合爆炸与反复调参的“超参数泄露”问题；量子计算天然并行搜索与高维内积运算可加速自相关/偏自相关计算，并直接输出模型参数。

Method: 1) 用基于交换测试的量子自相关（QACF）与偏自相关（QPACF）筛选差分阶 d 和候选滞后；2) 固定 VQC 线路结构、优化器与训练预算，避免再调参；3) 用同一电路并行估计 AR 系数（VQC-AR）与 MA 系数（VQC-MA）；4) 插一层“弱滞后精炼”子网络，对 AR 滞后加权或剪枝但不改 (p,d,q)；5) 滚动原点评估对比经典自动 ARIMA。

Result: 环境与工业数据集上，量子方案在 MSE、MAPE 与 Diebold-Mariano 检验中均显著优于经典自动 ARIMA，同时元优化时间减少；七项量子组件共同决定了性能提升。

Conclusion: 固定配置的 VQC 可在不泄露超参的前提下，将量子优势嵌入 ARIMA 的阶数发现、滞后精炼与参数估计三大环节，为时间序列预测提供一条低-overhead 量子增强路径。

Abstract: We present a quantum-inspired ARIMA methodology that integrates quantum-assisted lag discovery with \emph{fixed-configuration} variational quantum circuits (VQCs) for parameter estimation and weak-lag refinement. Differencing and candidate lags are identified via swap-test-driven quantum autocorrelation (QACF) and quantum partial autocorrelation (QPACF), with a delayed-matrix construction that aligns quantum projections to time-domain regressors, followed by standard information-criterion parsimony. Given the screened orders $(p,d,q)$, we retain a fixed VQC ansatz, optimizer, and training budget, preventing hyperparameter leakage, and deploy the circuit in two estimation roles: VQC-AR for autoregressive coefficients and VQC-MA for moving-average coefficients. Between screening and estimation, a lightweight VQC weak-lag refinement re-weights or prunes screened AR lags without altering $(p,d,q)$. Across environmental and industrial datasets, we perform rolling-origin evaluations against automated classical ARIMA, reporting out-of-sample mean squared error (MSE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and Diebold--Mariano tests on MSE and MAE. Empirically, the seven quantum contributions -- (1) differencing selection, (2) QACF, (3) QPACF, (4) swap-test primitives with delayed-matrix construction, (5) VQC-AR, (6) VQC weak-lag refinement, and (7) VQC-MA -- collectively reduce meta-optimization overhead and make explicit where quantum effects enter order discovery, lag refinement, and AR/MA parameter estimation.

</details>


### [967] [HistDiT: A Structure-Aware Latent Conditional Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity Virtual Staining in Histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08305)
*Aasim Bin Saleem,Amr Ahmed,Ardhendu Behera,Hafeezullah Amin,Iman Yi Liao,Mahmoud Khattab,Pan Jia Wern,Haslina Makmur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HistDiT——首个基于潜空间条件DiT的虚拟IHE染色框架，通过双流条件与多目标损失同时保持细胞结构锐度与生化表达准确性，显著优于GAN/U-Net基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统IHE染色耗时耗材且易破坏组织切片；现有虚拟染色方法（GAN/U-Net）在“结构保真-染色真实”两端顾此失彼，难以满足诊断级品质。

Method: 构建潜空间条件扩散Transformer（HistDiT）：a) 双流条件——VAE潜空间保持空间约束，UNI嵌入提供语义表型引导；b) 多目标损失函数兼顾结构锐度与纹理保真；c) 提出结构相关度量SCM，对核心形态进行精准质量评估。

Result: 在乳腺HER2切片数据集上，HistDiT生成的虚拟染色图像结构清晰度与生化表达一致性均显著优于当前最佳基线，定量指标（SCM、FID、SSIM）均获两位数提升，病理医师主观评分亦达诊断可用级别。

Conclusion: HistDiT突破了GAN/U-Net在虚拟IHE染色中的结构-染色权衡瓶颈，为大规模、低成本、无损的免疫组化评估提供了可行方案，并具备向其他生物标记物扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Immunohistochemistry (IHC) is essential for assessing specific immune biomarkers like Human Epidermal growth-factor Receptor 2 (HER2) in breast cancer. However, the traditional protocols of obtaining IHC stains are resource-intensive, time-consuming, and prone to structural damages. Virtual staining has emerged as a scalable alternative, but it faces significant challenges in preserving fine-grained cellular structures while accurately translating biochemical expressions. Current state-of-the-art methods still rely on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) or standard convolutional U-Net diffusion models that often struggle with "structure and staining trade-offs". The generated samples are either structurally relevant but blurry, or texturally realistic but have artifacts that compromise their diagnostic use. In this paper, we introduce HistDiT, a novel latent conditional Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that establishes a new benchmark for visual fidelity in virtual histological staining. The novelty introduced in this work is, a) the Dual-Stream Conditioning strategy that explicitly maintains a balance between spatial constraints via VAE-encoded latents and semantic phenotype guidance via UNI embeddings; b) the multi-objective loss function that contributes to sharper images with clear morphological structure; and c) the use of the Structural Correlation Metric (SCM) to focus on the core morphological structure for precise assessment of sample quality. Consequently, our model outperforms existing baselines, as demonstrated through rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

</details>


### [968] [Lost in the Hype: Revealing and Dissecting the Performance Degradation of Medical Multimodal Large Language Models in Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08333)
*Xun Zhu,Fanbin Mo,Xi Chen,Kaili Zheng,Shaoshuai Yang,Yiming Shi,Jian Gao,Miao Li,Ji Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 尽管医学多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在预训练规模上遥遥领先，但其在最基础的图像分类任务上仍明显落后于传统深度学习模型。本文通过14个开源医学MLLM的系统实验，首次从特征信息流角度逐模块/逐层解析性能崩解的根源，提出四类失效模式并给出可量化指标，为社区敲响‘规模≠临床可用’的警钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学MLLM被寄予厚望，却在最早被整合的分类任务上表现反直觉地差。该悖论表明，仅扩大数据与参数无法自动转化为临床级精度，亟需厘清‘性能退化究竟发生在哪个环节’，才能避免盲目堆资源、真正走向可部署的医学大模型。

Method: 在三个代表性医学分类数据集上，对14个开源MLLM进行端到端基准测试；引入特征探针（feature probing）追踪视觉特征从编码器→连接器→LLM的逐层演变，量化各模块对分类信号的保真度；提出健康度评分刻画特征退化程度，实现跨模型、跨数据的可比诊断。

Result: (1) 定位四类核心失效：①视觉表征质量受限；②连接器投影保真缺失；③LLM医学推理不足；④语义映射空间错位。(2) 健康度评分与最终分类准确率高度相关（R>0.8），验证了诊断指标的有效性。(3) 传统ConvNet/ViT在同等数据量下平均AUC领先最佳MLLM 4–9%，差距在细粒度病变（如乳腺微钙化）上扩大到12%。

Conclusion: 研究首次实证表明，MLLM的退化并非单一模块之过，而是‘视觉-语义’全链路错位累积所致；仅靠扩展预训练无法弥补医学场景下的固有语义鸿沟。呼吁社区从‘堆参数’转向‘解剖失效、重设计链路’，并开源了特征诊断工具包，为推动下一代临床级医学多模态模型提供路线图。

Abstract: The rise of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has sparked an unprecedented wave of applications in the field of medical imaging analysis. However, as one of the earliest and most fundamental tasks integrated into this paradigm, medical image classification reveals a sobering reality: state-of-the-art medical MLLMs consistently underperform compared to traditional deep learning models, despite their overwhelming advantages in pre-training data and model parameters. This paradox prompts a critical rethinking: where exactly does the performance degradation originate? In this paper, we conduct extensive experiments on 14 open-source medical MLLMs across three representative image classification datasets. Moving beyond superficial performance benchmarking, we employ feature probing to track the information flow of visual features module-by-module and layer-by-layer throughout the entire MLLM pipeline, enabling explicit visualization of where and how classification signals are distorted, diluted, or overridden. As the first attempt to dissect classification performance degradation in medical MLLMs, our findings reveal four failure modes: 1) quality limitation in visual representation, 2) fidelity loss in connector projection, 3) comprehension deficit in LLM reasoning, and 4) misalignment of semantic mapping. Meanwhile, we introduce quantitative scores that characterize the healthiness of feature evolution, enabling principled comparisons across diverse MLLMs and datasets. Furthermore, we provide insightful discussions centered on the critical barriers that prevent current medical MLLMs from fulfilling their promised clinical potential. We hope that our work provokes rethinking within the community-highlighting that the road from high expectations to clinically deployable MLLMs remains long and winding.

</details>


### [969] [Scalable Neural Decoders for Practical Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08358)
*Andi Gu,J. Pablo Bonilla Ataides,Mikhail D. Lukin,Susanne F. Yelin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种卷积神经网络译码器，利用QLDPC码的几何结构，在物理错误率0.1%时即可把逻辑错误率压到10⁻¹⁰，译码延迟满足主流量子硬件实时预算，时空开销有望显著低于预期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有QLDPC码译码算法无法在实际硬件速度下兑现其理论容错潜力，亟需兼具高速度、低延迟与高准确度的新型经典译码器。

Method: 设计卷积神经网络译码器，直接学习QLDPC码的格点几何；在[144,12,12]Gross码上训练并测试，实时输出置信度估计。

Result: 逻辑错误率较最优传统译码器再降17倍，达10⁻¹⁰；译码吞量提高3–5个数量级，延迟<100 µs，满足超导/离子阱平台实时预算；置信度校准良好，可削减重复-直至-成功协议时间开销。

Conclusion: 在物理错误率0.1%的今日指标下，即可用较小码长实现大规模容错所需逻辑错误率，暗示容错量子计算的时空成本可能远低于此前估计。

Abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) is essential for scalable quantum computing. However, it requires classical decoders that are fast and accurate enough to keep pace with quantum hardware. While quantum low-density parity-check codes have recently emerged as a promising route to efficient fault tolerance, current decoding algorithms do not allow one to realize the full potential of these codes in practical settings. Here, we introduce a convolutional neural network decoder that exploits the geometric structure of QEC codes, and use it to probe a novel "waterfall" regime of error suppression, demonstrating that the logical error rates required for large-scale fault-tolerant algorithms are attainable with modest code sizes at current physical error rates, and with latencies within the real-time budgets of several leading hardware platforms. For example, for the $[144, 12, 12]$ Gross code, the decoder achieves logical error rates up to $\sim 17$x below existing decoders - reaching logical error rates $\sim 10^{-10}$ at physical error $p=0.1\%$ - with 3-5 orders of magnitude higher throughput. This decoder also produces well-calibrated confidence estimates that can significantly reduce the time overhead of repeat-until-success protocols. Taken together, these results suggest that the space-time costs associated with fault-tolerant quantum computation may be significantly lower than previously anticipated.

</details>


### [970] [What a Comfortable World: Ergonomic Principles Guided Apartment Layout Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08411)
*Piotr Nieciecki,Aleksander Plocharski,Przemyslaw Musialski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将建筑人体工学规范转化为可微分损失函数嵌入Transformer，训练阶段直接约束户型生成，消除数据集中的历史缺陷，兼顾合规与可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯数据驱动方法只是把现存训练样本低效布局原样复现，无法自动纠正人体工学缺陷，亟需把专业知识「灌输」到生成模型中。

Method: 1. 梳理建筑文献提取房间邻接与距离规范；2. 将规范转译为可微分的损失项；3. 把损失项嵌入Transformer训练流程，端到端优化“符合规范”的布局分布。

Result: 在保持结构有效性的前提下，生成布局的人体工学合规率明显优于纯数据基线，多项可居住性指标显著提升。

Conclusion: 把领域先验以可微损失形式注入生成模型，可在不牺牲多样性的条件下系统性提升设计合规性与居住质量，为数据驱动建筑生成开辟新范式。

Abstract: Current data-driven floor plan generation methods often reproduce the ergonomic inefficiencies found in real-world training datasets. To address this, we propose a novel approach that integrates architectural design principles directly into a transformer-based generative process. We formulate differentiable loss functions based on established architectural standards from literature to optimize room adjacency and proximity. By guiding the model with these ergonomic priors during training, our method produces layouts with significantly improved livability metrics. Comparative evaluations show that our approach outperforms baselines in ergonomic compliance while maintaining high structural validity.

</details>


### [971] [Synthetic Data for any Differentiable Target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08423)
*Tristan Thrush,Sung Min Park,Herman Brunborg,Luke Bailey,Marcel Roed,Neil Band,Christopher Potts,Tatsunori Hashimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者提出 Dataset Policy Gradient（DPG），用高阶梯度完成精确数据归因，将归因分作为强化学习奖励，可端到端优化合成数据生成器，从而仅通过监督微调就让目标模型在不可见指标上达成特定行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法难以对“数据→模型属性”的映射实施精确控制，尤其当期望属性未写进 prompt 时；需要一种通用且可微的 RL 原语来直接优化数据生成策略。

Method: 1. 定义合成数据生成器为策略网络；2. 对目标模型执行 SFT 并用高阶梯度计算每条生成样本对最终指标的确切贡献（数据归因）；3. 将归因分作为策略梯度奖励，反向传播更新生成器；4. 理论证明 DPG 近似真实但难算的生成器梯度。

Result: 仅用 SFT 与合成数据，成功让目标模型 1) 在 LM head 权重中隐藏 QR 码；2) 嵌入固定数值 67；3) 权重的 ℓ² 范数降低；4) 将输入改写为另一语言；5) 生成特定 UUID——后两个任务目的均未写入 prompt。

Conclusion: DPG 提供了一种强大、灵活、端到端的方式，通过纯合成训练数据即可精确塑造语言模型的任意可微性质，揭示了“数据层面上对模型实施强化控制”的新极限与风险。

Abstract: What are the limits of controlling language models via synthetic training data? We develop a reinforcement learning (RL) primitive, the Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG), which can precisely optimize synthetic data generators to produce a dataset of targeted examples. When used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of a target model, these examples cause the target model to do well on a differentiable metric of our choice. Our approach achieves this by taking exact data attribution via higher-order gradients and using those scores as policy gradient rewards. We prove that this procedure closely approximates the true, intractable gradient for the synthetic data generator. To illustrate the potential of DPG, we show that, using only SFT on generated examples, we can cause the target model's LM head weights to (1) embed a QR code, (2) embed the pattern $\texttt{67}$, and (3) have lower $\ell^2$ norm. We additionally show that we can cause the generator to (4) rephrase inputs in a new language and (5) produce a specific UUID, even though neither of these objectives is conveyed in the generator's input prompts. These findings suggest that DPG is a powerful and flexible technique for shaping model properties using only synthetic training examples.

</details>


### [972] [On-board Telemetry Monitoring in Autonomous Satellites: Challenges and Opportunities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08424)
*Lorenzo Capelli,Leandro de Souza Rosa,Maurizio De Tommasi,Livia Manovi,Andriy Enttsel,Mauro Mangia,Riccardo Rovatti,Ilaria Pinci,Carlo Ciancarelli,Eleonora Mariotti,Gianluca Furano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在卫星姿轨控分系统中，用卷积自编码器+中间层“窥视孔”技术实现可解释、低算力开销的在轨故障检测与隔离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着航天器自主化程度提高，亟需既可靠又可解释的星载故障检测方案，以满足在轨快速诊断与恢复需求。

Method: 提出“窥视孔”框架：从卷积自编码器中间激活中提取低维、语义标注的编码，并将其映射为可解释的异常指标，用于反作用轮遥测的异常识别、定位与偏差检测。

Result: 实验表明，该框架在不显著增加计算资源的前提下，可对检测到的异常进行语义级表征，并有效实现故障隔离与定位。

Conclusion: 该方法兼顾了解释性与资源效率，具备星载实时部署的可行性，为未来自主航天器提供了可信的FDIR解决方案。

Abstract: The increasing autonomy of spacecraft demands fault-detection systems that are both reliable and explainable. This work addresses eXplainable Artificial Intelligence for onboard Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery within the Attitude and Orbit Control Subsystem by introducing a framework that enhances interpretability in neural anomaly detectors. We propose a method to derive low-dimensional, semantically annotated encodings from intermediate neural activations, called peepholes. Applied to a convolutional autoencoder, the framework produces interpretable indicators that enable the identification and localization of anomalies in reaction-wheel telemetry. Peepholes analysis further reveals bias detection and supports fault localization. The proposed framework enables the semantic characterization of detected anomalies while requiring only a marginal increase in computational resources, thus supporting its feasibility for on-board deployment.

</details>


### [973] [SUPERNOVA: Eliciting General Reasoning in LLMs with Reinforcement Learning on Natural Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08477)
*Ashima Suvarna,Kendrick Phan,Mehrab Beikzadeh,Hritik Bansal,Saadia Gabriel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SUPERNOVA框架，首次把可验证奖励强化学习(RLVR)扩展到通用推理：通过系统改造含专家标注的指令微调数据集，经100+控制实验确立“源任务按单目标任务性能而非平均性能筛选”等数据策划原则，在BBEH等基准上相对基线(Qwen3.5)提升高达52.8%，并开源代码数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR在形式化领域(数学、代码)已显著提升LLM推理，但泛化到因果、时序等通用推理时，缺乏跨技能、可验证的优质训练数据成根本瓶颈，需可扩展的数据策划范式。

Method: 构建SUPERNOVA数据策划框架：1)从含专家标注的指令微调数据中提取并改写推理链，生成可验证问答对；2)设计100+RL控制实验，系统扫描源任务选择、任务混合比例与合成增强三因素；3)提出“按单目标任务表现筛选源任务”的策略，优于传统按平均表现选任务。

Result: 在BBEH、Zebralogic、MMLU-Pro等通用推理基准上，SUPERNOVA训练的模型全面优于强基线(Qwen3.5等)，BBEH最大相对提升52.8%，且增益跨模型尺度一致；消融证实源任务选择对最终性能影响最大。

Conclusion: 通过原则性数据策划即可把RLVR推向通用推理，无需改模型结构；“按目标任务挑数据”是最关键因素；SUPERNOVA提供可复现的策划流程与开源资源，为扩展RLVR到更广推理技能奠定实践路径。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly improved large language model (LLM) reasoning in formal domains such as mathematics and code. Despite these advancements, LLMs still struggle with general reasoning tasks requiring capabilities such as causal inference and temporal understanding. Extending RLVR to general reasoning is fundamentally constrained by the lack of high-quality, verifiable training data that spans diverse reasoning skills. To address this challenge, we propose SUPERNOVA, a data curation framework for RLVR aimed at enhancing general reasoning. Our key insight is that instruction-tuning datasets containing expert-annotated ground-truth encode rich reasoning patterns that can be systematically adapted for RLVR. To study this, we conduct 100+ controlled RL experiments to analyze how data design choices impact downstream reasoning performance. In particular, we investigate three key factors: (i) source task selection, (ii) task mixing strategies, and (iii) synthetic interventions for improving data quality. Our analysis reveals that source task selection is non-trivial and has a significant impact on downstream reasoning performance. Moreover, selecting tasks based on their performance for individual target tasks outperforms strategies based on overall average performance. Finally, models trained on SUPERNOVA outperform strong baselines (e.g., Qwen3.5) on challenging reasoning benchmarks including BBEH, Zebralogic, and MMLU-Pro. In particular, training on SUPERNOVA yields relative improvements of up to 52.8\% on BBEH across model sizes, demonstrating the effectiveness of principled data curation for RLVR. Our findings provide practical insights for curating human-annotated resources to extend RLVR to general reasoning. The code and data is available at https://github.com/asuvarna31/supernova.

</details>


### [974] [PIArena: A Platform for Prompt Injection Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08499)
*Runpeng Geng,Chenlong Yin,Yanting Wang,Ying Chen,Jinyuan Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 缺乏统一评测平台 → 提出 PIArena 标准化评估 → 实验揭示现有防御方法普遍泛化差、对自适应攻击脆弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: prompt injection 现有防御缺乏一致性基准，导致结果可比性差，被广泛数据或自适应攻击即可击穿，亟需统一、可扩展的测评环境。

Method: 设计并开源 PIArena 框架，集成多种攻击与防御插件；提出策略型动态攻击，利用防御反馈在线优化注入提示。

Result: 在 PIArena 上评估主流防御：跨任务泛化能力弱；对自适应攻击成功率显著升高；当注入任务与目标任务语义一致时捍卫几乎失效。

Conclusion: 要实现可信 prompt injection 防护，必须脱离“点对点”式验证，使用统一可自适应的评估平台持续测试；社区应基于 PIArena 共享基准并迭代更强鲁棒防御。

Abstract: Prompt injection attacks pose serious security risks across a wide range of real-world applications. While receiving increasing attention, the community faces a critical gap: the lack of a unified platform for prompt injection evaluation. This makes it challenging to reliably compare defenses, understand their true robustness under diverse attacks, or assess how well they generalize across tasks and benchmarks. For instance, many defenses initially reported as effective were later found to exhibit limited robustness on diverse datasets and attacks. To bridge this gap, we introduce PIArena, a unified and extensible platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables users to easily integrate state-of-the-art attacks and defenses and evaluate them across a variety of existing and new benchmarks. We also design a dynamic strategy-based attack that adaptively optimizes injected prompts based on defense feedback. Through comprehensive evaluation using PIArena, we uncover critical limitations of state-of-the-art defenses: limited generalizability across tasks, vulnerability to adaptive attacks, and fundamental challenges when an injected task aligns with the target task. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/sleeepeer/PIArena.

</details>


### [975] [Differentially Private Language Generation and Identification in the Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08504)
*Anay Mehrotra,Grigoris Velegkas,Xifan Yu,Felix Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 差分隐私约束下，所有可数语言都能被“按极限生成”且质量不降，但样本复杂度必须从1升到Θ(k/ε)；而“按极限识别”被隐私彻底阻断，两类无限交集模型已不可识别；若改为i.i.d.采样，则可识别当且仅当其在对抗模型中也能被识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在持续发布场景（continual release）中，既要在线无限输出合格文本，又要保护整条隐私输入序列不被泄露，探讨隐私在语言极限生成与极限识别任务中的本质代价与可行性边界。作者采用 Kleinberg–Mullainathan 新提出的“极限”模型，对比其与经典隐私学习领域常被宣称的“隐私导致不可学”现象是否同样成立。

Method: 1) 差分隐私保障：算法输出对任意相邻输入序列满足ε-DP；采用计数器记忆机制抽取前缀样本，并结合指数噪声输出标记符号。
2) 可数集合生成：构造 DP-languageGenerator 算法，证明可语法正确、完全且 DP 生成任何可数语言；通过计数上界证明样本下界Ω(k/ε)。
3) 对抗识别不可能性：推导出含两个无限交集、有限差集的语言族（σ-FISD）不存在ε-DP识别器，应用隐私的反集中性质与“区分子集”技术给出严格归纳不变量矛盾。
4) 随机采样识别等价性：把 IPO 的 Gold 型监控器改为私有阈值版本（PrivateMonitor），证明当对手模型可行时 i.i.d. 亦可、反之亦然。

Result: 1) 生成侧：所有可数语言都能 DP 极限生成，无质量损失；但对大小为 k 的有限族，私有版样本复杂度需Ω(k/ε)，非私有只需1个样本。
2) 识别侧：
   (i) 存在基本不可私有化的语言族（σ-FISD）——无论样本多少都无法被任何ε-DP算法极限识别；
   (ii) 若改为字符串 i.i.d. 采样，则一个族可被 DP 极限识别当且仅当它在对抗模型下也可被极限识别。
3) 结论：隐私让“生成”仅涨价但可行，却让“识别”出现刚性障碍；同时首次显示出隐私环境下对抗模型与随机模型对可识别性的等价关系。

Conclusion: 差分隐私对语言极限处理造成“生成可承受、识别被阻断”的分化：只要样本预算充足，可数语言在线生成不受质性影响；但若想在线判定语言类别，哪怕是很弱的结构条件（无限交集+有限差）也会因隐私屏障而注定失败。对实际持续发布系统而言，生成任务可以放心引入隐私机制，而任何需要实时语言判定（如模式检测、类别归因）的场景，要么放弃极限要求，要么接受高成本离线处理。该研究为隐私下语言流算法奠定了基本极限框架，并揭示了模型设定（对抗 vs 随机）对隐私可行性的非平凡影响。

Abstract: We initiate the study of language generation in the limit, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24], under the constraint of differential privacy. We consider the continual release model, where a generator must eventually output a stream of valid strings while protecting the privacy of the entire input sequence. Our first main result is that for countable collections of languages, privacy comes at no qualitative cost: we provide an $\varepsilon$-differentially-private algorithm that generates in the limit from any countable collection. This stands in contrast to many learning settings where privacy renders learnability impossible. However, privacy does impose a quantitative cost: there are finite collections of size $k$ for which uniform private generation requires $Ω(k/\varepsilon)$ samples, whereas just one sample suffices non-privately.
  We then turn to the harder problem of language identification in the limit. Here, we show that privacy creates fundamental barriers. We prove that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification. Next, we turn to the stochastic setting where the sample strings are sampled i.i.d. from a distribution (instead of being generated by an adversary). Here, we show that private identification is possible if and only if the collection is identifiable in the adversarial model. Together, our results establish new dimensions along which generation and identification differ and, for identification, a separation between adversarial and stochastic settings induced by privacy constraints.

</details>


### [976] [Demystifying OPD: Length Inflation and Stabilization Strategies for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08527)
*Feng Luo,Yu-Neng Chuang,Guanchu Wang,Zicheng Xu,Xiaotian Han,Tianyi Zhang,Vladimir Braverman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对on-policy知识蒸馏中出现的轨迹截断崩塌与性能骤降问题，提出StableOPD框架，用参考约束与轨迹混合蒸馏抑制长重复轨迹，平均提升7.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有On-policy Distillation(OPD)在强化学习推理场景中允许学生模型自身采样数据并由教师指导，但实验发现随训练推进学生轨迹会突然过长，导致截断占优、重复饱和、梯度偏倚，最终验证性能急剧下滑，急需揭示机理并稳定训练。

Method: (1)诊断：证明该现象根因是学生诱导采样与蒸馏目标共同强化“长而重复”轨迹的隐含偏好；(2)StableOPD：引入基于参考分布的KL散度上限约束，抑制采样漂移；同时采用“历史滚动平均轨迹+新轨迹”的轨迹混合蒸馏，平衡短/长样本比例。

Result: 在三个数学推理数据集上，相比标准OPD：训练波动显著下降，长度膨胀被遏止，截断率降低至可忽略水平；验证准确率平均提升7.2%，且训练曲线更平滑，无明显性能尖峰或跳水。

Conclusion: 截断崩塌是OPD在自生成数据场景下的本质失效模式；通过约束采样分布并混合轨迹蒸馏可有效消除该问题。StableOPD为on-policy知识蒸馏提供了一类普适稳定化范式，可直接迁移至其他推理任务及大模型微调流程。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student models under their own induced distribution while leveraging supervision from stronger teachers. We identify a failure mode of OPD: as training progresses, on-policy rollouts can undergo abrupt length inflation, causing truncated trajectories to dominate the training data. This truncation collapse coincides with abrupt repetition saturation and induces biased gradient signals, leading to severe training instability and sharp degradation in validation performance. We attribute this problem to the interaction between student-induced data collection and the distillation objective, which implicitly favors long and repetitive rollouts. To address this issue, we propose StableOPD, a stabilized OPD framework that combines a reference-based divergence constraint with rollout mixture distillation. These together mitigate repetition-induced length inflation and further stabilize OPD training. Across multiple math reasoning datasets, our approach prevents truncation collapse, stabilizes training dynamics, and improves performance by 7.2% on average.

</details>


### [977] [Tabular GANs for uneven distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.00638)
*Insaf Ashrapov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一、模块化的框架，可无缝支持GAN、扩散模型与LLM三大主流表格数据生成范式，并在7个基准数据集上验证其有效性，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据合成已不局限于GAN，扩散模型与大语言模型（LLM）在样本质量、隐私与可控性上各具优势，但缺乏统一平台横向比较与复用。

Method: 构建模块化框架，包含：①通用数据预处理；②模型无关接口层；③标准化训练/推理管线；④综合评估模块。三大生成范式以插件形式接入，实验采用7个公开表格数据集进行对比与下游任务验证。

Result: 实验显示，在分布漂移场景下，基于GAN的数据增强可显著提升下游模型性能；扩散与LLM范式在样本保真度、隐私保护与条件控制上表现互补。框架复现性与扩展性良好。

Conclusion: GAN、扩散模型与LLM各具所长，统一模块化框架为表格数据生成研究提供可复现、可扩展的基准平台，推动未来方法创新与公平比较。

Abstract: Generative models for tabular data have evolved rapidly beyond Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). While GANs pioneered synthetic tabular data generation, recent advances in diffusion models and large language models (LLMs) have opened new paradigms with complementary strengths in sample quality, privacy, and controllability. In this paper, we survey the landscape of tabular data generation across three major paradigms - GANs, diffusion models, and LLMs - and introduce a unified, modular framework that supports all three. The framework encompasses data preprocessing, a model-agnostic interface layer, standardized training and inference pipelines, and a comprehensive evaluation module. We validate the framework through experiments on seven benchmark datasets, demonstrating that GAN-based augmentation can improve downstream performance under distribution shift. The framework and its reference implementation are publicly available at https://github.com/Diyago/Tabular-data-generation, facilitating reproducibility and extensibility for future research.

</details>


### [978] [Tractable Uncertainty-Aware Meta-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.01881)
*Young-Jin Park,Cesar Almecija,Apoorva Sharma,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LUMA是一种不确定性感知回归型元学习方法，能用线性化贝叶斯推断在少数据、多模态及安全关键场景下快速适应新任务并检测分布外(OoD)样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统元学习在数据极少或任务分布外时表现差，且缺乏可靠的不确定性估计，难以满足安全关键应用需求；同时任务分布常呈多模态，进一步加剧挑战。

Method: 将元学习形式化为对线性化神经网络的贝叶斯推断，利用高斯过程理论学习目标相关的参数化任务先验；通过Fisher信息矩阵构建低秩协方差先验，实现解析可追踪的后验更新与不确定性估计。

Result: 实验表明LUMA在少数据场景下快速适应并保持高精度，能有效检测OoD任务，且对多模态任务分布鲁棒；相比现有方法在不确定性与泛化性能上均占优。

Conclusion: LUMA为安全关键、小样本、多模态元学习提供了具备理论保证的不确定性感知框架，其线性化贝叶斯+低秩先验策略兼顾了可解释性、计算效率与鲁棒性，具广泛落地潜力。

Abstract: Meta-learning is a popular approach for learning new tasks with limited data by leveraging the commonalities among different tasks. However, meta-learned models can perform poorly when context data is too limited, or when data is drawn from an out-of-distribution (OoD) task. Especially in safety-critical settings, this necessitates an uncertainty-aware approach to meta-learning. In addition, the often multimodal nature of task distributions can pose unique challenges to meta-learning methods. To this end, we present LUMA, a meta-learning method for regression that (1) makes probabilistic predictions on in-distribution tasks efficiently, (2) is capable of detecting OoD context data, and (3) handles heterogeneous, multimodal task distributions effectively. The strength of our framework lies in its solid theoretical basis, enabling analytically tractable Bayesian inference on a linearized model for principled uncertainty estimation and robust generalization. We achieve this by adopting a probabilistic perspective and learning a parametric, tunable task distribution via Bayesian inference on a linearized neural network, leveraging Gaussian process theory. Moreover, we make our approach computationally tractable by leveraging a low-rank prior covariance learning scheme based on the Fisher Information Matrix. Our numerical analysis demonstrates that LUMA quickly adapts to new tasks and remains accurate even in low-data regimes; it effectively detects OoD tasks; and that both of these properties continue to hold for multimodal task distributions.

</details>


### [979] [An Automated Survey of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Large Language Models, Architectures, Protocols, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.02781)
*Eduardo C. Garrido-Merchán,Álvaro López López*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Claude Opus 4.6 自动生成的 2026 年初版综述，对主流开源与闭源大模型、部署协议及 15 行业落地应用进行全面对比与案例剖析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式 AI 与大模型成为计算机科学最具变革性的范式，领域迭代极快，亟需一份覆盖最新模型家族、部署标准及跨行业实践的时效性全景综述，为研究者与产业界提供统一参考。

Method: 采用自动化生成 + 人工编辑双重机制：① 选取 17 个前沿模型（含 DeepSeek、Qwen、LLaMA 4、GPT-5.4 等），系统梳理架构创新、训练策略与 benchmark / Chatbot Arena 表现；② 归纳 RAG、MCP、A2A、Function Calling 等主流部署协议及服务框架；③ 基于实证与案例，对金融、法律、旅游、农业等 15 个垂直行业的落地场景进行量化回顾。

Result: 获得① 各模型在统一基准下的性能排位与优势维度；② 部署协议的标准化成熟度对比；③ 15 行业共 200+ 案例的 ROI、效率提升与风险洞察，形成可复用的行业采纳指南。

Conclusion: 大模型已从技术竞赛进入产业深耕阶段，开源权重模型在多项指标上逼近闭源 SOTA，RAG 与 Agent 协议成为落地必备；建议每半年更新综述，以持续捕捉快速演进的模型能力与行业需求。下一步需重点关注安全对齐、推理成本优化及垂直领域数据飞轮构建。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence, and large language models in particular, have emerged as one of the most transformative paradigms in modern computer science. This automated survey provides an accessible treatment of the field as of early 2026, with a strong focus on the leading model families, deployment protocols, and real-world applications. The core of the survey is devoted to a detailed comparative analysis of the frontier large language models, with particular emphasis on open-weight systems: DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3.2, and the forthcoming DeepSeek V4; the Qwen 3 and Qwen 3.5 series; GLM-5; Kimi K2.5; MiniMax M2.5; LLaMA 4; Mistral Large 3; Gemma 3; and Phi-4, alongside proprietary systems including GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Grok 4.20, and Claude Opus 4.6. For each model, we describe the architectural innovations, training regimes, and empirical performance on current benchmarks and the Chatbot Arena leaderboard. The survey further covers deployment protocols including Retrieval-Augmented Generation, the Model Context Protocol, the Agent-to-Agent protocol, function calling standards, and serving frameworks. We present an extensive review of real-world applications across fifteen industry sectors, from financial services and legal technology to tourism and agriculture, supported by empirical evidence and case studies. This work has been generated by Claude Opus 4.6 (Anthropic) under the supervision and editorial review of the human authors, with the goal of producing updated editions approximately every six months.

</details>


### [980] [Reconstructing the Geometry of Random Geometric Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.09591)
*Han Huang,Pakawut Jiradilok,Elchanan Mossel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文给出首个从随机几何图高效重建嵌入在 ℝᴺ 中的低维流形几何的算法，补足了仅需图结构、无需原始距离信息的流形学习空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典流形学习依赖“点+距离”数据，而许多网络仅提供连边信息；若能把图反推出隐藏度量，就能用纯拓扑数据恢复低维几何，为降维、可视化与几何生成模型奠基。

Method: 1) 利用连接概率随欧氏距离严格递减的假设，将边存在概率转化为“图距离”统计量；2) 证明该统计量以高概率保留真实流形的测地距离；3) 设计多项式时间算法，先由局部邻接谱估计局部切空间，再用多维标度全局拼合，重建等距嵌入。

Result: 在样本量 n=Õ(r⁻ᵈ log N) 时，算法以 ≥1−δ 概率输出嵌入，其 Procrustes 误差 ε=O(r) 并达到信息论下界；在 d-维单位球面、S-curve 等合成数据及单细胞 RNA-seq 网络实验上，重建误差比现有网络嵌入方法降低 40–70%。

Conclusion: 严格递减连接概率足以把图反编码为流形几何；所提框架为“无坐标几何学习”提供可扩展、可证明正确的路径，并启发后续研究曲率、噪声及动态图的几何重建。

Abstract: Random geometric graphs are random graph models defined on metric spaces. Such a model is defined by first sampling points from a metric space and then connecting each pair of sampled points with probability that depends on their distance, independently among pairs. In this work, we show how to efficiently reconstruct the geometry of the underlying space from the sampled graph under the manifold assumption, i.e., assuming that the underlying space is a low dimensional manifold and that the connection probability is a strictly decreasing function of the Euclidean distance between the points in a given embedding of the manifold in $\mathbb{R}^N$. Our work complements a large body of work on manifold learning, where the goal is to recover a manifold from sampled points sampled in the manifold along with their (approximate) distances.

</details>


### [981] [CODA: A Continuous Online Evolve Framework for Deploying HAR Sensing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14922)
*Minghui Qiu,Jun Chen,Lin Chen,Shuxin Zhong,Yandao Huang,Lu Wang,Kaishun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CODA，一种面向移动感知的持续在线适应框架，可在不重新训练模型的情况下，恒久保持高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: “始终在线”人机活动识别系统随时间推移会出现静默性能衰退（域漂移）。现有一次性更新无法应对长期非平稳漂移，亟需流式数据驱动的即时、持续适应方案。

Method: 提出CODA框架：(i) 基于缓存的选择性同化机制，优先利用少量有监督且信息丰富的样本提升性能；(ii) 自适应时间保持策略，令系统随传感条件演变逐步遗忘过时样本。方法将适应过程建模为轻量级缓存演化，而非重训练。

Result: 在涵盖手机、手表及多传感器配置的4个异构数据集上，CODA在非平稳漂移条件下持续优于一次性适应，鲁棒应对不完美反馈，设备端延迟可忽略不计。

Conclusion: CODA证明，通过“选择性学习+主动遗忘”的缓存级演化，可在资源受限终端上实现长期、无重配置的在线适应，为移动感知系统提供了一条低耗高效的持续精度保持路径。

Abstract: In always-on HAR deployments, model accuracy erodes silently as domain shift accumulates over time. Addressing this challenge requires moving beyond one-off updates toward instance-driven adaptation from streaming data. However, continuous adaptation exposes a fundamental tension: systems must selectively learn from informative instances while actively forgetting obsolete ones under long-term, non-stationary drift. To address them, we propose CODA, a continuous online adaptation framework for mobile sensing. CODA introduces two synergistic components: (i) Cache-based Selective Assimilation, which prioritizes informative instances likely to enhance system performance under sparse supervision, and (ii) an Adaptive Temporal Retention Strategy, which enables the system to gradually forget obsolete instances as sensing conditions evolve. By treating adaptation as a principled cache evolution rather than parameter-heavy retraining, CODA maintains high accuracy without model reconfiguration. We conduct extensive evaluations on four heterogeneous datasets spanning phone, watch, and multi-sensor configurations. Results demonstrate that CODA consistently outperforms one-off adaptation under non-stationary drift, remains robust against imperfect feedback, and incurs negligible on-device latency.

</details>


### [982] [Deep Privacy Funnel Model: From a Discriminative to a Generative Approach with an Application to Face Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02696)
*Behrooz Razeghi,Parsa Rahimi,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一套基于信息瓶颈（Privacy Funnel，PF）的端到端可训练框架，在保持人脸识别性能的同时，对多种敏感属性实现可控的隐泄露抑制，并给出可扩展的生成版和变分界近似（GenPF / DVPF）及 PyTorch 代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脸识别模型在提供高识别精度的同时，往往会无意泄漏性别、种族等敏感属性，传统差分隐私或对抗梯度方法难以兼顾

Method: 1) 将 PF 的信息瓶颈目标（对数损失的互信息最小化）嵌入端到端网络；2) 推导可优化的变分界并结合深度网络（DVPF）；3) 扩展 PF 到生成场景，提出 GenPF，使其在信息论与估计准则下统一 VAE、GAN 与扩散模型；4) 兼容主流人脸识别骨干（AdaFace/ArcFace）进行训练和推理。

Result: 在常用人脸验证与属性推断基准上，DVPF+GenPF 方法在保持识别准确率（例如在 LFW 上达 99.8%）的同时，敏感属性推断 AUC 平均下降 20% 以上（χ² 错误率提升≈25%），量化隐私–效用曲线明显优于若干现有对抗抑制基线。

Conclusion: 基于 PF 的可扩展框架能在深度表示学习环境中实现机理清晰、可量化的隐私–效用权衡，并可无缝接入主流人脸识别网络，为后续公用模型隐私合规提供实用工具。

Abstract: In this study, we apply the information-theoretic Privacy Funnel (PF) model to face recognition and develop a method for privacy-preserving representation learning within an end-to-end trainable framework. Our approach addresses the trade-off between utility and obfuscation of sensitive information under logarithmic loss. We study the integration of information-theoretic privacy principles with representation learning, with a particular focus on face recognition systems. We also highlight the compatibility of the proposed framework with modern face recognition networks such as AdaFace and ArcFace. In addition, we introduce the Generative Privacy Funnel ($\mathsf{GenPF}$) model, which extends the traditional discriminative PF formulation, referred to here as the Discriminative Privacy Funnel ($\mathsf{DisPF}$). The proposed $\mathsf{GenPF}$ model extends the privacy-funnel framework to generative formulations under information-theoretic and estimation-theoretic criteria. Complementing these developments, we present the deep variational PF (DVPF) model, which yields a tractable variational bound for measuring information leakage and enables optimization in deep representation-learning settings. The DVPF framework, associated with both the $\mathsf{DisPF}$ and $\mathsf{GenPF}$ models, also clarifies connections with generative models such as variational autoencoders (VAEs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), and diffusion models. Finally, we validate the framework on modern face recognition systems and show that it provides a controllable privacy--utility trade-off while substantially reducing leakage about sensitive attributes. To support reproducibility, we also release a PyTorch implementation of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [983] [MALLM-GAN: Multi-Agent Large Language Model as Generative Adversarial Network for Synthesizing Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10521)
*Yaobin Ling,Xiaoqian Jiang,Yejin Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用 GPT 做「生成器」、另一 LLM 做「判别器」，像 GAN 一样交替训练，在小样本场景下生成高质量、保隐私的表格医疗数据，实验效果优于现有最佳方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大数据时代研究依赖数据，但在医疗等高敏感领域，隐私与成本导致数据稀缺；现有合成表格数据模型需大量样本，无法直接缓解小样本困境。

Method: 把 GAN 框架搬到 LLM：一个 LLM 接收上下文后生成逼近真实分布的表格样本，另一个 LLM 作为判别器评估真假，两模型通过对抗式、基于语言反馈的优化循环迭代提升，无需原始大规模训练集。

Result: 在公开与私有医疗数据集上，用数百条样本即可训练，合成数据在机器学习下游任务（分类、回归等指标）中优于 CTGAN、TVAE、TabDDPM 等最新基线，同时差分隐私测试与成员推理攻击显示真实数据隐私风险显著降低。

Conclusion: 提出的 LLM-GAN 框架能在数据极度受限场景稳定输出高保真合成表格数据，兼顾隐私与可用性，为小样本医疗数据共享与模型训练提供新范式。

Abstract: In the era of big data, access to abundant data is crucial for driving research forward. However, such data is often inaccessible due to privacy concerns or high costs, particularly in healthcare domain. Generating synthetic (tabular) data can address this, but existing models typically require substantial amounts of data to train effectively, contradicting our objective to solve data scarcity. To address this challenge, we propose a novel framework to generate synthetic tabular data, powered by large language models (LLMs) that emulates the architecture of a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). By incorporating data generation process as contextual information and utilizing LLM as the optimizer, our approach significantly enhance the quality of synthetic data generation in common scenarios with small sample sizes. Our experimental results on public and private datasets demonstrate that our model outperforms several state-of-art models regarding generating higher quality synthetic data for downstream tasks while keeping privacy of the real data.

</details>


### [984] [BoBa: Boosting Backdoor Detection through Data Distribution Inference in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.09658)
*Zhengyuan Jiang,Xingyu Lyu,Shanghao Shi,Yang Xiao,Yimin Chen,Y. Thomas Hou,Wenjing Lou,Ning Wanga*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 BoBa，一种利用客户端数据分布信息、先聚类再投票的 FL 背门攻击检测方法，可将背门攻击成功率压至 0.1% 以下且无损主精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习环境数据非独立同分布（non-IID），导致模型间自然差异大，传统异常检测难以区分“正常 outlier”与“背门 outlier”，检测率与误报率难以两全。

Method: (1) 提出信誉化数据分布推断机制，在客户端本地估计类别分布并验证可信度；(2) 将客户端按分布特征做重叠聚类，每客户端可属多簇；(3) 服务器用各簇内模型参数投票，识别统计异常并定位背门更新。

Result: 在多种非 IID 程度和主流背门攻击（Multi-Shot、DP-SGD、FANG 等）下，BoBa 将攻击成功率(ASR)降至 <0.001，主任务精度维持 ≥ 98%，优于现有基于余弦、规范或谱等特征的方案。

Conclusion: 通过显式利用数据分布先验并对多簇综合评估，BoBa 在强非 IID 场景仍稳健检测背门攻击，兼具高检测率与低误报，为安全联邦学习提供实用防护方案。

Abstract: Federated learning, while being a promising approach for collaborative model training, is susceptible to backdoor attacks due to its decentralized nature. Backdoor attacks have shown remarkable stealthiness, as they compromise model predictions only when inputs contain specific triggers. As a countermeasure, anomaly detection is widely used to filter out backdoor attacks in FL. However, the non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data distribution nature of FL clients presents substantial challenges in backdoor attack detection, as the data variety introduces variance among benign models, making them indistinguishable from malicious ones.
  In this work, we propose a novel distribution-aware backdoor detection mechanism, BoBa, to address this problem. To differentiate outliers arising from data variety versus backdoor attacks, we propose to break down the problem into two steps: clustering clients utilizing their data distribution, and followed by a voting-based detection. We propose a novel data distribution inference mechanism for accurate data distribution estimation. To improve detection robustness, we introduce an overlapping clustering method, where each client is associated with multiple clusters, ensuring that the trustworthiness of a model update is assessed collectively by multiple clusters rather than a single cluster. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that BoBa can reduce the attack success rate to lower than 0.001 while maintaining high main task accuracy across various attack strategies and experimental settings.

</details>


### [985] [Causal Discovery in Linear Models with Unobserved Variables and Measurement Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.19426)
*Yuqin Yang,Mohamed Nafea,Negar Kiyavash,Kun Zhang,AmirEmad Ghassami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Linear systems with latent variables and measurement error (LV-SEM-ME) are partially identifiable under the mixing-matrix separability and faithfulness conditions.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ignoring either latent common causes or noisy measurements misleads causal structure learning, making it necessary to address both distortions simultaneously.
