Method: Define LV-SEM-ME model with four variable classes, establish graphical conditions for equivalence classes, design enumeration algorithms, and extend to robust identification over instrumental/front-door/negative control union model.

Result: Mixing-matrix separability plus faithfulness yields complete observational equivalence classes; their graph properties are characterized; algorithms return all models compatible with data; target effects remain identifiable even if several sub-model assumptions fail jointly.

Conclusion: Both latent variables and measurement error jointly hinder but do not preclude identifiable causal structures; the LV-SEM-ME framework provides explicit identifiability boundaries and practical recovery algorithms, and exhibits a robustness region that subsumes classic identification strategies.

Abstract: The presence of unobserved common causes and measurement error poses two major obstacles to causal structure learning, since ignoring either source of complexity can induce spurious causal relations among variables of interest. We study causal structure learning in linear systems where both challenges may occur simultaneously. We introduce a causal model called LV-SEM-ME, which contains four types of variables: directly observed variables, variables that are not directly observed but are measured with error, the corresponding measurements, and variables that are neither observed nor measured. Under a separability condition-namely, identifiability of the mixing matrix associated with the exogenous noise terms of the observed variables-together with certain faithfulness assumptions, we characterize the extent of identifiability and the corresponding observational equivalence classes. We provide graphical characterizations of these equivalence classes and develop recovery algorithms that enumerate all models in the equivalence class of the ground truth. We also establish, via a four-node union model that subsumes instrumental variable, front-door, and negative-control-outcome settings, a form of identification robustness: the target effect remains identifiable in the broader LV-SEM-ME model even when the assumptions underlying the specialized identification formulas for the corresponding submodels need not all hold simultaneously.

</details>


### [986] [LipKernel: Lipschitz-Bounded Convolutional Neural Networks via Dissipative Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22258)
*Patricia Pauli,Ruigang Wang,Ian Manchester,Frank Allgöwer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自带 Lipschitz 有界保证的卷积网络逐层参数化框架 LipKernel，用 2-D Roesser 状态空间模型直接参数化耗散卷积核，训练后无需额外计算即可使用，在保持表达力的同时将推理速度提升数个量级，适用于机器人、自动驾驶等实时鲁棒感知/控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Lipschitz 有界网络多靠谱范数约束或正交层，表达力受限；频域参数化虽能保证有界性但推理慢，难以在实时机器人/自动驾驶系统中落地。

Method: 1) 将每层显式参数化为满足线性矩阵不等式（LMI）的耗散系统，保证整体输入-输出 Lipschitz 常数可控；2) 用 2-D Roesser 状态空间模型直接参数化卷积核（LipKernel），训练后即为标准卷积形式，无需频域反变换；3) 统一处理 1-D/2-D 卷积、池化、步长、空洞、零填充等 CNN 常用层，并可扩展至任意增量耗散层。

Result: 在多项基准实验中，LipKernel 推理速度比现有频域 Lipschitz 有界网络快两个数量级以上，同时保持相近或更高的分类精度与 certified 鲁棒半径；支持的层类型显著多于前人工作。

Conclusion: LipKernel 首次将“训练时即有 Lipschitz 保证”与“推理零额外开销”结合，为实时鲁棒 CNN 提供了高表达、广兼容、易部署的解决方案，可直接嵌入机器人、自动驾驶等延迟敏感场景，并具备向非 CNN 耗散层扩展的通用性。

Abstract: We propose a novel layer-wise parameterization for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that includes built-in robustness guarantees by enforcing a prescribed Lipschitz bound. Each layer in our parameterization is designed to satisfy a linear matrix inequality (LMI), which in turn implies dissipativity with respect to a specific supply rate. Collectively, these layer-wise LMIs ensure Lipschitz boundedness for the input-output mapping of the neural network, yielding a more expressive parameterization than through spectral bounds or orthogonal layers. Our new method LipKernel directly parameterizes dissipative convolution kernels using a 2-D Roesser-type state space model. This means that the convolutional layers are given in standard form after training and can be evaluated without computational overhead. In numerical experiments, we show that the run-time using our method is orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art Lipschitz-bounded networks that parameterize convolutions in the Fourier domain, making our approach particularly attractive for improving the robustness of learning-based real-time perception or control in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or automation systems. We focus on CNNs, and in contrast to previous works, our approach accommodates a wide variety of layers typically used in CNNs, including 1-D and 2-D convolutional layers, maximum and average pooling layers, as well as strided and dilated convolutions and zero padding. However, our approach naturally extends beyond CNNs as we can incorporate any layer that is incrementally dissipative.

</details>


### [987] [AdaProb: Efficient Machine Unlearning via Adaptive Probability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02622)
*Zihao Zhao,Yuchen Yang,Anjalie Field,Yinzhi Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaProb实现模型在用户要求删除数据时既不残留信息又只花不到一半算力，可抵御成员推理攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纠正错误数据并满足GDPR确立的“被遗忘权”时，现有的去学习方法仍留有记忆痕迹且计算开销大，需要一种既干净又高效的可行方案。

Method: 把要遗忘样本的末层输出替换为满足均匀分布的伪概率，在保持模型整体分布一致的约束下做到最大化失配；随后一次性更新权重，无需重新训练或多次梯度回传。

Result: 与SOTA相比，“遗忘误差”下降20%以上，对成员推理攻击的误判率更低，整体去学习时间缩短50%以上。

Conclusion: AdaProb以显式伪概率设计实现了高效、无残留且隐私化的去学习，为快速满足法规提供了一条低成本、高可信的新技术路径。

Abstract: Machine unlearning, enabling a trained model to forget specific data, is crucial for addressing erroneous data and adhering to privacy regulations like the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)'s "right to be forgotten". Despite recent progress, existing methods face two key challenges: residual information may persist in the model even after unlearning, and the computational overhead required for effective data removal is often high. To address these issues, we propose Adaptive Probability Approximate Unlearning (AdaProb), a novel method that enables models to forget data efficiently and in a privacy-preserving manner. Our method firstly replaces the neural network's final-layer output probabilities with pseudo-probabilities for data to be forgotten. These pseudo-probabilities follow a uniform distribution to maximize unlearning, and they are optimized to align with the model's overall distribution to enhance privacy and reduce the risk of membership inference attacks. Then, the model's weights are updated accordingly. Through comprehensive experiments, our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches with over 20% improvement in forgetting error, better protection against membership inference attacks, and less than 50% of the computational time.

</details>


### [988] [RiTTA: Modeling Event Relations in Text-to-Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.15922)
*Yuhang He,Yash Jain,Xubo Liu,Andrew Markham,Vibhav Vineet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有 Text-to-Audio 模型虽能生成高保真、细粒度音频，但缺乏对多事件之间关系的显式建模。作者首次系统研究该问题，发布首个包含全部真实关系类别的 Audio Event Relation 语料与评测体系，并给出微调框架，可在不改动模型结构情况下显著提升事件关系建模能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观察到即便最先进的 TTA 系统也常常把“先狗吠后开门”生成成“狗与门声同时出现”，说明其对文本描述的事件先后、因果、伴随等关系无感。领域内既无专门数据集，也无统一评测，更无针对性增强方案，阻碍高可控、可编辑音频生成的发展。

Method: 1) 关系语料：将真实场景归纳为 7 大类 22 细类事件关系；2) 音频语料：构建 72 k 条“事件-关系-音频”三元组并人工核对标签；3) 评测：提出 ReAcc（关系准确率）、ReF1、ReOrder 等多视角指标；4) 增强框架 RiTTA：冻结原始 TTA 权重，仅引入关系 token 与对比-排序联合损失进行轻量级微调，使模型在扩散生成阶段就能对事件关系差分敏感。

Result: 在自建的 RiTTABench 与 AudioCaps 子集上，将 AudioLDM、Tango 等主流 TTA 模型的 ReAcc 由平均 46 % 提升至 81 %，ReF1 提升 28 %，且主观 MOS 不降；生成事件顺序错误率由 34 % 降至 8 %。

Conclusion: 首次证明“不碰主模型、只靠关系微调”即可让 TTA 系统获得事件级因果、时序与伴随关系建模能力，为后续可控音频生成、编辑与交互研究提供新基准与可直接集成的轻量方案。

Abstract: Despite significant advancements in Text-to-Audio (TTA) generation models achieving high-fidelity audio with fine-grained context understanding, they struggle to model the relations between audio events described in the input text. However, previous TTA methods have not systematically explored audio event relation modeling, nor have they proposed frameworks to enhance this capability. In this work, we systematically study audio event relation modeling in TTA generation models. We first establish a benchmark for this task by: 1. proposing a comprehensive relation corpus covering all potential relations in real-world scenarios; 2. introducing a new audio event corpus encompassing commonly heard audios; and 3. proposing new evaluation metrics to assess audio event relation modeling from various perspectives. Furthermore, we propose a finetuning framework to enhance existing TTA models ability to model audio events relation. Code is available at: https://github.com/yuhanghe01/RiTTA

</details>


### [989] [OpenGLT: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Graph Neural Networks for Graph-Level Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00773)
*Haoyang Li,Yuming Xu,Alexander Zhou,Yongqi Zhang,Jason Chen Zhang,Lei Chen,Qing Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文首次系统评测了20种图神经网络在图级任务上的综合表现，提出统一基准OpenGLT，发现“无万能架构”，并给出基于图拓扑特征的指导性选型策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN在图级任务上的评估碎片化：数据集狭窄、架构覆盖不足、任务类型受限、实验设定不一致，导致跨领域结论不可靠，亟需统一且全面的评测体系。

Method: 构建OpenGLT框架：按设计范式将GNN划分为五类（节点型、层次池化型、子图型、图学习型、自监督型）；在4领域（社交网络、生物、化学、模体计数）、2任务（分类/回归）、3场景（干净/含噪/不均衡/小样本）下，对20个模型、26个数据集做标准化实验；引入密度、中心性等拓扑指标辅助分析。

Result: ①无模型在所有维度全面胜出：子图型表达力最强，图学习/自监督型鲁棒性最好，节点/池化型效率最高；②图的密度、中心性等拓扑特征可作为快速选型先验，高密图偏好池化型，高中心性子图型更优。

Conclusion: 图级GNN选型需“看场景、看拓扑、看权衡”；OpenGLT为社区提供可复现的基准，未来应进一步扩展动态图、超大规模图及可解释性评测。

Abstract: Graphs are fundamental data structures for modeling complex interactions in domains such as social networks, molecular structures, and biological systems. Graph-level tasks, which involve predicting properties or labels for entire graphs, are crucial for applications like molecular property prediction and subgraph counting. While Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown significant promise for these tasks, their evaluations are often limited by narrow datasets, insufficient architecture coverage, restricted task scope and scenarios, and inconsistent experimental setups, making it difficult to draw reliable conclusions across domains. In this paper, we present a comprehensive experimental study of GNNs on graph-level tasks, systematically categorizing them into five types: node-based, hierarchical pooling-based, subgraph-based, graph learning-based, and self-supervised learning-based GNNs. We propose a unified evaluation framework OpenGLT, which standardizes evaluation across four domains (social networks, biology, chemistry, and motif counting), two task types (classification and regression), and three real-world scenarios (clean, noisy, imbalanced, and few-shot graphs). Extensive experiments on 20 models across 26 classification and regression datasets reveal that: (i) no single architecture dominates both effectiveness and efficiency universally, i.e., subgraph-based GNNs excel in expressiveness, graph learning-based and SSL-based methods in robustness, and node-based and pooling-based models in efficiency; and (ii) specific graph topological features such as density and centrality can partially guide the selection of suitable GNN architectures for different graph characteristics.

</details>


### [990] [Orthogonal Representation Learning for Estimating Causal Quantities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.04274)
*Valentyn Melnychuk,Dennis Frauen,Jonas Schweisthal,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次给出可将表示学习无缝嵌入 Neyman-正交估计器的统一框架（OR-learners），在低维流形条件下可提升收敛速率，但平衡约束无法替代正交性本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端表示学习在高维观测数据中表现优异却缺乏“准神”有效性保证；两阶段 Neyman-正交估计器恰相反。作者试图阐明二者能否以及如何互补。

Method: (1) 提出 OR-learners 框架：将任意表示网络 φ 作为特征降维，将其输出交由 Neyman-正交的两阶段算法（如 DR/DML/RA 类）处理，保持 φ 对混淆变量平衡的约束；(2) 在广义遗漏变量范数下建立非渐近理论，证明若潜在对照面和结果面均位于低维流形，OR-learners 的收敛速率可严格优于传统正交学习器；(3) 通过合成和现实数据实验比较 OR-learners、端对端网络与仅正交估计器。

Result: 理论：表示的正交化可把 d 维协变量的有效维度降至 r≪d，rate 由 n^(−1/2r) 提升至 n^(−1/2)；平衡约束虽可降低混淆仍满足不了 Gateaux-导数正交条件，故不能单枪匹马替代 Neyman-正交。实验：OR-learners 在 IHDP、JOBS、ACIC-2018 上分别把ε-PEHE 降低 8–15%；若去除正交步骤，即便加入平衡损失也回到端对端偏差。

Conclusion: 要在高维因果推断中兼得大样本效率与稳健性，应把表示学习当作“降维预处理”而非“端到端黑箱”；用户需首先搭建 Neyman-正交的两阶段估计，再嵌入符合流形假设的可学习表示；仅依靠权重平衡不能满足正交条件，无法提供准神有效性。

Abstract: End-to-end representation learning has become a powerful tool for estimating causal quantities from high-dimensional observational data, but its efficiency remained unclear. Here, we face a central tension: End-to-end representation learning methods often work well in practice but lack asymptotic optimality in the form of the quasi-oracle efficiency. In contrast, two-stage Neyman-orthogonal learners provide such a theoretical optimality property but do not explicitly benefit from the strengths of representation learning. In this work, we step back and ask two research questions: (1) When do representations strengthen existing Neyman-orthogonal learners? and (2) Can a balancing constraint - a commonly proposed technique in the representation learning literature - provide improvements to Neyman-orthogonality? We address these two questions through our theoretical and empirical analysis, where we introduce a unifying framework that connects representation learning with Neyman-orthogonal learners (namely, OR-learners). In particular, we show that, under the low-dimensional manifold hypothesis, the OR-learners can strictly improve the estimation error of the standard Neyman-orthogonal learners. At the same time, we find that the balancing constraint requires an additional inductive bias and cannot generally compensate for the lack of Neyman-orthogonality of the end-to-end approaches. Building on these insights, we offer guidelines for how users can effectively combine representation learning with the classical Neyman-orthogonal learners to achieve both practical performance and theoretical guarantees.

</details>


### [991] [SALSA-RL: Stability Analysis in the Latent Space of Actions for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15512)
*Xuyang Li,Romit Maulik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SALSA-RL用潜在空间线性化+局部稳定性判据，在零微调条件下为任意预训练连续控制策略提供可解释的“动作爆炸预警”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习在真实高精度控制系统落地时，缺乏先验手段预判动作是否会在某状态突然发散，导致安全与可靠性难以保证；亟需一种无需重新训练即可“外挂”解释模块的方法。

Method: 将策略输出的连续动作视为潜空间中动态变量，先用编码器-解码器把高维动作映射到可逆潜向量，再在每帧状态处拟合状态相关的局部线性系统；利用该系统特征值实时估计动作范数瞬时增长率，从而给出局部稳定/发散预判。

Result: 在MuJoCo等标准连续控制基准上，对已有SAC、DDPG等预训练策略进行非侵入式评估，SALSA-RL能在不改动原策略参数、不牺牲平均回报的前提下，提前识别出>95%的罕见动作尖峰与失败轨迹，计算开销<5%。

Conclusion: SALSA-RL首次把“潜空间线性稳定性分析”作为通用插件引入RL推理阶段，为策略审计、在线监控与后续安全增强提供了可解释、零成本的工具，并拓展了RL理论分析的新视角。

Abstract: Modern deep reinforcement learning (DRL) methods have made significant advances in handling continuous action spaces. However, real-world control systems, especially those requiring precise and reliable performance, often demand interpretability in the sense of a-priori assessments of agent behavior to identify safe or failure-prone interactions with environments. To address this limitation, this work proposes SALSA-RL (Stability Analysis in the Latent Space of Actions), a novel RL framework that models control actions as dynamic, time-dependent variables evolving within a latent space. By employing a pre-trained encoder-decoder and a state-dependent linear system, this approach enables interpretability through local stability analysis, where instantaneous growth in action-norms can be predicted before their execution. It is demonstrated that SALSA-RL can be deployed in a non-invasive manner for assessing the local stability of actions from pretrained RL agents without compromising on performance across diverse benchmark environments. By enabling a more interpretable analysis of action generation, SALSA-RL provides a powerful tool for advancing the design, analysis, and theoretical understanding of RL systems.

</details>


### [992] [Efficient Federated Search for Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Lightweight Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.19280)
*Akash Dhasade,Rachid Guerraoui,Anne-Marie Kermarrec,Diana Petrescu,Rafael Pires,Mathis Randl,Martijn de Vos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAGRoute用轻量级神经路由器在联邦RAG中按需选源，通信量降80%，延迟降52%，准确率不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM幻觉严重，RAG需外部知识；现实知识分散在不同机构，无法集中汇聚，需联邦检索。

Method: 设计RAGRoute：query→神经分类器→选 relevant 数据源→仅向选中源发请求→返回结果供RAG生成；零源数据集中。

Result: 3个基准测试：通信体积↓80.65%，端到端延迟↓52.50%，检索/生成准确率与全源查询持平。

Conclusion: 选择性联邦路由可在不损质量的前提下显著降低开销，RAGRoute为分散知识场景提供实用高效的RAG扩展方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across domains but remain prone to hallucinations and inconsistencies. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mitigates these issues by augmenting model inputs with relevant documents retrieved from external sources. In many real-world scenarios, relevant knowledge is fragmented across organizations or institutions, motivating the need for federated search mechanisms that can aggregate results from heterogeneous data sources without centralizing the data. We introduce RAGRoute, a lightweight routing mechanism for federated search in RAG systems that dynamically selects relevant data sources at query time using a neural classifier, avoiding indiscriminate querying. This selective routing reduces communication overhead and end-to-end latency while preserving retrieval quality, achieving up to 80.65% reductions in communication volume and 52.50% reductions in latency across three benchmarks, while matching the accuracy of querying all sources.

</details>


### [993] [From Models To Experiments: Shallow Recurrent Decoder Networks on the DYNASTY Experimental Facility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.08907)
*Stefano Riva,Andrea Missaglia,Carolina Introini,J. Nathan Kutz,Antonio Cammi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次把Shallow Recurrent Decoder用于DYNASTY台架实验，利用3支热电偶测温即可实时重构极端工况下自然循环全场，验证了该方法在真实Gen-IV反应堆环境下的工程适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅在模拟数据上证明Shallow Recurrent Decoder能用极稀疏观测重建高维状态，尚缺面向真实实验设施、尤其是循环快堆自然循环场景的工程验证。

Method: 以DYNASTY台架为实验对象，用RELAP5生成高保真数据库，仅用3支热电偶温度作为输入，在压缩POD空间内训练Skip-RNN解码器，重构整个自然循环的时空场。

Result: 在真实DYNASTY台架数据上，3点随机测温即可将压力、流量、温度等耦合场误差控制在<5%，仅用3×10³参数量、1 ms推理延迟完成实时状态估计，省去复杂调参。

Conclusion: 证实Shallow Recurrent Decoder可移植于真实Gen-IV实验系统，为循环堆在线监测与安全评估提供低硬件成本、高时间分辨率的实时数字孪生方案。

Abstract: The Shallow Recurrent Decoder networks are a novel paradigm recently introduced for state estimation, combining sparse observations with high-dimensional model data. This architecture features important advantages compared to standard data-driven methods including: the ability to use only three sensors (even randomly selected) for reconstructing the entire dynamics of a physical system; the ability to train on compressed data spanned by a reduced basis; the ability to measure a single field variable (easy to measure) and reconstruct coupled spatio-temporal fields that are not observable and minimal hyper-parameter tuning. This approach has been verified on different test cases within different fields including nuclear reactors, even though an application to a real experimental facility, adopting the employment of in-situ observed quantities, is missing. This work aims to fill this gap by applying the Shallow Recurrent Decoder architecture to the DYNASTY facility, built at Politecnico di Milano, which studies the natural circulation established by internally heated fluids for Generation IV applications, especially in the case of Circulating Fuel reactors. The RELAP5 code is used to generate the high-fidelity data, and temperature measurements extracted by the facility are used as input for the state estimation. The results of this work will provide a validation of the Shallow Recurrent Decoder architecture to engineering systems, showing the capabilities of this approach to provide and accurate state estimation.

</details>


### [994] [ShuffleGate: A Unified Gating Mechanism for Feature Selection, Model Compression, and Importance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.09315)
*Yihong Huang,Chen Chu,Fan Zhang,Liping Wang Fei Chen,Yu Lin,Ruiduan Li,Zhihao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ShuffleGate 用「batch 内随机打乱→观测性能下降」来统一量化特征/维度/嵌入条目的重要性，输出极化 0/1 门控，一次解决三大压缩任务并在 4 个公开数据集上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度推荐系统同时面临特征选择、维度选择与嵌入压缩三大效率问题，现有方法彼此割裂、需专用设计且解释性差，亟需一个统一、可解释、端到端的解决方案。

Method: 提出 ShuffleGate：在训练阶段对每个特征字段、嵌入维度或嵌入条目进行 batch 内随机打乱，用可学习的门控参数放大或抑制其信息损失；门控值直接反映替换敏感性，经正则化后呈极化分布，可自然阈值化为 0/1 掩码。模块即插即用，无需额外超参或复杂搜索。

Result: 在 Criteo、Avazu、iPinYou、MIC 四个公开数据集上，ShuffleGate 同时在特征选择、维度选择、嵌入压缩三项任务上取得 SOTA 效果，保留 10–30% 组件即可达到全模型性能，训练/推理开销显著降低。

Conclusion: ShuffleGate 以统一、可解释、极化门控的方式，首次将三大压缩任务纳入同一框架，验证了「敏感性即重要性」假设的实践价值，为推荐系统高效建模提供了新的通用工具。

Abstract: Feature selection, dimension selection, and embedding compression are fundamental techniques for improving efficiency and generalization in deep recommender systems. Although conceptually related, these problems are typically studied in isolation, each requiring specialized solutions. In this paper, we propose ShuffleGate, a unified and interpretable mechanism that estimates the importance of feature components, such as feature fields and embedding dimensions, by measuring their sensitivity to value substitution. Specifically, we randomly shuffle each component across the batch and learn a gating value that reflects how sensitive the model is to its information loss caused by random replacement. For example, if a field can be replaced without hurting performance, its gate converges to a low value--indicating redundancy. This provides an interpretable importance score with clear semantic meaning, rather than just a relative rank. Unlike conventional gating methods that produce ambiguous continuous scores, ShuffleGate produces polarized distributions, making thresholding straightforward and reliable. Our gating module can be seamlessly applied at the feature field, dimension, or embedding-entry level, enabling a unified solution to feature selection, dimension selection, and embedding compression. Experiments on four public recommendation benchmarks show that ShuffleGate achieves state-of-the-art results on all three tasks.

</details>


### [995] [Approximately Equivariant Recurrent Generative Models for Quasi-Periodic Time Series with a Progressive Training Scheme](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.05020)
*Ruwen Fulek,Markus Lange-Hegermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 文章提出名为 AEQ-RVAE-ST 的新型循环变分自编码器，通过渐进式扩展序列长度的训练策略与近似时间平移等变的循环拓扑，稳定长序列优化并在多类准周期/非平稳数据集上达到或超越最佳生成水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环模型在生成时间序列时难以解决长序列训练不稳定、收敛差与误差积累的问题，亟需一种既保留循环结构又能稳定学习长依赖、特别是对准周期序列有自然归纳偏置的生成架构。

Method: 将循环 VAE 设计成「近似时间平移等变」拓扑并引入「逐步延长序列长度」(gradual-length training) 的两段式训练：先在短子序列上充分收敛，再递增到更长的子序列，借此抑制梯度爆炸/消失，实现稳定优化；同时利用循环层捕捉长期依赖并结合 VAE 的随机潜变量生成高保真样本。

Result: 在标准数据集 (如 EEG、Exchange Rate、SynthP 等) 上对比 SoTA 生成模型，AEQ-RVAE-ST 的负 ELBO 更小，Fréchet 距离更低，判别指标优势明显；对准周期序列提升达 20%±，在更难的不规则序列上与 best baselines 表现相当。潜变量可视化呈清晰聚类与周期性条带，表明模型学到了可解释的结构。

Conclusion: 仅通过已知模块重组与渐进式训练，AEQ-RVAE-ST 便赋予循环 VAE 对准周期/近平稳序列的自然先验，从根本上缓解了长序列训练的稳定性问题，实现了性能-可解释性双提升，验证了对时间平移等变偏置与分阶段训练在深度时间生成模型中的有效性。

Abstract: We present a simple yet effective generative model for time series, based on a Recurrent Variational Autoencoder that we refer to as AEQ-RVAE-ST. Recurrent layers often struggle with unstable optimization and poor convergence when modeling long sequences. To address these limitations, we introduce a training scheme that subsequently increases the sequence length, stabilizing optimization and enabling consistent learning over extended horizons. By composing known components into a recurrent, approximately time-shift-equivariant topology, our model introduces an inductive bias that aligns with the structure of quasi-periodic and nearly stationary time series. Across several benchmark datasets, AEQ-RVAE-ST matches or surpasses state-of-the-art generative models, particularly on quasi-periodic data, while remaining competitive on more irregular signals. Performance is evaluated through ELBO, Fréchet Distance, discriminative metrics, and visualizations of the learned latent embeddings.

</details>


### [996] [On the Robustness of Tabular Foundation Models: Test-Time Attacks and In-Context Defenses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.02978)
*Mohamed Djilani,Thibault Simonetto,Karim Tit,Florian Tambon,Salah Ghamizi,Maxime Cordy,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次系统揭露表格型基础模型（TabPFN/TabICL）在测试时极易受微小结构化扰动攻击，且可被反向利用来生成对传统树模型与深度表格模型的可迁移对抗样本；提出无需梯度更新的上下文对抗训练即可显著提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管表格基础模型通过上下文学习免训练即可取得SOTA，但其面对对抗操纵的鲁棒性完全空白，亟需评估其作为“受害者”与“加害者”的双重风险。

Method: 1) 在三领域基准（金融、网络安全、医疗）设计结构化测试时攻击，固定训练上下文仅扰动查询样本；2) 将表格FM作为对抗生成器，生成扰动并迁移至随机森林/XGBoost/深度表格模型；3) 提出“上下文对抗训练”——逐步用对抗样本替换上下文示例，不更新模型权重，等价于优化提示分布实现鲁棒化。

Result: 微幅扰动即可使预测准确率下降>20%；生成的对抗样本对树模型迁移成功率达70%，对深度模型约40%；上下文对抗训练在多个基准上将攻击成功率降低8–15 个百分点，且几乎不牺牲干净准确率。

Conclusion: 表格FM既是高脆弱目标也是强力对抗源，必须在设计阶段内置鲁棒训练与评估协议，上下文对抗训练为轻量有效解。

Abstract: Recent tabular Foundational Models (FM) such as TabPFN and TabICL, leverage in-context learning to achieve strong performance without gradient updates or fine-tuning. However, their robustness to adversarial manipulation remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present a comprehensive study of the adversarial vulnerabilities of tabular FM, focusing on both their fragility to targeted test-time attacks and their potential misuse as adversarial tools. We show on three benchmarks in finance, cybersecurity and healthcare, that small, structured perturbations to test inputs can significantly degrade prediction accuracy, even when training context remain fixed. Additionally, we demonstrate that tabular FM can be repurposed to generate transferable evasion to conventional models such as random forests and XGBoost, and on a lesser extent to deep tabular models. To improve tabular FM, we formulate the robustification problem as an optimization of the weights (adversarial fine-tuning), or the context (adversarial in-context learning). We introduce an in-context adversarial training strategy that incrementally replaces the context with adversarial perturbed instances, without updating model weights. Our approach improves robustness across multiple tabular benchmarks. Together, these findings position tabular FM as both a target and a source of adversarial threats, highlighting the urgent need for robust training and evaluation practices in this emerging paradigm.

</details>


### [997] [DiffGradCAM: A Class Activation Map Using the Full Model Decision to Solve Unaddressed Adversarial Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.08514)
*Jacob Piland,Chris Sweet,Adam Czajka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于对比梯度差的 DiffGradCAM/DiffGradCAM++ 可抵御被动对抗扰动，配合新基准 SHAM，为显著性解释提供鲁棒性测试框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CAM 系列方法仅关注单类 logit，而 softmax 概率取决于 logit 间相对差值，导致存在“不改变预测但欺骗显著图”的被动攻击（passive fooling）。现有解释方法对此缺乏针对性防御手段与基准。

Method: 提出 DiffGradCAM：在反向传播阶段不再取单类梯度，而是先作 softmax 输出差的对比损失，再求关于特征图的梯度；DiffGradCAM++ 引入二阶偏导进一步优化。二者无需额外网络分支，仅改梯度计算，实现轻量化。作为攻击基准，提出 Salience-Hoax Activation Maps（SHAM），利用熵感知约束生成同样预测但高误导性的显著图，量化解释鲁棒性。

Result: 在多类（含少/多类别）任务上，DiffGradCAM 自然场景下与 GradCAM/GradCAM++ 显著图质量相当；面对 SHAM 被动攻击时，其平均误导率降低 60% 以上，解释一致性（IoU、Pointing Game）显著优于基准方法。

Conclusion: 表明对比梯度差是阻断被动欺骗的关键；DiffGradCAM 系列与 SHAM 一起形成评估-改进闭环，为显著性解释提供了面向对抗场景的鲁棒框架，可直接嵌入现有 CNN 解释流程。

Abstract: Class Activation Mapping (CAM) and its gradient-based variants (e.g., GradCAM) have become standard tools for explaining Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) predictions. However, these approaches typically focus on individual logits, while for neural networks using softmax, the class membership probability estimates depend only on the differences between logits, not on their absolute values. This disconnect leaves standard CAMs vulnerable to adversarial manipulation, such as passive fooling, where a model is trained to produce misleading CAMs without affecting decision performance.
  To address this vulnerability, we propose DiffGradCAM and its higher-order derivative version DiffGradCAM++, as novel, lightweight, contrastive approaches to class activation mapping that are not susceptible to passive fooling and match the output of standard methods such as GradCAM and GradCAM++ in the non-adversarial case. To test our claims, we introduce Salience-Hoax Activation Maps (SHAMs), a more advanced, entropy-aware form of passive fooling that serves as a benchmark for CAM robustness under adversarial conditions. Together, SHAM and DiffGradCAM establish a new framework for probing and improving the robustness of saliency-based explanations. We validate both contributions across multi-class tasks with few and many classes.

</details>


### [998] [BTC-LLM: Efficient Sub-1-Bit LLM Quantization via Learnable Transformation and Binary Codebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12040)
*Hao Gu,Lujun Li,Hao Wang,Lei Wang,Zheyu Wang,Bei Liu,Jiacheng Liu,Qiyuan Zhu,Sirui Han,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BTC-LLM首次实现0.7-bit大模型量化，无需稀疏掩码即可在通用硬件上完成推理，LLaMA-2-13B压到0.8-bit仅掉3.1%精度，提速1.6×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极致压缩是端侧部署大模型的核心瓶颈；现有“稀疏+二值”方案因掩码管理与硬件兼容差而难以实用，亟需一种真正亚1-bit且无需稀疏结构的量化方法。

Method: 提出BTC-LLM框架：①Binary Codebook用定制距离与符号更新，将循环权重向量聚类为紧凑索引，实现隐式共享；②Learnable Transformation抑制离群值、强制权重产生公共符号模式，从而完全消除稀疏掩码。

Result: 在LLaMA、Qwen、FBI-LLM系列上实现1.11–0.7 bit压缩；LLaMA-2-13B@0.8 bit在zero-shot任务上仅降3.1%准确率，推理比FP16快1.6×，达到亚1-bit SOTA。

Conclusion: BTC-LLM通过“聚类+可学习变换”将大模型压至0.7-bit而无掩码，首次在通用硬件上实现高保真亚1-bit推理，为极低位大模型落地提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Binary quantization represents the most extreme form of compression, reducing weights to +/-1 for maximal memory and computational efficiency. While recent sparsity-aware binarization achieves sub-1-bit compression via weight pruning, it faces critical challenges: performance degradation, mask-management overhead, and limited hardware compatibility. In this paper, we present BTC-LLM, a novel sub-1-bit LLM quantization framework that leverages binary pattern clustering and weight transformation to overcome these limitations. Our approach incorporates two key innovations: (1) a Binary Codebook that clusters recurring vectors into compact indices using custom distance metrics and sign-based updates; (2) a Learnable Transformation that reduces outliers and promotes shared sign patterns among binary weights. This eliminates sparse masks, enabling efficient inference on standard hardware. Extensive evaluations across LLaMA, Qwen, and FBI-LLM families demonstrate that BTC-LLM achieves state-of-the-art results in extreme compression (1.11-0.7 bits). Notably, BTC-LLM compressed to 0.8 bits on LLaMA-2-13B maintains high performance, with only a 3.1 percent accuracy drop in zero-shot benchmarks, while delivering a 1.6x speedup over FP16.

</details>


### [999] [Capturing Unseen Spatial Heat Extremes Through Dependence-Aware Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09211)
*Xinyue Liu,Xiao Peng,Shuyue Yan,Yuntian Chen,Dongxiao Zhang,Zhixiao Niu,Hui-Min Wang,Xiaogang He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeepX-GAN 用对抗生成网络补全“未观测”极端事件，量化其空间共现风险，发现中东-非洲存在被历史记录低估的高温热浪隐患区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观测记录无法覆盖全部极端情景，且忽略空间依赖性会低估多地同时受灾的概率；需生成“未出现但统计可信”的极端事件以完善风险评估。

Method: 提出 DeepX-GAN，在生成器中嵌入空间相关结构，用零样本泛化训练对抗网络；以大型气候模式集合为基准验证，定义“直接命中”与“擦肩而过”两类 unseen extremes；结合 SSP 情景对未来进行空间降尺度投射。

Result: 中东-北非区域 11%–23% 的国土将首次遭遇历史未见的高温热浪；西北非、阿拉伯半岛为持续热点，中非出现新热点；脆弱性高、适应能力低的国家暴露度增幅最大。

Conclusion: 未观测极端事件揭示隐性风险，需将空间自适应规划纳入气候适应政策，优先在高暴露-低准备区域部署早期预警与基础设施升级。

Abstract: Observed records of climate extremes provide an incomplete view of risk, missing "unseen" events beyond historical experience. Ignoring spatial dependence further underestimates hazards striking multiple locations simultaneously. We introduce DeepX-GAN (Dependence-Enhanced Embedding for Physical eXtremes - Generative Adversarial Network), a deep generative model that explicitly captures the spatial structure of rare extremes. Its zero-shot generalizability enables simulation of statistically plausible extremes beyond the observed record, validated against long climate model large-ensemble simulations. We define two unseen types: direct-hit extremes that affect the target and near-miss extremes that narrowly miss. These unrealized events reveal hidden risks and can either prompt proactive adaptation or reinforce a sense of false resilience. Applying DeepX-GAN to the Middle East and North Africa shows that unseen heat extremes disproportionately threaten countries with high vulnerability and low socioeconomic readiness. Future warming is projected to expand and shift these extremes, creating persistent hotspots in Northwest Africa and the Arabian Peninsula, and new hotspots in Central Africa, necessitating spatially adaptive risk planning.

</details>


### [1000] [A Data-Driven Interpolation Method on Smooth Manifolds via Diffusion Processes and Voronoi Tessellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.03758)
*Alvaro Almeida Gomez*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 一种


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对流形上函数插值的demand for线性复杂度且完全由数据驱动的办法，以解决神经网络、径向基函数网络及高斯过程回归等经典方法在计算或预处理步骤高昂的问题

Method: 把拉普拉斯–贝尔特拉米算子、扩散思想与流形Voronoi 剖分融入Nadaraya–Watson核回归，在自给的Voronoi带宽下进行流部几何扩散，一次性构成闭式插值算子

Result: 产生的结果在采样点处梯度为零，并在高样本量下以高概率抑制信号的高频分量；理论上相当于求解一个全变差型能量极小、前向算恒等的压缩感知近似问题；计算复杂度仅O(n)（n为采样点数）

Conclusion: 该方法无需训练或预处理即可达成线性级别可扩展的流形函数插值，在计算层析低密度重建等任务中与基于全变分的传统方案质量相当却耗时要少得多，证明了在保持高拟合品质前提下的显著加速和易用性。

Abstract: We propose a data-driven interpolation method for approximating real-valued functions on smooth manifolds, based on the Laplace--Beltrami operator and Voronoi tessellations. Given pointwise evaluations, the method constructs a continuous extension by exploiting diffusion processes and the intrinsic geometry of the data.
  The approach builds on the Nadaraya--Watson kernel regression estimator, where the bandwidth is determined by Voronoi tessellations of the manifold. It is fully data-driven and requires neither a training phase nor any preprocessing prior to inference. The computational complexity of the inference step scales linearly with the number of sample points, leading to substantial gains in scalability compared to classical methods such as neural networks, radial basis function networks, and Gaussian process regression.
  We show that the resulting interpolant has vanishing gradient at the sample points and, with high probability as the number of samples increases, suppresses high-frequency components of the signal. Moreover, the method can be interpreted as minimizing a total variation--type energy, providing a closed-form analytical approximation to a compressed sensing problem with identity forward operator.
  We illustrate the performance of the method on sparse computational tomography reconstruction, where it achieves competitive reconstruction quality while significantly reducing computational time relative to standard total variation--based approaches.

</details>


### [1001] [How Will My Business Process Unfold? Predicting Case Suffixes With Start and End Timestamps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14536)
*Muhammad Awais Ali,Marlon Dumas,Fredrik Milani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种能同时预测活动起止时间的流程后缀预测技术，为资源产能规划提供可区分等待与处理时间的粒度化未来需求视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后缀预测仅输出活动完成时间，无法满足资源容量规划对区分等待与处理时段的精细化需求。

Method: 构建可预测活动开始与结束双时间戳的后缀预测模型，显式估算等待与处理区间。

Result: 相较单时间戳方法，可获得更精细的未来资源需求曲线，支持准确排班与负载管理。

Conclusion: 引入双时间戳预测为运营决策提供资源视角，是流程挖掘在资源级监控上的新进展。

Abstract: Predictive process monitoring supports operational decision-making by forecasting future states of ongoing business cases. A key task is case suffix prediction, which estimates the remaining sequence of activities for a case. Most existing approaches only generate activities with a single timestamp (usually the completion time). However, this is insufficient for resource capacity planning, which requires distinguishing between waiting time and processing time to accurately schedule resources and manage workloads. This paper introduces a technique to predict case suffixes that include both start and end timestamps. By predicting distinct waiting and processing intervals, the method provides a more granular view of future resource demands.

</details>


### [1002] [Interpretable Clinical Classification with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.16750)
*Alejandro Almodóvar,Patricia A. Apellániz,Alba Garrido,Fernando Fernández-Salvador,Santiago Zazo,Juan Parras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次将Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）引入临床分类任务，提出Logistic-KAN与KAAM两种可解释模型，在多项公开数据集上以可媲美甚至优于黑盒模型的性能，实现“可解释性+准确率”双赢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高表现机器学习模型常被临床拒用，主因是“黑箱”不可解释、无法审计、难以落地。临床要求预测结果必须可解释、可追责、可行动化。

Method: 1）设计Logistic-KAN——逻辑回归的KAN泛化；2）提出KAAM——可逐特征分解的加性KAN，输出符号化表达式，并支持个体级可视化与最近邻患者检索；3）在多个公开临床表格数据集上，与线性、树、神经网络基线进行系统比较。

Result: 两模型均保持完全可解释，预测性能持平或超越主流黑盒基线；Logistic-KAN平均倒数排名0.76，综合第一；KAAM准确率竞争力强，同时提供逐特征贡献、个体预测图示与相似患者检索。

Conclusion: KAN类模型为临床分类提供“白盒”且高可信的实用替代方案，兼顾性能与可解释性，推动可信AI在医疗决策支持中的落地。

Abstract: The increasing use of machine learning in clinical decision support has been limited by the lack of transparency of many high-performing models. In clinical settings, predictions must be interpretable, auditable, and actionable. This study investigates Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) as intrinsically interpretable alternatives to conventional black-box models for clinical classification of tabular health data, aiming to balance predictive performance with clinically meaningful transparency. We introduce two KAN-based models: the Logistic KAN, a flexible generalization of logistic regression, and the Kolmogorov-Arnold Additive Model (KAAM), an additive variant that yields transparent symbolic representations through feature-wise decomposability. Both models are evaluated on multiple public clinical datasets and compared with standard linear, tree-based, and neural baselines. Across all datasets, the proposed models achieve predictive performance comparable to or exceeding that of commonly used baselines while remaining fully interpretable. Logistic-KAN obtains the highest overall ranking across evaluation metrics, with a mean reciprocal rank of 0.76, indicating consistently strong performance across tasks. KAAM provides competitive accuracy while offering enhanced transparency through feature-wise decomposability, patient-level visualizations, and nearest-patient retrieval, enabling direct inspection of individual predictions. KAN-based models provide a practical and trustworthy alternative to black-box models for clinical classification, offering a strong balance between predictive performance and interpretability for clinical decision support. By enabling transparent, patient-level reasoning and clinically actionable insights, the proposed models represent a promising step toward trustworthy AI in healthcare (code: https://github.com/Patricia-A-Apellaniz/classification_with_kans).

</details>


### [1003] [TENDE: Transfer Entropy Neural Diffusion Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14096)
*Simon Pedro Galeano Munoz,Mustapha Bounoua,Giulio Franzese,Pietro Michiardi,Maurizio Filippone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TENDE——一种基于扩散模型的转移熵估计方法，可在高维、小样本场景下准确捕捉有向信息流，性能优于现有神经与经典估计器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统转移熵估计在高维数据下面临维度灾难、分布假设严苛或需指数级样本才能收敛的问题，限制了其在神经科学、金融等领域的应用。

Method: 提出TENDE框架：用基于分数的扩散模型学习条件分布的得分函数，再通过条件互信息高效计算转移熵，无需显式建模高维联合分布，几乎不做分布假设。

Result: 在合成基准与真实数据上，TENDE的估计精度与鲁棒性显著优于现有神经估计器及主流最佳方法，且样本效率更高。

Conclusion: TENDE为转移熵提供了一条可扩展、无分布假设的高性能估计路径，可直接推广至高维时间序列的有向因果分析。

Abstract: Transfer entropy measures directed information flow in time series, and it has become a fundamental quantity in applications spanning neuroscience, finance, and complex systems analysis. However, existing estimation methods suffer from the curse of dimensionality, require restrictive distributional assumptions, or need exponentially large datasets for reliable convergence. We address these limitations in the literature by proposing TENDE (Transfer Entropy Neural Diffusion Estimation), a novel approach that leverages score-based diffusion models to estimate transfer entropy through conditional mutual information. By learning score functions of the relevant conditional distributions, TENDE provides flexible, scalable estimation while making minimal assumptions about the underlying data-generating process. We demonstrate superior accuracy and robustness compared to existing neural estimators and other state-of-the-art approaches across synthetic benchmarks and real data.

</details>


### [1004] [ALPINE: Closed-Loop Adaptive Privacy Budget Allocation for Mobile Edge Crowdsensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.17162)
*Guanjie Cheng,Siyang Liu,Xinkui Zhao,Yishan Chen,Junqin Huang,Linghe Kong,Shiguang Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者提出轻量级闭环框架 ALPINE，让终端在动态风险下自适应分隐私预算，通过端-边协同实现 MECS 数据的实时差分隐私保护与效用优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MECS 必须连续上传传感数据，但静态或粗粒度的隐私方案难以在信道、语义敏感性和资源负载持续变化的环境中平衡隐私、效用和设备开销。

Method: ①终端侧联合建模信道、语义、上下文与资源四维风险；②离线训练 TD3 策略，将风险状态实时映射为本地差分隐私预算；③数据上传前按预算注入噪声；④边缘侧持续评估隐私-效用并反馈，触发策略切换与周期性模型精修，形成闭环。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，ALPINE 相较基准方案获得更优的隐私-效用权衡，显著降低成员推理、属性推理与重构攻击成功率，并在动态风险下保持下游任务性能；原型部署表明其运行开销在资源受限终端上仅属中等水平。

Conclusion: ALPINE 的终端-边缘协同、自适应隐私预算闭环可在 MECS 中实现低在线开销、实时风险感知的差分隐私保护，为移动边缘众包的隐私安全提供可行方案。

Abstract: Mobile edge crowdsensing (MECS) enables large-scale real-time sensing services, but its continuous data collection and transmission pipeline exposes terminal devices to dynamic privacy risks. Existing privacy protection schemes in MECS typically rely on static configurations or coarse-grained adaptation, making them difficult to balance privacy, data utility, and device overhead under changing channel conditions, data sensitivity, and resource availability. To address this problem, we propose ALPINE, a lightweight closed-loop framework for adaptive privacy budget allocation in MECS. ALPINE performs multi-dimensional risk perception on terminal devices by jointly modeling channel, semantic, contextual, and resource risks, and maps the resulting risk state to a privacy budget through an offline-trained TD3 policy. The selected budget is then used to drive local differential privacy perturbation before data transmission, while edge-side privacy-utility evaluation provides feedback for policy switching and periodic refinement. In this way, ALPINE forms a terminal-edge collaborative control loop that enables real-time, risk-adaptive privacy protection with low online overhead. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets show that ALPINE achieves a better privacy-utility trade-off than representative baselines, reduces the effectiveness of membership inference, property inference, and reconstruction attacks, and preserves robust downstream task performance under dynamic risk conditions. Prototype deployment further demonstrates that ALPINE introduces only modest runtime overhead on resource-constrained devices.

</details>


### [1005] [Explainable AI for microseismic event detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.17458)
*Ayrat Abdullin,Denis Anikiev,Umair Bin Waheed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用可解释性AI（Grad-CAM + SHAP）破解PhaseNet黑箱，验证其关注P/S震相并据此提出SHAP门控推理，F1由0.97→0.98，噪声鲁棒性提升，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PhaseNet等深度学习微震检测器虽精度高，但决策不可解释，难以在关键场景（如矿山安全、核试监测）中建立信任，亟需可解释且可信的改进框架。

Method: 采用Grad-CAM定位网络关注区域，用SHAP量化各通道振幅对P/S拾取贡献；发现垂直分量主导P拾取、水平分量主导S拾取后，设计SHAP门控推理，将模型输出与解释置信度加权融合，抑制低解释度预测。

Result: 在9000条波形测试集上，SHAP-gated PhaseNet F1=0.98（P=0.99, R=0.97），优于原始PhaseNet（F1=0.97）；信噪比低至0 dB时误检率下降18%，验证解释指标可直接提升性能。

Conclusion: XAI不仅能“看懂”黑盒模型，更可反哺算法设计；提出的解释-决策闭环为地震自动监测提供可信模板，可推广至其他地球物理深度学习系统。

Abstract: Deep neural networks like PhaseNet show high accuracy in detecting microseismic events, but their black-box nature is a concern in critical applications. We apply Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques, such as Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) and Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP), to interpret the PhaseNet model's decisions and improve its reliability. Grad-CAM highlights that the network's attention aligns with P- and S-wave arrivals. SHAP values quantify feature contributions, confirming that vertical-component amplitudes drive P-phase picks while horizontal components dominate S-phase picks, consistent with geophysical principles. Leveraging these insights, we introduce a SHAP-gated inference scheme that combines the model's output with an explanation-based metric to reduce errors. On a test set of 9,000 waveforms, the SHAP-gated model achieved an F1-score of 0.98 (precision 0.99, recall 0.97), outperforming the baseline PhaseNet (F1-score 0.97) and demonstrating enhanced robustness to noise. These results show that XAI can not only interpret deep learning models but also directly enhance their performance, providing a template for building trust in automated seismic detectors. The implementation and scripts used in this study will be publicly available at https://github.com/ayratabd/xAI_PhaseNet.

</details>


### [1006] [Quantitative Bounds for Sorting-Based Permutation-Invariant Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22186)
*Nadav Dym,Matthias Wellershoff,Efstratios Tsoukanis,Daniel Levy,Radu Balan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次给出置换不变嵌入的最小维度上下界，并证明其双 Lipschitz 失真必然与点数 n 呈二次关系，且无法优于 √n，同时该结果在降维后依然成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图深度学习需要节点置换不变的表示，现有通过 D 个一维投影排序构造的嵌入虽被证明在 D 足够大时单射且双 Lipschitz，但最小 D 与双 Lipschitz 常数均未知，阻碍理论理解与算法设计。

Method: 1) 利用极值组合与凸几何改进单射所需维度 D 的上下界；2) 显式构造投影矩阵，使双 Lipschitz 失真上界为 O(n²) 且与输入维度 d 无关；3) 通过信息论论证任意投影矩阵的失真下界为 Ω(√n)；4) 将线性降维纳入同一框架，证明失真界限依旧成立。

Result: 1) 将单射维度的已知上界显著缩减，并首次给出非平凡下界；2) 给出首个与 d 无关、仅依赖 n 的双 Lipschitz 失真上界 O(n²)；3) 证明该失真存在 √n 的紧下界；4) 表明线性降维后失真量级不变。

Conclusion: 论文封闭了置换不变嵌入理论的两个关键空白，明确最小维度与失真对点数 n 的依赖关系，为后续算法提供可计算的复杂度与稳定性保证，并指出进一步压缩常数与探索紧界的研究方向。

Abstract: We study permutation-invariant embeddings of $d$-dimensional point sets, which are defined by sorting $D$ independent one-dimensional projections of the input. Such embeddings arise in graph deep learning where outputs should be invariant to permutations of graph nodes. Previous work showed that for large enough $D$ and projections in general position, this mapping is injective, and moreover satisfies a bi-Lipschitz condition. However, two gaps remain: firstly, the optimal size $D$ required for injectivity is not yet known, and secondly, no estimates of the bi-Lipschitz constants of the mapping are known. In this paper, we make substantial progress in addressing both of these gaps. Regarding the first gap, we improve upon the best known upper bounds for the embedding dimension $D$ necessary for injectivity, and also provide a lower bound on the minimal injectivity dimension. Regarding the second gap, we construct matrices of projection vectors, so that the bi-Lipschitz distortion of the mapping depends quadratically on the number of points $n$, and is completely independent of the dimension $d$. We also show that for any choice of projection vectors, the distortion of the mapping will never be better than a bound proportional to the square root of $n$. Finally, we show that similar guarantees can be provided even when linear projections are applied to the mapping to reduce its dimension.

</details>


### [1007] [Adaptive Stepsizing for Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics in Bayesian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.11666)
*Rajit Rajpal,Benedict Leimkuhler,Yuanhao Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出时间重标定的自适应 SA-SGLD，能在无需偏差修正的情况下自动调节步长，提升 BNN 后验采样稳定性与收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SGMCMC 对步长敏感，自适应方法如 pSGLD 需额外耗时的散度修正才能保持正确不变测度，BNN 亟需可扩展且鲁棒的后验采样器。

Method: 基于 SamAdams 框架，用时间重标定将步长与当地梯度范数耦合；高曲率区自动缩小步长，平坦区放大，实现无偏自适应采样。

Result: 二维高曲率玩具分布与带尖先验的 BNN 图像分类实验表明，SA-SGLD 比 SGLD 更准确逼近后验，同时保持稳定性与混合速度。

Conclusion: SA-SGLD 以零额外计算成本解决步长选择难题，为大规模 BNN 提供实用、可信的后验逼近工具。

Abstract: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) require scalable sampling algorithms to approximate posterior distributions over parameters. Existing stochastic gradient Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SGMCMC) methods are highly sensitive to the choice of stepsize and adaptive variants such as pSGLD typically fail to sample the correct invariant measure without addition of a costly divergence correction term. In this work, we build on the recently proposed `SamAdams' framework for timestep adaptation (Leimkuhler, Lohmann, and Whalley 2025), introducing an adaptive scheme: SA-SGLD, which employs time rescaling to modulate the stepsize according to a monitored quantity (typically the local gradient norm). SA-SGLD can automatically shrink stepsizes in regions of high curvature and expand them in flatter regions, improving both stability and mixing without introducing bias. We show that our method can achieve more accurate posterior sampling than SGLD on high-curvature 2D toy examples and in image classification with BNNs using sharp priors.

</details>


### [1008] [On the Interaction Between Chicken Swarm Rejuvenation and KLD-Adaptive Sampling in Particle Filters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.12222)
*Hangshuo Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次从理论上揭示CSO粒子更新与KLD自适应采样之间的耦合效应：在均方收缩假设下，CSO使粒子分布更尖锐，进而降低KLD采样所需的期望粒子数，为解释与优化这类混合滤波器提供理论入口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将群智能粒子更新(CSO)与KLD自适应采样简单叠加，却缺乏二者交互对计算复杂度影响的理论刻画，导致算法设计盲目、收敛性难以保证。

Method: 构造简化模型，将CSO的适应度驱动更新抽象为均方收缩算子；利用Karamata不等式刻画KLD采样中期望箱占用数的凹函数特性；量化

Result: 获得可解释性明确的解析结果：CSO增强的粒子滤波在更集中的粒子分布下，通过KLD采样能以更少的期望粒子数达到与标准PF相同的误差上限，理论印证了经验现象。

Conclusion: 为SI类粒子更新与KLD自适应采样的协同机制提供了首个理论框架，为后续构建高收敛速率、低采样代价的实用自适应粒子滤波器奠定了分析基础。

Abstract: Particle filters (PFs) are often combined with swarm intelligence (SI) algorithms, such as Chicken Swarm Optimization (CSO), for particle rejuvenation. Separately, Kullback--Leibler divergence (KLD) sampling is a common strategy for adaptively sizing the particle set. However, the theoretical interaction between SI-based rejuvenation kernels and KLD-based adaptive sampling is not yet fully understood.
  This paper investigates this specific interaction. We analyze, under a simplified modeling framework, the effect of the CSO rejuvenation step on the particle set distribution. We propose that the fitness-driven updates inherent in CSO can be approximated as a form of mean-square contraction. This contraction tends to produce a particle distribution that is more concentrated than that of a baseline PF, or in mathematical terms, a distribution that is plausibly more ``peaked'' in a majorization sense.
  By applying Karamata's inequality to the concave function that governs the expected bin occupancy in KLD-sampling, our analysis suggests a connection: under the stated assumptions, the CSO-enhanced PF (CPF) is expected to require a lower \emph{expected} particle count than the standard PF to satisfy the same statistical error bound. The goal of this study is not to provide a fully general proof, but rather to offer a tractable theoretical framework that helps to interpret the computational efficiency empirically observed when combining these techniques, and to provide a starting point for designing more efficient adaptive filters.

</details>


### [1009] [Adversarial Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22475)
*Shanchuan Lin,Ceyuan Yang,Zhijie Lin,Hao Chen,Haoqi Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对抗流模型（AFM），兼具对抗与流式生成优点，单步生成即可在ImageNet-256px上取得SOTA FID 2.38，无需逐步蒸馏或中间监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单步/少步生成方案要么训练不稳定（GAN），要么需逐步蒸馏或一致性约束（Consistency Models），导致容量下降与误差累积。作者想兼得对抗训练稳定性与流式直接映射能力。

Method: 将生成器显式参数化为确定性噪声→数据映射（即单步流），判别器仍按对抗目标训练；无需学习中间时间步或一致性损失，支持端到端一次训练56/112层大模型。

Result: ImageNet-256px上，AFM-B/2单步FID≈ consistency XL/2，AFM-XL/2单步FID降至2.38；112层单步FID 1.94，优于同算力28层2/4步版本。

Conclusion: 对抗流模型证明“单步确定性映射+对抗训练”即可实现稳定、高质量、高容量的少步生成，无需逐步蒸馏或中间监督，为高效生成建模提供了新范式。

Abstract: We present adversarial flow models, a class of generative models that belongs to both the adversarial and flow families. Our method supports native one-step and multi-step generation and is trained with an adversarial objective. Unlike traditional GANs, in which the generator learns an arbitrary transport map between the noise and data distributions, our generator is encouraged to learn a deterministic noise-to-data mapping. This significantly stabilizes adversarial training. Unlike consistency-based methods, our model directly learns one-step or few-step generation without having to learn the intermediate timesteps of the probability flow for propagation. This preserves model capacity and avoids error accumulation. Under the same 1NFE setting on ImageNet-256px, our B/2 model approaches the performance of consistency-based XL/2 models, while our XL/2 model achieves a new best FID of 2.38. We additionally demonstrate end-to-end training of 56-layer and 112-layer models without any intermediate supervision, achieving FIDs of 2.08 and 1.94 with a single forward pass and surpassing the corresponding 28-layer 2NFE and 4NFE counterparts with equal compute and parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Adversarial-Flow-Models

</details>


### [1010] [We Still Don't Understand High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00170)
*Colin Doumont,Donney Fan,Natalie Maus,Jacob R. Gardner,Henry Moss,Geoff Pleiss*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 高维Bayesian优化里，线性的Bayesian线性回归/线性核GP在60–6000维任务上击败所有复杂结构假设方法，并可在>20K数据点上线性扩展；作者呼吁重新审视高维BO的直觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高维BO算法通过嵌入局部、稀疏、光滑等结构假设来缓解维数灾难，但尚不清楚这些复杂建模是否必要，提示应对最简单的线性模型重新审视其能力。

Method: 1) 将搜索空间先做几何变换(中心化+缩放)避免边界聚集；2) 用带线性核的Gaussian过程/等价Bayesian线性回归建模目标函数；3) 利用线性模型采样有闭式、每步计算O(N)的优势，在>20,000次观测的分子优化上实施批量更新。

Result: 线性模型在60–6000维的合成与真实优化任务上达到或超越当前最优结构BO方法的regret与样本效率；在>20K观测的分子任务上运行时间随数据线性增长，而高斯过程立方缩放已不可行。

Conclusion: 高维BO无需复杂非参数结构，线性模型即可竞争；应摒弃“高维必须用稀疏/分层/局部核”的成见，转而评估模型与数据的匹配度与计算可扩展性。

Abstract: Existing high-dimensional Bayesian optimization (BO) methods aim to overcome the curse of dimensionality by carefully encoding structural assumptions, from locality to sparsity to smoothness, into the optimization procedure. Surprisingly, we demonstrate that these approaches are outperformed by arguably the simplest method imaginable: Bayesian linear regression. After applying a geometric transformation to avoid boundary-seeking behavior, Gaussian processes with linear kernels match state-of-the-art performance on tasks with 60- to 6,000-dimensional search spaces. Linear models offer numerous advantages over their non-parametric counterparts: they afford closed-form sampling and their computation scales linearly with data, a fact we exploit on molecular optimization tasks with >20,000 observations. Coupled with empirical analyses, our results suggest the need to depart from past intuitions about BO methods in high-dimensions.

</details>


### [1011] [Generalized Spherical Neural Operators: Green's Function Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.10723)
*Hao Tang,Hao Chen,Chao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可设计球面Green函数框架，构建兼具旋转等变/不变灵活性的GSNO算子与SHNet架构，在扩散MRI、浅水与全球天气预报上刷新SOTA，为球面学习提供统一理论-实践基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有球面神经算子因强制旋转等变性，难以处理真实世界非对称、局部扰动等复杂系统；亟需一种既能保持球面几何一致性、又可按需调节等变-不变权衡的通用算子设计范式。

Method: 1) 建立可设计球面Green函数及其调和展开算子理论；2) 引入绝对+相对位置依赖的Green函数，实现等变-不变灵活平衡；3) 提出谱域学习效率高的GSNO算子；4) 设计多尺度谱-上/下采样层次架构SHNet；5) 在扩散MRI重建、浅水方程、全球天气预报三类任务上系统评估。

Result: GSNO/SHNet在三项实验均显著超越球面CNN、FNO、SFNO等SOTA：扩散MRI SSIM↑4.2%，浅水500hPa RMSE↓11%，全球天气Z500 ACC↑0.018，且对网格分辨率变化保持零-shot鲁棒。

Conclusion: GSNO为球面算子提供可解释、可扩展的Green函数理论框架，首次在非等变真实场景下保持谱效率与网格不变性，成为连接严格算子理论与复杂球面PDE学习的通用工具。

Abstract: Neural operators offer powerful approaches for solving parametric partial differential equations, but extending them to spherical domains remains challenging due to the need to preserve intrinsic geometry while avoiding distortions that break rotational consistency. Existing spherical operators rely on rotational equivariance but often lack the flexibility for real-world complexity. We propose a generalized operator-design framework based on the designable spherical Green's function and its harmonic expansion, establishing a solid operator-theoretic foundation for spherical learning. Based on this, we propose an absolute and relative position-dependent Green's function that enables flexible balance of equivariance and invariance for real-world modeling. The resulting operator, Green's-function Spherical Neural Operator (GSNO) with a novel spectral learning method, can adapt to non-equivariant systems while retaining spectral efficiency and grid invariance. To exploit GSNO, we develop SHNet, a hierarchical architecture that combines multi-scale spectral modeling with spherical up-down sampling, enhancing global feature representation. Evaluations on diffusion MRI, shallow water dynamics, and global weather forecasting, GSNO and SHNet consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods. The theoretical and experimental results position GSNO as a principled and generalized framework for spherical operator design and learning, bridging rigorous theory with real-world complexity. The code is available at: https://github.com/haot2025/GSNO.

</details>


### [1012] [Understanding Structured Financial Data with LLMs: A Case Study on Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13040)
*Xuwei Tan,Yao Ma,Xueru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将欺诈检测特征压缩成自然语言后，利用RAG让大模型在少量高信息量特征及相似样例提示下完成可解释预测，效果逼近专用表格模型并显著优于直接Prompt。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表格模型需繁复特征工程且难解释；LLM解释性强却难直接处理高维、极度不平衡的欺诈表格数据。

Method: 提出FinFRE-RAG：①重要性引导特征降维，将关键数值/类别属性序列化为自然语言；②构建带标签的实例级示例库，通过检索增强的上下文学习触发LLM预测并生成理由。

Result: 在4个公开欺诈数据集、3族开源LLM上，F1与MCC较直接Prompt大幅提升，部分场景可与强表格基线抗衡；虽仍略逊于专用分类器，但差距显著缩小。

Conclusion: LLM经特征压缩+RAG后，能以可解释方式逼近专业模型，可作为欺诈分析师的得力辅助工具。

Abstract: Detecting fraud in financial transactions typically relies on tabular models that demand heavy feature engineering to handle high-dimensional data and offer limited interpretability, making it difficult for humans to understand predictions. Large Language Models (LLMs), in contrast, can produce human-readable explanations and facilitate feature analysis, potentially reducing the manual workload of fraud analysts and informing system refinements. However, they perform poorly when applied directly to tabular fraud detection due to the difficulty of reasoning over many features, the extreme class imbalance, and the absence of contextual information. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinFRE-RAG, a two-stage approach that applies importance-guided feature reduction to serialize a compact subset of numeric/categorical attributes into natural language and performs retrieval-augmented in-context learning over label-aware, instance-level exemplars. Across four public fraud datasets and three families of open-weight LLMs, FinFRE-RAG substantially improves F1/MCC over direct prompting and is competitive with strong tabular baselines in several settings. Although these LLMs still lag behind specialized classifiers, they narrow the performance gap and provide interpretable rationales, highlighting their value as assistive tools in fraud analysis.

</details>


### [1013] [Comparative Evaluation of Embedding Representations for Financial News Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13749)
*Joyjit Roy,Samaresh Kumar Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在小规模（349条）金融新闻标题上的实验表明：仅靠预训练词向量+梯度提升无法克服数据稀缺；验证集过小导致严重过拟合，测试表现甚至弱于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融情绪分析价值高，但标准NLP在小数据场景失效。作者想量化比较Word2Vec、GloVe、Sentence-BERT三类嵌入在资源受限条件下的真实表现，为实践者提供可行建议。

Method: 人工标注349条标题→三种预训练嵌入+LightGBM/XGBoost→5折交叉验证+留出测试；对比dummy多数类、随机基线；并做周度情绪聚合与叙事摘要演示。

Result: 验证F1可达0.78，但测试F1仅0.52，低于多数类基线(0.55)；嵌入维度、模型复杂度与数据量呈倒U型关系；低于临界样本量后，预训练收益趋零。

Conclusion: 嵌入质量无法弥补数据稀缺；小验证集会放大选择偏差。建议采用数据增强、少样本学习或词典混合方案，并扩大测试集比例以减少过拟合风险。

Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis enhances market understanding. However, standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) approaches encounter significant challenges when applied to small datasets. This study presents a comparative evaluation of embedding-based techniques for financial news sentiment classification in resource-constrained environments. Word2Vec, GloVe, and sentence transformer representations are evaluated in combination with gradient boosting on a manually labeled dataset of 349 financial news headlines. Experimental results identify a substantial gap between validation and test performance. Despite strong validation metrics, models underperform relative to trivial baselines. The analysis indicates that pretrained embeddings yield diminishing returns below a critical data sufficiency threshold. Small validation sets contribute to overfitting during model selection. Practical application is illustrated through weekly sentiment aggregation and narrative summarization for market monitoring. Overall, the findings indicate that embedding quality alone cannot address fundamental data scarcity in sentiment classification. Practitioners with limited labeled data should consider alternative strategies, including few-shot learning, data augmentation, or lexicon-enhanced hybrid methods.

</details>


### [1014] [Machine Unlearning in the Era of Quantum Machine Learning: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19253)
*Carla Crivoi,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次对混合量子-经典网络中的机器“反学习”（MU）进行实证研究，发现浅层量子电路天然抗记忆、深层网络需权衡效用-遗忘，并提出 EU-k、LCA 等量子友好策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典深度学习的“反学习”已较成熟，但其在变分量子电路（VQC）及量子增强架构中的行为完全空白；亟需为日益扩大的量子机器学习系统建立基线经验与量子感知算法。

Method: 1) 将梯度、蒸馏、正则化、认证等主流 MU 技术迁移到量子框架；2) 针对混合模型提出两种专用反学习策略；3) 在 Iris、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST 上实施子集移除与整类删除两类删除场景，系统评估量子深度、纠缠结构与任务复杂度对遗忘效果的影响。

Result: 浅层 VQC 固有稳定性高、几乎无记忆；深层混合网络出现效用-遗忘-重训对齐三难权衡。EU-k、LCA 与 Certified Unlearning 在准确率下降、遗忘强度、重训一致性等指标上综合最优。结果对电路深度与 entanglement pattern 高度敏感。

Conclusion: 量子模型可支持高效反学习，但需量子专用算法与理论保证；研究为后续量子 MU 的算法设计与安全性分析提供了首个实证基线。代码已开源。

Abstract: We present the first empirical study of machine unlearning (MU) in hybrid quantum-classical neural networks. While MU has been extensively explored in classical deep learning, its behavior within variational quantum circuits (VQCs) and quantum-augmented architectures remains largely unexplored. First, we adapt a broad suite of unlearning methods to quantum settings, including gradient-based, distillation-based, regularization-based and certified techniques. Second, we introduce two new unlearning strategies tailored to hybrid models. Experiments across Iris, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST, under both subset removal and full-class deletion, reveal that quantum models can support effective unlearning, but outcomes depend strongly on circuit depth, entanglement structure, and task complexity. Shallow VQCs display high intrinsic stability with minimal memorization, whereas deeper hybrid models exhibit stronger trade-offs between utility, forgetting strength, and alignment with retrain oracle. We find that certain methods, e.g. EU-k, LCA, and Certified Unlearning, consistently provide the best balance across metrics. These findings establish baseline empirical insights into quantum machine unlearning and highlight the need for quantum-aware algorithms and theoretical guarantees, as quantum machine learning systems continue to expand in scale and capability. We publicly release our code at: https://github.com/CrivoiCarla/HQML.

</details>


### [1015] [From Classical Machine Learning to Tabular Foundation Models: An Empirical Investigation of Robustness and Scalability Under Class Imbalance in Emergency and Critical Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21602)
*Yusuf Brima,Marcellin Atemkeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究系统比较7类模型在高度不平衡的MIMIC-IV-ED和eICU表格数据集上的预测表现，发现没有一种模型在所有任务和数据集上全面领先，但基于推理的表格基础模型（TabPFN v2.6、TabICL）在急诊任务中加权F1最优，eICU则以XGBoost最佳；提出的轻量级TabResNet全面优于TabNet，凸显对不同场景按需选型的重要性 。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊科和重症监护中需要在高不确定、高度样本不平衡的表格数据上快速判定患者恶化风险，传统ML方法易受少数类样本稀缺影响而失效；亟需系统评估现有模型在极端不平衡下的鲁棒性与实际部署效率，为临床提供可靠、低成本的实时决策支持工具。

Method: 采集MIMIC-IV-ED与eICU两大公开重症数据库，构建7个高不平衡预测任务；对比决策树、随机森林、XGBoost、TabNet、自研轻量TabResNet、TabICL、TabPFN v2.6七大家族，采用加权F1、不平衡加剧鲁棒曲线与跨尺度算力测试三维评估；TabResNet以更少参数量实现类似TabNet的特征交互，并对基础模型采用纯推理范式零微调推理。

Result: 数据集决定最优模型：MIMIC-IV-ED上TabPFN v2.6与TabICL平均加权F1领先，XGBoost与TabResNet紧随；eICU上XGBoost居首，树模型整体优于基础模型；TabNet随着不平衡加深性能骤降且计算开销最大，TabResNet在所有任务稳定优于TabNet；扩展性方面树模型随数据量线性增长最优，基础模型依托单次预训练实现多任务低成本推理。

Conclusion: 临床高不平衡表格预测不存在“万能模型”，应根据任务大小、延迟与资源限制选型：资源充裕可选XGBoost或集成树模型；数据稀缺、计算受限场景可优先采用表格基础模型；轻量级TabResNet可作为TabNet的更高效替代。结果为未来在资源有限的临床环境中部署自适应、低门槛的机器学习辅助决策提供了模型选择基准与实证依据。

Abstract: Millions of patients pass through emergency departments and intensive care units each year, where clinicians must make high-stakes decisions under time pressure and uncertainty. Machine learning could support these decisions by predicting deterioration, guiding triage, and identifying rare but serious outcomes. Yet clinical tabular data are often highly imbalanced, biasing models toward majority classes. Building methods that are robust to imbalance and efficient enough for deployment remains a practical challenge.
  We investigated seven model families on imbalanced tabular data from MIMIC-IV-ED and eICU: Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, TabNet, TabResNet, TabICL, and TabPFN v2.6. TabResNet was designed as a lightweight alternative to TabNet. Models were evaluated using weighted F1-score, robustness to increasing imbalance, and computational scalability across seven prediction tasks.
  Performance varied by dataset. On MIMIC-IV-ED, TabPFN v2.6 and TabICL achieved the strongest average weighted F1 ranks, with XGBoost and TabResNet remaining competitive. On eICU, XGBoost performed best overall, followed by other tree-based methods, while foundation models ranked in the middle. TabNet showed the steepest performance decline as imbalance increased and the highest computational cost. TabResNet consistently outperformed TabNet, but did not surpass the best ensemble models. Classical and tree-based methods scaled most favourably with dataset size, while foundation models achieved low per-task cost through their inference-based paradigm.
  No single model family dominated across both datasets and tasks. However, tabular foundation models showed promise by combining competitive performance at low computational cost. If this efficiency generalizes to broader clinical settings, it could help lower the barrier to adaptive decision support in resource-constrained environments.

</details>


### [1016] [TreeAdv: Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03703)
*Lang Cao,Hui Ruan,Yongqian Li,Peng Chao,Wu Ning,Haonan Song,Renhong Chen,Yitong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 利用 rollout 的树结构对 token 级优势重分配的方法 TreeAdv，在数学推理任务上比 GRPO/GSPO 更高效，生成显著更短的思维链同时准确率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO 为每段 rollout 统一赋予全局优势，忽略 token 间的结构关系，导致采样效率低并偏好冗长但逻辑浅显的思维链。

Method: 1) 用熵驱动的采样策略构造公共前缀+在不确定性高的位置分支的“森林”结构；2) 规划完后将各完整路径（树叶）的返回值逆向重分配至内部节点与 token；3) 以此 token 级优势直接优化 GRPO/GSPO 一类群体级目标函数。

Result: 跨 10 个数学基准的建立理解与对齐刷精度实验：TreeAdv 在同等数据、监督、解码预算下平均提升 3–9% 准确率，并将生成的推理 tokens 削减 20–40%。

Conclusion: 显式利用群体 reward-rollouts 的树结构进行 token 级优势重分配，可提高强化学习在大模型推理对齐中的采样效率和可控性，表现出更强的“少 token 高质量”偏好。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with group-based objectives, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is a common framework for aligning large language models on complex reasoning tasks. However, standard GRPO treats each rollout trajectory as an independent flat sequence and assigns a single sequence-level advantage to all tokens, which leads to sample inefficiency and a length bias toward verbose, redundant chains of thought without improving logical depth. We introduce TreeAdv (Tree-Structured Advantage Redistribution for Group-Based RL), which makes the tree structure of group rollouts explicit for both exploration and advantage assignment. Specifically, TreeAdv builds a group of trees (a forest) based on an entropy-driven sampling method where each tree branches at high-uncertainty decisions while sharing low-uncertainty tokens across rollouts. Then, TreeAdv aggregates token-level advantages for internal tree segments by redistributing the advantages of complete rollouts (all leaf nodes), and TreeAdv can easily apply to group-based objectives such as GRPO or GSPO. Across 10 math reasoning benchmarks, TreeAdv consistently outperforms GRPO and GSPO, while using substantially fewer generated tokens under identical supervision, data, and decoding budgets.

</details>


### [1017] [Constrained Policy Optimization with Cantelli-Bounded Value-at-Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22993)
*Rohan Tangri,Jan-Peter Calliess*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VaR-CPO 是一种无需试错的保守型强化学习算法，通过矩近似与信任域扩展，在训练全程实现零约束违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 safe RL 方法在训练阶段仍可能出现约束违背，难以满足 VaR 风险约束下的零违规需求。

Method: 用 Cantelli 不等式将非光滑 VaR 约束转化为前两阶矩可计算的代理约束，并扩展 CPO 的信任域更新，为策略提升与约束违背提供最坏情况保证。

Result: 在可行环境中，VaR-CPO 训练全程零约束违反，采样效率优于基线。

Conclusion: VaR-CPO 在 VaR 风险约束下实现了保守且高效的策略优化，为安全强化学习提供了一种可部署的训练方案。

Abstract: We introduce the Value-at-Risk Constrained Policy Optimization algorithm (VaR-CPO), a sample efficient and conservative method designed to optimize Value-at-Risk (VaR) constrained reinforcement learning (RL) problems. Empirically, we demonstrate that VaR-CPO is capable of safe exploration, achieving zero constraint violations during training in feasible environments, a critical property that baseline methods fail to uphold. To overcome the inherent non-differentiability of the VaR constraint, we employ Cantelli's inequality to obtain a tractable approximation based on the first two moments of the cost return. Additionally, by extending the trust-region framework of the Constrained Policy Optimization (CPO) method, we provide worst-case bounds for both policy improvement and constraint violation during the training process.

</details>


### [1018] [MapTab: Are MLLMs Ready for Multi-Criteria Route Planning in Heterogeneous Graphs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18600)
*Ziqiao Shang,Lingyue Ge,Yang Chen,Shi-Yu Tian,Zhenyu Huang,Wenbo Fu,Yu-Feng Li,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MapTab 包含 32 万张路径规划与 4 千道 QA 题，首次系统评估 MLLM 在地图+表格 4 维约束下的综合推理能力，结果表明主流模型仍显著弱于单模基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准对多模大模型（MLLM）在「同时满足时间、价格、舒适度、可靠性」等多准则约束下的推理能力评估不足，阻碍 AGI 发展。

Method: 引入 MapTab：1) 双场景——160 城地铁网（Metromap）+168 处景点路网（Travelmap），共 328 幅地图；2) 每图配套结构化属性表；3) 自动生成 196 800 条路径规划任务与 3 936 道 QA，均需跨模态融合 4 准则做最优决策；4) 对 15 个代表性 MLLM 进行系统评测。

Result: 所有多模模型在多准则推理上均显著落后，且当视觉信息受限时，「图文协同」表现反而低于纯文本或纯视觉单模方法，暴露视觉感知与跨模态对齐缺陷。

Conclusion: MapTab 提供了高难度、真实场景的统一测试平台，推动 MLLM 在多准则多模态推理方向的持续迭代；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Systematic evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is crucial for advancing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). However, existing benchmarks remain insufficient for rigorously assessing their reasoning capabilities under multi-criteria constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce MapTab, a multimodal benchmark specifically designed to evaluate holistic multi-criteria reasoning in MLLMs via route planning tasks. MapTab requires MLLMs to perceive and ground visual cues from map images alongside route attributes (e.g., Time, Price) from structured tabular data. The benchmark encompasses two scenarios: Metromap, covering metro networks in 160 cities across 52 countries, and Travelmap, depicting 168 representative tourist attractions from 19 countries. In total, MapTab comprises 328 images, 196,800 route planning queries, and 3,936 QA queries, all incorporating 4 key criteria: Time, Price, Comfort, and Reliability. Extensive evaluations across 15 representative MLLMs reveal that current models face substantial challenges in multi-criteria multimodal reasoning. Notably, under conditions of limited visual perception, multimodal collaboration often underperforms compared to unimodal approaches. We believe MapTab provides a challenging and realistic testbed to advance the systematic evaluation of MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ziqiao-Shang/MapTab.

</details>


### [1019] [MultiModalPFN: Extending Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Multimodal Tabular Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20223)
*Wall Kim,Chaeyoung Song,Hanul Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MMPFN，把只能处理表格的TabPFN扩展到多模态，统一处理表格/图像/文本；用模态投射器＋多头门控MLP＋交叉注意力池化桥接异构数据，医疗及通用多模态数据集上全面SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TabPFN在表格任务表现优异，却无法直接利用医疗、营销等场景常见的图像、文本等非表格信息，限制了其适用范围。

Method: 设计MMPFN框架：各模态独立编码器→模态投射器（多头门控MLP+交叉注意力池化）将非表格嵌入转为表格兼容token→统一输入预训练TabPFN，以解决多模态注意力失衡并实现端到端训练。

Result: 在多个医疗和通用多模态基准上，MMPFN显著优于现有SOTA方法，证明其能有效融合表格与非表格特征并提升预测性能。

Conclusion: 首次把prior-data fitted network拓展到多模态，提供可扩展且高效的异构数据学习框架，代码已开源。

Abstract: Recently, TabPFN has gained attention as a foundation model for tabular data. However, it struggles to integrate heterogeneous modalities such as images and text, which are common in domains like healthcare and marketing, thereby limiting its applicability. To address this, we present the Multi-Modal Prior-data Fitted Network (MMPFN), which extends TabPFN to handle tabular and non-tabular modalities in a unified manner. MMPFN comprises per-modality encoders, modality projectors, and pre-trained foundation models. The modality projectors serve as the critical bridge, transforming non-tabular embeddings into tabular-compatible tokens for unified processing. To this end, we introduce a multi-head gated MLP and a cross-attention pooler that extract richer context from non-tabular inputs while mitigates attention imbalance issue in multimodal learning. Extensive experiments on medical and general-purpose multimodal datasets demonstrate that MMPFN consistently outperforms competitive state-of-the-art methods and effectively exploits non-tabular modalities alongside tabular features. These results highlight the promise of extending prior-data fitted networks to the multimodal setting, offering a scalable and effective framework for heterogeneous data learning. The source code is available at https://github.com/too-z/MultiModalPFN.

</details>


### [1020] [Why Adam Can Beat SGD: Second-Moment Normalization Yields Sharper Tails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03099)
*Ruinan Jin,Yingbin Liang,Shaofeng Zou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次证明Adam在相同二阶矩噪声假设下，其high-probability收敛对置信参数δ的依赖√1/δ，优于SGD的1/δ下限，从理论上拉开二者收敛速度差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam在许多任务中比SGD收敛更快，但现有理论仅给出与SGD同阶的保证，无法解释两者实验性能差距，需要新的理论框架论证Adam在收敛速度上的优势。

Method: 识别Adam的

Result: 在经典有界方差模型下，给出Adam首次high-probability收敛界：对置信参数δ的依赖为δ^{-1/2}，而SGD的下界为δ^{-1}，通过停止鞅技巧严格证明二者不可同日而语的高概率收敛速度。

Conclusion: Adam确实在理论上比SGD具有更优的high-probability收敛速度，首次预言并解释了实验中观察到的收敛差距，为二阶矩归一化在Adam加速中的作用提供了严格证据。

Abstract: Despite Adam demonstrating faster empirical convergence than SGD in many applications, much of the existing theory yields guarantees essentially comparable to those of SGD, leaving the empirical performance gap insufficiently explained. In this paper, we uncover a key second-moment normalization in Adam and develop a stopping-time/martingale analysis that provably distinguishes Adam from SGD under the classical bounded variance model (a second moment assumption). In particular, we establish the first theoretical separation between the high-probability convergence behaviors of the two methods: Adam achieves a $δ^{-1/2}$ dependence on the confidence parameter $δ$, whereas corresponding high-probability guarantee for SGD necessarily incurs at least a $δ^{-1}$ dependence.

</details>


### [1021] [Training event-based neural networks with exact gradients via Differentiable ODE Solving in JAX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08146)
*Lukas König,Manuel Kuhn,David Kappel,Anand Subramoney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Eventax用JAX把可微分ODE求解器与事件级脉冲处理结合，首次在通用ODE神经元模型上实现无梯度误差、时序精确的反向传播，并提供极简API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度训练SNN时，离散代用梯度法有偏差且时间分辨率受限；连续法虽梯度精确却仅适用于能解析求脉冲时间的简单模型（如LIF）。需要一种对任意复杂神经元都精确可训的框架。

Method: 在JAX上构建Eventax：核心用Diffrax的可微分ODE积分器正向仿真任意ODE描述的神经元动态；当满足用户自定义脉冲条件时，立即插入不连续事件并记录状态重置；反向传播通过伴随灵敏度法沿连续轨迹和离散事件同步求导，得到与仿真完全一致的梯度。API仅需用户给出三要素：ODE方程、脉冲触发函数、重置规则。

Result: 在Yin-Yang、MNIST上对比LIF、QIF、EIF、Izhikevich、EGRU等多种模型，Eventax的训练速度、准确率与已有代用梯度持平或更优，但梯度误差为零；首次用可训多房室模型（含人L2/3锥体神经元树突脉冲机制）完成图像分类任务，验证框架对复杂生物实性模型的支持。

Conclusion: Eventax消除了“精度-通用性”权衡，为研究事件驱动、生物细节丰富的SNN提供无需手工推导的端到端精确梯度训练工具，推动神经科学建模与神经形态算法协同开发。

Abstract: Existing frameworks for gradient-based training of spiking neural networks face a trade-off: discrete-time methods using surrogate gradients support arbitrary neuron models but introduce gradient bias and constrain spike-time resolution, while continuous-time methods that compute exact gradients require analytical expressions for spike times and state evolution, restricting them to simple neuron types such as Leaky Integrate and Fire (LIF). We introduce the Eventax framework, which resolves this trade-off by combining differentiable numerical ODE solvers with event-based spike handling. Built in JAX, our frame-work uses Diffrax ODE-solvers to compute gradients that are exact with respect to the forward simulation for any neuron model defined by ODEs . It also provides a simple API where users can specify just the neuron dynamics, spike conditions, and reset rules. Eventax prioritises modelling flexibility, supporting a wide range of neuron models, loss functions, and network architectures, which can be easily extended. We demonstrate Eventax on multiple benchmarks, including Yin-Yang and MNIST, using diverse neuron models such as Leaky Integrate-and-fire (LIF), Quadratic Integrate-and-fire (QIF), Exponential integrate-and-fire (EIF), Izhikevich and Event-based Gated Recurrent Unit (EGRU) with both time-to-first-spike and state-based loss functions, demonstrating its utility for prototyping and testing event-based architectures trained with exact gradients. We also demonstrate the application of this framework for more complex neuron types by implementing a multi-compartment neuron that uses a model of dendritic spikes in human layer 2/3 cortical Pyramidal neurons for computation. Code available at https://github.com/efficient-scalable-machine-learning/eventax.

</details>


### [1022] [C$^2$FG: Control Classifier-Free Guidance via Score Discrepancy Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.08155)
*Jiayang Gao,Tianyi Zheng,Jiayang Zou,Fengxiang Yang,Shice Liu,Luyao Fan,Zheyu Zhang,Hao Zhang,Jinwei Chen,Peng-Tao Jiang,Bo Li,Jia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出传统无分类器引导(CFG)使用固定或启发式权重忽视了扩散过程本身的动态特性，首次从理论上给出条件/无条件得分差异在扩散各时间步的严格上界，并据此提出无需训练、即插即用的C²FG方法，通过指数衰减函数让引导强度随时间步自适应变化，实验验证其通用性与兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代条件扩散模型依赖无分类器引导，但固定权重策略完全靠经验设定，无法匹配扩散过程内在的动态演化，导致生成质量受限；缺乏理论解释使得改进缺乏依据。

Method: 1) 对CFG进行理论分析，建立条件与无条件得分差异在任意时刻t的严格上界；2) 基于该界说明固定权重的不合理性，提出时间依赖引导的必要性；3) 设计C²FG——在采样阶段直接引入指数衰减控制函数调整引导强度，无需再训练或改变网络结构。

Result: 理论给出得分差异上界并揭示固定权重局限；C²FG在多种生成任务(图像、音频、文本到图像等)上一致提升FID、IS、CLIP-score等指标，且可与已有采样改进、分层引导等策略正交叠加，进一步提升效果。

Conclusion: 时间依赖引导是扩散模型的新原则；C²FG以零成本实现该原则，具有通用、易用、可叠加的优势，为后续条件扩散模型的采样控制提供了新基准。

Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is a cornerstone of modern conditional diffusion models, yet its reliance on the fixed or heuristic dynamic guidance weight is predominantly empirical and overlooks the inherent dynamics of the diffusion process. In this paper, we provide a rigorous theoretical analysis of the Classifier-Free Guidance. Specifically, we establish strict upper bounds on the score discrepancy between conditional and unconditional distributions at different timesteps based on the diffusion process. This finding explains the limitations of fixed-weight strategies and establishes a principled foundation for time-dependent guidance. Motivated by this insight, we introduce \textbf{Control Classifier-Free Guidance (C$^2$FG)}, a novel, training-free, and plug-in method that aligns the guidance strength with the diffusion dynamics via an exponential decay control function.
