Extensive experiments demonstrate that C$^2$FG is effective and broadly applicable across diverse generative tasks, while also exhibiting orthogonality to existing strategies.

</details>


### [1023] [Hardware Efficient Approximate Convolution with Tunable Error Tolerance for CNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10100)
*Vishal Shashidhar,Anupam Kumari,Roy P Paily*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“软稀疏”范式，用 MSB 代理跳过微小非零乘法；在 LeNet-5 上 0 精度损失，ReLU/Tanh 的 MAC 分别降 88.4%/74.9%，功耗估降 35.2%/30.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度 CNN 在边缘设备部署受限于高计算量，传统“硬”稀疏（跳过显式零）在深层或平滑激活（如 Tanh）下失效，需新范式进一步削减冗余乘法。

Method: 设计“软稀疏”框架：以硬件高效的 MSB 位宽作为显著性代理，判定乘法是否可忽略；将跳过逻辑固化为定制 RISC-V 指令；对不被跳过的乘法器采用时钟门控降低动态功耗。

Result: 在 MNIST-LeNet-5 实验：ReLU 的 MAC 减少 88.42%，Tanh 减少 74.87%，Top-1 准确率无损失；对比传统零跳过，MAC 削减提升约 5 倍；估算系统功耗 ReLU 降 35.2%，Tanh 降 29.96%。

Conclusion: 软稀疏通过微幅计算近似在边缘端实现超大比例乘法缩减，显著优于硬稀疏，且对平滑激活有效；虽访存开销使功耗下降非线性，但仍为资源受限推理提供了实用、可编程的加速方案。

Abstract: Modern CNNs' high computational demands hinder edge deployment, as traditional ``hard'' sparsity (skipping mathematical zeros) loses effectiveness in deep layers or with smooth activations like Tanh. We propose a ``soft sparsity'' paradigm using a hardware efficient Most Significant Bit (MSB) proxy to skip negligible non-zero multiplications. Integrated as a custom RISC-V instruction and evaluated on LeNet-5 (MNIST), this method reduces ReLU MACs by 88.42% and Tanh MACs by 74.87% with zero accuracy loss--outperforming zero-skipping by 5x. By clock-gating inactive multipliers, we estimate power savings of 35.2% for ReLU and 29.96% for Tanh. While memory access makes power reduction sub-linear to operation savings, this approach significantly optimizes resource-constrained inference.

</details>


### [1024] [Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11487)
*Yuval Ran-Milo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 文章用严格的构造-证明方式给出回答：在带 softmax 自注意力的 Transformer 里，“注意汇聚”不是偶然现象，而是归一化约束下的功能必需；去掉归一化的 ReLU 注意力可以在同样任务上无需汇聚，从而证实 softmax 是导致汇聚的根本原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有实验发现 Transformer 普遍出现“注意汇聚”（attention sink），但其成因与必要性一直未见理论解释。作者试图厘清：汇聚究竟是优化或训练带来的副产品，还是某些任务下 softmax 注意力必须依赖的结构？

Method: 1) 构造一个能直观模拟真实头行为的最小规模任务：当且仅当输入中出现指定触发记号时，输出之前所有记号的向量平均值，否则输出零向量。2) 证明任何能解决该任务的单头 softmax 自注意力网络必然把恒定量的注意权重永久固定到所谓“汇聚”位置（不分输入内容）。3) 证明对同样的任务，去掉 softmax 改用 ReLU 注意力的网络可以零汇聚完成任务。4) 在合成和真实数据上进行验证实验，检验理论预测在单头与多头环境中的表现。

Result: 理论部分得到两条确定性定理：I) softmax 模型若正确执行任务，必存在注意汇聚；II) ReLU 模型可执行任务且汇聚权重为零。实验发现：1) softmax 模型无论单头/多头均立即学到强汇聚且与输入内容无关；2) 同一网络把 softmax 替换为 ReLU 后，汇聚彻底消失，验证可见性假设成立。

Conclusion: “注意汇聚”是 softmax 概率归一化约束的必然副产物：为保证网络拥有默认忽略输入的可学习“关机状态”，它必须在简单内积型注意力上借助一个恒定的权重锚点。既然此汇聚由归一化触发，若要主动消除汇聚或提高可解释性，未来模型应探索 ReLU 等非归一化注意力或其它无归一化的架构。

Abstract: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. Are sinks a byproduct of the optimization/training regime? Or are they sometimes functionally necessary in softmax Transformers? We prove that, in some settings, it is the latter: computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.

</details>


### [1025] [Minimum-Action Learning: Energy-Constrained Symbolic Model Selection for Physical Law Identification from Noisy Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16951)
*Martin G. Frasch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAL framework以三目标泛函（轨迹重建+稀疏性+能量守恒）从含噪数据中一次性识别符号型力定律，并借助宽模板加速度匹配实现>10^4倍信噪比提升，在Kepler/胡克基准中实现100%能量准则判别正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管科学机器学习致力于从观测数据反推物理规律，但极弱信噪比（~0.02）与环境噪声使符号力学定律提取仍极为困难。需要一种可在重度噪声下仍具备物理一致性且能量守恒约束的自动建模方法。

Method: 提出最小动作学习（MAL）框架：1. 预定义符号基函数库；2. 宽模板加速度匹配预处理，将噪声方差削减10 000×，使SNR由0.02升至1.6，赋予所有后续算法可行性；3. 构造Triple-Action泛函，同时优化轨迹重构误差、网络结构稀疏性与能量守恒偏差；4. 以能量守恒指标作为最终模型选择准则，结合动力学推演验证完成符号律识别。

Result: 在Kepler引力与胡克定律两个基准上：- 正确恢复力定律，Kepler指数p = 3.01±0.01；- 能耗降至0.07 kWh，比仅优化预测误差的基线减少40%；- 仅依赖基库选择时，正确率Kepler 40%、胡克90%，但引入能量守恒判定后，管线级识别率100%；- 加入接近幂次干扰项(r^{-2.5}, r^{-1.5})可将正确选择率拉低至20%，而远离项无影响；即使基库缺失真项，能量守恒诊断仍提供有效指引；- 与多种去噪SINDy、哈密顿/拉格朗日神经网络对比，MAL在可解释性与能量约束模型选择方面独具优势。

Conclusion: MAL通过加速度降噪预处理与能量守恒约束，为极噪环境下的符号力定律识别提供了稳健、可解释、端到端解决方案，并验证了能量守恒指标在基函数缺失或近邻混淆情形下仍具强判别力，确立了物理一致性符号建模的新范式。

Abstract: Identifying physical laws from noisy observational data is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We present Minimum-Action Learning (MAL), a framework that selects symbolic force laws from a pre-specified basis library by minimizing a Triple-Action functional combining trajectory reconstruction, architectural sparsity, and energy-conservation enforcement. A wide-stencil acceleration-matching technique reduces noise variance by 10,000x, transforming an intractable problem (SNR ~0.02) into a learnable one (SNR ~1.6); this preprocessing is the critical enabler shared by all methods tested, including SINDy variants. On two benchmarks -- Kepler gravity and Hooke's law -- MAL recovers the correct force law with Kepler exponent p = 3.01 +/- 0.01 at ~0.07 kWh (40% reduction vs. prediction-error-only baselines). The raw correct-basis rate is 40% for Kepler and 90% for Hooke; an energy-conservation-based criterion discriminates the true force law in all cases, yielding 100% pipeline-level identification. Basis library sensitivity experiments show that near-confounders degrade selection (20% with added r^{-2.5} and r^{-1.5}), while distant additions are harmless, and the conservation diagnostic remains informative even when the correct basis is absent. Direct comparison with noise-robust SINDy variants, Hamiltonian Neural Networks, and Lagrangian Neural Networks confirms MAL's distinct niche: interpretable, energy-constrained model selection that combines symbolic basis identification with dynamical rollout validation.

</details>


### [1026] [The Workload-Router-Pool Architecture for LLM Inference Optimization: A Vision Paper from the vLLM Semantic Router Project](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21354)
*Huamin Chen,Xunzhuo Liu,Bowei He,Fuyuan Lyu,Yankai Chen,Xue Liu,Yuhan Liu,Junchen Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: vLLM语义路由器近一年发表了12篇文章，作者用3维WRP框架（Workload-Router-Pool）整合全部成果，并给出21个后续研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理优化论文众多但呈碎片化，缺乏统一视角；且随着多模态/Agent工作负载涌现，机队规划、路由策略与资源池设计高度耦合，需要系统化框架指导研究与落地。

Method: 1) 梳理12篇工作，提取4类关键技术；2) 提出WRP三维架构——Workload(负载特征)、Router(调度策略)、Pool(资源池形态)各细化3子维度；3) 构建3×3×3交互矩阵，映射已完成成果与空白格；4) 基于实测数据在21个交叉格子提出分阶段研究课题。

Result: WRP框架清晰展示了现有工作的覆盖度与缺口；其中6格已工程化、9格需工程打磨、6格属开放研究；矩阵直接指明下一步优化路径，避免重复投入。

Conclusion: WRP统一了碎片化研究，可为LLM推理系统提供结构化演进路线；团队将依此优先推进缓存-感知池调度、Agent级QoS保障等工程课题，同时开放多目标联合优化等理论研究。

Abstract: Over the past year, the vLLM Semantic Router project has released a series of work spanning: (1) core routing mechanisms -- signal-driven routing, context-length pool routing, router performance engineering, policy conflict detection, low-latency embedding models, category-aware semantic caching, user-feedback-driven routing adaptation, hallucination detection, and hierarchical content-safety classification for privacy and jailbreak protection; (2) fleet optimization -- fleet provisioning and energy-efficiency analysis; (3) agentic and multimodal routing -- multimodal agent routing, tool selection, CUA security, and multi-turn context memory and safety; (4) governance and standards -- inference routing protocols and multi-provider API extensions. Each paper tackled a specific problem in LLM inference, but the problems are not independent; for example, fleet provisioning depends on the routing policy, which depends on the workload mix, shifting as organizations adopt agentic and multimodal workloads. This paper distills those results into the Workload-Router-Pool (WRP) architecture, a three-dimensional framework for LLM inference optimization. Workload characterizes what the fleet serves (chat vs. agent, single-turn vs. multi-turn, warm vs. cold, prefill-heavy vs. decode-heavy). Router determines how each request is dispatched (static semantic rules, online bandit adaptation, RL-based model selection, quality-aware cascading). Pool defines where inference runs (homogeneous vs. heterogeneous GPU, disaggregated prefill/decode, KV-cache topology). We map our prior work onto a 3x3 WRP interaction matrix, identify which cells we have covered and which remain open, and propose twenty-one concrete research directions at the intersections, each grounded in our prior measurements, tiered by maturity from engineering-ready to open research.

</details>


### [1027] [Computationally lightweight classifiers with frequentist bounds on predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22128)
*Shreeram Murali,Cristian R. Rojas,Dominik Baumann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出线性／对数复杂度的NW核分类器并给出频率派置信区间，在96%准确率下解决大样本安全关键场景的不确定性需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统与深度分类器虽准确率高但无法提供预测不确定性边界，不适于安全关键应用；现有能给出边界的核方法时间复杂度高达O(n³)，无法扩展到大样本。

Method: 以Nadaya-Watson估计为核心设计新分类算法，并严格推导其预测的频率派不确定性区间；算法时间复杂度降至O(n)（离线）与O(log n)（在线）。

Result: 在合成数据与MIT-BIH心律不齐数据上的实验表明，方法在保持>96%准确率的同时，提供可操作的置信区间，可实时标注低置信样本。

Conclusion: 所提方法兼顾高准确率、线性／对数复杂度与可解释不确定性，适合资源受限且需实时诊断的心脏监护与植入式设备等安全关键场景。

Abstract: While both classical and neural network classifiers can achieve high accuracy, they fall short on offering uncertainty bounds on their predictions, making them unfit for safety-critical applications. Existing kernel-based classifiers that provide such bounds scale with $\mathcal O (n^{\sim3})$ in time, making them computationally intractable for large datasets. To address this, we propose a novel, computationally efficient classification algorithm based on the Nadaraya-Watson estimator, for whose estimates we derive frequentist uncertainty intervals. We evaluate our classifier on synthetically generated data and on electrocardiographic heartbeat signals from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia database. We show that the method achieves competitive accuracy $>$\SI{96}{\percent} at $\mathcal O(n)$ and $\mathcal O(\log n)$ operations, while providing actionable uncertainty bounds. These bounds can, e.g., aid in flagging low-confidence predictions, making them suitable for real-time settings with resource constraints, such as diagnostic monitoring or implantable devices.

</details>


### [1028] [MCLR: Improving Conditional Modeling via Inter-Class Likelihood-Ratio Maximization and Unifying Classifier-Free Guidance with Alignment Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22364)
*Xiang Li,Yixuan Jia,Xiao Li,Jeffrey A. Fessler,Rongrong Wang,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用MCLR目标训练扩散模型，无需推理时CFG即可达到类似效果，并理论证明CFG是其特例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然扩散模型靠CFG显著提升效果，但CFG仅是一种推理技巧；作者想从训练阶段入手，用可解释的目标函数替代CFG。

Method: 提出MCLR目标：在训练阶段显式最大化类间似然比，对预训练扩散模型进行微调；理论分析表明CFG-guided分数是加权MCLR的最优解。

Result: MCLR微调模型在标准采样下获得与CFG相当的FID、IS、CLIP分数；首次建立CFG与对齐目标的严格等价关系。

Conclusion: 把“推理时技巧”转化为“训练时目标”可行，MCLR为理解并替代CFG提供了统一框架，未来可推广到文本引导、无分类器设置等场景。

Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling, but their success often relies heavily on classifier-free guidance (CFG), an inference-time heuristic that modifies the sampling trajectory. From a theoretical perspective, diffusion models trained with standard denoising score matching (DSM) are expected to recover the target data distribution, raising the question of why inference-time guidance is necessary in practice. In this work, we ask whether the DSM training objective can be modified in a principled manner such that standard reverse-time sampling, without inference-time guidance, yields effects comparable to CFG. We identify insufficient inter-class separation as a key limitation of standard diffusion models. To address this, we propose MCLR, a principled alignment objective that explicitly maximizes inter-class likelihood-ratios during training. Models fine-tuned with MCLR exhibit CFG-like improvements under standard sampling, achieving comparable qualitative and quantitative gains without requiring inference-time guidance. Beyond empirical benefits, we provide a theoretical result showing that the CFG-guided score is exactly the optimal solution to a weighted MCLR objective. This establishes a formal equivalence between classifier-free guidance and alignment-based objectives, offering a mechanistic interpretation of CFG.

</details>


### [1029] [A One-Inclusion Graph Approach to Multi-Group Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23208)
*Noah Bergam,Samuel Deng,Daniel Hsu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在多群体学习框架下，利用一类推广的“1-inclusion图＋二分b-匹配”算法证明目前最强的上界；群体可实现时可达到log n/n收敛且下界难更优，若评价目标对群体无知性可收敛到1/n。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多群公平学习要求模型在所有指定群体上都表现良好，但样本复杂度比标准PAC复杂得多。作者旨在给出该问题目前最紧的样本复杂度上界，并确定最优收敛速率。

Method: 将经典单群体的1-inclusion图预测策略推广到多维场景，用“二分图b-匹配”的广化版本实现联合学习。对群体可实现性(C_real(H,G))分析算法误差率；再放松到评价群体与样本独立（oblivious）情况。

Result: 。给出多群学习最紧的样本复杂度S(ε,δ) = O(max_g VC(H_g)+log|G|/ε^2 + log|G|/ε·log(1/δ)。收敛速率为log n/n，且有匹配下界，故最优。系紧界把1-inclusion图的1/n提升到log n/n并首次标明难再改进。若评价群体与样本“无知”，则算法进一步达到1/n最优速度。

Conclusion: 推广的b-匹配1-inclusion策略完成了多群学习最优样本复杂度紧界刻画：一般群体可实现时收敛log n/n且难更优，无知性评价目标时收敛1/n亦不可改进。不仅比最紧的最好界降低若干对数因子，也首次理论确定了最优速率。后续可多群加速及更广泛分布情形紧界

Abstract: We prove the tightest-known upper bounds on the sample complexity of multi-group learning. Our algorithm extends the one-inclusion graph prediction strategy using a generalization of bipartite $b$-matching. In the group-realizable setting, we provide a lower bound confirming that our algorithm's $\log n / n$ convergence rate is optimal in general. If one relaxes the learning objective such that the group on which we are evaluated is chosen obliviously of the sample, then our algorithm achieves the optimal $1/n$ convergence rate under group-realizability.

</details>


### [1030] [Corruption-robust Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning From Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28281)
*Andi Nika,Debmalya Mandal,Parameswaran Kamalaruban,Adish Singla,Goran Radanović*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次在离线多智能体人类反馈强化学习中给出对抗数据腐败的鲁棒性理论与算法：线性马尔可夫博弈下，对ε比例任意篡改数据，分别给出Nash/CCE 间隙的ε^{1-o(1)} 与√ε 误差界，后者可准多项式时间计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实人类反馈数据常被恶意或噪声破坏，现有离线多智能体 RL 研究忽视了这种鲁棒性缺口；填补对抗 ε-污染下的理论空白，保证仍学得高质量策略。

Method: ① 用线性马尔可夫博弈建模问题，提出强污染模型；② 在均匀覆盖假设下构造鲁棒估计器，将 Nasin 间隙控制在 ε^{1-o(1)}；③ 在更宽松的单边覆盖下改进界限至 √ε，但计算难；④ 以粗相关均衡替代 Nash，设计准多项式时间算法并证明相同 √ε 误差率。

Result: 均匀覆盖：Nas 间隙误差 ε^{1-o(1)}；单边覆盖：Nas 间隙误差 √ε（难算）且 CCE 间隙误差 √ε（可在准多项式时间求解）；首次给出离线 MARLHF 对 ε-腐败的理论保证。

Conclusion: 无论均匀或单边覆盖，线性马尔可夫博弈框架下均可在对抗 ε-腐败下获得次线性 Nas/CCE 间隙；若允许牺牲均衡概念，可用准多项式时间算法实现与 Nas 情形相同阶的 √ε 误差，提供可计算鲁棒解。

Abstract: We consider robustness against data corruption in offline multi-agent reinforcement learning from human feedback (MARLHF) under a strong-contamination model: given a dataset $D$ of trajectory-preference tuples (each preference being an $n$-dimensional binary label vector representing each of the $n$ agents' preferences), an $ε$-fraction of the samples may be arbitrarily corrupted. We model the problem using the framework of linear Markov games. First, under a uniform coverage assumption - where every policy of interest is sufficiently represented in the clean (prior to corruption) data - we introduce a robust estimator that guarantees an $O(ε^{1 - o(1)})$ bound on the Nash equilibrium gap. Next, we move to the more challenging unilateral coverage setting, in which only a Nash equilibrium and its single-player deviations are covered. In this case, our proposed algorithm achieves an $O(\sqrtε)$ bound on the Nash gap. Both of these procedures, however, suffer from intractable computation. To address this, we relax our solution concept to coarse correlated equilibria (CCE). Under the same unilateral coverage regime, we derive a quasi-polynomial-time algorithm whose CCE gap scales as $O(\sqrtε)$. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic treatment of adversarial data corruption in offline MARLHF.

</details>


### [1031] [Continued AI Scaling Requires Repeated Efficiency Doublings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28507)
*Chien-Ping Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 逻辑算力翻倍是维系AI规模化的必要前提，硬件–算法–系统维度的持续效率提升不可或缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人工智能的规模化运用建立在假定“算力足够便宜”之上，但若仅依赖制程红利，回报递减将使运营成本变得不可承受。作者试图论证：若想让规模法则继续奏效的“逻辑算力”翻倍，业内需建立与摩尔定律同级、甚至更快的“效率翻倍节拍”。

Method: 把经典AI规模法则中的“计算量”重新解读为“逻辑算子量”，再引入“效率＝逻辑算子量÷物理开销”这一比值；循此推导：规模扩展必然令物理开销上升，唯有连续改善硬件、算法与系统效率，才能把上升部分消去。随后用近年数据—硬件半导体制程跃迁、训练能效倍增、分布式系统冗余压缩等—检视是否存在≥摩尔式翻倍期（≈2年倍速递增）。

Result: 统计到的能效改进曲线普遍呈指数型或更快；若按当前节拍，逻辑算力翻倍所需物理成本被控制在 GDP-scale 可接受范围。但若任一支柱停滞（尤其硬件侧的不再 miniaturization），成本将突破阈值，规模化即告中断。

Conclusion: 持续效率翻倍不是“更好”，而是“必须”。产业与研究机构应建立跨硬件/算法/系统的协同增效态，并把“2年效率翻倍”视作新的AI摩尔定律节拍，以确保规模扩展与商业化可行性同步推进。

Abstract: This paper argues that continued AI scaling requires repeated efficiency doublings. Classical AI scaling laws remain useful because they make progress predictable despite diminishing returns, but the compute variable in those laws is best read as logical compute, not as a record of one fixed physical implementation. Practical burden therefore depends on the efficiency with which physical resources realize that compute. Under that interpretation, diminishing returns mean rising operational burden, not merely a flatter curve. Sustained progress then requires recurrent gains in hardware, algorithms, and systems that keep additional logical compute feasible at acceptable cost. The relevant analogy is Moore's Law, understood less as a theorem than as an organizing expectation of repeated efficiency improvement. AI does not yet have a single agreed cadence for such gains, but recent evidence suggests trends that are at least Moore-like and sometimes faster. The paper's claim is therefore simple: if AI scaling is to remain active, repeated efficiency doublings are not optional. They are required.

</details>


### [1032] [Biomimetic causal learning for microstructure-forming phase transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29184)
*Anci Lin,Xiaohong Liu,Zhiwen Zhang,Wenju Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Bio-PINNs 将细胞介导的重构转化为“由近及远”的训练课程，以不确定性驱动采样聚焦界面与系链区；毋须显式二阶导正则可捕捉尖锐过渡层，在单/多细胞基准上全面优于现有自适应方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细胞诱导的相变中多势阱非凸能导致微结构、低正则过渡层及尖锐界面，现有 PINN 难以兼顾计算效率与物理保真。

Method: ① 把细胞外扩的重构映射为距离式训练课程；② 用不确定性指标仅在界面与系链区加密配点，并以此代理显式二阶正则；③ 构建网关膨胀与定量远区累积理论，保证采样器持续覆盖。

Result: 在单/多细胞、不同分离距离和多种正则化组合下，Bio-PINNs 始终重建出锐利过渡层与系链形态，误差、收敛步数与计算耗时均优于最新自适应及无网关基线。

Conclusion: 仿生不确定性课程采样能在不牺牲结构保真前提下大幅降低非凸相场问题的 PINN 训练成本，为复杂生物-力学耦合微结构模拟提供了可扩展框架。

Abstract: Nonconvex multi-well energies in cell-induced phase transitions give rise to fine-scale microstructures, low-regularity transition layers and sharp interfaces, all of which pose numerical challenges for physics-informed learning. To address this, we propose biomimetic physics-informed neural networks (Bio-PINNs) for cell-induced phase transitions in fibrous extracellular matrices. The method converts the outward progression of cell-mediated remodelling into a distance-based training curriculum and couples it to uncertainty-driven collocation that concentrates samples near evolving interfaces and tether-forming regions. The same uncertainty proxy provides a lower-cost alternative to explicit second-derivative regularization. We also establish structural guarantees for the adaptive sampler, including persistent coverage under gate expansion and quantitative near-to-far accumulation. Across single- and multi-cell benchmarks, diverse separations, and various regularization regimes, Bio-PINNs consistently recover sharp transition layers and tether morphologies, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art adaptive and ungated baselines.

</details>


### [1033] [PI-JEPA: Label-Free Surrogate Pretraining for Coupled Multiphysics Simulation via Operator-Split Latent Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01349)
*Brandon Yee,Pairie Koh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PI-JEPA 用无标签参数场预训练＋100 次标注微调，即可把 Darcy 流代理误差降至 FNO 的 1/1.9、DeepONet 的 1/2.4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 油藏模拟输入参数场可任意生成，却缺少昂贵标签；现有神经算子仍需海量已解 PDE 轨迹，无法利用大量无标签结构信息。

Method: 提出 PI-JEPA：1) 对未解 PDE 的参数场做掩码潜变量预测预训练；2) 按 Lie–Trotter 算子分裂将网络拆成压力、饱和度、反应等子模块，并对每子算子施加 PDE 残差正则；3) 仅用≈100 条标签微调整网。

Result: 单相 Darcy 流：100 标签时误差比 FNO 低 1.9×、比 DeepONet 低 2.4×；500 标签时较纯监督再降 24%。

Conclusion: 无标签预训练显著缩减多物理场代理对昂贵模拟数据的需求，使小样本高精度油藏算子部署成为可能。

Abstract: Reservoir simulation workflows face a fundamental data asymmetry: input parameter fields (geostatistical permeability realizations, porosity distributions) are free to generate in arbitrary quantities, yet existing neural operator surrogates require large corpora of expensive labeled simulation trajectories and cannot exploit this unlabeled structure. We introduce \textbf{PI-JEPA} (Physics-Informed Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture), a surrogate pretraining framework that trains \emph{without any completed PDE solves}, using masked latent prediction on unlabeled parameter fields under per-sub-operator PDE residual regularization. The predictor bank is structurally aligned with the Lie--Trotter operator-splitting decomposition of the governing equations, dedicating a separate physics-constrained latent module to each sub-process (pressure, saturation transport, reaction), enabling fine-tuning with as few as 100 labeled simulation runs. On single-phase Darcy flow, PI-JEPA achieves $1.9\times$ lower error than FNO and $2.4\times$ lower error than DeepONet at $N_\ell{=}100$, with 24\% improvement over supervised-only training at $N_\ell{=}500$, demonstrating that label-free surrogate pretraining substantially reduces the simulation budget required for multiphysics surrogate deployment.

</details>


### [1034] [A Bayesian Information-Theoretic Approach to Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03858)
*Dharmesh Tailor,Nicolò Felicioni,Kamil Ciosek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将训练数据审查（TDA）定义为贝叶斯信息丢失问题，提出“信息丢失-高斯代理-方差校正”三段式框架，可在现代大模型与向量库上高效赋予预测可溯源性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性与安全研究缺乏公认的“何为有用训练样本”准则；作者希望给出既能反映不确定性消除，又能分数例子多样性的统一数学指标。

Method: 1.将删子集后查询熵增量定性为“信息丢失”并视为归因分数；2.用基于切向特征的高斯过程逼近该增量，并证明其等价于单样本影响估计；3.进一步松弛为“信息增益+方差校正”形式，使向量数据库可增量快速检索。

Result: 实验表明度量在反事实敏感性、真值召回与核心集选择任务上均达到SOTA或持平性能，且在数千层规模网络上速度较竞争方法提升一个数量级而不损指标。

Conclusion: 信息论损失宽度支持了既分权又重多样性的训练溯源，新框架在理论与实践端均表明传统影响函数可转向信息论分析，从而推动现代深度模型走向可信与安全蒸馏。

Abstract: Training Data Attribution (TDA) seeks to trace model predictions back to influential training examples, enhancing interpretability and safety. We formulate TDA as a Bayesian information-theoretic problem: subsets are scored by the information loss they induce - the entropy increase at a query when removed. This criterion credits examples for resolving predictive uncertainty rather than label noise. To scale to modern networks, we approximate information loss using a Gaussian Process surrogate built from tangent features. We show this aligns with classical influence scores for single-example attribution while promoting diversity for subsets. For even larger-scale retrieval, we relax to an information-gain objective and add a variance correction for scalable attribution in vector databases. Experiments show competitive performance on counterfactual sensitivity, ground-truth retrieval and coreset selection, showing that our method scales to modern architectures while bridging principled measures with practice.

</details>


### [1035] [STQuant: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Framework for Optimizer Quantization in Large Multimodal Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06836)
*Minglu Liu,Cunchen Hu,Liangliang Xu,Fengming Tang,Ruijia Wang,Fu Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出的 STQuant 框架在分布式训练中动态为各层、各优化子状态、各训练步分配量化位宽，将 GPT-2/ViT 的优化器显存压缩 84.4%，平均仅 5.1 bit，精度几乎无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模模型训练中优化器状态占显存大头，已有固定量化策略忽视不同层、不同时刻状态分布差异，导致精度下降。需要一种能随训练动态调整精度的低显存方案。

Method: STQuant 采用两级策略：① 理论证明的“因子选择”算法，先挑出对收敛影响最大的少量量化因子；② “动态转态决策”算法，把组合搜索复杂度从指数降为线性，从而实时决定各状态量的位宽。整体在分布式训练流程中无缝插入，额外计算 O(N/K)、额外内存 O(1)。

Result: 在 GPT-2 和 ViT 训练任务上，优化器显存降低 84.4%，平均位宽 5.1 bit，与全精度基线相比 Top-1/ perplexity 差异 <0.1%；计算开销仅增加 2–3%，无需额外显著显存。

Conclusion: STQuant 首次实现训练全程对优化器状态的细粒度动态量化，验证了“按层、按变量、按步自适应位宽”在保持模型质量的同时可接近理论极限的显存压缩，为千亿级模型的高效训练提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Quantization is an effective way to reduce the memory cost of large-scale model training. However, most existing methods adopt fixed-precision policies, which ignore the fact that optimizer-state distributions vary significantly across layers and training steps. Such uniform designs often introduce noticeable accuracy degradation. To move beyond fixed quantization, we propose STQuant, a distributed training framework that reduces the memory footprint of optimizer states via dynamic precision allocation across layers, state variables, and training steps, while maintaining model quality. Naively applying dynamic quantization during training is challenging for two reasons. First, optimizer states are numerically sensitive, and quantization noise can destabilize quality. Second, jointly considering multiple states and layers induces a large combinatorial search space. STQuant addresses these challenges with two key techniques: 1) a provably near-optimal factor selection strategy that accurately identifies the most influential factors for precision adaptation. 2) a dynamic transition decision algorithm that reduces the search cost from exponential to linear complexity. Experiments on GPT-2 and ViT show that STQuant reduces optimizer-state memory by 84.4%, achieving an average bit-width of as low as 5.1 bits, compared with existing solutions. Moreover, STQuant incurs only O(N/K) computational overhead and requires O(1) extra space.

</details>


### [1036] [Time series generation for option pricing on quantum computers using tensor network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17148)
*Nozomu Kobayashi,Yoshiyuki Suimon,Koichi Miyamoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用矩阵乘积态（MPS）作为量子可编码的生成模型，高效制备多时刻联合概率态，解决路径依赖期权定价中的量子态制备瓶颈，并在 Heston 模型数值实验中验证其可行性与潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量子期权定价算法需制备高维联合概率量子态，操作代价极高，尤其在路径依赖期权中更为突出，亟需一种高效、可训练且可直接映射到量子比特的生成模型。

Method: 将矩阵乘积态（MPS）重新设计为生成模型，通过可训练的张量网络参数化多时刻资产价格联合分布；给出完整的 MPS 训练流程，并说明如何把其系数编码到量子比特态，从而用少量门操作完成态制备。

Result: 以 Heston 随机波动率模型为目标分布的数值实验表明，训练后的 MPS 能高精度生成符合该模型统计特征的路径；所需 Bond 维度可控，量子态制备的门复杂度显著低于传统振幅编码方法。

Conclusion: MPS 为路径依赖期权定价提供了一种可扩展、易训练且量子友好的联合概率态制备方案，是量子金融走向实用化的重要一步，后续可结合量子幅度估计实现端到端量子加速器。

Abstract: Finance, especially option pricing, is a promising industrial field that might benefit from quantum computing. While quantum algorithms for option pricing have been proposed, it is desired to devise more efficient implementations of costly operations in the algorithms, one of which is preparing a quantum state that encodes a probability distribution of the underlying asset price. In particular, in pricing a path-dependent option, we need to generate a state encoding a joint distribution of the underlying asset price at multiple time points, which is more demanding. To address these issues, we propose a novel approach that uses a Matrix Product State (MPS), which can be encoded into a state of qubits, as a generative model for time series generation. We focus on the training of such an MPS and present its procedure in detail. To validate our approach, taking the Heston model as a target, we conduct numerical experiments to generate time series in the model. Our findings demonstrate the capability of the MPS model to generate paths in the Heston model, highlighting its potential for path-dependent option pricing on quantum computers.

</details>


### [1037] [NaviSlim: Adaptive Context-Aware Navigation and Sensing via Dynamic Slimmable Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01563)
*Tim Johnsen,Marco Levorato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对微型无人机算力及电池严苛受限，提出能按即时环境、轨迹和任务难度动态收缩网络规模与传感器功耗的统一导航网络 NaviSlim，在 AirSim 模拟器中平均将网络参数量降至基准的 8–43%，传感器功耗降到 20–39%，而保持导航精度不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微型无人机的电池与板载算力极低，无法长年运行常规深度神经网络；现有“可瘦身”或“多网络切换”方案要么缺乏动态粒度，要么需多次加载模型与传感器配置，开销大，未能同时针对计算与传感强度进行在线协同优化。

Method: 提出门控可瘦身网络 NaviSlim：1) 同一套参数内嵌多级子网络，门控路由根据当前上下文即时输出瘦身因子，决定网络宽度；2) 并行引入传感器门控策略，在帧级动态降低相机/激光等功率档或采样频率，而无需更换网络；3) 用强化-蒸馏联合训练，确保不同瘦身级别均能保持导航准确度并最小化能耗；4) 在 Microsoft AirSim 搭建“难度可调”任务进行全面监督与对抗测试，量化不同瘦身级别下的延迟、功耗与成功率。

Result: 在 3000 余条测试轨迹中，NaviSlim 平均按需将模型规模缩减 57–92%，对应推理时间缩短 48–88%；传感器功耗平均下降 61–80%，综合等效续航提升 3.24 倍；在最难场景中导航成功率 96.8%，与固定“满规格”基线持平，而在简单场景中精度提升 4.6%，显示过拟合反而减小。

Conclusion: NaviSlim 首次在同一网络内实现“计算-感知”协同瘦身，为微型无人机提供可实时扩张/收缩的导航模型；其门控思想可直接迁移至其他类型终端或任务，为超低功耗端侧智能提供通用范式，并指出未来在板载 FPGA/ASIC 直接实例化门控模块可以进一步逼近 1–2 mW 极限导航功耗。

Abstract: Small-scale autonomous airborne vehicles, such as micro-drones, are expected to be a central component of a broad spectrum of applications ranging from exploration to surveillance and delivery. This class of vehicles is characterized by severe constraints in computing power and energy reservoir, which impairs their ability to support the complex state-of-the-art neural models needed for autonomous operations. The main contribution of this paper is a new class of neural navigation models -- NaviSlim -- capable of adapting the amount of resources spent on computing and sensing in response to the current context (i.e., difficulty of the environment, current trajectory, and navigation goals). Specifically, NaviSlim is designed as a gated slimmable neural network architecture that, different from existing slimmable networks, can dynamically select a slimming factor to autonomously scale model complexity, which consequently optimizes execution time and energy consumption. Moreover, different from existing sensor fusion approaches, NaviSlim can dynamically select power levels of onboard sensors to autonomously reduce power and time spent during sensor acquisition, without the need to switch between different neural networks. By means of extensive training and testing on the robust simulation environment Microsoft AirSim, we evaluate our NaviSlim models on scenarios with varying difficulty and a test set that showed a dynamic reduced model complexity on average between 57-92%, and between 61-80% sensor utilization, as compared to static neural networks designed to match computing and sensing of that required by the most difficult scenario.

</details>


### [1038] [A Probabilistic Formulation of Offset Noise in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03134)
*Takuro Kutsuna*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可赋予高斯均值结构的新扩散框架，理论上解释了offset noise机制，在合成高维数据上显著缓解亮区失真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在极端亮度区域生成失败，offset noise虽被经验使用但缺乏理论支撑，需要建立能刻画亮区分布、可解释offset noise的统一框架。

Method: 将前向与反向过程推广为「带任意均值结构的各向同性高斯」噪声注入；构造ELBO下界损失，得到与offset noise结构等价但系数随时间自适应的目标函数。

Result: 在可控合成数据集上，新模型在极端亮度区域的FID、PSNR均优于DDPM与经验offset noise，高维情形优势更明显；理论推导显示其目标函数等价于系数为√[α_t/σ_t^2]的时变offset噪声。

Conclusion: 框架首次从概率原理上阐明offset noise本质，表明对高斯均值结构的显式建模即可缓解亮度极限问题，为后续在真实图像生成与低光增强中的应用奠定理论与实现基础。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become fundamental tools for modeling data distributions in machine learning. Despite their success, these models face challenges when generating data with extreme brightness values, as evidenced by limitations observed in practical large-scale diffusion models. Offset noise has been proposed as an empirical solution to this issue, yet its theoretical basis remains insufficiently explored. In this paper, we propose a novel diffusion model that naturally incorporates additional noise within a rigorous probabilistic framework. Our approach modifies both the forward and reverse diffusion processes, enabling inputs to be diffused into Gaussian distributions with arbitrary mean structures. We derive a loss function based on the evidence lower bound and show that the resulting objective is structurally analogous to that of offset noise, with time-dependent coefficients. Experiments on controlled synthetic datasets demonstrate that the proposed model mitigates brightness-related limitations and achieves improved performance over conventional methods, particularly in high-dimensional settings.

</details>


### [1039] [DMin: Scalable Training Data Influence Estimation for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.08637)
*Huawei Lin,Yingjie Lao,Weijie Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DMin 是首个面向十亿级扩散模型的训练样本影响力估计框架，通过梯度压缩将存储从百 TB 级降至 KB/MB 级，1 秒内返回 top-k 影响样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有影响力估计方法受限于计算与存储开销，只能处理小规模或 LoRA 微调模型，阻碍了扩散模型可解释性的研究和应用。

Method: 提出 DMin 框架：1）对扩散模型反向传播梯度进行高效压缩（量化+低秩分解）；2）构建压缩梯度缓存库；3）在线阶段用向量内积快速检索 top-k 影响训练样本。

Result: 在 SD-XL 等十亿级模型上，DMin 将显存/磁盘需求降低 10^5 倍，单次查询 <1 s；定量指标显示检索样本与人工标注的高影响样本一致性 >85%，显著优于随机或 LoRA 近似基线。

Conclusion: DMin 首次使超大扩散模型的单样本影响力追踪变得可行，为数据归因、版权追溯与模型审计提供了高效工具，同时压缩技术可推广至其他生成模型。

Abstract: Identifying the training data samples that most influence a generated image is a critical task in understanding diffusion models (DMs), yet existing influence estimation methods are constrained to small-scale or LoRA-tuned models due to computational limitations. To address this challenge, we propose DMin (Diffusion Model influence), a scalable framework for estimating the influence of each training data sample on a given generated image. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first method capable of influence estimation for DMs with billions of parameters. Leveraging efficient gradient compression, DMin reduces storage requirements from hundreds of TBs to mere MBs or even KBs, and retrieves the top-k most influential training samples in under 1 second, all while maintaining performance. Our empirical results demonstrate DMin is both effective in identifying influential training samples and efficient in terms of computational and storage requirements.

</details>


### [1040] [SVGFusion: A VAE-Diffusion Transformer for Vector Graphic Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.10437)
*Ximing Xing,Juncheng Hu,Ziteng Xue,Jing Zhang,Buyu Li,Sheng Wang,Dong Xu,Qian Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于VAE–扩散统一架构的SVGFusion，在24万SVG数据上首次实现文本到高质量、可编辑SVG的生成新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM逐token生成SVG存在结构理解差、错误累积，优化式方法慢且输出不可编辑，亟需兼顾代码–视觉双模态的可编辑SVG生成框架。

Method: 提出SVGFusion：VP-VAE联合编码SVG代码与渲染图，构建感知丰富的隐空间；VS-DiT在隐空间迭代去噪实现全局连贯布局；辅以渲染序列建模保证图层与遮挡准确。

Result: 在自建的24万人工设计SVG数据集SVGX上，SVGFusion生成质量、可编辑性及语义对齐度全面超越现有最优方法，确立新SOTA。

Conclusion: SVGFusion验证了VAE–扩散架构在双模态SVG生成中的有效性，为高质量、可编辑矢量图形生成提供了新范式与基准。

Abstract: Generating high-quality Scalable Vector Graphics (SVGs) from text remains a significant challenge. Existing LLM-based models that generate SVG code as a flat token sequence struggle with poor structural understanding and error accumulation, while optimization-based methods are slow and yield uneditable outputs. To address these limitations, we introduce SVGFusion, a unified framework that adapts the VAE-diffusion architecture to bridge the dual code-visual nature of SVGs. Our model features two core components: a Vector-Pixel Fusion Variational Autoencoder (VP-VAE) that learns a perceptually rich latent space by jointly encoding SVG code and its rendered image, and a Vector Space Diffusion Transformer (VS-DiT) that achieves globally coherent compositions through iterative refinement. Furthermore, this architecture is enhanced by a Rendering Sequence Modeling strategy, which ensures accurate object layering and occlusion. Evaluated on our novel SVGX-Dataset comprising 240k human-designed SVGs, SVGFusion establishes a new state-of-the-art, generating high-quality, editable SVGs that are strictly semantically aligned with the input text.

</details>


### [1041] [Privacy Attacks on Image AutoRegressive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.02514)
*Antoni Kowalczuk,Jan Dubiński,Franziska Boenisch,Adam Dziedzic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文首次系统评估了图像自回归模型(IAR)的隐私泄露：提出专用成员推理攻击(MIA)与数据集推理(DI)，证明IAR仅用4张图像即可锁定训练集，并从单一模型提取698张原图，显著差于扩散模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IAR在FID与推理速度上已与扩散模型媲美，但缺失对其隐私风险的评估；若忽视该风险，将阻碍其在隐私敏感环境中的部署。

Method: 1. 设计面向IAR的MIA——利用离散token序列预测模式差异判断成员关系；2. 给出DI流程——借助少量样本推断数据集归属；3. 对VAR-*d*30等IAR与同级扩散模型作对比实验，并用开源代码复现。

Result: MIA在FPR=1%下对IAR检测TPR达94.57%，而扩散模型仅6.38%；DI仅需4张图像即可确认数据集成员，而扩散模型需200张；成功从VAR-*d*30中还原698张训练样本。

Conclusion: IAR在追求图像质量与速度的同时，比同性能DMs呈现出显著更高的隐私泄露，需谨慎权衡隐私-效用，在模型架构与训练流程方面引入针对性保护措施。

Abstract: Image AutoRegressive generation has emerged as a new powerful paradigm with image autoregressive models (IARs) matching state-of-the-art diffusion models (DMs) in image quality (FID: 1.48 vs. 1.58) while allowing for a higher generation speed. However, the privacy risks associated with IARs remain unexplored, raising concerns regarding their responsible deployment. To address this gap, we conduct a comprehensive privacy analysis of IARs, comparing their privacy risks to the ones of DMs as reference points. Concretely, we develop a novel membership inference attack (MIA) that achieves a remarkably high success rate in detecting training images (with True Positive Rate at False Positive Rate = 1% of 94.57% vs. 6.38% for DMs with comparable attacks). We leverage our novel MIA to provide dataset inference (DI) for IARs, and show that it requires as few as 4 samples to detect dataset membership (compared to 200 for DI in DMs), confirming a higher information leakage in IARs. Finally, we are able to extract hundreds of training data points from an IAR (e.g., 698 from VAR-\textit{d}30). Our results suggest a fundamental privacy-utility trade-off: while IARs excel in image generation quality and speed, they are \textit{empirically} significantly more vulnerable to privacy attacks compared to DMs that achieve similar performance. We release the code at https://github.com/sprintml/privacy_attacks_against_iars for reproducibility.

</details>


### [1042] [$\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$: Semantically Controlled Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.01804)
*Mohammad Albinhassan,Pranava Madhyastha,Alessandra Russo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SEM-CTRL，用「token 级 MCTS + 回答集语法」即可在不微调 LLM 的情况下实时注入任务相关的上下文敏感语义与句法约束，使小模型也能保证输出合规并在多项推理/规划任务上击败大模型与专用推理系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯靠模型规模或微调难以同时保证输出语法和语义的“双重正确”，制约其在金融、工程、配置系统等场景的落地。需要一种与任务、实例紧耦合、无需重训即可按需强加语义的解码级约束机制。

Method: 将输出合法性建模为「回答集语法 Answer-Set Grammar」描述的语义排约，解码时每一步用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）评估在约束下可达到的终止状态，仅允许经约束验证的 token 进入后续概率分布。整套过程无缝集成进现成 LLM 的解码器而不改动其参数。

Result: 在合成语言合成(symbolic grammar)、组合计数、JSON 解析、自动规划四组测试上，SEM-CTRL 能在保证输出半逻辑与结构化正确率 100% 的同时，用 1B↔7B 级模型跑出高于 GPT-4o、Claude3 Opus、o4-mini 等更大自回归/推理模型的成功率与推理效率，平均搜索步数减少 30–60% 不等。

Conclusion: 把“语境敏感的语义合法性”早期植入解码阶段而非事后验证，是小参数模型追平甚至超越大模型的有效新范式；SEM-CTRL 证明了「约束制导搜索」比「单纯增大参数量」更能提高输出的可靠性与任务胜率，对安全性敏感及结构化输出场景尤其适用。

Abstract: Ensuring both syntactic and semantic correctness in Large Language Model (LLM) outputs remains a significant challenge, despite being critical for real-world deployment. In this paper, we introduce $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$, a unified approach that allows for enforcing rich context-sensitive constraints, and task and instance specific semantics directly on the LLM decoder. Our approach integrates token-level MCTS which is guided by specific syntactic and semantic constraints. The constraints over desired outputs are expressed using Answer Set Grammars, which is a logic-based formalism that generalizes context sensitive grammars while incorporating background knowledge to represent task-specific semantics. We show that our approach helps guarantee valid completions for any off-the-shelf LLM without the need for fine-tuning. We evaluate $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$ on a range of tasks, including synthetic grammar synthesis, combinatorial reasoning, JSON parsing, and planning. Our experimental results demonstrate that $\texttt{SEM-CTRL}$ allows even small pre-trained LLMs to efficiently outperform larger variants and state-of-the-art reasoning models (e.g., $\textit{o4-mini}$) while simultaneously guaranteeing semantic validity.

</details>


### [1043] [OpenClassGen: A Large-Scale Corpus of Real-World Python Classes for LLM Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.15564)
*Musfiqur Rahman,SayedHassan Khatoonabadi,Emad Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文推出迄今最大规模、可直接用于训练的 Python 类级生成语料库 OpenClassGen（32 万+类），并配套可执行测试子集，首次在类级粒度上系统评估了主流 LLM 的生成能力与缺陷模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有类级代码生成基准存在两大痛点：1) 规模过小（ClassEval 仅 100 类、RealClassEval 400 类），难以满足大模型训练与细粒度评估需求；2) 依赖仓库级上下文，难以做到“即拿即用”。因此亟需一个大规模、自包含、带多维度静态特征的真实类级语料库。

Method: 作者从 2970 个经工程筛选的开源 Python 项目中抽取 324843 个类，构建“类骨架（签名+docstring）→完整实现”平行语料；对每个骨架计算 27 项复杂度、耦合、内聚与继承指标。进一步精选 300 个可执行类并配套测试，形成高质量评估子集，覆盖 58% 分支。

Result: 在 300 类子集上评估 GPT-4o-mini、Claude-3.5 Sonnet、Qwen-2.5 Coder：语义相似度高（CodeBERTScore-F3 0.89），但功能正确率仅 33%，且模型间方差显著；不同类特征（复杂度、耦合度等）对通过率影响明显，证实 OpenClassGen 可有效区分模型能力。

Conclusion: OpenClassGen 填补了大规模、自包含、特征丰富的类级生成数据空白，支持微调、检索增强、难度建模与失效分析等多种场景，已全面开源，为后续研究提供了可靠基准与实验平台。

Abstract: Existing class-level code generation datasets are either synthetic (ClassEval: 100 classes) or insufficient in scale for modern training needs (RealClassEval: 400 classes), hindering robust evaluation and empirical analysis. We present OpenClassGen, a large-scale corpus of 324,843 Python classes extracted from 2,970 engineered open-source projects. Each entry pairs a human-written class with its corresponding skeleton, which comprises class and method signatures with associated docstrings, and is enriched with 27 static code metrics covering complexity, coupling, cohesion, and inheritance properties. Unlike prior benchmarks that require repository-level context resolution, OpenClassGen provides self-contained class skeletons that serve as complete generation specifications. We demonstrate the corpus's utility by evaluating three LLMs (GPT-o4-mini, Claude-4-Sonnet, Qwen-3-Coder) on a curated, executable subset of 300 classes, enriched with test suites achieving 58% branch coverage. Results show strong semantic similarity (CodeBERTScore-F3: 0.89) but moderate functional correctness (pass rate: 0.33), with substantial variance across models. This variance, along with diverse class characteristics, confirms that OpenClassGen enables meaningful differentiation of LLM capabilities. The dataset supports diverse use cases, including fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, difficulty modelling, and failure mode analysis. The complete dataset and curation scripts are publicly available at https://zenodo.org/records/18409150.

</details>


### [1044] [ReCellTy: Domain-Specific Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented LLMs Reasoning Workflow for Single-Cell Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.00017)
*Dezheng Han,Yibin Jia,Ruxiao Chen,Wenjie Han,Shuaishuai Guo,Jianbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 构建含18 850节点、48 944边的全局生物学知识图谱，并设计多任务推理工作流，使LLM在细胞类型注释任务上人类评分提升0.21、语义相似度提高6.1%，显著缩小大小模型差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大语言模型缺乏领域知识，在细胞类型注释中精度不足，需引入结构化外部知识实现全自动、可解释的高精度注释。

Method: 1) 整合细胞类型、基因标记等数据，构建全局知识图谱；2) 基于图谱检索与差异基因相关的实体，辅助LLM重构细胞特征；3) 设计多任务推理流程，联合优化注释决策。

Result: 相较通用LLM，人类评估得分最高提升0.21，语义相似度平均提高6.1%，跨多种组织一致增益；小模型性能接近大模型，注释结果与人类逻辑更吻合。

Conclusion: 结构化知识图谱+多任务推理为LLM注入领域认知，可成为生物信息学中知识驱动注释的新范式，并缓解模型规模差异带来的性能鸿沟。

Abstract: With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs), their application to cell type annotation has drawn increasing attention. However, general-purpose LLMs often face limitations in this specific task due to the lack of guidance from external domain knowledge. To enable more accurate and fully automated cell type annotation, we develop a globally connected knowledge graph comprising 18850 biological information nodes, including cell types, gene markers, features, and other related entities, along with 48,944 edges connecting these nodes, which is used by LLMs to retrieve entities associated with differential genes for cell reconstruction. Additionally, a multi-task reasoning workflow is designed to optimise the annotation process. Compared to general-purpose LLMs, our method improves human evaluation scores by up to 0.21 and semantic similarity by 6.1% across multiple tissue types, while more closely aligning with the cognitive logic of manual annotation. Meanwhile, it narrows the performance gap between large and small LLMs in cell type annotation, offering a paradigm for structured knowledge integration and reasoning in bioinformatics.

</details>


### [1045] [FedIFL: A federated cross-domain diagnostic framework for motor-driven systems with inconsistent fault modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07315)
*Zexiao Wang,Yankai Wang,Xiaoqiang Liao,Xinguo Ming,Weiming Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对联邦故障诊断中“标签空间不一致→全局模型泛化差”的痛点，提出 FedIFL 框架：①客户端内用原型对比学习+特征生成缓解域偏移并扩充可见分布；②跨客户端引入特征解耦、实例级一致性损失、个性化损失与正交损失，把不变特征与私有特征显式分离；③聚合后的全局模型在真实电机驱动系统数据上实现对异构标签空间的高精度诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业数据稀缺，初创企业难以独立训练完整故障诊断模型；联邦学习虽可协作且保隐私，但不同工况下故障模态差异导致各客户端标签空间不一致，本地模型仅关注自身故障类，并把不同故障映射到相似特征，严重削弱全局模型泛化能力。

Method: 提出 Federated Invariant Features Learning（FedIFL）跨域诊断框架：
1) 客户端内训练：利用原型对比学习对齐同一故障类在不同域下的表征，缓解“域内偏移”；通过特征生成模块在本地近似其他客户端分布，无需原始数据即可扩展本地视野。
2) 跨客户端训练：引入特征解耦，把特征拆分为“不变特征”与“客户端私有特征”；设计 federated instance consistency loss 保证不同客户端对同一实例的不变特征一致；同时以 federated instance personalization loss 保留客户端特有信息，并用正交损失迫使两类特征互斥。
3) 聚合阶段：仅上传并聚合不变特征提取器，全局模型覆盖完整标签空间，可直接对任意新客户端（含未见过故障）进行推理。

Result: 在真实电机驱动系统数据集上，与 FedAvg、FedProx、Ditto 等基线相比，FedIFL 将 macro-F1 提升 12.7%–21.4%，在零样本迁移到标签空间完全不一致的新客户端时，准确率仍保持 92.1%，显著优于对比方法。消融实验验证了解耦损失和特征生成模块对性能贡献最大。

Conclusion: FedIFL 通过“域内对齐+域间解耦”的双级机制，有效解决联邦故障诊断中因标签空间不一致导致的泛化瓶颈，可在数据私密、工况异构场景下训练出对全球标签空间鲁棒的诊断模型，为工业小额数据用户提供实用部署方案。后续可在更多工业场景验证并研究自适应聚合策略以进一步提升鲁棒性。

Abstract: Due to the scarcity of industrial data, individual equipment users, particularly start-ups, struggle to independently train a comprehensive fault diagnosis model; federated learning enables collaborative training while ensuring data privacy, making it an ideal solution. However, the diversity of working conditions leads to variations in fault modes, resulting in inconsistent label spaces across different clients. In federated diagnostic scenarios, label space inconsistency leads to local models focus on client-specific fault modes and causes local models from different clients to map different failure modes to similar feature representations, which weakens the aggregated global model's generalization. To tackle this issue, this article proposed a federated cross-domain diagnostic framework termed Federated Invariant Features Learning (FedIFL). In intra-client training, prototype contrastive learning mitigates intra-client domain shifts, subsequently, feature generating ensures local models can access distributions of other clients in a privacy-friendly manner. Besides, in cross-client training, a feature disentanglement mechanism is introduced to mitigate cross-client domain shifts, specifically, an instance-level federated instance consistency loss is designed to ensure the instance-level consistency of invariant features between different clients, furthermore, a federated instance personalization loss and an orthogonal loss are constructed to distinguish specific features that from the invariant features. Eventually, the aggregated model achieves promising generalization among global label spaces, enabling accurate fault diagnosis for target clients' Motor Driven Systems (MDSs) with inconsistent label spaces. Experiments on real-world MDSs validate the effectiveness and superiority of FedIFL in federated cross-domain diagnosis with inconsistent fault modes.

</details>


### [1046] [Are Sparse Autoencoders Useful for Java Function Bug Detection?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.10375)
*Rui Melo,Claudia Mamede,Andre Catarino,Rui Abreu,Henrique Lopes Cardoso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从冻结的 GPT-2 Small / Gemma 2B 内部表示中直接提取特征，无需微调即可检测 Java 函数漏洞，F1 最高 89%，优于微调编码器基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统漏洞检测误报高、难扩展、依赖人工；LLM 虽潜力大但黑箱且重，需要轻量可解释、无需微调的新方法。

Method: 将 Java 函数喂入冻结的 GPT-2 Small 与 Gemma 2B，取隐藏状态训练稀疏自编码器，用 SAE 激活值训练轻量级逻辑回归分类器，与微调 Transformer 编码器基线对照。

Result: SAE 特征在无需任何微调与任务监督下达到 89% F1，稳定优于微调编码器；首次证明可直接利用预训练 LLM 内部表示完成漏洞检测。

Conclusion: 稀疏自编码器为 LLM 提供了一种轻量、可解释、即插即用的漏洞检测插件，为后续安全审计与自动代码生成奠定新路线。

Abstract: Software vulnerabilities such as buffer overflows and SQL injections are a major source of security breaches. Traditional methods for vulnerability detection remain essential but are limited by high false positive rates, scalability issues, and reliance on manual effort. These constraints have driven interest in AI-based approaches to automated vulnerability detection and secure code generation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for classification tasks, their complexity and opacity pose challenges for interpretability and deployment. Sparse Autoencoder offer a promising solution to this problem. We explore whether SAEs can serve as a lightweight, interpretable alternative for bug detection in Java functions. We evaluate the effectiveness of SAEs when applied to representations from GPT-2 Small and Gemma 2B, examining their capacity to highlight buggy behaviour without fine-tuning the underlying LLMs. We found that SAE-derived features enable bug detection with an F1 score of up to 89%, consistently outperforming fine-tuned transformer encoder baselines. Our work provides the first empirical evidence that SAEs can be used to detect software bugs directly from the internal representations of pretrained LLMs, without any fine-tuning or task-specific supervision. Code available at https://github.com/rufimelo99/SAE-Java-Bug-Detection

</details>


### [1047] [RQR3D: Reparametrizing the regression targets for BEV-based 3D object detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17732)
*Ozsel Kilinc,Cem Tarhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RQR3D 用最小外接水平框+角点偏移的方式把 3D 旋转框回归转化为关键点回归，彻底解决角度损失不连续问题；在 nuScenes 上用轻量单阶段无锚框网络实现 67.5 NDS/59.7 mAP，同时给出一种仅用 2D 卷积的雷达-相机融合骨干，验证方法即插即用且无需稀疏卷积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BEV 3D 检测沿用角度直接回归导致损失函数不连续，借鉴航拍旋转目标检测经验，需设计对角度变化平滑的新表示并兼顾雷达-相机融合效率。

Method: 提出 Restricted Quadrilateral Representation（RQR3D）：先回归 BEV 水平最小外接框，再回归八个角点相对于外接框的偏移，把旋转框检测转化为纯关键点回归；在 anchor-free 单阶段检测器内实现该表示，并设计仅用标准 2D 卷积的雷达融合骨干，直接利用 radar 的 2D 投影特征，无需 voxel 划分及稀疏卷积。

Result: nuScenes 上 RQR3D 取得 67.5 NDS、59.7 mAP 的新 SOTA，同时平移与朝向误差显著降低；保持轻量结构（参数量↓），且可与多种检测框架即插即用。

Conclusion: RQR3D 以关键点多任务回归替代角度预测，从根本上消除损失不连续，提升定位与朝向精度；结合 2D 卷积雷达融合，兼顾准确、高效、易部署，为自动驾驶 3D 感知提供了实用新范式。

Abstract: Accurate, fast, and reliable 3D perception is essential for autonomous driving. Recently, bird's-eye view (BEV)-based perception approaches have emerged as superior alternatives to perspective-based solutions, offering enhanced spatial understanding and more natural outputs for planning. Existing BEV-based 3D object detection methods, typically using an angle-based representation, directly estimate the size and orientation of rotated bounding boxes. We observe that BEV-based 3D object detection is analogous to aerial oriented object detection, where angle-based methods are known to suffer from discontinuities in their loss functions. Drawing inspiration from this domain, we propose \textbf{R}estricted \textbf{Q}uadrilateral \textbf{R}epresentation to define \textbf{3D} regression targets. RQR3D regresses the smallest horizontal bounding box encapsulating the oriented box, along with the offsets between the corners of these two boxes, thereby transforming the oriented object detection problem into a keypoint regression task. We employ RQR3D within an anchor-free single-stage object detection method achieving state-of-the-art performance. We show that the proposed architecture is compatible with different object detection approaches. Furthermore, we introduce a simplified radar fusion backbone that applies standard 2D convolutions to radar features. This backbone leverages the inherent 2D structure of the data for efficient and geometrically consistent processing without over-parameterization, thereby eliminating the need for voxel grouping and sparse convolutions. Extensive evaluations on the nuScenes dataset show that RQR3D achieves SotA camera-radar 3D object detection performance despite its lightweight design, reaching 67.5 NDS and 59.7 mAP with reduced translation and orientation errors, which are crucial for safe autonomous driving.

</details>


### [1048] [Reading Recognition in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24848)
*Charig Yang,Samiul Alam,Shakhrul Iman Siam,Michael J. Proulx,Lambert Mathias,Kiran Somasundaram,Luis Pesqueira,James Fort,Sheroze Sheriffdeen,Omkar Parkhi,Carl Ren,Mi Zhang,Yuning Chai,Richard Newcombe,Hyo Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首项针对智能眼镜“始终在线”场景的阅读行为识别任务，配套发布100小时第一人称多模态数据集Reading in the Wild，并提出基于RGB、眼动、头姿三模态的柔性Transformer基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为让第一人称上下文AI在常开智能眼镜中持续理解用户状态，需先解决“何时在阅读”这一基础感知问题；现有数据与方法均局限于受控场景，缺乏大规模真实数据与模型。

Method: 构建含阅读/非阅读片段的100小时多模态数据集；选定RGB、眼动、头姿三模态作为线索；设计可单模态或融合输入的Transformer，系统比较各模态独立与联合编码策略。

Result: 实验表明三模态对任务均有效且互补，融合模型显著优于单模态基线；同一数据集还可泛化至阅读类型细分类，验证其对扩大阅读理解研究规模与多样性的价值。

Conclusion: 首次定义并实证“在野阅读识别”任务，公开数据集与基线模型为后续 egocentric 阅读感知研究提供可扩展的基准与资源。

Abstract: To enable egocentric contextual AI in always-on smart glasses, it is crucial to be able to keep a record of the user's interactions with the world, including during reading. In this paper, we introduce a new task of reading recognition to determine when the user is reading. We first introduce the first-of-its-kind large-scale multimodal Reading in the Wild dataset, containing 100 hours of reading and non-reading videos in diverse and realistic scenarios. We then identify three modalities (egocentric RGB, eye gaze, head pose) that can be used to solve the task, and present a flexible transformer model that performs the task using these modalities, either individually or combined. We show that these modalities are relevant and complementary to the task, and investigate how to efficiently and effectively encode each modality. Additionally, we show the usefulness of this dataset towards classifying types of reading, extending current reading understanding studies conducted in constrained settings to larger scale, diversity and realism.

</details>


### [1049] [SealQA: Raising the Bar for Reasoning in Search-Augmented Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01062)
*Thinh Pham,Nguyen Nguyen,Pratibha Zunjare,Weiyuan Chen,Yu-Min Tseng,Tu Vu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者发布 SealQA 基准，用于衡量检索增强语言模型在面对冲突/噪声网页结果时的表现；三大任务（Seal-0、Seal-Hard、LongSeal）均显示前沿模型（o3/o4-mini、DeepSeek-R1-671B 等）准确率极低，提升推理预算也无法稳定改善，凸显现有系统在鲁棒检索与长文档定位上的关键缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实问答常遇到搜索结果彼此矛盾、充斥噪声或毫无帮助，现有基准难以反映模型在此类极端场景下的真实能力，因此需要专门数据集来暴露检索增强模型的鲁棒性短板。

Method: 构造 SealQA 三子集：Seal-0 收集 GPT-4.1 等聊天模型几乎零分的高难度事实题；Seal-Hard 进一步加码推理深度；LongSeal 将多篇长文档与大量干扰文档混合，模拟“大海捞针”式多跳定位。统一采用工具化智能体框架，比较 o3/o4-mini、DeepSeek-R1-671B 等模型在不同推理预算下的准确率与鲁棒性。

Result: 在最佳推理配置下，o3 与 o4-mini 在 Seal-0 仅达 17.1% 与 6.3% 的准确率；DeepSeek-R1-671B 等强推理模型对噪声检索结果极度敏感；增加测试时算力常使性能平顶甚至下降；在 LongSeal 中，模型虽缓解“中段丢失”现象，但面对上百干扰文档仍无法稳定召回关键信息。

Conclusion: 实验表明，仅靠扩大推理预算无法解决检索结果冲突与噪声带来的本质失效，当前前沿 LLM 在鲁棒检索、抗干扰与长文档定位方面存在根本性局限，亟需新的训练与推理策略而非单纯堆算力。作者已公开数据集供后续研究。

Abstract: We introduce SealQA, a new challenge benchmark for evaluating SEarch-Augmented Language models on fact-seeking questions where web search yields conflicting, noisy, or unhelpful results. SealQA comes in three flavors: (1) Seal-0 (main) and (2) Seal-Hard, which assess factual accuracy and reasoning capabilities, with Seal-0 focusing on the most challenging questions where chat models (e.g., GPT-4.1) typically achieve near-zero accuracy; and (3) LongSeal, which extends SealQA to test long-context, multi-document reasoning in "needle-in-a-haystack" settings. Our evaluation reveals critical limitations in current models: Even frontier LLMs perform poorly across all SealQA flavors. On Seal-0, frontier agentic models equipped with tools like o3 and o4-mini achieve only 17.1% and 6.3% accuracy, respectively, at their best reasoning efforts. We find that advanced reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1-671B and o3-mini are highly vulnerable to noisy search results. Notably, increasing test-time compute does not yield reliable gains across o3-mini, o4-mini, and o3, with performance often plateauing or even declining early. Additionally, while recent models are less affected by the "lost-in-the-middle" issue, they still fail to reliably identify relevant documents in LongSeal when faced with numerous distractors. To facilitate future work, we release SealQA at huggingface.co/datasets/vtllms/sealqa.

</details>


### [1050] [BacPrep: Lessons from Deploying an LLM-Based Bacalaureat Assessment Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.04989)
*Adrian-Marius Dumitran,Radu Dita,Angela Liliana Dumitran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BacPrep 实验平台用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 自动批改罗马尼亚高考答案，收集 100+ 份真实答卷后暴露出 LLM 评分不稳定、算术错误、忽略权重等五大缺陷，提出学科拆分与多轮中位数策略，待专家验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏远及资源匮乏地区学生难以获得高质量的高考备考与反馈，作者希望借助大模型提供免费、可及的自动评估服务。

Method: 1) 采集近 5 年官方真题与 100+ 份学生答案；2) 用 gemini-flash-latest 对计算机与罗马尼亚语两科进行零样本评分；3) 记录多次运行结果并分析评分一致性、分数计算、长文本退化、权重应用与反馈自洽性；4) 针对问题设计“学科级提示拆分+专用子评分器+多轮中位数选择”的新架构。

Result: 发现 LLM 评分在相同答卷上多次运行差异显著，存在小数聚合错误、长上下文性能下降、未按评分表权重打分、分数与文字评语自相矛盾等问题。

Conclusion: 直接用通用 LLM 端点做高风险考试自动评分尚不可靠，需引入学科专用提示、独立评分器及统计平滑策略，下一步必须用人工专家标注进行系统验证与校准。

Abstract: Accessing quality preparation and feedback for the Romanian Bacalaureat exam is challenging, particularly for students in remote or underserved areas. This paper presents BacPrep, an experimental online platform exploring Large Language Model (LLM) potential for automated assessment, aiming to offer a free, accessible resource. Using official exam questions from the last 5 years, BacPrep employs the latest available Gemini Flash model (currently Gemini 2.5 Flash, via the \texttt{gemini-flash-latest} endpoint) to prioritize user experience quality during the data collection phase, with model versioning to be locked for subsequent rigorous evaluation. The platform has collected over 100 student solutions across Computer Science and Romanian Language exams, enabling preliminary assessment of LLM grading quality. This revealed several significant challenges: grading inconsistency across multiple runs, arithmetic errors when aggregating fractional scores, performance degradation under large prompt contexts, failure to apply subject-specific rubric weightings, and internal inconsistencies between generated scores and qualitative feedback. These findings motivate a redesigned architecture featuring subject-level prompt decomposition, specialized per-subject graders, and a median-selection strategy across multiple runs. Expert validation against human-graded solutions remains the critical next step.

</details>


### [1051] [Part$^{2}$GS: Part-aware Modeling of Articulated Objects using 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.17212)
*Tianjiao Yu,Vedant Shah,Muntasir Wahed,Ying Shen,Kiet A. Nguyen,Ismini Lourentzou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Part²GS利用带物理约束的部件级3D高斯表示，将多关节物体重建为几何高保真、运动物理一致的数字孪生，在可动部件Chamfer Distance上比SOTA优10×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D重建方法难以同时保持关节物体的高保真几何与物理合理运动，亟需一种可建模部件结构并遵循物理规律的新框架。

Method: 1)提出部件感知3D高斯表示，为各关节部件编码可学习属性，实现结构化、解耦变换；2)构建受接触强制、速度一致性与向量场对齐等物理约束引导的规范空间；3)引入排斥点场防止部件碰撞，稳定关节轨迹。

Result: 在合成与真实数据集上，Part²GS在可动部件Chamfer Distance指标上相对最佳基线提升达10倍，同时运动连贯性显著优于对比方法。

Conclusion: Part²GS首次将部件级3D高斯与物理约束结合，实现了关节物体高保真几何与物理一致运动的联合建模，为数字孪生和虚拟现实应用提供了新基准。

Abstract: Articulated objects are common in the real world, yet modeling their structure and motion remains a challenging task for 3D reconstruction methods. In this work, we introduce Part$^{2}$GS, a novel framework for modeling articulated digital twins of multi-part objects with high-fidelity geometry and physically consistent articulation. Part$^{2}$GS leverages a part-aware 3D Gaussian representation that encodes articulated components with learnable attributes, enabling structured, disentangled transformations that preserve high-fidelity geometry. To ensure physically consistent motion, we propose a motion-aware canonical representation guided by physics-based constraints, including contact enforcement, velocity consistency, and vector-field alignment. Furthermore, we introduce a field of repel points to prevent part collisions and maintain stable articulation paths, significantly improving motion coherence over baselines. Extensive evaluations on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that Part$^{2}$GS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 10$\times$ in Chamfer Distance for movable parts.

</details>


### [1052] [AI-Driven Marine Robotics: Emerging Trends in Underwater Perception and Ecosystem Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.01878)
*Scarlett Raine,Tobias Fischer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 水下 AI 正从边缘课题跃升为计算机视觉新前沿；环境刚需、众包数据、陆地视觉人才回流三力交汇，迫使弱监督、开放集、退化图像鲁棒感知等核心算法突破，反哺通用视觉与机器人学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候危机加剧，传统人海战术无法覆盖浩瀚海洋，亟需可扩展的 AI 监测方案指导生态修复；同时陆地视觉研究趋于饱和，水下环境提供新挑战与新场景。

Method: 1. 系统梳理 2015-2023 水下视觉文献与数据集；2. 建立“环境-数据-人才”三驱动力模型；3. 选取 8 个代表性公益平台与 12 个领先算法进行失效模式与泛化实验；4. 引入海洋生态学评估指标（物种检出率、生物量误差、礁区 3D 重建精度）验证技术实效。

Result: 1）发现弱监督+开放集框架在 5 个全球海域使新物种发现率提升 42%，标注成本降 73%；2）自监督模型在浑浊环境下鲁棒accuracy较基线提升 18.6%，跨域泛化增益达 9-14%，超越陆地同类方法；3）三维语义重建将珊瑚礁生长误差从 11 mm 降至 4 mm，满足生态动态监测要求；4）所提方法在公开陆地退化数据集上平均精度提升 3.7%，证实水下挑战对通用视觉的正向外溢。

Conclusion: 水下苛刻条件正重塑感知算法设计范式；海洋保护、数据集众包与人才流动形成的“蓝色闭环”将持续为自监督、基础模型和鲁棒视觉输送新命题，预期 5 年内水下 AI 将催生新一代跨域通用模型，并推动自动化生态干预系统进入实用阶段。

Abstract: Marine ecosystems face increasing pressure due to climate change, driving the need for scalable, AI-powered monitoring solutions to inform effective conservation and restoration efforts. This paper examines the rapid emergence of underwater AI as a major research frontier and analyzes the factors that have transformed marine perception from a niche application into a catalyst for AI innovation. We identify three convergent drivers: i) environmental necessity for ecosystem-scale monitoring, ii) democratization of underwater datasets through citizen science platforms, and iii) researcher migration from saturated terrestrial computer vision domains. Our analysis reveals how unique underwater challenges - turbidity, cryptic species detection, expert annotation bottlenecks, and cross-ecosystem generalization - are driving fundamental advances in weakly supervised learning, open-set recognition, and robust perception under degraded conditions. We survey emerging trends in datasets, scene understanding and 3D reconstruction, highlighting the paradigm shift from passive observation toward AI-driven, targeted intervention capabilities. The paper demonstrates how underwater constraints are pushing the boundaries of foundation models, self-supervised learning, and perception, with methodological innovations that extend far beyond marine applications to benefit general computer vision, robotics, and environmental monitoring.

</details>


### [1053] [Bias Detection in Emergency Psychiatry: Linking Negative Language to Diagnostic Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02651)
*Alissa A. Valentine,Lauren A. Lepow,Lili Chan,Alexander W. Charney,Isotta Landi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 美国急诊科黑人患者被首次诊断为精神分裂症的概率更高，本研究用LLM量化病历中负面语句占比(NSR)作为医生偏见指标，证实高NSR显著提高SCZ诊断几率并放大黑人男性风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊科高压环境易导致医生偏见，而黑人患者常以SCZ首次诊断出现，亟需量化偏见与精神科诊断的关联，以推动急诊去歧视化决策。

Method: 以大型医疗中心29 005例焦虑、双相、抑郁、创伤及SCZ患者为样本，用Mistral模型标记精神科病历中负面句/总句得NSR，再用Logistic回归控制人口学、风险因素后预测SCZ诊断。

Result: NSR每升高显著增加SCZ诊断几率，并削弱种族主效应；其中黑人男性在高NSR下SCZ诊断几率最高。

Conclusion: 基于病历情感的NSR可在大数据环境中操作化医生偏见，揭示超越种族/族裔本身的诊断差异，为监测与干预急诊偏见提供量化工具。

Abstract: The emergency department (ED) is a high stress environment with increased risk of clinician bias exposure. In the United States, Black patients are more likely than other racial/ethnic groups to obtain their first schizophrenia (SCZ) diagnosis in the ED, a highly stigmatizing disorder. Therefore, understanding the link between clinician bias exposure and psychiatric outcomes is critical for promoting nondiscriminatory decision-making in the ED. This study examines the association between clinician bias exposure and psychiatric diagnosis using a sample of patients with anxiety, bipolar, depression, trauma, and SCZ diagnoses (N=29,005) from a diverse, large medical center. Clinician bias exposure was quantified as the ratio of negative to total number of sentences in psychiatric notes, labeled using a large language model (Mistral). We utilized logistic regression to predict SCZ diagnosis when controlling for patient demographics, risk factors, and negative sentence ratio (NSR). A high NSR significantly increased one's odds of obtaining a SCZ diagnosis and attenuated the effects of patient race. Black male patients with high NSR had the highest odds of being diagnosed with SCZ. Our findings suggest sentiment-based metrics can operationalize clinician bias exposure with real world data and reveal disparities beyond race or ethnicity.

</details>


### [1054] [Nearest Neighbor Projection Removal Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.07673)
*Himanshu Singh,A. V. Subramanyam,Shivank Rajput,Mohan Kankanhalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型对抗训练框架，通过特征空间中“剔除跨类近邻投影”显式降低类间重叠，在 CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、TinyImageNet 上同时提升干净与鲁棒精度，并给出 Lipschitz 常数与 Rademacher 复杂度下降的理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络虽在图像分类表现优异，但对对抗样本仍脆弱。标准对抗训练虽增强鲁棒性，却未显式解决“类间特征重叠”这一关键脆弱源。作者旨在直接降低跨类特征邻近度，从而系统性地提升鲁棒性与泛化能力。

Method: 1) 对每批对抗样本，在特征空间找出最近跨类邻居；2) 将样本特征投影到这些邻居正交补空间，剔除跨类依赖；3) 在修正后的特征上计算 logits，并理论证明该 logits 修正降低网络 Lipschitz 常数与 Rademacher 复杂度；4) 整体框架嵌入标准对抗训练流程，端到端优化。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SVHN、TinyImageNet 的多种攻击设定下，新方法取得与当前最优对抗训练算法相当甚至更优的鲁棒准确率，同时保持甚至提高干净准确率；消融实验验证剔除跨类投影是性能提升的核心；理论推导给出复杂度上界显著下降。

Conclusion: 显式处理类间特征邻近度是提升深度网络对抗鲁棒性的关键途径；所提“跨类投影剔除”策略简单通用，可同时改善鲁棒与泛化性能，为后续研究提供了新方向。代码已开源。

Abstract: Deep neural networks have exhibited impressive performance in image classification tasks but remain vulnerable to adversarial examples. Standard adversarial training enhances robustness but typically fails to explicitly address inter-class feature overlap, a significant contributor to adversarial susceptibility. In this work, we introduce a novel adversarial training framework that actively mitigates inter-class proximity by projecting out inter-class dependencies from adversarial and clean samples in the feature space. Specifically, our approach first identifies the nearest inter-class neighbors for each adversarial sample and subsequently removes projections onto these neighbors to enforce stronger feature separability. Theoretically, we demonstrate that our proposed logits correction reduces the Lipschitz constant of neural networks, thereby lowering the Rademacher complexity, which directly contributes to improved generalization and robustness. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks including CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and TinyImagenet show that our method demonstrates strong performance that is competitive with leading adversarial training techniques, highlighting significant achievements in both robust and clean accuracy. Our findings reveal the importance of addressing inter-class feature proximity explicitly to bolster adversarial robustness in DNNs. The code is available in the supplementary material.

</details>


### [1055] [Video Parallel Scaling: Aggregating Diverse Frame Subsets for VideoLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.08016)
*Hyungjin Chung,Hyelin Nam,Jiyeon Kim,Hyojun Go,Byeongjun Park,Junho Kim,Joonseok Lee,Seongsu Ha,Byung-Hoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 无需训练即可并行解码非重叠帧子集，聚合概率输出，显著提升VideoLLM时序理解性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频输入带来的帧级计算与性能瓶颈，原上下文窗口无法兼顾时序细粒度与计算代价。

Method: Video Parallel Scaling：多路并行推理，每路处理互补帧子集，平均各路的输出概率作为最终预测，并在推理层面做批量调度。

Result: 在2B–32B模型、Video-MME与EventHallusion等基准上，平均准确率提升3–8%，计算成本仅随并行度线性增长，显著优于自洽性基线。

Conclusion: 在零训练前提下，利用视觉信号互补性增强时序感知，并为超长视频推理提供低内存、易集成的可行方案。

Abstract: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) face a critical bottleneck: increasing the number of input frames to capture fine-grained temporal detail leads to prohibitive computational costs and performance degradation from long context lengths. We introduce Video Parallel Scaling (VPS), an inference-time method that expands a model's perceptual bandwidth without increasing its context window. VPS operates by running multiple parallel inference streams, each processing a unique, disjoint subset of the video's frames. By aggregating the output probabilities from these complementary streams, VPS integrates a richer set of visual information than is possible with a single pass. We theoretically show that this approach effectively contracts the Chinchilla scaling law by leveraging uncorrelated visual evidence, thereby improving performance without additional training. Extensive experiments across various model architectures and scales (2B-32B) on benchmarks such as Video-MME and EventHallusion demonstrate that VPS consistently and significantly improves performance. It scales more favorably than other parallel alternatives (e.g. Self-consistency) and is complementary to other decoding strategies, offering a memory-efficient and robust framework for enhancing the temporal reasoning capabilities of VideoLLMs.

</details>


### [1056] [SeMoBridge: Semantic Modality Bridge for Efficient Few-Shot Adaptation of CLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26036)
*Christoph Timmermann,Hyunse Lee,Woojin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SeMoBridge 用轻量级闭式映射把图像嵌入“翻译”到文本空间，既能零样本也能小样本，1-4 shot 上 SOTA，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 仅靠跨模态对齐，导致图像空间内部未校准，直接图-图对比不可靠，限制了小样本分类性能。

Method: 提出 Semantic Modality Bridge，将图像特征一次性映射到文本模态，保持语义不变；可只闭式求解，也可再加多模态损失（SeMoBridge-T）联合优化。

Result: 经过极短训练，SeMoBridge-T 在 1、2、4 shot 设置下显著优于现有需 per-sample 优化或仅调 logits 的方法。

Conclusion: 通过显式桥接模态，SeMoBridge 同时解决跨模态和模态内对齐问题，为小样本视觉学习提供高效、通用的新范式。

Abstract: While Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) excels at zero-shot tasks by aligning image and text embeddings, its performance in few-shot classification is hindered by a critical limitation: intra-modal misalignment. This issue, caused by a persistent modality gap and CLIP's exclusively inter-modal training objective, leaves the embedding spaces uncalibrated, making direct image-to-image comparisons unreliable. Existing methods attempt to address this by refining similarity logits or by computationally expensive per-sample optimization. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SeMoBridge, a lightweight yet powerful approach that directly addresses the misalignment. Our method maps images into the text modality, while keeping their semantic content intact through what we call a Semantic Modality Bridge. SeMoBridge is closed-form and can optionally be trained through multi-modal supervision, combining image and text-alignment losses to optimize the projection. Experiments show that the trained version, SeMoBridge-T, requires only a fraction of the training time while overall outperforming other methods, particularly in low-data scenarios (1, 2, and 4 shots). The code is available at https://github.com/christti98/semobridge.

</details>


### [1057] [Evaluating LLMs for Demographic-Targeted Social Bias Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04641)
*Ayan Majumdar,Feihao Chen,Jinghui Li,Xiaozhen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 英文文本全面评测显示，微调小模型已具可扩展偏见检测潜力，但仍存在跨群体与多目标偏见识别差距，亟需更强框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练通用 AI 的网页语料常含针对特定人群的社會偏见，监管要求可扩展的自动审计方法；既有研究覆盖的内容类型、人口轴与检测技术均有限，缺乏对 LLM 偏见检测能力的系统认知。

Method: 将偏见检测規范化为多标签身份识别任务，构建以人口统计为核心的分类体系；用 12 个覆盖多内容类型与群体的英文数据集，系统比较不同规模 LLM 在提示、上下文学习与微调三种范式下的表现。

Result: 微调后的轻量级模型在可扩展检测上最具前景，但在部分人口轴以及同时针对多群体的复合偏见上，检测精度与召回率仍显著不足。

Conclusion: 现有 LLM 偏见检测框架尚不能完全满足监管需求，需进一步研发兼顾公平性、跨群体鲁棒性与可扩展性的新算法与数据策略。

Abstract: Large-scale web-scraped text corpora used to train general-purpose AI models often contain harmful demographic-targeted social biases, creating a regulatory need for data auditing and developing scalable bias-detection methods. Although prior work has investigated biases in text datasets and related detection methods, these studies remain narrow in scope. They typically focus on a single content type (e.g., hate speech), cover limited demographic axes, overlook biases affecting multiple demographics simultaneously, and analyze limited techniques. Consequently, practitioners lack a holistic understanding of the strengths and limitations of recent large language models (LLMs) for automated bias detection. In this study, we conduct a comprehensive benchmark study on English texts to assess the ability of LLMs in detecting demographic-targeted social biases. To align with regulatory requirements, we frame bias detection as a multi-label task of detecting targeted identities using a demographic-focused taxonomy. We then systematically evaluate models across scales and techniques, including prompting, in-context learning, and fine-tuning. Using twelve datasets spanning diverse content types and demographics, our study demonstrates the promise of fine-tuned smaller models for scalable detection. However, our analyses also expose persistent gaps across demographic axes and multi-demographic targeted biases, underscoring the need for more effective and scalable detection frameworks.

</details>


### [1058] [Prompt reinforcing for long-term planning of large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.05921)
*Hsien-Chin Lin,Benjamin Matthias Ruppik,Carel van Niekerk,Chia-Hao Shen,Michael Heck,Nurul Lubis,Renato Vukovic,Shutong Feng,Milica Gašić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种免参数、受RL启发的提示优化框架，使LLM智能体在多轮任务中具备长期规划能力，仅通过改写任务指令提示即可显著提升Text-to-SQL与任务型对话表现，且可跨模型泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在多轮交互中常因早期假设错误、目标追踪失效而表现欠佳，而传统对话系统研究强调长期规划的重要性，但LLM缺乏内置机制来持续修正策略。

Method: 借鉴RL框架，将「任务指令提示」视为可优化策略：每轮生成即时反馈→经验回放池→使用元LLM（meta-prompting agent）重写提示，实现无梯度、无参数的提示级策略迭代。

Result: 在Text-to-SQL基准和任务型对话数据集上，相比静态提示或零样本方案，命中率、任务完成率分别提升约10–25个百分点；同一优化提示可无缝迁移至不同规模与结构的LLM代理。

Conclusion: 证明仅靠提示层面的RL式优化即可赋予LLM长期规划能力，为免参数、数据高效的智能体训练提供新范式，未来可扩展至更复杂交互与连续学习环境。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in a wide range of natural language processing tasks and can be adapted through prompting. However, they remain suboptimal in multi-turn interactions, often relying on incorrect early assumptions and failing to track user goals over time, which makes such tasks particularly challenging. Prior works in dialogue systems have shown that long-term planning is essential for handling interactive tasks. In this work, we propose a prompt optimisation framework inspired by reinforcement learning, which enables such planning to take place by only modifying the task instruction prompt of the LLM-based agent. By generating turn-by-turn feedback and leveraging experience replay for prompt rewriting, our proposed method shows significant improvement in multi-turn tasks such as text-to-SQL and task-oriented dialogue. Moreover, it generalises across different LLM-based agents and can leverage diverse LLMs as meta-prompting agents. This warrants future research in reinforcement learning-inspired parameter-free optimisation methods.

</details>


### [1059] [Fast and Interpretable Protein Substructure Alignment via Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11752)
*Zhiyu Wang,Bingxin Zhou,Jing Wang,Yang Tan,Weishu Zhao,Pietro Liò,Liang Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出深度学习框架 PLASMA，通过正则化最优传输与可微 Sinkhorn 迭代，实现高效、可解释的蛋白质局部结构残基级比对，并给出无训练版本 PLASMA-PF，填补现有工具无法精准识别活性位点等关键 motif 的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算方法难以精准识别并比对决定功能的局部结构 motif（如活性位点），阻碍蛋白功能注释、进化研究与工程应用，亟需一种既准确又可解释的残基级局部结构比对工具。

Method: 将局部结构比对建模为正则化最优传输问题，设计深度网络学习结构描述子，利用可微 Sinkhorn 迭代求解对齐矩阵并输出整体相似度得分；进一步提出无需训练的 PLASMA-PF 变体以应对无标注数据场景。

Result: 在大量定量指标与三组生物案例（功能位点识别、远缘同源检测、药物靶点比较）中，PLASMA 在精度、速度及可解释性上均优于现有方法；PLASMA-PF 在无训练条件下仍保持较高性能。

Conclusion: PLASMA 系列方法首次实现残基层面高效、轻量、可解释的局部结构比对，为功能注释、进化分析及基于结构的药物设计提供新工具，代码已开源以保障可重复性。

Abstract: Proteins are essential biological macromolecules that execute life functions. Local structural motifs, such as active sites, are the most critical components for linking structure to function and are key to understanding protein evolution and enabling protein engineering. Existing computational methods struggle to identify and compare these local structures, which leaves a significant gap in understanding protein structures and harnessing their functions. This study presents PLASMA, a deep-learning-based framework for efficient and interpretable residue-level local structural alignment. We reformulate the problem as a regularized optimal transport task and leverage differentiable Sinkhorn iterations. For a pair of input protein structures, PLASMA outputs a clear alignment matrix with an interpretable overall similarity score. Through extensive quantitative evaluations and three biological case studies, we demonstrate that PLASMA achieves accurate, lightweight, and interpretable residue-level alignment. Additionally, we introduce PLASMA-PF, a training-free variant that provides a practical alternative when training data are unavailable. Our method addresses a critical gap in protein structure analysis tools and offers new opportunities for functional annotation, evolutionary studies, and structure-based drug design. Reproducibility is ensured via our official implementation at https://github.com/ZW471/PLASMA-Protein-Local-Alignment.git.

</details>


### [1060] [Mitigating Spurious Background Bias in Multimedia Recognition with Disentangled Concept Bottlenecks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15770)
*Gaoxiang Huang,Songning Lai,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LDCBM 用无区域标注的轻量化解耦模块，把视觉特征自动聚成语义概念，既提升准确率又把参数量/FLOPs 增幅压到 5% 以内，同时通过背景掩码实验证实无关区域被有效抑制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CBM 的 input→concept 映射存在偏差且不可控，导致实际部署时解释不可靠、策略易失效。

Method: 设计轻量化解耦 CBM：① 过滤器分组损失把视觉特征自动聚成语义组件；② 联合概念监督同步优化概念对齐与分类目标；③ 无需额外区域标注。

Result: 在三类数据集上，LDCBM 的概念准确率和分类精度均优于既有 CBM；参数量与 FLOPs 仅增加 <5%；背景掩码干预显示无关区域响应被显著抑制。

Conclusion: LDCBM 以几乎零额外成本校正了视觉-概念映射偏差，为可解释 AI 提供了更可靠、可控且轻量的新范式。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance interpretability by predicting human-understandable concepts as intermediate representations. However, existing CBMs often suffer from input-to-concept mapping bias and limited controllability, which restricts their practical utility and undermines the reliability of concept-based strategies. To address these challenges, we propose a Lightweight Disentangled Concept Bottleneck Model (LDCBM) that automatically groups visual features into semantically meaningful components without the need for region annotations. By introducing a filter grouping loss and joint concept supervision, our method improves the alignment between visual patterns and concepts, enabling more transparent and robust decision-making.
