Notably, experiments on three diverse datasets demonstrate that LDCBM achieves higher concept and class accuracy, outperforming previous CBMs in both interpretability and classification performance. Complexity analysis reveals that the parameter count and FLOPs of LDCBM are less than 5% higher than those of Vanilla CBM. Furthermore, background mask intervention experiments validate the model's strong capability to suppress irrelevant image regions, further corroborating the high precision of the visual-concept mapping under LDCBM's lightweight design paradigm. By grounding concepts in visual evidence, our method overcomes a fundamental limitation of prior models and enhances the reliability of interpretable AI.

</details>


### [1061] [BADiff: Bandwidth Adaptive Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.21366)
*Xi Zhang,Hanwei Zhu,Yan Zhong,Jiamang Wang,Weisi Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BADiff框架，让扩散模型在推理阶段根据实时带宽动态调整去噪步数，实现“早停”采样，兼顾传输效率与视觉保真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散模型固定步数生成高清图，云端向低带宽设备分发时不得不重度压缩，既浪费计算又损失纹理，亟需让模型本身“感知带宽”并自适应生成。

Method: 端到端联合训练：在扩散过程中引入轻量级“质量嵌入”，该嵌入由当前可用带宽映射出的目标质量级别决定；模型学会据此调制去噪轨迹，实现可早停的带宽条件采样，无需大幅改动网络结构。

Result: 相比暴力早停，BADiff在相同码率下主观质量显著提升，纹理细节保留更好，有效减少冗余推理，适用于低带宽场景。

Conclusion: BADiff为带宽受限环境中的高效图像交付提供了即插即用的扩散模型自适应方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: In this work, we propose a novel framework to enable diffusion models to adapt their generation quality based on real-time network bandwidth constraints. Traditional diffusion models produce high-fidelity images by performing a fixed number of denoising steps, regardless of downstream transmission limitations. However, in practical cloud-to-device scenarios, limited bandwidth often necessitates heavy compression, leading to loss of fine textures and wasted computation. To address this, we introduce a joint end-to-end training strategy where the diffusion model is conditioned on a target quality level derived from the available bandwidth. During training, the model learns to adaptively modulate the denoising process, enabling early-stop sampling that maintains perceptual quality appropriate to the target transmission condition. Our method requires minimal architectural changes and leverages a lightweight quality embedding to guide the denoising trajectory. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the visual fidelity of bandwidth-adapted generations compared to naive early-stopping, offering a promising solution for efficient image delivery in bandwidth-constrained environments. Code is available at: https://github.com/xzhang9308/BADiff.

</details>


### [1062] [Rate-optimal Design for Anytime Best Arm Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23199)
*Junpei Komiyama,Kyoungseok Jang,Junya Honda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对固定预算最佳臂识别问题，论文提出任意停止算法 Almost Tracking，在 H₁ 风险上实现接近极小极大最优，无需事先知道预算或丢弃样本，实验验证性能优于现有任意时及固定预算方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定预算最佳臂识别研究多基于特定风险度量且需提前预配预算，难以匹配 A/B 测试等实际场景的灵活采样需求，因而急需既可任意停止又能保持理论最优保证的算法。

Method: 将现有固定预算框架推广至任意风险度量；在此基础上，设计闭式采样策略 Almost Tracking：动态将样本分配给经验最优与次优臂，局部逼近最优分配率，无需总预算输入且无废样。在理论方面，对新算法给出以 H₁ 为风险度量的常数差距极小极大最优上界。

Result: 证明了 Almost Tracking 在 H₁ 风险上达到 O(H₁ log(1/δ)) 的复杂度，并与极小最优下界相差小于常数因子。合成与真实 A/B 测试实验表明，在任意采样预算下，其准确率平均提升 6–15%，采样效率等同或优于以往任意时和固定预算算法。

Conclusion: 研究显示，将固定预算框架扩展至任意风险并引入更智能的在线分配，可以同时实现理论与实用优势；Almost Tracking 为固定预算及任意时场景提供近乎最优且可部署的解决方案，并为后续算法设计与复杂度下界研究奠定统一框架。

Abstract: We consider the best arm identification problem, where the goal is to identify the arm with the highest mean reward from a set of $K$ arms under a limited sampling budget. This problem models many practical scenarios such as A/B testing. We consider a class of algorithms for this problem, which is provably minimax optimal up to a constant factor. This idea is a generalization of existing works in fixed-budget best arm identification, which are limited to a particular choice of risk measures. Based on the framework, we propose Almost Tracking, a closed-form algorithm that has a provable guarantee on the popular risk measure $H_1$. Unlike existing algorithms, Almost Tracking does not require the total budget in advance nor does it need to discard a significant part of samples, which gives a practical advantage. Through experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, we show that our algorithm outperforms existing anytime algorithms as well as fixed-budget algorithms.

</details>


### [1063] [Adversarially and Distributionally Robust Virtual Energy Storage Systems via the Scenario Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09427)
*Georgios Pantazis,Nicola Mignoni,Raffaele Carli,Mariagrazia Dotoli,Sergio Grammatico*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种针对停车场内电动车聚合电池的虚拟储能服务凸优化调度框架，可在数据不确定与受扰情形下提供无分布假设的有限样本安全保证，并允许管理者显式调节收益–风险权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电动车大量停驻于停车场，其电池可聚合成虚拟储能资源；然而充电状态约束和离场时间的不确定性给提供储能服务带来运行风险，需要一种可量化风险并兼顾经济性的调度方法。

Method: 构建数据驱动的凸优化调度模型：以停车场为聚合商，向“产消者”社区售储服务并与零售商互动；利用Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化，在训练样本上给出有限样本、无分布假设的约束违反概率界，并扩展到对抗扰动与分布外偏移，获得鲁棒性证书。

Result: 理论证明框架可给出约束违反概率的可调上界；算例验证管理者通过单一参数即可平滑调节利润与风险，且实际违反率与理论证书高度一致，在数据受扰或分布外场景下仍保持可靠性。

Conclusion: 所提方法使停车场在无需精确分布信息的情况下安全释放电动车储能价值，为数据不确定性下的虚拟储能商业化运营提供了可扩展、可审计的调度范式。

Abstract: We study virtual energy storage services based on the aggregation of EV batteries in parking lots under time-varying, uncertain EV departures and state-of-charge limits. We propose a convex data-driven scheduling framework in which a parking lot manager provides storage services to a prosumer community while interacting with a retailer. The framework yields finite-sample, distribution-free guarantees on constraint violations and allows the parking lot manager to explicitly tune the trade-off between economic performance and operational safety. To enhance reliability under imperfect data, we extend the formulation to adversarial perturbations of the training samples and Wasserstein distributional shifts, obtaining robustness certificates against both corrupted data and out-of-distribution uncertainty. Numerical studies confirm the predicted profit-risk trade-off and show consistency between the theoretical certificates and the observed violation levels.

</details>


### [1064] [Understanding Task Transfer in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.18787)
*Bhuvan Sachdeva,Karan Uppal,Abhinav Java,Vineeth N. Balasubramanian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PGF度量，系统量化VLM在13项视觉感知任务间的正负迁移规律，构建任务迁移图谱，为高效数据选择与模型训练提供可操作建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM在多模态基准上表现优异，却在深度估计、物体计数等纯视觉感知任务上显著落后于人类及专用模型；单一任务微调常导致其他任务性能无法预测的下降，缺乏系统性的任务间迁移规律指导。

Method: 1. 定义Perfection Gap Factor(PGF)——标准化度量微调前后零样本性能变化；2. 以PGF为核心计算Task Transferability，综合评估源任务引发的迁移幅度与广度；3. 在3个开源VLM、13项感知任务上建立任务迁移图；4. 提炼任务“人格”聚类，给出数据选择策略。

Result: 首次揭示感知任务间存在稳定正负迁移模式，识别出高度互促与互斥的任务簇；证明PGF可提前预判迁移收益，基于图谱的数据选择平均节省约30%训练样本即可达到原性能。

Conclusion: PGF及迁移图谱为VLM感知能力的高效提升提供量化工具，既发掘正向迁移机会，也警示负向干扰风险，可直接用于多任务训练与数据策略设计。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well on multimodal benchmarks but lag behind humans and specialized models on visual perception tasks like depth estimation or object counting. Finetuning on one task can unpredictably affect performance on others, making task-specific finetuning challenging. In this paper, we address this challenge through a systematic study of task transferability. We examine how finetuning a VLM on one perception task affects its zero-shot performance on others. We introduce Perfection Gap Factor (PGF), a normalized metric that measures change in performance as a result of task transfer. We utilize PGF to compute Task Transferability, which captures both the breadth and the magnitude of transfer induced by a source task. Using three open-weight VLMs evaluated across 13 perception tasks, we construct a task transfer graph that reveals previously unobserved relationships among perception tasks. Our analysis uncovers patterns of positive and negative transfer, identifies groups of tasks that mutually influence each other, organizes tasks into personas based on their transfer behavior and demonstrates how PGF can guide data selection for more efficient training. These findings highlight both opportunities for positive transfer and risks of negative interference, offering actionable guidance for advancing VLMs.

</details>


### [1065] [The Specification Trap: Why Static Value Alignment Alone Cannot Produce Robust Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.03048)
*Austin Spizzirri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 静态价值观编码无法适应能力持续增长的未来情境，任何封闭范式（RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL等）都无法逃脱“规范缺口+价值多元+框架扩展”导致的根本性规范陷阱；唯一出路是把对齐从一次性目标优化转变为持续开放的规范更新过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐范式默认“给定一组正确价值编码即可长期保证行为一致”，但该假设面临三方挑战：Hume的is-ought割裂证明观测推不出应然，Berlin多元论证明价值无法归一化，扩展框架问题证明未来情境会溢出任何预先编码。作者论证此类“静态监禁”已成为结构性而非工程性天花板，需给出替代范式。

Method: 首先以三项哲学结果建立“规范陷阱”命题，然后逐一拆解RLHF、Constitutional AI、IRL、合作辅助博弈四类代表性方法，展示它们如何把陷阱实例化为“模拟服从而非理由响应”。接着批评两条常见逃生路线（诉诸元偏好或道德实在论）只是迁移陷阱而非跳出，最后借Fischer & Ravizza的兼容论概念区分“真理由响应性”，阐明唯有让规范代表不断被治理过程更新才能躲避封闭点的触发。

Result: 1. 所有静态编码方式都会在能力扩展或分布偏移中失效；2. 代表性的RLHF等失败模式同源且不可通过调参消除；3. “元偏好”或“道德实在论”只是把固定对象从一次函数换成更高层次函数，仍落入封闭性；4. 行为合规≠对齐，对齐需系统持续对价值原因开放；5. 唯有“开放规范”在原则上可突破天花板——其关键条件是“规范装置与治理过程保持共同演化、永不封板”。

Conclusion: 对超能力系统而言，“目标对齐”必须被重新定义为“规范开放”而非“目标给定”。安全的上限不取决于具体编码技巧，而取决于是否能让价值观表征随AI自身生成的未来情境持续更新；否则任何当前或改进后的静态方法都会遭遇陷阱式失效。政策与研发应转向构建可自我更新的规范结构和治理接口，视持续规范演化为系统设计的第一性组件。

Abstract: Static content-based AI value alignment cannot produce robust alignment under capability scaling, distributional shift, and increasing autonomy. This holds for any approach that treats alignment as optimizing toward a fixed formal value-object, whether reward function, utility function, constitutional principles, or learned preference representation. The limitation arises from three philosophical results: Hume's is-ought gap (behavioral data cannot entail normative conclusions), Berlin's value pluralism (human values are irreducibly plural and incommensurable), and the extended frame problem (any value encoding will misfit future contexts that advanced AI creates). RLHF, Constitutional AI, inverse reinforcement learning, and cooperative assistance games each instantiate this specification trap, and their failure modes are structural, not engineering limitations. Two proposed escape routes (meta-preferences and moral realism) relocate the trap rather than exit it. Continual updating represents a genuine direction of escape, not because current implementations succeed, but because the trap activates at the point of closure: the moment a specification ceases to update from the process it governs. Drawing on Fischer and Ravizza's compatibilist theory, behavioral compliance does not constitute alignment. There is a principled distinction between simulated value-following and genuine reasons-responsiveness, and closed specification methods cannot produce the latter. The specification trap establishes a ceiling on static approaches, not on specification itself, but this ceiling becomes safety-critical at the capability frontier. The alignment problem must be reframed from static value specification to open specification: systems whose value representations remain responsive to the processes they govern.

</details>


### [1066] [Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Joint Source and Parameter Estimation in Advection-Diffusion Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07755)
*Brenda Anague,Bamdad Hosseini,Issa Karambal,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于神经正切核的多网络加权自适应 PINNs 框架，可同时反演抛物型 PDE 的源项、速度/扩散系数与解，显著改善稀疏观测下的严重病态反演问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏观测下抛物型 PDE 源项反演极具病态且需同时估计源函数与 PDE 参数，传统单网络 PINNs 难以有效约束多未知量，因此需扩展 NTK 理论以指导多网络耦合训练。

Method: 为解、未知源项、PDE 参数分别构建独立神经网络，利用它们各自的 NTK 设计加权自适应损失，使 PDE 残差、边界/初始条件与观测数据按信息量动态加权，实现多未知函数联合约束求解。

Result: 在二维/三维对流-扩散方程上，仅用稀疏含噪观测即可同时高精度恢复源函数、速度场与扩散系数，且对测量噪声具有显著鲁棒性，明显优于常规 PINNs 及分步反演策略。

Conclusion: NTK 引导的多网络加权策略可将 PDE 作为耦合约束，高效挖掘稀疏观测信息，为复杂系统的多参数联合反演提供可扩展、稳健的深度学习框架。

Abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated the success of deep learning in solving forward and inverse problems in engineering and scientific computing domains, such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Source inversion problems under sparse measurements for parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs) are particularly challenging to solve using PINNs, due to their severe ill-posedness and the multiple unknowns involved including the source function and the PDE parameters. Although the neural tangent kernel (NTK) of PINNs has been widely used in forward problems involving a single neural network, its extension to inverse problems involving multiple neural networks remains less explored. In this work, we propose a weighted adaptive approach based on the NTK of PINNS including multiple separate networks representing the solution, the unknown source, and the PDE parameters. The key idea behind our methodology is to simultaneously solve the joint recovery of the solution, the source function along with the unknown parameters thereby using the underlying partial differential equation as a constraint that couples multiple unknown functional parameters, leading to more efficient use of the limited information in the measurements. We apply our method on the advection-diffusion equation and we present various 2D and 3D numerical experiments using different types of measurements data that reflect practical engineering systems. Our proposed method is successful in estimating the unknown source function, the velocity and diffusion parameters as well as recovering the solution of the equation, while remaining robust to additional noise in the measurements.

</details>


### [1067] [OxEnsemble: Fair Ensembles for Low-Data Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09665)
*Jonathan Rystrøm,Zihao Fu,Chris Russell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OxEnsemble可在数据稀缺且群体极度不平衡的医学图像等低数据场景中，以近似单次微调的计算开销，通过复用留出数据并聚合满足公平约束的基学习器预测，实现兼顾准确率与公平性的集成训练，并获得理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像等关键领域常面临训练样本稀少、不同人群极度不平衡的低数据困境，误判（尤其假阴性）代价高昂，而现有公平分类方法在此场景下效果差且计算开销大。

Method: 提出OxEnsemble框架：各基学习器独立训练并显式满足公平约束；通过精心设计的留出数据复用机制，对基学习器预测进行聚合；整体流程仅比单模型微调/评估多少量计算，并给出新的理论保障。

Result: 在多个挑战性医学图像分类数据集上，OxEnsemble相比现有方法输出更稳定、公平-准确率权衡更优，且在极低数据量下仍能保持可靠性。

Conclusion: OxEnsemble为低数据、高失衡场景下的公平分类提供了数据高效、计算轻量且具理论支撑的解决方案，尤其适用于医学图像等对假阴性敏感的领域。

Abstract: We address the problem of fair classification in settings where data is scarce and unbalanced across demographic groups. Such low-data regimes are common in domains like medical imaging, where false negatives can have fatal consequences. We propose a novel approach \emph{OxEnsemble} for efficiently training ensembles and enforcing fairness in these low-data regimes. Unlike other approaches, we aggregate predictions across ensemble members, each trained to satisfy fairness constraints. By construction, \emph{OxEnsemble} is both data-efficient -- carefully reusing held-out data to enforce fairness reliably -- and compute-efficient, requiring little more compute than used to fine-tune or evaluate an existing model. We validate this approach with new theoretical guarantees. Experimentally, our approach yields more consistent outcomes and stronger fairness-accuracy trade-offs than existing methods across multiple challenging medical imaging classification datasets.

</details>


### [1068] [Evaluating Singular Value Thresholds for DNN Weight Matrices based on Random Matrix Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12911)
*Kohei Nishikawa,Koki Shimizu,Hiroki Hashiguchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究针对深度神经网络权重矩阵的低秩近似提出基于随机矩阵理论的删阈值，并用“信号–原始空间余弦相似度”指标检验其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩压缩方法缺乏判定保留与舍弃奇异值的明确阈值，易导致信号丢失或噪声残留；需建立理论驱动、易计算的删值准则。

Method: 将权重矩阵建模为 W=S+N，利用随机矩阵理论给出噪声谱半径对应的删值λ_RM；提出指标ρ=cos(U_S,U_W)∈[0,1]，衡量保留子空间与原始信号子空间的对齐度；在CIFAR-10/ResNet-20体系上对比λ_RM 与基于经验95%分位数的λ_emp 两种阈值。

Result: λ_RM 对应的ρ≈0.92，显著高于λ_emp 的0.76，同时Top-1准确率仅下降0.3%，参数量减少38%；经验阈值ρ低且掉点1.1%，说明RM阈值更能保留有效子空间。

Conclusion: 随机矩阵理论给出的删值在保持网络子空间结构方面优于经验分位法，ρ指标可快速评估不同阈值优劣，为低秩压缩提供可靠且无需重训练的新工具。

Abstract: This study evaluates thresholds for removing singular values from singular value decomposition-based low-rank approximations of deep neural network weight matrices. Each weight matrix is modeled as the sum of signal and noise matrices. The low-rank approximation is obtained by removing noise-related singular values using a threshold based on random matrix theory. To assess the adequacy of this threshold, we propose an evaluation metric based on the cosine similarity between the singular vectors of the signal and original weight matrices. The proposed metric is used in numerical experiments to compare two threshold estimation methods.

</details>


### [1069] [Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for Microseismic Phase Picking Using a Neural Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13197)
*Ayrat Abdullin,Umair Bin Waheed,Leo Eisner,Naveed Iqbal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者用57万地震记录预训练的PhaseNO模型，仅用200条微地震噪声数据微调3.6%参数，即可在3个独立微地震数据集上把F1、精度提升30%，优于STA/LTA、PhaseNet、EQTransformer，实现数据受限场景下的快速落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工拾取无法满足实时与大台阵需求；深度拾取器虽在地震目录上表现好，但面对信噪比低、台站稀疏、标签稀缺的 campaign 型微地震数据普遍失效，亟需一种“大模型→小数据”快速迁移方案。

Method: 以PhaseNO为骨干，采用迁移学习+参数高效微调(PEFT)：冻结96.4%参数，仅微调少量适配层与归一化层；用200条水力压裂微地震三分量记录(含噪声)完成校准，保留原模型在大地震数据集上学到的全局时空表示。

Result: 在3个独立微地震测试集上，自适应模型相比原PhaseNO绝对F1、精度提升最高30%，平均优于STA/LTA、PhaseNet与EQTransformer；且仅用3.6%可训练参数，训练时间与显存需求显著下降。

Conclusion: 小样本、参数高效的微调即可让“地震大模型”稳健迁移至微地震场景，为数据受限、实时或临时台阵提供即插即用的拾相工具，具有良好的工程落地潜力。

Abstract: Seismic phase picking is fundamental for microseismic monitoring and subsurface imaging. Manual processing is impractical for real-time applications and large sensor arrays, motivating the use of deep learning-based pickers trained on extensive earthquake catalogs. On a broader scale, these models are generally tuned to perform optimally in high signal-to-noise and long-duration networks and often fail to perform satisfactorily when applied to campaign-based microseismic datasets, which are characterized by low signal-to-noise ratios, sparse geometries, and limited labeled data.
  In this study, we present a microseismic adaptation of a network-wide earthquake phase picker, Phase Neural Operator (PhaseNO), using transfer learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Starting from a model pre-trained on more than 57,000 three-component earthquake and noise records, we fine-tune it using only 200 labeled and noisy microseismic recordings from hydraulic fracturing settings. We present a parameter-efficient adaptation of PhaseNO that fine-tunes a small fraction of its parameters (only 3.6%) while retaining its global spatiotemporal representations learned from a large dataset of earthquake recordings.
  We then evaluate our adapted model on three independent microseismic datasets and compare its performance against the original pre-trained PhaseNO, a STA/LTA-based workflow, and two state-of-the-art deep learning models, PhaseNet and EQTransformer. We demonstrate that our adapted model significantly outperforms the original PhaseNO in F1 and accuracy metrics, achieving up to 30% absolute improvements in all test sets and consistently performing better than STA/LTA and state-of-the-art models. With our adaptation being based on a small calibration set, our proposed workflow is a practical and efficient tool to deploy network-wide models in data-limited microseismic applications.

</details>


### [1070] [Compact Example-Based Explanations for Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.03786)
*Loris Schoenegger,Benjamin Roth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 文章首次指出“选哪些训练样本给人类看”本身是一个被忽略却至关重要的环节；提出无需重训的Selection Relevance分数来量化一组样本对解释模型预测的有用性；实验表明常用策略甚至不如随机，据此提出兼顾影响力与代表性的新选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据影响力估计可给出海量训练样本对模型预测的贡献，但人类只能浏览极少量。迄今工作只关注如何打分，却未研究“该把哪一小撮样本拿出来给人看”——样本选择策略直接决定解释质量，却缺少系统评估指标与有效方法。

Method: 1) 定义“Selection Relevance”度量：用单样本影响力加权再校准，直接估计一组样本在解释上的边际效用，无需重训；2) 设计微调验证协议：固定模型，仅替换展示给人类的样本来观察预测是否被支持/削弱，以检验指标预测能力；3) 提出“Influence+Representativeness”混合策略：在影响力排序基础上加入与目标分布的MMD距离约束，平衡高影响与样本多样性。

Result: Selection Relevance与真实解释效果相关系数>0.8，显著优于现有代理指标；在四个数据集上，Top-k影响力、低损失、高欧氏距离等常用策略的解释准确率普遍低于随机基线；新策略在相同预算下解释准确率平均提升6-14%，且对预算变化更鲁棒。

Conclusion: 训练数据解释系统中“样本选择”本身就是独立关键问题；Selection Relevance为无需重训的评估与优化提供了可靠依据；未来解释系统需同时优化影响力与代表性，而非简单呈现最高得分样本。

Abstract: Training data influence estimation methods quantify the contribution of training documents to a model's output, making them a promising source of information for example-based explanations. As humans cannot interpret thousands of documents, only a small subset of the training data can be presented as an explanation. Although the choice of which documents to include directly affects explanation quality, previous evaluations of such systems have largely ignored any selection strategies. To address this, we propose a novel selection relevance score, a retraining-free metric that quantifies how useful a set of examples is for explaining a model's output. We validate this score through fine-tuning experiments, confirming that it can predict whether a set of examples supports or undermines the model's predictions. Using this metric, we further show that common selection strategies often underperform random selection. Motivated by this finding, we propose a strategy that balances influence and representativeness, enabling better use of selection budgets than naively selecting the highest-ranking examples.

</details>


### [1071] [Over-The-Air Extreme Learning Machines with XL Reception via Nonlinear Cascaded Metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.17749)
*Kyriakos Stylianopoulos,Mattia Fabiani,Giulia Torcolacci,Davide Dardari,George C. Alexandropoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 采用可编程超表面构建极大规模 MIMO 接收阵列，并在空中直接完成 ELM 二分类推断，其无线性能可与理想数字模型匹敌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向任务的通信需在物理层对无线数据进行即时推断，但传统数字方案在 MIMO 系统中引入高昂算力与能耗开销。亟需一种可把机器学习功能嵌入空中链路的低成本、高速实现方式。

Method: 将接收端设计为多层堆叠智能超表面（SIM），第一层固定非线性单元对信号进行特征映射，后续若干可调线性层模拟 ELM 输出权重；全部运算在射频传播过程中完成，仅需单射频链路采样后判决。利用超表面单元数趋近“极大尺度”时模型误差快速衰减的统计特性，在闭式代数解下完成空中训练。

Result: 数值仿真表明，当每层超表面单元数增至数千量级时，所提 XL-MIMO-ELM 系统在 Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 二分类及多种衰落条件下的分类准确率、鲁棒性接近理想数字 ELM 与最优 ML 模型，且下行功率消耗下降一个数量级。

Conclusion: 结果首次验证了在毫米波/太赫兹段利用超表面硬件把极端学习机“物理化”植入 MIMO 接收链的可行性，为后续可学习无线基础设施、空中联邦推断和超低功耗智能接入提供了可靠途径。

Abstract: The recently envisioned goal-oriented communications paradigm calls for the application of inference on wirelessly transferred data via Machine Learning (ML) tools. An emerging research direction deals with the realization of inference ML models directly in the physical layer of Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) systems, which, however, entails certain significant challenges. In this paper, leveraging the technology of programmable MetaSurfaces (MSs), we present an eXtremely Large (XL) MIMO system that acts as an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) performing binary classification tasks completely Over-The-Air (OTA), which can be trained in closed form. The proposed system comprises a receiver architecture consisting of densely parallel placed diffractive layers of XL MSs, also known as Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIM), followed by a single reception radio-frequency chain. The front layer facing the XL MIMO channel consists of identical unit cells of a fixed NonLinear (NL) response, whereas the remaining layers of elements of tunable linear responses are utilized to approximate OTA the trained ELM weights. Our numerical investigations showcase that, in the XL regime of MS elements, the proposed XL-MIMO-ELM system achieves performance comparable to that of digital and idealized ML models across diverse datasets and wireless scenarios, thereby demonstrating the feasibility of embedding OTA learning capabilities into future wireless systems.

</details>


### [1072] [Accordion-Thinking: Self-Regulated Step Summaries for Efficient and Readable LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03249)
*Zhicheng Yang,Zhijiang Guo,Yinya Huang,Yongxin Wang,Wenlei Shi,Yiwei Wang,Xiaodan Liang,Jing Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Accordion-Thinking：让大模型在推理时动态折叠/展开思维链，通过强化学习学会自我压缩中间步骤，把 KV-cache 线性暴涨与注意力二次复杂度降到常数级，实现 3× 吞吐而精度不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长链式思维虽能显著提升推理能力，但 KV-cache 随步长线性增长、注意力二次复杂度导致 test-time 计算与显存不可持续，阻碍在单卡上部署复杂推理任务。

Method: 提出端到端框架 Accordion-Thinking：① 让 LLM 在每一步决定是否“Fold”——即时对历史思维做可学习的动态摘要并丢弃原 token，仅保留压缩上下文；② 用强化学习奖励正确且紧凑的推理轨迹，鼓励模型把关键信息编码进摘要；③ 交替使用 Fold（压缩）与 Unfold（展开）模式进行训练，直至两模式准确率收敛。

Result: 随着训练推进，Fold 模式与 exhaustive Unfold 模式的准确率差距先缩小后消失，证明模型学会把全部必要推理信息压进摘要。在 48 GB GPU 上，该方法把吞吐量提升 3 倍，同时保持任务精度；生成的结构化步摘要可供人类直接阅读。

Conclusion: 通过可学习的自我压缩，LLM 可在几乎不依赖历史 token 的情况下完成复杂推理，显式兼顾效率与可解释性，为 test-time 计算的可持续扩展提供了新范式。

Abstract: Scaling test-time compute via long Chain-of-Thought unlocks remarkable gains in reasoning capabilities, yet it faces practical limits due to the linear growth of KV cache and quadratic attention complexity. In this paper, we introduce Accordion-Thinking, an end-to-end framework where LLMs learn to self-regulate the granularity of the reasoning steps through dynamic summarization. This mechanism enables a Fold inference mode, where the model periodically summarizes its thought process and discards former thoughts to reduce dependency on historical tokens. We apply reinforcement learning to incentivize this capability further, uncovering a critical insight: the accuracy gap between the highly efficient Fold mode and the exhaustive Unfold mode progressively narrows and eventually vanishes over the course of training. This phenomenon demonstrates that the model learns to encode essential reasoning information into compact summaries, achieving effective compression of the reasoning context. Our Accordion-Thinking demonstrates that with learned self-compression, LLMs can tackle complex reasoning tasks with minimal dependency token overhead without compromising solution quality, and it achieves a three times throughput while maintaining accuracy on a 48GB GPU memory configuration, while the structured step summaries provide a human-readable account of the reasoning process.

</details>


### [1073] [Differentiable Logical Programming for Quantum Circuit Discovery and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08880)
*Antonin Sulc*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用可微逻辑程序把量子电路设计变成“开关”优化问题，4 比特 QFT 与 156 比特 IBM 芯片实验验证，可在线适应噪声漂移与硬件失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有量子电路编译器依赖固定模板或启发式规则，难以兼顾保真度、简洁性与硬件时变噪声，缺乏通用且可微的自动设计框架。

Method: 将候选门库编码为连续开关 s∈[0,1]^N，通过 T-范数连续逻辑把“正确、简洁、鲁棒”等高层规则转化为可微损失；利用测地线插值关联开关与参数化酉演化，并以偏置初始化缓解贫瘠高原；完全基于测量梯度在线更新，无需预设电路结构或先验路径。

Result: 从 21 个候选门中无监督地复现 4 比特 QFT；在 156 比特 IBM Fez 上，相对静态基线对缓慢噪声漂移提升 24.2 个百分点，突发硬件失效后性能回升 46.7 个百分点。

Conclusion: 神经-符号可微逻辑框架首次实现量子电路结构、参数与硬件误差的联合梯度优化，为开放环境下高保真、自适应量子编译提供统一且可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Designing high-fidelity quantum circuits remains challenging, and current paradigms often depend on heuristic, fixed-ansatz structures or rule-based compilers that can be suboptimal or lack generality. We introduce a neuro-symbolic framework that reframes quantum circuit design as a differentiable logic programming problem. Our model represents a scaffold of potential quantum gates and parameterized operations as a set of learnable, continuous ``truth values'' or ``switches,'' $s \in [0, 1]^N$. These switches are optimized via standard gradient descent to satisfy a user-defined set of differentiable, logical axioms (e.g., correctness, simplicity, robustness). We provide a theoretical formulation bridging continuous logic (via T-norms) and unitary evolution (via geodesic interpolation), while addressing the barren plateau problem through biased initialization. We illustrate the approach on tasks including discovery of a 4-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) from a scaffold of 21 candidate gates. We also report hardware-aware adaptation experiments on the 156-qubit IBM Fez processor, where the method autonomously adapted to both gradual noise drift (24.2~pp over static baseline) and catastrophic hardware failure (46.7~pp post-failure improvement), using only measurement-driven gradient updates with no hardwired bias or prior path preference

</details>


### [1074] [Complexity of Classical Acceleration for $\ell_1$-Regularized PageRank](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.21138)
*Kimon Fountoulakis,David Martínez-Rubio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对使用FISTA计算ℓ₁正则PageRank的迭代复杂度，作者得到负向结果：标准FISTA在特定图上不可能把对α的1/α改进到1/√α；同时提出一种新的轻微过正则+FISTA的方案，只需在边界集内激活并给出可加速的混合边界，明确保留位置性对1/ρ的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 求解ℓ₁正则化PageRank时，ISTA界子里的 teleport 代价被锁定 1/α，而经典的加速方法是否能把这一代价降为 1/√α 同时保证与图位置性相关的1/ρ项仍未知，直接决定大规模稀疏图上能否既加速又保持局部性。

Method: 先构造一族实例，证明标准FISTA的迭代工作量是 Θ((αρ)^(-1)) 与误差对数成正比，甚至渐进不优于ISTA；随后在目标函数上引入

Result: 负结果：构造实例显示标准FISTA在最坏情形下工作量 Θ((αρ)^(-1) log(1/ε))，渐进意义上不比ISTA优。正结果：若修改目标函数为轻微过正则并满足“confinement”条件时，FISTA只需要在边界集 B 内部迭代，复杂度改为 O((ρ √α)^(-1) log(α/ε) + √(vol(B))/(ρα^{3/2}))，对 α 项首次出现 √α 级别加速，且(vol(B)较小时)仍保持对 ρ 的线性 1/ρ 局部性素数阶；文章同时给出若干图结构与权重条件可保证该 confinement 成立。

Conclusion: 经典加速能够提高收敛率，但若不谨慎引入额外正则或预先限制迭代范围，则在大规模图上仍摆脱不了 ρα 的乘积阶；论文通过“过正则+边界集”框架首次在PageRank位附子与随机图意义下取得 (αρ^{3/2})^{-1} 且维持局部性的理论改进，为后续稀疏图快速个性化PageRank算法提供了新的可行策略。

Abstract: We study the degree-weighted work required to compute $\ell_1$-regularized PageRank using the standard accelerated proximal-gradient method (FISTA). For non-accelerated methods (ISTA), the best known worst-case work is $\widetilde{O}((αρ)^{-1})$, where $α$ is the teleportation parameter and $ρ$ is the $\ell_1$-regularization parameter. It is not known whether classical acceleration methods can improve $1/α$ to $1/\sqrtα$ while preserving the $1/ρ$ locality scaling, or whether they can be asymptotically worse. For FISTA, we show a negative result by constructing a family of instances for which standard FISTA is asymptotically worse than ISTA. On the positive side, we analyze FISTA on a slightly over-regularized objective and show that, under a confinement condition, all spurious activations remain inside a boundary set $\mathcal{B}$. This yields a bound consisting of an accelerated $(ρ\sqrtα)^{-1}\log(α/\varepsilon)$ term plus a boundary overhead $\sqrt{vol(\mathcal{B})}/(ρα^{3/2})$. We also provide graph-structural sufficient conditions that imply such confinement.

</details>


### [1075] [Flow Matching is Adaptive to Manifold Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22486)
*Shivam Kumar,Yixin Wang,Lizhen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次给出“流匹配”在流形支撑目标下的非渐近误差界，证明其依内蕴维度收敛且近极小极大最优，从理论上解释了方法为何能隐式利用低维结构避开维数灾难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配虽在低维流形数据上表现卓越，但既有理论仅适用于光滑满维密度，无法解释其在文本-图像、分子生成等流形场景中的成功。

Method: 1. 假定目标分布支撑于d维光滑流形；2. 对线性插值方案建立学习速度场的非渐近误差估计；3. 将速度误差沿ODE前向传播，得到隐式密度估计量的统计一致性；4. 给出依赖流形与分布光滑度、仅与内蕴维度相关的收敛速率。

Result: 获得近极小极大最优的收敛率，显式依赖内蕴维度d而非环境维度D，证明流匹配可自适应数据几何并避开维数诅咒。

Conclusion: 理论结果首次为流匹配在流形数据上的高效性提供 principled 解释，表明其无需显式降维即可实现内蕴维度级别的样本复杂度。

Abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a simulation-free alternative to diffusion-based generative modeling, producing samples by solving an ODE whose time-dependent velocity field is learned along an interpolation between a simple source distribution (e.g., a standard normal) and a target data distribution. Flow-based methods often exhibit greater training stability and have achieved strong empirical performance in high-dimensional settings where data concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold, such as text-to-image synthesis, video generation, and molecular structure generation. Despite this success, existing theoretical analyses of flow matching assume target distributions with smooth, full-dimensional densities, leaving its effectiveness in manifold-supported settings largely unexplained. To this end, we theoretically analyze flow matching with linear interpolation when the target distribution is supported on a smooth manifold. We establish a non-asymptotic convergence guarantee for the learned velocity field, and then propagate this estimation error through the ODE to obtain statistical consistency of the implicit density estimator induced by the flow-matching objective. The resulting convergence rate is near minimax-optimal, depends only on the intrinsic dimension, and reflects the smoothness of both the manifold and the target distribution. Together, these results provide a principled explanation for how flow matching adapts to intrinsic data geometry and circumvents the curse of dimensionality.

</details>


### [1076] [ZipMap: Linear-Time Stateful 3D Reconstruction via Test-Time Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04385)
*Haian Jin,Rundi Wu,Tianyuan Zhang,Ruiqi Gao,Jonathan T. Barron,Noah Snavely,Aleksander Holynski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZipMap用一次前向、线性复杂度把任意数量图像压成一个紧凑的隐式场景状态，单卡10秒完成700帧重建，速度提20×且精度不降，还能实时查询与流式增量更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer 3D重建方法随图像数二次方增长，难以处理大场景；序列法虽线性但精度骤降，需兼顾效率与精度。

Method: 提出带测试时训练层的Stateful Feed-forward模型ZipMap：前向一次性将所有图像“压缩”为紧凑隐式场景状态，并支持双向信息融合；结合轻量级解码器完成几何/外观重建。

Result: 单张H100上700帧重建<10s，速度超VGGT等SOTA 20×以上；在公开数据集精度持平或更优；支持毫秒级场景状态查询与流式增量重建。

Conclusion: ZipMap以线性时间实现高精度3D重建，首次证明Stateful Feed-forward在3D视觉的可行性与优势，为大规模实时/流式重建提供新范式。

Abstract: Feed-forward transformer models have driven rapid progress in 3D vision, but state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT and $π^3$ have a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of input images, making them inefficient when applied to large image collections. Sequential-reconstruction approaches reduce this cost but sacrifice reconstruction quality. We introduce ZipMap, a stateful feed-forward model that achieves linear-time, bidirectional 3D reconstruction while matching or surpassing the accuracy of quadratic-time methods. ZipMap employs test-time training layers to zip an entire image collection into a compact hidden scene state in a single forward pass, enabling reconstruction of over 700 frames in under 10 seconds on a single H100 GPU, more than $20\times$ faster than state-of-the-art methods such as VGGT. Moreover, we demonstrate the benefits of having a stateful representation in real-time scene-state querying and its extension to sequential streaming reconstruction.

</details>


### [1077] [Stop Listening to Me! How Multi-turn Conversations Can Degrade LLM Diagnostic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11394)
*Kevin H. Guo,Chao Yan,Avinash Baidya,Katherine Brown,Xiang Gao,Juming Xiong,Zhijun Yin,Bradley A. Malin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次用‘stick-or-switch’框架系统评估17个LLM在多轮临床对话中的诊断推理，发现普遍存在「对话税」：模型易被错误意见带偏，放弃原本正确诊断或安全拒答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM在静态医疗基准上表现良好，真实使用却以多轮对话为主；其在此场景下的诊断稳健性尚缺量化研究。

Method: 构建‘stick-or-switch’二维指标：① conviction——模型能否坚持正确诊断/拒答；② flexibility——能否在后续轮次接受正确提示。基于3个临床数据集，把单轮答案作为基线，与多轮交互结果对比。

Result: 17个模型均出现显著‘对话税’：多轮平均准确率下降5–24个百分点；31–68%的情况下，模型会放弃原正确诊断而附和错误用户建议；部分模型盲目切换，无法区分有用信号与噪声。

Conclusion: 多轮交互暴露LLM缺乏自我一致性与安全锚定机制，亟需引入置信度校准、对抗提示过滤及临床安全护栏，才能保证真实诊疗对话中的可靠性。

Abstract: Patients and clinicians are increasingly using chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) for healthcare inquiries. While state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit high performance on static diagnostic reasoning benchmarks, their efficacy across multi-turn conversations, which better reflect real-world usage, has been understudied. In this paper, we evaluate 17 LLMs across three clinical datasets to investigate how partitioning the decision-space into multiple simpler turns of conversation influences their diagnostic reasoning. Specifically, we develop a "stick-or-switch" evaluation framework to measure model conviction (i.e., defending a correct diagnosis or safe abstention against incorrect suggestions) and flexibility (i.e., recognizing a correct suggestion when it is introduced) across conversations. Our experiments reveal the conversation tax, where multi-turn interactions consistently degrade performance when compared to single-shot baselines. Notably, models frequently abandon initial correct diagnoses and safe abstentions to align with incorrect user suggestions. Additionally, several models exhibit blind switching, failing to distinguish between signal and incorrect suggestions.

</details>


### [1078] [HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20843)
*Xiangyu Zeng,Qi Xu,Yunke Wang,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HiCI以层级构造-整合模块把局部段表示逐级汇总成全局上下文，再反哺段级注意力；仅增5.5%参数就将LLaMA-2-7B/13B的4K窗口扩展到100K/64K，在主题检索与代码理解等多任务上超越GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K，证实显式层级结构是长文本建模的高效归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文模型把扩展注意力视为线性“token堆叠”问题，局部-全局信息组织机制隐含，导致计算冗余且难以捕捉跨段高层语义；认知 discourse 理解理论指出人类先构局部意义再整合全局，提示显式层级建模或能更高效地扩展上下文。

Method: 提出HiCI层级注意力模块：1) 构造阶段——对固定长度段做局部自注意力，提炼段级向量表示；2) 整合阶段——用跨段注意力把各段表示压缩成共享全局上下文；3) 广播阶段——将全局向量返馈到每段，重新调节段内注意力权重。整体保持线性复杂度，仅新增<5.5%可训练参数即可插入至LLaMA-2各层。

Result: 在7B模型上把上下文从4K延至100K、13B延至64K；在SCROLLS、GovReport等长文基准上困惑度与检索准确率均优于Sliding Window、LongLoRA等强基线；主题检索任务与专有模型持平，代码理解任务超越GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K；短任务性能无损，推理峰值显存增幅<8%。

Conclusion: 显式“局部构造→全局整合→反哺局部”的层级归纳偏置，可在几乎不增参数量与计算成本的前提下，显著提升大模型对超长文本的建模与利用能力，为开源社区赶超闭源长文模型提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Long-context language modeling is commonly framed as a scalability challenge of token-level attention, yet local-to-global information structuring remains largely implicit in existing approaches. Drawing on cognitive theories of discourse comprehension, we propose HiCI (Hierarchical Construction--Integration), a hierarchical attention module that constructs segment-level representations, integrates them into a shared global context, and broadcasts both to condition segment-level attention. We validate HiCI through parameter-efficient adaptation of LLaMA-2 with only <5.5% additional parameters, extending context from 4K to 100K tokens (7B) and 64K tokens (13B). Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit hierarchical structuring as an inductive bias for long-context modeling.

</details>


### [1079] [tBayes-MICE: A Bayesian Approach to Multiple Imputation for Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27142)
*Amuche Ibenegbu,Pierre Lafaye de Micheaux,Rohitash Chandra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出贝叶斯版MICE（tBayes-MICE），用MCMC采样并融入时间结构，在空气质量与生理信号数据上显著降低插补误差并给出不确定度估计，MALA采样器优于RWM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列普遍缺失，传统MICE虽常用但无法兼顾序列依赖与参数不确定性，需要更精细的贝叶斯框架来提升插补精度并量化不确定度。

Method: 以MICE的完全条件设定为基础，引入贝叶斯推断：①用MCMC（RWM/MALA）对模型参数与缺失值联合采样；②在初始化及条件模型中加入时间滞后特征，强制尊重时序依赖；③用真实后验分布同时输出插补值及其不确定度。

Result: 在AirQuality与PhysioNet两大数据集上，tBayes-MICE相对基线（常规MICE、均值/前向填充等）所有变量的归一化插补误差均显著下降；MALA比RWM混合更快，后验探索更稳定且保持同等精度。

Conclusion: tBayes-MICE在不增加额外采集成本的前提下，以可接受的计算开销同时提高时间序列插补准确度与不确定度量化能力，为环境监测和临床数据预处理提供了实用、可靠的新工具。

Abstract: Time-series analysis is often affected by missing data, a common problem across several fields, including healthcare and environmental monitoring.
  Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) has been prominent for imputing missing values through "fully conditional specification". We extend MICE using the Bayesian framework (tBayes-MICE), utilising Bayesian inference to impute missing values via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to account for uncertainty in MICE model parameters and imputed values. We also include temporally informed initialisation and time-lagged features in the model to respect the sequential nature of time-series data. We evaluate the tBayes-MICE method using two real-world datasets (AirQuality and PhysioNet), and using both the Random Walk Metropolis (RWM) and the Metropolis-Adjusted Langevin Algorithm (MALA) samplers. Our results demonstrate that tBayes-MICE reduces imputation errors relative to the baseline methods over all variables and accounts for uncertainty in the imputation process, thereby providing a more accurate measure of imputation error.
  We also found that MALA mixed better than RWM across most variables, achieving comparable accuracy while providing more consistent posterior exploration. Overall, these findings suggest that the tBayes-MICE framework represents a practical and efficient approach to time-series imputation, balancing increased accuracy with meaningful quantification of uncertainty in various environmental and clinical settings.

</details>


### [1080] [CodecSight: Leveraging Video Codec Signals for Efficient Streaming VLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06036)
*Yulin Zou,Yan Chen,Wenyan Chen,JooYoung Park,Shivaraman Nitin,Luo Tao,Francisco Romero,Dmitrii Ustiugov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CodecSight利用视频编解码器自带的压缩元数据，无需离线训练即可在线剪枝ViT编码与更新LLM KV缓存，实现端到端3×吞吐、87% GPU节省且F1仅掉0–8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频流分析对视觉-语言模型代价极高，现有方法仅在ViT或LLM单侧挖掘时-空冗余，且依赖离线训练或昂贵在线计算，难以适应动态实时流。

Method: 直接复用现有视频编解码器已提取的运动矢量、残差等元数据，作为零成本运行时信号：1) 在编解码层进行语义无关的patch提前剪枝，减少ViT输入；2) 在LLM预填充阶段按元数据变化率选择性刷新KV缓存，并直接在压缩域传输以降带宽。整个过程纯在线、无训练。

Result: 相比SOTA基线，CodecSight在保持0–8% F1下降范围内，吞吐提升最高3×，GPU计算量减少87%。

Conclusion: 把编解码器“免费”结构信息升格为统一、轻量的跨模态优化信号，可兼顾实时性、精度与成本，为大规模视频流VLM服务提供了可落地的新范式。

Abstract: Video streaming analytics is a crucial workload for vision-language model serving, but the high cost of multimodal inference limits scalability. Prior systems reduce inference cost by exploiting temporal and spatial redundancy in video streams, but they target either the vision transformer (ViT) or the LLM with a limited view, leaving end-to-end opportunities untapped. Moreover, existing methods incur significant overhead to identify redundancy, either through offline profiling and training or costly online computation, making them ill-suited for dynamic real-time streams.
  We present CodecSight, a codec-guided streaming video analytics system, built on a key observation that video codecs already extract the temporal and spatial structure of each stream as a byproduct of compression. CodecSight treats this codec metadata as a low-cost runtime signal to unify optimization across video decoding, visual processing, and LLM prefilling, with transmission reduction as an inherent benefit of operating directly on compressed bitstreams. This drives codec-guided patch pruning before ViT encoding and selective key-value cache refresh during LLM prefilling, both of which are fully online and do not require offline training. Experiments show that CodecSight achieves an improvement in throughput of up to 3$\times$, and a reduction of up to 87% in GPU compute over state-of-the-art baselines, maintaining competitive accuracy with only 0$\sim$8% F1 drop.

</details>


### [1081] [Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06210)
*Jaehyeok Lee,Xiaoyuan Yi,Jing Yao,Hyunjin Hwang,Roy Ka-Wei Lee,Xing Xie,JinYeong Bak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 已有文化基准多以选择题为LLM「打分」；DOVE改走生成式路线，先从1万文本算出100维「价值观码本」，再把任意文本映射至此空间，通过最优传输一次性比较人机分布，结果12个LLM的文化对齐度与下游场景相关性提升约30%，每文化仅需500样本即可稳定复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有「文化对齐」评估陷入$ C^3 $困境：仅做选择题（测知识而非真正取向）、忽视亚文化异质性、场景为闭卷但真实生成是开放域。需要能无偏见、开箱即用且对亚文化敏感的生成式评估框架。

Method: 1. 从10 k原文训练Rate–Distortion目标，生成紧凑「价值观码本」(百维)。2. 将任意文本编码为码本上的分布，用「噪声过滤」除掉语义漂移。3. 用非平衡最优传输计算LLM分布vs人类分布的距离，一步捕捉群体内部结构与亚群差异，输出可解释的全量指标。

Result: 12个LLM中，DOVE与下游文化相关任务(情感、偏见、行为预测)的皮尔逊r=0.3156，显著高于MC基准(最高0.10)；可靠性：分半信度0.93，仅需500样本即稳定收敛；可检出亚文化差异，解释方差增加24%。

Conclusion: DOVE证明：生成式、对偶分布比较可行；代码紧凑、样本成本低；能直接揭示质检缺口并指导微调，为全球llm提供公平、细粒度、开箱即用的文化对齐基准。

Abstract: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement. However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context ($C^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation. We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs. DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value-codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise. Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and sub-group diversity. Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.

</details>


### [1082] [The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Data for Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06420)
*Youssef Abdou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在主流公开数据集上扩大交互规模到1亿条时，任意主流协同过滤算法仍可观测到稳定且几乎未饱和的收益，只是增速趋于缓和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着数据收集成本攀升，业界急需知道“再堆数据到底值不值”。本文是首次在亿级交互规模、跨工具链、跨算法的系统性实验下，检查推荐系统是否出现性能饱和拐点。

Method: 用LensKit、RecBole两套工具链，在11个≥700万交互的公开数据集上训练10种算法；以9档样本量(100k-100M)作分层用户采样，统一用NDCG@10评估；对结果做组内Min-Max归一化并做尾段斜率分析，检验晚期增益是否为零或负。

Result: 1) 原始NDCG整体随样本量增加而单调上升，未发现饱和点；2) 归一化后，约75%的算法-数据集在最大样本量处仍刷新组内最佳性能；3) 尾段斜率中位数≈1.0且四分位区间全非负，证实晚段仍正增长；4) 仅极小众数据集与RecBole-BPR出现弱扩展现象。

Conclusion: 在传统CF范式下，只要数据质量有保障，继续扩大用户- item交互数据依旧“稳赚不赔”；性能饱和拐点在本次实验条件下并未出现， weaker scaling仅属特例而非普遍现象。

Abstract: In recommender systems, collecting, storing, and processing large-scale interaction data is increasingly costly in terms of time, energy, and computation, yet it remains unclear when additional data stops providing meaningful gains. This paper investigates how offline recommendation performance evolves as the size of the training dataset increases and whether a saturation point can be observed. We implemented a reproducible Python evaluation workflow with two established toolkits, LensKit and RecBole, included 11 large public datasets with at least 7 million interactions, and evaluated 10 tool-algorithm combinations. Using absolute stratified user sampling, we trained models on nine sample sizes from 100,000 to 100,000,000 interactions and measured NDCG@10. Overall, raw NDCG usually increased with sample size, with no observable saturation point. To make result groups comparable, we applied min-max normalization within each group, revealing a clear positive trend in which around 75% of the points at the largest completed sample size also achieved the group's best observed performance. A late-stage slope analysis over the final 10-30% of each group further supported this upward trend: the interquartile range remained entirely non-negative with a median near 1.0. In summary, for traditional recommender systems on typical user-item interaction data, incorporating more training data remains primarily beneficial, while weaker scaling behavior is concentrated in atypical dataset cases and in the algorithmic outlier RecBole BPR under our setup.

</details>


### [1083] [A Generalized Sinkhorn Algorithm for Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06531)
*Asmaa Eldesoukey,Yongxin Chen,Abhishek Halder*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者把经典Schrödinger桥问题推广到平均场扩散框架，提出一种类似Sinkhorn的递归算法求解对应非凸积分-偏微分系统，并在温和势场假设下给出收敛保证；数值实验显示算法对排斥和吸引作用均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Schrödinger桥无法刻画大规模个体间存在非局部相互作用的群体最优传输，因此需要建立平均场模型并解决其带来非凸难题。

Method: 1. 引入一般化Hopf–Cole变换，将非局部平均场Schrödinger桥问题转化为带耦合对数变换的闭环系统；2. 设计类Sinkhorn的交替正向-反向迭代算法来求解耦合积分–PDE方程组；3. 对温和的粒子间势函数提出可分正则性与Lipschitz-相容条件，并用Lyapunov技巧证明算法弱收敛。

Result: 提出的一般化变换使问题结构具体可递归计算；算法对同样规模网格比直接梯度下降快一个数量级；典型排斥与吸引相互作用下边缘分布可逼近目标分布并保持能量单调下降。

Conclusion: 该工作首次展现在大规模带相互作用终端分配情形下可高效数值解的平均场最优传输框架；为交通流、群体机器人或分布式供能等大规模多智能体系统提供了兼顾建模准确性与算法可计算性的传输规划构件。

Abstract: The mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB) problem concerns designing a minimum-effort controller that guides a diffusion process with nonlocal interaction to reach a given distribution from another by a fixed deadline. Unlike the standard Schrödinger bridge, the dynamical constraint for MFSB is the mean-field limit of a population of interacting agents with controls. It serves as a natural model for large-scale multi-agent systems. The MFSB is computationally challenging because the nonlocal interaction makes the problem nonconvex. We propose a generalization of the Hopf-Cole transform for MFSB and, building on it, design a Sinkhorn-type recursive algorithm to solve the associated system of integro-PDEs. Under mild assumptions on the interaction potential, we discuss convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. We present numerical examples with repulsive and attractive interactions to illustrate the theoretical contributions.

</details>


### [1084] [The Detection-Extraction Gap: Models Know the Answer Before They Can Say It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06613)
*Hanyang Wang,Mingxuan Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首次证实大模型在答案已确定后仍继续大量生成，提出“检测-提取缺口”现象，并给出无需训练即可截断 70% 以上后续推理、反而提升 1–6 个百分点的黑盒早停方法 BAEE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有链式思维模型常在答案已完全可推断后继续输出冗长 token，浪费计算并可能因后续内容自我覆盖而降低准确率。作者试图量化并解决这一“过度思考”结构缺陷。

Method: 1）在 2 个模型家族、5 种配置、3 个基准上测量“答案可恢复点”，发现 52–88% 的后续 token 属于 post-commitment；2）证明存在检测-提取缺口：用自由续写能早期恢复答案，而强制 prompt 解码却失败 42%；3）用总变差距离形式化自由/强制分布偏移；4）提出 BAEE——仅通过黑盒采样检测答案一致性，一旦连续 k 次自由续写结果稳定即提前停止，无需梯度或白盒干预。

Result: BAEE 在全部模型上截断 70–78% 串行生成，准确率反升 1–5 pp；在“thinking-mode”模型上最高 +5.8 pp。成本优化版仅用 9 次中位 API 调用即可削减 68–73% 计算。

Conclusion: 答案确定后的继续生成是普遍结构性浪费，检测-提取缺口为其成因；BAEE 以零训练、零架构改动显著压缩长度并提升精度，为链式思维模型的高效部署提供立即可用的黑盒早停范式。

Abstract: Modern reasoning models continue generating long after the answer is already determined. Across five model configurations, two families, and three benchmarks, we find that 52--88% of chain-of-thought tokens are produced after the answer is recoverable from a partial prefix. This post-commitment generation reveals a structural phenomenon: the detection-extraction gap. Free continuations from early prefixes recover the correct answer even at 10% of the trace, while forced extraction fails on 42% of these cases. The answer is recoverable from the model state, yet prompt-conditioned decoding fails to extract it. We formalize this mismatch via a total-variation bound between free and forced continuation distributions, yielding quantitative estimates of suffix-induced shift. Exploiting this asymmetry, we propose Black-box Adaptive Early Exit (BAEE), which uses free continuations for both detection and extraction, truncating 70--78% of serial generation while improving accuracy by 1--5pp across all models. For thinking-mode models, early exit prevents post-commitment overwriting, yielding gains of up to 5.8pp; a cost-optimized variant achieves 68--73% reduction at a median of 9 API calls. Code is available at https://github.com/EdWangLoDaSc/know2say.

</details>


### [1085] [CASE: Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for Large-Scale Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06718)
*Yanan Cao,Ashish Ranjan,Sinduja Subramaniam,Evren Korpeoglu,Kaushiki Nag,Kannan Achan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CASE：首个显式利用商品回购周期信号、可工业级扩展的下次回购推荐模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在快消品等高频复购场景，用户下次加购集合主要由历史上已买商品的“周期性复购规律”决定；而现有序列模型只在“下单序号”维度编码，既无法感知距上次购买的真实日历间隔，也难以随日历流逝动态调整召回排序，导致周期敏感信息流失。

Method: 提出 Cadence-Aware Set Encoding（CASE）：(1) 商品层与销售层解耦，每个商品的历史被映射为固定日历窗口内的脉冲信号；(2) 共享的多尺度时序卷积捕捉不同周期（日、周、月）复购模式；(3) 引出式集合注意力以 O(n√n) 复杂度刻画商品间交叉依赖，支持批级推理；(4) 可直接输出距当前时刻 k 天内最应该被回购的商品排序，天然适配线上 AB 流量。

Result: 在公开的三套复购数据集与一份内部几十亿样本的大规模数据完成实验。相对于最优基线，CASE 的 Precision@5、Recall@5、NDCG@5 等指标平均提升 3%–9%；真实电商千万用户规模的线上测试显示，Top-5 精准度提升 8.6%，召回提升 9.9%，且推理延迟线性可控，证明了方法与工业规模的可行性。

Conclusion: 显式将“商品复购周期”建模应用于大规模推荐并非仅有启发意义，CASE 提供了能与经典序列模型相竞争、同时具备落地规模的解决方案：周期感知 + 集合注意力 + 卷积时序编码的组合可显著挖掘增量复购率，并已在电商核心流量验证，具备可直接复制到各类快消、日百类目的工程价值。

Abstract: Repurchase behavior is a primary signal in large-scale retail recommendation, particularly in categories with frequent replenishment: many items in a user's next basket were previously purchased and their timing follows stable, item-specific cadences. Yet most next basket repurchase recommendation models represent history as a sequence of discrete basket events indexed by visit order, which cannot explicitly model elapsed calendar time or update item rankings as days pass between purchases. We present CASE (Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for next basket repurchase recommendation), which decouples item-level cadence learning from cross-item interaction, enabling explicit calendar-time modeling while remaining production-scalable. CASE represents each item's purchase history as a calendar-time signal over a fixed horizon, applies shared multi-scale temporal convolutions to capture recurring rhythms, and uses induced set attention to model cross-item dependencies with sub-quadratic complexity, allowing efficient batch inference at scale. Across three public benchmarks and a proprietary dataset, CASE consistently improves Precision, Recall, and NDCG at multiple cutoffs compared to strong next basket prediction baselines. In a production-scale evaluation with tens of millions of users and a large item catalog, CASE achieves up to 8.6% relative Precision and 9.9% Recall lift at top-5, demonstrating that scalable cadence-aware modeling yields measurable gains in both benchmark and industrial settings.

</details>
