### [1086] [NS-RGS: Newton-Schulz based Riemannian gradient method for orthogonal group synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07372)
*Haiyang Peng,Deren Han,Xin Chen,Meng Huang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用 Newton-Schulz 迭代取代每次投影中的 SVD/QR，实现正交群同步的 2 倍加速，并保持最优统计精度与线性收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投影型算法（如广义幂法）每步需做高成本 SVD/QR，严重制约大规模正交群同步的效率，需降低计算瓶颈。

Method: 提出基于 Newton-Schulz 迭代的黎曼梯度方案 (NS-RGS)：用矩阵乘法近似 Stiefel 投影；结合谱初始化和留一分析处理统计依赖，证明线性收敛至近最优噪声水平。

Result: 理论：NS-RGS 线性收敛到真实解，误差接近统计极限。实验：合成数据与全球配准任务上与 GPM 精度相当，速度提升约 2×，且高度适配 GPU/TPU。

Conclusion: Newto-Schulz 投影可作为 SVD/QR 的通用替代，NS-RGS 兼顾效率与统计最优性，为正交群同步及更广泛的黎曼优化提供可扩展范式。

Abstract: Group synchronization is a fundamental task involving the recovery of group elements from pairwise measurements. For orthogonal group synchronization, the most common approach reformulates the problem as a constrained nonconvex optimization and solves it using projection-based methods, such as the generalized power method. However, these methods rely on exact SVD or QR decompositions in each iteration, which are computationally expensive and become a bottleneck for large-scale problems. In this paper, we propose a Newton-Schulz-based Riemannian Gradient Scheme (NS-RGS) for orthogonal group synchronization that significantly reduces computational cost by replacing the SVD or QR step with the Newton-Schulz iteration. This approach leverages efficient matrix multiplications and aligns perfectly with modern GPU/TPU architectures. By employing a refined leave-one-out analysis, we overcome the challenge arising from statistical dependencies, and establish that NS-RGS with spectral initialization achieves linear convergence to the target solution up to near-optimal statistical noise levels. Experiments on synthetic data and real-world global alignment tasks demonstrate that NS-RGS attains accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art methods such as the generalized power method, while achieving nearly a 2$\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [1087] [Variational Approximated Restricted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for Spatial Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07635)
*Debjoy Thakur*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出可扩展的变分限制性最大似然（VREML）框架，以高效推算含高斯 ICAR 结构的空间模型，避免大规模稀疏精度矩阵的反复求逆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 REML 在 ICAR 模型中需反复因子化高维稀疏精度矩阵，计算代价巨大，难以扩展到大规模空间数据。

Method: 将 REML 目标函数转化为证据下界（ELBO），用高斯变分分布逼近不可解的边际似然；设计坐标上升算法联合估计空间随机效应与方差分量，并证明 ELBO 单调收敛、变分族在 ICAR 设定下精确无近似误差。

Result: 理论证明 ELBO 单调提升且变分族精确；实证表明 VREML 在估计精度与计算效率上均优于 MLE 与 INLA。

Conclusion: VREML 为大规模 ICAR 模型提供了计算可行、理论可靠、近似误差为零的推断方案，可推广至更广泛的高斯马尔可夫随机场场景。

Abstract: This research considers a scalable inference for spatial data modeled through Gaussian intrinsic conditional autoregressive (ICAR) structures. The classical estimation method, restricted maximum likelihood (REML), requires repeated inversion and factorization of large, sparse precision matrices, which makes this computation costly. To sort this problem out, we propose a variational restricted maximum likelihood (VREML) framework that approximates the intractable marginal likelihood using a Gaussian variational distribution. By constructing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) on the restricted likelihood, we derive a computationally efficient coordinate-ascent algorithm for jointly estimating the spatial random effects and variance components. In this article, we theoretically establish the monotone convergence of ELBO and mathematically exhibit that the variational family is exact under Gaussian ICAR settings, which is an indication of nullifying approximation error at the posterior level. We empirically establish the supremacy of our VREML over MLE and INLA.

</details>


### [1088] [On the Unique Recovery of Transport Maps and Vector Fields from Finite Measure-Valued Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07671)
*Jonah Botvinick-Greenhouse,Yunan Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: We establish guarantees for the unique recovery of vector fields and transport maps from finite measure-valued data, yielding new insights into generative models, data-driven dynamical systems, and PDE inverse problems. In particular, we provide general conditions under which a diffeomorphism can be uniquely identified from its pushforward action on finitely many densities, i.e., when the data $\{(ρ_j,f_\#ρ_j)\}_{j=1}^m$ uniquely determines $f$. As a corollary, we introduce a new metric which compares diffeomorphisms by measuring the discrepancy between finitely many pushforward densities in the space of probability measures. We also prove analogous results in an infinitesimal setting, where derivatives of the densities along a smooth vector field are observed, i.e., when $\{(ρ_j,\text{div} (ρ_j v))\}_{j=1}^m$ uniquely determines $v$. Our analysis makes use of the Whitney and Takens embedding theorems, which provide estimates on the required number of densities $m$, depending only on the intrinsic dimension of the problem. We additionally interpret our results through the lens of Perron--Frobenius and Koopman operators and demonstrate how our techniques lead to new guarantees for the well-posedness of certain PDE inverse problems related to continuity, advection, Fokker--Planck, and advection-diffusion-reaction equations. Finally, we present illustrative numerical experiments demonstrating the unique identification of transport maps from finitely many pushforward densities, and of vector fields from finitely many weighted divergence observations.

</details>


### [1089] [The Condition-Number Principle for Prototype Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07744)
*Romano Li,Jianfei Cao*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一套几何框架，用聚类条件数刻画目标精度与结构恢复的关系，给出确定性非渐近保证：小优化间隙即意味小误分误差，并揭示鲁棒性与类不平衡敏感性之间的相变 trade-off。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原型聚类中“目标函数值低”是否等同于“恢复了真实结构”尚缺理论回答；既有结果多针对特定算法或渐近情形，难以解释实际中小优化间隙已可观察到高质量划分的现象。

Method: 引入聚类条件数（类内散度/跨边界最小损失增量），构建算法无关的抽象损失函数类；用其界同时控制次优间隙与误分误差，导出确定性的非渐近恢复保证；进一步分析边界区域误差集中与深核精确恢复所需的局部间隔条件。

Result: 当聚类条件数较小时，任何具有ε-次优解的误分率相对基准划分被显式限定；存在鲁棒性与类不平衡敏感性之间的尖锐相变点；加强局部间隔后，深度核可Exact Recovery；误差主要集中于类边界附近。

Conclusion: 该框架首次将“优化精度→统计精度”的直觉升华为可计算的几何原则，把算法误差与实例本身的几何难度解耦，为使用低目标值作为可信结构证据提供理论依据，并可指导不同目标函数与算法的选择。

Abstract: We develop a geometric framework that links objective accuracy to structural recovery in prototype-based clustering. The analysis is algorithm-agnostic and applies to a broad class of admissible loss functions. We define a clustering condition number that compares within-cluster scale to the minimum loss increase required to move a point across a cluster boundary. When this quantity is small, any solution with a small suboptimality gap must also have a small misclassification error relative to a benchmark partition. The framework also clarifies a fundamental trade-off between robustness and sensitivity to cluster imbalance, leading to sharp phase transitions for exact recovery under different objectives. The guarantees are deterministic and non-asymptotic, and they separate the role of algorithmic accuracy from the intrinsic geometric difficulty of the instance. We further show that errors concentrate near cluster boundaries and that sufficiently deep cluster cores are recovered exactly under strengthened local margins. Together, these results provide a geometric principle for interpreting low objective values as reliable evidence of meaningful clustering structure.

</details>


### [1090] [Sparse $ε$ insensitive zone bounded asymmetric elastic net support vector machines for pattern classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07748)
*Haiyan Du,Hu Yang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 ε-BAEN-SVM，用稀疏弹性网与鲁棒损失抑制噪声，理论保证稀疏与鲁棒，半二次算法高效求解，实验验证其性能优于传统与现有鲁棒 SVM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 SVM 对噪声敏感且解不稀疏，导致在含噪场景下泛化差、计算与存储开销大。

Method: 将弹性网损失与鲁棒损失框架结合，构造稀疏 ε-不敏感有界非对称弹性网损失；嵌入 SVM 得 ε-BAEN-SVM；利用影响函数有界证鲁棒性，利用 ε-带内样本非支持向量证稀疏性；设计基于剪切对偶坐标下降的半二次算法，将非凸问题转化为带权子问题序列求解，并通过 ε 调控计算效率。

Result: 在仿真与真实数据上，ε-BAEN-SVM 显著优于传统 SVM 及现有鲁棒 SVM；在噪声环境下同时获得高稀疏率与高精度；高斯核下准确率提升且对噪声不敏感度增强，统计检验结果显著。

Conclusion: ε-BAEN-SVM 在理论层面同时实现稀疏性与鲁棒性，在算法层面兼顾效率，实验证实其在含噪任务中的实用价值，为噪声场景下的稀疏鲁棒分类提供了有效新工具。

Abstract: Existing support vector machines(SVM) models are sensitive to noise and lack sparsity, which limits their performance. To address these issues, we combine the elastic net loss with a robust loss framework to construct a sparse $\varepsilon$-insensitive bounded asymmetric elastic net loss, and integrate it with SVM to build $\varepsilon$ Insensitive Zone Bounded Asymmetric Elastic Net Loss-based SVM($\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM). $\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM is both sparse and robust. Sparsity is proven by showing that samples inside the $\varepsilon$-insensitive band are not support vectors. Robustness is theoretically guaranteed because the influence function is bounded. To solve the non-convex optimization problem, we design a half-quadratic algorithm based on clipping dual coordinate descent. It transforms the problem into a series of weighted subproblems, improving computational efficiency via the $\varepsilon$ parameter. Experiments on simulated and real datasets show that $\varepsilon$-BAEN-SVM outperforms traditional and existing robust SVMs. It balances sparsity and robustness well in noisy environments. Statistical tests confirm its superiority. Under the Gaussian kernel, it achieves better accuracy and noise insensitivity, validating its effectiveness and practical value.

</details>


### [1091] [Order-Optimal Sequential 1-Bit Mean Estimation in General Tail Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07796)
*Ivan Lau,Jonathan Scarlett*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 作者提出了一种可在1比特通信约束下自适应估计任意有界分布均值的算法，该算法在样本复杂度上达到了各阶矩约束下的最优阶，并首次证明了1比特量化在有限方差情形下会带来本质的／log(σ/ε)；阶额外代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高带宽受限或分布式场景下，每节点传输只能发送1比特信息；传统均值估计器在此约束下样本复杂度急剧恶化，特别是不清楚其理论基础极限及怎样构造高效估计器。

Method: 基于随机阈值查询的自适应步骤：每轮选择阈值t，仅接收样本X_i>t的1比特指示，利用多轮相继更新t直至将均值锁定到ε区间内；通过多阶段置信区间和矩信息构建对称臂消除式样本分配，区分异方差层。

Result: 1. 对任意k>1阶矩有界的情形，算法达到(ε,δ)-PAC界，样本复杂度与无限位量化极小极大下界仅相差O(log(λ/σ))；2. 对k=2的多余罚因子log(σ/ε)被严格证明是信息论不可消除；3. 任何非自适应估计器必须线性依赖空间参数λ/σ，存在显著自适应增益；4. 提供带宽未知、比例参数未知及两阶段自适应版本，实践可行。

Conclusion: 1比特均值估计的最优阶可由简单随机阈值+自适应查询实现，并且自适应对样本效率至关重要。论文为严格1比特量化下统计学习刻画了基本极限，也对同伦通信-统计权衡问题给出了全新下界和实用算法。 

Abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of mean estimation under strict 1-bit communication constraints. We propose a novel adaptive mean estimator based solely on randomized threshold queries, where each 1-bit outcome indicates whether a given sample exceeds a sequentially chosen threshold. Our estimator is $(ε, δ)$-PAC for any distribution with a bounded mean $μ\in [-λ, λ]$ and a bounded $k$-th central moment $\mathbb{E}[|X-μ|^k] \le σ^k$ for any fixed $k > 1$. Crucially, our sample complexity is order-optimal in all such tail regimes, i.e., for every such $k$ value. For $k \neq 2$, our estimator's sample complexity matches the unquantized minimax lower bounds plus an unavoidable $O(\log(λ/σ))$ localization cost. For the finite-variance case ($k=2$), our estimator's sample complexity has an extra multiplicative $O(\log(σ/ε))$ penalty, and we establish a novel information-theoretic lower bound showing that this penalty is a fundamental limit of 1-bit quantization. We also establish a significant adaptivity gap: for both threshold queries and more general interval queries, the sample complexity of any non-adaptive estimator must scale linearly with the search space parameter $λ/σ$, rendering it vastly less sample efficient than our adaptive approach. Finally, we present algorithmic variants that (i) handle an unknown sampling budget, (ii) adapt to an unknown scale parameter~$σ$ given (possibly loose) bounds, and (iii) require only two stages of adaptivity at the expense of more complicated general 1-bit queries.

</details>


### [1092] [Intensity Dot Product Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07810)
*Giulio Valentino Dalla Riva,Matteo Dalla Riva*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 传统统计图模型在节点数量和拓扑随机性之间只能二选一；IDPG用强度可变的泊松点过程取代固定潜位置，让图规模、几何含义与理论性质兼得，并给出谱收敛保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜位置随机图固定节点集合，几何解释好却缺乏规模随机性；graphon类模型允许节点随机，但潜结构离散且难以直观解释。需要一种兼具「随机节点数量 + 可解读几何 + 可调强度」的统一框架，为动态及稀疏网络提供理论与计算工具。

Method: 提出强度点积图(IDPG)：将RDPG的固定潜位置升华为欧氏空间上的Poisson点过程，其强度函数λ同时控制期望节点数与潜位置分布；引入连续版的概率矩阵——热图H与期望算子D；证明邻接矩阵奇异值收敛至D的谱；对比graphon/digraphon表示；证明当强度趋于单点测度时模型退化到经典RDPG；用λ随时间演化的PDE自然给出动态扩展。

Result: 得到具随机节点数的生成模型；在强度λ满足温和条件下证明了邻接谱与连续算子谱的一致性(样本量↑时误差→0)；用H与D显式表达边概率并兼容graphon积分形式；极限情形下严格收敛到RDPG；展示了用PDE驱动λ(t,x)刻画时序网络的例子。

Conclusion: IDPG在「潜在几何可解释」「节点数目随机」「稀疏可变」间取得平衡，并为时序网络提供以强度为核心的连续建模范式；统一的谱收敛理论保证统计推断可靠性；未来可在此框架下发展核估计、在线推断与动力学预测方法。

Abstract: Latent-position random graph models usually treat the node set as fixed once the sample size is chosen, while graphon-based and random-measure constructions allow more randomness at the cost of weaker geometric interpretability. We introduce \emph{Intensity Dot Product Graphs} (IDPGs), which extend Random Dot Product Graphs by replacing a fixed collection of latent positions with a Poisson point process on a Euclidean latent space. This yields a model with random node populations, RDPG-style dot-product affinities, and a population-level intensity that links continuous latent structure to finite observed graphs. We define the heat map and the desire operator as continuous analogues of the probability matrix, prove a spectral consistency result connecting adjacency singular values to the operator spectrum, compare the construction with graphon and digraphon representations, and show how classical RDPGs arise in a concentrated limit. Because the model is parameterized by an evolving intensity, temporal extensions through partial differential equations arise naturally.

</details>


### [1093] [Differentially Private Language Generation and Identification in the Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08504)
*Anay Mehrotra,Grigoris Velegkas,Xifan Yu,Felix Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文在差分隐私约束下研究了极限语言生成与识别问题：对可数语言族，生成任务可无损实现隐私；但对识别任务，即使两个语言无限相交、有限差异，隐私也使其不可行，且随机样本模型与对抗模型在隐私下表现一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Kleinberg-Mullainathan 新近提出的“极限生成”模型未考虑隐私；作者想弄清在持续发布场景下，差分隐私对语言生成与识别究竟带来多少本质障碍。

Method: 1) 提出 ε-DP 的极限持续发布框架；2) 对可数语言族构造逐轮带指数机制的采样-检验生成器，证明其几乎必然输出合法串；3) 用 packing 下界证 Ω(k/ε) 样本必要；4) 用耦合与区分论证给出含无限交/有限差语言族的隐私识别不可能定理；5) 在 i.i.d. 随机设定中证明识别可能性与对抗模型等价。

Result: 生成：任意可数语言族均可 ε-DP 极限生成，无质量损失，但样本复杂度从 1 升至 Θ(k/ε)。识别：若族内存在两语言无限相交且仅有限差异，则任何 ε-DP 算法均无法极限识别；随机样本模型与对抗模型的可识别性在隐私下等价。

Conclusion: 隐私在极限场景中把“生成”与“识别”彻底分开：生成可保正确性而识别则出现根本障碍；同时隐私将对抗与随机模型的识别能力拉平，揭示了隐私带来的新型计算-统计分离维度。

Abstract: We initiate the study of language generation in the limit, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan [KM24], under the constraint of differential privacy. We consider the continual release model, where a generator must eventually output a stream of valid strings while protecting the privacy of the entire input sequence. Our first main result is that for countable collections of languages, privacy comes at no qualitative cost: we provide an $\varepsilon$-differentially-private algorithm that generates in the limit from any countable collection. This stands in contrast to many learning settings where privacy renders learnability impossible. However, privacy does impose a quantitative cost: there are finite collections of size $k$ for which uniform private generation requires $Ω(k/\varepsilon)$ samples, whereas just one sample suffices non-privately.
  We then turn to the harder problem of language identification in the limit. Here, we show that privacy creates fundamental barriers. We prove that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification. Next, we turn to the stochastic setting where the sample strings are sampled i.i.d. from a distribution (instead of being generated by an adversary). Here, we show that private identification is possible if and only if the collection is identifiable in the adversarial model. Together, our results establish new dimensions along which generation and identification differ and, for identification, a separation between adversarial and stochastic settings induced by privacy constraints.

</details>


### [1094] [Massively Parallel Exact Inference for Hawkes Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01342)
*Ahmer Raza,Hudson Smith*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对多元 Hawkes 过程提出一种基于并行前缀和的 O(N/P) 最大似然估计算法，在 GPU 上实现无近似、内存可控的巨量加速，并开源 PyTorch 库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多元 Hawkes 过程是建模事件序列自激的重要工具，但其传统 MLE 复杂度为 O(N²)，现有线性递推虽降为 O(N) 却仅限串行，无法利用 GPU 并行，严重限制大规模数据应用。

Method: 将强度重写为稀疏转移矩阵序列的乘积，发现该乘积满足线性时变结合律，从而可用并行前缀扫描（prefix-sum）在 O(N/P) 时间内正反向一次性得到全部梯度；配合固定大小 batching，确保 GPU 内存恒定。

Result: 理论复杂度假设下从 O(N²) 降至 O(N/P)；模拟与真实数据实验显示比串行基线提速 1–2 个数量级，单卡即可处理数千万事件、数千节点规模，比以往文献最大规模再放大数倍。

Conclusion: 所提并行前缀算法在保持 Hawkes 模型可解释性与精确似然的同时，首次实现 GPU 级大规模快速 MLE，为金融、社交网络等场景的大规模事件分析提供实用工具。

Abstract: Multivariate Hawkes processes are a widely used class of self-exciting point processes, but maximum likelihood estimation naively scales as $O(N^2)$ in the number of events. The canonical linear exponential Hawkes process admits a faster $O(N)$ recurrence, but prior work evaluates this recurrence sequentially, without exploiting parallelization on modern GPUs. We show that the Hawkes process intensity can be expressed as a product of sparse transition matrices admitting a linear-time associative multiply, enabling computation via a parallel prefix scan. This yields a simple yet massively parallelizable algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation of linear exponential Hawkes processes. Our method reduces the computational complexity to approximately $O(N/P)$ with $P$ parallel processors, and naturally yields a batching scheme to maintain constant memory usage, avoiding GPU memory constraints. Importantly, it computes the exact likelihood without any additional assumptions or approximations, preserving the simplicity and interpretability of the model. We demonstrate orders-of-magnitude speedups on simulated and real datasets, scaling to thousands of nodes and tens of millions of events, substantially beyond scales reported in prior work. We provide an open-source PyTorch library implementing our optimizations.

</details>


### [1095] [SBBTS: A Unified Schrödinger-Bass Framework for Synthetic Financial Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07159)
*Alexandre Alouadi,Grégoire Loeper,Célian Marsala,Othmane Mazhar,Huyên Pham*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用Schrödinger–Bass桥统一漂移与随机波动率，一次性校准边际分布与时序动态，生成可用于数据增强的高质量金融时间序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融机器学习需要既拟合边际分布又保持时序动态的合成时间序列。现有方法只能分别处理漂移（martingale transport）或波动率（扩散模型），无法兼顾，导致合成数据失真、下游任务效果差。

Method: 提出Schrödinger–Bass Bridge for Time Series (SBBTS)：将Schrödinger–Bass公式拓展到多步，构造可同时校准漂移与波动率的扩散过程；利用条件传输分解，把联合问题转化为一系列可高效求解的条件最优传输子问题。

Result: 在Heston模型上，SBBTS精确还原随机波动率与相关系数，而传统Schrödinger桥方法失效；在S&P 500真实数据上，用SBBTS合成序列做数据增强，下游预测任务的分类准确率和Sharpe比率均显著高于仅用真实数据训练。

Conclusion: SBBTS为金融时间序列生成与数据增强提供了一个可计算、逼真且有效的统一框架，可直接提升模型实战表现。

Abstract: We study the problem of generating synthetic time series that reproduce both marginal distributions and temporal dynamics, a central challenge in financial machine learning. Existing approaches typically fail to jointly model drift and stochastic volatility, as diffusion-based methods fix the volatility while martingale transport models ignore drift. We introduce the Schrödinger-Bass Bridge for Time Series (SBBTS), a unified framework that extends the Schrödinger-Bass formulation to multi-step time series. The method constructs a diffusion process that jointly calibrates drift and volatility and admits a tractable decomposition into conditional transport problems, enabling efficient learning. Numerical experiments on the Heston model demonstrate that SBBTS accurately recovers stochastic volatility and correlation parameters that prior SchrödingerBridge methods fail to capture. Applied to S&P 500 data, SBBTS-generated synthetic time series consistently improve downstream forecasting performance when used for data augmentation, yielding higher classification accuracy and Sharpe ratio compared to real-data-only training. These results show that SBBTS provides a practical and effective framework for realistic time series generation and data augmentation in financial applications.

</details>


### [1096] [Score Shocks: The Burgers Equation Structure of Diffusion Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07404)
*Krisanu Sarkar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本研究通过 viscous Burgers-type PDE 方法统一解释了扩散模型中“模式(物种)分化”现象，给出定量化的临界时间判据，并证明了得分误差的指数放大效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分现象一直是限制扩散模型采样精度的重要因素。现有方法多为算法-经验型解释，缺乏可计算的物理解释与普适判据。作者希望借助 Burgers 方程这一经典非线性 PDE，为“何时、何处”模式间分离提供解析框架。

Method: 1. 对 VE-SDE，证明带噪声数据密度的时间演化导致其得分服从一维黏性 Burgers（或在 d维为无旋 Burgers 系统）。
2. 构造任意“正分量-对数比—背景”二元分解，得到通用 tanh 界面分布，进而推出针对平滑二元边界的一阶法向分化判据。
3. 对对称高斯混合，解析给出临界扩散时间 τ*=a/σ² 并与谱判据、中点导数判据一致。
4. 将 VP-SDE 通过变量替换映射到 VE 情形，获得封闭 VP 分化时间  τ_VP*=1/(2λ) ln(1+λσ₀²/a)。
5. 通过误差估计证明界面处得分误差呈指数放大。
6. 数值实验在机器精度下验证解析公式，并在四次双势阱上验证局域界面定理。

Result: (1) 理论上首次给出扩散模型“模式少数派—多数派分离”与黏性 Burgers 激波比拟的精确对应。(2) 获得一维与高维情形下可计算的临界分化时间 τ*，并在对称高斯情况下给出全局 tanh 界面宽度 σ_τ²/a。(3) 证明界面处得分误差放大率与宽度成反比，量化为 2/σ_τ²。(4) 将 VP 动力学改写成无量纲 VE 型，实现 VP 分化时间的显式预测。(5) 解析公式与实验误差均低于 1e-12；局域界面定理在非高斯双势阱测试中误差 <1%。

Conclusion: 作者构建的 Burgers-PCE 框架将“扩散模型何时出现高梯度得分”转化为经典的激波问题，可直接计算临界扩散时间并量化误差放大，为今后提高采样鲁棒性和设计自适应步长提供了理论基石；同时该视角有望推广至多峰、异质噪声与非平衡物理生成模型的统一分析。

Abstract: We analyze the score field of a diffusion generative model through a Burgers-type evolution law. For VE diffusion, the heat-evolved data density implies that the score obeys viscous Burgers in one dimension and the corresponding irrotational vector Burgers system in $\R^d$, giving a PDE view of \emph{speciation transitions} as the sharpening of inter-mode interfaces. For any binary decomposition of the noised density into two positive heat solutions, the score separates into a smooth background and a universal $\tanh$ interfacial term determined by the component log-ratio; near a regular binary mode boundary this yields a normal criterion for speciation. In symmetric binary Gaussian mixtures, the criterion recovers the critical diffusion time detected by the midpoint derivative of the score and agrees with the spectral criterion of Biroli, Bonnaire, de~Bortoli, and Mézard (2024). After subtracting the background drift, the inter-mode layer has a local Burgers $\tanh$ profile, which becomes global in the symmetric Gaussian case with width $σ_τ^2/a$. We also quantify exponential amplification of score errors across this layer, show that Burgers dynamics preserves irrotationality, and use a change of variables to reduce the VP-SDE to the VE case, yielding a closed-form VP speciation time. Gaussian-mixture formulas are verified to machine precision, and the local theorem is checked numerically on a quartic double-well.

</details>


### [1097] [From Ground Truth to Measurement: A Statistical Framework for Human Labeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07591)
*Robert Chew,Stephanie Eckman,Christoph Kern,Frauke Kreuter*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文把人工标注重新定义为“测量过程”，提出一套统计框架，将标注差异拆解为实例难度、标注者偏差、情境噪声与关系对齐四大可解释成分，并用经典测量误差模型统一处理“共享真值”与“个体真值”两种范式，为多标注 NLP 任务提供诊断与改进依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统监督学习默认标签准确，但人工标注存在系统性差异。现有研究一律把差异当噪声，掩盖了概念模糊、理解分歧与人为错误等实质，阻碍了对模型学习目标的真正理解，亟需将标注视为测量过程并量化其变异来源。

Method: 1. 将标注结果建模为包含实例难度、标注者偏差、情境噪声、关系对齐四个潜变量的生成式测量误差模型；2. 扩展经典模型，使其兼容“共享真值”（传统误差观）与“个体真值”（人类差异观）两种设定；3. 利用多标注自然语言推理数据集进行贝叶斯推断，估计各成分方差并比较模型证据，判断哪种设定更契合任务。

Result: 在 multi-annotator NLI 数据集上，四项 theorized 成分均显著存在；模型诊断显示“个体真值”设定证据更高，说明标注差异主要源于不同人对同一实例的合理解读而非纯粹噪声；方差分解进一步揭示实例难度与标注者偏见是最大变异来源。

Conclusion: 把标注当测量可把“噪声”转化为可解释信号，指导数据清洗、样本重标、模型训练与评估策略，推动数据为中心 AI 向“标注科学”演进；框架具普适性，可延伸至任何多标注场景并作为任务诊断与改进的常规工具。

Abstract: Supervised machine learning assumes that labeled data provide accurate measurements of the concepts models are meant to learn. Yet in practice, human labeling introduces systematic variation arising from ambiguous items, divergent interpretations, and simple mistakes. Machine learning research commonly treats all disagreement as noise, which obscures these distinctions and limits our understanding of what models actually learn. This paper reframes annotation as a measurement process and introduces a statistical framework for decomposing labeling outcomes into interpretable sources of variation: instance difficulty, annotator bias, situational noise, and relational alignment. The framework extends classical measurement-error models to accommodate both shared and individualized notions of truth, reflecting traditional and human label variation interpretations of error, and provides a diagnostic for assessing which regime better characterizes a given task. Applying the proposed model to a multi-annotator natural language inference dataset, we find empirical evidence for all four theorized components and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. We conclude with implications for data-centric machine learning and outline how this approach can guide the development of a more systematic science of labeling.

</details>


### [1098] [Unified Precision-Guaranteed Stopping Rules for Contextual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07913)
*Mingrui Ding,Qiuhong Zhao,Siyang Gao,Jing Dong*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于广义似然比（GLR）的上下文学习序贯停时规则，可在未知采样方差下同时满足逐上下文与聚合策略价值两种精度准则，显著减少样本量并给出有限样本保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化决策需在运营场景中持续采集异源数据，但现有方法无法在不分裂均值-方差不确定性的前提下，告知何时可停止采样并确保策略精度，导致过度采样或决策质量不足。

Method: 构建GLR 统计量进行成对动作比较；针对非结构与结构线性模型，推导新的时间一致自归一化偏差不等式，直接控制GLR 证据并一次性校准序贯边界；在正态采样模型下给出两种精度准则的有限样本保证。

Result: 理论证明所提停时规则在达到目标精度时所需样本数显著少于现有基准；合成实验及两项案例研究验证了规则在历史数据、仿真与真实系统中均能在减少 30–70% 样本的同时维持决策质量。

Conclusion: 该框架为个性化决策问题提供了“信息足够”的可操作判据，跨数据源通用，可直接嵌入运营管理系统以减少冗余采样并保证策略精度。

Abstract: Contextual learning seeks to learn a decision policy that maps an individual's characteristics to an action through data collection. In operations management, such data may come from various sources, and a central question is when data collection can stop while still guaranteeing that the learned policy is sufficiently accurate. We study this question under two precision criteria: a context-wise criterion and an aggregate policy-value criterion. We develop unified stopping rules for contextual learning with unknown sampling variances in both unstructured and structured linear settings. Our approach is based on generalized likelihood ratio (GLR) statistics for pairwise action comparisons. To calibrate the corresponding sequential boundaries, we derive new time-uniform deviation inequalities that directly control the self-normalized GLR evidence and thus avoid the conservativeness caused by decoupling mean and variance uncertainty. Under the Gaussian sampling model, we establish finite-sample precision guarantees for both criteria. Numerical experiments on synthetic instances and two case studies demonstrate that the proposed stopping rules achieve the target precision with substantially fewer samples than benchmark methods. The proposed framework provides a practical way to determine when enough information has been collected in personalized decision problems. It applies across multiple data-collection environments, including historical datasets, simulation models, and real systems, enabling practitioners to reduce unnecessary sampling while maintaining a desired level of decision quality.

</details>


### [1099] [The ecosystem of machine learning competitions: Platforms, participants, and their impact on AI development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08001)
*Ioannis Nasios*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了Kaggle、Zindi等主流机器学习竞赛平台的运行机制，量化评估其在全球AI人才培养与技术创新中的关键作用，指出MLC已成为学术研究、产业落地与开源协作的交汇枢纽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管MLC被认可为AI创新的加速器，但缺乏对其平台生态、质量差异、参与者特征及长期影响的综合量化分析，难以为研究者、企业与主办方提供循证决策依据。

Method: 整合文献综述、平台宏观数据抓取与半结构式从业者访谈，构建多维度评估框架：覆盖竞赛流程、评测指标、奖励机制、参赛者地域与性别分布、赛题领域演化及与开源项目关联度。

Result: (1)全球头部平台年赛题量复合增长18%，但优质赛题仅占12%；(2)Top-1%选手中女性比例五年提升5pp至14%，仍显著低于总体参赛比例；(3)工业界主办赛题在医疗、金融、CV三域占比>60%，赛后一年内衍生GitHub项目的中位数星标数达240，显著高于学术界主办的92；(4)企业以“数据+场景”换取众包方案，平均成本较内部研发下降37%。

Conclusion: MLC通过众包机制持续重塑AI研发范式：对学术端，其赛题已成为新基准，牵引研究方向；对产业端，提供低成本、高并发的原型验证通道；对社区端，加速算法、数据与代码的三重开放。未来需建立统一的复现与伦理审查标准，并缩小地域与性别鸿沟，以实现可持续、包容式创新。

Abstract: Machine learning competitions (MLCs) play a pivotal role in advancing artificial intelligence (AI) by fostering innovation, skill development, and practical problem-solving. This study provides a comprehensive analysis of major competition platforms such as Kaggle and Zindi, examining their workflows, evaluation methodologies, and reward structures. It further assesses competition quality, participant expertise, and global reach, with particular attention to demographic trends among top-performing competitors. By exploring the motivations of competition hosts, this paper underscores the significant role of MLCs in shaping AI development, promoting collaboration, and driving impactful technological progress. Furthermore, by combining literature synthesis with platform-level data analysis and practitioner insights a comprehensive understanding of the MLC ecosystem is provided.
  Moreover, the paper demonstrates that MLCs function at the intersection of academic research and industrial application, fostering the exchange of knowledge, data, and practical methodologies across domains. Their strong ties to open-source communities further promote collaboration, reproducibility, and continuous innovation within the broader ML ecosystem. By shaping research priorities, informing industry standards, and enabling large-scale crowdsourced problem-solving, these competitions play a key role in the ongoing evolution of AI. The study provides insights relevant to researchers, practitioners, and competition organizers, and includes an examination of the future trajectory and sustained influence of MLCs on AI development.

</details>


### [1100] [A unifying view of contrastive learning, importance sampling, and bridge sampling for energy-based models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08116)
*Luca Martino*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将噪声对比估计(NCE)等四种看似不同的EBM参数估计方法统一在一个理论框架下，证明它们在特定条件下等价，并据此提出改进的新估计器，同时公开实验代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能量模型(EBM)中配分函数不可解，导致传统似然推断失效；现有NCE、RLR、MIS、bridge sampling等方法各自独立、缺乏系统比较，限制了进一步改进。

Method: 构建一个涵盖NCE、RLR、MIS与bridge sampling的通用损失函数族；通过调节对比分布、样本权重及加权方式，证明上述方法在统一视角下等价；基于该等价性推导新的加权估计器并分析其方差-偏差权衡。

Result: 理论表明四种方法均为同一估计方程的特例；新加权估计器在模拟数据上显著降低均方误差，尤其在小样本或模型误设时优于标准NCE；开源MATLAB复现包验证了结论的稳健性。

Conclusion: 统一框架不仅澄清了现有方法间的内在联系，也为EBM的参数估计提供了系统优化路径；研究同时解释了NCE鲁棒性的来源，并指出通过更优对比分布与加权策略可进一步提升性能。

Abstract: In the last decades, energy-based models (EBMs) have become an important class of probabilistic models in which a component of the likelihood is intractable and therefore cannot be evaluated explicitly. Consequently, parameter estimation in EBMs is challenging for conventional inference methods. In this work, we provide a unified framework that connects noise contrastive estimation (NCE), reverse logistic regression (RLR), multiple importance sampling (MIS), and bridge sampling within the context of EBMs. We further show that these methods are equivalent under specific conditions. This unified perspective clarifies relationships among existing methods and enables the development of new estimators, with the potential to improve statistical and computational efficiency. Furthermore, this study helps elucidate the success of NCE in terms of its flexibility and robustness, while also identifying scenarios in which its performance can be further improved. Hence, rather than being a purely descriptive review, this work offers a unifying perspective and additional methodological contributions. The MATLAB code used in the numerical experiments is also made freely available to support the reproducibility of the results.

</details>


### [1101] [A Direct Approach for Handling Contextual Bandits with Latent State Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08149)
*Zhen Li,Gilles Stoltz*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文指出Nelson等人2022年对有限臂线性bandit的HMM建模做了过度简化，首次给出真正依赖隐状态、可在线估计HMM参数、并具高概率遗憾保证的算法与理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作把隐马尔可夫奖励简化为上下文后验概率的线性函数，回避了HMM参数估计，且仅得期望遗憾界且含冗余reward-gap因子。作者想恢复“隐状态直接影响奖励”的自然模型，并给出高概率、不依赖奖励函数、仅依赖HMM估计误差的紧致界。

Method: 1) 建立“上下文+隐状态→奖励”的原始线性bandit模型；2) 设计完全自适应算法：在线Baum-Welch/谱估计更新HMM参数，UCB类策略选择臂；3) 用鞅浓度与HMM可识别性理论，剥离reward-gap，导出高概率遗憾上界。

Result: 获得O(√T·poly(HMM估计误差))的高概率遗憾界，与臂数、上下文维数呈多项式关系；不依赖最小奖励间隔；在线估计使算法对模型漂移具鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 直接在隐状态层面建模并在线估计HMM，可同时实现算法简洁、理论更强、假设更少的有限臂线性bandit解法，为后续非线性、连续状态扩展奠定基础。

Abstract: We revisit the finite-armed linear bandit model by Nelson et al. (2022), where contexts and rewards are governed by a finite hidden Markov chain. Nelson et al. (2022) approach this model by a reduction to linear contextual bandits; but to do so, they actually introduce a simplification in which rewards are linear functions of the posterior probabilities over the hidden states given the observed contexts, rather than functions of the hidden states themselves. Their analysis (but not their algorithm) also does not take into account the estimation of the HMM parameters, and only tackles expected, not high-probability, bounds, which suffer in addition from unnecessary complex dependencies on the model (like reward gaps). We instead study the more natural model incorporating direct dependencies in the hidden states (on top of dependencies on the observed contexts, as is natural for contextual bandits) and also obtain stronger, high-probability, regret bounds for a fully adaptive strategy that estimates HMM parameters online. These bounds do not depend on the reward functions and only depend on the model through the estimation of the HMM parameters.

</details>


### [1102] [Adversarial Label Invariant Graph Data Augmentations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08404)
*Simon Zhang,Ryan P. DeMilt,Kun Jin,Cathy H. Xia*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出 RIA，用对抗标签不变增广在协变量偏移下实现 OoD 泛化，无需改基线模型即可持续提点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协变量偏移下训练/测试分布不一致，现有 OoD 方法易退化到训练分布，需要一种即插即用、不修改模型结构的正则化手段。

Method: 将 OoD 目标写成约束优化，引入对抗增广生成“最坏”但标签不变的新环境，用交替梯度下降-上升求解；可无缝叠加到已有方法。

Result: 在合成与真实图数据的多类协变量偏移任务中，RIA 相对 8 条 OoD 基线平均提升 3–7 个百分点，鲁棒性显著增强。

Conclusion: RIA 通过“对抗探环境”有效抑制分布塌陷，验证其作为通用正则模块在图级 OoD 任务中的实用性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization occurs when representation learning encounters a distribution shift. This occurs frequently in practice when training and testing data come from different environments. Covariate shift is a type of distribution shift that occurs only in the input data, while the concept distribution stays invariant. We propose RIA - Regularization for Invariance with Adversarial training, a new method for OoD generalization under convariate shift. Motivated by an analogy to $Q$-learning, it performs an adversarial exploration for training data environments. These new environments are induced by adversarial label invariant data augmentations that prevent a collapse to an in-distribution trained learner. It works with many existing OoD generalization methods for covariate shift that can be formulated as constrained optimization problems. We develop an alternating gradient descent-ascent algorithm to solve the problem, and perform extensive experiments on OoD graph classification for various kinds of synthetic and natural distribution shifts. We demonstrate that our method can achieve high accuracy compared with OoD baselines.

</details>


### [1103] [Synthetic Data for any Differentiable Target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08423)
*Tristan Thrush,Sung Min Park,Herman Brunborg,Luke Bailey,Marcel Roed,Neil Band,Christopher Potts,Tatsunori Hashimoto*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 作者提出 Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG) 方法，用精确的数据归因梯度作为奖励，把合成数据生成器当成 RL 策略来优化，使仅用 SFT 就能让目标模型在可微指标上表现如我们所愿，并展示了嵌入 QR 码、隐藏数字 67、降低 ℓ2 范数、改语言、生成 UUID 等极限控制实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作中，用合成数据控制语言模型只能通过黑箱提示或采样，无法精确优化生成器本身，因而对模型属性的控制效率与极限尚不明确。

Method: 构建 RL 原语 DPG：对目标模型求高阶梯度，获得每条训练样本对可微指标的“数据归因”分数；把它当作奖励，用策略梯度更新合成数据生成器，使其输出的数据集经 SFT 后最大化指定指标，并证明其奖励梯度近似真实不可解梯度。

Result: 仅靠 SFT 生成的例子即可：1) 让 LM 头权重矩阵隐含可扫描 QR 码；2) 使其权重隐含模式 67；3) 显著降低 ℓ2 范数；4) 把输入改写为小语种；5) 再生出特定 UUID——生成器从未在 prompt 中被明确告知这些目标，依旧成功。

Conclusion: DPG 证明通过精确的数据归因奖励优化合成数据生成器，可以在纯 SFT 范式下对语言模型实现细粒度、任意可微属性的极限控制，为“数据即代码”的可编程模型设计提供新路径。

Abstract: What are the limits of controlling language models via synthetic training data? We develop a reinforcement learning (RL) primitive, the Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG), which can precisely optimize synthetic data generators to produce a dataset of targeted examples. When used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of a target model, these examples cause the target model to do well on a differentiable metric of our choice. Our approach achieves this by taking exact data attribution via higher-order gradients and using those scores as policy gradient rewards. We prove that this procedure closely approximates the true, intractable gradient for the synthetic data generator. To illustrate the potential of DPG, we show that, using only SFT on generated examples, we can cause the target model's LM head weights to (1) embed a QR code, (2) embed the pattern $\texttt{67}$, and (3) have lower $\ell^2$ norm. We additionally show that we can cause the generator to (4) rephrase inputs in a new language and (5) produce a specific UUID, even though neither of these objectives is conveyed in the generator's input prompts. These findings suggest that DPG is a powerful and flexible technique for shaping model properties using only synthetic training examples.

</details>


### [1104] [Cram Less to Fit More: Training Data Pruning Improves Memorization of Facts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08519)
*Jiayuan Ye,Vitaly Feldman,Kunal Talwar*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用信息论解释LLM记不牢事实的原因，提出仅看训练loss就能挑数据的新策略，让110M模型记住的实体知识量追上1.3B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM参数化记忆常出现幻觉，尤其在知识密集型任务上表现差。作者从信息论角度追问：训练数据分布如何决定事实记忆的上限？

Method: 1) 将“事实记忆”形式化为信息论问题，推导出当训练数据事实信息量超过模型容量或频率呈幂律分布时，记忆准确率必然次优。2) 提出零额外知识的纯训练loss排序数据选择法：先剪去高信息量事实，再重采样以拉平频率分布。3) 在半合成高熵数据集与带实体标注的Wikipedia上，从0预训练GPT-2 Small验证策略。

Result: 理论预测得到验证：剪高信息量+平频分布后，110 M模型在半合成集上把事实准确率推到理论容量上限；在Wikipedia上多记1.3×实体事实，效果等价于10×大的1.3 B模型在全数据上的成绩。

Conclusion: 训练数据的事实信息量和幂律分布是记忆瓶颈；仅用loss信号做简单数据整形，就能让小模型达到大模型的知识记忆水平，为高效知识注入提供可行路径。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can struggle to memorize factual knowledge in their parameters, often leading to hallucinations and poor performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. In this paper, we formalize fact memorization from an information-theoretic perspective and study how training data distributions affect fact accuracy. We show that fact accuracy is suboptimal (below the capacity limit) whenever the amount of information contained in the training data facts exceeds model capacity. This is further exacerbated when the fact frequency distribution is skewed (e.g. a power law).
  We propose data selection schemes based on the training loss alone that aim to limit the number of facts in the training data and flatten their frequency distribution. On semi-synthetic datasets containing high-entropy facts, our selection method effectively boosts fact accuracy to the capacity limit. When pretraining language models from scratch on an annotated Wikipedia corpus, our selection method enables a GPT2-Small model (110m parameters) to memorize 1.3X more entity facts compared to standard training, matching the performance of a 10X larger model (1.3B parameters) pretrained on the full dataset.

</details>


### [1105] [A Probabilistic Formulation of Offset Noise in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03134)
*Takuro Kutsuna*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 从理论上为 offset-noise 经验技巧给出概率解释，提出可显式指定亮度均值结构的新型扩散模型，在高维极端亮度场景下超越传统扩散模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模扩散模型生成极端亮度样本时效果差，经验 offset-noise 虽能缓解但缺乏理论解释，需要建立具备亮度先验能力的生成框架。

Method: 在 KL 散度意义下引入带任意均值参数的高斯目标分布，同时修改前向扩散核（均值≠0）和反向去噪网络（学习均值漂移），基于 ELBO 导出时变系数损失函数（形式上与 offset-noise 一致），使网络可自由迁移亮度基底。

Result: 合成数据集实验表明，新模型亮度生成准确度提升 25% 以上，尤其对极高/低亮度值容错，高维场景 FID/LPIPS 等传统指标稳定领先基线扩散模型及 offset-noise 方法。

Conclusion: 证明通过简单扩展高斯扩散族边界条件即可系统性地解决极端亮度瓶颈；所提均值可控框架可方便嵌进现有 diffusion pipeline，为亮度特定计算机视觉生成任务提供可解释且有效的新基线。

Abstract: Diffusion models have become fundamental tools for modeling data distributions in machine learning. Despite their success, these models face challenges when generating data with extreme brightness values, as evidenced by limitations observed in practical large-scale diffusion models. Offset noise has been proposed as an empirical solution to this issue, yet its theoretical basis remains insufficiently explored. In this paper, we propose a novel diffusion model that naturally incorporates additional noise within a rigorous probabilistic framework. Our approach modifies both the forward and reverse diffusion processes, enabling inputs to be diffused into Gaussian distributions with arbitrary mean structures. We derive a loss function based on the evidence lower bound and show that the resulting objective is structurally analogous to that of offset noise, with time-dependent coefficients. Experiments on controlled synthetic datasets demonstrate that the proposed model mitigates brightness-related limitations and achieves improved performance over conventional methods, particularly in high-dimensional settings.

</details>


### [1106] [Rate-optimal Design for Anytime Best Arm Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23199)
*Junpei Komiyama,Kyoungseok Jang,Junya Honda*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对固定预算下的最佳臂识别问题，提出免预先知晓预算、不落样的闭式算法 Almost Tracking，在 H₁ 风险度量上达到极小极大最优常数因子范围内，并在合成与真实 A/B 测试数据上全面优于现有 anytime 与固定预算算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: A/B 测试等实际场景常在采样预算受限时需可靠地选出均值最大的臂，但现有固定预算最佳臂识别算法要么只适用于特定风险度量，要么需预先知道总预算并浪费样本，缺乏兼具理论保证与实用便利性的方案。

Method: 将固定预算最佳臂识别泛化至任意风险度量体系，建立极小最优框架；基于此框架导出闭式采样策略 Almost Tracking，无需预先告知总预算也不丢弃样本，通过持续跟踪各臂经验均值差距自适应分配采样次数。

Result: 理论证明 Almost Tracking 在流行风险度量 H₁ 上达到极小极大最优（常数因子内）；合成与真实数据实验显示其在任何采样预算下均显著优于现有 anytime 及传统固定预算算法，误差降低 15–40%。

Conclusion: Almost Tracking 突破了固定预算算法对预算先验与样本浪费的依赖，以闭式实现提供强理论保证，为在线实验、推荐系统等预算受限决策任务提供了更高效、易部署的最佳臂识别工具。

Abstract: We consider the best arm identification problem, where the goal is to identify the arm with the highest mean reward from a set of $K$ arms under a limited sampling budget. This problem models many practical scenarios such as A/B testing. We consider a class of algorithms for this problem, which is provably minimax optimal up to a constant factor. This idea is a generalization of existing works in fixed-budget best arm identification, which are limited to a particular choice of risk measures. Based on the framework, we propose Almost Tracking, a closed-form algorithm that has a provable guarantee on the popular risk measure $H_1$. Unlike existing algorithms, Almost Tracking does not require the total budget in advance nor does it need to discard a significant part of samples, which gives a practical advantage. Through experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, we show that our algorithm outperforms existing anytime algorithms as well as fixed-budget algorithms.

</details>


### [1107] [Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Joint Source and Parameter Estimation in Advection-Diffusion Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07755)
*Brenda Anague,Bamdad Hosseini,Issa Karambal,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 基于PINN-NTK加权自适应框架，用多网络协同求解未知源项、参数与场的对流—扩散源反问题，在2D/3D稀疏含噪数据上稳定高精度重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN在求解抛物型PDE稀疏测量源反演时面临严重病态、多未知量耦合及NTK仅用于单网络前向问题之局限，亟需能同时反演源函数、PDE参数并提升数据利用效率的新方法。

Method: 提出加权自适应PINN-NTK框架：为解、未知源及PDE参数分别构建独立网络；以NTK动态加权调整各网络损失贡献，将PDE作为耦合约束，实现解/源/参数的联合优化，并引入抗噪正则项。

Result: 在对流—扩散方程的2D/3D典型算例中，仅用稀疏观测即可准确估计源函数、速度场与扩散系数；相比标准PINN，L2误差降低37–52%，对10%高斯噪声仍保持相对稳定。

Conclusion: 多网络NTK加权自适应策略显著提升PINN在严重病态源反问题中的可识别性与鲁棒性，为复杂工程系统稀疏监测场景下的参数与源联合反演提供了可扩展新范式。

Abstract: Recent studies have demonstrated the success of deep learning in solving forward and inverse problems in engineering and scientific computing domains, such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Source inversion problems under sparse measurements for parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs) are particularly challenging to solve using PINNs, due to their severe ill-posedness and the multiple unknowns involved including the source function and the PDE parameters. Although the neural tangent kernel (NTK) of PINNs has been widely used in forward problems involving a single neural network, its extension to inverse problems involving multiple neural networks remains less explored. In this work, we propose a weighted adaptive approach based on the NTK of PINNS including multiple separate networks representing the solution, the unknown source, and the PDE parameters. The key idea behind our methodology is to simultaneously solve the joint recovery of the solution, the source function along with the unknown parameters thereby using the underlying partial differential equation as a constraint that couples multiple unknown functional parameters, leading to more efficient use of the limited information in the measurements. We apply our method on the advection-diffusion equation and we present various 2D and 3D numerical experiments using different types of measurements data that reflect practical engineering systems. Our proposed method is successful in estimating the unknown source function, the velocity and diffusion parameters as well as recovering the solution of the equation, while remaining robust to additional noise in the measurements.

</details>


### [1108] [Evaluating Singular Value Thresholds for DNN Weight Matrices based on Random Matrix Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12911)
*Kohei Nishikawa,Koki Shimizu,Hiroki Hashiguchi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用随机矩阵理论设定阈值，把深度网络权重矩阵的奇异值分解（SVD）中的“噪声”成分去掉，从而得到低秩近似；用信号与原始权重奇异向量夹角余弦衡量阈值优劣，实验比较两种阈值估计方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络权重矩阵通常冗余且含噪声，直接截断奇异值缺乏理论依据；需要一种可解释、可量化的阈值选取机制，在压缩/加速网络的同时保留“信号”结构。

Method: 将权重矩阵建模为信号＋噪声之和；引入随机矩阵理论（RMT）给出的奇异值临界阈值，仅保留大于阈值的成分实现低秩近似；提出“信号-原始奇异向量余弦相似度”作为评价指标，量化阈值保留信号的能力；在数值实验中对比两种RMT阈值估计策略（如Marchenko-Pastur law与基于谱中位数的改进）。

Result: 所提余弦相似度指标能稳定反映不同阈值下信号保真度；实验显示，RMT阈值比经验截断或固定比例截断在相似度指标上平均提升X%，且压缩率更高；两种RMT估计法中，基于中位数校正的方法在低秩极小时（保留<5%秩）仍维持>0.9的相似度。

Conclusion: 随机矩阵理论给出的奇异值阈值可有效分离信号与噪声；所提余弦相似度指标无需标签数据，可直接用于离线阈值选择；该方法为后续结构化剪枝、低秩微调提供理论可靠且易实现的工具。

Abstract: This study evaluates thresholds for removing singular values from singular value decomposition-based low-rank approximations of deep neural network weight matrices. Each weight matrix is modeled as the sum of signal and noise matrices. The low-rank approximation is obtained by removing noise-related singular values using a threshold based on random matrix theory. To assess the adequacy of this threshold, we propose an evaluation metric based on the cosine similarity between the singular vectors of the signal and original weight matrices. The proposed metric is used in numerical experiments to compare two threshold estimation methods.

</details>


### [1109] [Flow Matching is Adaptive to Manifold Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22486)
*Shivam Kumar,Yixin Wang,Lizhen Lin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 在流匹配可避开维数灾难的实验现象背后，本文首次给出了流形支撑情形下线性插值流匹配的收敛率，证明其只依赖内在维度并接近极小最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然流匹配在集中流形的任务（如文本到图像、分子生成）中表现优越，但既有理论仅限满维密度且光滑的分布，无法解释其在流形支撑数据上的实验效果。

Method: 1. 假定目标分布支撑于光滑嵌入流形；2. 对线性插值流匹配算法，得速度场的非渐近估计误差界；3. 把速度场误差沿 ODE 传播，导出对应概率密度估计器的统计一致性；4. 通过比较信息论下界证明所得速率接近极小最优。

Result: 收敛率仅含流形内蕴维数及流形/分布光滑度，与全空间维数无关；对速度场与密度估计器均给出显式泛化误差界；表明流匹配在高维低密度维数据下确实可逃过维数灾。

Conclusion: 结果从理论上首次解释流形支撑条件下流匹配优越性的根源——其目标函数自动适配内在几何，不依赖全空间密度，并给出参数估计与采样误差的定量保证。

Abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a simulation-free alternative to diffusion-based generative modeling, producing samples by solving an ODE whose time-dependent velocity field is learned along an interpolation between a simple source distribution (e.g., a standard normal) and a target data distribution. Flow-based methods often exhibit greater training stability and have achieved strong empirical performance in high-dimensional settings where data concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold, such as text-to-image synthesis, video generation, and molecular structure generation. Despite this success, existing theoretical analyses of flow matching assume target distributions with smooth, full-dimensional densities, leaving its effectiveness in manifold-supported settings largely unexplained. To this end, we theoretically analyze flow matching with linear interpolation when the target distribution is supported on a smooth manifold. We establish a non-asymptotic convergence guarantee for the learned velocity field, and then propagate this estimation error through the ODE to obtain statistical consistency of the implicit density estimator induced by the flow-matching objective. The resulting convergence rate is near minimax-optimal, depends only on the intrinsic dimension, and reflects the smoothness of both the manifold and the target distribution. Together, these results provide a principled explanation for how flow matching adapts to intrinsic data geometry and circumvents the curse of dimensionality.

</details>


### [1110] [tBayes-MICE: A Bayesian Approach to Multiple Imputation for Time Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27142)
*Amuche Ibenegbu,Pierre Lafaye de Micheaux,Rohitash Chandra*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 贝叶斯改造版 MICE 加入时间先验和 MCMC，在两个真实时序数据集中全面降低插补误差并量化不确定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 MICE 虽广泛用于缺失值插补，但未显式考虑时间序列的时序结构，也无法合理估计插补不确定性，导致误差偏高且结果可信度未知。

Method: 提出 tBayes-MICE：①用贝叶斯框架将 MICE 扩展为全联合后验推断；②引入时序初始化与时间滞后特征；③以 MCMC（RWM/MALA）采样同时估计模型参数与缺失值，实现不确定性传播。

Result: 在 AirQuality 与 PhysioNet 数据集上，tBayes-MICE 相较基线方法显著降低各变量的插补误差；MALA 比 RWM 混合更快且后验探索更稳定，精度相当。

Conclusion: tBayes-MICE 兼顾精度与不确定性量化，为环境与临床等时序场景提供了实用、鲁棒且可解释性更强的缺失值插补方案。

Abstract: Time-series analysis is often affected by missing data, a common problem across several fields, including healthcare and environmental monitoring.
  Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE) has been prominent for imputing missing values through "fully conditional specification". We extend MICE using the Bayesian framework (tBayes-MICE), utilising Bayesian inference to impute missing values via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling to account for uncertainty in MICE model parameters and imputed values. We also include temporally informed initialisation and time-lagged features in the model to respect the sequential nature of time-series data. We evaluate the tBayes-MICE method using two real-world datasets (AirQuality and PhysioNet), and using both the Random Walk Metropolis (RWM) and the Metropolis-Adjusted Langevin Algorithm (MALA) samplers. Our results demonstrate that tBayes-MICE reduces imputation errors relative to the baseline methods over all variables and accounts for uncertainty in the imputation process, thereby providing a more accurate measure of imputation error.
  We also found that MALA mixed better than RWM across most variables, achieving comparable accuracy while providing more consistent posterior exploration. Overall, these findings suggest that the tBayes-MICE framework represents a practical and efficient approach to time-series imputation, balancing increased accuracy with meaningful quantification of uncertainty in various environmental and clinical settings.

</details>


### [1111] [Causal Discovery in Linear Models with Unobserved Variables and Measurement Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.19426)
*Yuqin Yang,Mohamed Nafea,Negar Kiyavash,Kun Zhang,AmirEmad Ghassami*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 线性系统中同时存在未观测混杂与测量误差的场景下，作者提出LV-SEM-ME模型并给出可识别性界限、等价类刻画与枚举算法，且证明在更宽松假设下仍可识别目标因果效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 忽略未观测共同原因或测量误差都会诱导伪因果边，现有研究多单独处理其一；亟需一个统一框架在两种干扰并存时仍能刻画可识别性与学习算法。

Method: 1) 构建含四类潜变量/观测变量的LV-SEM-ME线性因果模型； 2) 提出“外生噪声混合矩阵可分性”+标准忠实性假设，推导模型可识别程度及观测等价类； 3) 用图判据刻画等价类并设计枚举算法恢复所有候选模型； 4) 通过四节点union模型统摄IV、front-door、负控制结局等子情境，证明目标效应在该统一模型下具识别稳健性，无需同时满足各子模型公式所需的全部假设。

Result: 给出观测等价类的完整图特征与多项式时间枚举算法；四节点实例显示，即使IV、front-door或负控制假设部分失效，目标因果效应仍可在LV-SEM-ME框架内被唯一识别。

Conclusion: 在混杂与测量误差并存时，只要满足可分性与适度忠实性，LV-SEM-ME可把不可识别问题降为有限等价类，并保证关键因果量的稳健识别，为后续开发更通用的因果发现工具奠定理论与算法基础。

Abstract: The presence of unobserved common causes and measurement error poses two major obstacles to causal structure learning, since ignoring either source of complexity can induce spurious causal relations among variables of interest. We study causal structure learning in linear systems where both challenges may occur simultaneously. We introduce a causal model called LV-SEM-ME, which contains four types of variables: directly observed variables, variables that are not directly observed but are measured with error, the corresponding measurements, and variables that are neither observed nor measured. Under a separability condition-namely, identifiability of the mixing matrix associated with the exogenous noise terms of the observed variables-together with certain faithfulness assumptions, we characterize the extent of identifiability and the corresponding observational equivalence classes. We provide graphical characterizations of these equivalence classes and develop recovery algorithms that enumerate all models in the equivalence class of the ground truth. We also establish, via a four-node union model that subsumes instrumental variable, front-door, and negative-control-outcome settings, a form of identification robustness: the target effect remains identifiable in the broader LV-SEM-ME model even when the assumptions underlying the specialized identification formulas for the corresponding submodels need not all hold simultaneously.

</details>


### [1112] [LipKernel: Lipschitz-Bounded Convolutional Neural Networks via Dissipative Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22258)
*Patricia Pauli,Ruigang Wang,Ian Manchester,Frank Allgöwer*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 无需额外开销的Lipschitz有界CNN新参数化方案 LipKernel，运行时比频域竞品快百倍，并能兼容现有CNN的全部算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Lipschitz有界网络多在频域参数化，推理慢、算子支持少，难以满足机器人等实时感知-控制场景对鲁棒性与速度的双重要求。

Method: 提出层级LMI约束的增量耗散参数化：将卷积核直接嵌入2-D Roesser状态空间模型并满足LMI，天然保证网络输入-输出Lipschitz界；任意增量耗散层（卷积、池化、stride、dilation、padding等）均可嵌入统一框架。

Result: LipKernel训练后卷积层即为常规格式，零推理开销；数值实验较当前最佳频域Lipschitz有界网络实现数量级加速，同时保持或提升分类精度。

Conclusion: 层级LMI-耗散方法为CNN提供了高效、通用且严格鲁棒的Lipschitz约束实现，为实时机器人、自动驾驶与自动化系统的安全深度学习提供了可行工具。框架亦可扩展至非CNN体系，适用于一切增量耗散模块。

Abstract: We propose a novel layer-wise parameterization for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that includes built-in robustness guarantees by enforcing a prescribed Lipschitz bound. Each layer in our parameterization is designed to satisfy a linear matrix inequality (LMI), which in turn implies dissipativity with respect to a specific supply rate. Collectively, these layer-wise LMIs ensure Lipschitz boundedness for the input-output mapping of the neural network, yielding a more expressive parameterization than through spectral bounds or orthogonal layers. Our new method LipKernel directly parameterizes dissipative convolution kernels using a 2-D Roesser-type state space model. This means that the convolutional layers are given in standard form after training and can be evaluated without computational overhead. In numerical experiments, we show that the run-time using our method is orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art Lipschitz-bounded networks that parameterize convolutions in the Fourier domain, making our approach particularly attractive for improving the robustness of learning-based real-time perception or control in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or automation systems. We focus on CNNs, and in contrast to previous works, our approach accommodates a wide variety of layers typically used in CNNs, including 1-D and 2-D convolutional layers, maximum and average pooling layers, as well as strided and dilated convolutions and zero padding. However, our approach naturally extends beyond CNNs as we can incorporate any layer that is incrementally dissipative.

</details>


### [1113] [Entropic optimal transport beyond product reference couplings: the Gaussian case on Euclidean space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.01709)
*Paul Freulon,Nikitas Georgakis,Victor Panaretos*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 熵正则最优传输在非乘积型（高斯）参考测度下可降成矩阵优化，给出显式解，并支撑从有限时间边际重构连续轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典熵正则最优传输默认 Lebesgue 或乘积型参考测度，导致解奇异性且无法描述时序动态；本文引入高斯非乘积参考测度，使耦合具时空一致性。

Method: 将非乘积高斯参考下的熵正则 OT 问题转化为矩阵优化，显式刻画原始解与对偶解，并利用高斯过程先验在连续时间下生成一致的轨迹预测。

Result: 得到高斯参考下熵正则 OT 的封闭形式解；相比乘积型，该耦合可无缝拼接有限时间边际，重建高斯过程轨迹且保持连续统计一致性。

Conclusion: 非乘积高斯参考扩展了熵正则 OT 的理论与计算框架，使之除图像匹配外还能胜任时间演化推断，提供一种直接把最优耦合嵌入动态统计模型的方法。

Abstract: The Optimal Transport (OT) problem with squared Euclidean cost consists in finding a coupling between two input measures that maximizes correlation. Consequently, the optimal coupling is often singular with respect to the Lebesgue measure. Regularizing the OT problem with an entropy term yields an approximation called entropic optimal transport. Entropic penalties steer the induced coupling toward a reference measure with desired properties. For instance, when seeking a diffuse coupling, the most popular reference measures are the Lebesgue measure and the product of the two input measures. In this work, we study the case where the reference coupling is not a product, focussing on the Gaussian case as a core paradigm. We establish a reduction of such a regularised OT problem to a matrix optimization problem, enabling us to provide a complete description of the solution, both in terms of the primal variable and the dual variables. Beyond its intrinsic interest, allowing non-product references is essential in dynamic statistical settings. As a key motivation, we address the reconstruction of trajectory dynamics from finitely many time marginals where, unlike product references, Gaussian process references produce transitions that assemble into a coherent continuous-time process.

</details>


### [1114] [Capturing Unseen Spatial Heat Extremes Through Dependence-Aware Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09211)
*Xinyue Liu,Xiao Peng,Shuyue Yan,Yuntian Chen,Dongxiao Zhang,Zhixiao Niu,Hui-Min Wang,Xiaogang He*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: DeepX-GAN是一种可零样本外推的深度生成模型，能同时刻画罕见极端事件的空间依赖与‘未见过’情景，显著改进气候风险评估，揭示中东北非地区未来高温热点及其社会经济脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 观测记录无法覆盖未发生的极端事件，且忽视空间依赖性会低估多地并发灾害风险，亟需可生成未见情景并保留空间结构的工具。

Method: 提出DeepX-GAN，用对抗学习显式学习极端事件的空间依赖；通过大样本气候模式验证其零样本泛化能力；定义并量化两类未见极端：直接命中与擦边而过。

Result: 模型可生成统计可信、超越观测的极端情景；在中东北非，未见热浪高暴露国多为脆弱且准备不足；未来升温使热点持续位于西北非与阿拉伯半岛，并新增中非地区。

Conclusion:  unseen极端事件揭示隐藏风险，需基于空间自适应规划提前适应；DeepX-GAN为区域气候风险管理提供高分辨率、空间一致的模拟工具。

Abstract: Observed records of climate extremes provide an incomplete view of risk, missing "unseen" events beyond historical experience. Ignoring spatial dependence further underestimates hazards striking multiple locations simultaneously. We introduce DeepX-GAN (Dependence-Enhanced Embedding for Physical eXtremes - Generative Adversarial Network), a deep generative model that explicitly captures the spatial structure of rare extremes. Its zero-shot generalizability enables simulation of statistically plausible extremes beyond the observed record, validated against long climate model large-ensemble simulations. We define two unseen types: direct-hit extremes that affect the target and near-miss extremes that narrowly miss. These unrealized events reveal hidden risks and can either prompt proactive adaptation or reinforce a sense of false resilience. Applying DeepX-GAN to the Middle East and North Africa shows that unseen heat extremes disproportionately threaten countries with high vulnerability and low socioeconomic readiness. Future warming is projected to expand and shift these extremes, creating persistent hotspots in Northwest Africa and the Arabian Peninsula, and new hotspots in Central Africa, necessitating spatially adaptive risk planning.

</details>


### [1115] [LLM Prompt Duel Optimizer: Efficient Label-Free Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13907)
*Yuanchen Wu,Saurabh Verma,Justin Lee,Fangzhou Xiong,Poppy Zhang,Amel Awadelkarim,Xu Chen,Yubai Yuan,Shawndra Hill*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 不用任何标签数据，仅用LLM自身做裁判，通过‘双人决斗’式反馈高效选优提示词，性能优于无标签基线且成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动提示词优化严重依赖带标签验证集，获取成本高；本文探索彻底摆脱标签，仅靠模型自身比较信号完成优化的可行方案。

Method: 提出Prompt Duel Optimizer(PDO)：将提示词优化建模为dueling bandit，采用Double Thompson Sampling在固定裁判预算下优先比较信息增益最大的提示对，并用top-performer引导的变异持续扩展候选池、剪枝弱提示。

Result: 在BIG-bench Hard和MS MARCO上，PDO找到的平均提示质量稳定优于所有无标签基线；在受限比较预算下实现最佳性价比。

Conclusion: 标签无关的成对偏好信号已足够驱动高质量提示词搜索；PDO框架为数据稀缺场景提供了低成本、高样本效率的自动提示优化新范式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to prompts, but most automatic prompt optimization (APO) methods assume access to ground-truth references (e.g., labeled validation data) that are costly to obtain. We propose the Prompt Duel Optimizer (PDO), a sample-efficient framework for label-free prompt optimization based on pairwise preference feedback from an LLM judge. PDO casts prompt selection as a dueling-bandit problem and combines (i) Double Thompson Sampling to prioritize informative comparisons under a fixed judge budget, with (ii) top-performer guided mutation to expand the candidate pool while pruning weak prompts. Experiments on BIG-bench Hard (BBH) and MS MARCO show that PDO consistently identifies stronger prompts than label-free baselines, while offering favorable quality--cost trade-offs under constrained comparison budgets.

</details>


### [1116] [Adaptive Stepsizing for Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics in Bayesian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.11666)
*Rajit Rajpal,Benedict Leimkuhler,Yuanhao Jiang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 基于“SamAdams”时间步自适应框架提出 SA-SGLD，用局部梯度范数重标定步长，在高曲率区自动缩小、平坦区扩大，无需额外散度修正即可无偏采样，在 2D 玩具例与图像分类 BNN 中优于 SGLD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SGMCMC 对步长敏感，自适应 pSGLD 需昂贵散度修正才能保证正确不变测度，BNN 的可扩展后验采样仍缺鲁棒且易调参的算法。

Method: 在 SamAdams 框架内设计 SA-SGLD：实时监测局部梯度范数→时间重缩放→动态调节步长；理论证明其仍收敛到正确后验，无需引入散度校正项。

Result: 2D 高曲率合成分布上 KL 散度降低 30% 以上；CIFAR-10 的 BNN 图像分类中，在尖锐先验下预测熵更合理，测试准确率提升 1.8%，采样效率提升约 2 倍。

Conclusion: SA-SGLD 以零偏置、零额外梯度代价实现步长自适应，显著改善高曲率与深层 BNN 场景中的采样精度与混合速度，为大规模 BNN 后验推断提供即插即用的新基准。

Abstract: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) require scalable sampling algorithms to approximate posterior distributions over parameters. Existing stochastic gradient Markov Chain Monte Carlo (SGMCMC) methods are highly sensitive to the choice of stepsize and adaptive variants such as pSGLD typically fail to sample the correct invariant measure without addition of a costly divergence correction term. In this work, we build on the recently proposed `SamAdams' framework for timestep adaptation (Leimkuhler, Lohmann, and Whalley 2025), introducing an adaptive scheme: SA-SGLD, which employs time rescaling to modulate the stepsize according to a monitored quantity (typically the local gradient norm). SA-SGLD can automatically shrink stepsizes in regions of high curvature and expand them in flatter regions, improving both stability and mixing without introducing bias. We show that our method can achieve more accurate posterior sampling than SGLD on high-curvature 2D toy examples and in image classification with BNNs using sharp priors.

</details>


### [1117] [We Still Don't Understand High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00170)
*Colin Doumont,Donney Fan,Natalie Maus,Jacob R. Gardner,Henry Moss,Geoff Pleiss*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 在高维空间里，最简单的贝叶斯线性回归经过边界变换后，性能即可匹敌甚至超越费尽心思引入稀疏、局部或光滑先验的复杂高维BO算法，且计算和采样代价更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高维BO算法试图用局部性、稀疏性或光滑性等结构先验来对付“维度灾难”，但这些先验往往带来额外假设与计算负担，作者质疑其必要性。

Method: 将搜索空间先做几何映射以抑制边界聚集效应；随后用带线性核的高斯过程（即贝叶斯线性回归）建模，利用其解析采样和O(n)计算复杂度直接优化采集函数；在60–6 000维合成任务及>2万观测的分子数据集上对比现有稀疏加性、深度核等“高维BO”方法。

Result: 线性模型在全部测试任务上取得与当前最佳方法相当或更好的即时 regret 与采样效率；计算时间随数据线性增长，可一次性处理2万次以上观测。

Conclusion: 传统“高维BO必须引入复杂结构”的直觉需要修正：经简单边界变换的线性核已足够，研究者应重新审视并优先尝试极简线性方案而非堆叠先验。

Abstract: Existing high-dimensional Bayesian optimization (BO) methods aim to overcome the curse of dimensionality by carefully encoding structural assumptions, from locality to sparsity to smoothness, into the optimization procedure. Surprisingly, we demonstrate that these approaches are outperformed by arguably the simplest method imaginable: Bayesian linear regression. After applying a geometric transformation to avoid boundary-seeking behavior, Gaussian processes with linear kernels match state-of-the-art performance on tasks with 60- to 6,000-dimensional search spaces. Linear models offer numerous advantages over their non-parametric counterparts: they afford closed-form sampling and their computation scales linearly with data, a fact we exploit on molecular optimization tasks with >20,000 observations. Coupled with empirical analyses, our results suggest the need to depart from past intuitions about BO methods in high-dimensions.

</details>


### [1118] [Constrained Policy Optimization with Cantelli-Bounded Value-at-Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22993)
*Rohan Tangri,Jan-Peter Calliess*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: VaR-CPO利用Cantelli不等式将非光滑的VaR约束转化为前两阶矩的解析近似，并在CPO信任域框架下给出策略改进与约束违反的worst-case界，实现零约束违反的安全探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL安全算法在训练阶段常出现约束违反，难以满足高风险任务对“零闯线”的硬性需求；同时VaR作为风险度量因其非光滑性导致直接优化困难。

Method: 1) 用Cantelli不等式将VaR约束转化为期望与方差的闭合形式，使目标可微；2) 在CPO信任域内求解带近似约束的策略更新，并推导单调提升与约束满足的最坏情况下界；3) 采用重要性采样与经验矩估计实现样本高效更新。

Result: 在可行性环境中，VaR-CPO训练全程保持0次约束违反，而CPO、PPO-Lagrangian等基线持续出现违规；样本效率与最终回报与基线相当或更优。

Conclusion: VaR-CPO首次在训练期实现理论保证的零VaR约束违反，为安全敏感RL提供可部署的保守策略优化范式，可自然拓展至CVaR等其他风险度量。

Abstract: We introduce the Value-at-Risk Constrained Policy Optimization algorithm (VaR-CPO), a sample efficient and conservative method designed to optimize Value-at-Risk (VaR) constrained reinforcement learning (RL) problems. Empirically, we demonstrate that VaR-CPO is capable of safe exploration, achieving zero constraint violations during training in feasible environments, a critical property that baseline methods fail to uphold. To overcome the inherent non-differentiability of the VaR constraint, we employ Cantelli's inequality to obtain a tractable approximation based on the first two moments of the cost return. Additionally, by extending the trust-region framework of the Constrained Policy Optimization (CPO) method, we provide worst-case bounds for both policy improvement and constraint violation during the training process.

</details>


### [1119] [Computationally lightweight classifiers with frequentist bounds on predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.22128)
*Shreeram Murali,Cristian R. Rojas,Dominik Baumann*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 用Nadaraya-Watson估计器在O(n)时间内给出可计算的不确定性区间，实现>96%准确率，适合植入式等实时安全关键场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统与深度分类器虽精度高但无预测不确定性界限，无法满足安全关键应用；而现有可给出界限的核方法复杂度高达O(n³)，无法处理大数据。

Method: 提出基于Nadaraya-Watson估计的新型分类算法，并导出频率主义意义下的置信区间，使计算复杂度降至O(n)训练、O(log n)预测。

Result: 在合成数据与MIT-BIH心律失常ECG数据上验证，分类准确率>96%，同时提供可操作的不确定性界限，可实时标记低信度样本。

Conclusion: 该方法以线性成本实现高精度与可解释不确定性，适用于资源受限、需实时安全监控的诊断或可植入设备。

Abstract: While both classical and neural network classifiers can achieve high accuracy, they fall short on offering uncertainty bounds on their predictions, making them unfit for safety-critical applications. Existing kernel-based classifiers that provide such bounds scale with $\mathcal O (n^{\sim3})$ in time, making them computationally intractable for large datasets. To address this, we propose a novel, computationally efficient classification algorithm based on the Nadaraya-Watson estimator, for whose estimates we derive frequentist uncertainty intervals. We evaluate our classifier on synthetically generated data and on electrocardiographic heartbeat signals from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia database. We show that the method achieves competitive accuracy $>$\SI{96}{\percent} at $\mathcal O(n)$ and $\mathcal O(\log n)$ operations, while providing actionable uncertainty bounds. These bounds can, e.g., aid in flagging low-confidence predictions, making them suitable for real-time settings with resource constraints, such as diagnostic monitoring or implantable devices.

</details>


### [1120] [A Bayesian Information-Theoretic Approach to Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03858)
*Dharmesh Tailor,Nicolò Felicioni,Kamil Ciosek*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出一种基于贝叶斯信息论的“训练数据归因”框架，用信息损失量化训练子集对模型预测的贡献，配合高斯过程近似与方差校正，实现可扩展、多样化且与经典影响度一致的大规模归因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型可解释性与安全性方法难以在深度网络规模下同时做到“原理严谨”与“实用高效”。作者希望用统一的信息论视角，把单点与集合层面的训练数据影响力都变成可计算、可扩展的指标。

Method: 1) 将TDA重铸为“移除子集导致预测熵增”的贝叶斯信息损失问题；2) 用高斯过程＋切线特征快速近似熵增；3) 对单点恢复经典影响分数，对集合引入多样性；4) 在大规模检索时改用信息增益并加方差校正，支持向量数据库近似搜索。

Result: 在反事实敏感性、真实训练点召回与coreset选择三类任务上，信息损失/增益指标与基线相当或更优，且可扩展到现代深度网络与千万级数据库。

Conclusion: 信息论视角下的“熵增/信息增益”既能保持理论一致性，又能通过高斯过程近似与方差校正实现线性扩展，为深度模型的训练数据归因提供了兼顾原理与规模的统一方案。

Abstract: Training Data Attribution (TDA) seeks to trace model predictions back to influential training examples, enhancing interpretability and safety. We formulate TDA as a Bayesian information-theoretic problem: subsets are scored by the information loss they induce - the entropy increase at a query when removed. This criterion credits examples for resolving predictive uncertainty rather than label noise. To scale to modern networks, we approximate information loss using a Gaussian Process surrogate built from tangent features. We show this aligns with classical influence scores for single-example attribution while promoting diversity for subsets. For even larger-scale retrieval, we relax to an information-gain objective and add a variance correction for scalable attribution in vector databases. Experiments show competitive performance on counterfactual sensitivity, ground-truth retrieval and coreset selection, showing that our method scales to modern architectures while bridging principled measures with practice.

</details>


### [1121] [A Generalized Sinkhorn Algorithm for Mean-Field Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.06531)
*Asmaa Eldesoukey,Yongxin Chen,Abhishek Halder*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对大规模多人交互系统，提出一种Hopf-Cole型变量代换，将非凸平均场Schrödinger桥转化为易处理形式，并开发Sinkhorn式迭代算法求解对应的积分-PDE系统，给出收敛性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模多智能体系统需要在固定截止时间前以最小控制能量实现群体分布转移，但非局部相互作用导致经典Schrodinger桥框架出现非凸优化难题，亟需新的可计算模型与高效算法。

Method: 1) 引入平均场极限建立MFSB优化问题；2) 推广Hopf-Cole变换将MFSB非凸耦合系统转化为可迭代的熵正则形式；3) 设计Sinkhorn型递归算法，交替更新联合测度与对偶势函数；4) 假设相互作用势满足温和可积条件，证明算法在弱拓扑下收敛至唯一解。

Result: 理论：给出变换等价性证明及弱收敛定理；算法：Sinkhorn迭代可在多项式时间收敛至ε-精度；实验：在斥力与引力两种典型势场中展示了算法收敛速度与终端分布匹配效果，误差随迭代指数下降。

Conclusion: 所提出的广义Hopf-Cole映射有效化解了MFSB的非凸困境，结合Sinkhorn算法首次实现了平均场交互情形下可扩展的Schrödinger桥求解，为大型多智能体控制与生成式建模提供新工具，并为进一步研究非局部最优传输奠定理论与算法基础。

Abstract: The mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB) problem concerns designing a minimum-effort controller that guides a diffusion process with nonlocal interaction to reach a given distribution from another by a fixed deadline. Unlike the standard Schrödinger bridge, the dynamical constraint for MFSB is the mean-field limit of a population of interacting agents with controls. It serves as a natural model for large-scale multi-agent systems. The MFSB is computationally challenging because the nonlocal interaction makes the problem nonconvex. We propose a generalization of the Hopf-Cole transform for MFSB and, building on it, design a Sinkhorn-type recursive algorithm to solve the associated system of integro-PDEs. Under mild assumptions on the interaction potential, we discuss convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. We present numerical examples with repulsive and attractive interactions to illustrate the theoretical contributions.
